verses.name: Genesis 1:1

verses.name: Genesis 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">without form</w> <w lemma="strong:H0922">and void</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02822">and darkness</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">of the deep</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07363" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0216">and there was light</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">that</w> <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996 strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">the darkness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the light from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">between the light and between the darkness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">Day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">and the darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">Night</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06153">And the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">and the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">were the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And the evening…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the evening was, and the morning was</rdg> etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07549">Let there be a firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and let it divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">from the waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>firmament</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">expansion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">the firmament</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08478">under</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">from the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05921">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">the firmament</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651">and it was so</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">Heaven</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06153">And the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">and the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">were the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And the evening…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the evening was, and the morning was</rdg> etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">Let the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03004">and let the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appear</w>: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">Earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04723">and the gathering together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">he Seas</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">Let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01876" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">grass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06212">the herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">yielding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yielding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">whose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in itself, upon the earth</w>: and it was so.<note type="study"><catchWord>grass</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tender grass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">grass</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06212">herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">yielding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yielding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">whose seed</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04327">in itself, after his kind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">And the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">and the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">were the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And the evening…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the evening was, and the morning was</rdg> etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03974">Let there be lights</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">in the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">from the night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0226">and let them be for signs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and for seasons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and for days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and years</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the day…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">between the day and between the night</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03974">And let them be for lights</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">in the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">lights</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01419">the greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">to rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">and the lesser</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">to rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">the night</w>: <transChange type="added">he made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03556">the stars</w> also.<note type="study"><catchWord>to rule the day…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the rule of the day</rdg>, etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">them in the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And to rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">over the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and over the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">from the darkness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">And the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">and the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">were the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And the evening…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the evening was, and the morning was</rdg> etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">Let the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bring forth abundantly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">the moving creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and fowl</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">may fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>moving</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">creeping</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>life</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fowl…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let fowl fly</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>open…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">face of the firmament of heaven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">created</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">whales</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and every living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that moveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">which the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">brought forth abundantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04327">after their kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and every winged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and multiply</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and let fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">And the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">and the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">were the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And the evening…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the evening was, and the morning was</rdg> etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">Let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and creeping thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>: and it was so.

verses.name: Genesis 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after their kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and every thing that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">in our image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01823">after our likeness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01710">over the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and over the fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and over the cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and over all the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and over every creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">So God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">created</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> in his <transChange type="added">own</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06754">image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06754">in the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">created</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">he him; male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">and female</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">created</w> he them.

verses.name: Genesis 1:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">them, and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Be fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and multiply</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and replenish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and subdue it</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01710">over the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and over the fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and over every living thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that moveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>moveth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">creepeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">you every herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and every tree</w>, in the which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yielding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to you it shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">for meat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bearing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seeding seed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>yielding…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seeding seed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">And to every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and to every fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to every thing that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, wherein <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H02416">life</w>, <transChange type="added">I have given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03418">every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">for meat</w>: and it was so.<note type="study"><catchWord>life</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a living soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 1:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">every thing that</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he had made</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06153">And the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">and the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">were the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And the evening…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the evening was, and the morning was</rdg> etc.</note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen30" osisID="Gen.1"/>

verses.name: Genesis 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Thus the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">were finished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host of them</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ended</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">from all his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">it: because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that in it he had rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">from all his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">created</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and made</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>created…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">created to make</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0428">These</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when they were created</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07880">And every plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02962">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it was in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06212">and every herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02962">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it grew</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03588">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">had not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">caused it to rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to till</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But there went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0108">a mist</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the whole face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>there…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a mist which went up from</rdg>, etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and breathed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">into his nostrils</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">and man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">became a living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the dust…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dust of the ground</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">a garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">in Eden</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08033">and there</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he had formed</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04480">And out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-1">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-1">to grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">every tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that is pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">for food</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06086">the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">also in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05104">And a river</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to water</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">the garden</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and from thence it was parted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and became into four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">The name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the first</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06376">Pison</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01931">that</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it which compasseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02341">of Havilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">where</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">And the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">of that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0916">bdellium</w> <w lemma="strong:H07718">and the onyx</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">river</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01521">Gihon</w>: the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it that compasseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ethiopia</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Cush</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">river</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02313">Hiddekel</w>: that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it which goeth toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06926">the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07243">And the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">river</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eastward to Assyria</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put him</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">into the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dress</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it and to keep</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>the man</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Adam</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">Of every tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou mayest freely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eating thou shalt eat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">But of the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of it: for in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou eatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou shalt surely…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dying thou shalt die</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">that the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">alone; I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">him an help meet</w> for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>meet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as before him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0127">And out of the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and every fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">unto Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what he would call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">them: and whatsoever Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">every living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">that</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name thereof</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Adam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">to all cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and to the fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and to every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">but for Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there was not found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">an help meet</w> for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-2">caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H08639">a deep sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-2">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0121">upon Adam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he slept</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">of his ribs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and closed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> instead thereof;

verses.name: Genesis 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06763">And the rib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">from man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">he a woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">her unto the man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">builded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02063">This</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06471">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">of my bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of my flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02063">she</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">Woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02063">because she</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">out of Man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Woman</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Isha</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ish</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03651">Therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">shall a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto his wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">and they shall be one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And they were both</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and were not ashamed</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen31" osisID="Gen.2"/>

verses.name: Genesis 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05175">Now the serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was</w> <w lemma="strong:H06175">more subtil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">than any beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0637">Yea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">hath God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of every tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Yea…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Yea, because</rdg>, etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">unto the serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06529">But of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the tree</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it, neither shall ye touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06435">it, lest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye die</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05175">And the serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Ye shall not surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thereof, then your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and ye shall be as gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And when the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">that the tree</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">for food</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">and that it</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08378">pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to the eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to be desired</w> to make <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit thereof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">also</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with her; and he did eat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of them both</w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were opened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">and they</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knew</w> that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05903">naked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08609" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-3">and they sewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">fig</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">leaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08609" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-3">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02290">aprons</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>aprons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">things to gird about</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in the cool</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">and Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">hid themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">amongst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cool</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wind</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">unto Adam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, Where <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0335">thou</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I was afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0595">because I</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05903">naked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I hid myself</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04310">Who</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">told</w> thee that thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05903">naked</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whereof I commanded thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">that thou shouldest not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">eat</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">The woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou gavest</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05978">with me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">she</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">me of the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I did eat</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05175">The serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">beguiled me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I did eat</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">unto the serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0859">Because thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast done</w> this, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">above all cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and above every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01512">upon thy belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06083">and dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0342">enmity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">between thee and the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and between thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">and her seed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall bruise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thy head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt bruise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06119">his heel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">Unto the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I will greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H06093">thy sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02032">and thy conception</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06089">in sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08669">and thy desire</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to thy husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall rule</w> over thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>to thy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">subject to thy husband</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0121">And unto Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">of which</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I commanded thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of it: cursed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H06093">for thy sake; in sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03605">it all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06975">Thorns also</w> <w lemma="strong:H01863">and thistles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall it bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to thee; and thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">the herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>bring…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to bud</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02188">In the sweat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">unto the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">for out of it wast thou taken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06083">for dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0859">thou</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06083">and unto dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou return</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02332">Eve</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0517">because she was the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of all living</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Eve</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Chavah</rdg>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Living</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Unto Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">also and to his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">did the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coats</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and clothed them</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02005">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">is become as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of us, to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and now, lest he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">also of the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sent him forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">from the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to till</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">from whence he was taken</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So he drove out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">at the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">Cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03858">and a flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">which turned every way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen32" osisID="Gen.3"/>

verses.name: Genesis 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And Adam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02332">Eve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07014">Cain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Cain</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Gotten</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Acquired</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And she again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01893">Abel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01893">And Abel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was a keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07014">but Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was a tiller</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abel</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hebel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a keeper</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a feeder</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And in process</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07014">it came to pass, that Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in process…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the end of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01893">And Abel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">he</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01062">of the firstlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of his flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">and of the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereof. And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01893">unto Abel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and to his offering</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>flock</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sheep</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07014">But unto Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and to his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he had not respect</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07014">And Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and his countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07014">unto Cain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why art thou wroth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06440">and why is thy countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fallen</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">If</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou doest well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07613">shalt thou not be accepted</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and if thou doest not well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w>. And unto thee <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08669">his desire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt rule</w> over him.<note type="study"><catchWord>be accepted</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">have the excellency</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">subject unto thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07014">And Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H01893">Abel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07704">and it came to pass, when they were in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07014">that Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01893">Abel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew him</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 4:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07014">unto Cain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0335">Where</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01893">Abel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> not: <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">I my brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeper</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">unto me from the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:11
verses.text: And now <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thou cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from thy hand</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588">When</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou tillest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall not henceforth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">unto thee her strength</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a fugitive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a vagabond</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">shalt thou be in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07014">And Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">My punishment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than I can bear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>My…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Mine iniquity is greater than that it may be forgiven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Behold, thou hast driven me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05921">and from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall I be hid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and I shall be a fugitive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a vagabond</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall come to pass</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that findeth me</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall slay me</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">unto him, Therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever slayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07014">Cain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">vengeance shall be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07659">on him sevenfold</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H07014">upon Cain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">lest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">any finding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him should kill</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 4:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07014">And Cain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05113">of Nod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06926">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H05731">of Eden</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 4:17

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04968">of Methuselah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">were nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">sixty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 5:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03929">And Lamech</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">eighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 5:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">us concerning our work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06093">and toil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of our hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04480">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath cursed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Noah</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Noe</rdg>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Rest</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Comfort</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 5:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03929">And Lamech</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 5:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03929">of Lamech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">were seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 5:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">was five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05146">and Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08035">Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02526">Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03315">and Japheth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen34" osisID="Gen.5"/>

verses.name: Genesis 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And it came to pass, when men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were born</w> unto them,

verses.name: Genesis 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">That the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">that they</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">fair</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">them wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of all which they chose</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">My spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall not always</w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">with man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07683 strong:H01571" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8677">for that he also</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">yet his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">shall be an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05303">There were giants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in those days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">and also after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">that</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they bare</w> <transChange type="added">children</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01992">to them, the same</w> <transChange type="added">became</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of renown</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And <divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03336">every imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">of the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07535">only</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the whole imagination</rdg>: the Hebrew word signifieth not only the imagination, but also the purposes and desires</note><note type="study"><catchWord>continually</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">every day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And it repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and it grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">him at</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I have created</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">both man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and the creeping thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for it repenteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me that I have made</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>both…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from man unto beast</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">But Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">was a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in his generations</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>perfect</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upright</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08035">Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02526">Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03315">and Japheth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also was corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">with violence</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and, behold, it was corrupt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01320">for all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had corrupted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">unto Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">The end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is filled with</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">through them</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and, behold, I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">them with</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with the earth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from the earth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 6:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">thee an ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01613">of gopher</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07064">rooms</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">it within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">and without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">with pitch</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rooms</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nests</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 6:15
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is the fashion</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt make</w> it <transChange type="added">of</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">of the ark</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of it fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of it thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06672">A window</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">to the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520">and in a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou finish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">it above</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06607">and the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">of the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">in the side thereof</w>; <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08482">lower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and third</w> <transChange type="added">stories</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> it.

verses.name: Genesis 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02009">And, behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0589">I</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">even I, do bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">a flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">all flesh</w>, wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08478">from under</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03605">every thing</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But with thee will I establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">into</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0859">thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> with thee.

verses.name: Genesis 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">And of every living thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> of every <transChange type="added">sort</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">into the ark</w>, to keep <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">with thee; they shall be male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">and female</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05775">Of fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after their kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after their kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">of every creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> of every <transChange type="added">sort</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> unto thee, to keep <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">alive</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">thou unto thee of all food</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that is eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt gather</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0402">to thee; and it shall be for food</w> for thee, and for them.

verses.name: Genesis 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">according to all that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, so did</w> he. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen35" osisID="Gen.6"/>

verses.name: Genesis 7:1
