verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">unto Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thou and all thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">into the ark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thee have I seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before me</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">in this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02889">Of every clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651 strong:H07651">to thee by sevens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his female</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of beasts</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01931 strong:H02889">not clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">by two</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his female</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by sevens</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seven seven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05775">Of fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">also of the air</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651 strong:H07651">by sevens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">and the female</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-4">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-4">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by sevens</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seven seven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05750">For yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and I will cause it to rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03605">and every</w> <w lemma="strong:H03351">living substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">from off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">blot out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">according unto all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">when the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">was upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">with him, into the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">of the flood</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02889">Of clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of beasts</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">not clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and of fowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of every thing that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">There went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">unto Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">into the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">and the female</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And it came to pass after seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">of the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">were upon the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on the seventh day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141">In</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundredth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07651">the seventeenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02088">the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">were all the fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">broken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0699">and the windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were opened</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>windows</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">floodgates</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01653">And the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">was upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">In the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08035">and Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02526">and Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03315">and Japheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05146">and Noah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">with them, into the ark</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01992">They</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and all the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after their kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and every creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and every fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06833">every bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of every sort</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sort</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">unto Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">into the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">wherein</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And they that went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">and female</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">as God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">him: and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shut him in</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03999">And the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">was forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it was lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">above the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and were increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08392">and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01364">and all the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hills</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08478">under</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the whole heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">were covered</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568 strong:H06240">Fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">did the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">were covered</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">both of fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and of beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08318">and of every creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">and every man</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">All in whose nostrils</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307 strong:H05397">the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, of all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02724">in the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the breath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the breath of the spirit of life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03351">And every living substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">which was upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">both man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and the creeping things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and the fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they were destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05146">and Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">only</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">remained</w> <transChange type="added">alive</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">and they that</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08392">with him in the ark</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen36" osisID="Gen.7"/>

verses.name: Genesis 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and every living thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and all the cattle</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08392">with him in the ark</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-5">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">a wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-5">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07918" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asswaged</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04599">The fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">also of the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0699">and the windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05534" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were stopped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">and the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was restrained</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from off the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8800">continually</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07097">and after the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of the hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were abated</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>continually</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in going and returning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08392">And the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651 strong:H06240">on the seventeenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0780">of Ararat</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">decreased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">until</w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">on the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">were the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">seen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>decreased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were in going and decreasing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 8:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">of forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05146">that Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">the window</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">of the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he sent forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06158">a raven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and fro</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">until the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from off the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in going forth and returning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Also he sent forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">a dove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from him, to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">if the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were abated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from off the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03123">But the dove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04494">no rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">for the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of her foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">unto him into the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">for the waters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took her</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and pulled her in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">unto him into the ark</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pulled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused her to come</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">yet other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">he sent forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">the dove</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">out of the ark</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03123">And the dove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153 strong:H06256">to him in the evening</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">and, lo, in her mouth</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02132">an olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H02965">pluckt off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05146">so Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were abated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from off the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And he stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">yet other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">the dove</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">which returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">unto him any more</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 8:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08337">And it came to pass in the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundredth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">and first year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from off the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05146">and Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and, behold, the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dry</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">on the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">was the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dried</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 8:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">unto Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">thou, and thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> with thee.

verses.name: Genesis 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">with thee every living thing</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">with thee, of all flesh</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05775">of fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and of every creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they may breed abundantly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> with him:

verses.name: Genesis 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Every beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">every creeping thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and every fowl</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03605">whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their kinds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">out of the ark</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kinds</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">families</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 8:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">of every clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">and of every clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">any more for man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05668">sake</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03336">for the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from his youth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither will I again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">any more every thing living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I have done</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a sweet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a savour of rest</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">satisfaction</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for the imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">through the imagination</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">While the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">remaineth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">seedtime</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">and harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07120">and cold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">and heat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07019">and summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02779">and winter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not cease</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>While…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">As yet all the days of the earth</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen37" osisID="Gen.8"/>

verses.name: Genesis 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Be fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and multiply</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and replenish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04172">And the fear of you</w> <w lemma="strong:H02844">and the dread of you</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">shall be upon every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and upon every fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon all that moveth</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01709">and upon all the fishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">into your hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are they delivered</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07431">Every moving thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that liveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">shall be meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03418">for you; even as the green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I given</w> you all things.

verses.name: Genesis 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0389">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">with the life</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, shall ye not eat</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0389">And surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">your blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of your lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I require</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">at the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I require it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and at the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">at the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I require</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso sheddeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">by man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">shall his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be shed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06754">for in the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">he man</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And you, be ye fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and multiply</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bring forth abundantly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and multiply</w> therein.

verses.name: Genesis 9:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">unto Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him, saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And I, behold, I establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">with you, and with your seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after you</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">And with every living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05775">with you, of the fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">of the cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and of every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with you; from all that go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">to every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">with you; neither shall all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">any more by the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">of a flood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03999">neither shall there any more be a flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">the token</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0589">which I</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">between me and you and every living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">with you, for perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I do set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">my bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">in the cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">and it shall be for a token</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">between me and the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it shall come to pass, when I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">that the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">in the cloud</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">between me and you and every living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">shall no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">become a flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">all flesh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07198">And the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">shall be in the cloud</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will look upon it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I may remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">between</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">every living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">unto Noah</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">the token</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I have established</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">between me and all flesh</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08035">were Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02526">and Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03315">and Japheth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01931 strong:H02526">and Ham</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Canaan</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Chenaan</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 9:19
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and of them was the whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">overspread</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">began</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127 strong:H0376">an husbandman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">a vineyard</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he drank</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was drunken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and he was uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02526">And Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08035">And Shem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03315">and Japheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">a garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon both</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">their shoulders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0322">backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and their faces</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0322">backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">not their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">awoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">from his wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">what his younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03667">Canaan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">shall he be unto his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08035">of Shem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03667">and Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his servant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">servant to them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03315">Japheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H08035">of Shem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03667">and Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">shall be his servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enlarge</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">persuade</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 9:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05146">And Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 9:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">were nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen38" osisID="Gen.9"/>

verses.name: Genesis 10:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08035">Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02526">Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03315">and Japheth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto them were sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">the flood</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03315">of Japheth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01586">Gomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04031">and Magog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04074">and Madai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03120">and Javan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08422">and Tubal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04902">and Meshech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08494">and Tiras</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01586">of Gomer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0813">Ashkenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07384">and Riphath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08425">and Togarmah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03120">of Javan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0473">Elishah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08659">and Tarshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03794">Kittim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01721">and Dodanim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Dodanim</catchWord>: or, as some read it, <rdg type="alternate">Rodanim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0339">By these were the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">divided in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their lands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">after his tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">in their nations</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03568">Cush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and Mizraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06316">and Phut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03667">and Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Cush</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05434">Seba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02341">and Havilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05454">and Sabtah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07484">and Raamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05455">and Sabtecha</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07484">of Raamah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07614">Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01719">and Dedan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03568">And Cush</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05248">Nimrod</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he began</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01368">He was a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">hunter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651">wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it is said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05248">Even as Nimrod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">hunter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">And the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">was Babel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0751">and Erech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0390">and Accad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03641">and Calneh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08152">of Shinar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Babel</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Babylon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Out of that land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">Asshur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">Nineveh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07344">Rehoboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03625">and Calah</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he went out into Assyria</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the city…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the streets of the city</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07449">And Resen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">between Nineveh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03625">and Calah</w>: the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">And Mizraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03866">Ludim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06047">and Anamim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03853">and Lehabim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05320">and Naphtuhim</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06625">And Pathrusim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03695">and Casluhim</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">out of whom came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">Philistim</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H03732">and Caphtorim</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03667">And Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">Sidon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02845">and Heth</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Sidon</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Tzidon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02983">And the Jebusite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01622">and the Girgasite</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02340">And the Hivite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06208">and the Arkite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05513">and the Sinite</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0721">And the Arvadite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06786">and the Zemarite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02577">and the Hamathite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">were the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">spread abroad</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">was from Sidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">to Gerar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05804">unto Gaza</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as thou goest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05467">unto Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0126">and Admah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06636">and Zeboim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03962">even unto Lasha</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gaza</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Azzah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:20
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">after their tongues</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their countries</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">in their nations</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08035">Unto Shem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">also, the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05677">of Eber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03315">of Japheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the elder</w>, even to him were <transChange type="added">children</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">born</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08035">of Shem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05867">Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">and Asshur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0775">and Arphaxad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03865">and Lud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">and Aram</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Arphaxad</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Arpachshad</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Aram</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05780">Uz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02343">and Hul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01666">and Gether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04851">and Mash</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0775">And Arphaxad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07974">Salah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07974">and Salah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05677">Eber</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Salah</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Shelah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05677">And unto Eber</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06389">Peleg</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">for in his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">was the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06385" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">divided</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03355">Joktan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Peleg</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Division</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03355">And Joktan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0486">Almodad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08026">and Sheleph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02700">and Hazarmaveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03392">and Jerah</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01913">And Hadoram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0187">and Uzal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01853">and Diklah</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 10:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05745">And Obal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H039">and Abimael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07614">and Sheba</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0211">And Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02341">and Havilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03103">and Jobab</w>: all these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03355">of Joktan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04186">And their dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04852">was from Mesha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05611">unto Sephar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">a mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:31
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08035">of Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">after their tongues</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">after their nations</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 10:32
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05146">of Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">after their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">in their nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">and by these were the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">the flood</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen39" osisID="Gen.10"/>

verses.name: Genesis 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">was of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">speech</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>language</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip.</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>speech</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, as they journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">from the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">a plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08152">of Shinar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they dwelt</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eastward</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03843">brick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">them throughly</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03843">And they had brick</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">for stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02564">and slime</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">they for morter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they said…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man said to his neighbour</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>burn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">burn them to a burning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">us a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">and a tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">whose top</w> <transChange type="added">may reach</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">us a name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest we be scattered abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">and the tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">builded</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, the people</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and they have all one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">language</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and this they begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03605 strong:H03808">and now nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will be restrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from them, which they have imagined</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us go down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there confound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">their language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they may not understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">speech</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">scattered them abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08033">from thence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">Therefore is the name of it</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">Babel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did there confound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">the language</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-6">and from thence did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-6">scatter them abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Babel</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Confusion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 11:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08035">of Shem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08035">Shem</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0775">Arphaxad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">two years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">the flood</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08035">And Shem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0775">Arphaxad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0775">And Arphaxad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07974">Salah</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0775">And Arphaxad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07974">Salah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07974">And Salah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05677">Eber</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07974">And Salah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05677">Eber</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05677">And Eber</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06389">Peleg</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Peleg</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Phalec</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05677">And Eber</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06389">Peleg</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06389">And Peleg</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07466">Reu</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06389">And Peleg</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07466">Reu</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07466">And Reu</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08286">Serug</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Serug</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Saruch</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07466">And Reu</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08286">Serug</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08286">And Serug</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">Nahor</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08286">And Serug</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">Nahor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05152">And Nahor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08646">Terah</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Terah</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Thara</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05152">And Nahor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08646">Terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672 strong:H06240">and nineteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08646">And Terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05152">Nahor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02039">and Haran</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08646">of Terah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08646">Terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05152">Nahor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02039">and Haran</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02039">and Haran</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02039">And Haran</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08646">Terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of his nativity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0218">in Ur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">and Nahor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">them wives</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">of Abram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08297">Sarai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">of Nahor’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04435">Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02039">of Haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04435">of Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03252">of Iscah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08297">But Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06135">was barren</w>; she <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02056">no child</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 11:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08646">And Terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03876">and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02039">of Haran</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08297">and Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">his daughter in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0218">with them from Ur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02771">unto Haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> there.

verses.name: Genesis 11:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08646">of Terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">were two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08646">and Terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H02771">in Haran</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen40" osisID="Gen.11"/>

verses.name: Genesis 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04138">and from thy kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and from thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I will shew</w> thee:

verses.name: Genesis 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will make of thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-7">thee, and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-7">great</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01293">and thou shalt be a blessing</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them that bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him that curseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">thee: and in thee shall all families</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be blessed</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">So Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">unto him; and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">with him: and Abram</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02771">out of Haran</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08297">Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03876">and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and all their substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07408" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had gathered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02771">in Haran</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they came</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Sichem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0436">unto the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04176">of Moreh</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03669">And the Canaanite</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0227">then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>plain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">plains</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">Unto thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">he an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">who appeared</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from thence unto a mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w>, <transChange type="added">having</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05857">and Hai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there he builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">going on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">still</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">toward the south</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>going…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in going and journeying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 12:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07458">And there was a famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H087">and Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">there; for the famine</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0834">And it came to pass, when</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he was come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08297">unto Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">Behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04994">now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">a fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to look upon</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04713">Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, that they shall say</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they will kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, but they will save thee alive</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04994">I pray thee</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04616">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it may be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">with me for thy sake; and my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">because of thee</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:14
