verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H087">And it came to pass, that, when Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> that she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">also of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">her, and commended</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">her before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">into Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-8">And he entreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-8">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for her sake: and he had sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and he asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">and maidservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0860">and she asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and camels</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">plagued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">plagues</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H08297">Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto me? why didst thou not tell</w> me that she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why saidst thou</w>, She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so I might have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">her to me to wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">now therefore behold thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go thy way</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">concerning him: and they sent him away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w>, and all that he had. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen41" osisID="Gen.12"/>

verses.name: Genesis 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">he, and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03876">and all that he had, and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">with him, into the south</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">in cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">in silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and in gold</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04550">on his journeys</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">from the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">even to Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">where his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had been</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">at the beginning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01008">between Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">and Hai</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">Unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">there at the first</w>: <w lemma="strong:H087">and there Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03876">And Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also, which went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">had flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">and tents</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was not able to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, that they might dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07399">for their substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">was great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07379">And there was a strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">between the herdmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">of Abram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the herdmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">of Lot’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">then in the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">unto Lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0408">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H04808">strife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy herdmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">for we</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brethren</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men brethren</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 13:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not the whole land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thee</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">separate thyself</w>, I pray thee, from me: if <transChange type="added">thou wilt take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">the left hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03231" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then I will go to the right</w>; or if <transChange type="added">thou depart</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">to the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08041" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then I will go to the left</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03876">And Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">all the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04945">well watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">every where, before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01588">as the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">like the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06820">unto Zoar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03876">Then Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">him all the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03876">and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">east</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they separated themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">from the other</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03876">and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">of the plain</w>, and pitched <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">But the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">and sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceedingly</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">that Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">from him, Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">now thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and look</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">where thou art northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and southward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">and eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and westward</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">For all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which thou seest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee will I give it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and to thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">as the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0834">so that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">shall thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also be numbered</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">in the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">of it and in the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it; for I will give</w> it unto thee.

verses.name: Genesis 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">Then Abram</w> removed <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0436">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">of Mamre</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>plain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">plains</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen42" osisID="Gen.13"/>

verses.name: Genesis 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0569">of Amraphel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08152">of Shinar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0746">Arioch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0495">of Ellasar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03540">Chedorlaomer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08413">and Tidal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 14:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H01298">Bera</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01306">and with Birsha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">of Gomorrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08134">Shinab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0126">of Admah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08038">and Shemeber</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06636">of Zeboiim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01106">of Bela</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">which is</w> <w lemma="strong:H06820">Zoar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">All these were joined together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the vale</w> <w lemma="strong:H07708">of Siddim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">is the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H06240">Twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03540">Chedorlaomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">and in the thirteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they rebelled</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702 strong:H06240">And in the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03540">Chedorlaomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the kings</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">the Rephaims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06255">in Ashteroth Karnaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02104">and the Zuzims</w> <w lemma="strong:H01990">in Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0368">and the Emims</w> <w lemma="strong:H07741">in Shaveh Kiriathaim</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Shaveh…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The plain of Kiriathaim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02752">And the Horites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">in their mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0364">unto El–paran</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05921">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>El–paran</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The plain of Paran</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05880">En–mishpat</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06946">Kadesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">all the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H06003">of the Amalekites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and also the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02688">in Hazezon–tamar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">of Gomorrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0126">of Admah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06636">of Zeboiim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01106">of Bela</w> (<w lemma="strong:H01931">the same</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06820">Zoar</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">with them in the vale</w> <w lemma="strong:H07708">of Siddim</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03540">With Chedorlaomer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08413">and with Tidal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0569">and Amraphel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08152">of Shinar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0746">and Arioch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0495">of Ellasar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">with five</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06010">And the vale</w> <w lemma="strong:H07708">of Siddim</w> <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H0875">was full of</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02564 strong:H0875">slimepits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">there; and they that remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountain</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">all the goods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0400">and all their victuals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went their way</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">in Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and his goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">one that had escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">the Hebrew</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for he dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0436">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">of Mamre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0812">of Eshcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06063">of Aner</w>: and these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285 strong:H01167">confederate</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">with Abram</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>plain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">plains</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And when Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">that his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02593">his trained</w> <transChange type="added">servants</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03211">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083 strong:H06240">and eighteen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursued</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01835">unto Dan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>armed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">led forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>trained</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">instructed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And he divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">himself against them, he and his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H02327">them unto Hobah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">all the goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and also brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and his goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">also, and the people</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">him after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">his return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03540">of Chedorlaomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and of the kings</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06010">with him, at the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07740">of Shaveh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">which</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">dale</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04442">And Melchizedek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08004">of Salem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w>: and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">possessor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">be the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04042" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thy hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">him tithes</w> of all.

verses.name: Genesis 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">me the persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">the goods</w> to thyself.<note type="study"><catchWord>persons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the possessor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">That I will not</w> <transChange type="added">take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02339">from a thread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08288 strong:H05275">even to a shoelatchet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">and that I will not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> any thing that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thine, lest thou shouldest say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-9">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-9">rich</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01107">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">only that which</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">and the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H06063">me, Aner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0812">Eshcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04471">and Mamre</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01992">let them</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">their portion</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen43" osisID="Gen.14"/>

verses.name: Genesis 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04236">in a vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">not, Abram</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">thy shield</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">thy exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">reward</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what wilt thou give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me, seeing I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06185">childless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04943 strong:H01121">and the steward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of my house</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01931">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H0461">Eliezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, to me thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and, lo, one born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is mine heir</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And, behold, the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">This shall not be thine heir</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he that shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">out of thine own bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be thine heir</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought him forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">now toward heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">the stars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to number</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">unto him, So</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">shall thy seed</w> be.

verses.name: Genesis 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">it to him for righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0218">of Ur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to inherit</w> it.

verses.name: Genesis 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">whereby</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall inherit it</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">me an heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">of three years old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">and a she goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">of three years old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">of three years old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08449">and a turtledove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01469">and a young pigeon</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto him all these, and divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them in the midst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">each</w> <w lemma="strong:H01335">piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">one against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06833">but the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01334" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">divided</w> he not.

verses.name: Genesis 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05861">And when the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">upon the carcases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05380" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">drove them away</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">And when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was going down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08639">a deep sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">upon Abram</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0367">and, lo, an horror</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02825">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fell</w> upon him.

verses.name: Genesis 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of a surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">that thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">shall be a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in a land</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not theirs, and shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them; and they shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">them four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And also that nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom they shall serve</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will I judge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651 strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">substance</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt be buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">old age</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">But in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">they shall come hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05771">for the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02008">not yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">full</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">And it came to pass, that, when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05939">and it was dark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06227">behold a smoking</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">between</w> <w lemma="strong:H01506">those pieces</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a burning…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a lamp of fire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01931">In the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">with Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">Unto thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">unto the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07017">The Kenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07074">and the Kenizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06935">and the Kadmonites</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02850">And the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07497">and the Rephaims</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0567">And the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01622">and the Girgashites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen44" osisID="Gen.15"/>

verses.name: Genesis 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08297">Now Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-10">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">him no</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-10">children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08198">and she had an handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04713">an Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01904">Hagar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08297">And Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Behold now, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath restrained me</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from bearing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">unto my maid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0194">it may</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be that I may obtain children</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">by her. And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08297">of Sarai</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>obtain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be built by her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08297">And Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01904">Hagar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">her maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her to her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to be his wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01904">unto Hagar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she conceived</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that she had conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01404">her mistress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in her eyes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08297">And Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">unto Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02555">My wrong</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee: I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">my maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into thy bosom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that she had conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I was despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in her eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judge</w> between me and thee.

verses.name: Genesis 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">But Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08297">unto Sarai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">Behold, thy maid</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thy hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H02896">to her as it pleaseth thee</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08297">And when Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">dealt hardly with</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, she fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from her face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that which is good in thine eyes</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>dealt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">afflicted her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 16:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">found her</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">by a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">by the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07793">to Shur</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01904">Hagar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08297">Sarai’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">maid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0335">whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">camest thou</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and whither wilt thou go</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01404">of my mistress</w> <w lemma="strong:H08297">Sarai</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01404">to thy mistress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and submit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thyself under her hands</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto her, I will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">exceedingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it shall not be numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02009">unto her, Behold</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02030">with child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and shalt bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">thy affliction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ishmael</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">God shall hear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06501">And he will be a wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">against every man, and every man’s hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him; and he shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of all his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto her, Thou God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07210">seest me</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01988">Have I also here</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after him</w> <w lemma="strong:H07210">that seeth me</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0875">Wherefore the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416 strong:H0883">Beer–lahai–roi</w>; behold, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06946">between Kadesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01260">and Bered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Beer–lahai–roi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The well of him that liveth and seeth me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 16:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01904">And Hagar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H087">and Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01904">which Hagar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01904">when Hagar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">to Abram</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen45" osisID="Gen.16"/>

verses.name: Genesis 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And when Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08673">was ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">to Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07706">the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08549">and be thou perfect</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>perfect</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upright</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sincere</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">between me and thee, and will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">thee exceedingly</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">And Abram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on his face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him, saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0589">As for me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">behold, my covenant</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">with thee, and thou shalt be a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multitude of nations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">Neither shall thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">any more be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">but thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">shall be Abraham</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">for a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I made thee</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abraham</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Father of a great multitude</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-11">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">thee exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-11">fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of thee, and kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come out</w> of thee.

verses.name: Genesis 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">between me and thee and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in their generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">to be a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto thee, and to thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after thee</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto thee, and to thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">wherein thou art a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">for an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">possession</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be their God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wherein…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of thy sojournings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 17:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">therefore, thou, and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in their generations</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:10
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall keep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">between me and you and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after thee</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02145">Every man child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">among you shall be circumcised</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05243" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall circumcise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">of your foreskin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0226">and it shall be a token</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> betwixt me and you.

verses.name: Genesis 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08083">And he that is eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">among you, every man child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in your generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03211">he that is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04736">or bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">of any stranger</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">not of thy seed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he that is eight…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a son of eight days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03211">He that is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thy house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04736">and he that is bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with thy money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">must needs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be circumcised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01285">and my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">shall be in your flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06189">And the uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">man child</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">of his foreskin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not circumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from his people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08297">As for Sarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">her name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08297">Sarai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">her name</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sarah</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Princess</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also of her: yea, I will bless</w> her, and she shall be <transChange type="added">a mother</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of people</w> shall be of her.<note type="study"><catchWord>she…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">she shall become nations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">Then Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laughed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, Shall <transChange type="added">a child</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">unto him that is an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08283">and shall Sarah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08673">that is ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bear</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">O that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might live</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thee</w>!

verses.name: Genesis 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H061">indeed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">with him for an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">with his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after him</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03458">And as for Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard thee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Behold, I have blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him, and will make him fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">him exceedingly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H06240">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he beget</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make him</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01285">But my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">with Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08283">which Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">unto thee at this set time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">in the next</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">talking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with him, and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">from Abraham</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03211">and all that were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04736">and all that were bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with his money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">among the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">of their foreskin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">as God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 17:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08673">ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he was circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">of his foreskin</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03458">And Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969 strong:H06240">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he was circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">of his foreskin</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">In the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">was Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">circumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">and Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 17:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03211">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04736">and bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">of the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were circumcised</w> with him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen46" osisID="Gen.17"/>

verses.name: Genesis 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0436">unto him in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">of Mamre</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">in the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>plain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">plains</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and, lo, three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by him: and when he saw</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">them from the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">himself toward the ground</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">My Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if now I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass not away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">I pray thee, from thy servant</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">Let a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04994">I pray you</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be fetched</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">your feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and rest yourselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">under the tree</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">a morsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and comfort ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">your hearts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">after that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall pass on</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for therefore are ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">your servant</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as thou hast said</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>comfort</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stay</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">you have passed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">unto Sarah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Make ready quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05429">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">meal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03888" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">knead</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-12">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05692">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-12">upon the hearth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Make ready…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hasten</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">unto the herd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetcht</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H07390">tender</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto a young man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dress</w> it.

verses.name: Genesis 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02529">butter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02461">and milk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">and the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had dressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before them</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">by them under the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0346">unto him, Where</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">Behold, in the tent</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">unto thee according to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08283">and, lo, Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall have a son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08283">And Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind him</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">Now Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">and Sarah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02205">old</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">well stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in age</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">to be with Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of women</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08283">Therefore Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laughed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within herself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I am waxed old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05730">shall I have pleasure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">being old also</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">Wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">did Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laugh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0552">Shall I of a surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0589">a child, which</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">am old</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-13">Is</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-13">too hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H04150">At the time appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">unto thee, according to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08283">and Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall have a son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08283">Then Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">denied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I laughed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not; for she was afraid</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">Nay</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou didst laugh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from thence, and looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">with them to bring them on the way</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Shall I hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">from Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">that thing which</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I do</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">Seeing that Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">shall surely become a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be blessed</w> in him?

verses.name: Genesis 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">him, that</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his household</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">may bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">upon Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that which he hath spoken</w> of him.

verses.name: Genesis 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02201">Because the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">is great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and because their sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">is very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">grievous</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now, and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whether they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">according to the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of it, which is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me; and if not, I will know</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thence, and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">toward Sodom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">but Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou also destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Peradventure there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou also destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04616">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">the fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">therein</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02486">That be far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from thee to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">after this manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">with the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">and that the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">should be as the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">that be far</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from thee: Shall not the Judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">right</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 18:26
