verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">in Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">all the place</w> for their sakes.

verses.name: Genesis 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Behold now, I have taken upon me</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0595">which</w> <transChange type="added">am but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">and ashes</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Peradventure there shall lack</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of the fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wilt thou destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the city</w> for <transChange type="added">lack of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I find</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">there forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto him yet again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">Peradventure there shall be forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">for forty’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <transChange type="added">unto him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04994">Oh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">let not the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be angry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will speak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07970">Peradventure there shall thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if I find</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> there.

verses.name: Genesis 18:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Behold now, I have taken upon me</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto the Lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06242">Peradventure there shall be twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">for twenty’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Oh let not the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be angry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">but this once</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06235">Peradventure ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">for ten’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Genesis 18:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">as soon as</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">communing</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">with Abraham</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto his place</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen47" osisID="Gen.18"/>

verses.name: Genesis 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">angels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">to Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03876">and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03876">and Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seeing</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them; and he bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">himself with his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">toward the ground</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Behold now, my lords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">I pray you, into your servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-14">and tarry all night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">your feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and ye shall rise up early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on your ways</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-14">Nay; but we will abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all night</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06484" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he pressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">upon them greatly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they turned in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into his house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">them a feast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did bake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But before they lay down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738" type="x-split-15">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738" type="x-split-15">round</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">both old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">and young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from every quarter</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">unto Lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">to thee this night</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bring them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto us, that we may know</w> them.

verses.name: Genesis 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03876">And Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after him</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">I pray you, brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do not so wickedly</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Behold now, I have two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let me, I pray you, bring them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto you, and do</w> ye to them as <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0411">only unto these</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H0408">nothing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for therefore came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">they under the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06982">of my roof</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">back</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">This one</w> <transChange type="added">fellow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and he will needs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be a judge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">now will we deal worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06484" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, than with them. And they pressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">upon the man</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">But the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and pulled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to them, and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">to the door</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05575">with blindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">both small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that they wearied</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves to find</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">unto Lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06311">Hast thou here</w> <w lemma="strong:H04310">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">besides? son in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">and whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thou hast in the city</w>, bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of this place</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0587">For we</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06818">because the cry of them</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is waxen great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">us to destroy</w> it.

verses.name: Genesis 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03876">And Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">unto his sons in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which married</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of this place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">But he seemed as one that mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">his sons in law</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03644">And when</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">then the angels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which are here</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">lest thou be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are here</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>iniquity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">punishment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">And while he lingered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">laid hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and upon the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and upon the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02551">being merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto him: and they brought him forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not behind thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">thou in all the plain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">lest thou be consumed</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03876">And Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold now, thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou hast magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">unto me</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in saving</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">lest some evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and I die</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">Behold now, this city</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">unto, and it</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04705">a little one</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Oh, let me escape</w> thither, (<transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04705">it not a little one</w>?) <w lemma="strong:H05315">and my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02009">unto him, See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">also, that I will not overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">for the which</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast spoken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thee</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">thee, escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither; for I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till thou be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thither. Therefore the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06820">Zoar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zoar</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Little</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 19:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was risen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">when Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06820">into Zoar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>risen</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gone forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">rained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">upon Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and upon Gomorrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01614">brimstone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">and fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">out of heaven</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0411">those</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03603">and all the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06780">and that which grew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the ground</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">But his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">looked back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from behind him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05333">and she became a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gat up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Genesis 19:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">Sodom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07008">and, lo, the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07008">as the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03536">of a furnace</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And it came to pass, when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02018">of the overthrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">in the which</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03876">And Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06820">out of Zoar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him; for he feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06820">in Zoar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in a cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">he and his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01067">And the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">unto the younger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Our father</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">old</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto us after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 19:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-16">let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-16">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him, that we may preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-17">And they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-17">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01067">and the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with her father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not when she lay down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nor when she arose</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01067">that the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">unto the younger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0570">yesternight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with my father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let us make him drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">this night</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">also; and go thou in</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him, that we may preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-18">And they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-18">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">also: and the younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him; and he perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not when she lay down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nor when she arose</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Thus were both</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">of Lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">by their father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01067">And the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01931">the same</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 19:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06810">And the younger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she also bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01151">Ben–ammi</w>: the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen48" osisID="Gen.19"/>

verses.name: Genesis 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">from thence toward the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">between Kadesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07793">and Shur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sojourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">in Gerar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>: <w lemma="strong:H040">and Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">of Gerar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">to Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">in a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> to him, Behold, thou <transChange type="added">art but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a dead man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">for the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast taken</w>; for she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01167">a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">wife</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a man’s…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">married to an husband</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">But Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had not come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her: and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">also a righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">he not unto me, She</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01931">and she</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01571">even</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">she</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">herself said</w>, He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08537">in the integrity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05356">and innocency</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I done</w> this.<note type="study"><catchWord>integrity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">simplicity</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sincerity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">unto him in a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01571">Yea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">this in the integrity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of thy heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I also withheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee from sinning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me: therefore suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I thee not to touch</w> her.

verses.name: Genesis 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Now therefore restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">a prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and he shall pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">for thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and thou shalt live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and if thou restore</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not, know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou that thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, thou, and all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> thine.

verses.name: Genesis 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">Therefore Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their ears</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">were sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">Then Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, What hast thou done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us? and what have I offended</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, that thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">on me and on my kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02401">sin</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">deeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto me that ought not to be done</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sawest thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I thought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07535">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">not in this place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they will slay me</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">for my wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">sake</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0546">And yet indeed</w> <transChange type="added">she is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>; she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">but not the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of my mother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and she became my wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And it came to pass, when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">caused me to wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">from my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I said</w> unto her, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto me; at every place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whither we shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> of me, He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">and womenservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">him Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">Behold, my land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H02896">where it pleaseth</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as is good in thine eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08283">And unto Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>: behold, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03682">to thee a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of the eyes</w>, unto all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with thee, and with all <transChange type="added">other</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thus she was reproved</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H085">So Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and his maidservants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they bare</w> <transChange type="added">children</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">closed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">all the wombs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">of Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">of Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen49" osisID="Gen.20"/>

verses.name: Genesis 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">unto Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he had spoken</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08283">For Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02208">in his old age</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">at the set time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> to him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">unto him, whom Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">to him, Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">being eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">as God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">was an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">when his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was born</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 21:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08283">And Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06712">me to laugh</w>, <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will laugh</w> with me.

verses.name: Genesis 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04448" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Who would have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08283">that Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">should have given children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">suck</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have born</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02208">in his old age</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03206">And the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was weaned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">feast</w> the <transChange type="added">same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">that Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was weaned</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08283">And Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01904">of Hagar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which she had born</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">mocking</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">this bondwoman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and her son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of this bondwoman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be heir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with my son</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03327">with Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">in Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let it not be grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">because of the lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and because of thy bondwoman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08283">in all that Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee, hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto her voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03327">for in Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">shall thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be called</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And also of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of the bondwoman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w>, because he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02573">and a bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01904">unto Hagar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">putting</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07926">on her shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">and the child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent her away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wandered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">of Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was spent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02573">the bottle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and she cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07880">of the shrubs</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat her down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">over against</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">a good way off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198 strong:H02909" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">as it were a bowshot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">of the child</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she sat</w> over against <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">her voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the lad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04397">and the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01904">to Hagar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">out of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01904">unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not; for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the lad</w> where he <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him in thine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">him a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">her eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02573">the bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-19">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-19">drink</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">was with the lad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07199 strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and became an archer</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">of Paran</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">him a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">And it came to pass at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H040">that Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06369">and Phichol</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of his host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with thee in all that thou doest</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Now therefore swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">unto me here</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">by God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08266" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou wilt not deal falsely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05209">with me, nor with my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05220">nor with my son’s son</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">according to the kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto me, and to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein thou hast sojourned</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">if thou shalt lie unto me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I will swear</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">reproved</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">of a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H040">which Abimelech’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had violently taken away</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I wot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not who hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03808">neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">didst thou tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">me, neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet heard</w> I <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">them unto Abimelech</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and both of them</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">ewe lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> by themselves.

verses.name: Genesis 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02008">What</w> <transChange type="added">mean</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">these seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">ewe lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast set</w> by themselves?

verses.name: Genesis 21:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, For <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">ewe lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05668">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">they may be a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, that I have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">this well</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">Beer–sheba</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">because there they sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both of them</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Beer–sheba</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The well of the oath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 21:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">at Beer–sheba</w>: <w lemma="strong:H040">then Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06369">and Phichol</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 21:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">Abraham</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0815">a grove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">in Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">there on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">the everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grove</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 21:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sojourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">in the Philistines’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen50" osisID="Gen.21"/>

verses.name: Genesis 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">did tempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto him, Abraham</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">here</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Behold…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Behold me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take now</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03173">thine only</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou lovest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and get thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04179">of Moriah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and offer him</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">there for a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which I will tell</w> thee of.

verses.name: Genesis 22:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">his ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of his young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">with him, and Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had told</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">Then on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto his young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">ye here with the ass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05288">and I and the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">yonder</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worship</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come again</w> to you.

verses.name: Genesis 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03327">upon Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03979">and a knife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">of them together</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">I, my son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">Behold the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the wood</w>: but where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07716">the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will provide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">himself a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both of them</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had told</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">him of; and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-20">there, and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-20">in order</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06123" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">him on the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the wood</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03979">the knife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto him out of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I.

verses.name: Genesis 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither do thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06258">unto him: for now</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">that thou fearest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">seeing thou hast not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">withheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03173">thine only</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange> from me.

verses.name: Genesis 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and behold behind</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05442">in a thicket</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">by his horns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">in the stead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03070">Jehovah–jireh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0834">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it is said</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">In the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be seen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehovah–jireh</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The Lord will see</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">provide</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 22:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">out of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">By myself have I sworn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834 strong:H03282">for because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">and hast not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">withheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03173">thine only</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange>:

verses.name: Genesis 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">That in blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee, and in multiplying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">and as the sand</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">upon the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">shore</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02233">and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of his enemies</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>shore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">And in thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">shall all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">be blessed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06118 strong:H0834">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">So Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto his young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">to Beer–sheba</w>; <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">at Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">that it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04435">Behold, Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath also born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">Nahor</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05780">Huz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0938">and Buz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07055">and Kemuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Aram</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03777">And Chesed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02375">and Hazo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06394">and Pildash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03044">and Jidlaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01328">and Bethuel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01328">And Bethuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08083">these eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04435">Milcah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">to Nahor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Rebekah</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Rebecca</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06370">And his concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07208">Reumah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02875">also Tebah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01514">and Gaham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08477">and Thahash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04601">and Maachah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen51" osisID="Gen.22"/>

verses.name: Genesis 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08283">And Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">was an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">old</w>: <transChange type="added">these were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">of Sarah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08283">And Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H07153">in Kirjath–arba</w>; the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">for Sarah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to weep</w> for her.

verses.name: Genesis 23:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">his dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 23:4
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08453">and a sojourner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with you: give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">me a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of a buryingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you, that I may bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">my dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of my sight</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w> unto him,

verses.name: Genesis 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear us</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among us</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04005">in the choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of our sepulchres</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thy dead</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H03808">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of us shall withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">from thee his sepulchre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but that thou mayest bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thy dead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a prince of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">himself to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:8
