verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">If it be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">my dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of my sight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me, and intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">for me to Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06714">of Zohar</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That he may give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">me the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04375">of Machpelah</w>, which he hath, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of his field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04392" type="x-split-21">for as much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392" type="x-split-21">as it is worth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall give it</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">me for a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of a buryingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">amongst you</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as much…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">full money</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06085">And Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06085">and Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the audience</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all that went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>audience</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ears</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03808">Nay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear me</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give I</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">thee, and the cave</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein, I give it</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thee; in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I it thee: bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thy dead</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">himself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">unto Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the audience</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, But if thou <transChange type="added">wilt give it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">I pray thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">thee money</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">for the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of me, and I will bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">my dead</w> there.

verses.name: Genesis 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06085">And Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w> unto him,

verses.name: Genesis 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto me: the land</w> <transChange type="added">is worth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>; what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0996">that betwixt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me and thee? bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">therefore thy dead</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">unto Ephron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">to Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he had named</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the audience</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">current</w> <transChange type="added">money</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the merchant</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07704">And the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">of Ephron</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04375">in Machpelah</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">Mamre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04631">and the cave</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">therein, and all the trees</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in all the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were made sure</w>

verses.name: Genesis 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">Unto Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">for a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">before all that went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04375">of Machpelah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">Mamre</w>: the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">And the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04631">and the cave</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, were made sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">for a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of a buryingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">by the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen52" osisID="Gen.23"/>

verses.name: Genesis 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was old</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">well stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in age</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> in all things.<note type="study"><catchWord>well…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gone into days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto his eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that ruled over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">all that he had, Put</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">I pray thee, thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">under my thigh</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I will make thee swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whom I dwell</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto my country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04138">and to my kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto him, Peradventure the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not be willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">me</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto this land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">must I needs bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from whence thou camest</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">unto him, Beware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-22">thou that thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06435">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-22">thither again</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which took me</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">from my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of my kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and which spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto me, and that sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">Unto thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">this land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">his angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto my son</w> from thence.

verses.name: Genesis 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And if the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not be willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">then thou shalt be clear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">from this my oath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-23">only bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-23">thither again</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">under the thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">to him concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">of the camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02898">for all the goods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his master</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0763">to Mesopotamia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">of Nahor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-24">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">his camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-24">to kneel down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">of the evening</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that women go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to draw</w> <transChange type="added">water</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that women who draw water go forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">I pray thee, send me</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">good speed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Behold, I stand</w> <transChange type="added">here</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">by the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">and the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">And let it come to pass, that the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to whom I shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Let down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">thy pitcher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, that I may drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and she shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-25">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">thy camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-25">drink</w> also: <transChange type="added">let the same be</transChange> she <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thereby shall I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my master</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And it came to pass, before he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07259">that, behold, Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">who</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01328">to Bethuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04435">of Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">of Nahor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03537">with her pitcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">upon her shoulder</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">And the damsel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to look upon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">a virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">neither had any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her: and she went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to the well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">her pitcher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good of countenance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet her</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01572" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Let me, I pray thee, drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">of thy pitcher</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and she hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">her pitcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and gave him drink</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And when she had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">giving him drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will draw</w> <transChange type="added">water</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01581">for thy camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also, until they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">drinking</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And she hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and emptied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">her pitcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H08268">into the trough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">again unto the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to draw</w> <transChange type="added">water</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">for all his camels</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07583" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">wondering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">at her held his peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whether the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-26">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-26">prosperous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">or</w> not.

verses.name: Genesis 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01581">And it came to pass, as the camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">drinking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">a golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">earring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01235">of half a shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06781">bracelets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for her hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04948">weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>earring</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">jewel for the forehead</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04310">Whose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0859">thou</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">me, I pray thee: is there</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">room</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for us to lodge in</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> unto him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01328">of Bethuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04435">of Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">unto Nahor</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">moreover unto him, We have both</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04554">and provender</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">enough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01571">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">room</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lodge in</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bowed down his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05973 strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath not left destitute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of his mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and his truth</w>: I <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">led me</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">And the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <transChange type="added">them of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">her mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07259">And Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">had a brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03837">Laban</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03837">and Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto the well</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">the earring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06781">and bracelets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">upon his sister’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">of Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03541">Thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me; that he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">the camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">at the well</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thou blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherefore standest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">thou without</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and room</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">for the camels</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he ungirded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">his camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04554">and provender</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">for the camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Genesis 24:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03455 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8714">And there was set</w> <transChange type="added">meat</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">until I have told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">mine errand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak on</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he is become great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">him flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">and maidservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and asses</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08283">And Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H02209">she was old</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and unto him hath he given</w> all that he hath.

verses.name: Genesis 24:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">And my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">made me swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in whose land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I dwell</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 24:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and to my kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto my son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">Peradventure the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not follow</w> me.

verses.name: Genesis 24:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto me, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">whom I walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">his angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with thee, and prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of my kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and of my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 24:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Then shalt thou be clear</w> from <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0423">my oath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">to my kindred</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and if they give</w> not thee <transChange type="added">one</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05355">thou shalt be clear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">from my oath</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto the well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">if now thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I go</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 24:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Behold, I stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">by the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05959">and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to draw</w> <transChange type="added">water</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-27">to her, Give me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">I pray thee, a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">of thy pitcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-27">to drink</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 24:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And she say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to me, Both drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou, and I will also draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">for thy camels</w>: <transChange type="added">let</transChange> the same <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath appointed out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">for my master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And before I had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07259">behold, Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">with her pitcher</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">on her shoulder</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto the well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew</w> <transChange type="added">water</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto her, Let me drink</w>, I pray thee.

verses.name: Genesis 24:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And she made haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">her pitcher</w> from her <transChange type="added">shoulder</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-28">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">thy camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-28">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also: so I drank</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-29">and she made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">the camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-29">drink</w> also.

verses.name: Genesis 24:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">Whose daughter</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">The daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01328">of Bethuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05152">Nahor’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04435">whom Milcah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him: and I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">the earring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">upon her face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06781">and the bracelets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon her hands</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I bowed down my head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which had led me</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">in the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto his son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">And now if ye will</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">with my master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me: and if not, tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me; that I may turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">to the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">to the left</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">Then Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H01328">and Bethuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">The thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">proceedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto thee bad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07259">Behold, Rebekah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">and let her be thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">their words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">bowing himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07259">to Rebekah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">also to her brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and to her mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04030">precious things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>jewels</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">he and the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and tarried all night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Send me away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my master</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And her brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and her mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05291">Let the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abide</w> with us <transChange type="added">a few</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">at the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H06218">ten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she shall go</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a few…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a full year, or ten months</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto them, Hinder me</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not, seeing the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath prospered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">send me away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to my master</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">the damsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at her mouth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, Wilt thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with this man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they sent away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and her nurse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">and Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0859">unto her, Thou</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">our sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be thou</w> <transChange type="added">the mother</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">of millions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and let thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of those which hate</w> them.

verses.name: Genesis 24:61
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07259">And Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05291">and her damsels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">upon the camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">and the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went his way</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0883">of the well Lahai–roi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for he dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">in the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07742" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">the eventide</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and, behold, the camels</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">coming</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to meditate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to pray</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 24:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07259">And Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">her eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she lighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">the camel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:65
verses.text: For she <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto the servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04310">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01976">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet us</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servant</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore she took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06809">a vail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and covered herself</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:66
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had done</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 24:67
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought her</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">into his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and she became his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">her: and Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother’s</w> <transChange type="added">death</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen53" osisID="Gen.24"/>

verses.name: Genesis 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then again</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and her name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06989">Keturah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02175">him Zimran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03370">and Jokshan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04091">and Medan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04080">and Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03435">and Ishbak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07744">and Shuah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03370">And Jokshan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01719">and Dedan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01719">of Dedan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0805">were Asshurim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03912">and Letushim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03817">and Leummim</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05891">Ephah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06081">and Epher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02585">and Hanoch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H028">and Abida</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0420">and Eldaah</w>. All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06989">of Keturah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">all that he had unto Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">of the concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">which Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">had, Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">from Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">while he yet lived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">unto the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:7
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he lived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568 strong:H08141 strong:H07657">threescore and fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">Then Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave up the ghost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">old age</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">an old man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07649">and full</w> <transChange type="added">of years</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to his people</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">and Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">him in the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04375">of Machpelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">of Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06714">of Zohar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">Mamre</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">The field</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">which Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">purchased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">there was Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">buried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08283">and Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03327">and Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0883">the well Lahai–roi</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01904">whom Hagar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08283">Sarah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 25:13
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">by their names</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">according to their generations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05032">Nebajoth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06938">and Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0110">and Adbeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04017">and Mibsam</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04927">And Mishma</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01746">and Dumah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04854">and Massa</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02316">Hadar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08485">and Tema</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03195">Jetur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05305">Naphish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06929">and Kedemah</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Hadar</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hadad</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 25:16
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>, and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">by their towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02918">and by their castles</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0523">according to their nations</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:17
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave up the ghost</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02341">from Havilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07793">unto Shur</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">toward Assyria</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of all his brethren</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>died</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fell</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 25:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 25:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">was forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01328">of Bethuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">the Syrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">of Padan–aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">to Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">the Syrian</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, because she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06135">barren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">of him, and Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">struggled together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within her</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w>, If <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> so, why <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02088">I thus</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto her, Two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">in thy womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">of people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">from thy bowels</w>; and <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03816">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be stronger</w> than <transChange type="added">the other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03816">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and the elder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">the younger</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And when her days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were fulfilled</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08380">twins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">in her womb</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">And the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0132">red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08181">all over like an hairy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">garment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-30">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-30">out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">on Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06119">heel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03327">and Isaac</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when she bare</w> them.

verses.name: Genesis 25:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the boys</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grew</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06215">and Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was a cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">hunter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08535">a plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in tents</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">because he did eat</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06718">venison</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07259">but Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">venison was in his mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 25:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05138">pottage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06215">and Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">from the field</w>, and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">faint</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 25:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03938" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">me, I pray thee, with</w> <w lemma="strong:H0122">that same</w> <w lemma="strong:H0122">red</w> <transChange type="added">pottage</transChange>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">faint</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">therefore was his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with that red, with that red pottage</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Edom</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Red</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 25:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01062">thy birthright</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">at the point</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01062">and what profit shall this birthright</w> do to me?<note type="study"><catchWord>at…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">going to die</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 25:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to me this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him: and he sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01062">his birthright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 25:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">Then Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05138">and pottage</w> <w lemma="strong:H05742">of lentiles</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went his way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06215">thus Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">despised</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01062">birthright</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen54" osisID="Gen.25"/>

verses.name: Genesis 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07458">And there was a famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that was in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">unto Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">unto Gerar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Go not down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which I shall tell</w> thee of:

verses.name: Genesis 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will be with thee, and will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0411">all these</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-31">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-31">to multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0411">all these</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">countries</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02233">and in thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">shall all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">be blessed</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06118">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">that Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">my charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and my laws</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">in Gerar</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asked</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to say</w>, <transChange type="added">She is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">my wife</w>; lest, <transChange type="added">said he</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">me for Rebekah</w>; because she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to look upon</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it came to pass, when he had been there a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H040">that Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">looked out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">a window</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">and, behold, Isaac</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sporting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">with Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0389">Behold, of a surety</w> she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and how saidst</w> thou, She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Because I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest I die</w> for her.

verses.name: Genesis 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto us? one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">might lightly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have lien</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shouldest have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">guiltiness</w> upon us.

verses.name: Genesis 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">charged</w> all <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">Then Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in that land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and received</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the same year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08180 strong:H03967">an hundredfold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>received</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-32">waxed great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01432">and grew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-32">until he became</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">great</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went going</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04735">For he had possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and great store</w> <w lemma="strong:H05657">of servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">envied</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>servants</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">husbandry</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0875">For all the wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had stopped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">them with earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">from us; for thou art much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mightier</w> than we.

verses.name: Genesis 26:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thence, and pitched his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">of Gerar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08033">there</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:18
