verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">the wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06430">for the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had stopped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">by which</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had called</w> them.

verses.name: Genesis 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">there a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of springing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>springing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">living</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the herdmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">of Gerar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">with Isaac’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">herdmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">The water</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ours: and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">of the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H06230">Esek</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06229" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">because they strove</w> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>Esek</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Contention</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for that also: and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name of it</w> <w lemma="strong:H07856">Sitnah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sitnah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Hatred</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thence, and digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and for that they strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not: and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name of it</w> <w lemma="strong:H07344">Rehoboth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06258">For now</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath made room</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for us, and we shall be fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Rehoboth</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Room</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">from thence to Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">unto him the same night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> not, for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, and will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Genesis 26:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there, and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">there: and there Isaac’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">a well</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H040">Then Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">to him from Gerar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0276">and Ahuzzath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04828">one of his friends</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06369">and Phichol</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of his army</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04069">unto them, Wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye to me, seeing ye hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and have sent me away</w> from you?

verses.name: Genesis 26:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was with thee: and we said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">Let there be now an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">betwixt</w> us, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0996">betwixt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us and thee, and let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> with thee;<note type="study"><catchWord>We saw…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Seeing we saw</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That thou wilt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">us no hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as we have not touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and as we have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07535">unto thee nothing but</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have sent thee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06258">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>That…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">If thou shalt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">them a feast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they rose up betimes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03327">and Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sent them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">from him in peace</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass the same day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">that Isaac’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">him concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had digged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, We have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 26:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07656">it Shebah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">therefore the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0884">Beer–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shebah</catchWord>: That is, <rdg type="x-meaning">an oath</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Beer–sheba</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the well of the oath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 26:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">was forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03067">Judith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0882">of Beeri</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01315">and Bashemath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0356">of Elon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 26:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04786">Which were a grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">and to Rebekah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a grief…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitterness of spirit</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen55" osisID="Gen.26"/>

verses.name: Genesis 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it came to pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">that when Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03543" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were dim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so that he could not see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">his eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto him, My son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> unto him, Behold, <transChange type="added">here am</transChange> I.

verses.name: Genesis 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold now, I am old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of my death</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">I pray thee, thy weapons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08522">thy quiver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">and thy bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">to the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> me <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06720 strong:H06718" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">venison</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>take</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hunt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">me savoury meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">such as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I love</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me, that I may eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">that my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H02962">thee before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I die</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07259">And Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">when Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">to Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">to the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hunt</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06718">venison</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07259">And Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">unto Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">me venison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">me savoury meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">my death</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now therefore, my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">according to that which</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">I command</w> thee.

verses.name: Genesis 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">now to the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">me from thence two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">kids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">them savoury meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">such as he loveth</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">to thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he may eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">and that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he may bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">his death</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">to Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06215">Behold, Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08163">a hairy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02509">a smooth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">peradventure will feel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">me, and I shall seem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08591" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">to him as a deceiver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">upon me, and not a blessing</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, Upon me <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07045">thy curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">only obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">fetch</w> me <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">to his mother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">savoury meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">such as his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loved</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07259">And Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of her eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with her in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put them upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">her younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>goodly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desirable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And she put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">the skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">of the kids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02513">and upon the smooth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">of his neck</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">the savoury meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">and the bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which she had prepared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of her son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I; who <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, my son</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">thy firstborn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according as thou badest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me: arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">of my venison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">that thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may bless</w> me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto his son</w>, How <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou hast found</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">so quickly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to me</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04184" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, that I may feel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee, my son</w>, whether thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02088">my very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> or not.

verses.name: Genesis 27:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he felt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">but the hands</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he discerned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him not, because his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">were hairy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">as his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so he blessed</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 27:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou my very son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me, and I will eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of my son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">venison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">that my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may bless</w> thee. And he brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, and he did eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">him wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he drank</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, and kiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me, my son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: and he smelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of his raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07381">the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of my son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07381">as the smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of a field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 27:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Therefore God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">thee of the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04924">and the fatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 27:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">thee, and nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01933" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to thee: be</w> <w lemma="strong:H01376">lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">over thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and let thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">to thee: cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that curseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee, and blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he that blesseth</w> thee.

verses.name: Genesis 27:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03327">And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">was yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">scarce</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06215">that Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">from his hunting</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he also had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04303">savoury meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought it</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Let my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">venison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">that thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may bless</w> me.

verses.name: Genesis 27:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, Who <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">thy firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02731 strong:H03966">exceedingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0645">Who? where</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">he that hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">venison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and I have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of all before thou camest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have blessed</w> him? yea, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">he shall be blessed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trembled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">trembled with a great trembling greatly</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>taken</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hunted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 27:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And when Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">me also, O my father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">Thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">with subtilty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">thy blessing</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">Is not he rightly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034 strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">named</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he hath supplanted me</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">two times</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01062">my birthright</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and, behold, now he hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">my blessing</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0680" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou not reserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a blessing</w> for me?<note type="study"><catchWord>Jacob</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A supplanter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 27:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">unto Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01376">him thy lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and all his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to him for servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01715">and with corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I sustained</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and what shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0645">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thee, my son</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>sustained</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">supported</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 27:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">Hast thou but one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">blessing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">bless</w> me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">me also, O my father</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">unto him, Behold, thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04924">shall be the fatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02919">and of the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05920">from above</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>the fatness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the fatness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 27:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">And by thy sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07300" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shalt break</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">his yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">from off thy neck</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H07852" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">of the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">wherewith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blessed him</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06215">and Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">The days</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">of mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are at hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then will I slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 27:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">her elder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">were told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">to Rebekah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">her younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto him, Behold, thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">as touching thee, doth comfort</w> himself, <transChange type="added">purposing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to kill</w> thee.

verses.name: Genesis 27:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now therefore, my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">thou to Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02771">to Haran</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 27:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with him a few</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">until</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">fury</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn away</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 27:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">Until thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee, and he forget</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him: then I will send</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">thee from thence: why</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should I be deprived</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">also of you both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 27:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07259">And Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03290">if Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>, such as these <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">what good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">shall my life</w> do me? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen56" osisID="Gen.27"/>

verses.name: Genesis 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">to Padan–aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01328">of Bethuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thee a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">from thence of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, and make thee fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">thee, that thou mayest be a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of people</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>a multitude…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an assembly of people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">thee the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">to thee, and to thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with thee; that thou mayest inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">wherein thou art a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wherein…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of thy sojournings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">to Padan–aram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">unto Laban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01328">of Bethuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">the Syrian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">of Rebekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">and Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 28:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06215">When Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">that Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sent him away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">to Padan–aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">him a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from thence; and that as he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him he gave him a charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And that Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">to Padan–aram</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">that the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were evil in the eyes</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Genesis 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">unto Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04258">which he had Mahalath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05032">of Nebajoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">to be his wife</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Mahalath</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Bashemath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 28:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">from Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02771">toward Haran</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Haran</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Charran</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he lighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon a certain place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and tarried there all night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">because the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was set</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04763">his pillows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-33">and lay down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-33">to sleep</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he dreamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05551">and behold a ladder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the top of it</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">reached</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04397">and behold the angels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ascending</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and descending</w> on it.

verses.name: Genesis 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">above it, and said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereon thou liest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee will I give it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and to thy seed</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">And thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">shall be as the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt spread abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">and to the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and to the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and to the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02233">and in thee and in thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">shall all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be blessed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spread…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">break forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 28:15
verses.text: And, behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, and will keep</w> thee in all <transChange type="added">places</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whither</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou goest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will bring thee again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">into this land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">thee, until</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have spoken</w> to thee of.

verses.name: Genesis 28:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">awaked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">out of his sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0403">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">is</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I knew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not.

verses.name: Genesis 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he was afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">How dreadful</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">this place</w>! this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">none other but the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had put</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04763">his pillows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set it up</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04676">a pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top of it</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0199">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w> <transChange type="added">was called</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03870">Luz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">at the first</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Beth–el</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The house of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">If God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will be with me, and will keep me</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in this way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">me bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put on</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So that I come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">then shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">be my God</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 28:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">And this stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have set</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04676">a pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">shall be God’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and of all that thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">give the tenth</w> unto thee. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen57" osisID="Gen.28"/>

verses.name: Genesis 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">Then Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up his feet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>people</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0875">and behold a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, and, lo, there <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">by it; for out of that well</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">the flocks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0875">upon the well’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05739">And thither were all the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they rolled</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">from the well’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-34">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-34">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">upon the well’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in his place</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto them, My brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0370">whence</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye? And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02771">Of Haran</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> we.

verses.name: Genesis 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">ye Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">of Nahor</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We know</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">he well</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07354">and, behold, Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with the sheep</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Is he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Is there peace to him?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02005">Lo</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">yet high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">that the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">should be gathered together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">ye the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">feed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yet the day is great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We cannot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05739">until all the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be gathered together</w>, and <transChange type="added">till</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">from the well’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then we water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05750">And while he yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">with them, Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for she kept them</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And it came to pass, when Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">that Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and rolled</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">from the well’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w> that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, and that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">her father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And it came to pass, when Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">the tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and embraced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him to his house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tidings</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hearing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">to him, Surely</w> thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and my flesh</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">with him the space</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of a month</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the space…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a month of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, Because thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shouldest thou therefore serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">me for nought</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> me, what <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04909">thy wages</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>?

verses.name: Genesis 29:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">had two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the elder</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of the younger</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07390">tender</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07354">but Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08389 strong:H03303">was beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">and well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">favoured</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">thee seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">for Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">thy younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">her to thee, than that I should give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">her to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">abide</w> with me.

verses.name: Genesis 29:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">for Rachel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and they seemed</w> unto him <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a few</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">for the love he had</w> to her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">unto Laban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">my wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">for my days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fulfilled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may go in</w> unto her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">And it came to pass in the evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her to him; and he went in</w> unto her.

verses.name: Genesis 29:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02153">Zilpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">his maid</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08198">an handmaid</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass, that in the morning</w>, behold, it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">to Laban</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me? did not I serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">with thee for Rachel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">wherefore then hast thou beguiled</w> me?

verses.name: Genesis 29:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">It must not be so done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in our country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">the younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01067">the firstborn</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>country</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">her</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">week</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">thee this also for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">with me yet seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so, and fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">her week</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">him Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w> also.

verses.name: Genesis 29:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">to Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">Bilhah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">his handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">to be her maid</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">also unto Rachel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">also Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">more than Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">with him yet seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">that Leah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">her womb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07354">but Rachel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06135">barren</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 29:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">And Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03588">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">upon my affliction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03588">now therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">my husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will love</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>Reuben</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">See a son</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again, and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w> that I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he hath therefore given</w> me this <transChange type="added">son</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also: and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">Simeon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Simeon</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Hearing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she conceived again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">Now this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">will my husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, because I have born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">him three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">therefore was his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">Levi</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Levi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Joined</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 29:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again, and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bearing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Judah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Praise</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>left…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood from bearing</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen58" osisID="Gen.29"/>

verses.name: Genesis 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07354">And when Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">no children, Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">envied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">her sister</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0369">or else</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">I die</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">against Rachel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">I in God’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stead, who hath withheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">from thee the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the womb</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">Behold my maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">Bilhah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her; and she shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">upon my knees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that I may also have children</w> by her.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be built by her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">him Bilhah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">her handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> unto her.

verses.name: Genesis 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01090">And Bilhah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07354">And Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and hath also heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me a son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">she his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Dan</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Judging</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01090">And Bilhah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again, and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">a second</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:8
