verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07354">And Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">With great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05319">wrestlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have I wrestled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">with my sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I have prevailed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">Naphtali</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wrestlings of God</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Naphtali</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">My wrestling</rdg>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Nephthalim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">When Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that she had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bearing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02153">Zilpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">her maid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">her Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02153">And Zilpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">And Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01409">A troop</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gad</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A troop</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">company</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02153">And Zilpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">a second</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">And Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0837">Happy am I</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">for the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">will call me blessed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">Asher</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Happy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">In my happiness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Asher</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Happy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07205">And Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01736">mandrakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">them unto his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07354">Then Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">to Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">I pray thee, of thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01736">mandrakes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> unto her, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a small matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou hast taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">my husband</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and wouldest thou take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01736">mandrakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">also? And Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore he shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">with thee to night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01736">mandrakes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">in the evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03812">and Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou must come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me; for surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee with my son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01736">mandrakes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">with her that night</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">unto Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">And Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">me my hire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">my maiden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to my husband</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">Issachar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Issachar</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">An hire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">And Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again, and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">And Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02064" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath endued</w> me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02065">dowry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06471">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">will my husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H02082" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me, because I have born</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">him six</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">Zebulun</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zebulun</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Dwelling</rdg>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Zabulon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">a daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">her name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01783">Dinah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Dinah</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Judgment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to her, and opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">her womb</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">my reproach</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to me another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Joseph</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Adding</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07354">And it came to pass, when Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">that Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">unto Laban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Send me away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto mine own place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and to my country</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">my wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and my children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02004">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I have served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and let me go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">my service</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have done</w> thee.

verses.name: Genesis 30:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, I pray thee, if I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>, <transChange type="added">tarry</transChange>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have learned by experience</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">me for thy sake</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">me thy wages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">how</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">thee, and how</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">thy cattle</w> was with me.

verses.name: Genesis 30:30
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">which thou hadst before I</w> <transChange type="added">came</transChange>, and it is <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">unto a multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thee since my coming</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04970">and now when</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I provide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for mine own house</w> also?<note type="study"><catchWord>increased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>since…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at my foot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall I give thee</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">me any thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou wilt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for me, I will again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feed</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">thy flock</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 30:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">through all thy flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">removing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05348">from thence all the speckled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and spotted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02345">and all the brown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03775">among the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the spotted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05348">and speckled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">among the goats</w>: and <transChange type="added">of such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07939">shall be my hire</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">So shall my righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for me in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when it shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">for my hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thy face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03605">every one</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05348">not speckled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and spotted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">among the goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02345">and brown</w> <w lemma="strong:H03775">among the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that shall be counted stolen</w> with me.<note type="study"><catchWord>in time…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 30:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">Behold, I would it might be</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy word</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08495">the he goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H06124">that were ringstraked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and spotted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">and all the she goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H05348">that were speckled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and spotted</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> every one that had <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H02345">in it, and all the brown</w> <w lemma="strong:H03775">among the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">betwixt himself and Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">flocks</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">him rods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03892">of green</w> <w lemma="strong:H03839">poplar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03869">and of the hazel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06196">and chesnut tree</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06478" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and pilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H06479">strakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">in them, and made the white</w> <w lemma="strong:H04286">appear</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04731">in the rods</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">the rods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06478" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he had pilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07298">in the gutters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the watering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08268">troughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">when the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they should conceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">And the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">before the rods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06124">ringstraked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05348">speckled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and spotted</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03775">the lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06124">the ringstraked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02345">and all the brown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">in the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">his own flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by themselves, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">them not unto Laban’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">cattle</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">did conceive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">that Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">the rods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07298">in the gutters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that they might conceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">among the rods</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">But when the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">were feeble</w>, he put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not in</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">so the feebler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">were Laban’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 30:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">exceedingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and had much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">and maidservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and asses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen59" osisID="Gen.30"/>

verses.name: Genesis 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken away</w> all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father’s</w>; and of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">all this glory</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">of Laban</w>, and, behold, it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08543">not toward him as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">before</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as before</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as yesterday and the day before</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04138">and to thy kindred</w>; and I will be with thee.

verses.name: Genesis 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">and Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">to the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">unto his flock</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them, I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">countenance</w>, that it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08543">not toward me as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">before</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">but the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath been</w> with me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0859">And ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">that with all my power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And your father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, and changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04909">my wages</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04489">times</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">but God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">suffered him</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not to hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">me</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05348">thus, The speckled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">shall be thy wages</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06629">then all the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05348">speckled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and if he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06124">thus, The ringstraked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">shall be thy hire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">all the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06124">ringstraked</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Thus God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and given</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> to me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And it came to pass at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">that the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">in a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">and, behold, the rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which leaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">upon the cattle</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06124">ringstraked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05348">speckled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01261">and grisled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rams</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">unto me in a dream</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I.

verses.name: Genesis 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">now thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">all the rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which leap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">upon the cattle</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06124">ringstraked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05348">speckled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01261">and grisled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">all that Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doeth</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Genesis 31:13
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where thou anointedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the pillar</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where thou vowedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me: now arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of thy kindred</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07354">And Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">and Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">yet any portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">or inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for us in our father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Are we not counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of him strangers</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, and hath quite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">also our money</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06239">For all the riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">from our father</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">ours, and our children’s</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">now then, whatsoever God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee, do</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">Then Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">upon camels</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 31:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">all his cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and all his goods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07408" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had gotten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">of his getting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07408" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">in Padan–aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">his sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07354">and Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08655">the images</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">her father’s</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">teraphim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stole away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unawares</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">to Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">the Syrian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05921">in that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01097">him not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that he fled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unawares…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the heart of Laban</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with all that he had; and he rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <transChange type="added">toward</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">that Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was fled</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after him</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">him in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">to Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">the Syrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">in a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">unto him, Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that thou speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">not to</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">either good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">bad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>either…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from good to bad</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03837">Then Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03290">Now Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03837">and Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What hast thou done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou hast stolen away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">unawares</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to me, and carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as captives</w> <transChange type="added">taken</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 31:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Wherefore didst thou flee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">secretly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and steal away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from me; and didst not tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, that I might have sent thee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">and with songs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08596">with tabret</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">and with harp</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>steal…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hast stolen me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And hast not suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me to kiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and my daughters</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast now done foolishly</w> in <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">doing</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">It is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">in the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">you hurt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">but the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0570">unto me yesternight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take thou heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that thou speak not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">either good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">or bad</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:30
verses.text: And now, <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou wouldest needs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be gone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03700" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">because thou sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03700" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">longedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">after thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore hast thou stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my gods</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 31:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">to Laban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I was afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06435">Peradventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou wouldest take by force</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thy daughters</w> from me.

verses.name: Genesis 31:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0834">With whomsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou findest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him not live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05048">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">discern</w> thou what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thine with me, and take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to thee. For Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">not that Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had stolen</w> them.

verses.name: Genesis 31:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">into Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03812">and into Leah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and into the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">maidservants’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tents</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he found</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not. Then went he out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">of Leah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">into Rachel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07354">Now Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08655">the images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">them in the camel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">furniture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">upon them. And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">searched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">all the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but found</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>searched</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">felt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to her father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let it not displease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thee</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">for the custom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of women</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon me. And he searched</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08655">not the images</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and chode</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">with Laban</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">to Laban</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my trespass</w>? what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">my sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast so hotly pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after me</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 31:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588">Whereas</w> <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast searched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all my stuff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what hast thou found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of all thy household</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">stuff</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03541">here</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">before my brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they may judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">betwixt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">us both</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>searched</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">felt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">This twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <transChange type="added">have</transChange> I <transChange type="added">been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07353">with thee; thy ewes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">and thy she goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have not cast their young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and the rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I not eaten</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02966">That which was torn</w> <transChange type="added">of beasts</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">not unto thee; I bare the loss</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of it; of my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">didst thou require</w> it, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:40
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Thus</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">I was; in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">the drought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07140">me, and the frost</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08142">and my sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from mine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">Thus have I been twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thy house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I served thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for thy cattle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou hast changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04909">my wages</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04489">times</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03884">Except</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06343">and the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">now empty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">mine affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">and the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of my hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and rebuked</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0570">yesternight</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:43
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <transChange type="added">These</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughters</w>, and <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my children</w>, and <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">cattle</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">my cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that thou seest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mine: and what can I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto these my daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have born</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 31:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore come thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05707">I and thou; and let it be for a witness</w> between me and thee.

verses.name: Genesis 31:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set it up</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04676">a pillar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">an heap</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">there upon the heap</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03026">it Jegar–sahadutha</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03290">but Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01567">it Galeed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jegar–sahadutha</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The heap of witness</rdg>, Chaldee</note><note type="study"><catchWord>Galeed</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The heap of witness</rdg>, Heb.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01530">This heap</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">between me and thee this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08034">Therefore was the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01567">Galeed</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 31:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04709">And Mizpah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0834">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">between me and thee, when we are absent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">from another</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Mizpah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A beacon</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">watchtower</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">If thou shalt afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or if thou shalt take</w> <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with us; see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> betwixt me and thee.

verses.name: Genesis 31:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03837">And Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01530">Behold this heap</w>, and behold <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04676">pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have cast</w> betwixt me and thee;

verses.name: Genesis 31:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01530">This heap</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w>, and <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04676">pillar</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05713">witness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I will not pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">this heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">this heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">and this pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto me, for harm</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">of Nahor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">betwixt us. And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">by the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 31:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">Then Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and tarried all night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">killed beasts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 31:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-35">And early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-35">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and his daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">them: and Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto his place</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen60" osisID="Gen.31"/>

verses.name: Genesis 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">and the angels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">met</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And when Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">Mahanaim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Mahanaim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Two hosts</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">camps</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">to Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>country</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">field</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus, I have sojourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03837">with Laban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stayed there</w> until now:

verses.name: Genesis 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">And I have oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">and womenservants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I may find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and also he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and four hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> with him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">Then Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and distressed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with him, and the flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and the camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">into two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">bands</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06215">If Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">company</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">then the other company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">shall escape</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which saidst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thy country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04138">and to thy kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will deal well</w> with thee:

verses.name: Genesis 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06994" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am not worthy of the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of all the mercies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">and of all the truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04731">for with my staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">this Jordan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and now I am become two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">bands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I am not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I am less than all</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">I pray thee, from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of my brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03373">for I fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, lest he will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite me</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do thee good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which cannot be numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">there that same night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of that which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">for Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03967">Two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">she goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08495">he goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07353">ewes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 32:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">Thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">milch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with their colts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bulls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">she asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05895">foals</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he delivered</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05739">every drove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by themselves; and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07305">a space</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">betwixt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">drove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">drove</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the foremost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06215">When Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">meeteth thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and asketh thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, Whose <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? and whither goest</w> thou? and whose <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">these before</w> thee?

verses.name: Genesis 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then thou shalt say</w>, <transChange type="added">They be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w>: and, behold, also he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind us</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01571">And so</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded he</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">the droves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">On this manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall ye speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">unto Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye find</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">moreover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold, thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind us</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will appease</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">with the present</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">peradventure he will accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of me</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-36">So went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the present</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-36">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and himself lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the company</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">womenservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H06240">and his eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">the ford</w> <w lemma="strong:H02999">Jabbok</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and sent them over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and sent over</w> that he had.<note type="study"><catchWord>sent them</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to pass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was left</w> <w lemma="strong:H079" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">alone; and there wrestled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him until the breaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">of the day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>breaking…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascending of the morning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not against him, he touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">the hollow of his thigh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the hollow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was out of joint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H079" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">as he wrestled</w> with him.

verses.name: Genesis 32:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Let me go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07837">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">breaketh</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will not let thee go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou bless</w> me.

verses.name: Genesis 32:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto him, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">Thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">no more Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">but Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08280" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for as a prince hast thou power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and with men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast prevailed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Israel</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A prince of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asked</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">I pray thee, thy name</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Wherefore <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02088">it</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou dost ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after my name</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he blessed</w> him there.

verses.name: Genesis 32:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06439">Peniel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is preserved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Peniel</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The face of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 32:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And as he passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06439">Penuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose</w> <w lemma="strong:H06760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon him, and he halted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">upon his thigh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 32:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> not <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01517">the sinew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05384">which shrank</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">upon the hollow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">of the thigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the hollow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01517">in the sinew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05384">that shrank</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen61" osisID="Gen.32"/>

verses.name: Genesis 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06215">and, behold, Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and with him four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">unto Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07354">and unto Rachel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and unto the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">handmaids</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">the handmaids</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">foremost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03812">and Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and her children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">after</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07354">and Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">hindermost</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and embraced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">on his neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kissed him</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they wept</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and the children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0428">those</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath graciously given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08198">Then the handmaidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">they and their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they bowed themselves</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03812">And Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">also with her children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-37">came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed themselves</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-37">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">and Rachel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they bowed</w> themselves.

verses.name: Genesis 33:8
