verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, What <transChange type="added">meanest</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04264">thou by all this drove</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I met</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">These are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What is all this band to thee?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">I have</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">enough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>; keep that thou hast unto thyself.<note type="study"><catchWord>keep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be that to thee that is thine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">my present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at my hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for therefore I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as though I had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou wast pleased with me</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">I pray thee, my blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">that is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to thee; because God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath dealt graciously with me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03605" type="x-split-38">and because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">I have</w> <w lemma="strong:H03605" type="x-split-38">enough</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06484" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he urged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and he took</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enough</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all things</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us take our journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will go</w> before thee.

verses.name: Genesis 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto him, My lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">that the children</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07390">tender</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05763" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with young</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01849" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me: and if men should overdrive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">all the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will die</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and I will lead on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0328">softly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">according as</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that goeth before me</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">be able to endure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">unto Seir</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>according…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the foot of the work</rdg>, etc., <rdg type="x-literal">and according to the foot of the children</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Let me now leave</w> with thee <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the folk</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">needeth it? let me find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>leave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Wherefore is this?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06215">So Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">unto Seir</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">to Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">booths</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">for his cattle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">therefore the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">Succoth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Succoth</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Booths</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08004">to Shalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">from Padan–aram</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shechem</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Sychem</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">a parcel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of a field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where he had spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">at the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">of Hamor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">for an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07192">pieces of money</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hamor</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Emmor</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pieces…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lambs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 33:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he erected</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called it</w> <w lemma="strong:H0415">El–elohe–Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>El–elohe–Israel</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">God the God of Israel</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen62" osisID="Gen.33"/>

verses.name: Genesis 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01783">And Dinah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">of Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07927">And when Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">of Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with her, and defiled her</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>defiled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">humbled her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01783">unto Dinah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">the damsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">unto the damsel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kindly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the heart of the damsel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07927">And Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">Hamor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H03207">me this damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he had defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01783">Dinah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">now his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">were with his cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">held his peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they were come</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02544">And Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">were grieved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and they were very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he had wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">with Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which thing ought not to be done</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02544">And Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">The soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">longeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">for your daughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray you give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">her him to wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">And make ye marriages</w> with us, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto us, and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">our daughters</w> unto you.

verses.name: Genesis 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">with us: and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before you</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and trade</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">ye therein, and get you possessions</w> therein.

verses.name: Genesis 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07927">And Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and unto her brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and what ye shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me I will give</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">me never so much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04119">dowry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04976">and gift</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">according as ye shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me: but give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">me the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">and Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceitfully</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he had defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01783">Dinah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201 strong:H03808" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, We cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">our sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">that is uncircumcised</w>; for that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02781">a reproach</w> unto us:

verses.name: Genesis 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02063">But in this</w> <w lemma="strong:H0225" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will we consent</w> unto you: If ye will be as we <transChange type="added">be</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">that every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">of you be circumcised</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 34:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will we give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">our daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you, and we will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to us, and we will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with you, and we will become one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">unto us, to be circumcised</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then will we take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">our daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we will be gone</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And their words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">Hamor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07927">and Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">Hamor’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">deferred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he had delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">in Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>: and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">more honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">than all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02544">And Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">and Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of their city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">with the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of their city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 34:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">These men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08003">peaceable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us; therefore let them dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trade</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">therein; for the land</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07342">large</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for them</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to us for wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">them our daughters</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02063">Only herein</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">will the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0225" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">consent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto us for to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with us, to be one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">if every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">among us be circumcised</w>, as they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">circumcised</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04735">not their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">and their substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and every beast</w> of theirs <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0225" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">ours? only let us consent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, and they will dwell</w> with us.

verses.name: Genesis 34:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02544">And unto Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">and unto Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02145">and every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was circumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07992">And it came to pass on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when they were sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">that two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08095">Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">and Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01783">Dinah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">boldly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">all the males</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">and Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-39">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01783">Dinah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-39">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>edge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 34:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">upon the slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because they had defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">their sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and their oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and their asses</w>, and that which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, and that which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 34:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">And all their wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and all their little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took they captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spoiled</w> even all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">to Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">and Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me to make me to stink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">among the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>: and I <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04962">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">in number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they shall gather themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against me, and slay me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I shall be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">I and my house</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 34:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Should he deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">with our sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as with an harlot</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen63" osisID="Gen.34"/>

verses.name: Genesis 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">to Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">there: and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee when thou fleddest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">Then Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his household</w>, and to all that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">with him, Put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among you</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and be clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and change</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">your garments</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And let us arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">to Beth–el</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of my distress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and was with me in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I went</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">all the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>, and <transChange type="added">all their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05141">earrings</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their ears</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">them under the oak</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07927">by Shechem</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they journeyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02847">and the terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">was upon the cities</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and they did not pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">So Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03870">to Luz</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">he and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Genesis 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0416">El–beth–el</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">because there God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, when he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>El–beth–el</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The God of Beth–el</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01683">But Deborah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">Rebekah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">nurse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and she was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">beneath Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H0437">under an oak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0439">Allon–bachuth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Allon–bachuth</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The oak of weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 35:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">again, when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">out of Padan–aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto him, Thy name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">any more Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">but Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">shall be thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">Almighty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and multiply</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">and a company</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">shall be of thee, and kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02504">out of thy loins</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 35:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">and Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee I will give it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and to thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from him in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">where he talked</w> with him.

verses.name: Genesis 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">where he talked</w> with him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04678">a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">a drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereon, and he poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> thereon.

verses.name: Genesis 35:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">where God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">with him, Beth–el</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">from Beth–el</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05750">and there was but</w> <w lemma="strong:H03530">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">to Ephrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07354">and Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">travailed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and she had hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">labour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a little…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a little piece of ground</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 35:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And it came to pass, when she was in hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that the midwife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not; thou shalt have this son</w> also.

verses.name: Genesis 35:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And it came to pass, as her soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was in departing</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she died</w>) <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01126">Ben–oni</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">but his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">him Benjamin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ben–oni</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The son of my sorrow</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Benjamin</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The son of the right hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 35:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07354">And Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">to Ephrath</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01035">Beth–lehem</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">upon her grave</w>: that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04678">the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">of Rachel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H04029">of Edar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And it came to pass, when Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in that land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07205">that Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">with Bilhah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">were twelve</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 35:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">of Leah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08095">and Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03878">and Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">and Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">and Zebulun</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 35:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">of Rachel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 35:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">of Bilhah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">handmaid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05321">and Naphtali</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 35:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02153">of Zilpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">handmaid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0836">and Asher</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">to him in Padan–aram</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">unto Mamre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07153">unto the city of Arbah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">where Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">and Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sojourned</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">were an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 35:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03327">And Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave up the ghost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02205">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07649">and full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">buried</w> him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen64" osisID="Gen.35"/>

verses.name: Genesis 36:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05711">Adah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0356">of Elon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0173">and Aholibamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06034">of Anah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06649">of Zibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivite</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01315">And Bashemath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05032">of Nebajoth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Bashemath</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Mahalath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05711">And Adah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">to Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">Eliphaz</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01315">and Bashemath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">Reuel</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 36:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0173">And Aholibamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03274">Jeush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03281">and Jaalam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07141">and Korah</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto him in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06215">And Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and his daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and all the persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and his cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and all his beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07075">and all his substance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07408" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had got</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>persons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07399">For their riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">were more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than that they might dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">wherein they were strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">of their cattle</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the Edomites</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Edom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:10
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0464">Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05711">of Adah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07467">Reuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01315">of Bashemath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">of Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">were Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0201">Omar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06825">Zepho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01609">and Gatam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07073">and Kenaz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zepho</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zephi</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08555">And Timna</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">was concubine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">to Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">to Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">Amalek</w>: these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05711">of Adah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:13
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">of Reuel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05184">Nahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02226">and Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08048">Shammah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04199">and Mizzah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">these were the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01315">of Bashemath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And these were the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0173">of Aholibamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06034">of Anah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06649">of Zibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">to Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03274">Jeush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03281">and Jaalam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07141">and Korah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">of Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0201">Omar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06825">Zepho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">Kenaz</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 36:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01609">Gatam</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">Amalek</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <transChange type="added">that came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0464">of Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>; these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05711">of Adah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">of Reuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05184">Nahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H08048">Shammah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04199">Mizzah</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <transChange type="added">that came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07467">of Reuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>; these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01315">of Bashemath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0173">of Aholibamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03266">Jeush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03281">Jaalam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">Korah</w>: these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <transChange type="added">that came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0173">of Aholibamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06034">of Anah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:19
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>, and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">their dukes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H02752">the Horite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03877">Lotan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07732">and Shobal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06649">and Zibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06034">and Anah</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 36:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01787">And Dishon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0687">and Ezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01789">and Dishan</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02752">of the Horites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03877">of Lotan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02753">were Hori</w> <w lemma="strong:H01967">and Hemam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03877">and Lotan’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08555">Timna</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hemam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Homam</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07732">of Shobal</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05935">these; Alvan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04506">and Manahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05858">and Ebal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08195">Shepho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0208">and Onam</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Alvan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Alian</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shepho</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shephi</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:24
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06649">of Zibeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0345">both Ajah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06034">and Anah</w>: this <transChange type="added">was that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06034">Anah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03222">the mules</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">the asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06649">of Zibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06034">of Anah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01787">these; Dishon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0173">and Aholibamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06034">of Anah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:26
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01787">of Dishon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02533">Hemdan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0790">and Eshban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03506">and Ithran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03763">and Cheran</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hemdan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Amram</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0687">of Ezer</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01092">these; Bilhan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02190">and Zaavan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06130">and Akan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Akan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jakan</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01789">of Dishan</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05780">these; Uz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0765">and Aran</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:29
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <transChange type="added">that came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02752">of the Horites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03877">Lotan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07732">Shobal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06649">Zibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06034">Anah</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 36:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01787">Dishon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0687">Ezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01789">Dishan</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <transChange type="added">that came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02753">of Hori</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">among their dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">there reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">any king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">over the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01106">And Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01838">Dinhabah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01106">And Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03103">and Jobab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01224">of Bozrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Genesis 36:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03103">And Jobab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02367">and Husham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08489">of Temani</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Genesis 36:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02367">And Husham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01908">and Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0911">of Bedad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in his stead: and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05762">Avith</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 36:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01908">And Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08072">and Samlah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04957">of Masrekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Genesis 36:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08072">And Samlah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07344">of Rehoboth</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Genesis 36:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01177">and Baal–hanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05907">of Achbor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Genesis 36:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01177">And Baal–hanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05907">of Achbor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01924">and Hadar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in his stead: and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06464">Pau</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04105">Mehetabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04308">of Matred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04314">of Mezahab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hadar, Pau</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hadad, Pai</rdg>: after his death was an Aristocracy</note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:40
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">of the dukes</w> <transChange type="added">that came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">after their places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">by their names</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H08555">Timnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05933">Alvah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03509">Jetheth</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Alvah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Aliah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 36:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0173">Aholibamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06373">Pinon</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 36:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">Kenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04014">Mibzar</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 36:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04025">Magdiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05902">Iram</w>: these <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">according to their habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of their possession</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of the Edomites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Edomites</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Edom</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen65" osisID="Gen.36"/>

verses.name: Genesis 37:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">wherein his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">was a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wherein…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of his father’s sojournings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 37:2
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651 strong:H06240">seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was feeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with his brethren</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the lad</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">of Bilhah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and with the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02153">of Zilpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">their evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01681">report</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Now Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">more than all his children</w>, because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02208">of his old age</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">him a coat</w> of <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06446">colours</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>colours</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 37:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And when his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">him more than all his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and could</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peaceably</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and they hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him yet the more</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02472">I pray you, this dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have dreamed</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 37:7
verses.text: For, behold, we <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432 strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">binding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0485">sheaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0485">and, lo, my sheaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and also stood upright</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0485">and, behold, your sheaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made obeisance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0485">to my sheaf</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to him, Shalt thou indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">over us? or shalt thou indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">over us? And they hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him yet the more</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">for his dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and for his words</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">yet another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">it his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">more; and, behold, the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H06240">and the eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">made obeisance</w> to me.

verses.name: Genesis 37:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">to his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and to his brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebuked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> unto him, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02472">this dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast dreamed</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0517">Shall I and thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">ourselves to thee to the earth</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 37:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">envied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him; but his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">observed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the saying</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">in Shechem</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">Do not thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">feed</w> <transChange type="added">the flock</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07927">in Shechem</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will send thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them. And he said</w> to him, Here <transChange type="added">am I</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to him, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">whether it be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">and well</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with the flocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-40">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">me word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-40">again</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">him out of the vale</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>see…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">see the peace of thy brethren</rdg>, etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 37:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And a certain man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">found him</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wandering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asked him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">What seekest</w> thou?

verses.name: Genesis 37:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">I seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0375">me, I pray thee, where</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they feed</w> <transChange type="added">their flocks</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">hence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01886">to Dothan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01886">them in Dothan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">him afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">even before he came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05230" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">unto them, they conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against him to slay</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01976">Behold, this</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472 strong:H01167">dreamer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dreamer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">master of dreams</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 37:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now therefore, and let us slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him into some</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we will say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">Some evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and we shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">what will become of his dreams</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07205">And Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him out of their hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Let us not kill</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07205">And Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">no blood</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">him into this pit</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">no hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">upon him; that he might rid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him out of their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-41">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him to his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-41">again</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And it came to pass, when Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they stript</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">his coat</w>, <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coat</w> of <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06446">colours</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on him;<note type="study"><catchWord>colours</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 37:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">him into a pit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0953">and the pit</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07386">empty</w>, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w> in it.

verses.name: Genesis 37:25
