verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0736">and, behold, a company</w> <w lemma="strong:H03459">of Ishmeelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">from Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">with their camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05219">spicery</w> <w lemma="strong:H06875">and balm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03910">and myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going</w> to carry <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01215">What profit</w> <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if we slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and conceal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 37:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03459">him to the Ishmeelites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and let not our hand</w> be upon him; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brother</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">our flesh</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were content</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hearkened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 37:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then there passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04084">by Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05503 strong:H0582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">merchantmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03459">to the Ishmeelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">for twenty</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07205">And Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">unto the pit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03130">and, behold, Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0953">not in the pit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">The child</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0575">not; and I, whither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall I go</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 37:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">the coat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 37:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">the coat</w> of <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06446">colours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">to their father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">This have we found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">know</w> now whether it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coat</w> or no.

verses.name: Genesis 37:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he knew it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">him; Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is without doubt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">rent in pieces</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">upon his loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 37:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And all his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and all his daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him; but he refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to be comforted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I will go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">into the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H057">mourning</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01">Thus his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w> for him.

verses.name: Genesis 37:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04092">And the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">him into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06318">unto Potiphar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">an officer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh’s</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eunuch</rdg>: but the word doth signify not only eunuchs, but also chamberlains, courtiers, and officers</note><note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chief of the slaughter men</rdg>, or <rdg type="alternate">executioners</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 37." eID="gen66" osisID="Gen.37"/>

verses.name: Genesis 38:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And it came to pass at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">that Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">from his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">in to a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05726">Adullamite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02437">Hirah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">there a daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">Canaanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07770">Shuah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took her</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went in</w> unto her.

verses.name: Genesis 38:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06147">Er</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again, and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0209">Onan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And she yet again conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07956">Shelah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03580">and he was at Chezib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when she bare</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 38:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H06147">for Er</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06147">And Er</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">was wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 38:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0209">unto Onan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02992" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and marry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">her, and raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to thy brother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0209">And Onan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">that the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">should not be his; and it came to pass, when</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he spilled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">lest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he should give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brother</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0834">And the thing which</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wherefore he slew</w> him also.<note type="study"><catchWord>displeased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was evil in the eyes of the Lord</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 38:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">to Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">his daughter in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">at thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07956">till Shelah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be grown</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest peradventure he die</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">also, as his brethren</w> <transChange type="added">did</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H08559">And Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And in process</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07770">of Shuah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was comforted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto his sheepshearers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">to Timnath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07453">he and his friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H02437">Hirah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05726">the Adullamite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in process…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the days were multiplied</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 38:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02524">Behold thy father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">to Timnath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">his sheep</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-42">And she put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0491">her widow’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-42">off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">from her, and covered her</w> <w lemma="strong:H06809">with a vail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05968" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and wrapped herself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">an open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">place</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">to Timnath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07956">that Shelah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was grown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and she was not given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto him to wife</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an open…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the door of eyes</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">of Enajim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 38:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">When Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw her</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he thought</w> her <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">an harlot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because she had covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">her face</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto her by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, let me come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee; (for he knew</w> not that she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03618">his daughter in law</w>.) <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What wilt thou give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, that thou mayest come in</w> unto me?

verses.name: Genesis 38:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will send</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01423 strong:H05795">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">from the flock</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou give</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06162">a pledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till thou send</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>a kid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a kid of the goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 38:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H06162">pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee? And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02368">Thy signet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06616">and thy bracelets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and thy staff</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, and she conceived</w> by him.

verses.name: Genesis 38:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid by</w> <w lemma="strong:H06809">her vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from her, and put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">the garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0491">of her widowhood</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795 strong:H01423">the kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05726">the Adullamite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to receive</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06162">pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">from the woman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he found her</w> not.

verses.name: Genesis 38:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06948">the harlot</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">openly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way side</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06948">There was no harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">in this</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>openly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in Enajim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 38:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">her; and also the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06948">there was no harlot</w> in this <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let her take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0937">to her, lest we be shamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">this kid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hast not found</w> her.<note type="study"><catchWord>be shamed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">become a contempt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 38:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969">And it came to pass about three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">after, that it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">thy daughter in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath played the harlot</w>; and also, behold, she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02030">with child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">by whoredom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring her forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and let her be burnt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:25
verses.text: When she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">brought forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02524">to her father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">By the man</w>, whose these <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02030">I with child</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Discern</w>, I pray thee, whose <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02858">these, the signet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06616">and bracelets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and staff</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">acknowledged</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She hath been more righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">than I; because that I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07956">her not to Shelah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And he knew her</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">again</w> no more.

verses.name: Genesis 38:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">And it came to pass in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of her travail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08380">that, behold, twins</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">in her womb</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when she travailed</w>, that <transChange type="added">the one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put out</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and the midwife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">a scarlet thread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">This came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 38:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And it came to pass, as he drew back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">that, behold, his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How hast thou broken forth</w>? <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06556">breach</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon thee: therefore his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">Pharez</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>How hast…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Wherefore hast thou made this breach against thee?</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Pharez</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">A breach</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 38:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08144">that had the scarlet thread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">Zarah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 38." eID="gen67" osisID="Gen.38"/>

verses.name: Genesis 39:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06318">and Potiphar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">an officer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04713 strong:H0376">an Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03459">of the Ishmeelites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which had brought him down</w> thither.

verses.name: Genesis 39:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">was with Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and he was a prosperous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and he was in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptian</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">And his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with him, and that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">made all that he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he served</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: and he made him overseer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over his house</w>, and all <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03426">he had</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0227">And it came to pass from the time</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he had made him overseer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">and over all that he had</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptian’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">for Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">sake</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01293">and the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">was upon all that he had</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">and in the field</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">all that he had in Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">not ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">he had, save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which he did eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> was <transChange type="added">a</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08389">goodly</w> <transChange type="added">person</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">and well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">favoured</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">that his master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">her eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">upon Joseph</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lie</w> with me.

verses.name: Genesis 39:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But he refused</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto his master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Behold, my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wotteth</w> not what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with me in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he hath committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">all that he hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to my hand</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 39:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">none greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">than I; neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he kept back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">from me but thee, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0859">thou</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how then can I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against God</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 39:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, as she spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">to Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not unto her, to lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by her</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> to be with her.

verses.name: Genesis 39:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass about this time</w>, that <transChange type="added">Joseph</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">his business</w>; and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582 strong:H0376">none of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> there within.

verses.name: Genesis 39:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">him by his garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me: and he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and got</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">him out</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">forth</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 39:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of her house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680 strong:H0376">an Hebrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto us to mock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us; he came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me to lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me, and I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>loud</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 39:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">with me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and got him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And she laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by her</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">until his lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And she spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto him according to these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">The Hebrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us, came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto me to mock</w> me:

verses.name: Genesis 39:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And it came to pass, as I lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">with me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">And it came to pass, when his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which she spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">After this manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to me; that his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">master</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and put him</w> <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">into the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">where the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">prisoners</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">and he was there in the prison</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">was with Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">him mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">him favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">of the prison</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shewed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">extended kindness unto him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 39:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">of the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">to Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">all the prisoners</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">in the prison</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and whatsoever they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there, he was the doer</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 39:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">of the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">not to any thing</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> was with him, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> made <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to prosper</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 39." eID="gen68" osisID="Gen.39"/>

verses.name: Genesis 40:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the butler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">baker</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had offended</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">their lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05631">his officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">against the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the butlers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and against the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the bakers</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">them in ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">into the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">where Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with them, and he served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them: and they continued a season</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">in ward</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both of them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">his dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06623">according to the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">of his dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the butler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the baker</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05470 strong:H01004">in the prison</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">unto them in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w> upon them, and, behold, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02196" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sad</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">officers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04929">with him in the ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">Wherefore look</w> ye <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">sadly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>look…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are your faces evil?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 40:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, We have dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no interpreter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of it. And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">Do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06623">not interpretations</w> <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">tell me</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, I pray you.

verses.name: Genesis 40:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">butler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">his dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">to Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">to him, In my dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01612">behold, a vine</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before me</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 40:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01612">And in the vine</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08299">branches</w>: and it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as though it budded</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05322">her blossoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shot forth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0811">and the clusters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof brought forth ripe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 40:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">cup</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in my hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">the grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07818" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">them into Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">cup</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">into Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06623">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of it: The three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08299">branches</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 40:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05750">Yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">within three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">shall Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thine head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">thee unto thy place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">after the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">when thou wast his butler</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lift…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reckon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 40:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But think</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on me when it shall be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I pray thee, unto me, and make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of me unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring me</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of this house</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>think…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">remember me with thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 40:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">For indeed I was stolen away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and here also have I done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they should put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">me into the dungeon</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 40:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">When the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">baker</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">was good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0637">I also</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02472">in my dream</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">I had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02751">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">baskets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on my head</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>white</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">full of holes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 40:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05945">And in the uppermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">basket</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03978">of all manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644 strong:H04639" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of bakemeats</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">for Pharaoh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05775">and the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">them out of the basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bakemeats…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meat of Pharaoh, the work of a baker</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">cook</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 40:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06623">the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thereof: The three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">baskets</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 40:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Yet within three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">shall Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thy head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from off thee, and shall hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">thee on a tree</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05775">and the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">thy flesh</w> from off thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>lift…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reckon thee, and take thy office from thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 40:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07992">And it came to pass the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205 strong:H03117" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">birthday</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto all his servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">butler</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">baker</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lifted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reckoned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 40:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-43">And he restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">butler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04945">unto his butlership</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-43">again</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">into Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 40:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">baker</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">as Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had interpreted</w> to them.

verses.name: Genesis 40:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Yet did not the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">butler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but forgat</w> him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 40." eID="gen69" osisID="Gen.40"/>

verses.name: Genesis 41:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of two full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">that Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dreamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">by the river</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And, behold, there came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">out of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320 strong:H01277">and fatfleshed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0260">in a meadow</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And, behold, seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">out of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">ill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320 strong:H01851">and leanfleshed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">upon the brink</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">And the ill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320 strong:H01851">and leanfleshed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">and fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06547">So Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">awoke</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">and, behold, seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">stalk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01277">rank</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rank</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And, behold, seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01851">thin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07710" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and blasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">with the east wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sprung up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after them</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01851">And the seven thin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">rank</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">and full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">awoke</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">that his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06470" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was troubled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02748">for all the magicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and all the wise men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">thereof: and Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">them his dream</w>; but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that could interpret</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">them unto Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">butler</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">I do remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">my faults</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">me in ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">in the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">me and the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">baker</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I and he; we dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06623">according to the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">of his dream</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">there with us a young man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">an Hebrew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">to the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and we told</w> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and he interpreted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">to us our dreams</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">to each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">according to his dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he did interpret</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it came to pass, as he interpreted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to us, so it was; me he restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">unto mine office</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and him he hanged</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">Then Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought him hastily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of the dungeon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shaved</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">his raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made him run</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that can interpret</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it: and I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w> of thee, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou canst understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H06622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to interpret</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when thou hearest a dream thou canst interpret it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-44">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01107">not in me</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-44">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">an answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02472">In my dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">upon the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And, behold, there came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">out of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320 strong:H01277">fatfleshed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">and well</w> <w lemma="strong:H08389">favoured</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0260">in a meadow</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And, behold, seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01803">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">ill</w> <w lemma="strong:H08389">favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320 strong:H07534">and leanfleshed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02007">such</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">as I never</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">for badness</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07534">And the lean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the ill favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07130 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they had eaten them up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it could not be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had eaten them</w>; but they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">still</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">ill favoured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08462">as at the beginning</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I awoke</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eaten…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">come to the inward parts of them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">in my dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and, behold, seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">stalk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And, behold, seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06798" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">withered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01851">thin</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07710" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">blasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">with the east wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sprung up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after them</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>withered</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">small</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01851">And the thin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I told</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02748">unto the magicians</w>; but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none that could declare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to me.

verses.name: Genesis 41:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02472">The dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> what he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">about to do</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">The seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07651">and the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02472">the dream</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07534">thin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and ill favoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after them</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07651">and the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07710" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">blasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">with the east wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">shall be seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:28
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">What God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">about to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, there come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07647">plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there shall arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after them</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07647">and all the plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07458">and the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 41:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07647">And the plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of that famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651 strong:H0310">following</w>; for it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">grievous</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grievous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heavy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02472">And for that the dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was doubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">twice</w>; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">because the thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">will shortly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bring it to pass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>established…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prepared of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Now therefore let Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">discreet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">and wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him over the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Let Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let him appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06496">officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02567" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and take up the fifth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">in the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07647">plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And let them gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">all the food</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of those good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06651" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and let them keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0400">And that food</w> <w lemma="strong:H06487">shall be for store</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">against the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">which shall be in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">that the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">not through the famine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>perish…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be not cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of all his servants</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Can we find</w> <transChange type="added">such a one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02088">as this</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">in whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>?

verses.name: Genesis 41:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">Forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">as God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hath shewed</w> thee all this, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">none so discreet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">and wise</w> as thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange>:

verses.name: Genesis 41:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt be</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over my house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and according unto thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">shall all my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ruled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03678">only in the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I be greater</w> than thou.<note type="study"><catchWord>be ruled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be armed</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">kiss</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee over all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:42
