verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">his ring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">it upon Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and arrayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">him in vestures</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">of fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">a gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07242">chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">about his neck</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>fine…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">silk</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he made him to ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he had; and they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H086">Bow the knee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and he made</w> him <transChange type="added">ruler</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Bow…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Tender father</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Abrech</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01107">and without</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee shall no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">or foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06847">Zaphnath–paaneah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">him to wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0621">Asenath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06319">of Poti–pherah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0204">of On</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> over <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zaphnath–paaneah</catchWord>: which in the Coptic signifies, A revealer of secrets, or, <rdg type="alternate">The man to whom secrets are revealed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>priest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:46
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went throughout</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And in the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07647">plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07062">by handfuls</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gathered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">all the food</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">which were in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">the food</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0400">the food</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">every city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laid he up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the same</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06651" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">until he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">numbering</w>; for <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">number</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And unto Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">before the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0621">which Asenath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06319">of Poti–pherah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0204">of On</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>priest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">of the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For God</w>, <transChange type="added">said he</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05382" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath made me forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">all my toil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and all my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Manasseh</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Forgetting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">he Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath caused me to be fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">of my affliction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ephraim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Fruitful</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:53
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07651">And the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07647">of plenteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">that was in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were ended</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of dearth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">according as Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07458">and the dearth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">was in all lands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">but in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">there was bread</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And when all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was famished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">for bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06547">and Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">unto all the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what he saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to you, do</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 41:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07458">And the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">was over all the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all the storehouses, and sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">unto the Egyptians</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07458">and the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all the storehouses</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all wherein was</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 41:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And all countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">to Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for to buy</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07458">because that the famine</w> was <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all lands</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 41." eID="gen70" osisID="Gen.41"/>

verses.name: Genesis 42:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">Now when Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that there was</w> <w lemma="strong:H07668">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Why do ye look</w> one upon another?

verses.name: Genesis 42:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H07668">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get you down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thither, and buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for us from thence; that we may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not die</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01144">But Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">not with his brethren</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06435">Lest peradventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0611">mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">befall him</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to buy</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">those that came</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07458">for the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">was in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07989">the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> he <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed down</w> themselves before him <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them, but made himself strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto them, and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">roughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them; and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0370">unto them, Whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye? And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">From the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>roughly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard things with them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 42:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but they knew</w> not him.

verses.name: Genesis 42:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">the dreams</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, and said</w> unto them, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">spies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye are come</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto him, Nay, my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">are thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05168">We</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">all one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>; we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03651">true</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">are no spies</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, Nay, but to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye are come</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servants</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06996">and, behold, the youngest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with our father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not.

verses.name: Genesis 42:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto them, That <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, saying</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">spies</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 42:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02063">Hereby</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">ye shall be proved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">By the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">hence, except your youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come</w> hither.

verses.name: Genesis 42:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of you, and let him fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and ye shall be kept in prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that your words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be proved</w>, whether <transChange type="added">there be any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">you: or else</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">by the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> surely ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">spies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kept…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 42:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put them all together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">into ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gathered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 42:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">unto them the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">This do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and live</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">I fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 42:19
verses.text: If ye <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03651">true</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">let one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">of your prison</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">ye, carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07668">corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07459">for the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of your houses</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 42:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">your youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto me; so shall your words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be verified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall not die</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they did</w> so.

verses.name: Genesis 42:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H061">verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0818">guilty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">concerning our brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">in that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">the anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of his soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">when he besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, and we would not hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06869">therefore is this distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> upon us.

verses.name: Genesis 42:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07205">And Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Spake I</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not unto you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Do not sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">against the child</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye would not hear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01818">therefore, behold, also his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is required</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">not that Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">understood</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for he spake unto them by an interpreter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he spake…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an interpreter was between them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 42:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And he turned himself about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from them, and wept</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned to them again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">from them Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">him before their eyes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">Then Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">their sacks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">with corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">into his sack</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">them provision</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">for the way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651">and thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did he</w> unto them.

verses.name: Genesis 42:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they laded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">their asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07668">with the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w> thence.

verses.name: Genesis 42:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">his sack</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">his ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04554">provender</w> <w lemma="strong:H04411">in the inn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he espied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">his money</w>; for, behold, it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0572">in his sack’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">My money</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is restored</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02009">and, lo</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0572">even in my sack</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">and their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">failed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they were afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> unto us?<note type="study"><catchWord>failed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 42:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him all that befell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them; saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 42:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">The man</w>, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">the lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">roughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to us, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">us for spies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>roughly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with us hard things</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 42:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we said</w> unto him, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03651">true</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">we are no spies</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 42:32
verses.text: We <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H06240">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">not, and the youngest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">the lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto us, Hereby shall I know</w> that ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03651">true</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of your brethren</w> <transChange type="added">here</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with me, and take</w> <transChange type="added">food for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07459">the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of your households</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be gone</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 42:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">And bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">your youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me: then shall I know</w> that ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">no spies</w>, but <transChange type="added">that</transChange> ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03651">true</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>: <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">you your brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall traffick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And it came to pass as they emptied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">their sacks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that, behold, every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06872">bundle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of money</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08242">in his sack</w>: and when <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">they and their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06872">the bundles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they were afraid</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto them, Me have ye bereaved</w> <transChange type="added">of my children</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08095">not, and Simeon</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, and ye will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w> <transChange type="added">away</transChange>: all these things are against me.

verses.name: Genesis 42:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07205">And Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">my two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">if I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him not to thee: deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will bring him to thee again</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 42:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with you; for his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and he is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0611">alone: if mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">befall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">him by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in the which ye go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then shall ye bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">my gray hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">with sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 42." eID="gen71" osisID="Gen.42"/>

verses.name: Genesis 43:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07458">And the famine</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398 strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8765">And it came to pass, when they had eaten up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07668">the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which they had brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Go again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">us a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">The man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">did solemnly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">protest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto us, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brother</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with you.<note type="study"><catchWord>did…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">protesting protested</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">If thou wilt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us, we will go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">thee food</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 43:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">But if thou wilt not send</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will not go down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto us, Ye shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">except your brother</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with you.

verses.name: Genesis 43:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Wherefore dealt ye <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ill</w> with me, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">whether ye had yet a brother</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 43:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">The man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us straitly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of our state, and of our kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">yet alive</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03426">have ye</w> <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">him according</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to the tenor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of these words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">could we certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he would say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-45">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-45">down</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>asked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">asking asked us</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>tenor</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>could…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">knowing could we know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me, and we will arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not die</w>, both we, and thou, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02945">also our little ones</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for him; of my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou require</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518" type="x-split-46">him: if</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518" type="x-split-46">him not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto thee, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him before thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then let me bear the blame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 43:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03884">For except</w> <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8701">we had lingered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">surely now we had returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">this second time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>this</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">twice by this</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto them, If <transChange type="added">it must be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0645">so now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">this; take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02173">of the best fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in your vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and carry down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H06875">balm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">and a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05219">spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03910">and myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0992">nuts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08247">and almonds</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 43:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">double</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in your hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that was brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">of your sacks</w>, carry <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in your hand</w>; peradventure it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04870">an oversight</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 43:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">also your brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 43:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">you mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he may send away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">your other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0834">If</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I be bereaved</w> <transChange type="added">of my children</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am bereaved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>If…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">And I, as I have been</rdg>, etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">double</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And when Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the ruler of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w> <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02874 strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and slay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and make ready</w>; for <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">with me at noon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">kill a killing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>dine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">as Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bade</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">into Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">because they were brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">into Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that was returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">in our sacks</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">at the first time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">are we brought in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8705">that he may seek occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">against us, and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">upon us, and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">us for bondmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and our asses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seek…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">roll himself upon us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the steward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">with him at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 43:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">sir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">we came indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">at the first time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>we…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">coming down we came down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it came to pass, when we came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04411">to the inn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">our sacks</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">of his sack</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">our money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">in full weight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we have brought it again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in our hand</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0312">And other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have we brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we cannot tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">our money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">in our sacks</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to you, fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not: your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04301">you treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">in your sacks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I had</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">your money</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">Simeon</w> out unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>I had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">your money came to me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">into Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">their feet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">their asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04554">provender</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the present</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they should eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> there.

verses.name: Genesis 43:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And when Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">him the present</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">themselves to him to the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he asked</w> them of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">welfare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">the old man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of whom ye spake</w>? <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">he yet alive</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>welfare</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Is your…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Is there peace to your father?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 43:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in good health</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">yet alive</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they bowed down their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made obeisance</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">this your younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of whom ye spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thee, my son</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made haste</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07356">for his bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03648" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">did yearn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">upon his brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he sought</w> <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to weep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he entered</w> into <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02315">chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> there.

verses.name: Genesis 43:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0662" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and refrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they set on</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">with the Hebrews</w>; for that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">unto the Egyptians</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01062">according to his birthright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06810">and the youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06812">according to his youth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">marvelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">at another</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 43:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <transChange type="added">and sent</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04864">messes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto them from before him</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01144">but Benjamin’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">mess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">was five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so much as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">any of theirs. And they drank</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and were merry</w> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">drank largely</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 43." eID="gen72" osisID="Gen.43"/>

verses.name: Genesis 44:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the steward of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">sacks</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">as much as</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they can</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">carry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">in his sack’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the steward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">him that was over his house</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 44:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">my cup</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">cup</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0572">in the sack’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of the youngest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07668">and his corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">that Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">As soon as the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were sent away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">they and their asses</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they were gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> not <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">far off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his steward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and when thou dost overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 44:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not this <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">in which my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drinketh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and whereby indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he divineth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye have done evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in so doing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>divineth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">maketh trial?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 44:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">unto them these same</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto him, Wherefore saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02486">God forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to this thing</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 44:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">Behold, the money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which we found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">in our sacks’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">we brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thee out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how then should we steal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">out of thy lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">or gold</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 44:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">With whomsoever of thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it be found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">both let him die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">and we also will be my lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">bondmen</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Now also <transChange type="added">let</transChange> it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according unto your words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651"/><w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he with whom it is found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">shall be my servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05355">and ye shall be blameless</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Then they speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">his sack</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">his sack</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he searched</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">at the eldest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">at the youngest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01375">and the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">in Benjamin’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0572">sack</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">their clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">his ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">to Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; for he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet there: and they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the ground</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">unto them, What deed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this that ye have done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wot ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not that such a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">as I can certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">divine</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>divine</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make trial?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 44:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall we say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">what shall we speak</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">or how shall we clear ourselves</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath found out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w>: behold, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, both we, and <transChange type="added">he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01571">also</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H0834">with whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is found</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">God forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">so</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in whose hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">the cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">he shall be my servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and as for you, get you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03063">Then Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">Oh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">let thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I pray thee, speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">in my lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">and let not thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">against thy servant</w>: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">even as Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">Have</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">ye a father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">or a brother</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 44:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">We have</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">a father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">an old man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">and a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02208">of his old age</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">a little one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he alone is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 44:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou saidst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, that I may set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> upon him.

verses.name: Genesis 44:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">The lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: for <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he should leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <transChange type="added">his father</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would die</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou saidst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">Except</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">your youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with you, ye shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it came to pass when we came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">we told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go again</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">us a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06996">if our youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with us, then will we go down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for we may</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0369">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">our youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with us.

verses.name: Genesis 44:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us, Ye know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">that my wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">me two</w> <transChange type="added">sons</transChange>:

verses.name: Genesis 44:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me, and I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">he is torn in pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I saw him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">not since</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 44:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And if ye take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">this also from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0611">and mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">befall him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye shall bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">my gray hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">with sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Now therefore when I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the lad</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not with us; seeing that his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is bound up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in the lad’s life</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 44:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">It shall come to pass, when he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">that the lad</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">with us</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he will die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">the gray hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">with sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">For thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">became surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">for the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">instead of the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">a bondman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to my lord</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05288">and let the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 44:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0349">For how</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the lad</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not with me? lest peradventure I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall come on</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">find my father</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 44." eID="gen73" osisID="Gen.44"/>

verses.name: Genesis 45:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">Then Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H0662" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">not refrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">himself before all them that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by him; and he cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-47">Cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-47">to go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from me. And there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">with him, while Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">made himself known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01065 strong:H06963">And he wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">aloud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085 strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wept…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave forth his voice in weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">doth my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">yet live</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him; for they were troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at his presence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>troubled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">terrified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me, I pray you. And they came near</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Now therefore be not grieved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with yourselves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me hither: for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me before you</w> <w lemma="strong:H04241">to preserve life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>nor…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">neither let there be anger in your eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:6
