verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">For these two years</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07458">the famine</w> <transChange type="added">been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: and yet <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, in the which <transChange type="added">there shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">neither</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02758">earing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">nor harvest</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me before you</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">you a posterity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to save your lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">by a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">deliverance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to preserve…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to put for you a remnant</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:8
verses.text: So now <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> not you <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me hither, but God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">me a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">and lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of all his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">me lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of all Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, tarry</w> not:

verses.name: Genesis 45:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07138">and thou shalt be near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, thou, and thy children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and thy flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and thy herds</w>, and all that thou hast:

verses.name: Genesis 45:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">And there will I nourish</w> thee; for yet <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">lest thou, and thy household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and all that thou hast, come to poverty</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And, behold, your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w>, that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that speaketh</w> unto you.

verses.name: Genesis 45:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And ye shall tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of all my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and of all that ye have seen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and ye shall haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> hither.

verses.name: Genesis 45:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">upon his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">upon his neck</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Moreover he kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">all his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">upon them: and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">that his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">talked</w> with him.

verses.name: Genesis 45:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06963">And the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof was heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">in Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was good in the eyes of Pharaoh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">This do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02943" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye; lade</w> <w lemma="strong:H01165">your beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>;

verses.name: Genesis 45:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and your households</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me: and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">you the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">Now thou art commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">this do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye; take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">you wagons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">for your little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and for your wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Also</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">not your stuff</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02898">for the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> yours.<note type="study"><catchWord>regard…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let not your eye spare</rdg>, etc.</note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">so: and Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">them wagons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">them provision</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">for the way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandment</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">To all of them he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">changes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">of raiment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01144">but to Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">changes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">of raiment</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And to his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">after this</w> <transChange type="added">manner</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">laden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">with the good things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">she asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">laden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">with corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">and bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04202">and meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>laden…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">carrying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-48">So he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-48">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they departed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, See that ye fall not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 45:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 45:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">yet alive</w>, and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03820">And Jacob’s heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fainted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he believed</w> them not.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jacob’s</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 45:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them: and when he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">the wagons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">which Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">him, the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">revived</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 45:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">enough</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">yet alive</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see him</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before I die</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 45." eID="gen74" osisID="Gen.45"/>

verses.name: Genesis 46:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took his journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with all that he had, and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">to Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04759">in the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">of the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I.

verses.name: Genesis 46:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will there make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of thee a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 46:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">with thee into Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and I will also surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring thee up</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">upon thine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">from Beer–sheba</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and their little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05699">in the wagons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">which Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to carry</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 46:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">their cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and their goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07408" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and all his seed</w> with him:

verses.name: Genesis 46:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">His sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with him, his daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and all his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought he</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">with him into Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">firstborn</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02585">Hanoch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06396">and Phallu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02696">and Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03756">and Carmi</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03223">Jemuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03226">and Jamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0161">and Ohad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03199">and Jachin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06714">and Zohar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Shaul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of a Canaanitish</w> woman.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jemuel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Nemuel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jachin</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jarib</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Zohar</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zerah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01648">Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06955">Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04847">and Merari</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gershon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Gershom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06147">Er</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0209">and Onan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07956">and Shelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06557">and Pharez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02226">and Zerah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06147">but Er</w> <w lemma="strong:H0209">and Onan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Pharez</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">were Hezron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02538">and Hamul</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08439">Tola</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06312">and Phuvah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03102">and Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08110">and Shimron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Phuvah, and Job</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Puah, and Jashub</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05624">Sered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0356">and Elon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03177">and Jahleel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:15
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">of Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">in Padan–aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">with his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01783">Dinah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and his daughters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06837">Ziphion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02291">and Haggi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07764">Shuni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0675">and Ezbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06179">Eri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0722">and Arodi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0692">and Areli</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ziphion</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zephon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ezbon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ozni</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Arodi</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Arod</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03232">Jimnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03438">and Ishuah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03440">and Isui</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01283">and Beriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08294">and Serah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01283">of Beriah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02268">Heber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04439">and Malchiel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:18
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02153">of Zilpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03837">whom Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">to Leah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and these she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337 strong:H06240">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">of Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And unto Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0621">which Asenath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06319">of Poti–pherah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0204">of On</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>priest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01106">Belah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01071">and Becher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0788">and Ashbel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01617">Gera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05283">and Naaman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0278">Ehi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07220">and Rosh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04649">Muppim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02650">and Huppim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0714">and Ard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ehi</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ahiram</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Muppim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shupham</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">Shuppim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Huppim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hupham</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:22
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">of Rachel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">to Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the souls</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02366">Hushim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hushim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shuham</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03183">Jahzeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01476">and Guni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03337">and Jezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08006">and Shillem</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:25
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">of Bilhah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03837">which Laban</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">unto Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">these unto Jacob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the souls</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">All the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">with Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">of his loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">besides Jacob’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the souls</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>loins</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thigh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">him in Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to direct</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">unto Goshen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">his chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01657">to Goshen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself unto him; and he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">on his neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">on his neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">a good while</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">since</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>, because thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05750">yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 46:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and unto his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto him, My brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> unto me;

verses.name: Genesis 46:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">for their trade hath been to feed cattle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">their flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and their herds</w>, and all that they have.<note type="study"><catchWord>their trade…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they are men of cattle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 46:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and shall say</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">your occupation</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 46:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">That ye shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servants’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">trade</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">hath been about cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from our youth</w> even until now, both we, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">also our fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for every shepherd</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">unto the Egyptians</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 46." eID="gen75" osisID="Gen.46"/>

verses.name: Genesis 47:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">Then Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and their flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and their herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that they have, are come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>; and, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">some</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brethren</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">your occupation</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servants</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shepherds</w>, both we, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">also our fathers</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">moreover unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">For to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are we come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">have no pasture</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for their flocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07458">for the famine</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> unto thee:

verses.name: Genesis 47:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thee</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04315">in the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-49">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-49">to dwell</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them dwell</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03426 strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and if thou knowest</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of activity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">among them, then make them</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">over my cattle</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set him</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03117 strong:H02416">old</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> thou?<note type="study"><catchWord>How…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">How many are the days of the years of thy life?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 47:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">The days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">of my pilgrimage</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">have the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">been, and have not attained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">of their pilgrimage</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">them a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04315">in the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07486">of Rameses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">as Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">nourished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and all his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> to <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02945">families</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>according…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as a little child is nourished</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the little ones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 47:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07458">for the famine</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">so that the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> and <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fainted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of the famine</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">gathered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">all the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07668">for the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which they bought</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">into Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">And when money</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">failed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">all the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">us bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for why should we die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">in thy presence? for the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0656" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">your cattle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">you for your cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">if money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0656" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them bread</w> <transChange type="added">in exchange</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05483">for horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and for the flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and for the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and for the asses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them with bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">for all their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">for that year</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">led them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 47:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">When that year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was ended</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">unto him the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto him, We will not hide</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">from my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">how that our money</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is spent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">also hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">our herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of cattle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there is not ought left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01472">but our bodies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and our lands</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 47:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore shall we die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">both we and our land</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">us and our land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">for bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and we and our land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">will be servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and give</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">that the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not desolate</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">for Pharaoh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04714">for the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">his field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">because the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over them: so the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">became Pharaoh’s</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And as for the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">them to cities</w> from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> even to the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> thereof.

verses.name: Genesis 47:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0127">Only the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bought he</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">not; for the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">had a portion</w> <transChange type="added">assigned them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">their portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">which Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: wherefore they sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">not their lands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>priests</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">princes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 47:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">Then Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">and your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">for Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01887">lo</w>, <transChange type="added">here is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for you, and ye shall sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08393">And it shall come to pass in the increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">shall be your own, for seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0400">and for your food</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and for them of your households</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and for food</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">for your little ones</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast saved our lives</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">and we will be Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">it a law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">over the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02569">should have the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07535">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> only, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">became not Pharaoh’s</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>priests</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">princes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 47:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they had possessions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, and grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceedingly</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651 strong:H06240">seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H02416">so the whole age</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">was an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the whole…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the days of the years of his life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 47:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">that Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">must die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, If now I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">I pray thee, thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">under my thigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me; bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">me not, I pray thee, in Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 47:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I will lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with my fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">me out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">me in their buryingplace</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">as thou hast said</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 47:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto me. And he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto him. And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">himself upon the bed’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 47." eID="gen76" osisID="Gen.47"/>

verses.name: Genesis 48:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, that <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Behold, thy father</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">with him his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:2
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Behold, thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto thee: and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">upon the bed</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03870">unto me at Luz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> me,

verses.name: Genesis 48:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of thee a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">to thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after thee</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">possession</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08147">And now thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thee in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">unto thee into Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07205">mine; as Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">and Simeon</w>, they shall be mine.

verses.name: Genesis 48:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04138">And thy issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou begettest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them, shall be thine, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">in their inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And as for me, when I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06307">from Padan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07354">Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">by me in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05750">when</w> yet <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03530">but a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">unto Ephrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I buried her</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">there in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">of Ephrath</w>; the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01035">Beth–lehem</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these?

verses.name: Genesis 48:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> me in this <transChange type="added">place</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bring them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless</w> them.

verses.name: Genesis 48:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Now the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were dim</w> <w lemma="strong:H02207">for age</w>, <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not see</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought them near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him; and he kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and embraced</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>dim</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heavy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 48:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I had not thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and, lo, God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">me also thy seed</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">from between</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">his knees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and he bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">himself with his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them both</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">in his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">toward Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">left hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">in his left hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">toward Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">right hand</w>, and brought <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">near</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 48:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">his right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">upon Ephraim’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06810">the younger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08040">and his left hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">upon Manasseh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-50">guiding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-50">wittingly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04519">for Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">whom my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">and Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">did walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">me all my life long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 48:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">The Angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me from all evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the lads</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and let my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be named</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on them, and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">and Isaac</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01711" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">into a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as fishes do increase</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 48:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And when Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and he held up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">it from Ephraim’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">unto Manasseh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>displeased…</catchWord>: <rdg type="x-literal">was evil in his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 48:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Not so, my father</w>: for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">refused</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">he also shall become a people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he also shall be great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0199">but truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">his younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">than he, and his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">shall become a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>multitude</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fulness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 48:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">In thee shall Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">thee as Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and as Manasseh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Behold, I die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">but God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall be with you, and bring you again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 48:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to thee one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">above thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">and with my bow</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 48." eID="gen77" osisID="Gen.48"/>

verses.name: Genesis 49:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Gather yourselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may tell</w> you <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall befall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">you in the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Gather yourselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">my firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">my might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">and the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0202">of my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H07613">of dignity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">of power</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 49:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06349">Unstable</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt not excel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou wentest up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">bed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">then defiledst thou</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326">to my couch</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou shalt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do not thou excel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he went…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my couch is gone</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 49:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08095">Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">and Levi</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03627">instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of cruelty</w> <transChange type="added">are in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04380">their habitations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>instruments…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">their swords are weapons of violence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 49:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">not thou into their secret</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06951">unto their assembly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">mine honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03161" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not thou united</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">for in their anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">and in their selfwill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06131" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they digged down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">a wall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>digged…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">houghed oxen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 49:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">their anger</w>, for <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05794">fierce</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05678">and their wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it was cruel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">them in Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">them in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">whom thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall praise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">thy hand</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203">in the neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall bow down</w> before thee.

verses.name: Genesis 49:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01482">whelp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02964">from the prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art gone up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he stooped down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he couched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">as a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03833">and as an old lion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who shall rouse him up</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 49:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07626">The sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">from Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">nor a lawgiver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">from between his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">until</w> <w lemma="strong:H07886">Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>; and unto him <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03349">the gathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Binding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05895">his foal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">unto the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0860">and his ass’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">colt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08321">unto the choice vine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">his garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">in wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05497">and his clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">of grapes</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 49:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">His eyes</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02447">red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">with wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">and his teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02074">Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02348">at the haven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>; and he <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02348">for an haven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">of ships</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03411">and his border</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06721">unto Zidon</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03485">Issachar</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01634">a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">couching down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04942">between two burdens</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 49:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">that rest</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pleasant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">his shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and became a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">unto tribute</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">shall be a serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08207">an adder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">in the path</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that biteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06119">heels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so that his rider</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an adder</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an arrow-snake</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 49:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have waited for</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:19
