verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01416">a troop</w> <w lemma="strong:H01464" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall overcome</w> <w lemma="strong:H01464" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: but he shall overcome</w> <w lemma="strong:H06119">at the last</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0836">Out of Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">his bread</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08082">fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04574">dainties</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05321">Naphtali</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0355">a hind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">let loose</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08233">goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">words</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">bough</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">bough</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">by a well</w>; <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H07791">over the wall</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>branches</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 49:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671 strong:H01167">The archers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have sorely grieved him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shot</w> <transChange type="added">at him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07852" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hated him</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 49:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07198">But his bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">in strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06339" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were made strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H046">of the mighty</w> <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>; (from thence <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the shepherd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:)

verses.name: Genesis 49:25
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">by the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who shall help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">thee; and by</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">who shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">thee with blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05920">above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">of the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">under, blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">of the breasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07356">and of the womb</w>:

verses.name: Genesis 49:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">The blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">above the blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of my progenitors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08379">unto the utmost bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of the everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hills</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">they shall be on the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06936">and on the crown of the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">of him that was separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">from his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ravin</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02061">a wolf</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05706">the prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and at night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>All these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H06240">the twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: and this <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">that their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto them, and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">them; every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">according to his blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he blessed</w> them.

verses.name: Genesis 49:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto them, I am to be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">me with my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in the cave</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">of Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 49:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04631">In the cave</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04375">of Machpelah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">Mamre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">which Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">with the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">of Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">for a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of a buryingplace</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">There they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H08283">and Sarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H07259">and Rebekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there I buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">Leah</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04735">The purchase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">and of the cave</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> therein <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02845">of Heth</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 49:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">And when Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of commanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he gathered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">into the bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and yielded up the ghost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 49." eID="gen78" osisID="Gen.49"/>

verses.name: Genesis 50:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">upon his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and kissed</w> him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the physicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02590" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to embalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the physicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02590" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">embalmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">And forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for him; for so are fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02590" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of those which are embalmed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">for him threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mourned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wept</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 50:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And when the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01068">of his mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If now I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">I pray you, in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 50:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">made me swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">Lo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">I die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06913">in my grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for me in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there shalt thou bury me</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore let me go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, and bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will come again</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">according as he made thee swear</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and with him went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">all the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>,

verses.name: Genesis 50:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02945">only their little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and their flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and their herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">with him both chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">and it was a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">company</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">to the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0329">of Atad</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there they mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">lamentation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">a mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And when the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">the mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in the floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0329">of Atad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">a grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to the Egyptians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">wherefore the name of it</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H067">Abel–mizraim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abel–mizraim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The mourning of the Egyptians</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 50:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto him according as he commanded</w> them:

verses.name: Genesis 50:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">him in the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04375">of Machpelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">which Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">with the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">for a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of a buryingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">of Ephron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04471">Mamre</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">he, and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him to bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he had buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And when Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03863">will peradventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07852" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hate us</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and will certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">requite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">us all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which we did</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they sent a messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">did command</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">he died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>sent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">charged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 50:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">unto Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Forgive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">I pray thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">now, the trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and their sin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto thee evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and now, we pray thee, forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">the trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when they spake</w> unto him.

verses.name: Genesis 50:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before his face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, Behold, we <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Fear</w> not: for <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">I in the place of God</w>?

verses.name: Genesis 50:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But as for you, ye thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> against me; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">meant it</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">unto good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04616">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bring to pass</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-51">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-51">alive</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">ye not: I will nourish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">you, and your little ones</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">kindly</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>kindly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to their hearts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 50:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">he, and his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08029">of the third</w> <transChange type="added">generation</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">also of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">upon Joseph’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">knees</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">born</rdg></note>

verses.name: Genesis 50:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">I die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you, and bring you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">to Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and to Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you, and ye shall carry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">from hence</w>.

verses.name: Genesis 50:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">So Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02590" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they embalmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03455" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and he was put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">in a coffin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 50." eID="gen79" osisID="Gen.50"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen29" osisID="Gen" type="book"/>

verses.name: Exodus 1:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his household</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">with Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08095">Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03878">Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03485">Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05321">and Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0836">and Asher</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And all the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">of the loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">were seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03130">for Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">was in Egypt</w> <transChange type="added">already</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>loins</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thigh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03130">And Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and all his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01755">and all that generation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and increased abundantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">and waxed exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mighty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was filled</w> with them.

verses.name: Exodus 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now there arose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">over Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">not Joseph</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mightier</w> than we:

verses.name: Exodus 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">let us deal wisely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them; lest they multiply</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">any war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">they</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">join</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also unto our enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w> against us, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">get them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore they did set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269 strong:H04522">over them taskmasters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05450">them with their burdens</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">for Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04543">treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06619">Pithom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07486">and Raamses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But the more they afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">them, the more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and grew</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they were grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>But…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And as they afflicted them, so they multiplied</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Exodus 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">And the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-52">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-52">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06531">with rigour</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-53">And they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">their lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-53">bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">with hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">bondage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02563">in morter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03843">and in brick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">and in all manner of service</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05656">all their service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein they made them serve</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06531">with rigour</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">to the Hebrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">midwives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">of which the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08236">Shiphrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06326">Puah</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">When ye do the office of a midwife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">to the Hebrew women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and see</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H070">upon the stools</w>; if it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then ye shall kill</w> him: but if it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">a daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then she shall live</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">But the midwives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not as the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-54">them, but saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the men children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-54">alive</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">for the midwives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04069">unto them, Why</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ye done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-55">and have saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the men children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-55">alive</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And the midwives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">Because the Hebrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04713">not as the Egyptian women</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02422">lively</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and are delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02962">ere</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">the midwives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come in</w> unto them.

verses.name: Exodus 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Therefore God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">dealt well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">with the midwives</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and waxed very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mighty</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And it came to pass, because the midwives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them houses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Every son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03209">that is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">into the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and every daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye shall save alive</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen81" osisID="Exod.1"/>

verses.name: Exodus 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <transChange type="added">to wife</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">a daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she saw</w> him that he <transChange type="added">was a</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">goodly</w> <transChange type="added">child</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">him three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">months</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when she could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">not longer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, she took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">for him an ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01573">of bulrushes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02560" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and daubed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02564">it with slime</w> <w lemma="strong:H02203">and with pitch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein; and she laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05488">in the flags</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">by the river’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">brink</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">And his sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">what would be done</w> to him.

verses.name: Exodus 2:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01323">And the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wash</w> <transChange type="added">herself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">at the river</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05291">and her maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">along by the river’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">side</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08392">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">the flags</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">her maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to fetch</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when she had opened</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">and, behold, the babe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wept</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she had compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on him, and said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">children</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to thee a nurse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that she may nurse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w> for thee?

verses.name: Exodus 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to her, Go</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05959">And the maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-56">unto her, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">this child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-56">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and nurse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it for me, and I will give</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07939">thy wages</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05134" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and nursed</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03206">And the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and she brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">him unto Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and he became her son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04871" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">him out of the water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Moses</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Drawn out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 2:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was grown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05450">on their burdens</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he spied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H04713">an Egyptian</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">smiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">an Hebrew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">one of his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">this way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">and that way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he saw</w> that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">him in the sand</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">behold, two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">together: and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">to him that did the wrong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Wherefore smitest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thou thy fellow</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over us? intendest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, as thou killedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptian</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0403">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is known</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a prince</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man, a prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Now when Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">But Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">by a well</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Now the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">had seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01802" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew</w> <transChange type="added">water</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07298">the troughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to water</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">flock</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>priest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and drove them away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">but Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">their flock</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">to Reuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04069">How</w> <transChange type="added">is it that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">so soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Reuel</catchWord>: called also <rdg type="x-identity">Jethro</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Jether</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H04713">An Egyptian</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the shepherds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01802" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and also drew</w> <transChange type="added">water</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01802" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for us, and watered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto his daughters</w>, And where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he? why <transChange type="added">is</transChange> it <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye have left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, that he may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was content</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with the man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06855">Zipporah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she bare</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">Gershom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">I have been a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">in a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gershom</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A stranger here</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 2:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07227 strong:H01992">And it came to pass in process</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0584" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">by reason of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the bondage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07775">and their cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">by reason of the bondage</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05009">their groaning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">with Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">with Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and with Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had respect</w> unto <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">knew</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen82" osisID="Exod.2"/>

verses.name: Exodus 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Now Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462 strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8804">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03503">of Jethro</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he led</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">to the backside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02722">to Horeb</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03827">unto him in a flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05572">of a bush</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05572">and, behold, the bush</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05572">and the bush</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">not consumed</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will now turn aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04069">why</w> <w lemma="strong:H05572">the bush</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is not burnt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">unto him out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05572">of the bush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I.

verses.name: Exodus 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Draw not nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">hither</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05394" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">thy shoes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">from off thy feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">for the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whereon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou standest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">ground</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I have surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">the affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">their cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their taskmasters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">their sorrows</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I am come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them up out of that land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">unto a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">and a large</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06818">Now therefore, behold, the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me: and I have also seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">wherewith the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">oppress</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now therefore, and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">thee unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">that thou mayest bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, Who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I, that I should go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and that I should bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Certainly I will be with thee; and this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a token</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">unto thee, that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee: When thou hast brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon this mountain</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto them, The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me unto you; and they shall say</w> to me, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall I say</w> unto them?

verses.name: Exodus 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I AM</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">THAT I AM</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I AM hath sent</w> me unto you.

verses.name: Exodus 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">moreover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> me unto you: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02143">my memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-57">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-57">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I have surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">visited</w> you, and <transChange type="added">seen</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that which is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to you in Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">you up out of the affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to thy voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">thou and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath met</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us: and now let us go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">we beseech thee, three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I am sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not let</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">no, not by a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>no…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">but by strong hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">with all my wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thereof: and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he will let you go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">empty</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">But every woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall borrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">of her neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of her that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in her house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08071">and raiment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and upon your daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and ye shall spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Egyptians</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Egypt</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen83" osisID="Exod.3"/>

verses.name: Exodus 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But, behold, they will not believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, nor hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto my voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they will say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath not appeared</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">that in thine hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">A rod</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it on the ground</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it on the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05175">and it became a serpent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">it by the tail</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">it, and it became a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in his hand</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">That they may believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath appeared</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 4:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">furthermore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto him, Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">now thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into thy bosom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into his bosom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it out, behold, his hand</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">leprous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">as snow</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-58">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into thy bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-58">again</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-59">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into his bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-59">again</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and plucked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">it out of his bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and, behold, it was turned again</w> as his <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, neither hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">sign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that they will believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">of the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">sign</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">also these two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">signs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pour</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03004">upon the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou takest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">out of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">shall become blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03006">upon the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall become</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall be and shall be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 4:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">my Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">I</w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not eloquent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08543 strong:H08032">neither heretofore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0227">nor since</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>: but I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of speech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03515">and of a slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eloquent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of words</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>heretofore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">since yesterday, nor since the third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Who hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or who maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0483">the dumb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02795">or deaf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06493">or the seeing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05787">or the blind</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">have not I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: Exodus 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and I will be with thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee what thou shalt say</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">my Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">send</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">I pray thee, by the hand</w> <transChange type="added">of him whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou wilt send</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wilt</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shouldest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">not Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he can speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">well</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And also, behold, he cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee: and when he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, he will be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in his mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">and I will be with thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and with his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you what ye shall do</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall be thy spokesman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>: and he shall be, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">he shall be to thee instead of a mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and thou shalt be to him instead of God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:17
