verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">this rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">signs</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03500">to Jethro</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Let me go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto my brethren</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">whether they be yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03503">And Jethro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">to Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jethro</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Jether</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">in Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">for all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">them upon an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">all those wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but I will harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">that he shall not let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">my firstborn</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thee, Let my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me: and if thou refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to let him go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I will slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">thy firstborn</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01870">And it came to pass by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04411">in the inn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill</w> him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06855">Then Zipporah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06864">a sharp stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">the foreskin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of her son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">at his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">Surely a bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">husband</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> thou to me.<note type="study"><catchWord>sharp…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">knife</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made it touch</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he let him go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">A bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">husband</w> <transChange type="added">thou art</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04139">because of the circumcision</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">to Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and met</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">him in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kissed</w> him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who had sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">him, and all the signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he had commanded</w> him.

verses.name: Exodus 4:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 4:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">the signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 4:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">believed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when they heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and that he had looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">upon their affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they bowed their heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen84" osisID="Exod.4"/>

verses.name: Exodus 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may hold a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">unto me in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I should obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to let Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">neither will I let Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath met</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us: let us go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">we pray thee, three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">upon us with pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">or with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">from their works</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H05450">you unto your burdens</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> now <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and ye make them rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05450">from their burdens</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the taskmasters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and their officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03843">brick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08543 strong:H08032">as heretofore</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">straw</w> for themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04971">And the tale</w> <w lemma="strong:H03843">of the bricks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which they did make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08543 strong:H08032">heretofore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them; ye shall not diminish</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> thereof: for they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">idle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore they cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to our God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05656">Let there more work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">upon the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein; and let them not regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Let there…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let the work be heavy upon the men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 5:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the taskmasters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and their officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">you straw</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, get</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">you straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">where</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye can find</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">it: yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of your work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be diminished</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">were scattered abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8780">to gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">stubble</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">instead of straw</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the taskmasters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">hasted</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">your works</w>, <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">tasks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as when there was</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">straw</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>your daily…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a matter of a day in his day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">which Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">taskmasters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">over them, were beaten</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">demanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Wherefore have ye not fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">your task</w> <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in making brick</w> <w lemma="strong:H08543">both yesterday</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">and to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08543 strong:H08032">as heretofore</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 5:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Then the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore dealest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thou thus with thy servants</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08401">There is no straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to us, Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03843">brick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">and, behold, thy servants</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">beaten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but the fault</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">in thine own people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he said</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">idle</w>, <transChange type="added">ye are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">idle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore ye say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> therefore now, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">work</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08401">for there shall no straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, yet shall ye deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H08506">the tale</w> <w lemma="strong:H03843">of bricks</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did see</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in evil</w> <transChange type="added">case</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after it was said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not minish</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03843">from your bricks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">of your daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">task</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 5:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they met</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">who stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as they came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon you, and judge</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07381">because ye have made our savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> us.<note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to stink</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, wherefore hast thou <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">evil entreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>? why <transChange type="added">is</transChange> it <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast sent</w> me?

verses.name: Exodus 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For since I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath done evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to this people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither hast thou delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">at all</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>neither…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">delivering thou hast not delivered</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen85" osisID="Exod.5"/>

verses.name: Exodus 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now shalt thou see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02389">for with a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he let them go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and with a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName></catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And I appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and unto Jacob</w>, by <transChange type="added">the name of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">but by my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was I not known</w> to them.

verses.name: Exodus 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I have also established</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with them, to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">of their pilgrimage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein they were strangers</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I have also heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05009">the groaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">keep in bondage</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03651">Wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05450">you out from under the burdens</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will rid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">you out of their bondage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">you with a stretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">out arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">you to me for a people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and I will be to you a God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05450">you out from under the burdens</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you in unto the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">concerning the which I did swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">it to Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and to Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04181">it you for an heritage</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>swear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift up my hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 6:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">so unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">not unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07115">for anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07186">and for cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">bondage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>anguish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shortness</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">straitness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">in, speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that he let the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Behold, the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto me; how then shall Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0589">me</w>, who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gave them a charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">and unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02585">Hanoch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06396">and Pallu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03756">and Carmi</w>: these <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03223">Jemuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03226">and Jamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0161">and Ohad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03199">and Jachin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06714">and Zohar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Shaul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of a Canaanitish woman</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H08435">according to their generations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01648">Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06955">and Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04847">and Merari</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08141">and the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03845">Libni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06019">Amram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03324">and Izhar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">and Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05816">and Uzziel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08141">and the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04249">Mahali</w> <w lemma="strong:H04187">and Mushi</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H08435">according to their generations</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06019">And Amram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03115">him Jochebed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01733">his father’s sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">him Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08141">and the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H06019">of Amram</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03324">of Izhar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07141">Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05298">and Nepheg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02147">and Zichri</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05816">of Uzziel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04332">Mishael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0469">and Elzaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05644">and Zithri</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0472">him Elisheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05992">of Amminadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05177">of Naashon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05070">him Nadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0617">Assir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0511">and Elkanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H023">and Abiasaph</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07145">of the Korhites</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0499">And Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> him <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06317">of Putiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">him Phinehas</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01931">These</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">that Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">to whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">according to their armies</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01992">These</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">they which spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 6:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass on the day</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">thou unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that I say</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 6:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">and how shall Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearken</w> unto me? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen86" osisID="Exod.6"/>

verses.name: Exodus 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thee a god</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">shall be thy prophet</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">all that I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">thee: and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of his land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I will harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">my signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and my wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">But Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you, that I may lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">mine armies</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">by great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">And the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, so did</w> they.

verses.name: Exodus 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">When Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">a miracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for you: then thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">thy rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08577">it shall become a serpent</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">so as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">his rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08577">and it became a serpent</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Then Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">the wise men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03784" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and the sorcerers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02748">now the magicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they also did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">in like manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03858">with their enchantments</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For they cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">his rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08577">and they became serpents</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">but Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">swallowed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">their rods</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not unto them; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">hardened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">thee unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lo, he goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">unto the water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and thou shalt stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">by the river’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">brink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against he come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04294">and the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which was turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">to a serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">me in the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03541">and, behold, hitherto</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou wouldest not hear</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">In this thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">behold, I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">with the rod</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">upon the waters</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">in the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">to blood</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01710">And the fish</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">in the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02975">and the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall lothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">thy rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">upon the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">upon their streams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02975">upon their rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H098">and upon their ponds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04723">and upon all their pools</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">that they may become blood</w>; and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">there may be blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, both in <transChange type="added">vessels of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, and in <transChange type="added">vessels of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pools…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gathering of their waters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">so, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">in the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">and all the waters</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">in the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">to blood</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01710">And the fish</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02975">in the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02975">and the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stank</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">and there was blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02748">And the magicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03909">so with their enchantments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06547">and Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hardened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither did he hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither did he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">to this</w> also.

verses.name: Exodus 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">And all the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">for water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">of the river</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were fulfilled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">the river</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen87" osisID="Exod.7"/>

verses.name: Exodus 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may serve</w> me.

verses.name: Exodus 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03986">And if thou refuse</w> to let <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">all thy borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">with frogs</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02975">And the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-60">shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-60">abundantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04904 strong:H02315">and into thy bedchamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04296">and upon thy bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and upon thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08574">and into thine ovens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04863">and into thy kneadingtroughs</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>kneadingtroughs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dough</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06854">And the frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">both on thee, and upon thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and upon all thy servants</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">with thy rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">over the streams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02975">over the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H098">and over the ponds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06854">and cause frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">over the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06854">and the frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02748">And the magicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03909">so with their enchantments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">Then Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he may take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">the frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from me, and from my people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and I will let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may do sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04970">over me: when</w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall I intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thee, and for thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and for thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">the frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from thee and thy houses</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they may remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">in the river</w> only?<note type="study"><catchWord>Glory…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Have this honour over me</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>when</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against when</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Be it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest know</w> that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">none like unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>To morrow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Against to morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06854">And the frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from thee, and from thy houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and from thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and from thy people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">in the river</w> only.

verses.name: Exodus 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">the frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">against Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06854">and the frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">out of the villages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">and out of the fields</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06651" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gathered them together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">upon heaps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stank</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">But when Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07309">that there was respite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not unto them; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">thy rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03654">that it may become lice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">so; for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">with his rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03654">and it became lice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">in man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and in beast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06083">all the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03654">became lice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02748">And the magicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03909">so with their enchantments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03654">lice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03654">not: so there were lice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and upon beast</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02748">Then the magicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0676">the finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06547">and Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hardened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not unto them; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Rise up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lo, he cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">to the water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may serve</w> me.

verses.name: Exodus 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Else, if thou wilt not let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">swarms</w> <transChange type="added">of flies</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">upon thee, and upon thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and upon thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and into thy houses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be full</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">of swarms</w> <transChange type="added">of flies</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and also the ground</w> whereon they <transChange type="added">are</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>swarms…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a mixture of noisome beasts</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Exodus 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06395" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will sever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">in which my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">that no</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">swarms</w> <transChange type="added">of flies</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H04616">there; to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou mayest know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06304">a division</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">between my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and thy people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">shall this sign</w> be.<note type="study"><catchWord>a division</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a redemption</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to morrow</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by to morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 8:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so; and there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">a grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">swarm</w> <transChange type="added">of flies</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, and <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and into all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was corrupted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">of the swarm</w> <transChange type="added">of flies</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>corrupted</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">destroyed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 8:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and for Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">It is not meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so to do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02005">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lo, shall we sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will they not stone</w> us?

verses.name: Exodus 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as he shall command</w> us.

verses.name: Exodus 8:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will let you go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">only ye shall not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">far away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">for me</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from thee, and I will intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">that the swarms</w> <transChange type="added">of flies</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">from his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and from his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07535">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">let not Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">deal deceitfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">any more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">in not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">letting the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">the swarms</w> <transChange type="added">of flies</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">from his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and from his people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">not one</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 8:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">at this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">also, neither would he let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">go</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen88" osisID="Exod.8"/>

verses.name: Exodus 9:1
