verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">in unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may serve</w> me.

verses.name: Exodus 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03986">For if thou refuse</w> to let <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and wilt hold</w> them still,

verses.name: Exodus 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Behold, the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">upon thy cattle</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">upon the horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">upon the asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">upon the camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">upon the oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and upon the sheep</w>: <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">murrain</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06395" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall sever</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">between the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">and the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">and there shall nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w> of all <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">a set time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">that thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and all the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04735">but of the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">not one</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and, behold, there was not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">of the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dead</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03820">And the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hardened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and he did not let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393 strong:H02651">to you handfuls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06368">of ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03536">of the furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">and let Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">it toward the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H080">And it shall become small dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07822">and shall be a boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">breaking forth</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H076">blains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and upon beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06368">ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03536">of the furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">it up toward heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07822">and it became a boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">breaking forth</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H076">blains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and upon beast</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02748">And the magicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">of the boils</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07822">for the boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02748">was upon the magicians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and upon all the Egyptians</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not unto them; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Rise up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may serve</w> me.

verses.name: Exodus 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06471">For I will at this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">all my plagues</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">upon thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and upon thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and upon thy people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest know</w> that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">none like me in all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For now I will stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thee and thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">with pestilence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou shalt be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">And in very</w> <w lemma="strong:H05668">deed</w> for this <transChange type="added">cause</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have I raised thee up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for to shew</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">thee my power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and that my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">may be declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>raised…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made thee stand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8706">As yet exaltest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou thyself against my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that thou wilt not let them go</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04279">Behold, to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">about this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">I will cause it to rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03644">such as hath not been</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">since</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245 strong:H03117" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">the foundation</w> thereof even until now.

verses.name: Exodus 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> therefore now, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05756" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">and all that thou hast in the field</w>; <transChange type="added">for upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which shall be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and shall not be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01259">the hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon them, and they shall die</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03373">He that feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">among the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">made his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">and his cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the houses</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he that regarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">and his cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>regarded…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set not his heart unto</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 9:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01259">that there may be hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and upon beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06212">and upon every herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">his rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">and hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran along</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rained</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01259">So there was hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947 strong:H0784" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">with the hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">grievous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">such as there was none</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">like it in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">since it became a nation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01259">And the hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01259">and the hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">every herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">every tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Only in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">where the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01259">was there no hail</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, I have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">this time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and I and my people</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> (for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">enough</w>) that there be no <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thunderings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">and hail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will let you go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and ye shall stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no longer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">voices of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 9:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, As soon as I am gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will spread abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01259">neither shall there be any more hail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">how that the earth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">But as for thee and thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye will not yet fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06594">And the flax</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">and the barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was smitten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08184">for the barley</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H024">in the ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06594">and the flax</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01392">bolled</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02406">But the wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03698">and the rie</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were not smitten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02007">for they</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0648">not grown up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>not grown…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hidden</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">dark</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 9:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the thunders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">and hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ceased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04306">and the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And when Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">that the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">and the hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the thunders</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were ceased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">he and his servants</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 9:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">And the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hardened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither would he let the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">go</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by Moses</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of Moses</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen89" osisID="Exod.9"/>

verses.name: Exodus 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">in unto Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for I have hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I might shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">these my signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">before</w> him:

verses.name: Exodus 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And that thou mayest tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">what things I have wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">and my signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">among them; that ye may know</w> how that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04970">How long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">wilt thou refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thyself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">me? let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may serve</w> me.

verses.name: Exodus 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588">Else</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03986">if thou refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to let my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">behold, to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">the locusts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">into thy coast</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And they shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that one cannot be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the residue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">of that which is escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">unto you from the hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">every tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which groweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">for you out of the field</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>face</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eye</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thy houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of all thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of all the Egyptians</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">which neither thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">nor thy fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">that they were upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">unto him, How long shall this man be a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto us? let the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02962">thou not yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">that Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is destroyed</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">were brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that shall go</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>who…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">who and who</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Exodus 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">with our young</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and with our old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">with our sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and with our daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">with our flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and with our herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we go</w>; for we <transChange type="added">must hold</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, Let the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">be so with you, as I will let you go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and your little ones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">look</w> <transChange type="added">to it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">for evil</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> you.

verses.name: Exodus 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Not so: go</w> now ye <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">for that ye did desire</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they were driven out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">presence</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">for the locusts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">every herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01259">all that the hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath left</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">his rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">an east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all that day</w>, and all <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01242">when it was morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">the locusts</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0697">And the locusts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">grievous</w> <transChange type="added">were they</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">them there were no such</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">locusts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">as they, neither after</w> them shall be such.

verses.name: Exodus 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For they covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">so that the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was darkened</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">every herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and all the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">which the hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had left</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03418">not any green thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">in the trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06212">or in the herbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">through all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">Then Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">in haste</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, and against you.<note type="study"><catchWord>called</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hastened to call</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore forgive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">I pray thee, my sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">only this once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he may take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from me this death</w> only.

verses.name: Exodus 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">west</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">the locusts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">them into the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fastened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">so that he would not let the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">that there may be darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">even darkness</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may be felt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>even…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that one may feel darkness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0653">and there was a thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither rose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">from his place for three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">but all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">had light</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">in their dwellings</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06629">only let your flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and your herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be stayed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02945">let your little ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also go</w> with you.

verses.name: Exodus 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou must give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">also sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">and burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we may sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>us</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">into our hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04735">Our cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">with us; there shall not an hoof</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be left behind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thereof must we take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not with what we must serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until we come</w> thither.

verses.name: Exodus 10:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not let them go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">thee from me, take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to thyself, see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w>; for in <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt die</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> no more. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen90" osisID="Exod.10"/>

verses.name: Exodus 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Yet will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">plague</w> <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">upon Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and upon Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will let you go</w> hence: when he shall let <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thrust you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">hence altogether</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">now in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and let every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">borrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and every woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07468">of her neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">Moreover the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02676 strong:H03915">About midnight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will I go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">And all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">from the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">even unto the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">of the maidservant</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07347">the mill</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01060">and all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of beasts</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And there shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">such as there was none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">like it, nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be like it any more</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But against any of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">shall not a dog</w> <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">move</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">his tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">against man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">or beast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">how that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06395" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">doth put a difference</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">between the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And all these thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">unto me, and bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get thee out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">that follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thee: and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I will go out</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">from Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02750">in a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that follow…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that is at thy feet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heat of anger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">unto you; that my wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may be multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">all these wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">so that he would not let the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen91" osisID="Exod.11"/>

verses.name: Exodus 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02320">This month</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">unto you the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of months</w>: it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w> to you.

verses.name: Exodus 12:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">ye unto all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">In the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of this month</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to them every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">a lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for an house</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And if the household</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">too little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">for the lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07934">let him and his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">next</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04373">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of the souls</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">to his eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H03699" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall make your count</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">for the lamb</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07716">Your lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">shall be without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03532">out from the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">or from the goats</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">son of a year</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04931">And ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">it up until the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the same month</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03605">and the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">it in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">the evening</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">between the two evenings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and strike</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">side posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04947">and on the upper door post</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein they shall eat</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06748">roast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04682">and unleavened bread</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04844">with bitter</w> <transChange type="added">herbs</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall eat</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04995">not of it raw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01311 strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">nor sodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">at all with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06748">but roast</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03767">with his legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">and with the purtenance</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And ye shall let nothing of it remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that which remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of it until the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03602">And thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye eat</w> it; <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">your loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">girded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05275">your shoes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on your feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04731">and your staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in your hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02649">it in haste</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">passover</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">this night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and against all the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgment</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gods</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">princes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818">And the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">shall be to you for a token</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the houses</w> where ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06452" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05063">over you, and the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">shall not be upon you to destroy</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to destroy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a destruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">shall be unto you for a memorial</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">it a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall keep it a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">by an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0389">even</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07603">leaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of your houses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for whosoever eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">leavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">from the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">until the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">off from Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">And in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">and in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">there shall be an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">to you; no manner of work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">in them, save</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">which every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">must eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that only may be done</w> of you.<note type="study"><catchWord>man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall observe</w> <transChange type="added">the feast of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06106">for in this selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">your armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore shall ye observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in your generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">by an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07223">In the first</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0702 strong:H06240">on the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">until the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07603">shall there be no leaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in your houses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for whosoever eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that which is leavened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">even that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">from the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">whether he be a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0249">or born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">nothing leavened</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04186">in all your habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">Then Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">for all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">you a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to your families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H092">a bunch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0231">of hyssop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dip</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05592">in the bason</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and strike</w> <w lemma="strong:H04947">the lintel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">side posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05592">in the bason</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of you shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04947">upon the lintel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">side posts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06452" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the destroyer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in unto your houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to smite</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">for an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to thee and to thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall come to pass, when ye be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">you, according as he hath promised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">this service</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And it shall come to pass, when your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">unto you, What mean ye by this service</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 12:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">That ye shall say</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06452" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">our houses</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bowed the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> they.

verses.name: Exodus 12:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H02677">And it came to pass, that at midnight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">from the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">unto the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of the captive</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0953 strong:H01004">in the dungeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01060">and all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of cattle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dungeon</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of the pit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">he, and all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and all the Egyptians</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01419">and there was a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>; for <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">not a house</w> where <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">not one dead</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rise up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get you forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">both ye and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">as ye have said</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Also take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">your flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and your herds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as ye have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be gone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and bless</w> me also.

verses.name: Exodus 12:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">And the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were urgent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that they might send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in haste</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, We <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">all dead</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01217">their dough</w> <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before it was leavened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04863">their kneadingtroughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">being bound up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">in their clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">upon their shoulders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kneadingtroughs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dough</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they borrowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08071">and raiment</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 12:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so that they lent</w> unto them <transChange type="added">such things as they required</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07486">from Rameses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">to Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">about six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">on foot</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">children</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06154">And a mixed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">also with them; and flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and herds</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a mixed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a great mixture</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they baked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05692">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01217">of the dough</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which they brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it was not leavened</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">because they were thrust out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and could</w> <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8699">not tarry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither had they prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">for themselves any victual</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:40
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04186">Now the sojourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">of the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">even the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">it came to pass, that all the hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 12:42
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">a night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08107">to be much observed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them out from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08107">to be observed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in their generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a night…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a night of observations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:43
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">the ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">of the passover</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">There shall no stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> thereof:

verses.name: Exodus 12:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">that is bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when thou hast circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, then shall he eat</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 12:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08453">A foreigner</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">and an hired servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not eat</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 12:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">In one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall it be eaten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt not carry forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">ought of the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye break</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">a bone</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 12:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">All the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall keep</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>keep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 12:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01616">And when a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, and will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">let all his males</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">be circumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and then let him come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0249">it; and he shall be as one that is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06189">for no uncircumcised person</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 12:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0249">shall be to him that is homeborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and unto the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> you.

verses.name: Exodus 12:50
