verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> they.

verses.name: Exodus 12:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">And it came to pass the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">by their armies</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen92" osisID="Exod.12"/>

verses.name: Exodus 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">unto me all the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06363">whatsoever openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of beast</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine.

verses.name: Exodus 13:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in which ye came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02392">for by strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought you out</w> from this <transChange type="added">place</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02557">there shall no leavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be eaten</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bondage</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">servants</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came ye out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H024">Abib</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And it shall be when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee, a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">this service</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">in this month</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">and in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04682">Unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02557">and there shall no leavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07603">with thee, neither shall there be leaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">with thee in all thy quarters</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">This is done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05668">because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">that</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me when I came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">And it shall be for a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto thee upon thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02146">and for a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">between thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">may be in thy mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02389">for with a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt therefore keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">this ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in his season</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to year</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And it shall be when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">as he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thee and to thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall give</w> it thee,

verses.name: Exodus 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">That thou shalt set apart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06363">all that openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">the matrix</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06363">and every firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07698">that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of a beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">which thou hast; the males</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to pass over</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06363">And every firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of an ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">with a lamb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and if thou wilt not redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, then thou shalt break his neck</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01060">and all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou redeem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 13:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And it shall be when thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">thee in time to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this? that thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02392">unto him, By strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">And it came to pass, when Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">would hardly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">let us go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">both the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">and the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of beast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore I sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06363">all that openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">the matrix</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">being males</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01060">but all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of my children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I redeem</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">And it shall be for a token</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02903">and for frontlets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">between thine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02392">for by strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought us forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">And it came to pass, when Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">had let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">led</w> them not <transChange type="added">through</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">although</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Lest peradventure the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-61">led</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-61">about</w>, <transChange type="added">through</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02571">harnessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>harnessed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by five in a rank</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with him: for he had straitly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-62">you; and ye shall carry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-62">away</w> hence with you.

verses.name: Exodus 13:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took their journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">from Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0864">in Etham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">them by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">in a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of a cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03915">and by night</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">in a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give them light</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He took not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">nor the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen93" osisID="Exod.13"/>

verses.name: Exodus 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06367">Pi–hahiroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04024">between Migdol</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">and the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01189">Baal–zephon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05226">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall ye encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">For Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0943" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">entangled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath shut them in</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he shall follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them; and I will be honoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">upon Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and upon all his host</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04714">that the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they did</w> so.

verses.name: Exodus 14:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03824">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">and of his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why have we done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">this, that we have let Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from serving</w> us?

verses.name: Exodus 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">his chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> with him:

verses.name: Exodus 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and all the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07991">and captains</w> over every one of them.

verses.name: Exodus 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with an high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">But the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">them, all the horses</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and his horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and his army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them encamping</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06367">beside Pi–hahiroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01189">Baal–zephon</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">And when Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drew nigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and, behold, the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">marched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">them; and they were sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, Because <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06913">no graves</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou taken us away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02063">wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thus with us, to carry us forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 14:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not this the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that we did tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">thee in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Let us alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w>? For <transChange type="added">it had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for us to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than that we should die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">ye not, stand still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to you to day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04714">for the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">no more for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for whereas ye have seen the Egyptians to day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for you, and ye shall hold your peace</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore criest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">thou unto me? speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they go forward</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">But lift thou up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">thy rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">over the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it: and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">on dry</w> <transChange type="added">ground</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">through the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And I, behold, I will harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I will get me honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">upon Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and upon all his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">upon his chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and upon his horsemen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">And the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when I have gotten me honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">upon Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">upon his chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and upon his horsemen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">them; and the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before their face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> them:

verses.name: Exodus 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">between the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">and the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06051">and it was a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">and darkness</w> <transChange type="added">to them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but it gave light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w> <transChange type="added">to these</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that the one came not near</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all the night</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">over the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">caused the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to go</w> <transChange type="added">back</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05794">by a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02724">dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were divided</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">upon the dry</w> <transChange type="added">ground</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">unto them on their right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08040">and on their left</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04714">And the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them to the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">all Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">his chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and his horsemen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass, that in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0821">watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">through the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">and of the cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 14:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And took off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">their chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that they drave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03517">them heavily</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04714">so that the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">for them against the Egyptians</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that they…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and made them to go heavily</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 14:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">over the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">upon their chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and upon their horsemen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">over the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">to his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">when the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">appeared</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it; and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overthrew</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shook off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 14:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and the horsemen</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">them; there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">not so much as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> of them.

verses.name: Exodus 14:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">upon dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">unto them on their right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08040">and on their left</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Thus the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">upon the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">shore</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 14:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">that great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon the Egyptians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>work</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen94" osisID="Exod.14"/>

verses.name: Exodus 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then sang</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath triumphed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01342" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">gloriously</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his rider</w> <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he thrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03050">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H02176">and song</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03444">and he is become my salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02088">he</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05115" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will prepare him an habitation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and I will exalt</w> him.

verses.name: Exodus 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">and his host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04005">his chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">also are drowned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">in the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08415">The depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: they sank</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">into the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03225">Thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0142" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is become glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath dashed in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">And in the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of thine excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">them that rose up against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee: thou sentest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">thy wrath</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">them as stubble</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And with the blast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thy nostrils</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06192" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">stood upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H05067">as an heap</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08415">the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were congealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will pursue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will overtake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">my lust</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon them; I will draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">my sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall destroy</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">repossess</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou didst blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">with thy wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06749" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: they sank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05777">as lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">in the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:11
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">like unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">among the gods</w>? who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0142" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">like thee, glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in holiness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fearful</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">praises</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">wonders</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>gods</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mighty ones?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou stretchedst out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">swallowed</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Thou in thy mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast led forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H02098">which</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast redeemed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast guided</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">in thy strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">unto thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">habitation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall hear</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02427">sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06429">of Palestina</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0227">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be amazed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0352">the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07461">trembling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon them; all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall melt away</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0367">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">and dread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">upon them; by the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">of thine arm</w> they shall be <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">still</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">as a stone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">till thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">till the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass over</w>, <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H02098">which</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast purchased</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them in, and plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">them in the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of thine inheritance</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04349">the place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thee to dwell in</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the Sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thy hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">have established</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">For the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">with his chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and with his horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon them; but the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">on dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04813">And Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05031">the prophetess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">a timbrel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in her hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and all the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">her with timbrels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04246">and with dances</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04813">And Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">them, Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath triumphed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01342" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">gloriously</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his rider</w> <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he thrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">into the sea</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">So Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">from the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07793">of Shur</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 15:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04785">to Marah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04785">of Marah</w>, for they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">therefore the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04785">Marah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Marah</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Bitterness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall we drink</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">him a tree</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when he had cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">into the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04985" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were made sweet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">for them a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and an ordinance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and there he proved</w> them,

verses.name: Exodus 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If thou wilt diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wilt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">that which is right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and wilt give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">to his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">all his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04245">none of these diseases</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, which I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon the Egyptians</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that healeth</w> thee.

verses.name: Exodus 15:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0362">to Elim</w>, where <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">and threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08558">palm trees</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">there by the waters</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen95" osisID="Exod.15"/>

verses.name: Exodus 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took their journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0362">from Elim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">unto the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05512">of Sin</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0362">between Elim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">and Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">on the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after their departing out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414 strong:H04310" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Would to God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">we had died</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when we sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">by the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">pots</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when we did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07648">to the full</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for ye have brought us forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into this wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">this whole assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">with hunger</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for you; and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a certain rate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">every day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I may prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, whether they will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in my law</w>, or no.<note type="study"><catchWord>a certain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the portion of a day in his day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08345">And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they shall prepare</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they bring in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04932">and it shall be twice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as much as they gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">daily</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">At even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath brought you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">And in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for that he heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08519">your murmurings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: and what <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05168">we</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885 strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">that ye murmur</w> against us?

verses.name: Exodus 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">This shall be</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">you in the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the full</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08519">your murmurings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which ye murmur</w> against him: and what <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05168">we</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08519">your murmurings</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not against us, but against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08519">your murmurings</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And it came to pass, as Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">toward the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and, behold, the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">in the cloud</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08519">the murmurings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153 strong:H0996">At even</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">And it came to pass, that at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H07958">the quails</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01242">and in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07902">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02919">And when the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07902">that lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was gone up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">behold, upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <transChange type="added">there lay</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01851">a small</w> <w lemma="strong:H02636" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">round thing</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01851">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H03713">as the hoar frost</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the ground</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04478">manna</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they wist</w> not what it <transChange type="added">was</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto them, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">you to eat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>It is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">What is this?</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">It is a portion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 16:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of it every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">to his eating</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06016">an omer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">for every man</w>, <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of your persons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every man</w> for <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in his tents</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the poll</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">head</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>persons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so, and gathered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">some more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">some less</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they did mete</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06016">with an omer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that gathered much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had nothing over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and he that gathered little</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had no lack</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">to his eating</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Let no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of it till the morning</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Notwithstanding they hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">not unto Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">but some</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of them left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of it until the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it bred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08438">worms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stank</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w> with them.

verses.name: Exodus 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">it every morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">to his eating</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08121">and when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waxed hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it melted</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08345">on the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">twice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">as much bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">omers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and all the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto them, This <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07677">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bake</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye will bake</w> <transChange type="added">to day</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that ye will seethe</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03605">and that which</w> <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">remaineth over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">lay up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">for you to be kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they laid it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">till the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">bade</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and it did not stink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07415">neither was there any worm</w> therein.

verses.name: Exodus 16:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that to day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">for to day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">a sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not find</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">it in the field</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">it; but on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w>, in it there shall be none.

verses.name: Exodus 16:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there went out</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for to gather</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they found</w> none.

verses.name: Exodus 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">How long refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">and my laws</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 16:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">for that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">you the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">therefore he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">you on the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of two days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">in his place, let no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">thereof Manna</w>: and it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01407">like coriander</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02940">and the taste</w> of it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06838">like wafers</w> <transChange type="added">made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01706">with honey</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commandeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">Fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">an omer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">of it to be kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">for your generations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">wherewith I have fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">you in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I brought you forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H06803">pot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">an omer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">of manna</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">therein, and lay it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">to be kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">for your generations</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">As the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">so Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">laid it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the Testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">to be kept</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">manna</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">inhabited</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">manna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 16:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06016">Now an omer</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06224">the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen96" osisID="Exod.16"/>

verses.name: Exodus 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">from the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05512">of Sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04550">after their journeys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07508">in Rephidim</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:2
