verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Wherefore the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did chide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">with Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">us water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may drink</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Why chide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: Exodus 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thirsted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">there for water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Wherefore <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">us up out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">us and our children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">and our cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">with thirst</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto this people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04592">they be almost</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ready to stone</w> me.

verses.name: Exodus 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">with thee of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04294">and thy rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">wherewith thou smotest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">thee there upon the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">in Horeb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shalt smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">out of it, that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may drink</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">so in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04532">Massah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04809">and Meribah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07379">because of the chiding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and because they tempted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">Is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> us, or not?<note type="study"><catchWord>Massah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Temptation</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Meribah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Chiding</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Strife</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 17:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07508">in Rephidim</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Choose us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">with Amalek</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">I will stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">of the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">with the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Joshua</catchWord>: called <rdg type="x-identity">Jesus</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to him, and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">with Amalek</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02354">and Hur</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">of the hill</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And it came to pass, when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">held up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">that Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when he let down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06002">Amalek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">But Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">heavy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">under him, and he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">thereon; and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">and Hur</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stayed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one on the one side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other on the other side</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">were steady</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H02522" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">discomfited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">Amalek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Write</w> this <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02146">a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rehearse</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for I will utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">the remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of Amalek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from under heaven</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03071">of it JEHOVAH–nissi</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>JEHOVAH–nissi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The <divineName>Lord</divineName> my banner</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03050">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03676 strong:H03027">hath sworn</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">will have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">with Amalek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">from generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to generation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Because the hand of Amalek is against the throne of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, therefore</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName> hath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the hand upon the throne of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen97" osisID="Exod.17"/>

verses.name: Exodus 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03503">When Jethro</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of all that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and for Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03503">Then Jethro</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06855">Zipporah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07964">he had sent her back</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And her two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">of which the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01647">Gershom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">I have been an alien</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">in a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Gershom</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">A stranger there</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the other</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0461">Eliezer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">for the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w>, <transChange type="added">said he</transChange>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05828">mine help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">me from the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Eliezer</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">My God is an help</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03503">And Jethro</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">where he encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">at the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I thy father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03503">Jethro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto thee, and thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and her two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> with her.

verses.name: Exodus 18:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and did obeisance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and they asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">each</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">other</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">welfare</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>welfare</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">and to the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">sake</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08513">all the travail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that had come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">upon them by the way</w>, and <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">delivered</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03503">And Jethro</w> <w lemma="strong:H02302" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for all the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03503">And Jethro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">than all gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">for in the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein they dealt proudly</w> <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> above them.

verses.name: Exodus 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03503">And Jethro</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">and sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">with Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">by Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">from the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">unto the evening</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And when Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou doest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">why sittest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou thyself alone, and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">by thee from morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">unto even</w>?

verses.name: Exodus 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto his father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Because the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">When they have a matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me; and I judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">between one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">and another</w>, and I do make <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and his laws</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man and his fellow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto him, The thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou doest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou wilt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wear away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">both thou, and this people</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with thee: for this thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">too heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thee; thou art not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to perform</w> it thyself alone.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thou wilt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Fading thou wilt fade</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">now unto my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give thee counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with thee: Be thou for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430 strong:H04136">to God-ward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that thou mayest bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the causes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">them ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">and laws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shalt shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein they must walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they must do</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover thou shalt provide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">out of all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03373">such as fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hating</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">covetousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and place</w> <transChange type="added">such</transChange> over them, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifties</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of tens</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And let them judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at all seasons</w>: and it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">every great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">unto thee, but every small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall judge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">so shall it be easier</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thyself, and they shall bear</w> <transChange type="added">the burden</transChange> with thee.

verses.name: Exodus 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">command</w> thee <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou shalt be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to endure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall also go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to their place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">So Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of his father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all that he had said</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">them heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifties</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of tens</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at all seasons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07186">the hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">causes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">but every small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992 strong:H01697">matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they judged</w> themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 18:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let his father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">depart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his way into his own land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen98" osisID="Exod.18"/>

verses.name: Exodus 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">In the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> they <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they were departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07508">from Rephidim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and were come</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and there Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">camped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">before the mount</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto him out of the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what I did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">unto the Egyptians</w>, and <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">you on eagles’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> you unto myself.

verses.name: Exodus 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore, if ye will obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">indeed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05459">then ye shall be a peculiar treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto me above all people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for all the earth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine:

verses.name: Exodus 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04467">And ye shall be unto me a kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">and an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">for the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> him.

verses.name: Exodus 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">All that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will do</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Lo, I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">unto thee in a thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with thee, and believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee for ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">and to morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and let them wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">their clothes</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And be ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">against the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07992">for the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01379" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt set bounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> to yourselves, <transChange type="added">that ye</transChange> go <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">or touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of it: whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">put to death</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">There shall not an hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it, but he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be stoned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">through</w>; whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03104">when the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">soundeth long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mount</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trumpet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cornet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 19:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">their clothes</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">against the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> not at <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07992">And it came to pass on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">that there were thunders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">and lightnings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03515">and a thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">loud</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">so that all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trembled</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">out of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">at the nether</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">part of the mount</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">And mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06225" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was altogether on a smoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834 strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">upon it in fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06227">and the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof ascended</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">as the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03536">of a furnace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the whole mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">quaked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">And when the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">sounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02390">and waxed louder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and louder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">him by a voice</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <transChange type="added">up</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0413">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest they break through</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to gaze</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them perish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>charge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">contest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And let the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">also, which come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">themselves, lest the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">break forth</w> upon them.

verses.name: Exodus 19:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou chargedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01379" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Set bounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">about the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sanctify</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get thee down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">thou, and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">with thee: but let not the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">break through</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he break forth</w> upon them.

verses.name: Exodus 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">So Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> unto them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen99" osisID="Exod.19"/>

verses.name: Exodus 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 20:2
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bondage</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">servants</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0312">Thou shalt have no other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before me</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">unto thee any graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08544">or any likeness</w> <transChange type="added">of any thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0834">that</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>, or that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> beneath, or that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">under the earth</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Thou shalt not bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">thyself to them, nor serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them: for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07067">a jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">visiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08029">unto the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H07256">and fourth</w> <transChange type="added">generation</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that hate</w> me;

verses.name: Exodus 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And shewing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">unto thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me, and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will not hold him guiltless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to keep it holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all thy work</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">But the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <transChange type="added">in it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">any work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, nor thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor thy daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">nor thy maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">nor thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">nor thy stranger</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 20:11
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, and all that in them <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hallowed</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 20:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and thy mother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">that thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may be long</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee.

verses.name: Exodus 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not kill</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not commit adultery</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not steal</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against thy neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not covet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not covet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">nor his manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">nor his maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">nor his ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">nor his ass</w>, nor any thing that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the thunderings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03940">and the lightnings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06226">smoking</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou with us, and we will hear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">but let not God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us, lest we die</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not: for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05668">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">you, and that his fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">may be before your faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye sin</w> not.

verses.name: Exodus 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">unto the thick darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">where God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">with you from heaven</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with me gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto you gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 20:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04196">An altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, and shalt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thereon thy burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">and thy peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">thy sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and thine oxen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04725">in all places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">where I record</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto thee, and I will bless</w> thee.

verses.name: Exodus 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if thou wilt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">me an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">it of hewn stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for if thou lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thy tool</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon it, thou hast polluted</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>build…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">build them with hewing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">by steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto mine altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06172">that thy nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not discovered</w> thereon. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen100" osisID="Exod.20"/>

verses.name: Exodus 21:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">an Hebrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall serve</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">and in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">for nothing</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01610">by himself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01610">by himself</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802 strong:H01167">if he were married</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">then his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go out</w> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>by himself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with his body</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">If his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">him a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and she have born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">or daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and her children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">shall be her master’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01610">by himself</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And if the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall plainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">my wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and my children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saying shall say</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Then his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">him unto the judges</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he shall also bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">him to the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04201">or unto the door post</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0113">and his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07527" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">his ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04836">through with an aul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">him for ever</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">to be a maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she shall not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">as the menservants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">do</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07451">If she please</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">not her master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath betrothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">her unto a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall have no power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">seeing he hath dealt deceitfully</w> with her.<note type="study"><catchWord>please…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be evil in the eyes of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Exodus 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if he have betrothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her unto his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">with her after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of daughters</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">him another</w> <transChange type="added">wife</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07607">her food</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03682">her raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05772">and her duty of marriage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he not diminish</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if he do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">not these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, then shall she go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">without money</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that he die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">put to death</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And if a man lie not in wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">but God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0579" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">deliver</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">thee a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whither he shall flee</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">come presumptuously</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">upon his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06195">him with guile</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">him from mine altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may die</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And he that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">put to death</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that stealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and selleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him, or if he be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And he that curseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>curseth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">revileth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 21:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And if men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">together, and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">with a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0106">fist</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, but keepeth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04904">bed</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>another</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his neighbour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he rise again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">upon his staff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">then shall he that smote</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be quit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">only he shall pay</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07674">the loss of his time</w>, and shall cause <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to be thoroughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">healed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the loss…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his ceasing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 21:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">or his maid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">with a rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">punished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>punished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">avenged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0389">Notwithstanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if he continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">he shall not be punished</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">his money</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">If men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">strive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02030">with child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">so that her fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">depart</w> <transChange type="added">from her</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0611">and yet no mischief follow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">punished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">according as the woman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him; and he shall pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06414">as the judges</w> <transChange type="added">determine</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:23
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0611">mischief follow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for life</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">for eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">tooth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">for tooth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">for foot</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03555">Burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03555">for burning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06482">wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06482">for wound</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02250">stripe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02250">for stripe</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">or the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of his maid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that it perish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eye’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Exodus 21:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And if he smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">out his manservant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">tooth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">or his maidservant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">tooth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">for his tooth’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Exodus 21:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07794">If an ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or a woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07794">then the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">stoned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be eaten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01167">but the owner</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of the ox</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">quit</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">But if the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05056">were wont to push with his horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H08543">in time past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and it hath been testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to his owner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him in, but that he hath killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or a woman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07794">the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be stoned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">and his owner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">also shall be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">If there be laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">on him a sum of money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06306">for the ransom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">whatsoever is laid</w> upon him.

verses.name: Exodus 21:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whether he have gored</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have gored</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">a daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to this judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall it be done</w> unto him.

verses.name: Exodus 21:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">If the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall push</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">a manservant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">or a maidservant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto their master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">and the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be stoned</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall open</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">a pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">or if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">a pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and not cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">it, and an ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">or an ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fall</w> therein;

verses.name: Exodus 21:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01167">The owner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the pit</w> shall make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">good</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">unto the owner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of them; and the dead</w> <transChange type="added">beast</transChange> shall be his.

verses.name: Exodus 21:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if one man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then they shall sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the live</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of it; and the dead</w> <transChange type="added">ox</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also they shall divide</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 21:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Or if it be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">that the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05056">hath used to push</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H08543">in time past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">and his owner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him in; he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">for ox</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the dead</w> shall be his own. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen101" osisID="Exod.21"/>

verses.name: Exodus 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall steal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">an ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">or a sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, or sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it; he shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">for an ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">for a sheep</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>or a sheep</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">or a goat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 22:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01590">If a thief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04290">breaking up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and be smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he die</w>, <transChange type="added">there shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">no blood</w> <transChange type="added">be shed</transChange> for him.

verses.name: Exodus 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">If the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be risen</w> upon him, <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <transChange type="added">shed</transChange> for him; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">he should make full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">restitution</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">if he have nothing, then he shall be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01591">for his theft</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01591">If the theft</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">be certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">whether it be ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">or ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">or sheep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">double</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:5
