verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">shall cause a field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">or vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01165">in his beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">in another man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04315">of the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of his own field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04315">and of the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of his own vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he make restitution</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0784">If fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">break out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06975">in thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01430">so that the stacks of corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07054">or the standing corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">or the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be consumed</w> <transChange type="added">therewith</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he that kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01200">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">make restitution</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">or stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and it be stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">out of the man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01590">if the thief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let him pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">double</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01590">If the thief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">be not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">then the master</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the judges</w>, <transChange type="added">to see</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whether he have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">goods</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">For all manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">of trespass</w>, <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07794">for ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">for ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">for sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08008">for raiment</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H09">for any manner of lost thing</w>, which <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">challengeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to be his, the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of both parties</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">before the judges</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">whom the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall condemn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">double</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">or an ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">or a sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">or any beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">or be hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">or driven away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no man seeing</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>:

verses.name: Exodus 22:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07621">shall an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">be between them both</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath not put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">goods</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01167">and the owner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it shall accept</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, and he shall not make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">good</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01589 strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8800">And if it be stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">from him, he shall make restitution</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">unto the owner</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02963 strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8800">If it be torn in pieces</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let him bring</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall not make good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02966">that which was torn</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">borrow</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it be hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">the owner</w> thereof <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05973">not with it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">he shall surely</w> make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">good</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01167">if the owner</w> thereof <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with it, he shall not make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">good</w>: if it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07916">an hired</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">for his hire</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">entice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a maid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that is not betrothed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H04117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with her, he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">endow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">her to be his wife</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">If her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her unto him, he shall pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04119">according to the dowry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">of virgins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weigh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 22:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03784" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Thou shalt not suffer a witch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to live</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whosoever lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">with a beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that sacrificeth</w> unto <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">only, he shall be utterly destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt neither vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">him: for ye were strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Ye shall not afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">any widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">or fatherless child</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">If</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them in any wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">their cry</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">And my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall wax hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">you with the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and your wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">shall be widows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">fatherless</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If thou lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> to <transChange type="added">any of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shalt thou lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">upon him usury</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-63">If thou at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-63">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to pledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">it unto him by</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">that the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">goeth down</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 22:27
verses.text: For that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03682">his covering</w> only, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08071">his raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">for his skin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein shall he sleep</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall come to pass, when he crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, that I will hear</w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">gracious</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 22:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not revile</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gods</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">judges</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 22:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not delay</w> <transChange type="added">to offer</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04395">the first of thy ripe fruits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01831">and of thy liquors</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou give</w> unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>the first…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy fulness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>liquors</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03651">Likewise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">with thine oxen</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with thy sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">it shall be with his dam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08066">on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt give</w> it me.

verses.name: Exodus 22:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06944">And ye shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me: neither shall ye eat</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02966">torn of beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">it to the dogs</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen102" osisID="Exod.22"/>

verses.name: Exodus 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not raise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">report</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">with the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">to be an unrighteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>raise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">receive</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">Thou shalt not follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a multitude</w> to <transChange type="added">do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shalt thou speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">in a cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to decline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to wrest</w> <transChange type="added">judgment</transChange>:<note type="study"><catchWord>speak</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">answer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01921" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">a poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">man in his cause</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemy’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">or his ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going astray</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-64">thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-64">bring it back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to him again</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">under his burden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wouldest forbear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">help</w> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wilt thou cease to help him?</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">and wouldest cease to leave thy business for him: thou shalt surely leave it to join with him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not wrest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of thy poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">in his cause</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Keep thee far</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">from a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05355">and the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">and righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou not: for I will not justify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">no gift</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07810">for the gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H05786" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blindeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06493">the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05557" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and perverteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the wise</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the seeing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also thou shalt not oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">a stranger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">of a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">ye were strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heart</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">And six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">in the fruits</w> thereof:

verses.name: Exodus 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">But the seventh</w> <transChange type="added">year</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt let it rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">still; that the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03499">and what they leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">In like manner thou shalt deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">with thy vineyard</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02132">with thy oliveyard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oliveyard</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">olive trees</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thy work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">and on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt rest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07794">that thine ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">and thine ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of thy handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05314" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be refreshed</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:13
verses.text: And in all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto you be circumspect</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and make no mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">of other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither let it be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt keep a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">unto me in the year</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">thee, in the time appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H024">Abib</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for in it thou camest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and none shall appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">me empty</w>:)

verses.name: Exodus 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02282">And the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01061">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of thy labours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou hast sown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02282">and the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0614">of ingathering</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou hast gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in thy labours</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the field</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02138">all thy males</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of my sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">with leavened bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02459">neither shall the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">of my sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sacrifice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">feast</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">The first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">in his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">milk</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an Angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">thee into the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I have prepared</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Beware</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him, and obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">provoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him not; for he will not pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">your transgressions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in him</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But if thou shalt indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">all that I speak</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0340" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will be an enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and an adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thine adversaries</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an adversary…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I will afflict them that afflict thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">For mine Angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">thee in unto the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut them off</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Thou shalt not bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">nor serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, nor do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">after their works</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">but thou shalt utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, and quite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">their images</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">thy bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and thy water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-65">and I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04245">sickness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-65">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from the midst</w> of thee.

verses.name: Exodus 23:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">There shall nothing cast their young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06135">nor be barren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will fulfil</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0367">my fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to whom thou shalt come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">turn their backs</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>backs</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">neck</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06880">hornets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, which shall drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> thee.

verses.name: Exodus 23:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will not drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">thee in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">lest the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">become desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">multiply</w> against thee.

verses.name: Exodus 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">By little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">and little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, until thou be increased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thy bounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">from the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">even unto the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">and from the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">unto the river</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into your hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: Exodus 23:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">no covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with them, nor with their gods</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 23:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lest they make thee sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me: for if thou serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04170">it will surely be a snare</w> unto thee. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen103" osisID="Exod.23"/>

verses.name: Exodus 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">thou, and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05070">Nadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">and seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">ye afar off</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">alone shall come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they shall not come nigh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">neither shall the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go up</w> with him.

verses.name: Exodus 24:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and all the judgments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">All the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we do</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">under the hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04676">and twelve pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">according to the twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0101">in basons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the audience</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">All that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be obedient</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sprinkled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">on the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">Behold the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with you concerning all these words</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05070">Nadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">and seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03840">as it were a paved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05601">of a sapphire stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and as it were the body</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02892">clearness</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0678">And upon the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to me into the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be there: and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">thee tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and a law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have written</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that thou mayest teach</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and his minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">ye here</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for us, until we come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto you: and, behold, Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">and Hur</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04310">with you: if any</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167" type="x-split-66">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">have any matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167" type="x-split-66">to do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him come</w> unto them.

verses.name: Exodus 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">and a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">and the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">it six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">and the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04758">And the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like devouring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gat him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mount</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">was in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen104" osisID="Exod.24"/>

verses.name: Exodus 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">me an offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that giveth it willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">my offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">take for me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>offering</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heave offering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 25:3
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of them; gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>offering</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heave offering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08504">And blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08144 strong:H08438">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">and goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange>,<note type="study"><catchWord>fine…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">silk</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0352">And rams’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">dyed red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08476">and badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07848">and shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08081">Oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">for the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">spices</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">for anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05561">and for sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07718">Onyx</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">and stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">to be set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">in the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02833">and in the breastplate</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And let them make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">me a sanctuary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">According to all that I shew</w> thee, <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08403">the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08403">and the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of all the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, even so shall ye make</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">an ark</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0520">two cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">and without</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">upon it a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it, and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thereof; and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of it, and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the other</w> side of it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">into the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">by the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">that the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may be borne</w> with them.

verses.name: Exodus 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0905">The staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">in the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">of the ark</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall not be taken</w> from it.

verses.name: Exodus 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">into the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which I shall give</w> thee.

verses.name: Exodus 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">a mercy seat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0520">two cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 25:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them, in the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">of the mercy seat</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">on the one end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">on the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">end</w>: <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03727">of the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">ends</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the matter of the mercy seat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 25:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">And the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall stretch</w> forth <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">with their wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and their faces</w> <transChange type="added">shall look</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03727">toward the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">shall the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims</w> be.

verses.name: Exodus 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">upon the ark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0727">and in the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall give</w> thee.

verses.name: Exodus 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And there I will meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with thee, and I will commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">with thee from above the mercy seat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0996">from between</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05921">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, of all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which I will give thee in commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt also make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">a table</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0520">two cubits</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 25:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">thereto a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">unto it a border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02948">of an hand breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">a golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">to the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">for it four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">corners</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">on the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 25:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05980">Over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">shall the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">be for places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">of the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07979">that the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">may be borne</w> with them.

verses.name: Exodus 25:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07086">the dishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thereof, and spoons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07184">thereof, and covers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04518">thereof, and bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">thereof, to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">withal</w>: <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to pour out withal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 25:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">upon the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">shewbread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">me alway</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">a candlestick</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">shall the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be made</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03409">his shaft</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07070">and his branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01375">his bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03730">his knops</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">and his flowers</w>, shall be of the same.

verses.name: Exodus 25:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">And six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">out of the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of it; three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">of the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">out of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">of the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">out of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 25:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08246" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">made like unto almonds</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03730">a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06525">and a flower</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branch</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08246" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">made like almonds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branch</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03730">a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06525">and a flower</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08337">so in the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">out of the candlestick</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04501">And in the candlestick</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08246" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">made like unto almonds</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03730">their knops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06525">and their flowers</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:35
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03730">a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">under two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03730">of the same, and a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">under two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03730">of the same, and a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">under two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">of the same, according to the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">out of the candlestick</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03730">Their knops</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">and their branches</w> shall be of the same: all it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten work</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof: and they shall light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, that they may give light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall light</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall cause to ascend</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>it</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 25:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04457">And the tongs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">thereof, and the snuffdishes</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:39
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">of pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">it, with all these vessels</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 25:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">that thou make</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08403">after their pattern</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">which was shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">thee in the mount</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which thou wast caused to see</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen105" osisID="Exod.25"/>

verses.name: Exodus 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">and blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>: <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>of cunning…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the work of a cunning workman</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">embroiderer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03407">and every one of the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">shall have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measure</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">The five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall be coupled together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">to another</w>; and <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">to another</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">upon the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">from the selvedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02279">in the coupling</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and likewise shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07020">in the uttermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">edge</w> of <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04225">in the coupling</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>selvedge</catchWord>: <transChange type="amplified">an edge of cloth so woven that it cannot unravel</transChange></note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02572">Fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">of the curtain</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04225">in the coupling</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03924">that the loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">may take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of another</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">taches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269 strong:H0802">together with</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">the taches</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">and it shall be one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05795">goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to be a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">upon the tabernacle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">and the eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <transChange type="added">shall be all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measure</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">by themselves, and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03717" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by themselves, and shalt double</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H04136">in the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">on the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07020">outmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H02279">in the coupling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">of the curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02279">which coupleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">taches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">the taches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">into the loops</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">together, that it may be one</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tent</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">covering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05629">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">of the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that remaineth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">over the backside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0520">And a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">on the one side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520">and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on the other side of that which remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">in the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">of the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05628" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">it shall hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">over the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">on this side and on that side, to cover</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>of that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the remainder</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">surplus</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tent</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">dyed red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04372">and a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08476">badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">for the tabernacle</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing up</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">Ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">of a board</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520">and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">tenons</w> <transChange type="added">shall there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07947" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">set in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">against another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thus shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for all the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tenons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">for the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">southward</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">under the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">tenons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">tenons</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tenons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And for the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 26:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">And their forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03411">And for the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04742">for the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">in the two sides</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:24
