verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08382">And they shall be coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">together beneath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08382" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they shall be coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">above the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of it unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">ring</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">thus shall it be for them both</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">they shall be for the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04740">corners</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>coupled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">twinned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 26:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08083">And they shall be eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 26:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And five</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">of the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03411">for the two sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08484">And the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">of the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shall reach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to end</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">their rings</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">for the bars</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt rear up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the fashion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">thereof which was shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">thee in the mount</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">a vail</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03742">with cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it be made</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 26:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">it upon four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07848">of shittim</w> <transChange type="added">wood</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02053">their hooks</w> <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">upon the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt hang up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">under the taches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that thou mayest bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thither within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06532">and the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">unto you between the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">upon the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04501">and the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">toward the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">an hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">for the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08144 strong:H08438">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with needlework</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 26:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">for the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <transChange type="added">wood</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02053">their hooks</w> <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> for them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen106" osisID="Exod.26"/>

verses.name: Exodus 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall be foursquare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">of it upon the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">thereof: his horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">it with brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">his pans</w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to receive his ashes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03257">and his shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and his basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04207">and his fleshhooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04289">and his firepans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof thou shalt make</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04345">for it a grate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of network</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07568">and upon the net</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">corners</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03749">it under the compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">beneath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07568">that the net</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">may be even to</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">for the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">them with brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0905">And the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">shall be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">into the rings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">and the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">shall be upon the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05014" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Hollow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">with boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it: as it was shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">thee in the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall they make</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he shewed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 27:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05045">for the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">southward</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07050">hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">for the court</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">And the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">thereof and their twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">the hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06828">And likewise for the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">in length</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07050">hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of an hundred</w> <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and his twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and their twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">the hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07050">hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07341">And the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07050">The hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">of one side</w> <transChange type="added">of the gate shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And on the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07050">hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08179">And for the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04539">an hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639 strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wrought with needlework</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05982">All the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the court</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">filleted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">their hooks</w> <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">every where</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fifty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fifty by fifty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627">All the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">in all the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">thereof, and all the pins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">thereof, and all the pins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 27:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02134">thee pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03795">beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">for the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">to cause the lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">always</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to burn</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to ascend up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0168">In the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05715">before the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">it from evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">to morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto their generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">on the behalf of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen107" osisID="Exod.27"/>

verses.name: Exodus 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">thou unto thee Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">with him, from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05070">Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">for glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and for beauty</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt speak</w> unto all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom I have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">with the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they may make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:4
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">the garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which they shall make</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02833">a breastplate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0646">and an ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04598">and a robe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08665">and a broidered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04701">a mitre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H073">and a girdle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">and blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and fine linen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0713">purple</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">It shall have the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulderpieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thereof joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">at the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">edges</w> thereof; and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">it shall be joined together</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02805">And the curious girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0642">of the ephod</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work</w> thereof; <transChange type="added">even of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>curious</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">embroidered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07718">onyx</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on them the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of their names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">on one</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, and <transChange type="added">the other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">names</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">on the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">according to their birth</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">With the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">of an engraver</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">in stone</w>, <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06603">the engravings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">of a signet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou engrave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">with the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04142" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">them to be set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04865">in ouches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">upon the shoulders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">of memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulders</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">for a memorial</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04865">ouches</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08333">chains</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04020">at the ends</w>; <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05688">wreathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and fasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">the wreathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08333">chains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04865">to the ouches</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04639">after the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt make</w> it; <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0713">purple</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">scarlet</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Foursquare</w> it shall be <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03717" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">doubled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02239">a span</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H02239">thereof, and a span</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04396">in it settings</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>: <transChange type="added">the first</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02905">row</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0124">a sardius</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06357">a topaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01304">and a carbuncle</w>: <transChange type="added">this shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">row</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fill in it fillings of stone</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sardius</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ruby</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">row</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05306">an emerald</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05601">a sapphire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03095">and a diamond</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">And the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">row</w> <w lemma="strong:H03958">a ligure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07618">an agate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0306">and an amethyst</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">And the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">row</w> <w lemma="strong:H08658">a beryl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07718">and an onyx</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03471">and a jasper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07660" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">they shall be set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">in gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04396">in their inclosings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>inclosings</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fillings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">And the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">shall be with the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">according to their names</w>, <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06603">the engravings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">of a signet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">with his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">shall they be according to the twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">upon the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08331">chains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01383">at the ends</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05688">wreathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">upon the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">of the breastplate</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">wreathen</w> <transChange type="added">chains</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07098">on the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">of the breastplate</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">wreathen</w> <transChange type="added">chains</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt fasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04865">ouches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">on the shoulderpieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">it</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them upon the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">of the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in the border</w> thereof, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">in the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">inward</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And two</w> <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt make</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">underneath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04136">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the forepart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">thereof, over against</w> the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04225">coupling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">thereof, above</w> <w lemma="strong:H02805">the curious girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07405" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">by the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">thereof unto the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06616">with a lace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, that <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02805">may be above the curious girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02833">and that the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02118" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not loosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">from the ephod</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">in the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">upon his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in unto the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02146">for a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">in the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0224">the Urim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08550">and the Thummim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">and they shall be upon Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">upon his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">the robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">all</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">And there shall be an hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of it, in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">thereof: it shall have a binding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of woven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of it, as it were the hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H08473">of an habergeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it be not rent</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">beneath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07757">upon the hem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">pomegranates</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0713">purple</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07757">the hem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06472">thereof; and bells</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">between</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them round about</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>hem</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">skirts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">A golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06472">bell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">and a pomegranate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">a golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06472">bell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">and a pomegranate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07757">upon the hem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">of the robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And it shall be upon Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">and his sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in unto the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">out, that he die</w> not.

verses.name: Exodus 28:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">a plate</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and grave</w> upon it, <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06603">the engravings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">of a signet</w>, <inscription><w lemma="strong:H06944">HOLINESS</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">TO THE <divineName>LORD</divineName></w></inscription>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">it on a blue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06616">lace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04701">that it may be upon the mitre</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04136 strong:H06440">upon the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">of the mitre</w> it shall be.

verses.name: Exodus 28:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And it shall be upon Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">that Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in all their holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">gifts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08548">and it shall be always</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">upon his forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">that they may be accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:39
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07660" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt embroider</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">the coat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">of fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">the mitre</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08336">fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H073">the girdle</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639 strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">needlework</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:40
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0175">And for Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H073">for them girdles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04021">and bonnets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">for them, for glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and for beauty</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 28:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">them upon Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him; and shalt anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consecrate…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fill their hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">them linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04370">breeches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172 strong:H01320">their nakedness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04975">from the loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">even unto the thighs</w> they shall reach:<note type="study"><catchWord>their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flesh of their nakedness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>reach</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 28:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And they shall be upon Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and upon his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in unto the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">or when they come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">not iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and die</w>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto him and his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen108" osisID="Exod.28"/>

verses.name: Exodus 29:1
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto them to hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04682">And unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02471">and cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">tempered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07550">and wafers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>: <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them into one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">basket</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">them in the basket</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06499">with the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">them with water</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">the garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">upon Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">the coat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04598">and the robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0646">and the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02833">and the breastplate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0640" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H02805">him with the curious girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">the mitre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">upon the mitre</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pour</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and anoint</w> him.

verses.name: Exodus 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coats</w> upon them.

verses.name: Exodus 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H073">them with girdles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04021">the bonnets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">on them: and the priest’s office</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall be theirs for a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">statute</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bind</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>consecrate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fill the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06499">And thou shalt cause a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with thy finger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">all the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03516">above the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon them, and burn</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the caul</catchWord>: <transChange type="amplified">it seemeth by anatomy, and the Hebrew doctors, to be the midriff</transChange></note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">But the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">and his skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06569">and his dung</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt also take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sprinkle</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03767">of him, and his legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05409">unto his pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and unto his head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the whole ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of his blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08571">upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">of the right ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08571">and upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the thumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of their right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the great toe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of their right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04888">and of the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">upon Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and upon his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and upon his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and upon the garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him: and he shall be hallowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> with him.

verses.name: Exodus 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Also thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0451">and the rump</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <transChange type="added">above</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03516">the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">upon them, and the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w>; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of consecration</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 29:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">loaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">bread, and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07550">wafer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">out of the basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of the unleavened bread</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Exodus 29:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">all in the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and in the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shalt wave</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shalt wave</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shalt shake to and fro</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them of their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and burn</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">the breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">consecration</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and wave</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04490">and it shall be thy part</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">the breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">of the wave offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07785">and the shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">of the heave offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">which is waved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and which is heaved up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of the consecration</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w>, and of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">which is for his sons</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 29:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And it shall be Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">by a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08641">and it shall be an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of their peace offerings</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">their heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06944">And the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall be his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">him, to be anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">therein, and to be consecrated</w> in them.

verses.name: Exodus 29:30
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">that is priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in his stead shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">them on seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that son</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he of his sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of the consecration</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">and the bread</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05536">in the basket</w>, <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">those things wherewith the atonement was made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to consecrate</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">them: but a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not eat</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, because they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And if ought of the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of the consecrations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">or of the bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">unto the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou shalt burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the remainder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be eaten</w>, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thus shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>, according to all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">thee: seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou consecrate</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 29:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">a bullock</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03725">for atonement</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when thou hast made an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it, and thou shalt anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">it, to sanctify</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 29:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">for the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it; and it shall be an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944 strong:H06944">most holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whatsoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Now this <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">The one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08145">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 29:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And with the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">a tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">deal of flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07253">with the fourth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03795">of beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07243">and the fourth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05262">a drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">thereto according to the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and according to the drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">thereof, for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:42
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">where I will meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">you, to speak</w> there unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 29:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And there I will meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, and <transChange type="added">the tabernacle</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">by my glory</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the tabernacle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Israel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 29:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I will sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">also both Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister to me in the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:45
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and will be their God</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 29:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen109" osisID="Exod.29"/>

verses.name: Exodus 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04729">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> upon: <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0520">A cubit</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thereof; foursquare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">shall it be: and two cubits</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">thereof: the horns</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> of the same.

verses.name: Exodus 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01406">the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">thereof, and the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07161">and the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; and thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">unto it a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>top</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">roof</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sides</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">to it under the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of it, by the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thereof, upon the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it shalt thou make</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and they shall be for places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">for the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">it withal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>corners</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ribs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:6
