verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">by the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05715">over the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">where I will meet</w> with thee.

verses.name: Exodus 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">thereon sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when he dresseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall burn incense</w> upon it.<note type="study"><catchWord>sweet incense</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">incense of spices</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And when Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">lighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">upon it, a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lighteth</catchWord>: or <rdg type="alternate">setteth up</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">causeth to ascend</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>at even</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">between the two evenings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">no strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thereon, nor burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">nor meat offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">drink offering</w> thereon.

verses.name: Exodus 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of it once</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in a year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03725">of atonements</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">once</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he make atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">upon it throughout your generations</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou takest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">after their number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall they give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">a ransom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou numberest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05063">them; that there be no plague</w> among them, when <transChange type="added">thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">numberest</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>their number</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">them that are to be numbered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">This they shall give</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that passeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them that are numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04276">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">a shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H08255">a shekel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01626">gerahs</w>:) <w lemma="strong:H04276">an half</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekel</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Every one that passeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">among them that are numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not give more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01800">and the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not give less</w> <w lemma="strong:H04276">than half</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">a shekel</w>, when <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for your souls</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>give more</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiply</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>give less</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">diminish</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03725">the atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">it for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02146">that it may be a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for your souls</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt also make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">a laver</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03653">and his foot</w> <transChange type="added">also of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wash</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">it between the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> therein.

verses.name: Exodus 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">For Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and their feet</w> thereat:

verses.name: Exodus 30:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When they go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not; or when they come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">to the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Exodus 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So they shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">not: and it shall be a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> to them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">to him and to his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout their generations</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thou also unto thee principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01865">of pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">myrrh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and of sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07076">cinnamon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04276">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04276">so much</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and of sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">calamus</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>,

verses.name: Exodus 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06916">And of cassia</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">an hin</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 30:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">it an oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">ointment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07545">an ointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04842">compound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">after the art</w> <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the apothecary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06944">it shall be an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>apothecary</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">perfumer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">therewith, and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 30:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07979">And the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04501">and the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">of incense</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 30:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04196">And the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with all his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03595">and the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">and his foot</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">them, that they may be most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whatsoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them shall be holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and consecrate</w> them, that <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">may minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">This shall be an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto me throughout your generations</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Upon man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03251" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it not be poured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye make</w> <transChange type="added">any other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04971">like it, after the composition</w> of it: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">it shall be holy</w> unto you.

verses.name: Exodus 30:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H0834">Whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">compoundeth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">like it, or whosoever putteth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of it upon a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall even be cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">off from his people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">unto thee sweet spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05198">stacte</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07827">and onycha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02464">and galbanum</w>; <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05561">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">spices</w> <w lemma="strong:H02134">with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">frankincense</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0905">of each</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">shall there be a like</w> <transChange type="added">weight</transChange>:

verses.name: Exodus 30:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">it a perfume</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07545">a confection</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">after the art</w> <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the apothecary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04414" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">tempered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">together, pure</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>tempered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">salted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 30:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07833" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt beat</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of it very small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">where I will meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">with thee: it shall be unto you most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:37
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07004">the perfume</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt make</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04971">to yourselves according to the composition</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">thereof: it shall be unto thee holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 30:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H0834">Whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">like unto that, to smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereto, shall even be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from his people</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen110" osisID="Exod.30"/>

verses.name: Exodus 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01212">Bezaleel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0221">of Uri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">him with the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">in wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08394">and in understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and in knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">and in all manner of workmanship</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">cunning works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">in gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and in silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and in brass</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02799">And in cutting</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to set</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02799">and in carving</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of timber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in all manner of workmanship</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I, behold, I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0171">with him Aholiab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0294">of Ahisamach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">and in the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of all that are wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they may make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">all that I have commanded</w> thee;

verses.name: Exodus 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0168">The tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03727">and the mercy seat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">thereupon, and all the furniture</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>furniture</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07979">And the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and his furniture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with all his furniture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">of incense</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>furniture</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04196">And the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with all his furniture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03595">and the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">and his foot</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>furniture</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 31:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">And the cloths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08278">of service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and the garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister in the priest’s office</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04888">And the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05561">and sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according to all that I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee shall they do</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 31:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou also unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0389">Verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall keep</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">between me and you throughout your generations</w>; that <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that doth sanctify</w> you.

verses.name: Exodus 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> therefore; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto you: every one that defileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for whosoever doeth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">therein, that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">may work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be done</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07637">but in the seventh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07677">of rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever doeth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">in the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Wherefore the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout their generations</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 31:17
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">between me and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: for <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">and on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he rested</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05314" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was refreshed</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 31:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of communing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">with him upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with the finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen111" osisID="Exod.31"/>

verses.name: Exodus 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">delayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">out of the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">us gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> us; for <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">this Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us up out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we wot</w> not what is become of him.

verses.name: Exodus 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto them, Break off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">earrings</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of your wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and of your daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> unto me.

verses.name: Exodus 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">brake off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">earrings</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he received</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fashioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02747">it with a graving tool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">after he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">it a molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calf</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, These <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee up out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And when Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">it; and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made proclamation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">down to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to play</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get thee down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">for thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou broughtest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have corrupted</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange>:

verses.name: Exodus 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">aside quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: they have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">them a molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and have worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and have sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereunto, and said</w>, These <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which have brought thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, and, behold, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203 strong:H07186">a stiffnecked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Now therefore let me alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">that my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may wax hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">against them, and that I may consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of thee a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">why doth thy wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wax hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName></catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Wherefore should the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">For mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did he bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them out, to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">them in the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">from thy fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against thy people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">to whom thou swarest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">by thine own self, and saidst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto them, I will multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">your seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and all this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto your seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall inherit</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03871">the tables</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">on both</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">their sides</w>; on the one side and on the other <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they written</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03871">And the tables</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04385">and the writing</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04385">the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02801" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">graven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">upon the tables</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And when Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07452">as they shouted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> of <transChange type="added">them that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">for mastery</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> of <transChange type="added">them that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02476">for being overcome</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> of <transChange type="added">them that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do I hear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>being…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weakness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 32:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">the calf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04246">and the dancing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">them beneath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ground</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to powder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and strawed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and made the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">drink</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto thee, that thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">so great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02401">a sin</w> upon them?

verses.name: Exodus 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">Let not the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wax hot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, that they <transChange type="added">are set</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">on mischief</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">us gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> us: for <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">this Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we wot</w> not what is become of him.

verses.name: Exodus 32:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">unto them, Whosoever hath any gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">let them break</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">off. So they gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me: then I cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it into the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">this calf</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">naked</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made them naked</w> unto <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08103">shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">among their enemies</w>:)<note type="study"><catchWord>their enemies</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">those that rose up against them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 32:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Then Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> side? <transChange type="added">let him come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me. And all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered</w> themselves together unto him.

verses.name: Exodus 32:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">by his side</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">in and out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">from gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">throughout the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his companion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">his neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">about three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">For Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consecrate yourselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">even</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and upon his brother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may bestow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">upon you a blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>For Moses…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">And Moses said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, because every man hath been against his brother</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>Consecrate…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Fill your hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 32:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02401">sin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and now I will go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0194">peradventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">your sin</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">Oh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02401">sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">them gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet now, if thou wilt forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin</w>—; <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and if not, blot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">me, I pray thee, out of thy book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast written</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">Whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me, him will I blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of my book</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 32:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore now go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> unto <transChange type="added">the place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of which I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto thee: behold, mine Angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee: nevertheless in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin</w> upon them.

verses.name: Exodus 32:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">plagued</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">the calf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen112" osisID="Exod.32"/>

verses.name: Exodus 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">hence, thou and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and to Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">Unto thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> it:

verses.name: Exodus 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee; and I will drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusite</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Unto a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will not go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of thee; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203 strong:H07186">a stiffnecked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">lest I consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee in the way</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">these evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they mourned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">on him his ornaments</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203 strong:H07186">a stiffnecked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of thee in a</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">moment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thee: therefore now put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">thy ornaments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thee, that I may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what to do</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Exodus 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">stripped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">themselves of their ornaments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">by the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">Horeb</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">it without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">afar off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">from the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">it the Tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>. And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">every one which sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And it came to pass, when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto the tabernacle</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he was gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And it came to pass, as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloudy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">descended</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stood</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>, and <transChange type="added">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">with Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloudy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stand</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and worshipped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">as a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his friend</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he turned again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">but his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">a young man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou sayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me, Bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou hast not let me know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom thou wilt send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me. Yet thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee by name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hast also found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">me now thy way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, that I may find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">that this nation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">My presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <transChange type="added">with thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will give thee rest</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto him, If thy presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">go</w> not <transChange type="added">with me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">carry us not up</w> hence.

verses.name: Exodus 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">For wherein shall it be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0645">here</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that I and thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>? <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not in that thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06395" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with us? so shall we be separated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">I and thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">from all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also that thou hast spoken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee by name</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04994">I beseech thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">me thy glory</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02898">I will make all my goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">before thee, and I will proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee; and will be gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to whom I will be gracious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will shew mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">on whom I will shew mercy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou canst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">for there shall no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and live</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 33:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">by me, and thou shalt stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">upon a rock</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">And it shall come to pass, while my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">passeth by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05366">thee in a clift</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thee with my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">while</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I pass by</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 33:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">away mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">my back parts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">but my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be seen</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen113" osisID="Exod.33"/>

verses.name: Exodus 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06458" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thee two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">like unto the first</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will write</w> upon <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">that were in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou brakest</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And be ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and present</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thyself there to me in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0408">with thee, neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">let any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">throughout all the mount</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06629">neither let the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">nor herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">that mount</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06458" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he hewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">like unto the first</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">in the cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him there, and proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed by</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and proclaimed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07349">merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02587">and gracious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639 strong:H0750">longsuffering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and abundant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Keeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">for thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">forgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">and transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and that will by no means</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">clear</w> <transChange type="added">the guilty</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">visiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and upon the children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08029">children, unto the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H07256">and to the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">generation</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bowed his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">toward the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If now I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">let my Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> us; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203 strong:H07186">a stiffnecked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">our iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and our sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take us for thine inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">before all thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">marvels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">such as have not been done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">nor in any nation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> which thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a terrible thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I will do</w> with thee.

verses.name: Exodus 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thou that which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">thee the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusite</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thyself, lest thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04170">lest it be for a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of thee:

verses.name: Exodus 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But ye shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">their altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">their images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">their groves</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">For thou shalt worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">no other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">god</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07067">Jealous</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07067">a jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they go a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto their gods</w>, and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of his sacrifice</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 34:16
