verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-67">go a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-67">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">go a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">thee no molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02282">The feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou keep</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">thee, in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H024">Abib</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02320">for in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H024">Abib</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou camest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06363">All that openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">the matrix</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06363">mine; and every firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">among thy cattle</w>, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">or sheep</w>, <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that is male</w></transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sheep</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 34:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06363">But the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of an ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">with a lamb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and if thou redeem</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, then shalt thou break his neck</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01060">All the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt redeem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And none shall appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">me empty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 34:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">but on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt rest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02758">in earing time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">and in harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt rest</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">of weeks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01061">of the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">and the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0614">of ingathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">at the year’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08622">end</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>year’s end</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">revolution of the year</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 34:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969 strong:H06471">Thrice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02138">shall all your men children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For I will cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thy borders</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">neither shall any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou shalt go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969 strong:H06471">thrice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of my sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">with leaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02077">neither shall the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">of the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">of the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">unto the morning</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">The first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">in his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">milk</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Write</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou these words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">for after the tenor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with thee and with Israel</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And he was there with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he did neither eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">upon the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandments</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 34:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And it came to pass, when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">with the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">in Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wist</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">not that the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07160" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">while he talked</w> with him.

verses.name: Exodus 34:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And when Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">behold, the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07160" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they were afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come nigh</w> him.

verses.name: Exodus 34:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto them; and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">and all the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto him: and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">talked</w> with them.

verses.name: Exodus 34:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">came nigh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he gave them in commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">with him in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:33
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">till</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04533">a vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on his face</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">But when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-68">with him, he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04533">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-68">off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he came out</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">which he was commanded</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 34:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">that the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07160" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-69">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04533">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-69">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in to speak</w> with him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen114" osisID="Exod.34"/>

verses.name: Exodus 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-70">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-70">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto them, These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w>, that <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should do</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">shall work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">but on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">there shall be to you an holy day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">a sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07677">of rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">therein shall be put to death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Ye shall kindle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">no fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">throughout your habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">upon the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">ye from among you an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03605">whosoever</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05081">of a willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let him bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">it, an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08504">And blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">and goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0352">And rams’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">dyed red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08476">and badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07848">and shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08081">And oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">for the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and spices</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">for anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05561">and for the sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07718">And onyx</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">and stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">to be set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">for the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02833">and for the breastplate</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">And every wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among you shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 35:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04908">The tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04372">and his covering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07165">his taches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07175">and his boards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01280">his bars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">his pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and his sockets</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">The ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">and the staves</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06532">and the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">of the covering</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07979">The table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">and his staves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899 strong:H06440">and the shewbread</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04501">The candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">also for the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and his furniture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">and his lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">with the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">for the light</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07004">And the incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">and his staves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04888">and the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05561">and the sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04539">and the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">for the door at the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04196">The altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">with his brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04345">grate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">his staves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03595">the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">and his foot</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07050">The hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">his pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04539">and the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">for the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03489">The pins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03489">and the pins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04340">and their cords</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">The cloths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08278">of service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to do service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and the garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister in the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05712">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stirred him up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and every one whom his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made willing</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">and for all his service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and for the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05921">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03605">as many as</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">were willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02397">bracelets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05141">and earrings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02885">and rings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03558">and tablets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">all jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that offered</w> <transChange type="added">offered</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And every man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with whom was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">and goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and red</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08476">and badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Every one that did offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and every man, with whom was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for any work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And all the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">that were wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did spin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04299">that which they had spun</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and of purple</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">of scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and of fine linen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And all the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stirred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">them up in wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07718">onyx</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">and stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">to be set</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0646">for the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02833">and for the breastplate</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 35:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01314">And spice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">for the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04888">and for the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05561">and for the sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">a willing offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">whose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made them willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for all manner of work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01212">Bezaleel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0221">of Uri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 35:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he hath filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">him with the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">in wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08394">in understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and in knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">and in all manner of workmanship</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 35:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And to devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">curious works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">in gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and in silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and in brass</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 35:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02799">And in the cutting</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to set</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02799">and in carving</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">any manner of cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he hath put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he may teach</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0171">he, and Aholiab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0294">of Ahisamach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 35:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Them hath he filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">with wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all manner of work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">of the engraver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of the cunning workman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of the embroiderer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">in blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and in purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">in scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and in fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of the weaver</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03605">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of those that devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">cunning work</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen115" osisID="Exod.35"/>

verses.name: Exodus 36:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01212">Bezaleel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0171">and Aholiab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and every wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">in whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">how to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all manner of work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01212">Bezaleel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0171">and Aholiab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and every wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">in whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">every one whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stirred him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">unto the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> it:

verses.name: Exodus 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they received</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">all the offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> it <transChange type="added">withal</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">yet unto him free offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">And all the wise men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">from his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which they made</w>;

verses.name: Exodus 36:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">much more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">than enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">of the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">gave commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674 strong:H06963" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they caused it to be proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">throughout the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Let neither man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">nor woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">any more work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">for the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were restrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from bringing</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04399">For the stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">they had was sufficient</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">it, and too much</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02450">And every wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">hearted man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">and blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>: <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> he them.

verses.name: Exodus 36:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03407">the curtains</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">all of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">size</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto another</w>: and <transChange type="added">the other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto another</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">on the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">from the selvedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04225">in the coupling</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">likewise he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07020">in the uttermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">side</w> of <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04225">in the coupling</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>selvedge</catchWord>: <transChange type="amplified">an edge of cloth so woven that it cannot unravel</transChange></note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02572">Fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">he in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">he in the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">of the curtain</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04225">in the coupling</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03924">the loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">held</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <transChange type="added">curtain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to another</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">taches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">the curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">with the taches</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">so it became one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05795">goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">over the tabernacle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> them.

verses.name: Exodus 36:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">the eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">size</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">by themselves, and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w> by themselves.

verses.name: Exodus 36:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H07020">upon the uttermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">of the curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04225">in the coupling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03924">loops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">he upon the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">of the curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02279">which coupleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07165">taches</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-71">to couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-71">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">that it might be one</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tent</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">dyed red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04372">and a covering</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08476">badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">for the tabernacle</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing up</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">of a board</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">of a board</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">had two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">tenons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07947" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">equally distant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus did he make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for all the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">for the tabernacle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">for the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">southward</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 36:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">And forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">under the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">tenons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">tenons</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And for the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">corner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 36:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">And their forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03411">And for the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04742">he for the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">in the two sides</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08382">And they were coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">beneath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08382" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and coupled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">at the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">thereof, to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">ring</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">to both</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of them in both</w> <w lemma="strong:H04740">the corners</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>coupled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">twinned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08083">And there were eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">boards</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">under every</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">board</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134 strong:H0134">sockets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>under…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">two sockets, two sockets under one board</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07848">of shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 36:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And five</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">for the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">for the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08484">the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the one end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the other</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">their rings</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">for the bars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">a vail</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>: <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he it of cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">thereunto four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <transChange type="added">wood</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02053">their hooks</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">for them four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 36:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">an hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639 strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of needlework</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>of needlework</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the work of a needleworker</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">embroiderer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 36:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02053">of it with their hooks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their chapiters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02568">but their five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen116" osisID="Exod.36"/>

verses.name: Exodus 37:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01212">And Bezaleel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0520">two cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">of it, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">of it, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> of it:

verses.name: Exodus 37:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">and without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">to it round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">for it four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <transChange type="added">to be set</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">by the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of it; even two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of it, and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">upon the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> of it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">into the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">by the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0520">two cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and one cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 37:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten out of one piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">he them, on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">of the mercy seat</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>on…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">out of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Exodus 37:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">on the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">on this side, and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> on the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07098">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">on that side: out of the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">he the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07099 strong:H07098" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">ends</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>on the end</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">out of</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>on the other end</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">out of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Exodus 37:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">And the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">spread out</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">on high</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">with their wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">over the mercy seat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">with their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03727">to the mercy seatward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">were the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0520">two cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">thereof, and a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and a half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> thereof:

verses.name: Exodus 37:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">thereunto a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">thereunto a border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02948">of an handbreadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">for the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">for it four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">upon the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">corners</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 37:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05980">Over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">were the rings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">for the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07979">upon the table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07086">his dishes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and his spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04518">and his bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07184">and his covers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">withal</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to cover…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to pour out withal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 37:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">the candlestick</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">he the candlestick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03409">his shaft</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07070">and his branch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01375">his bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03730">his knops</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">and his flowers</w>, were of the same:

verses.name: Exodus 37:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">And six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">of the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thereof; three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">of the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">out of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thereof, and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">of the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">out of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w> thereof:

verses.name: Exodus 37:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08246" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">made after the fashion of almonds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03730">a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06525">and a flower</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08246" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">made like almonds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03730">a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06525">and a flower</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08337">so throughout the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">of the candlestick</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04501">And in the candlestick</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01375">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08246" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">made like almonds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03730">his knops</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">and his flowers</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 37:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03730">And a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">under two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03730">of the same, and a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">under two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03730">of the same, and a knop</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">under two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">of the same, according to the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going out</w> of it.

verses.name: Exodus 37:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03730">Their knops</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">and their branches</w> were of the same: all of it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten work</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">his seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04457">and his snuffers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04289">and his snuffdishes</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:24
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">of pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">he it, and all the vessels</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 37:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">the incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> of it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">of it a cubit</w>; <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">foursquare</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0520">and two cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">of it; the horns</w> thereof were of the same.

verses.name: Exodus 37:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01406">the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">of it, and the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07161">and the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it: also he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">unto it a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02213">for it under the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thereof, by the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of it, upon the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thereof, to be places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">for the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> it withal.

verses.name: Exodus 37:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 37:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">of sweet spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">according to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the apothecary</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 37." eID="gen117" osisID="Exod.37"/>

verses.name: Exodus 38:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">thereof, and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> thereof; <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">foursquare</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> thereof.

verses.name: Exodus 38:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">thereof on the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">of it; the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereof were of the same: and he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">it with brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05518">the pots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03257">and the shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the basons</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04207">the fleshhooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04289">and the firepans</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof made</w> he <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">for the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">a brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04345">grate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639 strong:H07568">of network</w> <w lemma="strong:H03749">under the compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">thereof beneath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">unto the midst</w> of it.

verses.name: Exodus 38:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">for the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07099">ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H04345">of the grate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">for the staves</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">them with brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">into the rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">on the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it withal; he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05014" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the altar hollow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">with boards</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">the laver</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03653">and the foot</w> of it <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04759">of the lookingglasses</w> of <transChange type="added">the women</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">assembling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which assembled</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lookingglasses</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">brasen glasses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>assembling</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">assembling by troops</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 38:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the court</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">southward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07050">the hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 38:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05982">Their pillars</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and their brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">the hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06828">And for the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <transChange type="added">the hangings were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">the hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">And for the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07050">hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">the hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06924">And for the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07050">The hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">of the one side</w> <transChange type="added">of the gate were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And for the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, on this hand and that hand, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07050">hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">of fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05982">their pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07050">All the hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">of fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:17
