verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0134">And the sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">for the pillars</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">the hooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06826">and the overlaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of their chapiters</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05982">and all the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">filleted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04539">And the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">for the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639 strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">needlework</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">in the breadth</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05980">answerable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07050">to the hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05982">And their pillars</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02053">their hooks</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06826">and the overlaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of their chapiters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02838">and their fillets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03489">And all the pins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">and of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0428">This</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">as it was counted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">of Ithamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">to Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01212">And Bezaleel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0221">of Uri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:23
verses.text: And with him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0171">Aholiab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0294">of Ahisamach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">an engraver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a cunning workman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and an embroiderer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">in blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and in purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and in scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and fine linen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">All the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that was occupied</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">even the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">of the offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">was twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 38:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">And the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of them that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568 strong:H07657">and threescore and fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 38:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01235">A bekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">for every man</w>, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04276">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">a shekel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for every one that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">to be numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">for six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>every man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a poll</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 38:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03967">And of the hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">the sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and the sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">of the vail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of the hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03603">a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">for a socket</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08504">And of the blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">cloths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08278">of service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to do service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08144 strong:H08438">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they did beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">into</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">thin plates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cut</w> <transChange type="added">it into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06616">wires</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">in the blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and in the purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and in the scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">and in the fine linen</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulderpieces</w> for it, to couple <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">by the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07099 strong:H07098" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">edges</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was it coupled together</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02805">And the curious girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0642">of his ephod</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> upon it, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of the same, according to the work</w> thereof; <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:6

verses.name: Exodus 39:7

verses.name: Exodus 39:9

verses.name: Exodus 39:10

verses.name: Exodus 39:11

verses.name: Exodus 39:12

verses.name: Exodus 39:13

verses.name: Exodus 39:14

verses.name: Exodus 39:15

verses.name: Exodus 39:19

verses.name: Exodus 39:25

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H073">And a girdle</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07806" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fine twined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">and blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639 strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">needlework</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">the plate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">crown</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04385">upon it a writing</w>, <transChange type="added">like to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06603">the engravings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">of a signet</w>, <inscription><w lemma="strong:H06944">HOLINESS</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">TO THE <divineName>LORD</divineName></w></inscription>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they tied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06616">unto it a lace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fasten</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">upon the mitre</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05656">Thus was all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">finished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> they.

verses.name: Exodus 39:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all his furniture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07165">his taches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07175">his boards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01280">his bars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">and his pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and his sockets</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 39:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04372">And the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0119" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">dyed red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04372">and the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">of badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06532">and the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">of the covering</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 39:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">The ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">and the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">thereof, and the mercy seat</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 39:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07979">The table</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899 strong:H06440">thereof, and the shewbread</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 39:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02889">The pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">candlestick</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">even with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">to be set in order</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">thereof, and the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">for light</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 39:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">And the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04888">and the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05561">and the sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04539">and the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>the sweet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the incense of sweet spices</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 39:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05178">The brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04345">and his grate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">his staves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03595">the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">and his foot</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 39:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07050">The hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">his pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and his sockets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04539">and the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">for the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04340">his cords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03489">and his pins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 39:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">The cloths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08278">of service</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to do service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister in the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">According to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">so the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">all the work</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 39:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">upon all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and, behold, they had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even so had they done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">it: and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 39." eID="gen119" osisID="Exod.39"/>

verses.name: Exodus 40:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Exodus 40:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">On the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08033">therein</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">with the vail</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">in the table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and set in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">the things that are to be set in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon it; and thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">in the candlestick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>the things…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the order thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 40:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">for the incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">to the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">between the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> therein.

verses.name: Exodus 40:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hang up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">at the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">therein, and shalt hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">it, and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">thereof: and it shall be holy</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04196">and it shall be an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>most holy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness of holinesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 40:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">and his foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sanctify</w> it.

verses.name: Exodus 40:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">them with water</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">upon Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him, and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">them with coats</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 40:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, as thou didst anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04888">for their anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall surely be an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">priesthood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout their generations</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, so did</w> he.

verses.name: Exodus 40:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07223">And it came to pass in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">on the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was reared up</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">his sockets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07175">the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">in the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">his pillars</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spread abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">over the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon it; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">into the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">on the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">upon the ark</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 40:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">into the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">of the covering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03409">upon the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06187">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">the table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03409">on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he lighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>:

verses.name: Exodus 40:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereon; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">the hanging</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">upon it the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the meat offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">between the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">there, to wash</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and their feet</w> thereat:

verses.name: Exodus 40:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when they came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they washed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">So Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06051">Then a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">because the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">thereon, and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06051">And when the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">over the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went onward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04550">in all their journeys</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>went onward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">journeyed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Exodus 40:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06051">But if the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were not taken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not till the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that it was taken up</w>.

verses.name: Exodus 40:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06051">For the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">upon the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">was on it by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04550">throughout all their journeys</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 40." eID="gen120" osisID="Exod.40"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen80" osisID="Exod" type="book"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto him out of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">unto them, If any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of you bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">your offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of the cattle</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the herd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of the flock</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07133">If his offering</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the herd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let him offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">it of his own voluntary will</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for him to make atonement</w> for him.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> that <transChange type="added">is by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall flay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">it into his pieces</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and lay the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">upon the fire</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-72">shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">the parts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06309">and the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-72">in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">upon the wood</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on the fire</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07130">But his inwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03767">and his legs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">all on the altar</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07133">And if his offering</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flocks</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03775">of the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">or of the goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt sacrifice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">it a male</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">it on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">it into his pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">with his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06309">and his fat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lay them in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on the wood</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on the fire</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03767">and the legs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">all, and burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05930">And if the burnt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">for his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05775">of fowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">of turtledoves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">or of young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it unto the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04454" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wring off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04680" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof shall be wrung out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">at the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>wring…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pinch off the head with the nail</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall pluck away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04760">his crop</w> <w lemma="strong:H05133">with his feathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">it beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east part</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">by the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">of the ashes</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>his feathers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the filth thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">it with the wings</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> shall not divide <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">asunder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">upon the wood</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">upon the fire</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen122" osisID="Lev.1"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And when any</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w> shall be <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05560">fine flour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon it, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">frankincense</w> thereon:

verses.name: Leviticus 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">it to Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07061" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08033">thereout</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393 strong:H07062">his handful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of the flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">thereof, and of the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">thereof, with all the frankincense</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">thereof; and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0234">the memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of it upon the altar</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of the meat offering</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">a thing most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-73">of the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-73">made by fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And if thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">an oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03989">baken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">in the oven</w>, <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04682">or unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07550">wafers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07133">And if thy oblation</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <transChange type="added">baken</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04227">in a pan</w>, it shall be <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05560">fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in a pan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on a flat plate</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06626" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou shalt part</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">it in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> thereon: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07133">And if thy oblation</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <transChange type="added">baken</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04802">in the fryingpan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be made</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05560">fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that is made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of these things unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and when it is presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it unto the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">from the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0234">a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, and shall burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And that which is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of the meat offering</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">a thing most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-74">of the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-74">made by fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">No meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which ye shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">with leaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for ye shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07603">no leaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">nor any honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-75">in any offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-75">made by fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07133">As for the oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">of the firstfruits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they shall not be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be burnt</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07133">And every oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of thy meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou season</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">with salt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04417">neither shalt thou suffer the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be lacking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">from thy meat offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07133">with all thine offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">salt</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And if thou offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of thy firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">for the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of thy firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H024">green ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07033" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of corn dried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">by the fire</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01643">corn beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03759">out of full ears</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon it, and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">frankincense</w> thereon: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0234">the memorial</w> of it, <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01643">of the beaten corn</w> thereof, and <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">thereof, with all the frankincense</w> thereof: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen123" osisID="Lev.2"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07133">And if his oblation</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">if he offer</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the herd</w>; whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">or female</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">it without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">of his offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and kill</w> it <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and all the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">upon the inwards</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>fat</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">suet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03689">by the flanks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03516">above the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03629">with the kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall he take away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>caul…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">midriff over the liver, and over the kidneys</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it on the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">upon the burnt sacrifice</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">upon the wood</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on the fire</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07133">And if his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">for a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02145">male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">or female</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">it without blemish</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">If he offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03775">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">for his offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then shall he offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">of his offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">the whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H0451">rump</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall he take off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06096">by the backbone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and all the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">upon the inwards</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03689">by the flanks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03516">above the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03629">with the kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall he take away</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it upon the altar</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the food</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">of the offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07133">And if his offering</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05795">a goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it, and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thereof upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">thereof his offering</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and all the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">upon the inwards</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03689">by the flanks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03516">above the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03629">with the kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall he take away</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">them upon the altar</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the food</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">of the offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02459">all the fat</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 3:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">for your generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">throughout all your dwellings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">neither fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">nor blood</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen124" osisID="Lev.3"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">If a soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">through ignorance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">against any of the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">concerning things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which ought not to be done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">against any</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">of them</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">If the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">that is anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">according to the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then let him bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01241">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">upon the bullock’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">that is anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">it to the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">his finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">of sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, which <transChange type="added">is at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall take off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">from it all the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for the sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and all the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">upon the inwards</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03689">by the flanks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03516">above the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03629">with the kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall he take away</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">As it was taken off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">from the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">them upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05785">And the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and all his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">with his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03767">and with his legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">and his inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06569">and his dung</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06499">Even the whole bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall he carry forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">unto a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01880">where the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08211">are poured out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">him on the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0413">where</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08211">are poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall he be burnt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>without…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to without the camp</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the pouring out of the ashes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05712">And if the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin through ignorance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the assembly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they have done</w> <transChange type="added">somewhat against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">concerning things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which should not be done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and are guilty</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">When the sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">against it, is known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">then the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01241">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for the sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06499">and the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:16
