verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">that is anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">his finger</w> <transChange type="added">in some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall put</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, which <transChange type="added">is at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">all his fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from him, and burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">with the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">with the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall he do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">with this: and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for them, and it shall be forgiven</w> them.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall carry forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him as he burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">for the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05387">When a ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and done</w> <transChange type="added">somewhat</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07684">through ignorance</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <transChange type="added">concerning things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which should not be done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and is guilty</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">Or if his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein he hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">come to his knowledge</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08163">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">of the goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">it in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where they kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his finger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">all his fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">as the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for him as concerning his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be forgiven</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">And if any</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the common</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">through ignorance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">while he doeth</w> <transChange type="added">somewhat against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">concerning things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which ought not to be done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be guilty</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>any one</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">any soul</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>common…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">people of the land</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 4:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">Or if his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">come to his knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08166">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05347">a female</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">for his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath sinned</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">thereof with his finger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">thereof at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">all the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">thereof, as the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">from off the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for him, and it shall be forgiven</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And if he bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">it a female</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">it for a sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where they kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 4:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his finger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">thereof at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 4:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">all the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">thereof, as the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03775">of the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">from the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">them upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">according to the offerings made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be forgiven</w> him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen125" osisID="Lev.4"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And if a soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">of swearing</w>, and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">a witness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">whether</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or known</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">if he do not utter</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">his iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Or if a soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">any unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>, whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05038">a carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">of an unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05038">or a carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">of unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05038">or the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">of unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">creeping things</w>, and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it be hidden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">from him; he also shall be unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and guilty</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Or if he touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">the uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02932">whatsoever uncleanness</w> <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that a man shall be defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">withal, and it be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from him; when he knoweth</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall be guilty</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Or if a soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0981" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">pronouncing</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">or to do good</w>, whatsoever <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0981" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall pronounce</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">with an oath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from him; when he knoweth</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall be guilty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> of these.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall be, when he shall be guilty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> of these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">that he shall confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath sinned</w> in that <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>:

verses.name: Leviticus 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">his trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05347">a female</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">from the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03776">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H08166">or a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for him concerning his sin</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And if he</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">be not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">a lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">his trespass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">turtledoves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his hand cannot reach to the sufficiency of a lamb</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">them unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who shall offer</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04454" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wring off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">his neck</w>, but shall not divide <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">asunder</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">upon the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04680" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be wrung out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the manner</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for him for his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be forgiven</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>manner</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ordinance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 5:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03027">But if he</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">be not able to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">turtledoves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he that sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">for his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">part of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">no oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon it, neither shall he put</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03828">frankincense</w> thereon: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then shall he bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">it to the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07061" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07062 strong:H04393">his handful</w> of it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0234">a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, and burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">according to the offerings made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for him as touching his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of these, and it shall be forgiven</w> him: and <transChange type="added">the remnant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">shall be the priest’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">as a meat offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">If a soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">a trespass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">through ignorance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">for his trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of the flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">with thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">by shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0817">for a trespass offering</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he shall make amends</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for the harm</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">that he hath done in the holy thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereto, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">it unto the priest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">for him with the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be forgiven</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05315">And if a soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of these things which are forbidden to be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">by the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">though he wist</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, yet is he guilty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">his iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">with thy estimation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0817">for a trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">for him concerning his ignorance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07683" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein he erred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wist</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">not, and it shall be forgiven</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 5:19
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">a trespass offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he hath certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen126" osisID="Lev.5"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">If a soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">a trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">unto his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06487">in that which was delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H08667">him to keep, or in fellowship</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01498">or in a thing taken away by violence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or hath deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">his neighbour</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>in fellowship</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in dealing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fellowship</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">putting of the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Or have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H09">that which was lost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">concerning it, and sweareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">in any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of all these that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sinning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">therein</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then it shall be, because he hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and is guilty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01500">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he took violently away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06233">or the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath deceitfully gotten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H06487">or that which was delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">him to keep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H09">or the lost thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he found</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Or all that about which he hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he shall even restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">it in the principal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-76">and shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-76">more</w> thereto, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">of his trespass offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the day…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the day of his being found guilty</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the day of his trespass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">his trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">with thy estimation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0817">for a trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be forgiven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him for any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of all that he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">in trespassing</w> therein.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Command</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04169">because of the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">unto the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be burning</w> in it.<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for the burning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">on his linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0906">and his linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04370">breeches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">upon his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">which the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">with the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">them beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and carry forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">unto a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">And the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in it; it shall not be put out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">on it every morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and lay the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon it; and he shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">thereon the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">The fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">shall ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall never go out</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of the meat offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07062">of it his handful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05560">of the flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and of the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">thereof, and all the frankincense</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">upon the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0234">the memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of it, unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the remainder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">thereof shall Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04682">with unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall it be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall eat</w> it.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">It shall not be baken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">with leaven</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> it <transChange type="added">unto them for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">their portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">of my offerings made by fire</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>, as <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0817">and as the trespass offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02145">All the males</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> of it. <transChange type="added">It shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in your generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-77">concerning the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-77">made by fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">every one that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them shall be holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:20
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07133">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he is anointed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06224">the tenth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">for a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">perpetual</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04276">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of it in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04276">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">thereof at night</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04227">In a pan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>; <transChange type="added">and when it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07246" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">baken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt bring</w> it in: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08601">the baken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou offer</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">that is anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in his stead shall offer</w> it: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03632">it shall be wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">burnt</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">For every meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">shall be wholly burnt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be eaten</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04725">In the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">where the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">shall the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">The priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that offereth it for sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">it: in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall it be eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whatsoever shall touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall be holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when there is sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thereof upon any garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that whereon it was sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02789">But the earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">wherein it is sodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and if it be sodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">in a brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">pot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04838" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">it shall be both scoured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and rinsed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02145">All the males</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">among the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> thereof: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 6:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">And no sin offering</w>, whereof <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to reconcile</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be eaten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen127" osisID="Lev.6"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:1
verses.text: Likewise this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">In the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where they kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">the trespass offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall he sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">of it all the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0451">thereof; the rump</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> on them, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03689">by the flanks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03516">above the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03629">with the kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall he take away</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">them upon the altar</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">a trespass offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02145">Every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">among the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof: it shall be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">As the sin offering</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">the trespass offering</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for them: the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that maketh atonement</w> therewith shall have <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">shall have to himself the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he hath offered</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">And all the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that is baken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">in the oven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and all that is dressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04802">in the fryingpan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04227">and in the pan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">shall be the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that offereth</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the pan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on the flat plate</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">slice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">And every meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02720">and dry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">have, one</w> <transChange type="added">as much</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">as another</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:11
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If he offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">it for a thanksgiving</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">with the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">of thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04682">and unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07550">wafers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02471">and cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07246" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fried</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02471">Besides the cakes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall offer</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">leavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">with the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">of thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of his peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And of it he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">out of the whole oblation</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">it shall be the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sprinkleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of his peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">for thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">that it is offered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">any of it until the morning</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02077">But if the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">of his offering</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">or a voluntary offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">his sacrifice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04283">and on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">also the remainder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of it shall be eaten</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">But the remainder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:18
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of his peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be accepted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither shall it be imputed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto him that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06292">it: it shall be an abomination</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">his iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">any unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be eaten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">and as for the flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">all that be clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> thereof.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">But the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that eateth</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>, that <transChange type="added">pertain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02932">having his uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">upon him, even that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Moreover the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">any unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02932">the uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, or <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08263">or any abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>, which <transChange type="added">pertain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">even that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">no manner of fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">of ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03775">or of sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">or of goat</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02459">And the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of the beast that dieth of itself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02966">of that which is torn with beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be used</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in any other use</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but ye shall in no wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> of it.<note type="study"><catchWord>beast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">carcase</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For whosoever eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of the beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of which men offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">even the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eateth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">no manner of blood</w>, <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05775">of fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">or of beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">in any of your dwellings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Whatsoever soul</w> <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03605">any manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">even that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 7:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of his peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of his peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">His own hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-78">the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-78">made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">with the breast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall he bring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02373">that the breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">may be waved</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02373">but the breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">shall be Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03225">And the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of your peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">He among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">shall have the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w> for <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04490">part</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08573">For the wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">and the heave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">from off the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of their peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">them unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">by a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>This <transChange type="added">is the portion</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04888">of the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04888">and of the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-79">out of the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-79">made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them to minister unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in the priest’s office</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 7:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he anointed</w> them, <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout their generations</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 7:37
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">of the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0817">and of the trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04394">and of the consecrations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and of the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 7:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">their oblations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen128" osisID="Lev.7"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">with him, and the garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04888">and the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06499">and a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05536">and a basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-80">And gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">thou all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-80">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">him; and the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto the congregation</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be done</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">them with water</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">upon him the coat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H073">him with the girdle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">him with the robe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and he girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02805">him with the curious girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">of the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0640" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> unto him therewith.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him: also he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02833">in the breastplate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0224">the Urim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08550">and the Thummim</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">the mitre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04701">also upon the mitre</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04136 strong:H06440">upon his forefront</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">plate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">crown</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> and all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therein, and sanctified</w> them.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thereof upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all his vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03595">both the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">and his foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sanctify</w> them.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">of the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">upon Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him, to sanctify</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coats</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them, and girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H073">them with girdles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04021">bonnets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon them; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put bonnets</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bound bonnets</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for the sin offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for the sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he slew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his finger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and purified</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">it, to make reconciliation</w> upon it.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">all the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">upon the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <transChange type="added">above</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03516">the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and their fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">burned</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06499">But the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">and his hide</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06569">and his dung</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for the burnt offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he killed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">into pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05409">and the pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06309">and the fat</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:21
