verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03767">and the legs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the whole ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of consecration</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he slew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it, and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08571">upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the thumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the great toe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08571">upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of their right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the thumbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of their right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the great toes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of their right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0451">and the rump</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and all the fat</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">upon the inwards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <transChange type="added">above</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03516">the liver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and their fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05536">And out of the basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02471">and a cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">bread, and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07550">wafer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02459">on the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and upon the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">all upon Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and upon his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and waved</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">them from off their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and burnt</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">upon the burnt offering</w>: they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04394">consecrations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">the breast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and waved</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of consecration</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">it was Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">part</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">of the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and of the blood</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and sprinkled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">upon Aaron</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">upon his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and upon his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and upon his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him; and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w> with him.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">it with the bread</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05536">in the basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of consecrations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as I commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> it.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And that which remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">and of the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04394">of your consecration</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be at an end</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">for seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he consecrate</w> you.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">As he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore shall ye abide</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">not: for so I am commanded</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 8:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">So Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen129" osisID="Lev.8"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">And it came to pass on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01241">thee a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and offer</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">ye a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05695">and a calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">and a lamb</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">Also a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">for peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04503">and a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">will appear</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they brought</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05712">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye should do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall appear</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">thy sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and thy burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for thyself, and for the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for them; as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> for himself.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him: and he dipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">his finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">out the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">at the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02459">But the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03629">and the kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H03516">the liver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">and the hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">unto him the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And they presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">unto him, with the pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thereof, and the head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he burnt</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the inwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03767">and the legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and burnt</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">upon the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">the goat</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it, and offered it for sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">as the first</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">it according to the manner</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>manner</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ordinance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">an handful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and burnt</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of the morning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>took…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled his hand out of it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">also the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">and the ram</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">unto him the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02459">And the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">and of the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0451">the rump</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04374">and that which covereth</w> <transChange type="added">the inwards</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03629">and the kidneys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03508">and the caul</w> <transChange type="added">above</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03516">the liver</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">upon the breasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02373">And the breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">and the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">waved</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">toward the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w>: <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">when all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shouted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on their faces</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen130" osisID="Lev.9"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05070">And Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">either</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">of them his censer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">therein</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereon, and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> them not.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Then Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, This <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I will be sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">in them that come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me, and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I will be glorified</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">held his peace</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04332">Mishael</w> <w lemma="strong:H0469">and Elzaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05816">of Uzziel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">the uncle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Come near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they went near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">them in their coats</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">and unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">and unto Ithamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">not your heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06533" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">your clothes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest ye die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lest wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">come upon all the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">but let your brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bewail</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath kindled</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">from the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest ye die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04888">for the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon you. And they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Do not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">nor strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, nor thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with thee, when ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest ye die</w>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And that ye may put difference</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">between holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02455">and unholy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">and between unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and clean</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And that ye may teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">all the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto them by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">and unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">and unto Ithamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-81">of the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-81">made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">it without leaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">it in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy due</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">due</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-82">of the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-82">made by fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">for so I am commanded</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08573">And the wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">and heave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">in a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, and thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> with thee: for <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy due</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">due</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">out of the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08641">The heave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">and the wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall they bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">with the offerings made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">of the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to wave</w> <transChange type="added">it for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and it shall be thine, and thy sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">with thee, by a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">the goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and, behold, it was burnt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he was angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">with Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <transChange type="added">alive</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore have ye not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, seeing it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>, and <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it you to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: Leviticus 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02005">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">of it was not brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">in within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye should indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">it in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as I commanded</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">and their burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and such things have befallen</w> me: and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should it have been accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: Leviticus 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he was content</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen131" osisID="Lev.10"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and to Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w> unto them,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02063">These</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">among all the beasts</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Whatsoever parteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">the hoof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08157 strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and is clovenfooted</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">cheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">among the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall ye eat</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0389">Nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">these shall ye not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of them that chew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">or of them that divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">the hoof</w>: <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01581">the camel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">because he cheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">not the hoof</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08227">And the coney</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">because he cheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">not the hoof</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0768">And the hare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">because he cheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">not the hoof</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02386">And the swine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">though he divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">the hoof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08157 strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and be clovenfooted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">yet he cheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">not the cud</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> to you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">Of their flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye not eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05038">and their carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye not touch</w>; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> to you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">These shall ye eat</w> of all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05579">whatsoever hath fins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">and scales</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">and in the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them shall ye eat</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05579">And all that have not fins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">and scales</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">and in the rivers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08318">of all that move</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and of any living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thing</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>, they <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08263">an abomination</w> unto you:

verses.name: Leviticus 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08263">They shall be even an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you; ye shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of their flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05038">but ye shall have their carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">in abomination</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05579">Whatsoever hath no fins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">nor scales</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>, that <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08263">an abomination</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are they which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye shall have in abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">the fowls</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be eaten</w>, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08263">an abomination</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05404">the eagle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06538">and the ossifrage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05822">and the ospray</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01676">And the vulture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0344">and the kite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06158">Every raven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">And the owl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08464">and the night hawk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07828">and the cuckow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05322">and the hawk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03563">And the little owl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07994">and the cormorant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03244">and the great owl</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08580">And the swan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06893">and the pelican</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07360">and the gier eagle</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02624">And the stork</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0601">the heron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after her kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01744">and the lapwing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05847">and the bat</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05775">All fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">that creep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going</w> upon <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08263">an abomination</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet these may ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">of every flying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">creeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thing that goeth</w> upon <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03767">which have legs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to leap</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">withal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 11:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">these of them ye may eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0697">the locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05556">and the bald locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02728">and the beetle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02284">and the grasshopper</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:23
verses.text: But all <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05775">flying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">creeping things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">which have four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08263">an abomination</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And for these ye shall be unclean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And whosoever beareth</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">of them shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The carcases</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">the hoof</w>, and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08156 strong:H08157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not clovenfooted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">nor cheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto you: every one that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them shall be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01992 strong:H03605">And whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">upon his paws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">among all manner of beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that go</w> on <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>, those <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto you: whoso toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">their carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">of them shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>: they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These also <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">unto you among the creeping things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02467">the weasel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05909">and the mouse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06632">and the tortoise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 11:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0604">And the ferret</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">and the chameleon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03911">and the lizard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02546">and the snail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08580">and the mole</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:31
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">to you among all that creep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever doth touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">them, when they be dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:32
verses.text: And upon whatsoever <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of them, when they are dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall be unclean</w>; whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">any vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">or raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">or skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08242">or sack</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">whatsoever vessel</w> <transChange type="added">it be</transChange>, wherein <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">it must be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">into water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so it shall be cleansed</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02789">And every earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>, whereinto <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432 strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them falleth</w>, whatsoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in it shall be unclean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall break</w> it.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0400">Of all meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which may be eaten</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> on which <transChange type="added">such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04945">and all drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that may be drunk</w> in every <transChange type="added">such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:35
verses.text: And every <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> whereupon <transChange type="added">any part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of their carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>; <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08574">oven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03600">or ranges</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">for pots, they shall be broken down</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">and shall be unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04599">Nevertheless a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">or pit</w>, <transChange type="added">wherein there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04723">plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">shall be clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but that which toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">their carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wherein…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a gathering together of waters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 11:37
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">any part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of their carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02221">upon any sowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which is to be sown</w>, it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:38
verses.text: But if <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">upon the seed</w>, and <transChange type="added">any part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of their carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fall</w> thereon, it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">And if any beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0402">of which ye may eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">of the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">of it shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he also that beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">of it shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08318">And every creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08263">an abomination</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be eaten</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whatsoever goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01512">upon the belly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and whatsoever goeth</w> upon <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">or whatsoever hath more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">among all creeping things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them ye shall not eat</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08263">an abomination</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">doth multiply feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 11:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-83">Ye shall not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">yourselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-83">abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">with any creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02933" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">neither shall ye make yourselves unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">with them, that ye should be defiled</w> thereby.<note type="study"><catchWord>yourselves abominable</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">your souls</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 11:44
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">and ye shall be holy</w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shall ye defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">yourselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">with any manner of creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:45
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you up out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">to be your God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06918">ye shall therefore be holy</w>, for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 11:46
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and of the fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and of every living</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that moveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and of every creature</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 11:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To make a difference</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">between the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and between the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that may be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that may not be eaten</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen132" osisID="Lev.11"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">If a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have conceived seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and born</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a man child</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then she shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">according to the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of the separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01738" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for her infirmity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall she be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">And in the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">of his foreskin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be circumcised</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she shall then continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">of her purifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she shall touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">no hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thing, nor come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">until the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02892">of her purifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be fulfilled</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if she bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">a maid child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then she shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">two weeks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05079">as in her separation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she shall continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">of her purifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And when the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02892">of her purifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are fulfilled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">for a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">or for a daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">she shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08449">or a turtledove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>of the first…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a son of his year</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Who shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for her; and she shall be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04726">from the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of her blood</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for her that hath born</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">or a female</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H01767 strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if she be not able to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">a lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then she shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">turtles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">or two young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for her, and she shall be clean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>she be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">her hand find not sufficiency of</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen133" osisID="Lev.12"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">When a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">shall have in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07613">a rising</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05597">a scab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0934">or bright spot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">and it be in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">then he shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">or unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>rising</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">swelling</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">on the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w>: and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08181">the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">in the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">and the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">in sight</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">a plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">on him, and pronounce him unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0934">If the bright spot</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">and in sight</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06013">not deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08181">and the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof be not turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall shut</w> up <transChange type="added">him that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">on him the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be at a stay</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">not in the skin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">him up seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">more</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">on him again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03544">somewhat dark</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">not in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him clean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04556">a scab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04556">But if the scab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">spread much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that he hath been seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">for his cleansing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he shall be seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">again</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:8
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04556">that, behold, the scab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spreadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him unclean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06883">a leprosy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05061">When the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">is in a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">then he shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07613">the rising</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it have turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>, and <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04241">quick</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">raw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07613">in the rising</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>quick…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the quickening of living flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:11
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">an old</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall not shut</w> him up: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06883">And if a leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">break out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06883">and the leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">all the skin</w> of <transChange type="added">him that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">even to his foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">wheresoever the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H04758">looketh</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall consider</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06883">the leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">all his flesh</w>, he shall pronounce <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">clean</w> <transChange type="added">that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it is all turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">But when</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">raw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">appeareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in him, he shall be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the raw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and pronounce him to be unclean</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the raw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06883">a leprosy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:16
