verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Or if the raw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">unto white</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> him: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">into white</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> shall pronounce <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">clean</w> <transChange type="added">that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01320">The flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">also, in which</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">thereof, was a boil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and is healed</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">And in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">of the boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">there be a white</w> <w lemma="strong:H07613">rising</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0934">or a bright spot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0125">and somewhat reddish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it be shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">to the priest</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And if, when the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seeth</w> it, behold, it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">in sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08181">and the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him unclean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">a plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">out of the boil</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">But if the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> on it, and, behold, <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03836">no white</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">hairs</w> therein, and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08217">not lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>, but <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03544">somewhat dark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">him up seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And if it spread much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him unclean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">a plague</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0934">But if the bright spot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stay</w> in his place, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spread</w> not, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06867">a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">boil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Or if there be <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> whereof <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04348">burning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04241">and the quick</w> <transChange type="added">flesh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04348">that burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">have a white</w> <w lemma="strong:H0934">bright spot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0125">somewhat reddish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03836">or white</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>a hot…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a burning of fire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> upon it: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08181">the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0934">in the bright spot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>, and it <transChange type="added">be in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06883">a leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04348">out of the burning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">wherefore the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him unclean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">But if the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> on it, and, behold, <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03836">no white</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0934">in the bright spot</w>, and it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08217">no lower</w> than the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skin</w>, but <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03544">somewhat dark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">him up seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">upon him the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">if it be spread much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him unclean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0934">And if the bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0934">spot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stay</w> in his place, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">not in the skin</w>, but it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03544">somewhat dark</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07613">a rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H04348">of the burning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him clean</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06867">an inflammation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04348">of the burning</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">have a plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">or the beard</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w>: and, behold, if it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">in sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>; <transChange type="added">and there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06669">in it a yellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01851">thin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">hair</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him unclean</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05424">a dry scall</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06883">a leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">or beard</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And if the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">on the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05424">of the scall</w>, and, behold, it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">not in sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>, and <transChange type="added">that there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07838">no black</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">in it; then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall shut</w> up <transChange type="added">him that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05424">of the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">on the plague</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05424">the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06669">not, and there be in it no yellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">hair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05424">and the scall</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">not in sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">He shall be shaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05424">but the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he not shave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall shut</w> up <transChange type="added">him that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05424">the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">more</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05424">on the scall</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05424">the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be not spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, nor <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">in sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">than the skin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05424">But if the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">his cleansing</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05424">on him: and, behold, if the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01239" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall not seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06669">for yellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">hair</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05424">But if the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">be in his sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">at a stay</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07838">there is black</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">grown</w> <w lemma="strong:H05424">up therein; the scall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is healed</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall pronounce him clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">also or a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">have in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of their flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0934">bright spots</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H0934">bright spots</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0934">the bright spots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of their flesh</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03544">darkish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0933">a freckled spot</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">groweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588 strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">whose hair is fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">off his head</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07142">bald</w>; <transChange type="added">yet is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">he clean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hair…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">head is pilled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And he that hath his hair fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">off from the part</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward his face</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01371">forehead bald</w>: <transChange type="added">yet is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">he clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07146">And if there be in the bald head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01372">or bald forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03836">a white</w> <w lemma="strong:H0125">reddish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">sore</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06883">a leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sprung</w> <w lemma="strong:H07146">up in his bald head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01372">or his bald forehead</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> upon it: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07613">the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">of the sore</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03836">white</w> <w lemma="strong:H0125">reddish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07146">in his bald head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01372">or in his bald forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06883">as the leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">appeareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">in the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">He is a leprous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">shall pronounce him utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unclean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05061">his plague</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in his head</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And the leper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">in whom the plague</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06533" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall be rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall put a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08222">upon his upper lip</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">Unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">All the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">wherein the plague</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in him he shall be defiled</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">alone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04186">his habitation</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:47
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0899">The garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">also that the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w> is in, <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06785">a woollen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06593">or a linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garment</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:48
verses.text: Whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08359">in the warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06154">or woof</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06593">of linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06785">or of woollen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05785">whether in a skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">or in any thing made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skin</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>thing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">work of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05061">And if the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H03422">be greenish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0125">or reddish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">in the garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">or in the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">either</w> <w lemma="strong:H08359">in the warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06154">or in the woof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">or in any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skin</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">a plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and shall be shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>thing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessel</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">instrument</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">upon the plague</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shut</w> up <transChange type="added">it that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">on the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05061">if the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">in the garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08359">either in the warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06154">or in the woof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">or in a skin</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in any work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that is made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03992" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a fretting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">leprosy</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He shall therefore burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">that garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08359">whether warp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06154">or woof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06785">in woollen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">or in linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">or any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">wherein the plague</w> is: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03992" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a fretting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">leprosy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And if the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall look</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">and, behold, the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be not spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">in the garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">either</w> <w lemma="strong:H08359">in the warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H06154">in the woof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skin</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 13:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that they wash</w> <transChange type="added">the thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">wherein the plague</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">it up seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">more</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">on the plague</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8718">that it is washed</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his colour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">and the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be not spread</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it in the fire</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06356">fret</w> inward, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07146">bare within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01372">or without</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whether…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whether it be bald in the head thereof, or in the forehead thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 13:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And if the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">look</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">and, behold, the plague</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03544">somewhat dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8718">the washing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of it; then he shall rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">it out of the garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">or out of the skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08359">or out of the warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06154">or out of the woof</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 13:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And if it appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">still</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">in the garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08359">either in the warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06154">or in the woof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">or in any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skin</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a spreading</w> <transChange type="added">plague</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">that wherein the plague</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">And the garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08359">either warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06154">or woof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">or whatsoever thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skin</w> <transChange type="added">it be</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which thou shalt wash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">if the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">from them, then it shall be washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">time, and shall be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 13:59
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">of the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">in a garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">of woollen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">or linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08359">either in the warp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06154">or woof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">or any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to pronounce it clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">or to pronounce it unclean</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen134" osisID="Lev.13"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">This shall be the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">of the leper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">of his cleansing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">He shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall look</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in the leper</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then shall the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">for him that is to be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0231">and hyssop</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>birds</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sparrows</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall command</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">that one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">of the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">in an earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">over running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">As for the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">it, and the cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and the scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0231">and the hyssop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall dip</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">them and the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">of the bird</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">over the running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">upon him that is to be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">from the leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall pronounce him clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and shall let the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">into the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon the face of the field</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And he that is to be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">off all his hair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">himself in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he may be clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">out of his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">But it shall be on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he shall shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">all his hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">off his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">and his beard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H01354">and his eyebrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08181">even all his hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">off: and he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">And on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">he lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">ewe lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03849">log</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the daughter of her year</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> that maketh <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall present</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that is to be made clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and those things, before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">he lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">him for a trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03849">and the log</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and wave</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where he shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">and the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02403">for as the sin offering</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest’s</w>, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">the trespass offering</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08571">upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">of him that is to be cleansed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the thumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the great toe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03849">of the log</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pour</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">into the palm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of his own</w> <w lemma="strong:H08042">left hand</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dip</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">in the oil</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08042">in his left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And of the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">shall the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08571">upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">of him that is to be cleansed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the thumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the great toe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">upon the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">in the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">of him that is to be cleansed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">for him that is to be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">from his uncleanness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for him, and he shall be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:21
verses.text: And if he <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01800">poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381 strong:H03027" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and cannot get</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so much; then he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">a trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">to be waved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for him, and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">for a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03849">and a log</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>cannot…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his hand reach not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a waving</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">turtledoves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381 strong:H03027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">such as he is able to get</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">shall be a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08066">them on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">for his cleansing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03849">and the log</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall wave</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08571">upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">of him that is to be cleansed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the thumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the great toe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">into the palm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of his own</w> <w lemma="strong:H08042">left hand</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">with his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">finger</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08042">in his left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08571">upon the tip</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">of him that is to be cleansed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the thumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0931">and upon the great toe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">of his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of the oil</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">in the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">of him that is to be cleansed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">of the turtledoves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">or of the young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">such as</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381 strong:H03027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he can get</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:31
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">such as he</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">is able to get</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">with the meat offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">for him that is to be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:32
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <transChange type="added">of him</transChange> in whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">whose hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">is not able to get</w> <transChange type="added">that which pertaineth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02893">to his cleansing</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When ye be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">to you for a possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in a house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of your possession</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And he that owneth the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">It seemeth</w> to me <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">as it were a plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall command</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that they empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">before the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <transChange type="added">into it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w>, that all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not made unclean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>empty</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prepare</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">on the plague</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07023">in the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08258">with hollow strakes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03422">greenish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0125">or reddish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">which in sight</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08217">lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">than</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">the wall</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">to the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">up the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall look</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">in the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall command</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that they take</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">away the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">in which</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">them into an unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And he shall cause the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07106" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be scraped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">out the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07096" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that they scrape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">off without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">into an unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08478">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of those stones</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">morter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall plaister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05061">And if the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">away the stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07096" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he hath scraped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">it is plaistered</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 14:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and look</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03992" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a fretting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of it, and the timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">thereof, and all the morter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>; and he shall carry <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">into an unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Moreover he that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the while</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that it is shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">up shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And if the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8799">shall come in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and look</w> <transChange type="added">upon it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">and, behold, the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06581" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was plaistered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">shall pronounce the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">because the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is healed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in coming in shall come in</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 14:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">birds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0231">and hyssop</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">of the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">in an earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">over running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">the cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0231">and the hyssop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and the scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dip</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">them in the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and in the running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">of the bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and with the running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and with the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">bird</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and with the cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0231">and with the hyssop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08438 strong:H08144">and with the scarlet</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But he shall let go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">into the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 14:54
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">for all manner of plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05424">and scall</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06883">And for the leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of a garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and of a house</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 14:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07613">And for a rising</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05597">and for a scab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0934">and for a bright spot</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 14:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">when</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and when</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when it is unclean…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the day of the unclean, and in the day of the clean</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen135" osisID="Lev.14"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and to Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them, When any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath a running issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">out of his flesh</w>, <transChange type="added">because of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02101">his issue</w> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>running…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">running of the reins</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02932">And this shall be his uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">in his issue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">whether his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07325" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">with his issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">or his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">be stopped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">from his issue</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02932">his uncleanness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04904">Every bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereon he lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hath the issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is unclean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03627">and every thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereon he sitteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">his bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that sitteth</w> on <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereon he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hath the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that hath the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And if he that hath the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07556" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">upon him that is clean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">then he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04817">And what saddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">soever he rideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon that hath the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">any thing that was under him shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that beareth</w> <transChange type="added">any of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">those things shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And whomsoever he toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hath the issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath not rinsed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627">And the vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">of earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which hath the issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03627">and every vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be rinsed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And when he that hath an issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">of his issue</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">to himself seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">for his cleansing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">in running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">And on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">to him two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">turtledoves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">them unto the priest</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them, the one</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">for his issue</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if any man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07902">of copulation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from him, then he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">all his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">And every garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">and every skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">whereon is the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07902">of copulation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">shall be washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">The woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">also with whom man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lie</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07902">of copulation</w>, they shall <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bathe</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">And if a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have an issue</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02101">her issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in her flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">be blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05079">she shall be put apart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in her separation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And every thing that she lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">upon in her separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">every thing also that she sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon shall be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">her bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:23
verses.text: And if it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> on <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04904">bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">or on any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereon she sitteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, he shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with her at all</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05079">and her flowers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be upon him, he shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04904">and all the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereon he lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:25
