verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And if a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">an issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of her blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">of the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of her separation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or if it run</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">beyond the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of her separation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">of the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">of her uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shall be as the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of her separation</w>: she <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04904">Every bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereon she lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">of her issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">shall be unto her as the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of her separation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03627">and whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">upon shall be unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02932">as the uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of her separation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">those things shall be unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But if she be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">of her issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then she shall number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">to herself seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she shall be clean</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">And on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto her two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">turtles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">them unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">to the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for her before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">for the issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">of her uncleanness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thus shall ye separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">from their uncleanness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">not in their uncleanness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when they defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">my tabernacle</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: Leviticus 15:32
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that hath an issue</w>, and <transChange type="added">of him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07902 strong:H02233">whose seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from him, and is defiled</w> therewith;

verses.name: Leviticus 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01739">And of her that is sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of her flowers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of him that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02101">an issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">of the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05347">and of the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and of him</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">with her that is unclean</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen136" osisID="Lev.15"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">not at all times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">into the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">upon the ark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not: for I will appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">in the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">upon the mercy</w> seat.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02063">Thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">shall Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">into the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">with a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">coat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0906">and he shall have the linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04370">breeches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">upon his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall be girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with a linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H073">girdle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0906">and with the linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04701">mitre</w> <w lemma="strong:H06801" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he be attired</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01992">these</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore shall he wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put them on</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">kids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">his bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01157">for himself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for himself, and for his house</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and present</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">goats</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05799">for the scapegoat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scapegoat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Azazel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">the goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon which the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and offer</w> him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fell</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08163">But the goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01486">on which the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05799">to be the scapegoat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> with him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05799">for a scapegoat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for himself, and shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for himself, and for his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for himself:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">a censer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784" type="x-split-84">of burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784" type="x-split-84">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">from off the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02651">and his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">of sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01851">beaten small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">the incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">upon the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">that the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">of the incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">may cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05715">upon the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he die</w> not:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">upon the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall he kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">the goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with that blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">it upon the mercy seat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">the mercy seat</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02932">because of the uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">and because of their transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">in all their sins</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and so shall he do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among them in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">of their uncleanness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>remaineth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dwelleth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And there shall be no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he come out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have made an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for himself, and for his household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and for all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto the altar</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it; and shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">of the goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">upon the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">upon it with his finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">it, and hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">it from the uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And when he hath made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of reconciling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">and the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the live</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">goat</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the live</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">over him all the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">and all their transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">in all their sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">putting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">them upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">of the goat</w>, and shall send <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06261">of a fit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a fit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of opportunity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08163">And the goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">upon him all their iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01509">not inhabited</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall let go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">the goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of separation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">the linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">into the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall leave</w> them there:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">his burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for himself, and for the people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02459">And the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And he that let go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">the goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05799">for the scapegoat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06499">And the bullock</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08163">and the goat</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">whose blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, shall <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">carry forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">their skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and their flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06569">and their dung</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">shall be a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> unto you: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">on the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">no work</w> at all, <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0249">one of your own country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> you:

verses.name: Leviticus 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For on that day</w> shall <transChange type="added">the priest</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for you, to cleanse</w> you, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye may be clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from all your sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:31
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">a sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07677">of rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto you, and ye shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">by a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom he shall anoint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and whom he shall consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister in the priest’s office</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">stead, shall make the atonement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">the linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">clothes</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>consecrate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fill his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 16:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and for the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and for all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 16:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05769">And this shall be an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto you, to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for all their sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">once</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">a year</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen137" osisID="Lev.16"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> unto them; This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> soever <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">an ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03775">or lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">or goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or that killeth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">it not unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be imputed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto that man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">To the end that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">their sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which they offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">even that they may bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and offer</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall no more offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">their sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">unto devils</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whom they have gone a whoring</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02708">This shall be a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto them throughout their generations</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them, Whatsoever man</w> <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you, that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">or sacrifice</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">it not unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">even that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from among his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And whatsoever man</w> <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">any manner of blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will even set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut him off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">For the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it to you upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for your souls</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">maketh an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the soul</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">No soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of you shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">neither shall any stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And whatsoever man</w> <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, which hunteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">and catcheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">any beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">or fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that may be eaten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall even pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">out the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thereof, and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">it with dust</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that hunteth any hunting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:14
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> of it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof: therefore I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of no manner of flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thereof: whosoever eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And every soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">that which died</w> <transChange type="added">of itself</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02966">or that which was torn</w> <transChange type="added">with beasts</transChange>, <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0249">one of your own country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he shall both wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall he be clean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that which died…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a carcase</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But if he wash</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, nor bathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">his iniquity</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen138" osisID="Lev.17"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, I am the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">After the doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein ye dwelt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye not do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04639">and after the doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whither I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, shall ye not do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in their ordinances</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">mine ordinances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> therein: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye shall therefore keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and my judgments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall live</w> in them: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">None of you shall approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to any</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">that is near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of kin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to him, to uncover</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>near…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">remainder of his flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06172">The nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06172">or the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou not uncover</w>: she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thy mother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06172">The nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou not uncover</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06172">The nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of thy sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">or daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother</w>, <transChange type="added">whether she be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04138">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">at home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04138">or born</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06172">their nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not uncover</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06172">The nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">or of thy daughter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06172">their nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not uncover</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02007">for theirs</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06172">thine own nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06172">The nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04138">begotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">thy sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>: she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">near kinswoman</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>: for she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">near kinswoman</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to his wife</w>: she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01733">thine aunt</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">of thy daughter in law</w>: she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">or her daughter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07608">her near kinswomen</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02154">wickedness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">to her sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to vex</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">beside the other in her life</w> <transChange type="added">time</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a wife…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">one wife to another</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also thou shalt not approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05079">as long as she is put apart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">for her uncleanness</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover thou shalt not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07903">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">carnally</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">with thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to defile</w> thyself with her.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">let any of thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">pass</w> through <transChange type="added">the fire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04432">to Molech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shalt thou profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Molech</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Moloch</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">with mankind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04904">as with</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">womankind</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H07903">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">with any beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thyself therewith: neither shall any woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">a beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07250" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lie down</w> thereto: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08397">confusion</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">not ye yourselves in any of these things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">for in all these the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> you:

verses.name: Leviticus 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is defiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore I do visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thereof upon it, and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06958" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">itself vomiteth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">her inhabitants</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye shall therefore keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not commit</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of these abominations</w>; <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0249">any of your own nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">nor any stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> you:

verses.name: Leviticus 18:27
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H0411">For all these</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">have the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you, and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is defiled</w>;)

verses.name: Leviticus 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">That the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06958" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">spue not you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">also, when ye defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H06958" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, as it spued out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> you.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For whosoever shall commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">any of these abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">even the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that commit</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">their people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore shall ye keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">mine ordinance</w>, that <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">commit</w> not <transChange type="added">any one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of these abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">customs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which were committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">you, and that ye defile</w> not yourselves therein: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen139" osisID="Lev.18"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">unto them, Ye shall be holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">ye not unto idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">to yourselves molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">it at your own will</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">It shall be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">it, and on the morrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and if ought remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">until the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And if it be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06292">abominable</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be accepted</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:8
verses.text: Therefore <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">his iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the hallowed thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">and that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from among his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when ye reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">the harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of your land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not wholly reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of thy field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shalt thou gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03951">the gleanings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of thy harvest</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">And thou shalt not glean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">thy vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shalt thou gather</w> <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06528">grape</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of thy vineyard</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">them for the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">and stranger</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not steal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither deal falsely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">to another</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And ye shall not swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither shalt thou profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not defraud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither rob</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06468">the wages</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">of him that is hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">with thee all night until the morning</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H02795">the deaf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">a stumblingblock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">the blind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but shalt fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">no unrighteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the person</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01921" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the person</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the mighty</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">thy neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not go</w> up and down <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07400">a talebearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among thy people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shalt thou stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">against the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of thy neighbour</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thou shalt in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">thy neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">sin</w> upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that thou bear not sin for him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not avenge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor bear any grudge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou shalt love</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">as thyself</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0929">Thou shalt not let thy cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07250" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gender</w> <w lemma="strong:H03610">with a diverse kind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thy field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03610">with mingled seed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0899">neither shall a garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03610">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08162">of linen and woollen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> upon thee.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07902 strong:H02233">carnally</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with a woman</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08198">a bondmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">betrothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to an husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">and not at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">redeemed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02668">nor freedom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01244">her; she shall be scourged</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">they shall not be put to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02666" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">because she was not free</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>betrothed…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">abused by any</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">reproached by (or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg>) man</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>she shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they</rdg>, etc: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there shall be a scourging</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">his trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">for a trespass offering</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">for him with the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of the trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath done</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be forgiven</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when ye shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall have planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">all manner of trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">for food</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06188" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall count</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">thereof as uncircumcised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">shall it be as uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto you: it shall not be eaten</w> of.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">But in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">all the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">thereof shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01974">to praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness of praises to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02549">And in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thereof, that it may yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">unto you the increase</w> thereof: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not eat</w> <transChange type="added">any thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shall ye use enchantment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">nor observe times</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall not round</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of your heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither shalt thou mar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">of thy beard</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03793">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H08296">cuttings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in your flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor print</w> <w lemma="strong:H07085">any marks</w> upon you: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Do not prostitute</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thy daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cause her to be a whore</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">lest the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall to whoredom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">become full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">of wickedness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prostitute</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">profane</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reverence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">my sanctuary</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">not them that have familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03049">after wizards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be defiled</w> by them: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">the hoary head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01921" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the old man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01616">And if a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">with thee in your land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall not vex</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>vex</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oppress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:34
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0249">with you shall be unto you as one born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">among you, and thou shalt love</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">him as thyself; for ye were strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">no unrighteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">in meteyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04948">in weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04884">or in measure</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 19:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">Just</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">balances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">just</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">weights</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">ephah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">and a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">hin</w>, shall ye have: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weights</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 19:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore shall ye observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">all my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and all my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> them: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen140" osisID="Lev.19"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again, thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Whosoever</w> <transChange type="added">he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that giveth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04432">unto Molech</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:3
