verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against that man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut him off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04432">unto Molech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">my sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And if the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">do any ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">from the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04432">unto Molech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">him not</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against that man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and against his family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut him off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that go a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, to commit whoredom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04432">with Molech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">their people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05315">And the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">such as have familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03049">wizards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, I will even set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against that soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut him off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">Sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">yourselves therefore, and be ye holy</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> them: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which sanctify</w> you.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">For every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that curseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon him.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that committeth adultery</w> with <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <transChange type="added">even he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that committeth adultery</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">with his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the adulterer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the adulteress</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">their blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">with his daughter in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08397">confusion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">their blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">with mankind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04904">as he lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with a woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">their blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and her mother</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02154">wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02154">both he and they; that there be no wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> you.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07903 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">with a beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">the beast</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And if a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">unto any beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07250" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereto, thou shalt kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the beast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">their blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0176">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">his nakedness</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">a wicked thing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H05971">of their people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">his iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01739">having her sickness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">her nakedness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04726">her fountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and she hath uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04726">the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of her blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">and both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of them shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">their people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discovered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">the nakedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">nor of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he uncovereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">his near kin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>uncovereth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath made naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01733">with his uncle’s wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">his uncle’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">their sin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06185">childless</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05079">an unclean thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06185">they shall be childless</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a separation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye shall therefore keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">all my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and all my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them: that the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whither I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06958" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therein, spue you not out</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall not walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in the manners</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you: for they committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all these things, and therefore I abhorred</w> them.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you, Ye shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it unto you to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it, a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which have separated</w> you from <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Ye shall therefore put difference</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">between clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">and unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">and between unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">and ye shall not make your souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">by beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">or by fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or by any manner of living thing that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">on the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I have separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from you as unclean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>creepeth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">moveth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06918">And ye shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto me: for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have severed</w> you from <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, that ye should be mine.

verses.name: Leviticus 20:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">also or woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">a familiar spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">or that is a wizard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">them with stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">their blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen141" osisID="Lev.20"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">unto them, There shall none be defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among his people</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07607">But for his kin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07138">that is near</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">for his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and for his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and for his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and for his brother</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">And for his sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07138">that is nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, which hath had no husband</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">for her may he be defiled</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he shall not defile</w> himself, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01167">a chief man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to profane</w> himself.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">being an husband among his people, he shall not defile himself for his wife</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07139" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07144">baldness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shall they shave off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">of their beard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08295" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08296">any cuttings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in their flesh</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">They shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and not profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-85">for the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-85">made by fire</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">they do offer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06918">therefore they shall be holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a whore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">or profane</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall they take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">from her husband</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto his God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou shalt sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him therefore; for he offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06918">he shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee: for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which sanctify</w> you, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01323">And the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of any</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">if she profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">herself by playing the whore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">she profaneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">her father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">she shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:10
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">among his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon whose head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">was poured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and that is consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">on the garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06533" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shall he go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to any dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">nor defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">himself for his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">or for his mother</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shall he go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05145">for the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">of the anointing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon him: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">in her virginity</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0490">A widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or a divorced woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">or profane</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">an harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">these shall he not take</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his own people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Neither shall he profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">do sanctify</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Whosoever</w> <transChange type="added">he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in their generations</w> that hath <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him not approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bread</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">food</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">For whatsoever man</w> <transChange type="added">he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">that hath a blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not approach</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05787">a blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06455">or a lame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or he that hath a flat nose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08311" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or any thing superfluous</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Or a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272 strong:H07667">that is brokenfooted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H07667">or brokenhanded</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01384">Or crookbackt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01851">or a dwarf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08400">or that hath a blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01618">or be scurvy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03217">or scabbed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0810">or hath his stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04790">broken</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>a dwarf</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">too slender</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">No man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03971">that hath a blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-86">the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-86">made by fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03971">he hath a blemish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and of the holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Only he shall not go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">unto the vail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03971">because he hath a blemish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">not my sanctuaries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">do sanctify</w> them.

verses.name: Leviticus 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen142" osisID="Lev.21"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that they separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">themselves from the holy things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and that they profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">not my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">in those things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which they hallow</w> unto me: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them, Whosoever</w> <transChange type="added">he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of all your seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">among your generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">unto the holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02932">having his uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">upon him, that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from my presence</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">What man soever</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a leper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or hath a running issue</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until he be clean</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And whoso toucheth</w> any thing <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">or a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07902 strong:H02233">whose seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth</w> from him;<note type="study"><catchWord>running…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">running of the reins</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Or whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08318">any creeping thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereby he may be made unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">or a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of whom he may take uncleanness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02932">whatsoever uncleanness</w> he hath;

verses.name: Leviticus 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">The soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which hath touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">any such shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">unless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">And when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall be clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and shall afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy things</w>; because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">his food</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05038">That which dieth of itself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02966">or is torn</w> <transChange type="added">with beasts</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to defile</w> himself therewith: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They shall therefore keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">mine ordinance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest they bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it, and die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore, if they profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it: I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">do sanctify</w> them.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">There shall no stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08453">a sojourner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07916">or an hired servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy thing</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">But if the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">buy</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">his money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03211">of it, and he that is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of his meat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the purchase of his money</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">If the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> also be <transChange type="added">married</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02114 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">unto a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she may not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">of an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a stranger</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man a stranger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">But if the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">be a widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or divorced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and have no child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and is returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05271">as in her youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">meat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">but there shall no stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> thereof.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">unwittingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof unto it, and shall give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">with the holy thing</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they shall not profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Or suffer them to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">of trespass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">their holy things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">do sanctify</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>suffer…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lade themselves with the iniquity of trespass in their eating</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them, Whatsoever</w> <transChange type="added">he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that will offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">for all his vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">and for all his freewill offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they will offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 22:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Ye shall offer</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">at your own will</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the beeves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03775">of the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">or of the goats</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">whatsoever hath a blemish</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall ye not offer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07522">for it shall not be acceptable</w> for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to accomplish</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05088">vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">or a freewill offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">in beeves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">or sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08549">it shall be perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">to be accepted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03971">there shall be no blemish</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>sheep</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05788">Blind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or maimed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02990">or having a wen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01618">or scurvy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03217">or scabbed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall not offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">these unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of them upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">Either a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">or a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H08311" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that hath any thing superfluous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07038" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or lacking in his parts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that mayest thou offer</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05071">a freewill offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05088">but for a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be accepted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall not offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04600" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that which is bruised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or crushed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or cut</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye make</w> <transChange type="added">any offering thereof</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in your land</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05236">Neither from a stranger’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall ye offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04893">of any of these; because their corruption</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">blemishes</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">in them: they shall not be accepted</w> for you.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">When a bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03775">or a sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">or a goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is brought forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">then it shall be seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">under the dam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08066">and from the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">and thenceforth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">for an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:28
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07794">cow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">or ewe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it and her young</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">both in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ewe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">she goat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when ye will offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">of thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offer</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">at your own will</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">On the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be eaten up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">none of it until the morrow</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore shall ye keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> them: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 22:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Neither shall ye profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but I will be hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which hallow</w> you,

verses.name: Leviticus 22:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">That brought you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">to be your God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen143" osisID="Lev.22"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">Concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">the feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall proclaim</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocations</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">my feasts</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">shall work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be done</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">but the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07677">of rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">no work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">in all your dwellings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">the feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in their seasons</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">In the fourteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">passover</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">And on the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the same month</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye must eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">In the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">ye shall have an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no servile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> therein.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no servile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, When ye be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you, and shall reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">the harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, then ye shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">a sheaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">of the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of your harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>sheaf</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">handful</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">omer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">the sheaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">to be accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">for you: on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">after the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall wave</w> it.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when ye wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">the sheaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">an he lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">And the meat offering</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05262">and the drink offering</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">neither bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07039">nor parched corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03759">nor green ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02088 strong:H06106">until the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">ye have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto your God</w>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">in all your dwellings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall count</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">unto you from the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">after the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that ye brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">the sheaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">of the wave offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">complete</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05704">Even unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">after the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">of your habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">loaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deals</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05560">they shall be of fine flour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall be baken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">with leaven</w>; <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01061">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01241">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>: they shall be <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">with their meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and their drink offerings</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then ye shall sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">for a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them with the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of the firstfruits</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">with the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06944">they shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priest</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">on the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">it may be an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you: ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no servile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">in all your dwellings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when ye reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">the harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of your land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not make clean riddance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">of the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of thy field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou reapest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shalt thou gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03951">any gleaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of thy harvest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">them unto the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and to the stranger</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">In the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07677">shall ye have a sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02146">a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">of blowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of trumpets, an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no servile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0389">Also</w> <w lemma="strong:H06218">on the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of this seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03725">of atonement</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06944">it shall be an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto you; and ye shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">no work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in that same</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03725">of atonement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for you before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">For whatsoever soul</w> <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">that shall not be afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in that same</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from among his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And whatsoever soul</w> <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">any work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in that same</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">the same soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">will I destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">no manner of work</w>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">in all your dwellings</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:32
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">unto you a sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07677">of rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and ye shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your souls</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08672">in the ninth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">from even</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">unto even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye celebrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">your sabbath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>celebrate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 23:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">The fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of this seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">On the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no servile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08066">on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">shall be an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto you; and ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06116">a solemn assembly</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no servile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>solemn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">day of restraint</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:37
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04150">the feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall proclaim</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">convocations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and drink offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">every thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">upon his</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 23:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07676">Beside the sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04979">and beside your gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05088">and beside all your vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">and beside all your freewill offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">Also in the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">in the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07223">on the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07677">a sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08066">and on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07677">a sabbath</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">you on the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">of goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H08558">of palm</w> <w lemma="strong:H06057">trees, and the boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05687">of thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06155">and willows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brook</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>boughs of goodly trees</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fruit of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 23:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">it a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w>. <transChange type="added">It shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in your generations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall celebrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">it in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in booths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">all that are Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0249">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in booths</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 23:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01755">That your generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that I made the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in booths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 23:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">the feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen144" osisID="Lev.23"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02134">unto thee pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03795">beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">for the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">to cause the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to cause</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to cause to ascend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02351">Without</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">shall Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">it from the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">unto the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in your generations</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall order</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">upon the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">fine flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thereof: two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">shall be in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cake</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them in two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">rows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H04635">on a row</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">upon the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02134">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">frankincense</w> upon <transChange type="added">each</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04635">row</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">that it may be on the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0234">for a memorial</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:8
