verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07676">Every sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">he shall set it</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <transChange type="added">being taken</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">by an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And it shall be Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">it in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-87">unto him of the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-87">made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">by a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">statute</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03482">of an Israelitish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">whose father</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04713 strong:H0376">an Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03481 strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and this son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03482">of the Israelitish</w> <transChange type="added">woman</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">strove together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03482">And the Israelitish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">blasphemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <transChange type="added">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cursed</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">him unto Moses</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08019">Shelomith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01704">of Dibri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>:)

verses.name: Leviticus 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">him in ward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">that the mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06567" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might be shewed</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to expound unto them according to the mouth of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him that hath cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and let all that heard</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and let all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stone</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043 strong:H03588" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">curseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">his sin</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that blasphemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">him: as well the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0249">as he that is born in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he blasphemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <transChange type="added">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And he</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>killeth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smiteth the life of a man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And he that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929 strong:H05315">a beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall make it good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for beast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>beast for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">life for life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H03971">a blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">in his neighbour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he hath done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so shall it be done</w> to him;

verses.name: Leviticus 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07667">Breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">for breach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">for eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">tooth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">for tooth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as he hath caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H03971">a blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">in a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so shall it be done</w> to him <transChange type="added">again</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And he that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">a beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">it: and he that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">he shall be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Ye shall have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">manner of law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">as well for the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0249">as for one of your own country</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 24:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they should bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him that had cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen145" osisID="Lev.24"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, When ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you, then shall the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">a sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>keep</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thy field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02168" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt prune</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">thy vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">in the fruit</w> thereof;

verses.name: Leviticus 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">But in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">shall be a sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07677">of rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">a sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt neither sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thy field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02168" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor prune</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">thy vineyard</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05599">That which groweth of its own accord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of thy harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not reap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">the grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">of thy vine undressed</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">it is a year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07677">of rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of thy vine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of thy separation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07676">And the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0402">shall be meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for you; for thee, and for thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and for thy maid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07916">and for thy hired servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08453">and for thy stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> with thee,

verses.name: Leviticus 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">And for thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and for the beast</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08393">shall all the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof be meat</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">unto thee, seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the space</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">sabbaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">shall be unto thee forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07782">Then shalt thou cause the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">of the jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06218">on the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03725">of atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">shall ye make the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all your land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the jubile</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">loud of sound</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And ye shall hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H02572">the fiftieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01865">liberty</w> throughout <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">thereof: it shall be a jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you; and ye shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">unto his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">unto his family</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03104">A jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H02572">shall that fiftieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be unto you: ye shall not sow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H05599">that which groweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of itself in it, nor gather</w> <transChange type="added">the grapes</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05139">in it of thy vine undressed</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:12
verses.text: For it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03104">the jubile</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06944">it shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you: ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thereof out of the field</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">In the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of this jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">unto his possession</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if thou sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">unto thy neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">or buyest</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05997">of thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall not oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">another</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">According to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">the jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">of thy neighbour</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">according unto the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of the fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall sell</w> unto thee:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">According</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">the price</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thereof, and according</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the fewness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt diminish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">the price</w> of it: for <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">to the number</w> <transChange type="added">of the years</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of the fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth he sell</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall not therefore oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05997">another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou shalt fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and ye shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">her fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07648">your fill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">therein in safety</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if ye shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall we eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold, we shall not sow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">in our increase</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then I will command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">my blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">upon you in the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">for three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08066">the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03465">of old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08671">until the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08393">until her fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03465">the old</w> <transChange type="added">store</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0776">The land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06783">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine; for ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08453">and sojourners</w> with me.<note type="study"><catchWord>for ever</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to be quite cut off</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for cutting off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of your possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">a redemption</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0251">If thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04134" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be waxen poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath sold</w> away <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07138">and if any of his kin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, then shall he redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">that which his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">sold</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have none to redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it, and himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381 strong:H01767" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353 strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to redeem</w> it;<note type="study"><catchWord>himself…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his hand hath attained and found sufficiency</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then let him count</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">of the sale</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, and restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the overplus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to whom he sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it; that he may return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">unto his possession</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">But if he</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">be not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8687 strongMorph:TH8804">to restore</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04465">to him, then that which is sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">shall remain in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that hath bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">it until the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of jubile</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03104">and in the jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it shall go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">unto his possession</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">a dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">in a walled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01353">then he may redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it within a whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">after it is sold</w>; <transChange type="added">within</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a full year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">may he redeem</w> it.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And if it be not redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">within the space</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">of a full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">then the house</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">in the walled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06783">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">it throughout his generations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">in the jubile</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">But the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">which have no wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them shall be counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">as the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01353">they may be redeemed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">in the jubile</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they may…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">redemption belongeth unto it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">Notwithstanding the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of their possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">may the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">at any time</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if a man purchase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">then the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">that was sold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go out</w> in <transChange type="added">the year of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03104">jubile</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">their possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a man…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">one of the Levites redeem them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">But the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">of the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may not be sold</w>; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">their perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">possession</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0251">And if thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04134" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be waxen poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fallen in decay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thee</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then thou shalt relieve</w> him: <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <transChange type="added">though he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08453">or a sojourner</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02416">that he may live</w> with thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>fallen…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his hand faileth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>relieve</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengthen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">thou no usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H08636">of him, or increase</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">that thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">may live</w> with thee.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">him thy money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">upon usury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">him thy victuals</w> <w lemma="strong:H04768">for increase</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:38
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought you forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to be your God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:39
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0251">And if thy brother</w> <transChange type="added">that dwelleth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04134" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by thee be waxen poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; thou shalt not compel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">him to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">as a bondservant</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>compel…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">serve thyself with him with the service</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:40
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07916">as an hired servant</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08453">as a sojourner</w>, he shall be with thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">thee unto the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of jubile</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:41
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall he depart</w> from thee, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he and his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him, and shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">unto his own family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0272">and unto the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he return</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:42
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall not be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04466">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">bondmen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the sale of a bondman</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H06531">over him with rigour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but shalt fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Both thy bondmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and thy bondmaids</w>, which thou shalt have, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">that are round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you; of them shall ye buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">bondmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">and bondmaids</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Moreover of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08453">of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that do sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among you, of them shall ye buy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and of their families</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with you, which they begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in your land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0272">and they shall be your possession</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">And ye shall take them as an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, to inherit</w> <transChange type="added">them for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">a possession</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be your bondmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">but over your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">over another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06531">with rigour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ye shall serve yourselves with them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:47
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01616">And if a sojourner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08453">or stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wax rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and thy brother</w> <transChange type="added">that dwelleth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04134" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">by him wax poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">himself unto the stranger</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08453">sojourner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06133">by thee, or to the stock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">of the stranger’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">family</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>wax rich…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his hand obtain</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that he is sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">he may be redeemed again</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may redeem</w> him:

verses.name: Leviticus 25:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01730">Either his uncle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">or his uncle’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may redeem</w> him, or <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07607">that is nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of kin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">unto him of his family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him; or if he be able</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he may redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">himself</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he shall reckon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him that bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">him from the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that he was sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">to him unto the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of jubile</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the price</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">of his sale</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">shall be according unto the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">according to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">of an hired servant</w> shall it be with him.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:51
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">yet many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <transChange type="added">behind</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto them he shall give again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">the price of his redemption</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">out of the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">that he was bought</w> for.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And if there remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">but few</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">unto the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of jubile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">then he shall count</w> with him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">unto his years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he give him again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">the price of his redemption</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:53
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08141">as a yearly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">hired servant</w> shall he be with him: <transChange type="added">and the other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H06531">with rigour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">over him in thy sight</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 25:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And if he be not redeemed</w> in these <transChange type="added">years</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of jubile</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he, and his children</w> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>in these…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by these means</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 25:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For unto me the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom I brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen146" osisID="Lev.25"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">you no idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">nor graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither rear you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">a standing image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye set up</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04906">image</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in your land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to bow down</w> unto it: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>standing…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pillar</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>image of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">figured stone</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a stone of picture</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">my sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reverence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">my sanctuary</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If ye walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> them;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">you rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in due season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">her increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">their fruit</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01786">And your threshing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall reach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01210">unto the vintage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01210">and the vintage</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall reach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto the sowing time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">your bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07648">to the full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall lie down</w>, and none shall make <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will rid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">neither shall the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through your land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to cease</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall chase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">you by the sword</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And five</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of you shall chase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">of you shall put ten thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to flight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">you by the sword</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto you, and make you fruitful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you, and establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> with you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">old store</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03465">the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">of the new</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">my tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">you: and my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not abhor</w> you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">And I will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, and will be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:13
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought you forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">that ye should not be their bondmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">of your yoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made you go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06968">upright</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and will not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all these commandments</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if ye shall despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">or if your soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so that ye will not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all my commandments</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that ye break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I also will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">this unto you; I will even appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0928">over you terror</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07829">consumption</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06920">and the burning ague</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01727" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and cause sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">your seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">in vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall eat</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>over</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">against you, and ye shall be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over you; and ye shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when none pursueth</w> you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05704">And if ye will not yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for all this hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto me, then I will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">you seven times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for your sins</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of your power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">your heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">as iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and your earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05154">as brass</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03581">And your strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be spent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">in vain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">her increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">neither shall the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">their fruits</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if ye walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07147">contrary</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and will</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-88">unto me; I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-88">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">plagues</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">upon you according to your sins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>contrary…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">at all adventures with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will also send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">among you, which shall rob you of your children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">your cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and make you few in number</w>; and your <transChange type="added">high</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be desolate</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And if ye will not be reformed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by me by these things, but will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07147">contrary</w> unto me;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will I also walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07147">contrary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto you, and will punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">you yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for your sins</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon you, that shall avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">the quarrel</w> of <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and when ye are gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">your cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">the pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">you; and ye shall be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I have broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of your bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall bake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">your bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">oven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-89">and they shall deliver</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">your bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-89">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not be satisfied</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02063">And if ye will not for all this</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, but walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07147">contrary</w> unto me;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then I will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07147">contrary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">unto you also in fury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0637">and I, even</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I, will chastise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">you seven times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for your sins</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye eat</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">your high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02553">your images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">your carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">upon the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">of your idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall abhor</w> you.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">your cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-90">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">your sanctuaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-90">unto desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will not smell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">the savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">of your sweet odours</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-91">And I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-91">into desolation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein shall be astonished</w> at it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I will scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">you among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you: and your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08077">shall be desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and your cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">waste</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Then shall the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">her sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as long</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">as it lieth desolate</w>, and ye <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in your enemies’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">then shall the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">her sabbaths</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">As long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">it lieth desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall rest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because it did not rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">in your sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye dwelt</w> upon it.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And upon them that are left</w> <transChange type="added">alive</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of you I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04816">a faintness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">into their hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of a shaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall chase</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and they shall flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04499">as fleeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">from a sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when none pursueth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shaken</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">driven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Leviticus 26:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">upon another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">as it were before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when none pursueth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08617">and ye shall have no power to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your enemies</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall eat you up</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And they that are left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of you shall pine away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in their iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in your enemies’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">lands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05771">and also in the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall they pine away</w> with them.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">If they shall confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">and the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04604">with their trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me, and that also they have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07147">contrary</w> unto me;

verses.name: Leviticus 26:41
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I also have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07147">contrary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto them, and have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0176">if then</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">their uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be humbled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they then accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of the punishment of their iniquity</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 26:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will I remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">with Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and also my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">with Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and also my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">with Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I remember</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also shall be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, and shall enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">her sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">while she lieth desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">without them: and they shall accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">of the punishment of their iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03282">because</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03282">even because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and because their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">And yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">for all that</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01571">when they be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will not cast them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither will I abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, to destroy them utterly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> with them: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I will for their sakes remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of their ancestors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom I brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that I might be their God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 26:46
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">and laws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">between him and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen147" osisID="Lev.26"/>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Leviticus 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them, When a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall make a singular</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">the persons</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">by thy estimation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06187">And thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">shall be of the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">even unto sixty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">even thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">shall be fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:4
verses.text: And if it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05347">a female</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">then thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">shall be thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:5
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">from five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">even unto twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">then thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">shall be of the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05347">and for the female</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:6
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">even unto five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">then thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">shall be of the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05347">and for the female</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">thy estimation</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:7
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">from sixty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and above</w>; if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a male</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">then thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">shall be fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05347">and for the female</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04134" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But if he be poorer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">than thy estimation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall present</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">himself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall value</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">him; according to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381 strong:H03027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">his ability</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">shall the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">value</w> him.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:9
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">a beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whereof men bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, all that <transChange type="added">any man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of such unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">shall be holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He shall not alter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, nor change</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">it, a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for a bad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">or a bad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for a good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and if he shall at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">change</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">for beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08545">then it and the exchange</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">thereof shall be holy</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:11
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">any unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of which they do not offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall present</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>:

verses.name: Leviticus 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall value</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">it, whether</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">it be good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">bad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06187">as thou valuest</w> it, <transChange type="added">who art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, so shall it be.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to thy estimation, O priest</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But if he will at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, then he shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">a fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06187">thereof unto thy estimation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And when a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall estimate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">it, whether it be good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">or bad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">as the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall estimate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, so shall it stand</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And if he that sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it will redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">of thy estimation</w> unto it, and it shall be his.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">some part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of a field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">then thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">shall be according</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">to the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">thereof: an homer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be valued</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">at fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the land of an homer</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">If he sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">his field</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">from the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of jubile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">according to thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall stand</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But if he sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">his field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">the jubile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall reckon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">unto him the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">even unto the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of the jubile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be abated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">from thy estimation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And if he that sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, then he shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">of thy estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto it, and it shall be assured</w> to him.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if he will not redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or if he have sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be redeemed</w> any more.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:21
