verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">But the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when it goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">in the jubile</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">shall be holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">as a field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">devoted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0272">the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">thereof shall be the priest’s</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:22
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04736">which he hath bought</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">not of the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of his possession</w>;

verses.name: Leviticus 27:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall reckon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04373">unto him the worth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">of thy estimation</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">unto the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of the jubile</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">thine estimation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">a holy thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">In the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of the jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him of whom it was bought</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">to him to whom the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <transChange type="added">did belong</transChange>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06187">And all thy estimations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shall be according to the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01626">gerahs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shall be the shekel</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01060">Only the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which should be the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01069" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">firstling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall sanctify</w> it; whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">or sheep</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>firstling of</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">firstborn</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Leviticus 27:27
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">of an unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06187">according to thine estimation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">a fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">then it shall be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">according to thy estimation</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02764">Notwithstanding no devoted thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall devote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> of all that he hath, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">and of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">or redeemed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02764">every devoted thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02764">None devoted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">which shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">devoted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be redeemed</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04643">And all the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of the tree</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Leviticus 27:31

verses.name: Numbers 1:40
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">by their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the names</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that were able to go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 1:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 1:42
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">throughout their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the names</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that were able to go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 1:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 1:44

verses.name: Numbers 1:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">So were all those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that were able to go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 1:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Even all they that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">were six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 1:47
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03881">But the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">after the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8719">were not numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 1:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 1:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Only thou shalt not number</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of them among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 1:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">But thou shalt appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">over the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and over all the vessels</w> thereof, and over all things that <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to it: they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereof; and they shall minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto it, and shall encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 1:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04908">And when the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">setteth forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall take it down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04908">and when the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is to be pitched</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall set it up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07131">that cometh nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 1:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall pitch their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">by his own camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01714">by his own standard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">throughout their hosts</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 1:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">But the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07110">that there be no wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">upon the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 1:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> they. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen150" osisID="Num.1"/>

verses.name: Numbers 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01714">by his own standard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">with the ensign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05048">far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they pitch</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>far…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">over against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06924">And on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H01714">of the sun shall they of the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">throughout their armies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05177">and Nahshon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05992">of Amminadab</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702 strong:H07657">threescore and fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And those that do pitch</w> next unto him <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05417">and Nethaneel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06686">of Zuar</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:7

verses.name: Numbers 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">All that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">throughout their armies</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07223">These shall first</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set forth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08486">On the south side</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01714">the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">according to their armies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0468">Elizur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07707">of Shedeur</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:11

verses.name: Numbers 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And those which pitch</w> by him <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08017">Shelumiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06701">of Zurishaddai</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Then the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0460">Eliasaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">of Reuel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Reuel</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Deuel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 2:15

verses.name: Numbers 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">All that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">throughout their armies</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall set forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second rank</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0168">Then the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall set forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">with the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as they encamp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall they set forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01714">by their standards</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:18

verses.name: Numbers 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:20
verses.text: And by him <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01583">Gamaliel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06301">of Pedahzur</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:21

verses.name: Numbers 2:22

verses.name: Numbers 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">All that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">throughout their armies</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they shall go forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">in the third rank</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01714">The standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">by their armies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0295">Ahiezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05996">of Ammishaddai</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And those that encamp</w> by him <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06295">Pagiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05918">of Ocran</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04294">Then the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0299">Ahira</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05881">of Enan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">All they that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">hindmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H01714">with their standards</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">those which were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">all those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">throughout their hosts</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">But the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8719">were not numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 2:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so they pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01714">by their standards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and so they set forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen151" osisID="Num.2"/>

verses.name: Numbers 3:1
verses.text: These also <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">with Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:2
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05070">Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:3
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which were anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom he consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister in the priest’s office</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whom…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whose hand he filled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05070">And Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and they had no children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ministered in the priest’s office</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-93">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-93">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and present</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that they may minister</w> unto him.

verses.name: Numbers 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">his charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>: they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">wholly given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto him out of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall wait on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">their priest’s office</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07131">that cometh nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I, behold, I have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">instead of all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06363">that openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">the matrix</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">therefore the Levites</w> shall be mine;

verses.name: Numbers 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">Because all the firstborn</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> mine; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">unto me all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>: mine shall they be: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">after the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02145">every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou number</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">as he was commanded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>word</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And these were the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by their names</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01648">Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06955">and Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04847">and Merari</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:18
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03845">Libni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06019">Amram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03324">and Izehar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05816">and Uzziel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04249">Mahli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04187">and Mushi</w>. These <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H01992">are</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01648">Of Gershon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03846">of the Libnites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08097">of the Shimites</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">of the Gershonites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">of them, according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of all the males</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">those that were numbered</w> of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">The families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">of the Gershonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">of the Gershonites</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0460">Eliasaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03815">of Lael</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04931">And the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">and the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04372">the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">thereof, and the hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">for the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07050">And the hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04539">and the curtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">for the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">by the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and by the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04340">and the cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of it for all the service</w> thereof.

verses.name: Numbers 3:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06955">And of Kohath</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06020">of the Amramites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03325">of the Izeharites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02276">of the Hebronites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H05817">of the Uzzielites</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">In the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of all the males</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">The families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">southward</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0469">Elizaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05816">of Uzziel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04931">And their charge</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07979">and the table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04501">and the candlestick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherewith they minister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04539">and the hanging</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">and all the service</w> thereof.

verses.name: Numbers 3:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0499">And Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">over the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">and have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06486">the oversight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04847">Of Merari</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04250">of the Mahlites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04188">of the Mushites</w>: these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">of them, according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of all the males</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06700">Zuriel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H032">of Abihail</w>: <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:36
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">under</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06486">the custody</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">and charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07175">the boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01280">and the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">thereof, and the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0134">thereof, and the sockets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">thereof, and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">thereof, and all that serveth</w> thereto,<note type="study"><catchWord>under…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the office of the charge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 3:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05982">And the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0134">and their sockets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03489">and their pins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04340">and their cords</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But those that encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">toward the east</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">for the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07131">that cometh nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">All that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">throughout their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">all the males</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:40
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of the males</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of their names</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> for me (I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>) <w lemma="strong:H01060">instead of all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">instead of all the firstlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">among the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">him, all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">And all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">by the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of names</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of them, were twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969 strong:H07657">and threescore and thirteen</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 3:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">instead of all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">instead of their cattle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> shall be mine: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06302">And for those that are to be redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of the two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969 strong:H07657">and threescore and thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">of the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which are more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">than</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 3:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt even take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">apiece by the poll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou take</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: (<w lemma="strong:H08255">the shekel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01626">gerahs</w>:)

verses.name: Numbers 3:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherewith the odd number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06302">of them is to be redeemed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 3:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06306">the redemption</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05736" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that were over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06302">and above them that were redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">by the Levites</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 3:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">Of the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">he the money</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 3:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06306 strong:H06302" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of them that were redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen152" osisID="Num.3"/>

verses.name: Numbers 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">From thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">even until fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">into the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 4:4
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <transChange type="added">about</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 4:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04264">And when the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">setteth forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall take down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">vail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w> with it:

verses.name: Numbers 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03681">thereon the covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">of badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">over</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">in the staves</w> thereof.

verses.name: Numbers 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07979">And upon the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of shewbread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07086">thereon the dishes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04518">and the bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07184">and covers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">to cover withal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08548">and the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> shall be thereon:<note type="study"><catchWord>cover…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pour out withal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">upon them a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144 strong:H08438">of scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">the same with a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">of badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">in the staves</w> thereof.

verses.name: Numbers 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">of the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">and his lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04457">and his tongs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04289">and his snuffdishes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and all the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereof, wherewith they minister</w> unto it:

verses.name: Numbers 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">it and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">thereof within a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">of badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04132">upon a bar</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">And upon the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">it with a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">of badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">to the staves</w> thereof:

verses.name: Numbers 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H08335">of ministry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherewith they minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">in a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04372">them with a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">of badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04132">on a bar</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And they shall take away the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">from the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0713">a purple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">cloth</w> thereon:

verses.name: Numbers 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">upon it all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereof, wherewith they minister</w> about it, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04289">the censers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04207">the fleshhooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03257">and the shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03681">upon it a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08476">of badgers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">to the staves</w> of it.<note type="study"><catchWord>basons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bowls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 4:15
