verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that they put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">every leper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and every one that hath an issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">and whosoever is defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by the dead</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02145">Both male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">and female</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall ye put out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall ye put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them; that they defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">not their camps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whereof</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I dwell</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and put them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">When a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">any sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">that men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">commit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04604">to do a trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and that person</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be guilty</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">Then they shall confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have done</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">his trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">with the principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and add</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">unto it the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> unto <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against whom he hath trespassed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But if the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have no kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">the trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">unto, let the trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">be recompensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">to the priest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0352">beside the ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03725">of the atonement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">whereby an atonement shall be made</w> for him.

verses.name: Numbers 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08641">And every offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of all the holy things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>, shall be his.<note type="study"><catchWord>offering</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heave offering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">hallowed things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">shall be his: whatsoever any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, it shall be his.

verses.name: Numbers 5:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them, If any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">a trespass</w> against him,

verses.name: Numbers 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233 strong:H07902">with her carnally</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be kept close</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and she be defiled</w>, and <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">no witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">against her, neither she be taken</w> <transChange type="added">with the manner</transChange>;

verses.name: Numbers 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon him, and he be jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and she be defiled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">or if the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon him, and he be jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and she be not defiled</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Then shall the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">her offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">for her, the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">meal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">no oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon it, nor put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">frankincense</w> thereon; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of jealousy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">of memorial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-94">bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-94">to remembrance</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring her near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">her before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">in an earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06083">and of the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07172">that is in the floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">into the water</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">of memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in her hands</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07068">the jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">shall have in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">the bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that causeth the curse</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall charge her by an oath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">If no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have lain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">to uncleanness</w> <transChange type="added">with another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">instead of thy husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">be thou free</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">from this bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that causeth the curse</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>with another…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">being in the power of thy husband</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">under thy husband</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But if thou hast gone aside</w> <transChange type="added">to another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">instead of thy husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and if thou be defiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and some man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have</w> <w lemma="strong:H07903">lain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">with thee beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thine husband</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">with an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">of cursing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">thee a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">and an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">doth make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thy thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to rot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0990">and thy belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06639">to swell</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>rot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And this water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that causeth the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">into thy bowels</w>, to make <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06638" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to swell</w>, and <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to rot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">amen</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall write</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">these curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall blot</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">out with the bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And he shall cause the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">the bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that causeth the curse</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that causeth the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall enter</w> into her, <transChange type="added">and become</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">the jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">out of the woman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">it upon the altar</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07061" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take an handful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of the offering</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0234">the memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof, and burn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">shall cause the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And when he hath made her to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w>, then it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">if she be defiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that causeth the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall enter</w> into her, <transChange type="added">and become</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0990">and her belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06638" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall swell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03409">and her thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall rot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">shall be a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">her people</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And if the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be not defiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">but be clean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">then she shall be free</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall conceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:29
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of jealousies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">when a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth aside</w> <transChange type="added">to another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">instead of her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and is defiled</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 5:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Or when the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">of jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">upon him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he be jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">over his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">upon her all this law</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 5:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Then shall the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be guiltless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">from iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">and this</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">her iniquity</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen154" osisID="Num.5"/>

verses.name: Numbers 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto them, When either man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall separate</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">of a Nazarite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to separate</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>to separate…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to make themselves Nazarites</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He shall separate</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03196">from wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">and strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H02558">no vinegar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02558">or vinegar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">of strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall he drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04952">any liquor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">of grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03892">moist</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03002">or dried</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">All the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nothing that is made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02785">from the kernels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02085">even to the husk</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>separation</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Nazariteship</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>vine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vine of the wine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">All the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">of the vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">there shall no razor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be fulfilled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">in the which he separateth</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">he shall be holy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06545">shall let the locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">of the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">grow</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">All the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he separateth</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">at no dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">body</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">He shall not make himself unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">or for his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">for his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">or for his sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04194">when they die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05145">because the consecration</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consecration</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">separation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">All the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">And if any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06621">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">by him, and he hath defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his consecration</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">then he shall shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">of his cleansing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he shave</w> it.

verses.name: Numbers 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">And on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">turtles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">pigeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">to the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">to the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">for him, for that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that same day</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05144" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">for a trespass offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">but the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">that were before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be lost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05145">because his separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was defiled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be lost</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 6:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">of the Nazarite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are fulfilled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">he lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">ewe lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">for peace offerings</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05536">And a basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02471">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07550">and wafers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and their meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and their drink offerings</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">his sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and his burnt offering</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the ram</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05536">with the basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">also his meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and his drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05139">And the Nazarite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">under the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01311">the sodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">out of the basket</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07550">wafer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">upon the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">of the Nazarite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <transChange type="added">the hair of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05145">his separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">is shaven</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall wave</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">a wave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08573">with the wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">and heave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">that the Nazarite</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:21
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">of the Nazarite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who hath vowed</w>, <transChange type="added">and of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">for his separation</w>, beside <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">that his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall get</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">to the vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he vowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he must do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">after the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">of his separation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03541">On this wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w> unto them,

verses.name: Numbers 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and keep</w> thee:

verses.name: Numbers 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">make his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee, and be gracious</w> unto thee:

verses.name: Numbers 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">thee peace</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will bless</w> them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen155" osisID="Num.6"/>

verses.name: Numbers 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had fully</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it, and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">it, and all the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thereof, both the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and had anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and sanctified</w> them;

verses.name: Numbers 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">That the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and were over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them that were numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offered</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>and were</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">who stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">their offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H06632">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">wagons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05699">a wagon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">of the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and for each one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">an ox</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them, that they may be to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">them unto the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">to his service</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">the wagons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and the oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">them unto the Levites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">wagons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">to their service</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">And four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">wagons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">unto their service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">of Ithamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">none</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05656">because the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w> belonging unto them <transChange type="added">was that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they should bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">upon their shoulders</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 7:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05387">And the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02598">for dedicating</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that it was anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">even the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">their offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 7:11

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, then he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of one speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">unto him from off the mercy seat</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">upon the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">from between the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and he spake</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>with him</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">with God</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen156" osisID="Num.7"/>

verses.name: Numbers 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto him, When thou lightest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall give light</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136 strong:H06440">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">the candlestick</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">so; he lighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H04136">thereof over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">the candlestick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">And this work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">of the candlestick</w> <transChange type="added">was of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03409">unto the shaft</w> <w lemma="strong:H06525">thereof, unto the flowers</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04749">beaten work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04758">according unto the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">the candlestick</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cleanse</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thus shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto them, to cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">them: Sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of purifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674 strong:H08593" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon them, and let them shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">all their flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and let them wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">their clothes</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">make themselves clean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let them shave…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let them cause a razor to pass over</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then let them take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">with his meat offering</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05560">fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-95">and thou shalt gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the whole assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-95">together</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">upon the Levites</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wave</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>offering</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wave offering</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they may be to execute</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">of the bullocks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">for the Levites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offer</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thus shalt thou separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> shall be mine.

verses.name: Numbers 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">that shall the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and offer</w> them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">an offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:16
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">wholly given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">unto me from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06363">instead of such as open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">every womb</w>, <transChange type="added">even instead of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I taken</w> them unto me.

verses.name: Numbers 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">For all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> mine, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">every firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I sanctified</w> them for myself.

verses.name: Numbers 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">for all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">to Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05063">that there be no plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">unto the sanctuary</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a gift</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">given</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">to the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">according unto all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">concerning the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> unto them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">were purified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">their clothes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offered</w> them <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08573">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for them to cleanse</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">their service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">concerning the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> they unto them.

verses.name: Numbers 8:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 8:24
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> that <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635 strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">upon the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to war the warfare of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And from the age</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">waiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">upon the service</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall serve</w> no more:<note type="study"><catchWord>cease…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">return from the warfare of the service</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But shall minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no service</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">touching their charge</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen157" osisID="Num.8"/>

verses.name: Numbers 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after they were come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Let the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">at his appointed season</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">In the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of this month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">it in his appointed season</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02708">according to all the rites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of it, and according to all the ceremonies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, shall ye keep</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>at even</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">between the two evenings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">on the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And there were certain men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02931">who were defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by the dead body</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01992">And those</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by the dead body</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">wherefore are we kept back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that we may not offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">an offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in his appointed season</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Stand still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will command</w> concerning you.

verses.name: Numbers 9:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">If any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">of you or of your posterity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">by reason of a dead body</w>, or <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in a journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet he shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">The fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall keep</w> it, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">it with unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04844">and bitter</w> <transChange type="added">herbs</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">none of it unto the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor break</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">any bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">of it: according to all the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">of the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall keep</w> it.

verses.name: Numbers 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But the man</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and is not in a journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forbeareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">even the same soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from among his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">not the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in his appointed season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">his sin</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01616">And if a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">among you, and will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02708">according to the ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">of the passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and according to the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, so shall he do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">ye shall have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">ordinance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">both for the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0249">and for him that was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">that the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">was reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06153">and at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">there was upon the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">as it were the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08548">So it was alway</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covered</w> it <transChange type="added">by day</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">and the appearance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">And when</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">from the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">then after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04725">and in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">where the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">there the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pitched their tents</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">At the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they pitched</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">upon the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they rested</w> in their tents.

verses.name: Numbers 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06051">And when the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">tarried long</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">upon the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">then the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and journeyed</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>tarried…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prolonged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 9:20
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03426">it was</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">when the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">was a few</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">upon the tabernacle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their tents, and according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they journeyed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:21
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03426">it was</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">when the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">abode from even</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">unto the morning</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then they journeyed</w>: whether <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">or by night</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">that the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they journeyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abode</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 9:22
verses.text: Or <transChange type="added">whether it were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">two days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">or a month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">or a year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">that the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">upon the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">remaining</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thereon, the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in their tents, and journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">not: but when it was taken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they journeyed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">At the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the tents, and at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they journeyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen158" osisID="Num.9"/>

verses.name: Numbers 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thee two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04749">of a whole piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: that thou mayest use</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">them for the calling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the assembly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04550">and for the journeying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camps</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when they shall blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">with them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">themselves to thee at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if they blow</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <transChange type="added">trumpet</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">then the princes</w>, <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall gather</w> themselves unto thee.

verses.name: Numbers 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When ye blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">an alarm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">then the camps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go forward</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When ye blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">an alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">then the camps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">on the south side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take their journey</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">an alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04550">for their journeys</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">But when the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">is to be gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall blow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but ye shall not sound an alarm</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02708">and they shall be to you for an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy that oppresseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you, then ye shall blow an alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall be remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall be saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from your enemies</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:10
