verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Also in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of your gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and in your solemn days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and in the beginnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of your months</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye shall blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">over your burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and over the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of your peace offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02146">that they may be to you for a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06242">And it came to pass on the twentieth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">that the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">from off the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04550">their journeys</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">out of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06051">and the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">of Paran</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">And they first</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took their journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07223">In the first</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01714">the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">according to their armies</w>: and over his host <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05177">Nahshon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05992">of Amminadab</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05417">Nethaneel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06686">of Zuar</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0446">Eliab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02497">of Helon</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04908">And the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was taken down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01714">And the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">according to their armies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06635">and over his host</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0468">Elizur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07707">of Shedeur</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08017">Shelumiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06701">of Zurishaddai</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0460">Eliasaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01845">of Deuel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06956">And the Kohathites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the sanctuary</w>: and <transChange type="added">the other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against they came</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the other</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the Gershonites and the Merarites</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 10:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01714">And the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">according to their armies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06635">and over his host</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0476">Elishama</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05989">of Ammihud</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01583">Gamaliel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06301">of Pedahzur</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H027">Abidan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01441">of Gideoni</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01714">And the standard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set forward</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">the rereward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of all the camps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">throughout their hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06635">and over his host</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0295">Ahiezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05996">of Ammishaddai</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06295">Pagiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05918">of Ocran</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06635">And over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0299">Ahira</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05881">of Enan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:28
verses.text: Thus <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H0428">were</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04550">the journeyings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">according to their armies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when they set forward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">These</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 10:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02246">unto Hobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">of Raguel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04084">the Midianite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">We are journeying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">it you: come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou with us, and we will do thee good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">concerning Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, I will not go</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to mine own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04138">and to my kindred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045 strong:H03651" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">how we are to encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall be, if thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto us, the same will we do</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Numbers 10:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0727">and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">them in the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to search out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">a resting place</w> for them.

verses.name: Numbers 10:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06051">And the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03119">upon them by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 10:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">And it came to pass, when the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">set forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rise up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and let thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be scattered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and let them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: Numbers 10:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when it rested</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07233">unto the many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many thousands</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ten thousand thousands</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen159" osisID="Num.10"/>

verses.name: Numbers 11:1
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0596" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">complained</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H07451">it displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0639">and his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">and the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among them, and consumed</w> <transChange type="added">them that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the uttermost parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>complained</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">were as it were complainers</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>it displeased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it was evil in the ears of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">and when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was quenched</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sunk</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">of the</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08404">Taberah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0784">because the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burnt</w> among them.<note type="study"><catchWord>Taberah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A burning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0628">And the mixt multitude</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378 strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">them fell a lusting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">Who shall give us flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to eat</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>fell…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lusted a lust</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wept…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">returned and wept</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01710">the fish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which we did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">freely</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07180">the cucumbers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H020">and the melons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02682">and the leeks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01211">and the onions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07762">and the garlick</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">But now our soul</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03002">dried away</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01115">nothing at all, beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">this manna</w>, <transChange type="added">before</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">our eyes</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04478">And the manna</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01407">as coriander</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thereof as the colour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0916">of bdellium</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>colour thereof…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eye of it as the eye of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gathered</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ground</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07347">in mills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01743" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or beat</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04085">in a mortar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and baked</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06517">in pans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05692">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">of it: and the taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">of it was as the taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03955">of fresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02919">And when the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">upon the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04478">the manna</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> upon it.

verses.name: Numbers 11:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">Then Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">throughout their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of his tent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">and the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also was displeased</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Wherefore hast thou afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wherefore have I not found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou layest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">the burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all this people</w> upon me?

verses.name: Numbers 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Have I conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all this people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I begotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, that thou shouldest say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">them in thy bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a nursing father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the sucking child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which thou swarest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0370">Whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">should I have flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all this people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">us flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may eat</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I am not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">alone</w>, because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03515">too heavy</w> for me.

verses.name: Numbers 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And if thou deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thus with me, kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, I pray thee, out of hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let me not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">my wretchedness</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">unto me seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">to be the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over them; and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">them unto the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">that they may stand</w> there with thee.

verses.name: Numbers 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0680" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee there: and I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the spirit</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and will put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon them; and they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">the burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, that thou bear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not thyself alone.

verses.name: Numbers 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">yourselves against to morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye have wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">Who shall give us flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to eat</w>? for <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">with us in Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">you flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall eat</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">nor two days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">nor five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">neither ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">nor twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 11:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H02320">even a whole month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until it come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">at your nostrils</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02214">and it be loathsome</w> <w lemma="strong:H03282">unto you: because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, and have wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why came we forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>whole…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">month of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> whom I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">footmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">them flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">Shall the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and the herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for them, to suffice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">them? or shall all the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for them, to suffice</w> them?

verses.name: Numbers 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Is the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed short</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">now whether my word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come to pass</w> unto thee or not.

verses.name: Numbers 11:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">the seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">in a cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0680" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto him, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the spirit</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07657">unto the seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H02205">elders</w>: and it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">when the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">upon them, they prophesied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did not cease</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">But there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <transChange type="added">of the</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0419">Eldad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H04312">Medad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rested</w> upon them; and they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of them that were written</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but went not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto the tabernacle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a young man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0419">Eldad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04312">and Medad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">do prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0979">of his young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forbid</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 11:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto him, Enviest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou for my sake? would God that all the</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">were prophets</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">his spirit</w> upon them!

verses.name: Numbers 11:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">him into the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">he and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">a wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01468" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07958">quails</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the sea</w>, and let <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">by the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as it were a day’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">on this side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and as it were a day’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">on the other side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520">and as it were two cubits</w> <transChange type="added">high</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as it were a day’s…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as it were the way of a day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all that day</w>, and all <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04283">and all the next</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07958">the quails</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that gathered least</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">homers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07849" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they spread</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07849" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">all abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">for themselves round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And while the flesh</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02962">yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">between their teeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">ere it was chewed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">plague</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 11:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06914">Kibroth–hattaavah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because there they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that lusted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Kibroth–hattaavah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The graves of lust</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 11:35
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06914">from Kibroth–hattaavah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02698">unto Hazeroth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02698">and abode at Hazeroth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abode at</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they were in</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen160" osisID="Num.11"/>

verses.name: Numbers 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04813">And Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03571">the Ethiopian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he had married</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he had married</w> <w lemma="strong:H03571">an Ethiopian</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ethiopian</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Cushite</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>married</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">taken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">indeed spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">only by Moses</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath he not spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">also by us? And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:3
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H0376">Now the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035 strong:H06035" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">meek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">above all the men</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.)

verses.name: Numbers 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04813">and unto Miriam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">ye three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07969">And they three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">in the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04813">and Miriam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">and they both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came forth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">now my words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05030">If there be a prophet</w> among you, <transChange type="added">I</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">will make myself known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04759">unto him in a vision</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">unto him in a dream</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">My servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not so, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in all mine house</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">With him will I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">even apparently</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02420">and not in dark speeches</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08544">and the similitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he behold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore then were ye not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">against my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against them; and he departed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06051">And the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">from off the tabernacle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04813">and, behold, Miriam</w> <transChange type="added">became</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">leprous</w>, <transChange type="added">white</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07950">as snow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04813">upon Miriam</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">she was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">leprous</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">Alas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I beseech thee, lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02973" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">upon us, wherein we have done foolishly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wherein we have sinned</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191 strong:H04994" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Let her not be as one dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">of whom the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">is half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">womb</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">her now, O God</w>, I beseech thee.

verses.name: Numbers 12:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">If her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03417" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had but</w> <w lemma="strong:H03417" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in her face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should she not be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let her be shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">from the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that let her be received</w> in <transChange type="added">again</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04813">And Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">from the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04813">not till Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was brought</w> in <transChange type="added">again</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02698">from Hazeroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">of Paran</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen161" osisID="Num.12"/>

verses.name: Numbers 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">thou men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may search</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">every one a ruler</w> among them.

verses.name: Numbers 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them from the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">of Paran</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">all those men</w> <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H01992">were</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:4
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08051">Shammua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02139">of Zaccur</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08202">Shaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02753">of Hori</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03008">Igal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01954">Oshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Oshea</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Joshua</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06406">Palti</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07505">of Raphu</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01427">Gaddiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05476">of Sodi</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01426">Gaddi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05485">of Susi</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05988">Ammiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01582">of Gemalli</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05639">Sethur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04317">of Michael</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05147">Nahbi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02058">of Vophsi</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01345">Geuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04352">of Machi</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:16
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to spy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">Oshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Jehoshua</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Oshea</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Joshua</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoshua</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Joshua</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them to spy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Get you up</w> this <transChange type="added">way</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mountain</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, what it <transChange type="added">is</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> therein, whether they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07504">or weak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">or many</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And what the land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that they dwell in</w>, whether it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">or bad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">and what cities</w> <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that they dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">whether in tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04013">or in strong holds</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And what the land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, whether it <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08082">fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07330">or lean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">whether there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">therein, or not. And be ye of good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03117">Now the time</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of the firstripe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and searched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">from the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07340">unto Rehob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as men come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">to Hamath</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they ascended</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">by the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">unto Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0289">where Ahiman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08344">Sheshai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08526">and Talmai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03211">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange>. (<w lemma="strong:H02275">Now Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06814">Zoan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>.)

verses.name: Numbers 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H0812">of Eshcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02156">from thence a branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0811">cluster</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">of grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">it between two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04132">upon a staff</w>; and <transChange type="added">they brought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07416">of the pomegranates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">and of the figs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brook</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">The place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H0812">Eshcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0182">because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0811">the cluster of grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cut down</w> from thence.<note type="study"><catchWord>brook</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Eshcol</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A cluster of grapes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from searching</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">to Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">and to Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and to all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">unto the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">of Paran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06946">to Kadesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto them, and unto all the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">them the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither thou sentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">us, and surely it floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>; and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> of it.

verses.name: Numbers 13:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0657">Nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05794">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the cities</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">walled</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and moreover we saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03211">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w> there.

verses.name: Numbers 13:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06002">The Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and by the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 13:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03612">And Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02013" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">before Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it; for we are well able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to overcome</w> it.

verses.name: Numbers 13:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">But the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We be not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against the people</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">stronger</w> than we.

verses.name: Numbers 13:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01681">an evil report</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had searched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">The land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">through which we have gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to search</w> it, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eateth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thereof; and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in it</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">of a great stature</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>men…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of statures</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 13:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there we saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05303">the giants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>, <transChange type="added">which come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05303">of the giants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">and we were in our own sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02284">as grasshoppers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and so we were in their sight</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen162" osisID="Num.13"/>

verses.name: Numbers 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and against Aaron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05712">and the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03863">unto them, Would God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we had died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03863">or would God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we had died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in this wilderness</w>!

verses.name: Numbers 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And wherefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us unto this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">that our wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">and our children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">should be a prey</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02896">were it not better</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for us to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">a captain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Then Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">all the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">and Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that searched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">their clothes</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto all the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">The land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which we passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">through to search</w> it, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">an exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">If the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in us, then he will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us into this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it us; a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Only rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not ye against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">ye the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">for us: their defence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from them, and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us: fear</w> them not.<note type="study"><catchWord>defence</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shadow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">But all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bade</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">them with stones</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03519">And the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">before all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">How long will this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">provoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">me? and how long will it be ere</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">me, for all the signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> them?

verses.name: Numbers 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">them with the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and disinherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of thee a greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mightier</w> than they.

verses.name: Numbers 14:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">Then the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall hear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, (<w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou broughtest up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in thy might</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> them;)

verses.name: Numbers 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they will tell</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of this land</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that thou <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that thou <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">art seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to face</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06051">thy cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standeth</w> over them, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">them, by day time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">in a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of a cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">and in a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou shalt kill</w> <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">then the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee will speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">was not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, therefore he hath slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03581">And now, I beseech thee, let the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of my Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou hast spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639 strong:H0750">longsuffering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">forgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">and transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and by no means</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">clearing</w> <transChange type="added">the guilty</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">visiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08029">unto the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H07256">and fourth</w> <transChange type="added">generation</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pardon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">I beseech thee, the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">according unto the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and as thou hast forgiven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">even until now</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>until…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hitherto</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have pardoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy word</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 14:21
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0199">truly</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">with the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Because all those men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">and my miracles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">and in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and have tempted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">me now these ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to my voice</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 14:23
