verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">Surely they shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">neither shall any of them that provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me see</w> it:<note type="study"><catchWord>Surely…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">If they see the land</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">But my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06118">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">he had another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">with him, and hath followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me fully</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereinto he went</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02233">and his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall possess</w> it.

verses.name: Numbers 14:25
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H06003">Now the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w>.) <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you, and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">you into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 14:27
verses.text: How long <transChange type="added">shall I bear with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which murmur</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me? I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08519">the murmurings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which they murmur</w> against me.

verses.name: Numbers 14:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> unto them, <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H03808">As truly as</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as ye have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in mine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so will I do</w> to you:

verses.name: Numbers 14:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06297">Your carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in this wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and all that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">of you, according to your whole number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which have murmured</w> against me,

verses.name: Numbers 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">Doubtless ye shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w>, <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375 strong:H03027" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make you dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">therein, save Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sware</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifted up my hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02945">But your little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">should be a prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them will I bring in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye have despised</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:32
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06297">you, your carcases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in this wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02184">your whoredoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06297">until your carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be wasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wander</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">feed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">After the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in which ye searched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">each day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03117 strong:H08141">for a year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">your iniquities</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08569">my breach of promise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>breach…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">altering of my purpose</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 14:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808 strong:H0518">I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">it</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto all this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">against me: in this wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall be consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there they shall die</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to search</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and made all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885 strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">to murmur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against him, by bringing up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01681">a slander</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 14:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Even those</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that did bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01681">report</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">by the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">But Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">and Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582 strong:H01992">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to search</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lived</w> <transChange type="added">still</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these sayings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:40
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gat them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">into the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">Lo</w>, we <transChange type="added">be here</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath promised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for we have sinned</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Wherefore now do ye transgress</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but it shall not prosper</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Go not up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">not among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">you; that ye be not smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your enemies</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06003">For the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">there before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and ye shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because ye are turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> will not be with you.

verses.name: Numbers 14:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06075" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But they presumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">top</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0727">nevertheless the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 14:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06003">Then the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in that hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and discomfited</w> them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02767">unto Hormah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen163" osisID="Num.14"/>

verses.name: Numbers 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, When ye be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">of your habitations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> unto you,

verses.name: Numbers 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">or a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in performing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">or in a freewill offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">or in your solemn feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the herd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">or of the flock</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>performing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">separating</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Then shall he that offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">his offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">of a tenth deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">with the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">And the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">for a drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">with the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">or sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0352">Or for a ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt prepare</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">with the third</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05262">And for a drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when thou preparest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">a bullock</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, or <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in performing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">or peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Numbers 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then shall he bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01241">with a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">with half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">for a drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thus shall it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">or for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716 strong:H03532">or for a lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">or a kid</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">According to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall prepare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03602">so</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to their number</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0249">All that are born of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">these things after this manner, in offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01616">And if a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sojourn</w> with you, or whosoever <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">you in your generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as ye do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he shall do</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">ordinance</w> <transChange type="added">shall be both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06951">for you of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and also for the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <transChange type="added">with you</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in your generations</w>: as ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">so shall the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">be before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">shall be for you, and for the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> with you.

verses.name: Numbers 15:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, When ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whither I bring</w> you,

verses.name: Numbers 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Then it shall be, that, when ye eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall offer up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall offer up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">a cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H06182">of your dough</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w>: as <transChange type="added">ye do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">of the threshingfloor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so shall ye heave</w> it.

verses.name: Numbers 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">Of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H06182">of your dough</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in your generations</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if ye have erred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not observed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all these commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 15:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <transChange type="added">Moses</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01973">and henceforward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">among your generations</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 15:24
verses.text: Then it shall be, if <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">by ignorance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">without the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">that all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">with his meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and his drink offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>without…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the eyes</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>manner</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ordinance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">for all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be forgiven</w> them; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07684">ignorance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">their offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">a sacrifice made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and their sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07684">for their ignorance</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And it shall be forgiven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them; seeing all the people</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07684">in ignorance</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">And if any</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">through ignorance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">a she goat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07683" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sinneth ignorantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he sinneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">by ignorance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for him; and it shall be forgiven</w> him.

verses.name: Numbers 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Ye shall have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for him that sinneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">through ignorance</w>, <transChange type="added">both for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0249">him that is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and for the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>sinneth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">doth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 15:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05315">But the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that doeth</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">presumptuously</w>, <transChange type="added">whether he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0249">born in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616 strong:H04480">or a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01442" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">the same reproacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">and that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>presumptuously</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with an high hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 15:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because he hath despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">shall utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be cut off</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05771">his iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> upon him.

verses.name: Numbers 15:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And while the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">were in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">that gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">sticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">upon the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And they that found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">him gathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">sticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">him unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and unto all the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">him in ward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06567" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">because it was not declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">what should be done</w> to him.

verses.name: Numbers 15:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">The man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">him without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 15:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them that they make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06734">them fringes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">in the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of their garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and that they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06734">upon the fringe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06616">a ribband</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 15:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06734">And it shall be unto you for a fringe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may look</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon it, and remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; and that ye seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your own heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">and your own eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which ye use to go a whoring</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 15:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That ye may remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto your God</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 15:41
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">to be your God</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen164" osisID="Num.15"/>

verses.name: Numbers 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07141">Now Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03324">of Izhar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01885">and Dathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0446">of Eliab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0203">and On</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06431">of Peleth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>:

verses.name: Numbers 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">with certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the assembly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07148">famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of renown</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And they gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and against Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">Ye take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">too much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">upon you, seeing all the congregation</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">every one of them, and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them: wherefore then lift ye up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">yourselves above the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Ye take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">It is much for you</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon his face</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">unto Korah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">and unto all his company</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">Even to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will shew</w> who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his, and <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>; and will cause <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to come near</w> unto him: even <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom he hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will he cause to come near</w> unto him.

verses.name: Numbers 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">This do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">you censers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07141">Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and all his company</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02004">therein</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w>: and it shall be <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth choose</w>, he <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>: <transChange type="added">ye take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">too much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon you, ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">unto Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">I pray you, ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 16:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Seemeth it but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a small thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto you, that the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">you from the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring you near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to himself to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> unto them?

verses.name: Numbers 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he hath brought thee near</w> <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and all thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with thee: and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">ye the priesthood</w> also?

verses.name: Numbers 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03651">For which cause</w> <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05712">thou and all thy company</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885 strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">that ye murmur</w> against him?

verses.name: Numbers 16:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01885">Dathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0446">of Eliab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will not come up</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 16:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a small thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast brought us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">us in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08323" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">except thou make thyself</w> <w lemma="strong:H05701">altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H08323" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">over us</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">Moreover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast not brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us into a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">us inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05365" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wilt thou put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of these men</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will not come up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bore out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">not thou their offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from them, neither have I hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> of them.

verses.name: Numbers 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">unto Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">Be thou and all thy company</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">thou, and they, and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">his censer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in them, and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">ye before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">his censer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">censers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">thou also, and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">each</w> <transChange type="added">of you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04289">his censer</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">his censer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in them, and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereon, and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">with Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07141">And Korah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">against them unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto all the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">yourselves from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">this congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I may consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">them in a moment</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon their faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the spirits</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">shall one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wilt thou be wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">with all the congregation</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 16:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 16:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Get you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">from about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01885">Dathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01885">unto Dathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">him</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">I pray you, from the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of these wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">in all their sins</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">So they gat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">from the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01885">Dathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01885">and Dathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and their little children</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hereby ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all these works</w>; for <transChange type="added">I have</transChange> not <transChange type="added">done them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of mine own mind</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If these men die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the common death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of all men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">or if they be visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">after the visitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of all men</w>; <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not sent</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>the common…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as every man dieth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But if the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01278">a new thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and swallow them up</w>, with all that <transChange type="added">appertain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, and they go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">quick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">into the pit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">that these men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>make…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">create a creature</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 16:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, as he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">that the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">clave asunder</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> under them:

verses.name: Numbers 16:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and swallowed them up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and their houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">and all the men</w> that <transChange type="added">appertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07141">unto Korah</w>, and all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07399">goods</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:33
verses.text: They, and all that <transChange type="added">appertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to them, went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">into the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">closed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them: and they perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them: for they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">Lest the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">swallow us up</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">the two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 16:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">the censers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">of the burning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">thou the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">yonder</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they are hallowed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04289">The censers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">of these sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against their own souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">let them make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07555">them broad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">plates</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06826">a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore they are hallowed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0226">and they shall be a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0499">And Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">censers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">wherewith they that were burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had offered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they were made broad</w> <transChange type="added">plates for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06826">a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 16:40
verses.text: <transChange type="added">To be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02146">a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04616 strong:H0834">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">no stranger</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">not of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07141">that he be not as Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and as his company</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to him by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04283">But on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and against Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Ye have killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And it came to pass, when the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and against Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">toward the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06051">and, behold, the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">it, and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 16:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07426" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Get you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">this congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I may consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">them as in a moment</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon their faces</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:46
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04289">a censer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">therein from off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">on incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">for them: for there is wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05063">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is begun</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the congregation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05063">and, behold, the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">was begun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">on incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and made an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">between the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the living</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04046">and the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was stayed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Now they that died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">in the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">were fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">beside them that died</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">about the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 16:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04046">and the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was stayed</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen165" osisID="Num.16"/>

verses.name: Numbers 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294 strong:H04294">of every one of them a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">of all their princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">write</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thou every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">upon his rod</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt write</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">upon the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rod</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">for the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt lay them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">where I will meet</w> with you.

verses.name: Numbers 17:5
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom I shall choose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall blossom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07918" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will make to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H08519">from me the murmurings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whereby they murmur</w> against you.

verses.name: Numbers 17:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and every one of their princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294 strong:H04294">him a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387 strong:H05387">apiece, for each prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H0259">one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to their fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H06240">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04294">and the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">their rods</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a rod…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a rod for one prince, a rod for one prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the rods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of witness</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass, that on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of witness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04294">and, behold, the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was budded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06525">buds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bloomed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">blossoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and yielded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08247">almonds</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">all the rods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">his rod</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 17:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-96">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-96">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">to be kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">for a token</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H04805">against the rebels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou shalt quite take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08519">their murmurings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me, that they die</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>rebels</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children of rebellion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, so did</w> he.

verses.name: Numbers 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, we die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we all perish</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07131">Whosoever cometh any thing near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">unto the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall we be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with dying</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen166" osisID="Num.17"/>

verses.name: Numbers 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thou and thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">and thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thou and thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">of your priesthood</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">also of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou with thee, that they may be joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto thee, and minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thee: but thou and thy sons</w> with thee <transChange type="added">shall minister</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of witness</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">thy charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of all the tabernacle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">only they shall not come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that neither they, nor ye also, die</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And they shall be joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee, and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">for all the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come nigh</w> unto you.

verses.name: Numbers 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07110">that there be no wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">any more upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I, behold, I have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: to you <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">given</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04979">a gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:7
