verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore thou and thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">your priest’s office</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for every thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall serve</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">your priest’s office</w> <transChange type="added">unto you as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05656">a service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">of gift</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07131">that cometh nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I also have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">thee the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">of mine heave offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of all the hallowed things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee have I given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04888">them by reason of the anointing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">by an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">This shall be thine of the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>, <transChange type="added">reserved</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">from the fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07133">every oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of theirs, every meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of theirs, and every sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">of theirs, and every trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of theirs, which they shall render</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for thee and for thy sons</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">In the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">it; every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">it: it shall be holy</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Numbers 18:11
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">thine; the heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04976">of their gift</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08573">with all the wave offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them unto thee, and to thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and to thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">with thee, by a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02889">every one that is clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> of it.

verses.name: Numbers 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02459">All the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H03323">of the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and all the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">of the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01715">and of the wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them which they shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them have I given</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>best</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 18:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01061">whatsoever is first ripe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">shall be thine; every one that is clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> it.

verses.name: Numbers 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02764">Every thing devoted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> shall be thine.

verses.name: Numbers 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06363">Every thing that openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">the matrix</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">whether it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">or beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shalt thou surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">redeem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">and the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">of unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou redeem</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And those that are to be redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou redeem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">according to thine estimation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">for the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">of five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08255">after the shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01626">gerahs</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">But the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of a cow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">or the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03775">of a sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">or the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of a goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not redeem</w>; they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shalt burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">their fat</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">an offering made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">And the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08573">of them shall be thine, as the wave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02373">breast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">and as the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">shoulder</w> are thine.

verses.name: Numbers 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08641">All the heave offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee, and thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">with thee, by a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto thee and to thy seed</w> with thee.

verses.name: Numbers 18:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt have no inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">neither shalt thou have any part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">thy part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">and thine inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">all the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02500">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">their service</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which they serve</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Neither must the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">henceforth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">lest they bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and die</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to die</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">But the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">their iniquity</w>: <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout your generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">that among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they have</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">no inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04643">But the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they offer</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">to the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">to inherit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore I have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">unto them, Among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall have</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">no inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thus speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, When ye take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">you from them for your inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">up an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of it for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04643">a tenth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04643">of the tithe</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:27
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">your heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be reckoned</w> unto you, as though <transChange type="added">it were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01715">the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">of the threshingfloor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04395">and as the fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">of the winepress</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thus ye also shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">of all your tithes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereof the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">to Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04979">Out of all your gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">every heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">of all the best</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the hallowed part</w> thereof out of it.<note type="study"><catchWord>best</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto them, When ye have heaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof from it, then it shall be counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">as the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">of the threshingfloor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08393">and as the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">of the winepress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>best</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 18:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">it in every place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">ye and your households</w>: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07939">your reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02500">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">your service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 18:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">no sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by reason of it, when ye have heaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">from it the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">of it: neither shall ye pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest ye die</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen167" osisID="Num.18"/>

verses.name: Numbers 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and unto Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 19:2
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">the ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0122">thee a red</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without spot</w>, wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">no blemish</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">upon which never</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">yoke</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">her unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he may bring her forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>, and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">her before</w> his face:

verses.name: Numbers 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0499">And Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of her blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his finger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of her blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">directly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 19:5
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">the heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05785">her skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and her flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and her blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06569">with her dung</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he burn</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0231">and hyssop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08144 strong:H08438">and scarlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">of the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">of the heifer</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall bathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">her shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And a man</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">up the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">of the heifer</w>, and lay <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">in a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and it shall be kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">for the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">for a water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of separation</w>: it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a purification for sin</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">of the heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and it shall be unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and unto the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">them, for a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">body</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul of man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">He shall purify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">himself with it on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">and on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall be clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">but if he purify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">not himself the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">then the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not be clean</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">body</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that is dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and purifieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">not himself, defileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">and that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">because the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was not sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">upon him, he shall be unclean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02932">his uncleanness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> yet upon him.

verses.name: Numbers 19:14
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">when a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in a tent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tent</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And every open</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06781">which hath no covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06616">bound</w> upon it, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">one that is slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">or a dead body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">or a bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06913">or a grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02931">And for an unclean</w> <transChange type="added">person</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">of the burnt heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of purification for sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">thereto in a vessel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>ashes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dust</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>running…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">living waters shall be given</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02889">And a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0231">hyssop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dip</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sprinkle</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">upon the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and upon all the vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and upon the persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that were there, and upon him that touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">a bone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">or one slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">or one dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06913">or a grave</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02889">And the clean</w> <transChange type="added">person</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">upon the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">and on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">and on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he shall purify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">himself, and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bathe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">himself in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall be clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall be unclean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and shall not purify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">himself, that soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">hath not been sprinkled</w> upon him; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05769">And it shall be a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto them, that he that sprinkleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of separation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until even</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02931">And whatsoever the unclean</w> <transChange type="added">person</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that toucheth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until even</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen168" osisID="Num.19"/>

verses.name: Numbers 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the whole congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">in Kadesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04813">and Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">there, and was buried</w> there.

verses.name: Numbers 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And there was no water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">for the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">themselves together against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and against Aaron</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chode</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">with Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">Would God that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we had died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">when our brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>!

verses.name: Numbers 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And why have ye brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into this wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01165">that we and our cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should die</w> there?

verses.name: Numbers 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And wherefore have ye made us to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">us in unto this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>? it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">no place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">or of figs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01612">or of vines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07416">or of pomegranates</w>; neither <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">there any water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon their faces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> unto them.

verses.name: Numbers 20:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">thou the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">together, thou, and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">ye unto the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall give forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">his water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shalt bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">to them water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">out of the rock</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-97">so thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01165">and their beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-97">drink</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he commanded</w> him.

verses.name: Numbers 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">together before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">now, ye rebels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">must we fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">you water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">out of this rock</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and with his rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">twice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">abundantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drank</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01165">and their beasts</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Because ye believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me not, to sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">me in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore ye shall not bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">this congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 20:13
verses.text: This <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H01992">is</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04809">of Meribah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">because the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he was sanctified</w> in them.<note type="study"><catchWord>Meribah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Strife</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 20:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">from Kadesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08513">all the travail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath befallen</w> us:<note type="study"><catchWord>befallen…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">How our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we have dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">us, and our fathers</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when we cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">our voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hath brought us forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>: and, behold, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06946">in Kadesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the uttermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of thy border</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">I pray thee, through thy country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will not pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">through the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">or through the vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will we drink</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">of the wells</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <transChange type="added">high</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will not turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">to the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">nor to the left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until we have passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thy borders</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">And Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Thou shalt not pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by me, lest I come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thee with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, We will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">by the high way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04735">and if I and my cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of thy water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04377 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will pay</w> for it: I will only, without <transChange type="added">doing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">any thing</w> <transChange type="added">else</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on my feet</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not go through</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0123">And Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">him with much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and with a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">Thus Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">passage</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">through his border</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">wherefore Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned away</w> from him.

verses.name: Numbers 20:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the whole congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">from Kadesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">by the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he shall not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because ye rebelled against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">at the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04809">of Meribah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>word</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">And strip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">them upon Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be gathered</w> <transChange type="added">unto his people</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall die</w> there.

verses.name: Numbers 20:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of all the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stripped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">them upon Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">there in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 20:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And when all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">that Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen169" osisID="Num.20"/>

verses.name: Numbers 21:1
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06166">Arad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">in the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">tell that Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0871">of the spies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">then he fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of them prisoners</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If thou wilt indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then I will utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">their cities</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delivered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">them and their cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02767">Hormah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hormah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Utter destruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was much discouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">because of the way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discouraged</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grieved</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shortened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">and against Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Wherefore have ye brought us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>? for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">and our soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loatheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07052">this light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08314">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">serpents</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they bit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">Therefore the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">to Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for we have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and against thee; pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">the serpents</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">from us. And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08314">thee a fiery serpent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">it upon a pole</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when he looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon it, shall live</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">a serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">it upon a pole</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05175">and it came to pass, that if a serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had bitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">when he beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">the serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he lived</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H088">in Oboth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H088">from Oboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05863">at Ije–abarim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ije–abarim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heaps of Abarim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">From thence they removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02218">of Zared</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">From thence they removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0769">for Arnon</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">between Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Wherefore it is said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of the wars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02052">What he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">in the Red sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">and in the brooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Vaheb in Suphah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0793">And at the stream</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that goeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06144">of Ar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">upon the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lieth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">leaneth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:16
verses.text: And from thence <transChange type="added">they went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0876">to Beer</w>: that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0875">the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whereof the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-98">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-98">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">them water</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">Then Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sang</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">this song</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Spring up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0875">O well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sing</w> ye unto it:<note type="study"><catchWord>Spring…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ascend</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">answer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">the well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05081">the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">digged</w> it, by <transChange type="added">the direction of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">the lawgiver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04938">with their staves</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04057">And from the wilderness</w> <transChange type="added">they went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04980">to Mattanah</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04980">And from Mattanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05160">to Nahaliel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05160">and from Nahaliel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01120">to Bamoth</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01120">And from Bamoth</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">the valley</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H06449">of Pisgah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">Jeshimon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>country</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">field</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Pisgah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jeshimon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the wilderness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">unto Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through thy land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will not turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">or into the vineyards</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will not drink</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">of the well</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will go along</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <transChange type="added">high</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until we be past</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thy borders</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05511">And Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">through his border</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05511">but Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-99">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-99">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03096">to Jahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">him with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">from Arnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02999">unto Jabbok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">even unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">for the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05794">strong</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all these cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and in all the villages</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>villages</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02809">For Heshbon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">who had fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">against the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0769">even unto Arnon</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Wherefore they that speak in proverbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">into Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">let the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and prepared</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 21:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">For there is a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03852">a flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">from the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it hath consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06144">Ar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01181">the lords of the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">to thee, Moab</w>! <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art undone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">O people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03645">of Chemosh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">that escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and his daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07622">into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">unto Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We have shot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">at them; Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01769">even unto Dibon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we have laid them waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05302">even unto Nophah</w>, which <transChange type="added">reacheth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04311">unto Medeba</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">Thus Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to spy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03270">Jaazer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423 strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and drove out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorites</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> there.

verses.name: Numbers 21:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05747">and Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them, he, and all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0154">at Edrei</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him not: for I have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into thy hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and his land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him as thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">unto Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">at Heshbon</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 21:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him, and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">until there was none</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">him alive</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen170" osisID="Num.21"/>

verses.name: Numbers 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06834">of Zippor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all that Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">to the Amorites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">And Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, because they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was distressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">And Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">Now shall this company</w> <w lemma="strong:H03897" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">lick up</w> all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">us, as the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H03897" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">licketh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03418">the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06834">of Zippor</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">therefore unto Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06604">to Pethor</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, there is a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">behold, they cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> me:<note type="study"><catchWord>face</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eye</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now therefore, I pray thee, curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">me this people</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06099">too mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for me: peradventure I shall prevail</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">we may smite</w> them, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I may drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I wot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he whom thou blessest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">blessed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he whom thou cursest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is cursed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">with the rewards of divination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto him the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">of Balak</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">here this night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-100">and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">you word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-100">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto me: and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">with Balaam</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">What men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> these with thee?

verses.name: Numbers 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01111">Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06834">of Zippor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,

verses.name: Numbers 22:11
