verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me them; peradventure I shall be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to overcome</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and drive them out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I shall prevail in fighting against him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them; thou shalt not curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">blessed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">of Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you into your land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give me leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> with you.

verses.name: Numbers 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> with us.

verses.name: Numbers 22:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and more honourable</w> than they.

verses.name: Numbers 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">to Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06834">of Zippor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee from coming</w> unto me:<note type="study"><catchWord>Let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be not thou hindered from</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For I will promote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">thee unto very great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whatsoever thou sayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me: come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore, I pray thee, curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">me this people</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">of Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01111">If Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">less</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">or more</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore, I pray you, tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">ye also here this night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me more</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">at night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto him, If the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee, rise up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">with them; but yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which I shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, that shalt thou do</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">his ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">with the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because he went</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04397">and the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">for an adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against him. Now he was riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">upon his ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servants</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Numbers 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0860">And the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0860">and the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01109">and Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">her into the way</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">But the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04934">in a path</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of the vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01447">a wall</w> <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01447">on this side, and a wall</w> on that side.

verses.name: Numbers 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0860">And when the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">she thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">herself unto the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and crushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">against the wall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">her again</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">further</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in a narrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, where <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">no way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">either to the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">or to the left</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0860">And when the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">under Balaam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01109">and Balaam’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">with a staff</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">of the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What have I done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto thee, that thou hast smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">me these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">times</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">unto the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">Because thou hast mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03863">me: I would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">there were</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for now would I kill</w> thee.

verses.name: Numbers 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0860">And the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0860">not I thine ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon which thou hast ridden</w> ever since <transChange type="added">I was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thine unto this day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">was I ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">wont</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do so</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee? And he said</w>, Nay.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">who hast ridden upon me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>ever since…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ever since thou wast</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">of Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">his head, and fell flat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">on his face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fell…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bowed himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">thine ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">times</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">to withstand</w> thee, because <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03399" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is perverse</w> before me:<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to be an adversary unto thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0860">And the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from me</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">times</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0194">unless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she had turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">surely now also I had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and saved her alive</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">not that thou stoodest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: now therefore, if it displease thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will get me back again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>displease…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be evil in thine eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">with the men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0657">but only</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto thee, that thou shalt speak</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01109">So Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">with the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">of Balak</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01111">And when Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">that Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him unto a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the utmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">coast</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Did I not earnestly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee? wherefore camest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou not unto me? am I not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H0552">indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to promote thee to honour</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 22:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Lo, I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee: have I now any power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any thing</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">putteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that shall I speak</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 22:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">with Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07155 strong:H02351">unto Kirjath–huzoth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Kirjath–huzoth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a city of streets</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 22:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">to Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and to the princes</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Numbers 22:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01111">that Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">into the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01120">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thence he might see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">the utmost</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen171" osisID="Num.22"/>

verses.name: Numbers 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Build</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">me here seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">me here seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">as Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01111">and Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">and Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offered</w> on <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">by thy burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">peradventure the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">me: and whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me I will tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205">to an high place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">solitary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, I have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I have offered</w> upon <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">in Balaam’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thus thou shalt speak</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto him, and, lo, he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">by his burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">he, and all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01111">Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">me from Aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02042">out of the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">me Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">defy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04100">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not cursed</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or how shall I defy</w>, <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not defied</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">For from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">of the rocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">him, and from the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him: lo, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and shall not be reckoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who can count</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">and the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07255">of the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0319">and let my last</w> end be like his!<note type="study"><catchWord>me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my soul</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">my life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What hast thou done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me? I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and, behold, thou hast blessed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">altogether</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Must I not take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in my mouth</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">I pray thee, with me unto another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from whence thou mayest see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">the utmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">part of them, and shalt not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">them all: and curse</w> me them from thence.

verses.name: Numbers 23:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">him into the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822 strong:H06839" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8677">of Zophim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H06449">of Pisgah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> on <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Pisgah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">here</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">by thy burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">while I meet</w> <transChange type="added">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03541">yonder</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and say</w> thus.

verses.name: Numbers 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to him, behold, he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">by his burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">with him. And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, What hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spoken</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rise up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01111">Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06834">of Zippor</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he should lie</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">that he should repent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall he not do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">or hath he spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall he not make it good</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have received</w> <transChange type="added">commandment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bless</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he hath blessed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I cannot reverse</w> it.

verses.name: Numbers 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath not beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">in Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither hath he seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">perverseness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with him, and the shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of a king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> among them.

verses.name: Numbers 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08443">he hath as it were the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07214">of an unicorn</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:23
verses.text: Surely <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05173">no enchantment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">against Jacob</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07081">any divination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">according to this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">What hath God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wrought</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>against</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03833">as a great lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">himself as a young lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until he eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02964">the prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of the slain</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them at all</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them at all</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">But Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not I thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">All that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speaketh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I must do</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 23:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">thee unto another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">peradventure it will please</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou mayest curse</w> me them from thence.

verses.name: Numbers 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">unto the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H06465">of Peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">Jeshimon</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Build</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">me here seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">me here seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">as Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">a bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">and a ram</w> on <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen172" osisID="Num.23"/>

verses.name: Numbers 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And when Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02895 strong:H05869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that it pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">not, as at other times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05173">for enchantments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">toward the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to seek…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the meeting of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abiding</w> <transChange type="added">in his tents</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">according to their tribes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> came upon him.

verses.name: Numbers 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">whose eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08365" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">are open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hath said</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>whose…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">who had his eyes shut, but now opened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">He hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04236">the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">falling</w> <transChange type="added">into a trance</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">but having his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">open</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">are thy tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">O Jacob</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">thy tabernacles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>!

verses.name: Numbers 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05158">As the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are they spread forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01593">as gardens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river’s side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0174">as the trees of lign aloes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath planted</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">as cedar trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">beside the waters</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-101">He shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-101">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01805">of his buckets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and his seed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and his king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H090">than Agag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">and his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be exalted</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought him forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08443">he hath as it were the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07214">of an unicorn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">his enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01633" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall break</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">their bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pierce</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02671">through with his arrows</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He couched</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he lay down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">as a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03833">and as a great lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who shall stir him up</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he that blesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thee, and cursed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that curseth</w> thee.

verses.name: Numbers 24:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01111">And Balak’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">against Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-102">and he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-102">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01111">and Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06895" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and, behold, thou hast altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blessed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore now flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">thou to thy place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-103">to promote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-103">thee unto great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">honour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">but, lo, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath kept thee back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">from honour</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">unto Balak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">I not also to thy messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou sentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">If Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">either</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">or bad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of mine own mind</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that will I speak</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And now, behold, I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto my people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will advertise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thee what this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">whose eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08365" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">are open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hath said</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">He hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04236">the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">falling</w> <transChange type="added">into a trance</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">but having his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">open</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, but not now: I shall behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">him, but not nigh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">a Star</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">out of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">and a Sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">the corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06979" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08351 strong:H08352" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of Sheth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>smite…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">smite through the princes of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">And Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03424">shall be a possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03424">also shall be a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for his enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiantly</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">Out of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come he that shall have dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">him that remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">on Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06002">Amalek</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0319">but his latter</w> end <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08">that he perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the nations</catchWord>: <rdg>the nations that warred against Israel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">even to destruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">on the Kenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0386">Strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">is thy dwellingplace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and thou puttest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">thy nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">in a rock</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07014">Nevertheless the Kenite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">shall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">be wasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">until Asshur</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall carry thee away captive</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Kenite</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Kain</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>until…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">how long shall it be ere Asshur carry thee away captive</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 24:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0188">Alas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">doeth</w> this!

verses.name: Numbers 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06716">And ships</w> <transChange type="added">shall come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03794">of Chittim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">Asshur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05677">Eber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08">and he also shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 24:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01109">And Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to his place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01111">and Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen173" osisID="Num.24"/>

verses.name: Numbers 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07851">in Shittim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to commit whoredom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">unto the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to their gods</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06775" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H01187">himself unto Baal–peor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">and the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">all the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and hang them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">against the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02740">that the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06775" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H01187">unto Baal–peor</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And, behold, one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04084">a Midianitish woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, who <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">weeping</w> <transChange type="added">before</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06372">And when Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">a javelin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06898">into the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of them through, the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H06897">her belly</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04046">So the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">And those that died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">in the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">were twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06372">Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-104">hath turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-104">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">while he was zealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">for my sake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, that I consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">in my jealousy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with my zeal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 25:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Wherefore say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">unto him my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">And he shall have it, and his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">priesthood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0834">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he was zealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and made an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">Now the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the Israelite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that was slain</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">that was slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04084">with the Midianitish woman</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02174">Zimri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05543">of Salu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of a chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08099">among the Simeonites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of a father</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04084">of the Midianitish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that was slain</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03579">Cozbi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06698">of Zur</w>; he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0523">over a people</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">of a chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">in Midian</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 25:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H04084">the Midianites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite</w> them:

verses.name: Numbers 25:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For they vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H05231">you with their wiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05230" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">wherewith they have beguiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">you in the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06465">of Peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and in the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03579">of Cozbi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">of a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">which was slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">of the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06465">for Peor’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">sake</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen174" osisID="Num.25"/>

verses.name: Numbers 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">the plague</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">throughout their fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that are able to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">with them in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 26:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Take the sum of the people</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">the eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">son of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02585">Hanoch</w>, <transChange type="added">of whom cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02599">of the Hanochites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06396">of Pallu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06384">of the Palluites</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02696">Of Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02697">of the Hezronites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03756">of Carmi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03757">of the Carmites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:7
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">of the Reubenites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and they that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">of them were forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06396">of Pallu</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0446">Eliab</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0446">of Eliab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05241">Nemuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01885">and Dathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>. This <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01885">Dathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121 strong:H07148" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">in the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">against Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and against Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">in the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when they strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Numbers 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and swallowed them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">together with Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">when that company</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">what time the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05251">and they became a sign</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Notwithstanding the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w> not.

verses.name: Numbers 26:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05241">of Nemuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H05242">of the Nemuelites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03226">of Jamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03228">of the Jaminites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03199">of Jachin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03200">of the Jachinites</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Nemuel</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jemuel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jachin</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jarib</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02226">Of Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02227">of the Zarhites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Shaul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H07587">of the Shaulites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zerah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Zohar</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:14
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H08099">of the Simeonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06827">of Zephon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06831">of the Zephonites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02291">of Haggi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02291">of the Haggites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07764">of Shuni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H07765">of the Shunites</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Zephon</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ziphion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0244">Of Ozni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0244">of the Oznites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06179">of Eri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06180">of the Erites</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Ozni</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ezbon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0720">Of Arod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0722">of the Arodites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0692">of Areli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0692">of the Arelites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Arod</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Arodi</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:18
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">of them, forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06147">Er</w> <w lemma="strong:H0209">and Onan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06147">and Er</w> <w lemma="strong:H0209">and Onan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07956">were; of Shelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08024">of the Shelanites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Pharez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06558">of the Pharzites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02227">of the Zarhites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Pharez</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">were; of Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02697">of the Hezronites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02538">of Hamul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02539">of the Hamulites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:22
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337 strong:H07657">of them, threescore and sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08439">Tola</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08440">of the Tolaites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06312">of Pua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06324">of the Punites</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Pua</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Phuvah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03437">Of Jashub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03432">of the Jashubites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08110">of Shimron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08117">of the Shimronites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jashub</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Job</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:25
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">of them, threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05624">of Sered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H05625">of the Sardites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0356">of Elon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0440">of the Elonites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03177">of Jahleel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03178">of the Jahleelites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:27
