verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H02075">of the Zebulunites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">of them, threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04354">of the Machirites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04353">and Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <transChange type="added">come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">of the Gileadites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:30
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>: <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0372">Jeezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0373">of the Jeezerites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02507">of Helek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02516">of the Helekites</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Jeezer</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Abiezer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:31
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0844">Asriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0845">of the Asrielites</w>: and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07928">Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H07930">of the Shechemites</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 26:32
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08061">Shemida</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08062">of the Shemidaites</w>: and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02660">Hepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02662">of the Hepherites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06765">And Zelophehad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02660">of Hepher</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">had no sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">but daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06765">of Zelophehad</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04244">Mahlah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05270">and Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02295">Hoglah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04435">Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08656">and Tirzah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:34
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of them, fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07803">of Shuthelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08364">of the Shuthalhites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01071">of Becher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01076">of the Bachrites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08465">of Tahan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08470">of the Tahanites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Becher</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Bered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:36
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07803">of Shuthelah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06197">of Eran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06198">of the Eranites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:37
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of them, thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01106">of Bela</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01108">of the Belaites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0788">of Ashbel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0789">of the Ashbelites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0297">of Ahiram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0298">of the Ahiramites</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Ahiram</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ehi</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Aharah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08197">Of Shupham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H07781">of the Shuphamites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02349">of Hupham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02350">of the Huphamites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shupham…Hupham</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Muppim and Huppim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01106">of Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H0714">were Ard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05283">and Naaman</w>: <transChange type="added">of Ard</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0716">of the Ardites</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05283">of Naaman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H05280">of the Naamites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ard</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Addar</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:41
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and they that were numbered</w> of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:42
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07748">of Shuham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H07749">of the Shuhamites</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shuham</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hushim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">All the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07749">of the Shuhamites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to those that were numbered</w> of them, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03232">of Jimna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03232">of the Jimnites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03440">of Jesui</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03441">of the Jesuites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01283">of Beriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01284">of the Beriites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01283">of Beriah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02268">of Heber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02277">of the Heberites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04439">of Malchiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04440">of the Malchielites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08294">Sarah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:47
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to those that were numbered</w> of them; <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:48
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03183">of Jahzeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03184">of the Jahzeelites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01476">of Guni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01477">of the Gunites</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 26:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03337">Of Jezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03340">of the Jezerites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08006">of Shillem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H08016">of the Shillemites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shillem</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shallum</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:50
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and they that were numbered</w> of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:51
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:52
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 26:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Unto these the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of names</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">To many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt give the more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">and to few</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt give the less</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">shall his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">to those that were numbered</w> of him.<note type="study"><catchWord>give the more…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiply his inheritance</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>give the less…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">diminish his inheritance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 26:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Notwithstanding the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">according to the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall inherit</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">According</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">to the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">shall the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof be divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">between many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">and few</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:57
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">of the Gershonites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04848">of the Merarites</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:58
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03846">of the Libnites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02276">of the Hebronites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04250">of the Mahlites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04188">of the Mushites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H07145">of the Korathites</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06955">And Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06019">Amram</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06019">of Amram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03115">Jochebed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, whom <transChange type="added">her mother</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">to Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06019">unto Amram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04813">and Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And unto Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H05070">Nadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05070">And Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And those that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of them were twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02145">all males</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">from a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8719">for they were not numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">because there was no inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:63
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they that were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">by Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But among these there was not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of them whom Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 26:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them, They shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And there was not left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of them, save Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen175" osisID="Num.26"/>

verses.name: Numbers 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06765">of Zelophehad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02660">of Hepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>: and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of his daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04244">Mahlah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05270">Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02295">and Hoglah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04435">and Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08656">and Tirzah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">and all the congregation</w>, <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">and he was not in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of them that gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">in the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but died</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">in his own sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and had no sons</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">Why should the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be done away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">his family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">because he hath no son</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> unto us <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>done…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">diminished</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">their cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">The daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06765">of Zelophehad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">right</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">them a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05159">and thou shalt cause the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to pass</w> unto them.

verses.name: Numbers 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and have no son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">then ye shall cause his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto his daughter</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">And if he have no daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And if he have no brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And if his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">have no brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">unto his kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">that is next</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">to him of his family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it: and it shall be unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into this mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05682">Abarim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when thou hast seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it, thou also shalt be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0175">as Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was gathered</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For ye rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against my commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04808">in the strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">me at the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>: that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04809">of Meribah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">in Kadesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Let the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the spirits</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">over the congregation</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Which may go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and which may go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and which may lead them out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and which may bring them in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05712">that the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">be not as sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which have no shepherd</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">thee Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> in whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> upon him;

verses.name: Numbers 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and give him a charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt put</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01935">of thine honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">upon him, that all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be obedient</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who shall ask</w> <transChange type="added">counsel</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for him after the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0224">of Urim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">at his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and at his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall come in</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he, and all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">with him, even all the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 27:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all the congregation</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 27:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon him, and gave him a charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen176" osisID="Num.27"/>

verses.name: Numbers 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">unto them, My offering</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">my bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">for my sacrifices made by fire</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05207">a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, shall ye observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">unto me in their due season</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a sweet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a savour of my rest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt say</w> unto them, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0801">the offering made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without spot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day by day</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>day by day</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in a day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">The one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>at even</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">between the two evenings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06224">And a tenth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">for a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">with the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03795">of beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which was ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">for a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">a sacrifice made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05262">And the drink offering</w> thereof <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07941">shalt thou cause the strong wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to be poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05262">a drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04503">as the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and as the drink offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, thou shalt offer</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">a sacrifice made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07676">And on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without spot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">deals of flour</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and the drink offering</w> thereof:

verses.name: Numbers 28:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">of every sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">beside the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and his drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07218">And in the beginnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of your months</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without spot</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth deals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of flour</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06241">tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">deals of flour</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06241">And a several tenth deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lamb</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">a sacrifice made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05262">And their drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">shall be half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01969">an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">unto a bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">unto a ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">and a fourth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01969">of an hin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">unto a lamb</w>: this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of every month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">throughout the months</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of the goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be offered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">beside the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and his drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">And in the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">And in the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of this month</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">shall unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be eaten</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 28:18

verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08345">And on the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 29:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">And their meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">and their drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">for the bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">for the rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03532">and for the lambs</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to their number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manner</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 29:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">goat</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08548">beside the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">his meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and his drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 29:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07637">And on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 29:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">And their meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">and their drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">for the bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">for the rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03532">and for the lambs</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to their number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manner</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 29:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">goat</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08548">beside the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">his meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and his drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 29:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08066">On the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06116">ye shall have a solemn assembly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">no servile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>:

verses.name: Numbers 29:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But ye shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0801">a sacrifice made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05207">of a sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07381">savour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">without blemish</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 29:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04503">Their meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">and their drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">for the bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">for the ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03532">and for the lambs</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to their number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manner</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 29:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">goat</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08548">beside the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and his meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and his drink offering</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 29:39
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">in your set feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05088">beside your vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">and your freewill offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">for your burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and for your meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and for your drink offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">and for your peace offerings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>do</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">offer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 29:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen178" osisID="Num.29"/>

verses.name: Numbers 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">unto the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">concerning the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">or swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0632">with a bond</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall not break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">according to all that proceedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of his mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>break</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">profane</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">If a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bind</w> <transChange type="added">herself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0632">by a bond</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">in her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">in her youth</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">her vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">and her bond</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith she hath bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall hold his peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">at her: then all her vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">and every bond</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith she hath bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">But if her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">disallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">her in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he heareth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05088">not any of her vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">or of her bonds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith she hath bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">her, because her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">disallowed</w> her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if she had at all an husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05088">when she vowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04008">or uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">ought out of her lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith she bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>she vowed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">her vows were upon her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and held his peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at her in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05088">then her vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">and her bonds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith she bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But if her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">disallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">her on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05088">then he shall make her vow which she vowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04008">and that which she uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">with her lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith she bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of none effect</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall forgive</w> her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05088">But every vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">of a widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and of her that is divorced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith they have bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w> against her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And if she vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">in her husband’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0632">by a bond</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">with an oath</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 30:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and held his peace</w> at her, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">disallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">her not: then all her vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">and every bond</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith she bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But if her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hath utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">made them void</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he heard</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04161">whatsoever proceeded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">out of her lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">concerning her vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">or concerning the bond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of her soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not stand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath made them void</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall forgive</w> her.

verses.name: Numbers 30:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05088">Every vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">and every binding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">it, or her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may make it void</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But if her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hold his peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at her from day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then he establisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">all her vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0632">or all her bonds</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon her: he confirmeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, because he held his peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at her in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he heard</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">But if he shall any ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make them void</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he hath heard</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">her iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 30:16
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">between a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">between the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and his daughter</w>, <transChange type="added">being yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05271">in her youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen179" osisID="Num.30"/>

verses.name: Numbers 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05360 strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04084">of the Midianites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shalt thou be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto thy people</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">some</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of yourselves unto the war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04080">and let them go against the Midianites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05360 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294 strong:H04294">Of every tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505 strong:H0505">a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">throughout all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to the war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A thousand of a tribe, a thousand of a tribe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04560" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">So there were delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">out of the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> of <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for war</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">them to the war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> of <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06372">them and Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">to the war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">with the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">instruments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02689">and the trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">to blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they warred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">against the Midianites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">all the males</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05921">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">the rest of them that were slain</w>; <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0189">Evi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07552">and Rekem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06698">and Zur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02354">and Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07254">and Reba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">also the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> took <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and their little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and took the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of all their cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and all their flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and all their goods</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">wherein they dwelt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02918">and all their goodly castles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">all the spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04455">and all the prey</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of beasts</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">the captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04455">and the prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">and the spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and unto the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">at the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">them without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the host</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>battle</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">host of war</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto them, Have ye saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">all the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">alive</w>?

verses.name: Numbers 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02007">Behold, these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">through the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">of Balaam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04560" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06465">of Peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04046">and there was a plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">among the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">among the little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">every woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hath known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">by lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">with him</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a male</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">But all the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">by lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">with him, keep alive</w> for yourselves.

verses.name: Numbers 31:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And do ye abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever hath killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">any person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and whosoever hath touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">any slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">purify</w> <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07628">yourselves and your captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07637">and on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And purify</w> all <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all that is made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of skins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and all work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all things made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">instrument</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">vessel of skins</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0499">And Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">the ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 31:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">Only the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">the iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0913">the tin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05777">and the lead</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Every thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that may abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, ye shall make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">go through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall be clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">nevertheless it shall be purified</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">of separation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and all that abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">not the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall make go through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And ye shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">your clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall be clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H04455">of the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">that was taken</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">thou, and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-105">And divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04455">the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-105">into two parts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">between them that took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon them, who went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and between all the congregation</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 31:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And levy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04371">a tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">of five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of the persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and of the beeves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and of the asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of the sheep</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 31:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04276">of their half</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0499">unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">an heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04276">half</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">of the persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the beeves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">of the asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of the flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">of all manner of beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">them unto the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>flocks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04455">And the booty</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">of the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">which the men of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had caught</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">was six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">and seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H07657">And threescore and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">beeves</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08346">And threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">asses</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:35
