verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">And thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120 strong:H05315">persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03605">in all</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">of women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that had not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">by lying</w> with him.

verses.name: Numbers 31:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04275">And the half</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">was in number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 31:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04371">tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">was six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568 strong:H07657">and threescore and fifteen</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01241">And the beeves</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">of which the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04371">tribute</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H07657">threescore and twelve</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02543">And the asses</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">of which the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04371">tribute</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H0120">And the persons</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">of which the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04371">tribute</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">persons</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04371">the tribute</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">heave offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04276">half</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">from the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that warred</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:43
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H04275">Now the half</w> <transChange type="added">that pertained unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">was three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H04480">sheep</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">And thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">beeves</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">And thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 31:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">And sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120 strong:H05315">persons</w>;)

verses.name: Numbers 31:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Even of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04276">half</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">them unto the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:48
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And the officers</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 31:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under our charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there lacketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not one man</w> of us.<note type="study"><catchWord>charge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">We have therefore brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">an oblation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">what every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath gotten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">of jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0685">chains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06781">and bracelets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02885">rings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05694">earrings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03558">and tablets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for our souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gotten</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the gold</w> of them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 31:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">And all the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">of the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that they offered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and of the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">was sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offering</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heave offering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 31:53
verses.text: (<transChange type="added">For</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> for himself.)

verses.name: Numbers 31:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">it into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02146">a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen180" osisID="Num.31"/>

verses.name: Numbers 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">had a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">of cattle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03270">of Jazer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">that, behold, the place</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">for cattle</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">and to Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and unto the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05852">Ataroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01769">and Dibon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03270">and Jazer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05247">and Nimrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02809">and Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0500">and Elealeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07643">and Shebam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05015">and Nebo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01194">and Beon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Nimrah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Beth–nimrah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shebam</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shibmah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Beon</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Baal–meon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">for cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">have cattle</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore, said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they, if we have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">let this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">for a possession</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring us not over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">Shall your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall ye sit</w> here?

verses.name: Numbers 32:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05106 strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">And wherefore discourage ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from going over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> them?<note type="study"><catchWord>discourage</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">break</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">them from Kadesh–barnea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For when they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0812">of Eshcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they discouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he sware</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">none of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and unto Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because they have not wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> me:<note type="study"><catchWord>wholly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fulfilled after me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03612">Save Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07074">the Kenezite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for they have wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he made them wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01755">until all the generation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was consumed</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, ye are risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in your fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H08635">stead, an increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">of sinful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to augment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">yet the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">toward Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For if ye turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, he will yet again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them in the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and ye shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all this people</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H01448">sheepfolds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">here for our cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">for our little ones</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 32:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0587">But we ourselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">will go ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until we have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">them unto their place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02945">and our little ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">in the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto our houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">until the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">have inherited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For we will not inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">with them on yonder side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01973">or forward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05159">because our inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">to us on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, If ye will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">if ye will go armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 32:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-106">And will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">all of you armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-106">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">until he hath driven out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> him,

verses.name: Numbers 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">then afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05355">and be guiltless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and before Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">shall be your possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye will not do so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, ye have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">your sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will find you out</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">you cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">for your little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01448">and folds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06792">for your sheep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that which hath proceeded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of your mouth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">as my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">commandeth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02945">Our little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">our wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">our flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and all our cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">shall be there in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 32:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">But thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will pass over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">every man armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">as my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saith</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">So concerning them Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 32:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto them, If the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will pass with you over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">every man armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you; then ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">for a possession</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 32:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if they will not pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with you armed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they shall have possessions</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">As the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so will we do</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05168">We will</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0272">that the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of our inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> ours.

verses.name: Numbers 32:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and unto half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">with the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">thereof in the coasts</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01769">Dibon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05852">and Ataroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06177">and Aroer</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 32:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05855">And Atroth, Shophan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03270">and Jaazer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03011">and Jogbehah</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Jaazer</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jazer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01039">And Beth–nimrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01028">and Beth–haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04013">fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01448">and folds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for sheep</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Beth–nimrah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Nimrah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0500">and Elealeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07156">and Kirjathaim</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 32:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05015">And Nebo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01186">and Baal–meon</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w> <w lemma="strong:H04142" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">being changed</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H07643">and Shibmah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034 strong:H08034">other names</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they builded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they called by names the names of the cities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 32:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">to Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and dispossessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorite</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> in it.

verses.name: Numbers 32:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">unto Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he dwelt</w> therein.

verses.name: Numbers 32:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02971">And Jair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02333">the small towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02334">them Havoth–jair</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 32:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05025">And Nobah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07079">Kenath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05025">it Nobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">after his own name</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen181" osisID="Num.32"/>

verses.name: Numbers 33:1
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04550">the journeys</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">with their armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">their goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04550">according to their journeys</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04550">their journeys</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">according to their goings out</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07486">from Rameses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568 strong:H06240">on the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">after the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with an high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of all the Egyptians</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">For the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">buried</w> all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">among them: upon their gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">also the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgments</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07486">from Rameses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">in Succoth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">from Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0864">in Etham</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0864">from Etham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turned again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06367">unto Pi–hahiroth</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01189">before Baal–zephon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04024">Migdol</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06367">Pi–hahiroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0864">of Etham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04785">in Marah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04785">from Marah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0362">unto Elim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0362">and in Elim</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">and threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08558">palm trees</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they pitched</w> there.

verses.name: Numbers 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0362">from Elim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">by the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">from the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05512">of Sin</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took their journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">out of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05512">of Sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01850">in Dophkah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01850">from Dophkah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0442">in Alush</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0442">from Alush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07508">at Rephidim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">where was no water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07508">from Rephidim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">from the desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">of Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06914">at Kibroth–hattaavah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Kibroth–hattaavah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the graves of lust</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06914">from Kibroth–hattaavah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02698">at Hazeroth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02698">from Hazeroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07575">in Rithmah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07575">from Rithmah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07428">at Rimmon–parez</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07428">from Rimmon–parez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">in Libnah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">from Libnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07446">at Rissah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07446">from Rissah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06954">in Kehelathah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06954">from Kehelathah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08234">Shapher</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08234">Shapher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02732">in Haradah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02732">from Haradah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04722">in Makheloth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04722">from Makheloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08480">at Tahath</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08480">from Tahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H08646">at Tarah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08646">from Tarah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04989">in Mithcah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04989">from Mithcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02832">in Hashmonah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02832">from Hashmonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04149">at Moseroth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04149">from Moseroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01142">in Bene–jaakan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01142">from Bene–jaakan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02735">at Hor–hagidgad</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02735">from Hor–hagidgad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03193">in Jotbathah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03193">from Jotbathah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05684">at Ebronah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05684">from Ebronah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06100">at Ezion–gaber</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06100">from Ezion–gaber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06946">Kadesh</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">from Kadesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">there, in the fortieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">after the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02549">of the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0175">And Aaron</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">when he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06166">Arad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">in the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of the coming</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06758">in Zalmonah</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06758">from Zalmonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06325">in Punon</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06325">from Punon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H088">in Oboth</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H088">from Oboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05863">in Ije–abarim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">in the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ije–abarim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heaps of Abarim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 33:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05864">from Iim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01769">in Dibon–gad</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01769">from Dibon–gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05963">in Almon–diblathaim</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05963">from Almon–diblathaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05682">of Abarim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05015">Nebo</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05682">of Abarim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01020">from Beth–jesimoth</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H063">unto Abel–shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abel–shittim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the plains of Shittim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 33:50
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 33:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them, When ye are passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 33:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then ye shall drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">you, and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04906">all their pictures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">all their molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and quite pluck down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">all their high places</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 33:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And ye shall dispossess</w> <transChange type="added">the inhabitants of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein: for I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Numbers 33:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8694" type="x-split-107">And ye shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8694" type="x-split-107">for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">among your families</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">to the more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall give the more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">and to the fewer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall give the less</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w>: every man’s <transChange type="added">inheritance</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">shall be in the place where his lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">falleth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04294">according to the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">ye shall inherit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>give the more…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiply his inheritance</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>give the less…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">diminish his inheritance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 33:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But if ye will not drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain</w> of them <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07899">pricks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06796">and thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">in your sides</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherein ye dwell</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 33:56
verses.text: Moreover it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto you, as I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> unto them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen182" osisID="Num.33"/>

verses.name: Numbers 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them, When ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>; (this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">unto you for an inheritance</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">with the coasts</w> thereof:)

verses.name: Numbers 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05045">Then your south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">quarter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">shall be from the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">along by the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and your south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">shall be the outmost coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And your border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">from the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">to the ascent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04610">of Akrabbim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pass on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">to Zin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the going forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">thereof shall be from the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">to Kadesh–barnea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall go on</w> <w lemma="strong:H02692">to Hazar–addar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pass on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06111">to Azmon</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall fetch a compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06111">from Azmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of it shall be at the sea</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the western</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">ye shall even have the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">for a border</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03220">this shall be your west</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06828">And this shall be your north</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">from the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08376" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye shall point out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">for you mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 34:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">From mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08376" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye shall point out</w> <transChange type="added">your border</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06657">shall be to Zedad</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 34:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go on</w> <w lemma="strong:H02202">to Ziphron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02704">of it shall be at Hazar–enan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06828">this shall be your north</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0184" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">And ye shall point out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">your east</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02704">from Hazar–enan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08221">to Shepham</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08221">from Shepham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">to Riblah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05871">of Ain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall descend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall reach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">unto the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03672">of Chinnereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>side of the sea</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder of the sea</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">to Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of it shall be at the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">this shall be your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">with the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">which ye shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">unto the nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and to the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">For the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01425">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have received</w> <transChange type="added">their inheritance</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">The two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 34:17
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">unto you: Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of every tribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-108">to divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-108">by inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">these: Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">Shemuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05989">of Ammihud</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">Of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0449">Elidad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03692">of Chislon</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01231">Bukki</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03020">of Jogli</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">The prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">for the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02592">Hanniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0641">of Ephod</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07055">Kemuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08204">of Shiphtan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0469">Elizaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06535">of Parnach</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06409">Paltiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05821">of Azzan</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0282">Ahihud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08015">of Shelomi</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06300">Pedahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05989">of Ammihud</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 34:29
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to divide the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen183" osisID="Num.34"/>

verses.name: Numbers 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of their possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall give</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">for the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> them.

verses.name: Numbers 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall they have to dwell in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04054">and the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of them shall be for their cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and for their goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and for all their beasts</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04054">And the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">shall reach</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07023">from the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">and outward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">from without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and on the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and on the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04054">this shall be to them the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And among the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">for refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the manslayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither: and to them ye shall add</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">above them ye shall give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 35:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">to the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>: them <transChange type="added">shall ye give</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall give</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: from <transChange type="added">them that have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall give many</w>; but from <transChange type="added">them that have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall give few</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">to his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he inheriteth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they inherit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 35:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them, When ye be come over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 35:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then ye shall appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">you cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to be cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for you; that the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thither, which killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">any person</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">at unawares</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by error</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 35:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And they shall be unto you cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">for refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from the avenger</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the manslayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not, until he stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And of these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">shall ye have for refuge</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">shall be cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:15
