verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">These six</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">shall be a refuge</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and for the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08453">and for the sojourner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">them: that every one that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">any person</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">unawares</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may flee</w> thither.

verses.name: Numbers 35:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And if he smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">him with an instrument</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that he die</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a murderer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the murderer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And if he smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him with throwing</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith he may die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he die</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a murderer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the murderer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with a stone of the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 35:18
verses.text: Or <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him with an hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">weapon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith he may die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he die</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a murderer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the murderer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The revenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">himself shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the murderer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he meeteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">him, he</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall slay</w> him.

verses.name: Numbers 35:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if he thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">him of hatred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">or hurl</w> <w lemma="strong:H06660">at him by laying of wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he die</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 35:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0342">Or in enmity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him with his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that smote</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a murderer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the revenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the murderer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he meeteth</w> him.

verses.name: Numbers 35:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But if he thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06621">him suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H0342">enmity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">or have cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">upon him any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06660">without laying of wait</w>,

verses.name: Numbers 35:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">Or with any stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith a man may die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">seeing</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">not</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, that he die</w>, and <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not his enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">neither sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">his harm</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 35:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">Then the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">between the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the revenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to these judgments</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 35:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the revenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him to the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of his refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither he was fled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">in it unto the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which was anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">with the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But if the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall at any time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">without the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of his refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whither he was fled</w>;

verses.name: Numbers 35:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the revenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">him without</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of his refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the revenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the slayer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01818">he shall not be guilty of blood</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">no blood shall be to him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 35:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Because he should have remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of his refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">until the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">but after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of his possession</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:29
verses.text: So these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">shall be for a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto you throughout your generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">in all your dwellings</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Whoso killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">any person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the murderer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">of witnesses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">but one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against any person</w> <transChange type="added">to cause him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to die</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover ye shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">no satisfaction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of a murderer</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">guilty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but he shall be surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">put to death</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>guilty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">faulty to die</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 35:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">no satisfaction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for him that is fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of his refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he should come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04194">until the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priest</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 35:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So ye shall not pollute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> wherein ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">for blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it defileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">cannot be cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that is shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">therein, but by the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that shed</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>the land cannot…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there can be no expiation for the land</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 35:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Defile</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not therefore the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which ye shall inhabit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I dwell</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen184" osisID="Num.35"/>

verses.name: Numbers 36:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">And the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0113">and my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06765">of Zelophehad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto his daughters</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And if they be married</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to any</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> of the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">then shall their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">from the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">to the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">from the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of our inheritance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whereunto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto whom they shall be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03104">And when the jubile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">shall be, then shall their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">unto the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">from the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whereunto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto whom they shall be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 36:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">The tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath said</w> well.

verses.name: Numbers 36:6
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">doth command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">concerning the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06765">of Zelophehad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">Let them marry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to whom they think</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">best</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04940">only to the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">shall they marry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>marry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be wives</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">So shall not the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">from tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">to tribe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">himself to the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>keep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cleave to the</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Numbers 36:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">And every daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that possesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">in any tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">shall be wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of her father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 36:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">Neither shall the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">remove</w> from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">but every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">himself to his own inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Numbers 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Even as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06765">of Zelophehad</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 36:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04244">For Mahlah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08656">Tirzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02295">and Hoglah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04435">and Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05270">and Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06765">of Zelophehad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">were married</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">unto their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">brothers’ sons</w>:

verses.name: Numbers 36:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">they were married</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">into the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">and their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">remained in the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to some that were of the families</rdg></note>

verses.name: Numbers 36:13
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w> <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen185" osisID="Num.36"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen149" osisID="Num" type="book"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:1
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05489">the Red</w> <transChange type="added">sea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06290">between Paran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08603">and Tophel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03837">and Laban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02698">and Hazeroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01774">and Dizahab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Red…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zuph</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:2
verses.text: (<transChange type="added">There are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <transChange type="added">journey</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02722">from Horeb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">unto Kadesh–barnea</w>.)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">And it came to pass in the fortieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">in the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">on the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according unto all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had given him in commandment</w> unto them;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05747">and Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06252">at Astaroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0154">in Edrei</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05676">On this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0874" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">this law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">unto us in Horeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Ye have dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">long enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in this mount</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you, and take your journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, and unto all <transChange type="added">the places</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07934">nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">thereunto, in the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and in the vale</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and in the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and by the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02348">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">and unto Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">unto the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all his neighbours</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you: go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">in and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto them and to their seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>set</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">given</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">unto you at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I am not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">you myself alone</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath multiplied</w> you, and, behold, ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:11
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">make you a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so many more as</w> ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">you, as he hath promised</w> you!)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0349">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can I myself alone bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02960">your cumbrance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">and your burden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07379">and your strife</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">you wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and known</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">among your tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">them rulers</w> over you.<note type="study"><catchWord>Take</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">The thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou hast spoken</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <transChange type="added">for us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of your tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">them heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">over you, captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">over fifties</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">over tens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">among your tribes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Hear</w> <transChange type="added">the causes</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">between your brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteously</w> between <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the stranger</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall not respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">the small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">as well as the great</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall not be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">for the judgment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God’s</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that is too hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for you, bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, and I will hear</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>respect…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">acknowledge faces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">you at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye should do</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when we departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">from Horeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we went through</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all that great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us; and we came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">to Kadesh–barnea</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you, Ye are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth give</w> unto us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee: go up</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">possess</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, neither be discouraged</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me every one of you, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, and they shall search us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-109">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">us word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-109">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by what way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we must go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and into what cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall come</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased me well</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of you, one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626 strong:H0376">of a tribe</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0812">of Eshcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and searched it out</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hands</w>, and brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-110">unto us, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">us word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-110">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth give</w> us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Notwithstanding ye would</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07279" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And ye murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in your tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">us, he hath brought us forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whither shall we go up</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have discouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">our heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and taller</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">than we; the cities</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and walled up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and moreover we have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06062">of the Anakims</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>discouraged</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you, Dread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, neither be afraid</w> of them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">you, he shall fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for you, according to all that he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">for you in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before your eyes</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04057">And in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where thou hast seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">how that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee, as a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until ye came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">into this place</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Yet in this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">ye did not believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, to search you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pitch your tents</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">in fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">you by what way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye should go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">and in a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of your words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and sware</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Surely there shall not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of these men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">that good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02108">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and to him will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath trodden upon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wholly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fulfilled to go after</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Also the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">was angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">with me for your sakes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou also shalt not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08033">in thither</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:38
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, he shall go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">thither: encourage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">him: for he shall cause Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to inherit</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02945">Moreover your little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0957">should be a prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and your children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">which in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had no knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">between good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither, and unto them will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and they shall possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:40
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you, turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you, and take your journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then ye answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, We have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us. And when ye had girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">on every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01951" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye were ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the hill</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Go not up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither fight</w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">not among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">you; lest ye be smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your enemies</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you; and ye would not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-111">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">presumptuously</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-111">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the hill</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ye were presumptuous, and went up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0567">And the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in that mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, and chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01682">you, as bees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">you in Seir</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02767">unto Hormah</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to your voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor give ear</w> unto you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 1:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So ye abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">in Kadesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">according unto the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye abode</w> <transChange type="added">there</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen187" osisID="Deut.1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then we turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took our journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me: and we compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Ye have compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">this mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">long enough</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">you northward</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">And command</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">through the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">in Seir</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">of you: take ye good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">heed</w> unto yourselves therefore:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Meddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not with them; for I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you of their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">no, not so much as a foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709 strong:H04096">breadth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">unto Esau</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">a possession</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>no…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">even to the treading of the sole of the foot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of them for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03739" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall also buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of them for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may drink</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thee in all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thy hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">through this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0705">these forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">hath been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee; thou hast lacked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when we passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">by from our brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">in Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">through the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0359">from Elath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06100">and from Ezion–gaber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, Distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">not the Moabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">neither contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with them in battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee of their land</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">a possession</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06144">Ar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">of Lot</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">a possession</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Distress…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Use no hostility against Moab</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0368">The Emims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">therein in times past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and tall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06062">as the Anakims</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01992">Which</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also were accounted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">giants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06062">as the Anakims</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04125">but the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0368">them Emims</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02752">The Horims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">in Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">beforetime</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">but the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">succeeded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, when they had destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in their stead; as Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03425">of his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>succeeded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inherited</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>stead</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">room</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now rise up</w>, <transChange type="added">said I</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and get you over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H02218">Zered</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H02218">Zered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brook</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the space</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in which we came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">from Kadesh–barnea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">until we were come over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H02218">Zered</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01755">until all the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were wasted out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>brook</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">For indeed the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was against them, to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">them from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they were consumed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">So it came to pass, when all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou art to pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06144">through Ar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:19
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou comest nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them not, nor meddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them: for I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">possession</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">of Lot</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">a possession</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:20
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">That also was accounted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of giants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07497">giants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">therein in old time</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05984">and the Ammonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02157">them Zamzummims</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Zamzummims</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Zuzims</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">A people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and tall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06062">as the Anakims</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; and they succeeded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and dwelt</w> in their stead:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">As he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">in Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">when he destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02752">the Horims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; and they succeeded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in their stead even unto this day</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05761">And the Avims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02699">in Hazerim</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05804">unto Azzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03732">the Caphtorims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03731">out of Caphtor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and dwelt</w> in their stead.)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rise ye up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take your journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and his land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to possess</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with him in battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>begin…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">begin, possess</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">the dread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">of thee and the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971 strong:H06440">of thee upon the nations</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under the whole heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">report</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee, and shall tremble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be in anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because of thee</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">out of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06932">of Kedemoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">unto Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through thy land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870 strong:H01870">along by the high way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will neither turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">unto the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">nor to the left</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">me meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I may eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">me water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I may drink</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">only I will pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on my feet</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:29
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H01121">As the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">in Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04125">and the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06144">in Ar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me;) until I shall pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05511">But Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not let us pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by him: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">his spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and made his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">obstinate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he might deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into thy hand</w>, as <transChange type="added">appeareth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have begun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thee: begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to possess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05511">Then Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">us, he and all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03096">at Jahaz</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">us; and we smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him, and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all his people</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all his cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and the little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">of every city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">we left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">none to remain</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the men…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">every city of men, and women, and little ones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">Only the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we took for a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">unto ourselves, and the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which we took</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06177">From Aroer</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">by the brink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>, and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">by the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01568">even unto Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">there was not one city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">too strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for us: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">all unto us</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 2:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Only unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou camest</w> not, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto any place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H02999">Jabbok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">nor unto the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">nor unto whatsoever the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">forbad</w> us. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen188" osisID="Deut.2"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then we turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">to Bashan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05747">and Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">us, he and all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0154">at Edrei</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him not: for I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him, and all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and his land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thy hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him as thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">unto Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">at Heshbon</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">also, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him until none was left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">to him remaining</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all his cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">there was not a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which we took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">not from them, threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02256">all the region</w> <w lemma="strong:H0709">of Argob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">All these cities</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">with high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01817">gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01280">and bars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06521">beside unwalled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">many</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And we utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, as we did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">unto Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">utterly destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">of every city</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">But all the cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">and the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we took for a prey</w> to ourselves.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:8
