verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-112">And we took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-112">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:9
verses.text: (<transChange type="added">Which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">the Sidonians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08303">Sirion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08149">it Shenir</w>;)

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">All the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01568">and all Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01316">and all Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05548">unto Salchah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0154">and Edrei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05747">For only Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of giants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06210">behold, his bedstead</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06210">a bedstead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>; <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">it not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">in Rabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">thereof, and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">of it, after the cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And this land</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06177">from Aroer</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">I unto the Reubenites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01425">and to the Gadites</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01316">and all Bashan</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">I unto the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02256">all the region</w> <w lemma="strong:H0709">of Argob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01316">with all Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01931">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of giants</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02971">Jair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">all the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H0709">of Argob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01651">of Geshuri</w> <w lemma="strong:H04602">and Maachathi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">them after his own name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02334 strong:H01316">Bashan–havoth–jair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">unto Machir</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07206">And unto the Reubenites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01425">and unto the Gadites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">from Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">even unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">even unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H02999">Jabbok</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06160">The plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">also, and Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the coast</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03672">from Chinnereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">even unto the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04417">the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0794 strong:H0798" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">under Ashdoth–pisgah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ashdoth–pisgah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the springs of Pisgah</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">you at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it: ye shall pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, all <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">for the war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>meet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of power</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">But your wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and your little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and your cattle</w>, (<transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">that ye have much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in your cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> you;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Until the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have given rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto your brethren</w>, as well as unto you, and <transChange type="added">until</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they also possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">them beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>: and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall ye return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03425">unto his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">Thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto these two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">so shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">unto all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou passest</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he shall fight</w> for you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And I besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast begun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">thy greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and thy mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">for what God</w> <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">or in earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that can do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">according to thy works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and according to thy might</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, let me go over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">that goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">and Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me for your sakes, and would not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me: and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">unto me, Let it suffice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee; speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto me of this matter</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">into the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H06449">of Pisgah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08486">and southward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">and eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with thine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt not go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">this Jordan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Pisgah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">But charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and encourage</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">him, and strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: for he shall go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall cause them to inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt see</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So we abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01047">Beth–peor</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen189" osisID="Deut.3"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">unto the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and unto the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, for to do</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall not add</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, neither shall ye diminish</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from it, that ye may keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01187">because of Baal–peor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980 strong:H0310" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01187">Baal–peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">them from among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01695">But ye that did cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every one of you this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">you statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">even as</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, that ye should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">so in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore and do</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>; for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">your wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">and your understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">all these statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">Surely this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">For what nation</w> <transChange type="added">is there so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, who <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in all <transChange type="added">things that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">we call</w> upon him <transChange type="added">for</transChange>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And what nation</w> <transChange type="added">is there so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">that hath statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">as all this law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Only take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to thyself, and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">diligently</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest thou forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">which thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lest they depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">from thy heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Specially</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou stoodest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">in Horeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-113">unto me, Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">me the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-113">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will make them hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that they shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they may teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their children</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">under the mountain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06205">with darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">clouds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">and thick darkness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">unto you out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08544">no similitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02108">only</w> <transChange type="added">ye heard</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>only…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">save a voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">unto you his covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you to perform</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandments</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them upon two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">me at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">you statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye might do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966">Take ye therefore good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto yourselves</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08544">no manner of similitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">unto you in Horeb</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Lest ye corrupt</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">you a graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08544">the similitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05566">of any figure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08403">the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of male</w> <w lemma="strong:H05347">or female</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08403">The likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of any beast</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08403">the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of any winged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that flieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the air</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08403">The likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of any thing that creepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">on the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08403">the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01710">of any fish</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">beneath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And lest thou lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when thou seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03556">and the stars</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shouldest be driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under the whole heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>divided</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">imparted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you, and brought you forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">out of the iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03564">furnace</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">to be unto him a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of inheritance</w>, as <transChange type="added">ye are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Furthermore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">was angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with me for your sakes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should not go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and that I should not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in unto that good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">But I must die</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I must not go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but ye shall go over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">that good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto yourselves, lest ye forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with you, and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">you a graven image</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08544">the likeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03605">of any</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath forbidden</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a consuming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07067">a jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">When thou shalt beget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall have remained long</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall corrupt</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a graven image</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08544">the likeness</w> of any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke him to anger</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-114">I call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-114">to witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">against you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04118">that ye shall soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from off the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereunto ye go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it; ye shall not prolong</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">upon it, but shall utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">you among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">in number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whither the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall lead</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there ye shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which neither see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor smell</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But if from thence thou shalt seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt find</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">him with all thy heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">When thou art in tribulation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and all these things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> upon thee, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if thou turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt be obedient</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto his voice</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">have found thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:31
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07349">a merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will not forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, neither destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, nor forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> unto them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">For ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">now of the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">that are past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which were</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee, since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">created</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, and <transChange type="added">ask</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the one side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> unto the other, whether there hath been <transChange type="added">any such thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">as this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">or hath been heard</w> like it?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:33
verses.text: Did <transChange type="added">ever</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speaking out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as thou hast heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and live</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Or hath God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">assayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">him a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from the midst</w> of <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04531">by temptations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">by signs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04159">and by wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and by war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and by a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and by a stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and by great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172">terrors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">for you in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before your eyes</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">Unto thee it was shewed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mightest know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05750">none else</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">beside him</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Out of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he made thee to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he might instruct</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee: and upon earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee his great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And because he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore he chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">their seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and brought thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with his mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mightier</w> than thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee in, to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee their land</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">therefore this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and consider</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and upon the earth</w> beneath: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none else.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">therefore his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it may go well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with thee, and with thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, and that thou mayest prolong</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee, for ever.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">Then Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">severed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217 strong:H08121">toward the sunrising</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither, which should kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847 strong:H01097">unawares</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H08543">him not in times</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">past</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and that fleeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0411">of these</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he might live</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:43
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01221">Bezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04334">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07206">of the Reubenites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07216">and Ramoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">of the Gadites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01474">and Golan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04520">of the Manassites</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:45
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05713">the testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after they came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05676">On this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01047">Beth–peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">at Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">whom Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after they were come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06177">From Aroer</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">by the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">even unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H07865">Sion</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 4:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06160">And all the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">even unto the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0794">under the springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06449">of Pisgah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen190" osisID="Deut.4"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in your ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and keep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and do</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>keep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">keep to do them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">with us in Horeb</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">not this covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0587">but with us</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> us, who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0428">all of us</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">here alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with you face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:5
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">between the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">and you at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">you the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye were afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mount</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bondage</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">servants</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0312">Thou shalt have none other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not make</w> thee <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06459">graven image</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08544">any likeness</w> <transChange type="added">of any thing</transChange> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>, or that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> beneath, or that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">beneath the earth</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Thou shalt not bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">thyself unto them, nor serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them: for I the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07067">a jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">visiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08029">unto the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H07256">and fourth</w> <transChange type="added">generation</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that hate</w> me,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And shewing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">unto thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> will not hold <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">guiltless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all thy work</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">But the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <transChange type="added">in it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">any work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, nor thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor thy daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">nor thy manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">nor thy maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">nor thine ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">nor thine ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">nor any of thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">nor thy stranger</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thy manservant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">and thy maidservant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may rest</w> as well as thou.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thou wast a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">thee out thence through a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and by a stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and thy mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee; that thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may be prolonged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and that it may go well</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">with thee, in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not kill</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou commit adultery</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou steal</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against thy neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Neither shalt thou desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">neither shalt thou covet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">his field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">or his manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">or his maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">his ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">or his ass</w>, or any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">These words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">unto all your assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06205">and of the thick darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he added no more</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them in two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delivered</w> them unto me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when ye heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of the darkness</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H02022">for the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye came near</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">all the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of your tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and your elders</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">us his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">and his greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">doth talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">with man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he liveth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore why should we die</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01419">for this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us: if we hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">any more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then we shall die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">add to hear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:26
verses.text: For who <transChange type="added">is there of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">all flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w>, as we <transChange type="added">have</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lived</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go thou near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall say</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou unto us all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee; and we will hear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of your words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when ye spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto me; and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which they have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto thee: they have well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said all that they have spoken</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02088">O that there were such</w> <w lemma="strong:H04310">an</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they would fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all my commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">always</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it might be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with them, and with their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-115">to them, Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">you into your tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-115">again</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But as for thee, stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">thou here by me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto thee all the commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which thou shalt teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, that they may do</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye shall observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you: ye shall not turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">to the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">or to the left</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 5:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, that ye may live</w>, and <transChange type="added">that it may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">well</w> with you, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye may prolong</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall possess</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen191" osisID="Deut.5"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, that ye might do</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it:<note type="study"><catchWord>go</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass over</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That thou mightest fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">all his statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee, thou, and thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">and that thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may be prolonged</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">therefore, O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it may be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, and that ye may increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">mightily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee, in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all thy soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and with all thy might</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">shall be in thine heart</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt teach them diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thy children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shalt talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them when thou sittest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when thou walkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when thou liest down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when thou risest up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>teach</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whet</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sharpen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">them for a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02903">and they shall be as frontlets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">between thine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt write</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">them upon the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thy house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and on thy gates</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And it shall be, when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">to Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and to Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou buildedst</w> not,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">of all good</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou filledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">not, and wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">digged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou diggedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">not, vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">and olive trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou plantedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not; when thou shalt have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be full</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">beware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest thou forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought thee forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bondage</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bondmen</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">servants</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, and shalt swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by his name</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> you;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:15
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07067">a jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">you) lest the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against thee, and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee from off the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Ye shall not tempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as ye tempted</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04532">in Massah</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Ye shall diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05713">and his testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he hath commanded</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt do</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it may be well</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, and that thou mayest go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">when thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">thee in time to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, What <transChange type="added">mean</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05713">the testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> you?<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:21
