verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">We were Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">bondmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">upon Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and upon all his household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">before our eyes</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>sore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he brought us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from thence, that he might bring us in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto our fathers</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">all these statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">for our good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">always</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he might preserve us alive</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">And it shall be our righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if we observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">all these</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath commanded</w> us. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen192" osisID="Deut.6"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">When the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05394" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and hath cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">thee, the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01622">and the Girgashites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mightier</w> than thou;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee; thou shalt smite</w> them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">no covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, nor shew mercy</w> unto them:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Neither shalt thou make marriages</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with them; thy daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto thy son</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For they will turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, that they may serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">so will the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against you, and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">thee suddenly</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But thus shall ye deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them; ye shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">their altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">their images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">their groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">their graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their statues</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">pillars</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:6
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05459">thee to be a special</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto himself, above all people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did not set his love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon you, nor choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">you, because ye were more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">in number than any people</w>; for ye <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">the fewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all people</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, and because he would keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he had sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">you out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">to a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And repayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him to their face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them: he will not be slack</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, he will repay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him to his face</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt therefore keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06118">Wherefore it shall come to pass, if</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">to these judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">unto thee the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and the mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>if</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">because</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he will love</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, and bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee: he will also bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of thy womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01715">thy corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and thy wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and thine oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07698">the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0504">of thy kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06251">and the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Thou shalt be blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">above all people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06135">there shall not be male</w> <w lemma="strong:H06135">or female barren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">among you, or among your cattle</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">from thee all sickness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">none of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04064">diseases</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou knowest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee; but will lay</w> them upon all <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hate</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thee; thine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have no pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them: neither shalt thou serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>; for that <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04170">a snare</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">These nations</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H0349">than I; how</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I dispossess</w> them?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not be afraid</w> of them: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shalt well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and unto all Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">The great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04531">temptations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">which thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">and the signs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04159">and the wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whereby the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought thee out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">so shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H03373">of whom thou art afraid</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06880">the hornet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">among them, until they that are left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">themselves from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, be destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not be affrighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">you, a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05394" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0411">those</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">thee by little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">and little</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou mayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">them at once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">lest the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increase</w> upon thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pluck off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them unto thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01949" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">them with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">until they be destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before thy face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shalt destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from under heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">there shall no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be able to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee, until thou have destroyed</w> them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06456">The graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">or gold</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">on them, nor take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto thee, lest thou be snared</w> therein: for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Neither shalt thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02764">lest thou be a cursed thing</w> like it: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thou shalt utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">detest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">it, and thou shalt utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">abhor</w> it; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02764">a cursed thing</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen193" osisID="Deut.7"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04687">All the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and multiply</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">all the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">led</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">thee these forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to humble</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, to know</w> what <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whether thou wouldest keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, or no.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, and suffered thee to hunger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">thee with manna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou knewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">not, neither did thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">know</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he might make thee know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth not live</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">by bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">only</w>, but by every <transChange type="added">word</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04161">that proceedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">doth man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08071">Thy raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waxed not old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon thee, neither did thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01216" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">swell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">these forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt also consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that, as a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">chasteneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">chasteneth</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to fear</w> him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thee into a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of brooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">of fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">and depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that spring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">of valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">and hills</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">A land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08184">and barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01612">and vines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">and fig trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07416">and pomegranates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>of oil…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of olive tree of oil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">A land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04544">scarceness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not lack</w> any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in it; a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">whose stones</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02042">and out of whose hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou mayest dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When thou hast eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and art full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">then thou shalt bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath given</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Beware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in not keeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:12
verses.text: Lest <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and art full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dwelt</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">thy herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and thy flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">multiply</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and thy silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and thy gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and all that thou hast is multiplied</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">Then thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which brought thee forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Who led</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee through that great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">wherein were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08314">fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">serpents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06137">and scorpions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06774">and drought</w>, where <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who brought thee forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">out of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02496">of flint</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Who fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">thee in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">with manna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">which thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not, that he might humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee, and that he might prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee, to do thee good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">at thy latter end</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">My power</w> <w lemma="strong:H06108">and the might</w> of <transChange type="added">mine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">me this wealth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But thou shalt remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">thee power</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he may establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall be, if thou do at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">them, and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, I testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">against you this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">As the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before your face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall ye perish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06118">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye would not be obedient</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen194" osisID="Deut.8"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mightier</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">than thyself, cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and fenced up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">A people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and tall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06062">of the Anakims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou knowest</w>, and <transChange type="added">of whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast heard</w> <transChange type="added">say</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Who can stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">therefore this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he which goeth over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee; <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a consuming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and he shall bring them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thy face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">so shalt thou drive them out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">them quickly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">not thou in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">after that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath cast them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">For my righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath brought me in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">this land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07564">but for the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">doth drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">Not for thy righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03476">or for the uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dost thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07564">but for the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">doth drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee, and that he may perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore, that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thee not this good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">it for thy righteousness</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07186 strong:H06203">a stiffnecked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not, how thou provokedst the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04480">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou didst depart out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until ye came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">ye have been rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02722">Also in Horeb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-116">ye provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-116">to wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">so that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">was angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with you to have destroyed</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I was gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03871">the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you, then I abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I neither did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto me two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with the finger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>; and on them <transChange type="added">was written</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to all the words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">with you in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the assembly</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">of forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">me the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03871">the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from hence; for thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have corrupted</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04118">they are quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; they have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">them a molten image</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Furthermore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, and, behold, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07186 strong:H06203">a stiffnecked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Let me alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from under heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">thee a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">mightier</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and greater</w> than they.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in my two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and, behold, ye had sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">you a molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calf</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye had turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">them out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">my two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">them before your eyes</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And I fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">as at the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I did neither eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">because of all your sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke him to anger</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">and hot displeasure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherewith the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against you to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">you. But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">unto me at that time</w> also.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">with Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to have destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">him: and I prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">for Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">also the same time</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">your sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05695">the calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stamped</w> it, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ground</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">very small</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">until it was as small</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">as dust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">thereof into the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that descended out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08404">And at Taberah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04532">and at Massah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06914">and at Kibroth–hattaavah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye provoked the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to wrath</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Likewise when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">you from Kadesh–barnea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you; then ye rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and ye believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him not, nor hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to his voice</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Ye have been rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I knew</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Thus I fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">as I fell down</w> <transChange type="added">at the first</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he would destroy</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">and thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">through thy greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H07190">not unto the stubbornness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07562">nor to their wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">nor to their sin</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Lest the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whence thou broughtest us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">them, and because he hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, he hath brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 9:29
verses.text: Yet they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">and thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou broughtest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">by thy mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and by thy stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen195" osisID="Deut.9"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06458" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thee two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">like unto the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto me into the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">thee an ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">on the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">that were in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou brakest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">them in the ark</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">an ark</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07848">shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06458" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">like unto the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">having the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">on the tables</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">according to the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04385">writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto you in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the assembly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> them unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandments</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">myself and came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">in the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I had made</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and there they be, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took their journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0885">from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04149">to Mosera</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">there Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and there he was buried</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ministered in the priest’s office</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">From thence they journeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01412">unto Gudgodah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01412">and from Gudgodah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03193">to Jotbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto him, and to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03878">Wherefore Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">hath no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">nor inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with his brethren</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">promised</w> him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">according to the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">unto me at that time</w> also, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not destroy</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>first…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">former days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04550">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go in journey</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">And now, Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">what doth the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">require</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of thee, but to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, and to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all thy heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all thy soul</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for thy good</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Behold, the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heavens</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, with all that therein <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Only the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had a delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and he chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">their seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">you above all people</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Circumcise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">therefore the foreskin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of your heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07185 strong:H06203" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and be no more stiffnecked</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">and Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of lords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and a terrible</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">reward</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He doth execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">of the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">and widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in giving</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">him food</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">and raiment</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Love</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">ye therefore the stranger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01616">for ye were strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him shalt thou serve</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and to him shalt thou cleave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by his name</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:21
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">thy praise</w>, and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">for thee these great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">which thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">with threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">persons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">thee as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen196" osisID="Deut.10"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou shalt love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">his charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">alway</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">ye this day</w>: for <transChange type="added">I speak</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not with your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have not known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and which have not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">the chastisement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01433">his greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">his mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and his stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">And his miracles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and his acts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and unto all his land</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And what he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">unto the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">unto their horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and to their chariots</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">how he made the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06687" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as they pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> you, and <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them unto this day</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And what he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">unto you in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until ye came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">into this place</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And what he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01885">unto Dathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">and Abiram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0446">of Eliab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">how the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and swallowed them up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and their households</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">and their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03351">and all the substance</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">in their possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>substance…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">living substance which followed them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was at their feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">But your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore shall ye keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And that ye may prolong</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto them and to their seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0776">For the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not as the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from whence ye came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where thou sowedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and wateredst</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with thy foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01588">as a garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03419">of herbs</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">But the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">and valleys</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drinketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">of the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">A land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">careth for</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">always</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">upon it, from the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">even unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>careth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seeketh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto my commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">him with all your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all your soul</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">That I will give</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04306">the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of your land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his due season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03138">the first rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04456">and the latter rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou mayest gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">in thy corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and thy wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and thine oil</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in thy fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">for thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou mayest eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be full</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>send</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:16
