verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">to yourselves, that your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not deceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye turn aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and worship</w> them;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against you, and he shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04306">that there be no rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and that the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">not her fruit</w>; and <transChange type="added">lest</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">from off the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore shall ye lay up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and in your soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">them for a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02903">that they may be as frontlets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">between your eyes</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And ye shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them your children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them when thou sittest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when thou walkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou liest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">down, and when thou risest up</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt write</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">them upon the door posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and upon thy gates</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">That your days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of your children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them, as the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">For if ye shall diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all these commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to cleave</w> unto him;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and ye shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and mightier</w> than yourselves.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">Every place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">whereon the soles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of your feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">shall be yours: from the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">and Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">from the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">even unto the uttermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">shall your coast</w> be.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">There shall no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be able to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> you: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172">of you and the dread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of you upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon, as he hath said</w> unto you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">A blessing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if ye obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07045">And a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if ye will not obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye have not known</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And it shall come to pass, when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath brought thee in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, that thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01630">Gerizim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07045">and the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05858">Ebal</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:30
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">they not on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">where the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">goeth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the champaign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0681">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0436">the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04176">of Moreh</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For ye shall pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and ye shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and dwell</w> therein.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 11:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">all the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen197" osisID="Deut.11"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:1
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it, all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that ye live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Ye shall utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">all the places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">wherein the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and upon the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07488">and under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>possess</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">inherit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And ye shall overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">their altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">their pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">their groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and ye shall hew down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">the graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of them out of that place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overthrow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">break down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not do so</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">But unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of all your tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> there, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07933">unto his habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye seek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thither thou shalt come</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thither ye shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">your burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and your sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04643">and your tithes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08641">and heave offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05088">and your vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">and your freewill offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01062">and the firstlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of your herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of your flocks</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04916">in all that ye put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">your hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto, ye and your households</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherein the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not do</w> after all <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">here this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> whatsoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own eyes</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For ye are not as yet come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">to the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">and to the inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:10
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">giveth you to inherit</w>, and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he giveth you rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from all your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that ye dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">Then there shall be a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to cause his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">there; thither shall ye bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all that I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">you; your burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and your sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04643">your tithes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08641">and the heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04005">and all your choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>your choice…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the choice of your vows</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye, and your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and your daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and your menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and your maidservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levite</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within your gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03588">forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">as he hath no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">nor inheritance</w> with you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to thyself that thou offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">not thy burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in every place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou seest</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">But in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of thy tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">there thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thy burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all that I command</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Notwithstanding thou mayest kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in all thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">whatsoever thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0185">lusteth after</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">according to the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">thee: the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">thereof, as of the roebuck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0354">and as of the hart</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Only ye shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as water</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou mayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of thy corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">or of thy wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">or of thy oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01062">or the firstlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of thy herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">or of thy flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05088">nor any of thy vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou vowest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">nor thy freewill offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08641">or heave offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But thou must eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, and thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and thy maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levite</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04916">in all that thou puttest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hands</w> unto.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thyself that thou forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">not the Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">as long as thou livest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all thy days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">When the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thy border</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">because thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">longeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou mayest eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">whatsoever thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0185">lusteth after</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">If the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there be too far</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee, then thou shalt kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of thy herd</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of thy flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, as I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">whatsoever thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0185">lusteth after</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06643">Even as the roebuck</w> <w lemma="strong:H0354">and the hart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">them: the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">them alike</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Only be sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">not the blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">for the blood</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou mayest not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">with the flesh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it; thou shalt pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as water</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it; that it may go well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with thee, and with thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, when thou shalt do</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">Only thy holy things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">which thou hast, and thy vows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thy burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of thy sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, that it may go well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with thee, and with thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">thee for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou doest</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">When the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, whither thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and thou succeedest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their land</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>succeedest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inheritest</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">possessest them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05367" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">to thyself that thou be not snared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">by following</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that they be destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; and that thou enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not after their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">How did these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">even so will I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">likewise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">so unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08441">for every abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hateth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto their gods</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">for even their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they have burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to their gods</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to the</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 12:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">What thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">soever I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it: thou shalt not add</w> <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereto, nor diminish</w> from it. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen198" osisID="Deut.12"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If there arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">you a prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or a dreamer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">of dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">thee a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">or a wonder</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">And the sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">or the wonder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come to pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whereof he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast not known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">and let us serve</w> them;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of that prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or that dreamer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">of dreams</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">proveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">whether ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all your soul</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and cleave</w> unto him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And that prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or that dreamer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">of dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05627">to turn</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">away from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which brought you out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">you out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to walk in</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-117">So shalt thou put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-117">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from the midst</w> of thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>to turn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">revolt against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0251">If thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">or thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">or thy daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">or the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">of thy bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07453">or thy friend</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">as thine own soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">entice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">thee secretly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast not known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">thou, nor thy fathers</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">you, nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">unto thee, or far off</w> from thee, from the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> even unto the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not consent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, nor hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto him; neither shall thine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, neither shalt thou spare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shalt thou conceal</w> him:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him; thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">shall be first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">upon him to put him to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">and afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to thrust thee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which brought thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bondage</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bondmen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">such wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">as this is among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou shalt hear</w> <transChange type="added">say</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of thy cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">there, saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you, and have withdrawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of their city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye have not known</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>the children…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">naughty men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou enquire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make search</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">diligently</w>; and, behold, <transChange type="added">if it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">certain</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02063">such</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> you;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">destroying it utterly</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">therein, and the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thereof, with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">all the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">of it into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">of the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and shalt burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">and all the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">thereof every whit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08510">and it shall be an heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall not be built again</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there shall cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">nought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">of the cursed thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">from the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">thee mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon thee, and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thee, as he hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>cursed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">devoted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou shalt hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen199" osisID="Deut.13"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:1
verses.text: Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">ye shall not cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yourselves, nor make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07144">any baldness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">between your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for the dead</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:2
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05459">thee to be a peculiar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto himself, above all the nations</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">any abominable thing</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:4
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which ye shall eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07794">the ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03775 strong:H07716">the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05795">and the goat</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0354">The hart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">and the roebuck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03180">and the fallow deer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0689">and the wild goat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01788">and the pygarg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08377">and the wild ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02169">and the chamois</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pygarg</catchWord>: or <rdg type="alternate">bison</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dishon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">And every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that parteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">the hoof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08157">and cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the cleft</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">into two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">claws</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">cheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">among the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall eat</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Nevertheless these ye shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of them that chew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">or of them that divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the cloven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">hoof</w>; <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01581">the camel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0768">and the hare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08227">and the coney</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for they chew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01625">the cud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">not the hoof</w>; <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02386">And the swine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">because it divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06541">the hoof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01625">yet cheweth not the cud</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you: ye shall not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of their flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">their dead carcase</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">These ye shall eat</w> of all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05579">all that have fins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">and scales</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye eat</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05579">And whatsoever hath not fins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">and scales</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye may not eat</w>; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> unto you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">all clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall eat</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:12
verses.text: But these <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of which ye shall not eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05404">the eagle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06538">and the ossifrage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05822">and the ospray</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07201">And the glede</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0344">and the kite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01772">and the vulture</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06158">And every raven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">And the owl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08464">and the night hawk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07828">and the cuckow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05322">and the hawk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after his kind</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03563">The little owl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03244">and the great owl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08580">and the swan</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06893">And the pelican</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07360">and the gier eagle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07994">and the cormorant</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02624">And the stork</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0601">and the heron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04327">after her kind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01744">and the lapwing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05847">and the bat</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08318">And every creeping thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">that flieth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto you: they shall not be eaten</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">all clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye may eat</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not eat</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05038">any thing that dieth of itself</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">it unto the stranger</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it; or thou mayest sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">it unto an alien</w>: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">in his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">milk</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Thou shalt truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">all the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">that the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">there, the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of thy corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">of thy wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and of thine oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01062">and the firstlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of thy herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of thy flocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">always</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">And if the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be too long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">for thee, so that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou art not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to carry</w> it; <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">if the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be too far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from thee, which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">there, when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath blessed</w> thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou turn</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">into money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bind up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt bestow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">that money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for whatsoever thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">lusteth after</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">for oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">or for sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">or for wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07941">or for strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">or for whatsoever thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">desireth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">there before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">thou, and thine household</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>desireth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">asketh of thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levite</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">him; for he hath no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">nor inheritance</w> with thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07097">At the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">all the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of thine increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the same year</w>, and shalt lay <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 14:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levite</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H02506">because he hath no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">nor inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">with thee,) and the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">and the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and the widow</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be satisfied</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thee in all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou doest</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen200" osisID="Deut.14"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">At the end</w> of <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08059">a release</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:2
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08059">of the release</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04874 strong:H01167">Every creditor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that lendeth</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall release</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not exact</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">or of his brother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because it is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08059">release</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>creditor</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">master of the lending of his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05237">Of a foreigner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou mayest exact</w> <transChange type="added">it again</transChange>: but <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">which is thine with thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall release</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0657">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">when there shall be no poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">among you; for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">shall greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it:<note type="study"><catchWord>Save…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">To the end that there be no poor among you</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Only if thou carefully</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all these commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, as he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05670" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee: and thou shalt lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">unto many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05670" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not borrow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">over many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they shall not reign</w> over thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H034">If there be among you a poor man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">within any</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, thou shalt not harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07092" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">from thy poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But thou shalt open</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05670" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto him, and shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05670" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">him sufficient</w> <w lemma="strong:H04270">for his need</w>, <transChange type="added">in that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he wanteth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Beware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">that there be not a thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">in thy wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">The seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08059">of release</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is at hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">against thy poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him nought; and he cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">against thee, and it be sin</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>thought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wicked</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">him, and thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">unto him: because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">that for this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thee in all thy works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04916">and in all that thou puttest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> unto.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H034">For the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall never cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">therefore I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt open</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06041">to thy poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">and to thy needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">if thy brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">an Hebrew man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">or an Hebrew woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee, and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">thee six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07637">then in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> from thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And when thou sendest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">him out free</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">from thee, thou shalt not let him go away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">empty</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06059" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt furnish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06059" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him liberally</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">out of thy flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01637">and out of thy floor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03342">and out of thy winepress</w>: <transChange type="added">of that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherewith the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee thou shalt give</w> unto him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thou wast a bondman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thee: therefore I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thee this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall be, if he say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, I will not go away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee; because he loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee and thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he is well</w> with thee;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04836">an aul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thrust</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">through his ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">unto the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and he shall be thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0519">And also unto thy maidservant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt do</w> likewise.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It shall not seem hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when thou sendest him away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">from thee; for he hath been worth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">a double</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">hired servant</w> <transChange type="added">to thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in serving</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">thee six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee in all that thou doest</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01060">All the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of thy herd</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of thy flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt do no work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">with the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of thy bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor shear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy sheep</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt eat</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">thou and thy household</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:21
verses.text: And if there be <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">blemish</w> therein, <transChange type="added">as if it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06455">lame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05787">or blind</w>, <transChange type="added">or have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">any ill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03971">blemish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">it within thy gates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02931">the unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">and the clean</w> <transChange type="added">person shall eat it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">alike</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">as the roebuck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0354">and as the hart</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Only thou shalt not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof; thou shalt pour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it upon the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as water</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen201" osisID="Deut.15"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H024">of Abib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02320">for in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H024">of Abib</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought thee forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt therefore sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and the herd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02557">no leavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">with it; seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w> therewith, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">of affliction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou camest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02649">in haste</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou camest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07603">And there shall be no leavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">with thee in all thy coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; neither shall there <transChange type="added">any thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou sacrificedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">all night until the morning</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:5
