verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou mayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">within any</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>sacrifice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">But at the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in, there thou shalt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">at the season</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou camest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt roast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto thy tents</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">Six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">and on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06116">a solemn assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">no work</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>solemn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">restraint</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto thee: begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">weeks</w> from <transChange type="added">such time as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou beginnest</w> <transChange type="added">to put</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02770">the sickle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07054">to the corn</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">of weeks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04530">with a tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">of a freewill offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt give</w> <transChange type="added">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName> thy God</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath blessed</w> thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>a tribute</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sufficiency</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, and thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and thy maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levite</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">and the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and the widow</w>, that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">you, in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thou wast a bondman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">these statutes</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after that thou hast gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in thy corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">and thy wine</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>corn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">floor, and thy winepress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">in thy feast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, and thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy manservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and thy maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">and the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and the widow</w>, that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou keep a solemn feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">thee in all thine increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and in all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08056">therefore thou shalt surely rejoice</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in a year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02138">shall all thy males</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he shall choose</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02282">in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">and in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">of weeks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">and in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they shall not appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">empty</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Every man</w> <transChange type="added">shall give</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04979">as he is able</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">according to the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath given</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the gift of his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">thee in all thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">thee, throughout thy tribes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">with just</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not wrest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt not respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">a gift</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07810">for a gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H05786" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">doth blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05557" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>words</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">matters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">That which is altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">just</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou follow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>That which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Justice, justice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">thee a grove</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of any trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">near unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt make</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Neither shalt thou set thee up</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04676">image</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hateth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>image</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">statue</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">pillar</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen202" osisID="Deut.16"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07794">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">or sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03971">wherein is blemish</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H07451">any evilfavouredness</w>: for that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sheep</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">If there be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">you, within any</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee, man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in transgressing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And hath gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">them, either the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">or moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">or any of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have not commanded</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">And it be told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou hast heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">diligently</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">true</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">certain</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">such abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then shalt thou bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or that woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto thy gates</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or that woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">them with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">till they die</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">At the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">or three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall he that is worthy of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">be put to death</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">he shall not be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">The hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">of the witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">shall be first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">upon him to put him to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-118">So thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-118">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">If there arise a matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">too hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for thee in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">between blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01779">between plea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">and plea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">and between stroke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">and stroke</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">of controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shalt thou arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and get thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">into the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and unto the judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that shall be in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and enquire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they shall shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thee the sentence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H06310">according to the sentence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">which they of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee; and thou shalt observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">according to all that they inform</w> thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">According to the sentence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thee, and according to the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which they shall tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, thou shalt do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not decline</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">from the sentence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which they shall shew</w> thee, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w>, nor <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">the left</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02087">presumptuously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">there before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or unto the judge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">even that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and will…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not to hearken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and do no more presumptuously</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and shalt possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and shalt dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein, and shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">over me, like as all the nations</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> me;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou shalt in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">over thee, whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>: <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">over thee: thou mayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H05237">a stranger</w> over thee, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">not thy brother</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But he shall not multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to himself, nor cause the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to the end that he should multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">forasmuch as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto you, Ye shall henceforth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">no more that way</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Neither shall he multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">to himself, that his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">not away: neither shall he greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">to himself silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall be, when he sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of his kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he shall write</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">him a copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w> out of <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it shall be with him, and he shall read</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">therein all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">and these statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> them:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">That his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be not lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">above his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and that he turn not aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">from the commandment</w>, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w>, or <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">the left</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to the end that he may prolong</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">in his kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">he, and his children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen203" osisID="Deut.17"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">The priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">all the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">shall have no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">nor inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-119">the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-119">made by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">and his inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">Therefore shall they have no inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath said</w> unto them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">And this shall be the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">due</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from them that offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w>, whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">or sheep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">the shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03895">and the two cheeks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06896">and the maw</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">The firstfruit</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of thy corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">of thy wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and of thine oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">and the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01488">of the fleece</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou give</w> him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">him out of all thy tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">him and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03881">And if a Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">from any</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">where he sojourned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0185">with all the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of his mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then he shall minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">as all his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">do</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">there before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02506">They shall have like portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04465">beside that which cometh of the sale</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his patrimony</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his sale by the fathers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">When thou art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, thou shalt not learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">after the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of those nations</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">There shall not be found</w> among you <transChange type="added">any one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that maketh his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">or his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">through the fire</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that useth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">divination</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">an observer of times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">or an enchanter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03784" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">or a witch</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02267 strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Or a charmer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or a consulter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">with familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">or a wizard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191 strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8801 strongMorph:TH8802">or a necromancer</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For all that do</w> these things <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01558">and because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of these abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">doth drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08549">Thou shalt be perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>perfect</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upright</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sincere</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">For these nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which thou shalt possess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">unto observers of times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and unto diviners</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but as for thee, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not suffered</w> thee so <transChange type="added">to do</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>possess</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">inherit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">unto thee a Prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thee, of thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">According to all that thou desiredst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">in Horeb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the assembly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Let me not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither let me see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">any more, that I die</w> not.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto me, They have well</w> <transChange type="added">spoken that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which they have spoken</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will raise them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">a Prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">like unto thee, and will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in his mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto them all that I shall command</w> him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:19
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which he shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will require</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> of him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">But the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which shall presume</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have not commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him to speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">or that shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">of other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">even that prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall die</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How shall we know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath not spoken</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">When a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">if the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">follow not, nor come to pass</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath not spoken</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02087">it presumptuously</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not be afraid</w> of him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen204" osisID="Deut.18"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">When the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">whose land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou succeedest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and in their houses</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>succeedest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">inheritest</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">possessest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">for thee in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee a way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and divide the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">giveth thee to inherit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">into three parts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that every slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may flee</w> thither.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the case</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the slayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thither, that he may live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Whoso killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847 strong:H01097">ignorantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whom he hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H08543">not in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">past</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from yesterday the third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">As when a man goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">into the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">with his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fetcheth a stroke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01631">with the axe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05394" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slippeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">from the helve</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">upon his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of those cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and live</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>head</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">iron</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>helve</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wood</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lighteth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">findeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Lest the avenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523 strong:H0310" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the slayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">while</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">him, because the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him</w>; whereas he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">inasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H08543">him not in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">past</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slay…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smite him in life</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from yesterday the third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Wherefore I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> for thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And if the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thy coast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">as he hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all these commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them, which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shalt thou add</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">more for thee, beside these three</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05355">That innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> be upon thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">But if any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lie in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for him, and rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against him, and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him mortally</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fleeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">into one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0411">of these</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>mortally</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">Then the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him thence, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the avenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he may die</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Thine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him, but thou shalt put away</w> <transChange type="added">the guilt of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that it may go well</w> with thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">landmark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">which they of old time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01379" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">in thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for any iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">or for any sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02399">in any sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he sinneth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">or at the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">shall the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be established</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02555">If a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to testify</w> against him <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05627">wrong</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">falling away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Then both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07379">between whom the controversy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">which shall be in those days</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">shall make diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">inquisition</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">the witness</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against his brother</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shall ye do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, as he had thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-120">so shalt thou put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-120">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And those which remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall henceforth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">no more any</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">such evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And thine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not pity</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">life</w> <transChange type="added">shall go</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">for eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">tooth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">for tooth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">for foot</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen205" osisID="Deut.19"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou goest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">than thou, be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of them: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">with thee, which brought thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall be, when ye are come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">unto the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">that the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07131">ye approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">unto battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against your enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03824">let not your hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">faint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02648" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, and do not tremble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither be ye terrified</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> of them;<note type="study"><catchWord>faint</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be tender</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>tremble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make haste</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">with you, to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for you against your enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">What man</w> <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02596" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath not dedicated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it? let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02596" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dedicate</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And what man</w> <transChange type="added">is he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">a vineyard</w>, and hath not <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">eaten</w> of it? let him <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">eat</w> of it.<note type="study"><catchWord>eaten…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made it common</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And what man</w> <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that hath betrothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath not taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her? let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">further</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">What man</w> <transChange type="added">is there that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">fearful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07390">and fainthearted</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">lest his brethren’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">as well as his heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>faint</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And it shall be, when the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">have made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to lead…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to be in the head of the people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou comest nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against it, then proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> unto it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall be, if it make thee answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and open</w> unto thee, then it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">therein shall be tributaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee, and they shall serve</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And if it will make no peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, but will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, then thou shalt besiege</w> it:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into thine hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou shalt smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02138">every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thereof with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">But the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and the little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and all that is in the city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07998">all the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, shalt thou take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thyself; and thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>take</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spoil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto all the cities</w> <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">from thee, which</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">not of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of these nations</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">But of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of these people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth give</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt save alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">nothing that breatheth</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">But thou shalt utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroy</w> them; <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">That they teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you not to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">after all their abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto their gods</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so should ye sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou shalt besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">in making war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against it to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, thou shalt not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof by forcing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01631">an axe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against them: for thou mayest eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, and thou shalt not cut them down</w> (<w lemma="strong:H06086">for the tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man’s</w> <transChange type="added">life</transChange>) <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to employ</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04692 strong:H06440">in the siege</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for, O man, the tree of the field is to be employed in the siege</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to employ…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to go from before thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">Only the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou knowest</w> that they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">not trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">for meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cut them down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">bulwarks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with thee, until it be subdued</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it come down</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen206" osisID="Deut.20"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:1
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it, lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it be not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who hath slain</w> him:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">Then thy elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thy judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the cities</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">him that is slain</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:3
verses.text: And it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">next</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">unto the slain man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">even the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697 strong:H01241">an heifer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which hath not been wrought with</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath not drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">in the yoke</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">the heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">unto a rough</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which is neither eared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor sown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-121">and shall strike off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">the heifer’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-121">neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">there in the valley</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall come near</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for them the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto him, and to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">and by their word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">shall every controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">and every stroke</w> be <transChange type="added">tried</transChange>:<note type="study"><catchWord>word</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w>, <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">next</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">unto the slain</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">over the heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06202" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that is beheaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valley</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">Our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">this blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">neither have our eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Be merciful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou hast redeemed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">not innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">charge</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01818">And the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">shall be forgiven</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto thy people of</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So shalt thou put away</w> the <transChange type="added">guilt of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, when thou shalt do</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou goest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into thine hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hast taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">them captive</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">among the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303 strong:H08389">a beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast a desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, that thou wouldest have her</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to thy wife</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">her home</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thine house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and she shall shave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">her head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06856">her nails</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>pare</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">suffer to grow</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">dress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And she shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">the raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of her captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from off her, and shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bewail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and her mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">month</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in unto her, and be her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and she shall be thy wife</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:14
