verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it shall be, if thou have no delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in her, then thou shalt let her go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">whither she will</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">her at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06014" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou shalt not make merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">of her, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast humbled</w> her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">have two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">beloved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they have born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him children</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the hated</w>; and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08146">be hers that was hated</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Then it shall be, when</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he maketh his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to inherit</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which he hath, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he may</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not make the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of the beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01069" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of the hated</w>, <transChange type="added">which is indeed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But he shall acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of the hated</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by giving</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">him a double</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of all that he hath</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0202">of his strength</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01062">of the firstborn</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that is found with him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have a stubborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which will not obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">or the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">when they have chastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, will not hearken</w> unto them:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Then shall his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">on him, and bring him out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and unto the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of his place</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">This our son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stubborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and rebellious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he will not obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">our voice</w>; <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02151" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a glutton</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05433" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a drunkard</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-122">so shalt thou put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-122">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">you; and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">have committed a sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">worthy of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and he be to be put to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">him on a tree</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05038">His body</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not remain all night</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">upon the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but thou shalt in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him that day</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for he that is hanged</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07045">accursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H0127">that thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">be not defiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accursed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the curse of God</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen207" osisID="Deut.21"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">or his sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">go astray</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thyself from them: thou shalt in any case</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto thy brother</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And if thy brother</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">not nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee, or if thou know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him not, then thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">it unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and it shall be with thee until thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">after it, and thou shalt restore it to him again</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03651">In like manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">with his ass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and so shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">with his raiment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H09">and with all lost thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brother’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he hath lost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hast found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">likewise: thou mayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">not hide</w> thyself.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">or his ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thyself from them: thou shalt surely</w> help him to lift <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">up again</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">The woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">shall not wear that which pertaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">unto a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">neither shall a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">on a woman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">garment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for all that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">so</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06833">If a bird’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">chance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to be before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">in any tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">or on the ground</w>, <transChange type="added">whether they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0667">young ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01000">or eggs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and the dam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0667">upon the young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01000">or upon the eggs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the dam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the young</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thou shalt in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">let the dam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee; that it may be well</w> with thee, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou mayest prolong</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou buildest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04624">a battlement</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">for thy roof</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">not blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">if any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> from thence.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">thy vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03610">with divers seeds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04395">lest the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou hast sown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08393">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of thy vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be defiled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fruit of thy seed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fulness of the seed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not plow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">with an ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">and an ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not wear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08162">a garment of divers sorts</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06785">of woollen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">and linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01434">thee fringes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">upon the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">quarters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03682">of thy vesture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherewith thou coverest</w> <transChange type="added">thyself</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>quarters</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, and hate</w> her,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">occasions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against her, and bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon her, and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">this woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to her, I found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">her not a maid</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Then shall the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">of the damsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and her mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring forth</w> <transChange type="added">the tokens of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05291">the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">virginity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">And the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hateth</w> her;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, lo, he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">occasions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of speech</w> <transChange type="added">against her</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">not thy daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">a maid</w>; and yet these <transChange type="added">are the tokens of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">virginity</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">the cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and chastise</w> him;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall amerce</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">him in an hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">of the damsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he hath brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">upon a virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">and she shall be his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he may</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not put her away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all his days</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But if this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">be true</w>, <transChange type="added">and the tokens of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01331">virginity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">be not found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">for the damsel</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then they shall bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">to the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of her city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">her with stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that she die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because she hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to play the whore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-123">so shalt thou put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-123">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">married</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to an husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">then they shall both of them</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">die</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the woman</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">so shalt thou put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05291">If a damsel</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">be betrothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto an husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">her in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lie</w> with her;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then ye shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them both</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">out unto the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">them with stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05291">the damsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H0834">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she cried</w> not, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H0834">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">so thou shalt put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">But if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">a betrothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">force</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her, and lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with her: then the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">only that lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with her shall die</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>force</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">take strong hold of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">But unto the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05291">in the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">no sin</w> <transChange type="added">worthy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for as when a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">riseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8804">and slayeth</w> him, even so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this matter</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">her in the field</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">the betrothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cried</w>, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to save</w> her.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">a damsel</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which is not betrothed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">on her, and lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with her, and they be found</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Then the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with her shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">unto the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and she shall be his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he hath humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, he may</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not put her away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all his days</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 22:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor discover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">skirt</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen208" osisID="Deut.22"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01795 strong:H06481" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">He that is wounded in the stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08212">or hath his privy member</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04464">A bastard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06224">even to his tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05984">An Ammonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">or Moabite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06224">even to their tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they met</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">you not with bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and with water</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and because they hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">against thee Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06604">of Pethor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0763">of Mesopotamia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to curse</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Nevertheless the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">into a blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loved</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">their peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">nor their prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prosperity</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt not abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">an Edomite</w>; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">an Egyptian</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01616">because thou wast a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in his land</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that are begotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">in their third</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04264">When the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">then keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thee from every wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If there be among you any man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02889">that is not clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07137">by reason of uncleanness that chanceth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">him by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall he go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">out of the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">But it shall be, when evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall wash</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08121">and when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cometh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turneth toward</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03027">Thou shalt have a place also</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither thou shalt go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03489">And thou shalt have a paddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0240">upon thy weapon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it shall be, when thou wilt ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">thyself abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therewith, and shalt turn back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06627">that which cometh</w> from thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>wilt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sittest down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of thy camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, and to give up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">thee; therefore shall thy camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">be holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">no unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee, and turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from thee</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unclean…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nakedness of any thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which is escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">from his master</w> unto thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall dwell</w> with thee, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">you, in that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">where it liketh him best</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt not oppress</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>liketh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is good for him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06948">There shall be no whore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06945">nor a sodomite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whore</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sodomitess</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0868">the hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of a whore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04242">or the price</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">of a dog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">for any vow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">for even both</w> these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not lend upon usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to thy brother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05392">usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05392">usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">of victuals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05392">usury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that is lent upon usury</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05237">Unto a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou mayest lend upon usury</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">but unto thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05391" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt not lend upon usury</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H04916">thee in all that thou settest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou shalt vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not slack</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">require</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">it of thee; and it would be sin</w> in thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if thou shalt forbear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02399">it shall be no sin</w> in thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04161">That which is gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of thy lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and perform</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05071">a freewill offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according as thou hast vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou hast promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">into thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou mayest eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07648">thy fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">at thine own pleasure</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not put</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in thy vessel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07054">into the standing corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of thy neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou mayest pluck</w> <w lemma="strong:H04425">the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but thou shalt not move</w> <w lemma="strong:H02770">a sickle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto thy neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07054">standing corn</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen209" osisID="Deut.23"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">When a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and married</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and it come to pass that she find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">no favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">some</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in her: then let him write</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">her a bill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03748">of divorcement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">her out of his house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>some…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">matter of nakedness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>divorcement</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cutting off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when she is departed out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she may go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">and be another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w> <transChange type="added">wife</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:3
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0314">the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her, and write</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">her a bill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03748">of divorcement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and giveth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">her out of his house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0314">or if the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which took</w> her <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">Her former</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which sent her away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">her again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to be his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8719">that she is defiled</w>; for that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and thou shalt not cause the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">When a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall he be charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with any business</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">he shall be free</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">at home</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall cheer up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath taken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>neither…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not any thing shall pass upon him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-124">No man shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07347">the nether</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">or the upper millstone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-124">to pledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-125">for he taketh</w> <transChange type="added">a man’s</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-125">to pledge</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stealing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06014" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and maketh merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of him, or selleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">him; then that thief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-126">and thou shalt put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-126">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">in the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of leprosy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">diligently</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">according to all that the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">you: as I commanded</w> them, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04813">unto Miriam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after that ye were come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">When thou dost lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H04859">thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05670" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05667">his pledge</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lend…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lend the loan of any thing to</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to whom thou dost lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05667">the pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if the man</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05667">with his pledge</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-127">In any case</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-127">thou shalt deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05667">him the pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">when the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">goeth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he may sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">in his own raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">thee: and it shall be righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto thee before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">an hired servant</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>, <transChange type="added">whether he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">or of thy strangers</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">At his day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt give</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07939">his hire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">neither shall the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go down</w> upon it; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon it: lest he cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against thee unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02399">and it be sin</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>setteth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifteth his soul unto it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">The fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall not be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for the fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">for his own sin</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">of the stranger</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03490">of the fatherless</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-128">nor take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-128">to pledge</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But thou shalt remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thou wast a bondman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thee thence: therefore I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou cuttest down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">thine harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in thy field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast forgot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">a sheaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">it: it shall be for the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">for the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and for the widow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thee in all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hands</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02251" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou beatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">thine olive tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt not go over the boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01616">it shall be for the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">for the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and for the widow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>go…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bough it after thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou gatherest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">the grapes of thy vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">thou shalt not glean</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">afterward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01616">it shall be for the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">for the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and for the widow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>afterward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thou wast a bondman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">therefore I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen210" osisID="Deut.24"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07379">If there be a controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">between men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">unto judgment</w>, that <transChange type="added">the judges</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them; then they shall justify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">And it shall be, if the wicked man</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be beaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall cause him to lie down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and to be beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01767">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">to his fault</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">by a certain number</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">Forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stripes</w> he may give him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not exceed</w>: lest, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he should exceed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">him above these with many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">stripes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">then thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07034" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">should seem vile</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02629" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not muzzle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H01778" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he treadeth out</w> <transChange type="added">the corn</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>treadeth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thresheth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0251">If brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and have no child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">shall not marry without</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">unto a stranger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02993">her husband’s brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">her to him to wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02992" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and perform the duty of an husband’s brother</w> unto her.<note type="study"><catchWord>her husband’s…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">her next kinsman</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:6
verses.text: And it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which she beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall succeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w> <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And if the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02994">his brother’s wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02994">then let his brother’s wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02993">My husband’s brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">a name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he will</w> <w lemma="strong:H02992" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not perform the duty of my husband’s brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brother’s</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">next kinsman’s</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">Then the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him, and speak</w> unto him: and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he stand</w> <transChange type="added">to it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I like</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to take</w> her;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02994">Then shall his brother’s wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto him in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">his shoe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">from off his foot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03417" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and spit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">So shall it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that will not build up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">The house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">of him that hath his shoe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">loosed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">When men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H0251">one with another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">draweth near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of him that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and putteth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04016">him by the secrets</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then thou shalt cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not pity</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03599">Thou shalt not have in thy bag</w> <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H068">divers weights</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and a small</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>divers…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a stone and a stone</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">Thou shalt not have in thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374 strong:H0374">divers measures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and a small</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>divers…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an ephah and an ephah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08003">thou shalt have a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">and just</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08003">a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">and just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shalt thou have: that thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may be lengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For all that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">such things</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">unrighteously</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">what Amalek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto thee by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye were come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How he met</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02179" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and smote the hindmost</w> of thee, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> all <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02826" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> thee, when thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03023">and weary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03373">and he feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore it shall be, when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hath given thee rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from all thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">the remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of Amalek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from under heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not forget</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen211" osisID="Deut.25"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:1
verses.text: And it shall be, when thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and possessest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and dwellest</w> therein;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">That thou shalt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of all the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and shalt put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02935">in a basket</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> there.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that shall be in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto him, I profess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for to give</w> us.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02935">the basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set it down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0761">A Syrian</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ready to perish</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sojourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">there with</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a few</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and became there a nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06099">mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and populous</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04713">And the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">evil entreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">us, and afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">upon us hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">bondage</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when we cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">our voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">on our affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05999">and our labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03906">and our oppression</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought us forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">with a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and with an outstretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172">terribleness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">and with signs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04159">and with wonders</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he hath brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">us into this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us this land</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And now, behold, I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225 strong:H06529">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me. And thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in every good</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto thee, and unto thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">thou, and the Levite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the stranger</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">When thou hast made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of tithing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">all the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of thine increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">of tithing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast given</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and the widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be filled</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:13
