verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then thou shalt say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have brought away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the hallowed things</w> out of <transChange type="added">mine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and also have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">them unto the Levite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and unto the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">to the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and to the widow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">according to all thy commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou hast commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: I have not transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither have I forgotten</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">thereof in my mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither have I taken away</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> thereof for <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <transChange type="added">use</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor given</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thereof for the dead</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according to all that thou hast commanded</w> me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Look down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">from thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04583">habitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">us, as thou swarest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">these statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt therefore keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">them with all thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast avouched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to be thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto his voice</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath avouched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05459">to be his peculiar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath promised</w> thee, and that <transChange type="added">thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shouldest keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all his commandments</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">thee high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">above all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">in praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and in name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">and in honour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06918">and that thou mayest be an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath spoken</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen212" osisID="Deut.26"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">with the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall be on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when ye shall pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, that thou shalt set thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07874" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and plaister</w> <w lemma="strong:H07875">them with plaister</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt write</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">upon them all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou art passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee, a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath promised</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">these stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05858">Ebal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07875">and thou shalt plaister</w> <w lemma="strong:H07874" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them with plaister</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there shalt thou build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt not lift up</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w> <transChange type="added">tool</transChange> upon them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">of whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereon unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there, and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt write</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">upon the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0874" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">plainly</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05535" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Take heed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou art become</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt therefore obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">and his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">These shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01630">Gerizim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye are come over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08095">Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03878">and Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">and Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And these shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05858">Ebal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">to curse</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0836">and Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">and Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05321">and Naphtali</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to curse</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a cursing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that maketh</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06459">graven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">or molten image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">of the craftsman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and putteth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> in <transChange type="added">a</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">secret</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07034" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that setteth light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">by his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05253" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that removeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">landmark</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05787">he that maketh the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that perverteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">of the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">and widow</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because he uncovereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">skirt</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">with any manner of beast</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">with his sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">or the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with his mother in law</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">secretly</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">an innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818 strong:H05315">person</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 27:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he that confirmeth</w> not <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them. And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen213" osisID="Deut.27"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to observe</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">thee on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">above all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">And all these blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">on thee, and overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, if thou shalt hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and blessed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of thy body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07698">the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0504">of thy kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06251">and the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy sheep</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02935">thy basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04863">and thy store</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>store</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dough</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">kneadingtroughs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou comest in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and blessed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou goest out</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">against thee to be smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thy face</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">against thee one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">thee seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0618">upon thee in thy storehouses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04916">and in all that thou settest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto; and he shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>storehouses</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">barns</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">thee an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto himself, as he hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, if thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that thou art called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall be afraid</w> of thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall make thee plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">in the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of thy body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and in the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and in the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>in goods</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for good</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>body</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall open</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">unto thee his good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">treasure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shalt lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">unto many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt not borrow</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thee the head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02180">and not the tail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04605">and thou shalt be above only</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04295">and thou shalt not be beneath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if that thou hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt not go aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">from any of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w>, or <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">the left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07045">that all these curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon thee, and overtake</w> thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and cursed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02935">thy basket</w> <w lemma="strong:H04863">and thy store</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of thy body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07698">the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0504">of thy kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06251">and the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy sheep</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou comest in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and cursed</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou goest out</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03994">upon thee cursing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04103">vexation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04045">and rebuke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04916">in all that thou settest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto for to do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">until thou be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and until thou perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">quickly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07455">of the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of thy doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereby thou hast forsaken</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which thou wouldest do</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">shall make the pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto thee, until he have consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">thee from off the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07829">thee with a consumption</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06920">and with a fever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01816">and with an inflammation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02746">and with an extreme burning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07711">and with blasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03420">and with mildew</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee until thou perish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sword</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">drought</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">And thy heaven</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">over thy head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">shall be brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> under thee <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H080">powder</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">and dust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall it come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">upon thee, until thou be destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thee to be smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against them, and flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02189">them: and shalt be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">into all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>removed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for a removing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05038">And thy carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">shall be meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">unto all fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and unto the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, and no man shall fray <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">away</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">thee with the botch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06076 strong:H02914" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and with the emerods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01618">and with the scab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02775">and with the itch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereof thou canst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">not be healed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07697">thee with madness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05788">and blindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08541">and astonishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And thou shalt grope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noonday</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05787">as the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">gropeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0653">in darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou shalt not prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in thy ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and thou shalt be only oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">evermore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and no man shall save</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt betroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07693 strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with her: thou shalt build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein: thou shalt plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">a vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shalt not gather the grapes</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>gather…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">profane</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">use it as common meat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07794">Thine ox</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">thereof: thine ass</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">violently taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not be restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">to thee: thy sheep</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and thou shalt have none to rescue</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall not return to thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto another</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall look</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03616">and fail</w> <transChange type="added">with longing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for them all the day</w> long: and <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">no might</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06529">The fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03018">and all thy labours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">shall a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not eat up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and thou shalt be only oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and crushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">alway</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07696" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">So that thou shalt be mad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">for the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt see</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">thee in the knees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07785">and in the legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">with a sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">botch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">be healed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">from the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">unto the top of thy head</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee, and thy king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which thou shalt set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">over thee, unto a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which neither thou nor thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have known</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there shalt thou serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stone</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08047">And thou shalt become an astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04912">a proverb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08148">and a byword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whither the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall lead</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-129">Thou shalt carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-129">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-130">and shalt gather</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-130">in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0697">for the locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H02628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall consume</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dress</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but shalt neither drink</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0103" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor gather</w> <transChange type="added">the grapes</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08438">for the worms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02132">Thou shalt have olive trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">throughout all thy coasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not anoint</w> <transChange type="added">thyself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with the oil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02132">for thine olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05394" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cast</w> <transChange type="added">his fruit</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt beget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou shalt not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they shall not be thine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">All thy trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">and fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06767">shall the locust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">consume</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consume</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">possess</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01616">The stranger</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee shall get up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above thee very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">high</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">low</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He shall lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to thee, and thou shalt not lend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to him: he shall be the head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02180">and thou shalt be the tail</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07045">Moreover all these curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and shall pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">thee, till thou be destroyed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hearkenedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">And they shall be upon thee for a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and for a wonder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and upon thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou servedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joyfulness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02898">and with gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">for the abundance</w> of all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore shalt thou serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">against thee, in hunger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06772">and in thirst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05903">and in nakedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02640">and in want</w> of all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">a yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">upon thy neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">until he have destroyed</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">against thee from far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">as swift</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05404">as the eagle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01675" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">flieth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">whose tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not understand</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>understand</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">A nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">of fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall not regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the person</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor shew favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to the young</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>of fierce…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong of face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">until thou be destroyed</w>: which <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not leave</w> thee <transChange type="added">either</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01715">corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">or oil</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07698">the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0504">of thy kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06251">or flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of thy sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">until he have destroyed</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">thee in all thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01364">until thy high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02004">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou trustedst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all thy land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he shall besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">thee in all thy gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of thine own body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and of thy daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">thee, in the siege</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04689">and in the straitness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherewith thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall distress</w> thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>body</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:54
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07390">tender</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">among you, and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06028">delicate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">toward his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and toward the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">of his bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and toward the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which he shall leave</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">So that he will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to any</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of them of the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom he shall eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he hath nothing left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">him in the siege</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04689">and in the straitness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherewith thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">thee in all thy gates</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07390">The tender</w> <w lemma="strong:H06028">and delicate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">woman among you, which would not adventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of her foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">for delicateness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07391">and tenderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">her eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">toward the husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">of her bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and toward her son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and toward her daughter</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07988">And toward her young one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">from between her feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and toward her children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which she shall bear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for she shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02640">them for want</w> of all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">secretly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">in the siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H04689">and straitness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherewith thine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">thee in thy gates</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>young one</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">afterbirth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou wilt not observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">this glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and fearful</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">THE <divineName>LORD</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">THY GOD</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-131">will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">thy plagues</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-131">wonderful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04347">and the plagues</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">plagues</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and of long continuance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">sicknesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and of long continuance</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Moreover he will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04064">upon thee all the diseases</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou wast afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall cleave</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02483">Also every sickness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04347">and every plague</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">them will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">upon thee, until thou be destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to ascend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And ye shall be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">in number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">whereas</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">ye were as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou wouldest not obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:63
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">over you to do you good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">you; so the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">over you to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">you, and to bring you to nought</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05255" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and ye shall be plucked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">from off the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thee among all people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the one end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">even unto the other</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there thou shalt serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">which neither thou nor thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have known</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stone</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01992">And among these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou find no ease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">neither shall the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04494">have rest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07268">thee there a trembling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03631">and failing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01671">and sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of mind</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:66
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">And thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H08511" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">in doubt before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee; and thou shalt fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shalt have none assurance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:67
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">In the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Would God it were</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">even</w>! <w lemma="strong:H06153">and at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Would God it were</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w>! <w lemma="strong:H06343">for the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith thou shalt fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">and for the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt see</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 28:68
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-132">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">thee into Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-132">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">with ships</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereof I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, Thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it no more again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and there ye shall be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for bondmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and bondwomen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and no man shall buy</w> <transChange type="added">you</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen214" osisID="Deut.28"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:1
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">beside the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">with them in Horeb</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and unto all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and unto all his land</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">The great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04531">temptations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">which thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">the signs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and those great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">miracles</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Yet the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">you an heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to perceive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I have led</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">you forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08008">your clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are not waxen old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">upon you, and thy shoe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not waxen old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon thy foot</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither have ye drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">or strong drink</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye might know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when ye came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05747">and Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">us unto battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we smote</w> them:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">it for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">unto the Reubenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">and to the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and to the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04520">of Manasseh</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">therefore the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of this covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, that ye may prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in all that ye do</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Ye stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">all of you before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">your captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of your tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">your elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and your officers</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02945">Your little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">your wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and thy stranger</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">thy camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from the hewer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of thy wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the drawer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of thy water</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That thou shouldest enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">into covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">and into his oath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">with thee this day</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>enter</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That he may establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for a people</w> unto himself, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">he may be unto thee a God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto thee, and as he hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">to Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and to Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Neither with you only do I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">this covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">and this oath</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:15
verses.text: But with <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">here with us this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, and also with <transChange type="added">him</transChange> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not here with us this day</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:16
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For ye know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how we have dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and how we came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye passed by</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">their abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and their idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> among them:)<note type="study"><catchWord>idols</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dungy gods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Lest there should be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">among you man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">or woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">or family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">or tribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">turneth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of these nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03426">lest there should be</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">among you a root</w> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">gall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03939">and wormwood</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>gall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a poisonous herb</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rosh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it come to pass, when he heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">of this curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">that he bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">himself in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">I shall have peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">though</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">in the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to add</w> <w lemma="strong:H07302">drunkenness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06771">to thirst</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>imagination</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stubbornness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>drunkenness…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the drunken to the thirsty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">him, but then the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">and his jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06225" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against that man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">and all the curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon him, and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from under heaven</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him unto evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">according to all the curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>are</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01755">So that the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">you, and the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">the plagues</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of that land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08463">and the sicknesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath laid</w> upon it;<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wherewith the <divineName>Lord</divineName> hath made it sick</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:23
