verses.text: <transChange type="added">And that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the whole land</w> thereof <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01614">brimstone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04417">and salt</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08316">burning</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it is not sown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor beareth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06212">nor any grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">groweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04114">therein, like the overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06017">and Gomorrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0126">Admah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06636">and Zeboim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in his anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in his wrath</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Even all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Wherefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thus unto this land</w>? what <transChange type="added">meaneth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02750">the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then men shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with them when he brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">them, gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they knew</w> not, and <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he had not given</w> unto them:<note type="study"><catchWord>whom he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">who had not given to them any portion</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>given</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">divided</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">upon it all the curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rooted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them out of their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and in wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">indignation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">them into another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 29:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">The secret</w> <transChange type="added">things belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>: but those <transChange type="added">things which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">revealed</w> <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto us and to our children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, that <transChange type="added">we</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen215" osisID="Deut.29"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And it shall come to pass, when all these things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">upon thee, the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">and the curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and thou shalt call</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">to mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among all the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whither the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath driven</w> thee,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And shalt return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">according to all that I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou and thy children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all thy soul</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">thy captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thee from all the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whither the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath scattered</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:4
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of thine be driven out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the outmost</w> <transChange type="added">parts</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">from thence will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and from thence will he fetch</w> thee:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">possessed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it; and he will do thee good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and multiply</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thee above thy fathers</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will circumcise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all thy soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">that thou mayest live</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">all these curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and on them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, which persecuted</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou shalt return</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">will make thee plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in every work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">in the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of thy body</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and in the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of thy cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and in the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">over thee for good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">over thy fathers</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou shalt hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04687">For this commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">not hidden</w> from thee, neither <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">it far off</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:12
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">not in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou shouldest say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">for us to heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it unto us, that we may hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and do</w> it?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:13
verses.text: Neither <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">it beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou shouldest say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for us, and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it unto us, that we may hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and do</w> it?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But the word</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">unto thee, in thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">and in thy heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest do</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04194">and death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">In that I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou mayest live</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and multiply</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">But if thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that thou wilt not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but shalt be drawn away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> them;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I denounce</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w>, <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall not prolong</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou passest over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-133">I call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-133">to record</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> against you, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">you life</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">and death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">and cursing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">that both thou and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may live</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 30:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That thou mayest love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and that thou mayest cleave</w> unto him: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">thy life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0753">and the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of thy days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">to Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">to Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and to Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen216" osisID="Deut.30"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all Israel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto them, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I can</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">no more go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and come in</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">also the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, Thou shalt not go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">this Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he will go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou shalt possess</w> them: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he shall go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them as he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">to Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">and to Og</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of them, whom he destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall give them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before your face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto them according unto all the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have commanded</w> you.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of a good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, nor be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of them</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, he <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that doth go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with thee; he will not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, nor forsake</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto him in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of a good courage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou must go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, he <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that doth go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, neither forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, neither be dismayed</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">this law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">it unto the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and unto all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">At the end</w> of <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">in the solemnity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08059">of release</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">When all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he shall choose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt read</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">this law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">before all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their hearing</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-134">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-134">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and thy stranger</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and that they may learn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have not known</w> <transChange type="added">any thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">ye live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou must die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and present</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">yourselves in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I may give him a charge</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">themselves in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">in a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of a cloud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05982">and the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">over the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, thou shalt sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with thy fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will rise up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither they go</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and will forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, and break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have made</w> with them.<note type="study"><catchWord>sleep</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lie down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">Then my anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">against them in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and I will hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from them, and they shall be devoured</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evils</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">and troubles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall befall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; so that they will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">Are not these evils</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon us, because our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">not among</w> us?<note type="study"><catchWord>befall</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">find</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for all the evils</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they shall have wrought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">in that</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore write</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">ye this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">for you, and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it in their mouths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">that this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">may be a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for me against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For when I shall have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">them into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">themselves, and waxen fat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then will they turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and provoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, and break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And it shall come to pass, when many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evils</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">and troubles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are befallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">them, that this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">them as a witness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">for it shall not be forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of the mouths</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of their seed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03336">their imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which they go about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">before I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>against</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>go…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And he gave Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">a charge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of a good courage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> unto them: and I will be with thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And it came to pass, when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they were finished</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">That Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">this book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">it in the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">of the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05707">that it may be there for a witness</w> against thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">thy rebellion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07186">and thy stiff</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">neck</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">behold, while I am yet alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">with you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">ye have been rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">and how much more after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">my death</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto me all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of your tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and your officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I may speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-135">and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-135">to record</w> against them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">that after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">my death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">ye will utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">corrupt</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">you; and evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will befall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">you in the latter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because ye will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke him to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">through the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hands</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of this song</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they were ended</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen217" osisID="Deut.31"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">O ye heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will speak</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">O earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03948">My doctrine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall drop</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">as the rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0565">my speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall distil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">as the dew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08164">as the small rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">upon the tender herb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07241">and as the showers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">upon the grass</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Because I will publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ascribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">ye greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto our God</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the Rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06467">his work</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">for all his ways</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">and without iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">just</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and right</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They have corrupted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03971">themselves, their spot</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">the spot</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his children</w>: <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06141">a perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06618">and crooked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He hath corrupted to himself</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>their…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that they are not his children, that is their blot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Do ye thus requite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05036">O foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">and unwise</w>? <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">not he thy father</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee? hath he not made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">thee, and established</w> thee?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">thee; thy elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they will tell</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>many…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05945">When the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-136">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-136">their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when he separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of Adam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">the bounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">portion</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02256">the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of his inheritance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cord</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">him in a desert</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08414">and in the waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03214">howling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">he led him about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">he instructed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, he kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0380">him as the apple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of his eye</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>led</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">compassed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05404">As an eagle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stirreth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">her nest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07363" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">fluttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01469">over her young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spreadeth abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">her wings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H084">them on her wings</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">did lead</w> him, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05236">no strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">god</w> with him.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He made him ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">on the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he might eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08570">the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the fields</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he made him to suck</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">out of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02496">out of the flinty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">rock</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02529">Butter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02461">and milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">with fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">of lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0352">and rams</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the breed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06260">and goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">with the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">of kidneys</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou didst drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H02561">the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06025">of the grape</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03484">But Jeshurun</w> <w lemma="strong:H08080" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01163" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08080" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art waxen fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05666" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art grown thick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03780" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art covered</w> <transChange type="added">with fatness</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then he forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and lightly esteemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the Rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of his salvation</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They provoked him to jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">with strange</w> <transChange type="added">gods</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">with abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">provoked they him to anger</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07700">unto devils</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0433">not to God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">to gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">not, to new</w> <transChange type="added">gods that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-137">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">newly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-137">up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">whom your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feared</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>not to…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which were not God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06697">Of the Rock</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07876" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee thou art unmindful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">that formed</w> thee.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he abhorred</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03708">because of the provoking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and of his daughters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abhorred</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">despised</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from them, I will see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">what their end</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08419">a very froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> in whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0529">no faith</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They have moved me to jealousy</w> with <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have provoked me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">with their vanities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will move them to jealousy</w> with <transChange type="added">those which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not a people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will provoke them to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">with a foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">For a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06919" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in mine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">unto the lowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">hell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">with her increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and set on fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04144">the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall burn</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hath burned</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shall consume</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hath consumed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischiefs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon them; I will spend</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">mine arrows</w> upon them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:24
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04198">burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">with hunger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07565">with burning heat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04815">and with bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06986">destruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will also send</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">the teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">upon them, with the poison</w> <w lemma="strong:H02119" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of serpents</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the dust</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">coals</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">The sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0367">and terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">within</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">both the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">and the virgin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the suckling</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">of gray hairs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>within</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the chambers</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bereave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06284" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I would scatter them into corners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02143">I would make the remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of them to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">from among men</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03884">Were it not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06862">lest their adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">should behave themselves strangely</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest they should say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">Our hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not done</w> all this.<note type="study"><catchWord>Our…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Our high hand, and not the <divineName>Lord</divineName> hath done</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:28
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">void</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">of counsel</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08394">understanding</w> in them.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03863">O that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were wise</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they understood</w> this, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they would consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">their latter end</w>!

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">How should one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">put ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to flight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">their Rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had shut them up</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06697">For their rock</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">not as our Rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">even our enemies</w> themselves <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06414">judges</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01612">For their vine</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01612">of the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05467">of Sodom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07709">and of the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H06017">of Gomorrah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06025">their grapes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">of gall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0811">their clusters</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04846">bitter</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>of the vine</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">worse than the vine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03196">Their wine</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">the poison</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">of dragons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0393">and the cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">venom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06620">of asps</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:34
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03647" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not this laid up in store</w> with me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sealed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">among my treasures</w>?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:35
verses.text: To me <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08005">and recompence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07272">their foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall slide</w> in <transChange type="added">due</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their calamity</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">at hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06264">and the things that shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon them make haste</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">himself for his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he seeth</w> that <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">or left</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall say</w>, Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>, <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in whom they trusted</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Which did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of their sacrifices</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drank</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05257">of their drink offerings</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and help</w> you, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">be your protection</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>your…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an hiding for you</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w> now that I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> I, <transChange type="added">am</transChange> he, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no god</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with me: I kill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I make alive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I wound</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I heal</w>: neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that can deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of my hand</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I whet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">my glittering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">on judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">to mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them that hate</w> me.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">I will make mine arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>; <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">and of the captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06546">of revenges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">O ye nations</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he will avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">to his adversaries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">unto his land</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to his people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Rejoice…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Praise his people, ye nations</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Sing ye</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01954">he, and Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hoshea</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Joshua</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to all Israel</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which I testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">among you this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which ye shall command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of this law</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:47
verses.text: For it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07386">not a vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> for you; because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">your life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">and through this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall prolong</w> <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither ye go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">that selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into this mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05682">Abarim</w>, <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05015">Nebo</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">for a possession</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whither thou goest up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto thy people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">as Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02023">Hor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>:

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because ye trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">against me among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">at the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946 strong:H04808">of Meribah–Kadesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because ye sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">me not in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Meribah–Kadesh</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strife at Kadesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> before <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thither unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen218" osisID="Deut.32"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:1
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01293">the blessing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">wherewith Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">his death</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">from Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">from Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto them; he shined forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">Paran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">with ten thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of saints</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">from his right hand</w> <transChange type="added">went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784 strong:H0799" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">a fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">law</w> for them.<note type="study"><catchWord>a fiery…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a fire of law</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">Yea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02245" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06918">all his saints</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thy hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08497" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and they sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">at thy feet</w>; <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01703">of thy words</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">us a law</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04181">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06952">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And he was king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03484">in Jeshurun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">when the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">were gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07205">Let Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not die</w>; and let <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04962">his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">be few</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And this <transChange type="added">is the blessing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him unto his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">let his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">be sufficient</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">for him; and be thou an help</w> <transChange type="added">to him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">from his enemies</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03878">And of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08550">thy Thummim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0224">and thy Urim</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02623">with thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom thou didst prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04532">at Massah</w>, <transChange type="added">and with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom thou didst strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">at the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04809">of Meribah</w>;

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and to his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him; neither did he acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his own children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have observed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">thy word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thy covenant</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06988">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">thee, and whole burnt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon thine altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They shall teach</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Let them teach</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they shall put</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">let them put</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>before…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at thy nose</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:11
