verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">his substance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">through the loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801" type="x-split-138">of them that rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">against him, and of them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801" type="x-split-138">him, that they rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03039">The beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w> by him; <transChange type="added">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02653" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him all the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">long, and he shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">between his shoulders</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03130">And of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">Blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04022">for the precious things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02919">for the dew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08415">and for the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that coucheth beneath</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04022">And for the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">fruits</w> <transChange type="added">brought forth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08121">by the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04022">and for the precious things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01645">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">by the moon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>put</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thrust</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>moon</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">And for the chief things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04022">and for the precious things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of the lasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hills</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04022">And for the precious things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">and fulness</w> thereof, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">the good will</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05572">in the bush</w>: let <transChange type="added">the blessing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06936">and upon the top of the head</w> of him <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05139">separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">from his brethren</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01926">His glory</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of his bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07161">and his horns</w> <transChange type="added">are like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H07214">of unicorns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with them he shall push</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">to the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07233">the ten thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, and they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unicorns</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an unicorn</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02074">And of Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in thy going out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03485">and, Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">in thy tents</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mountain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there they shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they shall suck</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08228">the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08226" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">in the sand</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01410">And of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that enlargeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03833">as a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and teareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">the arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0637">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">the crown of the head</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he provided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the first part</w> for himself, because there, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02513">a portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">of the lawgiver</w>, <transChange type="added">was he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05603" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">seated</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">with the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">the justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seated</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cieled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01835">And of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01482">whelp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02187" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall leap</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">from Bashan</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05321">And of Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05321">O Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07649">satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">with favour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04392">and full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">with the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">thou the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">and the south</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0836">And of Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0836">Asher</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">let him be acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and let him dip</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">in oil</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04515">Thy shoes</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">and as thy days</w>, <transChange type="added">so shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01679">thy strength</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thy shoes</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Under thy shoes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">none like unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03484">of Jeshurun</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">upon the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">in thy help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01346">and in his excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">on the sky</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06924">The eternal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04585">refuge</w>, and underneath <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arms</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he shall thrust out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; and shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Destroy</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w> <w lemma="strong:H0910">alone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08064">also his heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall drop down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">dew</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">thou, O Israel</w>: who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">like unto thee, O people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">of thy help</w>, and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">of thy excellency</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be found liars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; and thou shalt tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">upon their high places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>found…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">subdued</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen219" osisID="Deut.33"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">from the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05015">of Nebo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H06449">of Pisgah</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">unto Dan</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Pisgah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05321">And all Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">unto the utmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05045">And the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03603">and the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">of the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05899 strong:H08558" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of palm trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06820">unto Zoar</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">unto Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">it unto thy seed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have caused thee to see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt not go over</w> thither.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">So Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">there in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">him in a valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01047">Beth–peor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">of his sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">when he died</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03543" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was not dim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03893">nor his natural force</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">abated</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>natural…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moisture</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>abated</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">so the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">of weeping</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H060">mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were ended</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">for Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon him: and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">not a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">since</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">like unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to face</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">In all the signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and the wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and to all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and to all his land</w>,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02389">And in all that mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and in all the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172">terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen220" osisID="Deut.34"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen186" osisID="Deut" type="book"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it came to pass, that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">minister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now therefore arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">this Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou, and all this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I do give</w> to them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">Every place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">that the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of your foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tread upon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have I given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto you, as I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04057">From the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">and this Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">even unto the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">of the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and unto the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">toward the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">shall be your coast</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">There shall not any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be able to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">as I was with Moses</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will be with thee: I will not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, nor forsake</w> thee.

verses.name: Joshua 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of a good courage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for unto this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou divide for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto this…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou shalt cause this people to inherit the land</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Only be thou strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">courageous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">according to all the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: turn</w> not from it <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w> or <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">the left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that thou mayest prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whithersoever thou goest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prosper</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">do wisely</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05612">This book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of thy mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but thou shalt meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">therein day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to all that is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-139">therein: for then thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-139">prosperous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and then thou shalt have good success</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">do wisely</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Have not I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee? Be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of a good courage</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither be thou dismayed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee whithersoever thou goest</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">Then Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and command</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">you victuals</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">for within three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye shall pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">this Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you to possess</w> it.

verses.name: Joshua 1:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07206">And to the Reubenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">and to the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and to half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">hath given you rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you this land</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">Your wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">your little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and your cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">you on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but ye shall pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H02571">armed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">all the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">men of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and help</w> them;<note type="study"><catchWord>armed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">marshalled by five</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Until the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-140">have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-140">rest</w>, as <transChange type="added">he hath given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and they also have possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: then ye shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03425">of your possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and enjoy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">it, which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">you on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">All that thou commandest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us we will do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">and whithersoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou sendest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, we will go</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">According as we hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in all things, so will we hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee: only the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">be with thee, as he was with Moses</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Whosoever</w> <transChange type="added">he be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that doth rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against thy commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">in all that thou commandest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">him, he shall be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">only be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of a good courage</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen222" osisID="Josh.1"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07851">out of Shittim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to spy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02791">secretly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">view</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03405">even Jericho</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">into an harlot’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004 strong:H0802">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">named</w> <w lemma="strong:H07343">Rahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lodged</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>sent</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">had sent</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lodged</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lay</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in hither to night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to search out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07343">unto Rahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to thee, which are entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into thine house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to search out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the country</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus, There came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, but I wist</w> <w lemma="strong:H0370">not whence</w> they <transChange type="added">were</transChange>:

verses.name: Joshua 2:5
verses.text: And it came to pass <transChange type="added">about the time</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of shutting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">when it was dark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">that the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">whither the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I wot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not: pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">them quickly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for ye shall overtake</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But she had brought them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">to the roof</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of the house, and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">them with the stalks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">of flax</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which she had laid in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the roof</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">to Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">unto the fords</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and as soon as they which pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them were gone out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And before they were laid down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">unto them upon the roof</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0367">and that your terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon us, and that all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> of you.<note type="study"><catchWord>faint</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melt</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">how the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for you</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and what ye did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">and Og</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom ye utterly destroyed</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And as soon as we had heard</w> <transChange type="added">these things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">our hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">did melt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither did there remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">any more courage</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">in any man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of you: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in earth</w> beneath.<note type="study"><catchWord>did there…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rose up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Now therefore, I pray you, swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto me by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">since</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">you kindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye will also shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">me a true</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">token</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 2:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye will save alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and my mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">and my sisters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and all that they have, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">our lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from death</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">her, Our life</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for yours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">if ye utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not this our business</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And it shall be, when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we will deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truly</w> with thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">instead of you to die</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then she let them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">by a cord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">the window</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">for her house</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07023">upon the town</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and she dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">you to the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lest the pursuers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02247" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">you; and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">yourselves there three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">until the pursuers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be returned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your way</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto her, We <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">blameless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">of this thine oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast made us swear</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:18
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">we come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">this line</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">of scarlet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02339">thread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">in the window</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou didst let us down by</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and thy mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and all thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gather</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 2:19
verses.text: And it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">of the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">into the street</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, and we <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">guiltless</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and whosoever shall be with thee in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on our head</w>, if <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> be upon him.

verses.name: Joshua 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And if thou utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this our business</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05355">then we will be quit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">of thine oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast made us to swear</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">According unto your words</w>, so <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it. And she sent them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they departed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">the scarlet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">in the window</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">there three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">until the pursuers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were returned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the pursuers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">throughout all the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but found</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> not.

verses.name: Joshua 2:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08147">So the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">to Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> him all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that befell</w> them:

verses.name: Joshua 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">Truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for even all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">do faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> of us.<note type="study"><catchWord>faint</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melt</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen223" osisID="Josh.2"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07851">from Shittim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">to Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">he and all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there before they passed over</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07097">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, then ye shall remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from your place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> it.

verses.name: Joshua 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07350">Yet there shall be a space</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">between you and it, about two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">by measure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come not near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto it, that ye may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by which ye must go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye have not passed</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H08543">heretofore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heretofore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">since yesterday, and the third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">yourselves: for to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thee in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">that, as I was with Moses</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> I will be with thee.

verses.name: Joshua 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And thou shalt command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When ye are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the brink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall stand still</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">in Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come hither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hereby ye shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> you, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he will without fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">you the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01622">and the Girgashites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">Behold, the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passeth over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">you into Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">you twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">out of every</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03709">And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut off</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">from above</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon an</w> <w lemma="strong:H05067">heap</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And it came to pass, when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">from their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And as they that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">unto Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were dipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03383">for Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">overfloweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01415">all his banks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of harvest</w>,)

verses.name: Joshua 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">That the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">from above</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon an</w> <w lemma="strong:H05067">heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0121">Adam</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06654">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06891">Zaretan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">toward the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04417">the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">failed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were cut off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">right against Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">firm</w> <w lemma="strong:H02724">on dry ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-141">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02724">on dry ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">until all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-141">were passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen224" osisID="Josh.3"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And it came to pass, when all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">you twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">out of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">out of every</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">And command</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">you hence out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">out of the place where the priests’</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04673">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">firm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and ye shall carry them over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with you, and leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04411">them in the lodging place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where ye shall lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">this night</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Then Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">the twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">out of every</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and take ye up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of you a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">upon his shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according unto the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">That this may be a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> you, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">when your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ask</w> <transChange type="added">their fathers</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04279">in time to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, What <transChange type="added">mean</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">ye by these stones</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>in time…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then ye shall answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">them, That the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when it passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were cut off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H068">and these stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">shall be for a memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">so as Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried them over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04411">with them unto the place where they lodged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid them down</w> there.

verses.name: Joshua 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">in the place where the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04673">stood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and they are there unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">For the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">until every thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">according to all that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And it came to pass, when all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">that the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02571">armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> unto them:

verses.name: Joshua 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">About forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for war</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">unto battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">to the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prepared</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ready armed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">On that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, as they feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">out of Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come ye up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">out of Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And it came to pass, when the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the soles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests’</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02724">unto the dry land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto their place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and flowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01415">over all his banks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08543">as</w> <transChange type="added">they did</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08032">before</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lifted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">plucked up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>flowed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">out of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06218">on the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">in the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">And those twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they took out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">did Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">pitch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">When your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">in time to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, What <transChange type="added">mean</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">these stones</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>in time…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Then ye shall let your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">this Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">on dry land</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, until ye were passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">to the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, until we were gone over</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">That all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, that it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">mighty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye might fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for ever</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all days</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen225" osisID="Josh.4"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:1
