verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until we were passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">that their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">melted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">neither was there spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in them any more, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">thee sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">knives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and circumcise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sharp…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">knives of flints</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">him sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">knives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">at the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">of the foreskins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sharp…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">knives of flints</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the hill…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Gibeah–haaraloth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 5:4
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">why Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did circumcise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">All the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after they came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">were circumcised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">but all the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03209">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as they came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they had not circumcised</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">till all the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he would not shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he would give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">us, a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that floweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">with milk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And their children</w>, <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">in their stead, them Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">circumcised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06189">for they were uncircumcised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they had not circumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them by the way</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it came to pass, when they had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">circumcising</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in their places in the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till they were whole</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the people had made an end to be circumcised</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I rolled away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">from off you. Wherefore the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">Gilgal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gilgal</catchWord>: that is <rdg type="x-meaning">Rolling</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 5:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">on the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05669">of the old corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">after the passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened cakes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07033" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and parched</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in the selfsame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04478">And the manna</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after they had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05669">of the old corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither had the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">manna</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">any more; but they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">that year</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 5:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And it came to pass, when Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">was by Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">over against him with his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">thou for us, or for our adversaries</w>?

verses.name: Joshua 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Nay; but <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">am I now come</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and did worship</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto him, What saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servant</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>captain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05394" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">thy shoe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">from off thy foot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">for the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereon thou standest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> so. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen226" osisID="Josh.5"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03405">Now Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was straitly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none came in</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">did shut up, and was shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, all <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">go round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H06471">once</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of rams’ horns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">and the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long</w> <transChange type="added">blast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03104">with the ram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">horn</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when ye hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">shout</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02346">and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">flat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall ascend up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> straight before him.<note type="study"><catchWord>flat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">under it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and let seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of rams’ horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pass on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and let him that is armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And it came to pass, when Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">that the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of rams’ horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0727">and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And the armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">men went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628 strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">that blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and the rereward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>, <transChange type="added">the priests</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">going on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and blowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rereward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gathering host</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall not shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor make any noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with your voice</w>, neither shall <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of your mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I bid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">you shout</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then shall ye shout</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>any noise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">your voice to be heard</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">So the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">going about</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H06471">once</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03104">of rams’ horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the armed men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them; but the rereward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">the priests</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">going on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and blowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H06471">once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And it came to pass on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they rose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">about the dawning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">of the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the same manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">only on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And it came to pass at the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">when the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Shout</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">you the city</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05892">And the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">shall be accursed</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> it, and all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">therein, to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07343">only Rahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w>, she and all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with her in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because she hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we sent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accursed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">devoted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07535">And ye, in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02764">from the accursed thing</w>, lest ye make <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">accursed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when ye take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">of the accursed thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and trouble</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>accursed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">devoted</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a curse</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">devoted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">But all the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">and iron</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">into the treasury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consecrated</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shouted</w> when <transChange type="added">the priests</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with the trumpets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and it came to pass, when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">that the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell down flat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">so that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">straight before him, and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>flat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">under it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they utterly destroyed</w> all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">and ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">and sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">But Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that had spied out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">into the harlot’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thence the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and all that she hath, as ye sware</w> unto her.

verses.name: Joshua 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that were spies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07343">Rahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and her father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and her mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and her brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and all that she had; and they brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">all her kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">them without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kindred</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">families</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">therein: only the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">and of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">into the treasury</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-142">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07343">Rahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the harlot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-142">alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and all that she had; and she dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because she hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">which Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to spy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 6:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">adjured</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that riseth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and buildeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall lay the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">thereof in his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06810">and in his youngest</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the gates</w> of it.

verses.name: Joshua 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">was with Joshua</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08089">and his fame</w> was <transChange type="added">noised</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the country</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen227" osisID="Josh.6"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">a trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">in the accursed thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05912">for Achan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03756">of Carmi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02067">of Zabdi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">of the accursed thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">and the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Achan</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Achar</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Zabdi</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Zimri</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">from Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">to Ai</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05973">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01007">Beth–aven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and view</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and viewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">Ai</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">to Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto him, Let not all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">but let about two or three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">Ai</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">make not all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to labour</w> thither; for they <transChange type="added">are but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>about…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">about two thousand men</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">about three thousand men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So there went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thither of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">about three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of them about thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they chased</w> them <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07671">unto Shebarim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04174">them in the going down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03824">wherefore the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">melted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and became as water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in Morad</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the eventide</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">he and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0162">Alas, O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-143">wherefore hast thou at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-143">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03863">us? would to God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">we had been content</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>!

verses.name: Joshua 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0994">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall I say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">their backs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>backs</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">necks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03669">For the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall environ us round</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">our name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and what wilt thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">unto thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>?

verses.name: Joshua 7:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get thee up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherefore liest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thou thus upon thy face</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>liest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fallest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they have also transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: for they have even taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">of the accursed thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have also stolen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and dissembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also, and they have put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">even among their own stuff</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Therefore the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203">backs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02764">because they were accursed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither will I be with you any more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">the accursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">yourselves against to morrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02764">an accursed thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of thee, O Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou canst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">until ye take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">the accursed thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">In the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">therefore ye shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">according to your tribes</w>: and it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to the families</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">by households</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the household</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">by man</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:15
verses.text: And it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he that is taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">with the accursed thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and because he hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>folly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wickedness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">by their tribes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07626">and the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02227">of the Zarhites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02227">of the Zarhites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">by man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02067">and Zabdi</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his household</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">by man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05912">and Achan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03756">of Carmi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02067">of Zabdi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05912">unto Achan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">I pray thee, glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">confession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto him; and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me now what thou hast done</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hide</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not from me.

verses.name: Joshua 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05912">And Achan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0546">Indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thus and thus have I done</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">among the spoils</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08152">Babylonish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and a</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">wedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I coveted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and took</w> them; and, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of my tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w> under it.<note type="study"><catchWord>wedge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto the tent</w>; and, behold, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in his tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w> under it.

verses.name: Joshua 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them out of the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">them unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>laid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">poured</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05912">Achan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0155">and the garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and the wedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and his daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">and his oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and his asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and his sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">and his tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and all that he had: and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">them unto the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05911">of Achor</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">Why</w> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">us? the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">them with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">after they had stoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">them with stones</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they raised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">over him a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">from the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his anger</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08034">Wherefore the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06010">The valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05911">of Achor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Achor</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Trouble</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen228" osisID="Josh.7"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, neither be thou dismayed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with thee, and arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">to Ai</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and his land</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">to Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and her king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">unto Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and her king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07998">only the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">thereof, and the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, shall ye take for a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto yourselves: lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee an ambush</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">for the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> it.

verses.name: Joshua 8:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">against Ai</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chose out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye shall lie in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-144">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">not very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-144">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">but be ye all ready</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And I, and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me, will approach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall come to pass, when they come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">us, as at the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we will flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them,

verses.name: Joshua 8:6
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they will come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">us) till we have drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">them from the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they will say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">They flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">us, as at the first</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore we will flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>drawn</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pulled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then ye shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from the ambush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and seize</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into your hand</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall be, when ye have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye shall set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ye do</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have commanded</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 8:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore sent them forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03993">to lie in ambush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">between Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">and Ai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03091">but Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">he and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">to Ai</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w>, <transChange type="added">even the people</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him, went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew nigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">before the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>: now <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">a valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">between them and Ai</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">about five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them to lie in ambush</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">between Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">and Ai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H05857" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of Ai</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04264">all the host</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06119">and their liers in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>liers…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lying in wait</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that they hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and rose up early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">he and all his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">at a time appointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">the plain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he wist</w> not that <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">liers in ambush</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">against him behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">made as if they were beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H05857" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">in Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">together to pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: and they pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and were drawn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And there was not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">in Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">or Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">open</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">after Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03591">the spear</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">toward Ai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03591">the spear</w> that <transChange type="added">he had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">toward the city</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the ambush</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of their place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as soon as he had stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it, and hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And when the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, they saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06227">and, behold, the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ascended up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and they had no power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">this way or that way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the pursuers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And when Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the ambush</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06227">and that the smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ascended</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they turned again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0428">And the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">issued out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them; so they were in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">them, so that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they let</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">none of them remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">or escape</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">him to Joshua</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And it came to pass, when Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of slaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein they chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and when they were all fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">on the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they were consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">that all the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">unto Ai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> it was, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">both of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">For Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-145">drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-145">back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith he stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03591">the spear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until he had utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0929">Only the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">and the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took for a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto themselves, according unto the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">Ai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08510">it an heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08077">a desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153 strong:H06256">until eventide</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08121">and as soon as the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-146">that they should take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">his carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-146">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">from the tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">it at the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and raise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thereon a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>, <transChange type="added">that remaineth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">Then Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05858">Ebal</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 8:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">As Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as it is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">of whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">over which no man hath lift up</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thereon burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">there upon the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">a copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:33
