verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and their elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and their judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">on this side the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and on that side before the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">as well the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0249">as he that was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">among them; half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">of them over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01630">Gerizim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">of them over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05858">Ebal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">before</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that they should bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he read</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">the blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">and cursings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to all that is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 8:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">There was not a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of all that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">which Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">not before all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and the little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that were conversant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walked</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen229" osisID="Josh.8"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when all the kings</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and in the valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02348">and in all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">the Perizzite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>;

verses.name: Joshua 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">That they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">with Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and with Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">accord</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accord</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And when the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">what Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">unto Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">and to Ai</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They did work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06195">wilily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06737" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made as if they had been ambassadors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01087">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sacks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">upon their asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04997">bottles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01087">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and bound up</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01087">And old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">shoes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02921" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and clouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01087">and old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">upon them; and all the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">of their provision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dry</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05350">mouldy</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">to Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">at Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, and to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now therefore make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">ye a league</w> with us.

verses.name: Joshua 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02340">unto the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0194">Peradventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us; and how shall we make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> with you?

verses.name: Joshua 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto them, Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0370">ye? and from whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> ye?

verses.name: Joshua 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">unto him, From a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">because of the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08089">the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of him, and all that he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And all that he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">to the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05511">to Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05747">and to Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06252">at Ashtaroth</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">Wherefore our elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of our country</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to us, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">victuals</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with you</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">for the journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and say</w> unto them, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">your servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore now make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">ye a league</w> with us.<note type="study"><catchWord>with you</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in your hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03899">This our bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02525">we took hot</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">our provision</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of our houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">we came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you; but now, behold, it is dry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05350">and it is mouldy</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04997">And these bottles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which we filled</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and, behold, they be rent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08008">and these our garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">and our shoes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are become old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">by reason of the very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">long</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">of their victuals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and asked</w> not <transChange type="added">counsel</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the men…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they received the men by reason of their victuals</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">with them, to let them live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> unto them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07097">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, that they heard</w> that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">their neighbours</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">journeyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05892">Now their cities</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03716">and Chephirah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0881">and Beeroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07157">and Kirjath–jearim</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">them not, because the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">had sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05712">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">against the princes</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">But all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto all the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">We have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now therefore we may</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not touch</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">This we will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to them; we will even let them live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07110">lest wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">be upon us, because of the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which we sware</w> unto them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">And the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Let them live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but let them be hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drawers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">unto all the congregation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05387">as the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had promised</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 9:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for them, and he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Wherefore have ye beguiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, saying</w>, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from you; when ye dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> us?

verses.name: Joshua 9:23
verses.text: Now therefore ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cursed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and there shall none of you be freed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">from being bondmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drawers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not be cut off from you</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">Because it was certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">how that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you all the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">you, therefore we were sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of our lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of you, and have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02009">And now, behold, we</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">as it seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and right</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto us, do</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he unto them, and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they slew</w> them not.

verses.name: Joshua 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drawers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">for the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and for the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he should choose</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">delivered to be</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen230" osisID="Josh.9"/>

verses.name: Joshua 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0139">Now it came to pass, when Adoni–zedek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">how</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">Ai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and had utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it; as he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">to Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and her king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">to Ai</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and her king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and how the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had made peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">and were among</w> them;

verses.name: Joshua 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01391">because Gibeon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, and because it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">than Ai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all the men</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>royal…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cities of the kingdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0139">Wherefore Adoni–zedek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01944">unto Hoham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06502">and unto Piram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03412">of Jarmuth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03309">and unto Japhia</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">of Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01688">and unto Debir</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">of Eglon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, and help</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, that we may smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">Gibeon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for it hath made peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">with Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">Therefore the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03412">of Jarmuth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">of Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">of Eglon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">they and all their hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">before Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and made war</w> against it.

verses.name: Joshua 10:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Slack</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">from thy servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">to us quickly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">us, and help</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">us: for all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are gathered together</w> against us.

verses.name: Joshua 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ascended</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">from Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">he, and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">with him, and all the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">men of valour</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them not: for I have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into thine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">there shall not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: Joshua 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">unto them suddenly</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">from Gilgal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all night</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">discomfited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">them with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">at Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them along the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">that goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">to Beth–horon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05825">them to Azekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04719">and unto Makkedah</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, as they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04174">were in the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">to Beth–horon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05825">upon them unto Azekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they died</w>: <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which died</w> <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H01259">with hailstones</w> than <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">delivered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">Sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">stand thou still</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">upon Gibeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03394">and thou, Moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0357">of Ajalon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stand…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">And the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">and the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">until the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">themselves upon their enemies</w>. <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01931">not this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of Jasher</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08121">So the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood still</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">about a whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jasher</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the upright?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And there was no day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">like that before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">it or after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it, that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">with him, unto the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">But these five</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">themselves in a cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04719">at Makkedah</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">The five</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in a cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04719">at Makkedah</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">of the cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by it for to keep</w> them:

verses.name: Joshua 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And stay</w> ye not, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02179" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and smite the hindmost</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them; suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them not to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into their cities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into your hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>smite…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off the tail</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And it came to pass, when Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of slaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">them with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till they were consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08300">that the rest</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08277" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">into fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">to Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H04719">at Makkedah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">none moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">his tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against any</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">of the cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">those five</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">unto me out of the cave</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so, and brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">those five</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">unto him out of the cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03412">of Jarmuth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">of Lachish</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">of Eglon</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And it came to pass, when they brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">those kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">that Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">for all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07101">unto the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with him, Come near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">your feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">upon the necks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of these kings</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">their feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">upon the necks</w> of them.

verses.name: Joshua 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, nor be dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of good courage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for thus shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to all your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">against whom ye fight</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">them on five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and they were hanging</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">upon the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the evening</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And it came to pass at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they took them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">off the trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">them into the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">wherein they had been hid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in the cave’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <transChange type="added">which remain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">until this very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04719">Makkedah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof he utterly destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">them, and all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therein; he let</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">none remain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04719">of Makkedah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Then Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04719">from Makkedah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">with him, unto Libnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">against Libnah</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">it also, and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thereof, into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therein; he let</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">none remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in it; but did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof as he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">from Libnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">with him, unto Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">against it, and fought</w> against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">Lachish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">it on the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein, according to all that he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">to Libnah</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02036">Then Horam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">of Gezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">Lachish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him and his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until he had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">him none remaining</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03923">And from Lachish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">unto Eglon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him; and they encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">against it, and fought</w> against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it on that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therein he utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according to all that he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">to Lachish</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">from Eglon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">with him, unto Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they fought</w> against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thereof, and all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thereof, and all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therein; he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">none remaining</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according to all that he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">to Eglon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">it utterly, and all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> therein.

verses.name: Joshua 10:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">with him, to Debir</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> against it:

verses.name: Joshua 10:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">it, and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thereof, and all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof; and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therein; he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">none remaining</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">to Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">to Debir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; as he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">also to Libnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to her king</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:40
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and of the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and of the vale</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0794">and of the springs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all their kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">none remaining</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">all that breathed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">them from Kadesh–barnea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">even unto Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and all the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01391">even unto Gibeon</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And all these kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">did Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">at one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 10:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">with him, unto the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen231" osisID="Josh.10"/>

verses.name: Joshua 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02985">And it came to pass, when Jabin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">of Hazor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had heard</w> <transChange type="added">those things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03103">to Jobab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04068">of Madon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08110">of Shimron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0407">of Achshaph</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And to the kings</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">and of the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03672">of Chinneroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and in the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05299">and in the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01756">of Dor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 11:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">and on the west</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">under Hermon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">of Mizpeh</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">they and all their hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with them, much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">even as the sand</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">upon the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">shore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">with horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And when all these kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were met together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">at the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04792">of Merom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>met…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">assembled by appointment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">of them: for to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">about this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will I deliver them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">all slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06131" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt hough</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">their horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">their chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with him, against them by the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04792">of Merom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fell upon</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">them unto great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04956">and unto Misrephoth–maim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01237">and unto the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">of Mizpeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, until they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">them none remaining</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great Zidon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zidonrabbah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Misrephoth–maim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Salt pits</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Burnings of waters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bade</w> <w lemma="strong:H06131" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him: he houghed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">their horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">their chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thereof with the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02674">for Hazor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">beforetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">was the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of all those kingdoms</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">all the souls</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">therein with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">utterly destroying</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there was not any left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">to breathe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">Hazor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>any…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">any breath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of those kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of them, did Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">them, as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:13
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08510">still in their strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">none of them, save</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">Hazor</w> only; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03091">did Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burn</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">on their heap</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07998">And all the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of these cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and the cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took for a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">unto themselves; but every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">until they had destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, neither left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">they any to breathe</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">As the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">so did Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-147">he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-147">undone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>left…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">removed nothing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all that land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and all the south country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01657">of Goshen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">and the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and the valley</w> of the same;

verses.name: Joshua 11:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02510">Halak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">to Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01171">even unto Baal–gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">under mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he took</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and slew</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>the mount…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the smooth mountain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with all those kings</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">There was not a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that made peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">save the Hivites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w>: all <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in battle</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For it was of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should come against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he might destroy them utterly</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08467">that they might have no favour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">but that he might destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">And at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06062">the Anakims</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">from Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01688">from Debir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06024">from Anab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and from all the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and from all the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">destroyed them utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">with their cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06062">There was none of the Anakims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05804">only in Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01661">in Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0795">and in Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there remained</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the whole land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">according to all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">it for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">according to their divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">by their tribes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">from war</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen232" osisID="Josh.11"/>

verses.name: Joshua 12:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">and all the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ruled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06177">from Aroer</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">upon the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">and from the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and from half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">even unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H02999">Jabbok</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06160">And from the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03672">of Chinneroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and unto the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04417">the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01020">to Beth–jeshimoth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08486">and from the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0794 strong:H0798" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">under Ashdoth–pisgah</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the south</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Teman</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ashdoth–pisgah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the springs of Pisgah</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 12:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03499">of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06252">at Ashtaroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0154">and at Edrei</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05548">and in Salcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01316">and in all Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01651">of the Geshurites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04602">and the Maachathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Them did Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">unto the Reubenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">and the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 12:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">which Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01171">from Baal–gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">even unto the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02510">Halak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">to Seir</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03091">which Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">unto the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">a possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">according to their divisions</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">In the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and in the valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">and in the plains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0794">and in the springs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">and in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and in the south country</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 12:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05857">of Ai</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06654">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03412">of Jarmuth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">of Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">of Eglon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">of Gezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">of Debir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01445">of Geder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02767">of Hormah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06166">of Arad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">of Libnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05725">of Adullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04719">of Makkedah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08599">of Tappuah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02660">of Hepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0663">of Aphek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08289">of Lasharon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Lasharon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Sharon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04068">of Madon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">of Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08112">of Shimron–meron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0407">of Achshaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08590">of Taanach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">of Megiddo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06943">of Kedesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03362">of Jokneam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01756">of Dor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05299">in the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01756">of Dor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">of Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">of Tirzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen233" osisID="Josh.12"/>

verses.name: Joshua 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Now Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was old</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thou art old</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">yet very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be possessed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to possess it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:2
