verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that yet remaineth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01552">all the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01651">and all Geshuri</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07883">From Sihor</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">even unto the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">of Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">to the Canaanite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05841">the Gazathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0796">and the Ashdothites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0832">the Eshkalonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06139">and the Ekronites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05761">also the Avites</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08486">From the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04632">and Mearah</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06722">beside the Sidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0663">unto Aphek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">to the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Mearah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the cave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01382">of the Giblites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">and all Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01171">from Baal–gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">under mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">into Hamath</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hill country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">from Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04956">unto Misrephoth–maim</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06722">all the Sidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them will I drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">only divide thou it by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as I have commanded</w> thee.

verses.name: Joshua 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Now therefore divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">unto the nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07206">With whom the Reubenites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01425">and the Gadites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">them, beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> them;

verses.name: Joshua 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06177">From Aroer</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">upon the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04334">and all the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04311">of Medeba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01769">unto Dibon</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01568">And Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01651">of the Geshurites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04602">and Maachathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and all mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01316">and all Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05548">unto Salcah</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04468">All the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06252">in Ashtaroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0154">and in Edrei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">who remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04872">for these did Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast them out</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Nevertheless the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">expelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01651">not the Geshurites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04602">nor the Maachathites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01650">but the Geshurites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">and the Maachathites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until this day</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07626">Only unto the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">none inheritance</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-148">the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801" type="x-split-148">made by fire</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he said</w> unto them.

verses.name: Joshua 13:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">unto the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <transChange type="added">inheritance</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06177">was from Aroer</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">on the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04334">and all the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04311">by Medeba</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02809">Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and all her cities</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04334">in the plain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01769">Dibon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01120">and Bamoth–baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01010">and Beth–baal–meon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Bamoth–baal…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the high places of Baal, and house of Baal–meon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03096">And Jahazah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06932">and Kedemoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04158">and Mephaath</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07156">And Kirjathaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07643">and Sibmah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06890">and Zareth–shahar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01047">And Beth–peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0794 strong:H0798" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">and Ashdoth–pisgah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01020">and Beth–jeshimoth</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Ashdoth–pisgah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">springs of Pisgah</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04468">and all the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">whom Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">with the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0189">Evi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07552">and Rekem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06698">and Zur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02354">and Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07254">and Reba</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05257">dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the country</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">also the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the soothsayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">did the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">among them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">that were slain</w> by them.<note type="study"><catchWord>soothsayer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">diviner</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">was Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>. This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and the villages</w> thereof.

verses.name: Joshua 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <transChange type="added">inheritance</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">unto the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03270">was Jazer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06177">unto Aroer</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">Rabbah</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 13:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02809">And from Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07434">unto Ramath–mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0993">and Betonim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04266">and from Mahanaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">of Debir</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06010">And in the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01027">Beth–aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01039">and Beth–nimrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05523">and Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06829">and Zaphon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04468">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> and <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03672">of Chinnereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:28
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">and their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <transChange type="added">inheritance</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">unto the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>: and <transChange type="added">this</transChange> was <transChange type="added">the possession</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">was from Mahanaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01316">all Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04468">all the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02333">and all the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02971">of Jair</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 13:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02677">And half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06252">and Ashtaroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0154">and Edrei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04468">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <transChange type="added">were pertaining</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">to the one half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:32
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are the countries</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">did distribute for inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03405">by Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 13:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07626">But unto the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> not <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he said</w> unto them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen234" osisID="Josh.13"/>

verses.name: Joshua 14:1
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are the countries</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">inherited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">which Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">distributed for inheritance</w> to them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01486">By lot</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08672">for the nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribes</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">For Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and an half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">but unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">none inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">were two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">save cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">for their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">and for their substance</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">As the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">so the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Then the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03612">and Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07074">the Kenezite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">concerning me</w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">and thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">in Kadesh–barnea</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">Forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">I when Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">me from Kadesh–barnea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to espy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-149">and I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-149">again</w> as <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in mine heart</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">Nevertheless my brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with me made the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04529" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">melt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but I wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">And Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">Surely the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">whereon thy feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have trodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">shall be thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because thou hast wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And now, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath kept me alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">these forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0227">even since</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, while <transChange type="added">the children of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wandered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>: and now, lo, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wandered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 14:11
verses.text: As yet I <transChange type="added">am as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> as <transChange type="added">I was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">me: as my strength</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> then, even so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">now, for war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">both to go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to come in</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">me this mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whereof the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06062">how the Anakims</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> there, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">fenced</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0194">if so be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0854">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, then I shall be able to drive them out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">unto Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">therefore became the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07074">the Kenezite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">because that he wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07153">Kirjath–arba</w>; <transChange type="added">which Arba was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06062">among the Anakims</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">from war</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen235" osisID="Josh.14"/>

verses.name: Joshua 15:1
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">then was the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">to the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">of Zin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">of the south coast</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05045">And their south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">was from the shore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">from the bay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>bay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">to the south side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04610">to Maaleh–acrabbim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06790">along to Zin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ascended up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06947">unto Kadesh–barnea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">along to Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0146">to Adar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fetched a compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07173">to Karkaa</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Maaleh–acrabbim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the going up to Acrabbim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">From thence</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06111">toward Azmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of that coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">were at the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05045">this shall be your south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">coast</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06924">And the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04417">the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>. And <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">in the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">quarter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03956">from the bay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">at the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01031">to Beth–hogla</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">along by the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H01026">of Beth–arabah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">to the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0932">of Bohan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">toward Debir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">from the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05911">of Achor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and so northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">toward Gilgal</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0131">to Adummim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">toward the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05885">of En–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05883">thereof were at En–rogel</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">by the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">unto the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">of the Jebusite</w>; the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w> that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">unto the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05318">of Nephtoah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">Ephron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01173">to Baalah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07157">Kirjath–jearim</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01173">from Baalah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">along unto the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03297">Jearim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03693">Chesalon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">to Beth–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">to Timnah</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">unto the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">of Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07942">to Shicron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed along</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01173">Baalah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02995">unto Jabneel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">were at the sea</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">And the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">border</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">to the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the coast</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03612">And unto Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">a part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0413">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">to Joshua</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07151">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07153 strong:H0704" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Arba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>, which <transChange type="added">city is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the city…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Kirjath–arba</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03612">And Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">drove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thence the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08344">Sheshai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0289">and Ahiman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08526">and Talmai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03211">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thence to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">of Debir</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">of Debir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07158">Kirjath–sepher</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03612">And Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07158">Kirjath–sepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, to him will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05915">Achsah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06274">And Othniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">of Kenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of Caleb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it: and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05915">him Achsah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, as she came</w> <transChange type="added">unto him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that she moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06795" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she lighted off</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02543">ass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03612">and Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto her, What wouldest thou?

verses.name: Joshua 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">me a blessing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">me a south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">me also springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05942">her the upper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">springs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08482">and the nether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">springs</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:20
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07097">And the uttermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">toward the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06909">were Kabzeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05740">and Eder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03017">and Jagur</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07016">And Kinah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01776">and Dimonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05735">and Adadah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06943">And Kedesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02674">and Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03497">and Ithnan</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02128">Ziph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02928">and Telem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01175">and Bealoth</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02674">And Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02675">Hadattah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07152">and Kerioth</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02674">Hazor</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0538">Amam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08090">and Shema</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04137">and Moladah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02693">And Hazar–gaddah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02829">and Heshmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01046">and Beth–palet</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02705">And Hazar–shual</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0884">and Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0964">and Bizjothjah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01173">Baalah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05864">and Iim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06107">and Azem</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0513">And Eltolad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03686">and Chesil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02767">and Hormah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06860">And Ziklag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04089">and Madmannah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05578">and Sansannah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03822">And Lebaoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07978">and Shilhim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05871">and Ain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07417">and Rimmon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the cities</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:33
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08219">in the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0847">Eshtaol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06881">and Zoreah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0823">and Ashnah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02182">And Zanoah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05873">and En–gannim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08599">Tappuah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05879">and Enam</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03412">Jarmuth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05725">and Adullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07755">Socoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05825">and Azekah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08189">And Sharaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05723">and Adithaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01449">and Gederah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01453">and Gederothaim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>and Gederothaim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">or Gederothaim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06799">Zenan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02322">and Hadashah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04028">and Migdal–gad</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01810">And Dilean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04708">and Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03371">and Joktheel</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03923">Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01218">and Bozkath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05700">and Eglon</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03522">And Cabbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03903">and Lahmam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03798">and Kithlish</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01450">And Gederoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01016">Beth–dagon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05279">and Naamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04719">and Makkedah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03841">Libnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06281">and Ether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06228">and Ashan</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jiphtah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0823">and Ashnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05334">and Nezib</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07084">And Keilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0392">and Achzib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04762">and Mareshah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06138">Ekron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">with her towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and her villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06138">From Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">even unto the sea</w>, all that <transChange type="added">lay</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>near</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the place of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0795">Ashdod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with her towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and her villages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05804">Gaza</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with her towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and her villages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366 strong:H01419" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:48
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02022">And in the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08069">Shamir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03492">and Jattir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07755">and Socoh</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01837">And Dannah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07158">and Kirjath–sannah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01688">Debir</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06024">And Anab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0851">and Eshtemoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06044">and Anim</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01657">And Goshen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02473">and Holon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01542">and Giloh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0694">Arab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01746">and Dumah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0824">and Eshean</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03241">And Janum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01054">and Beth–tappuah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0664">and Aphekah</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Janum</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Janus</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 15:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02547">And Humtah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07153">and Kirjath–arba</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06730">and Zior</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04584">Maon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03760">Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02128">and Ziph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03194">and Juttah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03157">And Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03347">and Jokdeam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02182">and Zanoah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07014">Cain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01390">Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08553">and Timnah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02478">Halhul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01049">Beth–zur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01446">and Gedor</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04638">And Maarath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01042">and Beth–anoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0515">and Eltekon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07154">Kirjath–baal</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07157">Kirjath–jearim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07237">and Rabbah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 15:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04057">In the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01026">Beth–arabah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04081">Middin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05527">and Secacah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 15:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05044">And Nibshan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05898">and the city of Salt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05872">and En–gedi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 15:63
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02983">As for the Jebusites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201 strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not drive them out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02983">but the Jebusites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen236" osisID="Josh.15"/>

verses.name: Joshua 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01486">And the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">from Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">by Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">unto the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">from Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">throughout mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>fell</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">from Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H03870">to Luz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passeth along</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0757">of Archi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05852">to Ataroth</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And goeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">to the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03311">of Japhleti</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">of Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">the nether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01507">and to Gezer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">thereof are at the sea</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">So the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took their inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 16:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w> was <transChange type="added">thus</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">even the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05853">was Ataroth–addar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01032">unto Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the upper</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">toward the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04366">to Michmethah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">went about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H08387">unto Taanath–shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">by it on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H03239">to Janohah</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03239">from Janohah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05852">to Ataroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05292">and to Naarath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">to Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">at Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">The border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08599">from Tappuah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07071">Kanah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">thereof were at the sea</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03995">And the separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And they drave not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">in Gezer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03669">but the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">the Ephraimites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">under tribute</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen237" osisID="Josh.16"/>

verses.name: Joshua 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01486">There was also a lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">for the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>; for he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>; <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04353">for Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">because he was a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01568">therefore he had Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">and Bashan</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:2
verses.text: There was also <transChange type="added">a lot</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H044">of Abiezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02507">of Helek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0844">of Asriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07928">of Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02660">of Hepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08061">of Shemida</w>: these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02145">the male</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abiezer</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jeezer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 17:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06765">But Zelophehad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02660">of Hepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">had no sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">but daughters</w>: and these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of his daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04244">Mahlah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05270">and Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02295">Hoglah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04435">Milcah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08656">and Tirzah</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">us an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brethren</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06310">Therefore according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">them an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">to Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">beside the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">and Bashan</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">Because the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">had the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">was from Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04366">to Michmethah</w>, that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went along</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05887">of En–tappuah</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">had the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08599">of Tappuah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08599">but Tappuah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">on the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07071">Kanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of it were at the sea</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>river Kanah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">brook of reeds</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05045">Southward</w> <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">and northward</w> <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">is his border</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they met together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">in Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">and in Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">And Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">had in Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">and in Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H01052">Beth–shean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02991">and Ibleam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01756">of Dor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05874">of Endor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08590">of Taanach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">of Megiddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05316">countries</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Yet the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not drive out</w> <transChange type="added">the inhabitants of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">those cities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03669">but the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in that land</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Yet it came to pass, when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were waxen strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">to tribute</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">but did not utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive them out</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why hast thou given</w> me <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">to inherit</w>, seeing I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">me hitherto</w>?

verses.name: Joshua 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> them, If thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">to the wood</w> <transChange type="added">country</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for thyself there in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06522">of the Perizzites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">and of the giants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">if mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be too narrow</w> for thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>giants</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Rephaims</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">The hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">for us: and all the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">have chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <transChange type="added">both they</transChange> who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01052">of Beth–shean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">to Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and to Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and hast great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">thou shalt not have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <transChange type="added">only</transChange>:

verses.name: Joshua 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">But the mountain</w> shall be thine; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03293">a wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt cut it down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">though they have iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> though they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen238" osisID="Josh.17"/>

verses.name: Joshua 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">assembled together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">at Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">there. And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which had not yet received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, How long <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">ye slack</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> you?

verses.name: Joshua 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">from among you three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> for <transChange type="added">each</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they shall rise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and describe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it according</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">to the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them; and they shall come</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange> to me.

verses.name: Joshua 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">And they shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">it into seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">parts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in their coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in their coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall therefore describe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">parts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <transChange type="added">the description</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hither to me, that I may cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for you here before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">But the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">have no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">you; for the priesthood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01410">and Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07205">and Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> them.

verses.name: Joshua 18:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to describe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and describe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">it, and come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to me, that I may here cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for you before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:9
