verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and described</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">it by cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">into seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03091">to Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">at Shiloh</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">for them in Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03091">and there Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">according to their divisions</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01486">And the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">of their lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">between the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">was from Jordan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">to the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">side, and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">through the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">thereof were at the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01007">of Beth–aven</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03870">from thence toward Luz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03802">to the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03870">of Luz</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H05853">to Ataroth–adar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">near the hill</w> that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">of the nether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">Beth–horon</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was drawn</w> <transChange type="added">thence</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the hill</w> that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the goings out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07154">thereof were at Kirjath–baal</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07157">Kirjath–jearim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the west</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">quarter</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05045">And the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">quarter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">of Kirjath–jearim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">to the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05318">of Nephtoah</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w> that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">to the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03802">to the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">of Jebusi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H05883">to En–rogel</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And was drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05885">to En–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01553">toward Geliloth</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0131">of Adummim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">to the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0932">of Bohan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And passed along</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">toward the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">Arabah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">unto Arabah</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Arabah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the plain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed along</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">to the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01031">of Beth–hoglah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">were at the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">bay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">at the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>: this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">coast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03383">And Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01379" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of it on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">side</w>. This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01367">by the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">Now the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">were Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01031">and Beth–hoglah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06010">and the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07104">of Keziz</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01026">And Beth–arabah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06787">and Zemaraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01008">and Beth–el</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05761">And Avim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06511">and Parah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06084">and Ophrah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03726">And Chephar–haammonai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06078">and Ophni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01387">and Gaba</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01391">Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07414">and Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0881">and Beeroth</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04708">And Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03716">and Chephirah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04681">and Mozah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07552">And Rekem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03416">and Irpeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08634">and Taralah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06762">And Zelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0507">Eleph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and Jebusi</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01394">Gibeath</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07157">Kirjath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen239" osisID="Josh.18"/>

verses.name: Joshua 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">to Simeon</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">for the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05159">and their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">was within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">And they had in their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07652">Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04137">and Moladah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02705">And Hazar–shual</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01088">and Balah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06107">and Azem</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0513">And Eltolad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01329">and Bethul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02767">and Hormah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06860">And Ziklag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01024">and Beth–marcaboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02701">and Hazar–susah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01034">And Beth–lebaoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08287">and Sharuhen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05871">Ain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07417">Remmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06281">and Ether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06228">and Ashan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and their villages</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02691">And all the villages</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01192">to Baalath–beer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07414">Ramath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">of the south</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">Out of the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02506">for the part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">was too much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for them: therefore the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> of them.

verses.name: Joshua 19:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07992">And the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08301">was unto Sarid</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">toward the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04831">and Maralah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reached</w> <w lemma="strong:H01708">to Dabbasheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reached</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">to the river</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03362">Jokneam</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08301">from Sarid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03696">of Chisloth–tabor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and then goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01705">to Daberath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03309">to Japhia</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And from thence passeth on along</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924 strong:H04217">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H01662">to Gittah–hepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06278">to Ittah–kazin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">to Remmon–methoar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05269">to Neah</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>methoar</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which is drawn</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">compasseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">it on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02615">to Hannathon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">thereof are in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03317">of Jiphthah–el</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07005">And Kattath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05096">and Nahallal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08110">and Shimron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03030">and Idalah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01035">and Beth–lehem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:16
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">to Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">was toward Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03694">and Chesulloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07766">and Shunem</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02663">And Hapharaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07866">and Shion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0588">and Anaharath</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07245">And Rabbith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07191">and Kishion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H077">and Abez</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07432">And Remeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05873">and En–gannim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05876">and En–haddah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01048">and Beth–pazzez</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">to Tabor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07831">and Shahazimah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01053">and Beth–shemesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of their border</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">were at Jordan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:23
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02549">And the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">for the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their border</w> <w lemma="strong:H02520">was Helkath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02482">and Hali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0991">and Beten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0407">and Achshaph</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0487">And Alammelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06008">and Amad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04861">and Misheal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">to Carmel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07884">and to Shihor–libnath</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 19:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w> <w lemma="strong:H01016">to Beth–dagon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">to Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">and to the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03317">of Jiphthah–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01025">of Beth–emek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05272">and Neiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03521">to Cabul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left hand</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05683">And Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07340">and Rehob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02540">and Hammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07071">and Kanah</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">unto great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">Zidon</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 19:29
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">to Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04013">and to the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">Tyre</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02621">to Hosah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">thereof are at the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">from the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0392">to Achzib</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Tyre</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Tzor</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 19:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05981">Ummah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0663">also, and Aphek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07340">and Rehob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:31
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08345">The sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And their coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02501">was from Heleph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0438">from Allon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06815">to Zaanannim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0129">and Adami</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05346">Nekeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02995">and Jabneel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03946">unto Lakum</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08444">and the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">thereof were at Jordan</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 19:34
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0243">to Aznoth–tabor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02712">from thence to Hukkok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">to Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">on the south side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">to Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the west side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and to Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">upon Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04013">And the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06661">Ziddim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06863">Zer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02575">and Hammath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07557">Rakkath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03672">and Chinnereth</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0128">And Adamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07414">and Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02674">and Hazor</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06943">And Kedesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0154">and Edrei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05877">and En–hazor</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03375">And Iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04027">and Migdal–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02765">Horem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01043">and Beth–anath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01053">and Beth–shemesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08672">nineteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:39
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:40
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">for the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06881">was Zorah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0847">and Eshtaol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05905">and Ir–shemesh</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08169">And Shaalabbin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0357">and Ajalon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03494">and Jethlah</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0356">And Elon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08553">and Thimnathah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">and Ekron</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0514">And Eltekeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01405">and Gibbethon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01191">and Baalath</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03055">And Jehud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01139">and Bene–berak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01667">and Gath–rimmon</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 19:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04313">And Me–jarkon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07542">and Rakkon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">with the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03305">Japho</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>before</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">over against</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Japho</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Joppa</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 19:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <transChange type="added">too little</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for them: therefore the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03959">against Leshem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03959">Leshem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">after the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:48
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">with their villages</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 19:49
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">When they had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of dividing the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">by their coasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">to Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them:

verses.name: Joshua 19:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">According to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he asked</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08556">Timnath–serah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> therein.

verses.name: Joshua 19:51
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">which Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">divided for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So they made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of dividing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen240" osisID="Josh.19"/>

verses.name: Joshua 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Appoint out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">for you cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whereof I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto you by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that killeth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">unawares</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">unwittingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">thither: and they shall be your refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from the avenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when he that doth flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of those cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of that city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">him a place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he may dwell</w> among them.

verses.name: Joshua 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And if the avenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, then they shall not deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">up into his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847 strong:H01097">unwittingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H08543">him not beforetime</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in that city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for judgment</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">until the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shall be in those days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">then shall the slayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto his own city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and unto his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from whence he fled</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 20:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06943">Kedesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01551">in Galilee</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07927">and Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07153">and Kirjath–arba</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appointed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sanctified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05676">And on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">by Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they assigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01221">Bezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">upon the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07216">and Ramoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01474">and Golan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">These were the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04152">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and for the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sojourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">them, that whosoever killeth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H07684">at unawares</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither, and not die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the avenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen241" osisID="Josh.20"/>

verses.name: Joshua 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">unto Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">and unto Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and unto the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">unto them at Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">us cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04054">with the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">thereof for our cattle</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">out of their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">and their suburbs</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01486">And the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">for the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01486">had by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08099">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">out of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and out of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">out of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and out of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w> which are <transChange type="added">here</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mentioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>mentioned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>, <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223 strong:H07223" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">had: for theirs was the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">them the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07153 strong:H0704" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Arba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>, which <transChange type="added">city is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the hill</w> <transChange type="added">country</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04054">with the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>the city…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Kirjath–arba</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">But the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">and the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">they to Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">for his possession</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the slayer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03841">and Libnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03492">And Jattir</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0851">and Eshtemoa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02473">And Holon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01688">and Debir</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Holon</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Hilen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05871">And Ain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03194">and Juttah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01053">Beth–shemesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">out of those two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ain</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ashan</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01391">Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01387">Geba</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Geba</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Gaba</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06068">Anathoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05960">and Almon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Almon</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Alemeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">All the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04940">And the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">even they had the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">of their lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">them Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the slayer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01507">and Gezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06911">And Kibzaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01032">and Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0514">Eltekeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01405">Gibbethon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0357">Aijalon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01667">Gath–rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04276">And out of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08590">Tanach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01667">and Gath–rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">All the cities</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">for the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remained</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01648">of Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, out of the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">they gave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01474">Golan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the slayer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01203">and Beesh–terah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07191">Kishon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01705">Dabareh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03412">Jarmuth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05873">En–gannim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04861">Mishal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05658">Abdon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02520">Helkath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07340">and Rehob</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06943">Kedesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01551">in Galilee</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the slayer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02576">and Hammoth–dor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07178">and Kartan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">All the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">of the Gershonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">according to their families</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04940">And unto the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03362">Jokneam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07177">and Kartah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01829">Dimnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05096">Nahalal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07205">And out of the tribe of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01221">Bezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03096">with her suburbs, and Jahazah</w> with her suburbs,

verses.name: Joshua 21:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06932">Kedemoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04158">with her suburbs, and Mephaath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">with her suburbs; four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07433">Ramoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the slayer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04266">and Mahanaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 21:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02809">Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03270">Jazer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> in all.

verses.name: Joshua 21:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">So all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which were remaining</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, were <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">their lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">All the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">These cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H05892">were every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> them: thus <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all these cities</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:43
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and dwelt</w> therein.

verses.name: Joshua 21:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave them rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">according to all that he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them; the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into their hand</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 21:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">There failed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of any good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all came to pass</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen242" osisID="Josh.21"/>

verses.name: Joshua 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">Then Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">the Reubenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">and the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Ye have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">all that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, and have obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in all that I commanded</w> you:

verses.name: Joshua 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have not left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">these many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath given rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto your brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">them: therefore now return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">you unto your tents</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of your possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">you on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966">But take diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">and the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, to love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, and to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">him with all your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all your soul</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and sent them away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto their tents</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now to the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <transChange type="added">possession</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>: but unto the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">westward</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03091">And when Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sent them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">also unto their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">then he blessed</w> them,

verses.name: Joshua 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05233">riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto your tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and with very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and with brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and with iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and with very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">raiment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with your brethren</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">out of Shiloh</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of their possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">whereof they were possessed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01552">unto the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to see to</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Behold, the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01552">in the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05676">at the passage</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">at Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w> against them.

verses.name: Joshua 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and to the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06372">Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">And with him ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H0259">of each</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387 strong:H05387">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">throughout all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and each one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">an head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">among the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of the father</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and to the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with them, saying</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04604">What trespass</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this that ye have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in that ye have builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">you an altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye might rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: Joshua 22:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06465">of Peor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">too little</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">for us, from which we are not cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05063">although there was a plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,

verses.name: Joshua 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But that ye must turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? and it will be, <transChange type="added">seeing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">that to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will be wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">with the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0389">Notwithstanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">if the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of your possession</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">pass ye over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">of the possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherein the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelleth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and take possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us: but rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0408">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against us, in building</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">you an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05912">Did not Achan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">a trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">in the accursed thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07110">and wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">on all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0376">and that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">not alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in his iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Then the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">unto the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>,

verses.name: Joshua 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he knoweth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall know</w>; if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04777">in rebellion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04604">or if in transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">us not this day</w>,)

verses.name: Joshua 22:23
