verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That we have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">us an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">or if to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thereon burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">or meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">or if to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereon, let the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">himself require</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>;

verses.name: Joshua 22:24
verses.text: And if we have not <transChange type="added">rather</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01674">it for fear</w> of <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">In time to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto our children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">What have ye to do with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>In time…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">To morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">a border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">between us and you, ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02506">ye have no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">so shall your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-150">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">our children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-150">cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">fearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore we said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us now prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">us an altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">not for burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">nor for sacrifice</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 22:27
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">that</transChange> it <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">between us, and you, and our generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, that we might do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">him with our burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and with our sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08002">and with our peace offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">that your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may not say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to our children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">in time to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">Ye have no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore said</w> we, that it shall be, when they should <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to us or to our generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">in time to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we may say</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">which our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">not for burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">nor for sacrifices</w>; but it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">a witness</w> between us and you.

verses.name: Joshua 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02486">God forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that we should rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">for meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">or for sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">beside the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">his tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06372">And when Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">and heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it pleased</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was good in their eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06372">And Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we perceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, because ye have not committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">this trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0227">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>now</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">then</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 22:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06372">And Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-151">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-151">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">them word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did not intend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">against them in battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">wherein the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">and Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelt</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 22:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <transChange type="added">Ed</transChange>: for it <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">between us that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ed</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A witness</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen243" osisID="Josh.22"/>

verses.name: Joshua 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And it came to pass a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had given rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from all their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">that Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waxed old</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in age</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stricken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">come into days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02205">for their elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and for their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and for their judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and for their officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, I am old</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in age</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto all these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of you; for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he that hath fought</w> for you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto you by lot these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">to be an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">for your tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03383">from Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">with all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I have cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">even unto the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H03996">westward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>westward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the sunset</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall expel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you, and drive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them from out of your sight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath promised</w> unto you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966">Be ye therefore very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">courageous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">all that is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye turn</w> not aside therefrom <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w> or <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">the left</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">not among these nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">these that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">among you; neither make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor cause to swear</w> <transChange type="added">by them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them, nor bow</w> yourselves unto them:

verses.name: Joshua 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>But cleave…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">For if ye will cleave</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath driven out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">you great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">and strong</w>: but <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">you, no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath been able to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>For the <divineName>Lord</divineName>…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName> will drive</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of you shall chase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, he <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that fighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for you, as he hath promised</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966">Take good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">therefore unto yourselves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that ye love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yourselves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">your souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Else if ye do in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">unto the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of these nations</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">these that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">among you, and shall make marriages</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with them, and go in</w> unto them, and they to you:

verses.name: Joshua 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for a certainty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">drive out</w> <transChange type="added">any of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">you; but they shall be snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">and traps</w> <w lemma="strong:H07850">unto you, and scourges</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">in your sides</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06796">and thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until ye perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">from off this good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And, behold, this day</w> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in all your hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and in all your souls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">that not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath failed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of all the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">concerning you; all are come to pass</w> unto you, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath failed</w> thereof.

verses.name: Joshua 23:15
verses.text: Therefore it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">as all good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon you, which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">you; so shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">upon you all evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">until he have destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">you from off this good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When ye have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and have gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">yourselves to them; then shall the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against you, and ye shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">from off the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath given</w> unto you. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen244" osisID="Josh.23"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">for the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and for their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and for their judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and for their officers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">themselves before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">in old time</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08646">Terah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05152">of Nachor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your father</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">from the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the flood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and led</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">his seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">him Isaac</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">and Esau</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">unto Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">it; but Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">also and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I plagued</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">according to that which</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">them: and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I brought you out</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04714">and the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">with chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">unto the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03990">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">between you and the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon them, and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">them; and your eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">season</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you: and I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye might possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them from before</w> you.

verses.name: Joshua 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01111">Then Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06834">of Zippor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and warred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to curse</w> you:

verses.name: Joshua 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">unto Balaam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you still</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so I delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of his hand</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">unto Jericho</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01167">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">against you, the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">and the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01622">and the Girgashites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into your hand</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06880">the hornet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">you, which drave them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> you, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">not with thy sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">nor with thy bow</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for which ye did not labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, and ye dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">in them; of the vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">and oliveyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not do ye eat</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">him in sincerity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and in truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the flood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and in Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And if it seem evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04310">unto you</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye will serve</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">whether the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">served</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">of the flood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">or the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in whose land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye dwell</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">but as for me and my house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">God forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that we should forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>;

verses.name: Joshua 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, he <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that brought us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">and our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and which did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">those great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in our sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">us in all the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein we went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and among all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom we passed</w>:

verses.name: Joshua 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">drave out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">us all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">even the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>: <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we also serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>; he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07072">a jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will not forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">your transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">nor your sins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy God</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holy Gods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If ye forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he will turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and do you hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">you, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he hath done you good</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Nay; but we will serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against yourselves that ye have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">you the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him. And they said</w>, <transChange type="added">We are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Now therefore put away</w>, <transChange type="added">said he</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05236">the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">you, and incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">unto Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we serve</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we obey</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">them a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">in Shechem</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0427">there under an oak</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04720">by the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">Behold, this stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">shall be a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us; for it hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">unto us: it shall be therefore a witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto you, lest ye deny</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">So Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">unto his inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">that Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">him in the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08556">in Timnath–serah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01608">of Gaash</w>.

verses.name: Joshua 24:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03117 strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that overlived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and which had known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overlived…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prolonged their days after Joshua</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 24:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06106">And the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">they in Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02513">in a parcel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">which Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">of Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">for an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07192">pieces of silver</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05159">and it became the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pieces…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lambs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Joshua 24:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0499">And Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">him in a hill</w> <transChange type="added">that pertained to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06372">Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">him in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen245" osisID="Josh.24"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen221" osisID="Josh" type="book"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it came to pass, that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">for us against the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> against them?

verses.name: Judges 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">unto Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">with me into my lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that we may fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">against the Canaanites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I likewise will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">with thee into thy lot</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08095">So Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> with him.

verses.name: Judges 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into their hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0966">of them in Bezek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0137">Adoni–bezek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0966">in Bezek</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against him, and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0137">But Adoni–bezek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H0931">his thumbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and his great toes</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0137">And Adoni–bezek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">Threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H0931">having their thumbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and their great toes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">gathered</w> <transChange type="added">their meat</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07979">under my table</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I have done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">so God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath requited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me. And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">him to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there he died</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their thumbs…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the thumbs of their hands and of their feet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>gathered</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gleaned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">had fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">against the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and in the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">and in the valley</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>valley</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">low country</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">against the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H08034">now the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07153">Kirjath–arba</w>:) <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08344">Sheshai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0289">and Ahiman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08526">and Talmai</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And from thence he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">of Debir</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01688">of Debir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07158">Kirjath–sepher</w>:

verses.name: Judges 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03612">And Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He that smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07158">Kirjath–sepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, to him will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05915">Achsah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06274">And Othniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">of Kenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it: and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05915">him Achsah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when she came</w> <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that she moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06795" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she lighted</w> from off <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02543">ass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03612">and Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto her, What wilt thou?

verses.name: Judges 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">me a blessing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">me a south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">me also springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03612">And Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05942">her the upper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">and the nether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">springs</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">of the Kenite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05899 strong:H08558" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of palm trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, which <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">in the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H06166">of Arad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">with Simeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06857">Zephath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">it. And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02767">Hormah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Also Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">Gaza</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">with the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0831">thereof, and Askelon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">with the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">thereof, and Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">with the coast</w> thereof.

verses.name: Judges 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">was with Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he drave out</w> <transChange type="added">the inhabitants of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03808">but could not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">because they had chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drave…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">possessed the mountain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">unto Caleb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he expelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thence the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06061">of Anak</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did not drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02983">but the Jebusites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they also went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">against Beth–el</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with them.

verses.name: Judges 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sent to descry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>. (<w lemma="strong:H08034">Now the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03870">Luz</w>.)

verses.name: Judges 1:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the spies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto him, Shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">us, we pray thee, the entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thee mercy</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when he shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">them the entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but they let go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">and all his family</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">of the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03870">thereof Luz</w>: which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thereof unto this day</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04519">Neither did Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive out</w> <transChange type="added">the inhabitants of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01052">Beth–shean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08590">nor Taanach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01756">of Dor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02991">of Ibleam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">of Megiddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03669">but the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in that land</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And it came to pass, when Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">to tribute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and did not utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive them out</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0669">Neither did Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">in Gezer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03669">but the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">in Gezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 1:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02074">Neither did Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07003">of Kitron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05096">of Nahalol</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03669">but the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">them, and became tributaries</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0836">Neither did Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05910">of Accho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">of Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0303">nor of Ahlab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0392">nor of Achzib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02462">nor of Helbah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0663">nor of Aphik</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07340">nor of Rehob</w>:

verses.name: Judges 1:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0843">But the Asherites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for they did not drive them out</w>.

verses.name: Judges 1:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05321">Neither did Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01043">of Beth–anath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nevertheless the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01043">and of Beth–anath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">became tributaries</w> unto them.

verses.name: Judges 1:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0567">And the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the mountain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they would not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them to come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">to the valley</w>:

verses.name: Judges 1:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0567">But the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02776">Heres</w> <w lemma="strong:H0357">in Aijalon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08169">and in Shaalbim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">yet the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04522">so that they became tributaries</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prevailed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was heavy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 1:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01366">And the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04608">from the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04610">to Akrabbim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05553">from the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the going…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Maaleh–acrabbim</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen247" osisID="Judg.1"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">from Gilgal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01066">to Bochim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I made you to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto your fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">I will never</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> with you.<note type="study"><catchWord>angel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">messenger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And ye shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">no league</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of this land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall throw down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">their altars</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">why have ye done</w> this?

verses.name: Judges 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore I also said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will not drive them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> you; but they shall be <transChange type="added">as thorns</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06654">in your sides</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and their gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">shall be a snare</w> unto you.

verses.name: Judges 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And it came to pass, when the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01066">Bochim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">there unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Bochim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Weepers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 2:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03091">And when Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">had let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">unto his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03117 strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that outlived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>outlived</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prolonged days after</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03091">And Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">him in the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of his inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08556">in Timnath–heres</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01608">Gaash</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Timnath–heres</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Timnath–serah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01755">And also all that generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, which knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">nor yet the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w>:

verses.name: Judges 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them, and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">themselves unto them, and provoked the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to anger</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06252">and Ashtaroth</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of spoilers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08155" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and he sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">not any longer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Whithersoever they went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">was against them for evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">had sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">unto them: and they were greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">distressed</w>.

verses.name: Judges 2:16
