verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Nevertheless the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of those that spoiled</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>delivered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saved</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And yet they would not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto their judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they went a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">themselves unto them: they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">obeying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they did</w> not so.

verses.name: Judges 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">raised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them up judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was with the judge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the judge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">for it repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H05009">of their groanings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">by reason of them that oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01766" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them and vexed</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And it came to pass, when the judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">was dead</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and corrupted</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">more than their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in following</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">them, and to bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto them; they ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">not from their own doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07186">nor from their stubborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>corrupted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">were corrupt</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>ceased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let nothing fall of their</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 2:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">Because that this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto my voice</w>;

verses.name: Judges 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I also will not henceforth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">them of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">which Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he died</w>:

verses.name: Judges 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">That through them I may prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whether they will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">therein, as their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did keep</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, or not.

verses.name: Judges 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">those nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">driving them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">hastily</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">he them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>left</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">suffered</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen248" osisID="Judg.2"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> by them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> as many <transChange type="added">of Israel</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as had not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">all the wars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>;

verses.name: Judges 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07535">Only that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">them war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the least such as before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> nothing thereof;

verses.name: Judges 3:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and all the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06722">and the Sidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01179">Baal–hermon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And they were to prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by them, to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whether they would hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and Jebusites</w>:

verses.name: Judges 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to be their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forgat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">and the groves</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0639">Therefore the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03573">of Chushan–rishathaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0763">of Mesopotamia</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03573">Chushan–rishathaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Mesopotamia</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Aram–naharaim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a deliverer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who delivered</w> them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06274">Othniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">of Kenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deliverer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saviour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came upon him, and he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03573">Chushan–rishathaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0763">of Mesopotamia</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03573">against Chushan–rishathaim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Mesopotamia</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Aram</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06274">And Othniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">of Kenaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">Eglon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto him the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">and Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05899 strong:H08558" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of palm trees</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">So the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">Eglon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">raised them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a deliverer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0164">Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01617">of Gera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">a Benjamite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225 strong:H0334">lefthanded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">and by him</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">unto Eglon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a Benjamite</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the son of Jemini</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lefthanded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut of his right hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0164">But Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">him a dagger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">which had two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06366">edges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01574">of a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">length</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">it under his raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">upon his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the present</w> <w lemma="strong:H05700">unto Eglon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05700">and Eglon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And when he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he sent away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the present</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he himself turned again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">from the quarries</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01537">by Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05643">I have a secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">errand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto thee, O king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02013" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Keep silence</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And all that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by him went out</w> from him.<note type="study"><catchWord>quarries</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">graven images</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0164">And Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him; and he was sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04747">in a summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">parlour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0164">which he had for himself alone. And Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">I have a message</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee. And he arose</w> out of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03678">seat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a summer…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a parlour of cooling</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0164">And Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">his left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the dagger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">from his right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">it into his belly</w>:

verses.name: Judges 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05325">And the haft</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03851">the blade</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">closed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03851">the blade</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that he could not draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the dagger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">out of his belly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06574">and the dirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the dirt…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it came out at the buttocks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0164">Then Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04528">through the porch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">of the parlour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him, and locked</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When he was gone out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">that, behold, the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">of the parlour</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">locked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Surely he covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04747">in his summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">chamber</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>covereth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">doeth his easement</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till they were ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, he opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">not the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">of the parlour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04668">a key</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and opened</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0113">and, behold, their lord</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0164">And Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8699">while they tarried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passed beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">the quarries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08167">unto Seirath</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when he was come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">a trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">with him from the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and he before</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 3:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into your hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">the fords</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">toward Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pass over</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">about ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08082">all lusty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and all men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not a man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lusty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 3:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">So Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Judges 3:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08044">him was Shamgar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06067">of Anath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">with an ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H04451">goad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he also delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen249" osisID="Judg.3"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0164">when Ehud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02985">of Jabin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">in Hazor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of whose host</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02800">in Harosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08672">for he had nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02394">he mightily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01683">And Deborah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05031">a prophetess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03941">of Lapidoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And she dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08560">under the palm tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01683">of Deborah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">between Ramah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">and Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">to her for judgment</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01301">Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H042">of Abinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06943">out of Kedesh–naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, Hath not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">toward mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">Tabor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">with thee ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>?

verses.name: Judges 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto thee to the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07028">Kishon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02985">of Jabin’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">with his chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">and his multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01301">And Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, If thou wilt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me, then I will go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but if thou wilt not go</w> with me, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not go</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">with thee: notwithstanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou takest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">shall not be for thine honour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01683">And Deborah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01301">with Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06943">to Kedesh</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01301">And Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">and Naphtali</w> <w lemma="strong:H06943">to Kedesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">with ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">at his feet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01683">and Deborah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> with him.

verses.name: Judges 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02268">Now Heber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">the Kenite</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02246">of Hobab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">had severed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">himself from the Kenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">his tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0436">unto the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06815">of Zaanaim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06943">by Kedesh</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H01301">that Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H042">of Abinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">Tabor</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05516">And Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">all his chariots</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02800">with him, from Harosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07028">of Kishon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>together</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by cry</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">proclamation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01683">And Deborah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01301">unto Barak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Up</w>; for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">is not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01301">thee? So Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">Tabor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him.

verses.name: Judges 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">discomfited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w>, and all <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, and all <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04264">host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01301">Barak</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05516">so that Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lighted down</w> off <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on his feet</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01301">But Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">and after the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02800">unto Harosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the Gentiles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04264">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">of Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">there was not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto one</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05516">Howbeit Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03278">of Jael</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02268">of Heber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">the Kenite</w>: for <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02985">between Jabin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">of Hazor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02268">of Heber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">the Kenite</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03278">And Jael</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Turn in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me; fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not. And when he had turned in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto her into the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">she covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08063">him with a mantle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mantle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rug</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">blanket</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I am thirsty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04997">a bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">of milk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and gave him drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> him.

verses.name: Judges 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Stand in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and it shall be, when any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee, and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426" type="x-split-152">Is there</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426" type="x-split-152">here</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shalt say</w>, No.

verses.name: Judges 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03278">Then Jael</w> <w lemma="strong:H02268">Heber’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">a nail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04718">an hammer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in her hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03814">softly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">the nail</w> <w lemma="strong:H07541">into his temples</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06795" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">it into the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07290" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he was fast asleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and weary</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he died</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and took</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and put</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01301">And, behold, as Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03278">Jael</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">whom thou seekest</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he came</w> into her <transChange type="added">tent</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05516">behold, Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03489">and the nail</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07541">in his temples</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">So God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02985">Jabin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8799">prospered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07186">and prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02985">against Jabin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until they had destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02985">Jabin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prospered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">going went and was hard</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen250" osisID="Judg.4"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then sang</w> <w lemma="strong:H01683">Deborah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01301">and Barak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H042">of Abinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Judges 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06546 strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for the avenging</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">willingly offered</w> themselves.

verses.name: Judges 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O ye kings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07336" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O ye princes</w>; I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I, will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will sing</w> <transChange type="added">praise</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou wentest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou marchedst out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trembled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dropped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05645">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also dropped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05514">that Sinai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>melted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flowed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08044">of Shamgar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06067">of Anath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03278">of Jael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0734">the highways</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were unoccupied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the travellers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410 strong:H06128">through byways</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>travellers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walkers of paths</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>byways</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">crooked ways</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The inhabitants of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06520">the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01683">until that I Deborah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">a mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>; then <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03901">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04043">was there a shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">or spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">among forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>?

verses.name: Judges 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">toward the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that offered themselves willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye that ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H06715">on white</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye that sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Speak</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Meditate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They that are delivered</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">from the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02686" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of archers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04857">in the places of drawing water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08567" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">there shall they rehearse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">the righteous acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06666">the righteous acts</w> <transChange type="added">toward the inhabitants</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06520">of his villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">then shall the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to the gates</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>righteous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousnesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01683">Deborah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">a song</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01301">Barak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">and lead thy captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H042">of Abinoam</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08300">Then he made him that remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">over the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made me have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">over the mighty</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">Out of Ephraim</w> <transChange type="added">was there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08328">a root</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of them against Amalek</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">thee, Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">among thy people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04353">out of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">governors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">and out of Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that handle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the pen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the writer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>handle</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">draw with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01683">with Deborah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03485">even Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01301">and also Barak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">he was sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">into the valley</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06390">For the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02711">thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>foot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his feet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>thoughts</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">impressions</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>For</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">In</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why abodest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">thou among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04942">the sheepfolds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08292">the bleatings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">of the flocks</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06390">For the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02714">searchings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>For</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">In</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01835">and why did Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">in ships</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0836">Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02348">shore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H04664">in his breaches</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shore</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">port</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>breaches</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">creeks</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02074">Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">and Naphtali</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">jeoparded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">in the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>jeoparded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">exposed to reproach</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">then fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08590">in Taanach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">by the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">of Megiddo</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">no gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of money</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">They fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03556">the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">in their courses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">against Sisera</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>courses</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">paths</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05158">The river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07028">of Kishon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01640" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">swept them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06917">that ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H07028">Kishon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast trodden down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483 strong:H06119">Then were the horsehoofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01726">by the means of the pransings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01726">the pransings</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">of their mighty ones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pransings</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tramplings</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">plungings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04789">ye Meroz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ye bitterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; because they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">not to the help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05833">to the help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">against the mighty</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">Blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">above women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03278">shall Jael</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02268">of Heber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">the Kenite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be, blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">shall she be above women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tent</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she gave</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02461">milk</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">she brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02529">butter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">in a lordly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05602">dish</w>.

verses.name: Judges 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">to the nail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and her right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06001">to the workmen’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01989">hammer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and with the hammer she smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04277" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she smote off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when she had pierced</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stricken through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07541">his temples</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">she hammered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">At her feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he bowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he fell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he lay down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07272">at her feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he bowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he fell</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0834">where</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he bowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there he fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">dead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>At</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Between</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>dead</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">destroyed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0517">The mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">of Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">out at a window</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0822">through the lattice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">Why is his chariot</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">long</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in coming</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">why tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">the wheels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">of his chariots</w>?

verses.name: Judges 5:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">Her wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08282">ladies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">her, yea, she returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">answer</w> to herself,<note type="study"><catchWord>answer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">her words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Have they not sped</w>? have they <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the prey</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">to every</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">a damsel</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07361">two</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05516">to Sisera</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06648">of divers colours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06648">of divers colours</w> <w lemma="strong:H07553">of needlework</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06648">of divers colours</w> <w lemma="strong:H07553">of needlework on both sides</w>, <transChange type="added">meet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06677">for the necks</w> of <transChange type="added">them that take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the head of a man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 5:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">So let all thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: but <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that love</w> him <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08121">as the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">in his might</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen251" osisID="Judg.5"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04492">them the dens</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04631">and caves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04679">and strong holds</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prevailed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:3
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">it was, when Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04080">that the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06002">and the Amalekites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even they came up</w> against them;

verses.name: Judges 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against them, and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till thou come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">unto Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04241">no sustenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">neither sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">nor ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">nor ass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sheep</catchWord>: or <rdg type="alternate">goat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">with their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">and their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">grasshoppers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01581">both they and their camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">were without number</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> it.

verses.name: Judges 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">impoverished</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of the Midianites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And it came to pass, when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0182">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of the Midianites</w>,

verses.name: Judges 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030 strong:H0376">a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I brought you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought you forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of bondage</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>a prophet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man a prophet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of all that oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">you, and drave them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you, and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">you their land</w>;

verses.name: Judges 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> unto you, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in whose land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye dwell</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">under an oak</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06084">in Ophrah</w>, that <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03101">unto Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H033">the Abi–ezrite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02251" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">threshed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01660">by the winepress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to hide</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">the Midianites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gideon</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Gedeon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to hide…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to cause it to flee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">with thee, thou mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">man of valour</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0994">unto him, Oh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be with us, why then is all this befallen</w> us? and where <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all his miracles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us of, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Did not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">but now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">us into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of the Midianites</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in this thy might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou shalt save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of the Midianites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not I sent</w> thee?

verses.name: Judges 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0994">unto him, Oh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">my Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">wherewith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall I save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0505 strong:H0504" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">behold, my family</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01800">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">in Manasseh</w>, and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06810">the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my family…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my thousand is the meanest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, If now I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">me a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that thou talkest</w> with me.

verses.name: Judges 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hence, I pray thee, until I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto thee, and bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">my present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until thou come again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">meat offering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423 strong:H05795">a kid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04682">and unleavened cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">of an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">of flour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05536">in a basket</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04839">the broth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06517">in a pot</w>, and brought <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">unto him under the oak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and presented</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a kid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a kid of the goats</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:20
