verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">and the unleavened cakes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and lay</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01975">upon this</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04839">the broth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> so.

verses.name: Judges 6:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">Then the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">of the staff</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">and the unleavened cakes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">out of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">and the unleavened cakes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04397">Then the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">out of his sight</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And when Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceived</w> that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01439">Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0162">Alas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>! <w lemma="strong:H03651">for because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to face</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">unto him, Peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not: thou shalt not die</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">Then Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">there unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03073">it Jehovah–shalom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w> it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06084">yet in Ophrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H033">of the Abi–ezrites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehovah–shalom</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The <divineName>Lord</divineName> send peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915">And it came to pass the same night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">even the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and throw down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath, and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the grove</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> by it:<note type="study"><catchWord>even</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">of this rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04634">in the ordered place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">with the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">of the grove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which thou shalt cut down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rock</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in the ordered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in an orderly manner</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">Then Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w> unto him: and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it was, because he feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he could not do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he did</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And when the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">arose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">behold, the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0842">and the grove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was cut down</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">by it, and the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">built</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and asked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01439">Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Then the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">unto Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and because he hath cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the grove</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> by it.

verses.name: Judges 6:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">And Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto all that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, Will ye plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baal</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will ye save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him? he that will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">for him, let him be put to death</w> whilst <transChange type="added">it is yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w>: if he <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him plead</w> for himself, because <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">his altar</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">him Jerubbaal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01168">Let Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against him, because he hath thrown down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">his altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jerubbaal</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Let Baal plead</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jerubbesheth</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Let the shameful thing plead</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04080">Then all the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">and the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">But the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">upon Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">a trumpet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H044">and Abi–ezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">clothed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>gathered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">throughout all Manasseh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">who also was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: and he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">unto Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">and unto Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05321">and unto Naphtali</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>gathered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 6:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">If thou wilt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou hast said</w>,

verses.name: Judges 6:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01492">a fleece</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">of wool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in the floor</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02919">if the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01492">be on the fleece</w> only, and <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02721">dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon all the earth</w> <transChange type="added">beside</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that thou wilt save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou hast said</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And it was so: for he rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02115" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-153">and thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01492">the fleece</w> <w lemma="strong:H02115" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-153">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04680" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wringed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01492">out of the fleece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05602">a bowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">Let not thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">against me, and I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">but this once</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let me prove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">I pray thee, but this once</w> <w lemma="strong:H01492">with the fleece</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02721">let it now be dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01492">only upon the fleece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and upon all the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">let there be dew</w>.

verses.name: Judges 6:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">so that night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02721">for it was dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01492">upon the fleece</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">only, and there was dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on all the ground</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen252" osisID="Judg.6"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03378">Then Jerubbaal</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01439">Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with him, rose up early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05878">beside the well of Harod</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04264">so that the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">were on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">of them, by the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04176">of Moreh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">unto Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with thee <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">too many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for me to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">lest Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">vaunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves against me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">Mine own hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath saved</w> me.

verses.name: Judges 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04994">Now therefore go to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, Whosoever <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">fearful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02730">and afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06852" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and depart early</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">unto Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> yet <transChange type="added">too</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bring them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">unto the water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will try</w> them for thee there: and it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of whom I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, This shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, the same shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee; and of whomsoever I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, This shall not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, the same shall not go</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So he brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">unto the water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">unto Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03952" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Every one that lappeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">with his tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03611">as a dog</w> <w lemma="strong:H03952" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lappeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him shalt thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by himself; likewise every one that boweth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">upon his knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">And the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03952" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of them that lapped</w>, <transChange type="added">putting</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">were three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03499">but all the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">upon their knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">unto Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">By the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03952" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that lapped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>: and let all the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto his place</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">victuals</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07782">and their trumpets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">all</w> <transChange type="added">the rest of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto his tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and retained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">those three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04264">and the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">was beneath him in the valley</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915">And it came to pass the same night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the host</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03373">But if thou fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-154">to go down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-154">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06513">thou with Phurah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the host</w>:

verses.name: Judges 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">what they say</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">shall thine hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the host</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went he down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06513">with Phurah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the outside</w> <w lemma="strong:H02571">of the armed men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the host</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>armed men</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ranks by five</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04080">And the Midianites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">and the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">along in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">like grasshoppers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01581">and their camels</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">without number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And when Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his fellow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I dreamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06742 strong:H06742" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and, lo, a cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">tumbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto a tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it that it fell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04605 strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and overturned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">it, that the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lay along</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07453">And his fellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">nothing else save the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">of Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">hath God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">and all the host</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01439">when Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the telling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">of the dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07667">and the interpretation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thereof, that he worshipped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into your hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>interpretation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breaking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">companies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">a trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in every man’s hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07386">with empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">pitchers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03940">and lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">the pitchers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a trumpet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">trumpets in the hand of all of them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lamps</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">firebrands</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">torches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on me, and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">likewise: and, behold, when I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the outside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>, it shall be <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as I do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall ye do</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with a trumpet</w>, I and all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me, then blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">ye the trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">also on every side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of all the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <transChange type="added">The sword</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01439">and of Gideon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">So Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and the hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the outside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08484">of the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0821">watch</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0389">and they had but</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">newly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the watch</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">the pitchers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hands</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">companies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">the pitchers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and held</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">in their left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07782">and the trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">in their right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to blow</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">The sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01439">and of Gideon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">in his place round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the camp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04264">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127 strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his fellow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">even throughout all the host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04264">and the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01029">to Beth–shittah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06888">in Zererath</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">to the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H065">of Abel–meholah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02888">unto Tabbath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>border</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">out of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0836">and out of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">and out of all Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">the Midianites</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">throughout all mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">the Midianites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">before them the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01012">unto Beth–barah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">and Jordan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">Then all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01012">unto Beth–barah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">and Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Judges 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of the Midianites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06159">Oreb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02062">and Zeeb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06159">Oreb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">upon the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06159">Oreb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02062">and Zeeb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03342">at the winepress</w> <w lemma="strong:H02062">of Zeeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H06159">of Oreb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02062">and Zeeb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">to Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen253" osisID="Judg.7"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">unto him, Why hast thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">us thus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou calledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us not, when thou wentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">with the Midianites</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they did chide</w> <w lemma="strong:H02394">with him sharply</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Why…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What thing is this thou hast done unto us</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sharply</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strongly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, What have I done</w> now in comparison of you? <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05955">not the gleaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of the grapes of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01210">than the vintage</w> <w lemma="strong:H044">of Abi–ezer</w>?

verses.name: Judges 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06159">Oreb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02062">and Zeeb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and what was I able</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in comparison of you? Then their anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was abated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">toward him, when he had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>anger</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spirit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">to Jordan</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">he, and the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">with him, faint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">yet pursuing</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Judges 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03603">I pray you, loaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">that follow</w> me; for they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">faint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and I am pursuing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02078">Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08269">And the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02078">of Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">now in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we should give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">unto thine army</w>?

verses.name: Judges 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02078">Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will tear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">your flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06975">with the thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01303">and with briers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thresh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06439">thence to Penuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">unto them likewise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06439">of Penuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">him as the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had answered</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.

verses.name: Judges 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">also unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06439">of Penuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">this tower</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02078">Now Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07174">in Karkor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">and their hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">with them, about fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all that were left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of all the hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>men that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every one drawing a sword</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of them that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">on the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H05025">of Nobah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03011">and Jogbehah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04264">for the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">was secure</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02078">And when Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02078">Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and discomfited</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">all the host</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discomfited</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">terrified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">from battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02775">the sun</w> <transChange type="added">was up</transChange>,

verses.name: Judges 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of him: and he described</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto him the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651 strong:H07657">threescore and seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>described</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">writ</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02078">Behold Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with whom ye did upbraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, saying</w>, <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02078">of Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">now in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we should give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto thy men</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03287">weary</w>?

verses.name: Judges 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06975">and thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01303">and briers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and with them he taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>taught</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made to know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he beat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H06439">of Penuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02078">he unto Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0375">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">manner of men</w> <transChange type="added">were they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">at Tabor</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03644">As thou</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange>, so <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">they; each one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08389">resembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of a king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>resembled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the form</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Judges 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, They <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of my mother</w>: <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye had saved them alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I would not slay</w> you.

verses.name: Judges 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03500">unto Jether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">them. But the youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">not his sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he feared</w>, because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">yet a youth</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02078">Then Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou, and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">upon us: for as the man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01369">his strength</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02078">Zebah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06759">and Zalmunna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07720">the ornaments</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01581">on their camels’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">necks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ornaments</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ornaments like the moon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">Then the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">unto Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou over us, both thou, and thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also: for thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, I will not rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">over you, neither shall my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">over you: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rule</w> over you.

verses.name: Judges 8:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, I would desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">a request</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">of you, that ye would give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">the earrings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of his prey</w>. (<w lemma="strong:H02091">For they had golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">earrings</w>, because they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03459">Ishmaelites</w>.)

verses.name: Judges 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">We will willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">a garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and did cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">therein every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">the earrings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of his prey</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04948">And the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">earrings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he requested</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">was a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07720">beside ornaments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05188">and collars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">raiment</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">on the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06060">and beside the chains</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01581">about their camels’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">necks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>collars</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sweet jewels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">an ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">it in his city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06084">in Ophrah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went thither a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">it: which thing became a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">unto Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to his house</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04080">Thus was Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so that they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">no more</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0776">And the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was in quietness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01439">of Gideon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03378">And Jerubbaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his own house</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">had threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">of his body</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">begotten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">for he had many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">going out of his thigh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06370">And his concubine</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07927">in Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she also bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>called</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 8:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01439">And Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">old age</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">in the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06084">in Ophrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H033">of the Abi–ezrites</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01439">And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01170">Baal–berith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their god</w>.

verses.name: Judges 8:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who had delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>:

verses.name: Judges 8:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Neither shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">they kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01439">Gideon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">according to all the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen254" osisID="Judg.8"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">unto his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">with them, and with all the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: Judges 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">I pray you, in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">of all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, Whether <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for you, either that all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w>, <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">over you, or that one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over you? remember</w> also that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">your bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and your flesh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Whether…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What is good? whether</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Judges 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">of him in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">of all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">and their hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">to follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to follow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">him threescore and ten</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01170">of Baal–berith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H040">wherewith Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06348" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">him</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06084">at Ophrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon one</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03147">notwithstanding yet Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">the youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was left</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he hid</w> himself.

verses.name: Judges 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01167">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01037 strong:H04407" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Millo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0436">by the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">of the pillar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07927">in Shechem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>plain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oak</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when they told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03147">to Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01630">Gerizim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">unto me, ye men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may hearken</w> unto you.

verses.name: Judges 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">The trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8804">went forth</w> <transChange type="added">on a time</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">over them; and they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">unto the olive tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Reign</w> thou over us.

verses.name: Judges 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02132">But the olive tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Should I leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">my fatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherewith by me they honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be promoted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">over the trees</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>go…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">go up and down for other trees</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">And the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">to the fig tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> thou, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">reign</w> over us.

verses.name: Judges 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08384">But the fig tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Should I forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04987">my sweetness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and my good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08570">fruit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be promoted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">over the trees</w>?

verses.name: Judges 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">unto the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> thou, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">reign</w> over us.

verses.name: Judges 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01612">And the vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Should I leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">my wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which cheereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be promoted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">over the trees</w>?

verses.name: Judges 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0329">unto the bramble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> thou, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">reign</w> over us.<note type="study"><catchWord>bramble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thistle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0329">And the bramble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">unto the trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">If in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">me king</w> over you, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put your trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">in my shadow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0784">and if not, let fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0329">of the bramble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">the cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now therefore, if ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">and sincerely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H040">in that ye have made Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and if ye have dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">with Jerubbaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">unto him according to the deserving</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>;

verses.name: Judges 9:17
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H01">For my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for you, and adventured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">far</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>adventured…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cast his life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye are risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">against my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon one</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H040">and have made Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of his maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">over the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, because he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brother</w>;)

verses.name: Judges 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If ye then have dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">and sincerely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">with Jerubbaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and with his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">ye in Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let him also rejoice</w> in you:

verses.name: Judges 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">But if not, let fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">from Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01037 strong:H04407" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Millo</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">and let fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">from the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01037 strong:H04407" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of Millo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03147">And Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0876">to Beer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">there, for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">of Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H040">When Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07786" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>,

verses.name: Judges 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Then God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">between Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01167">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dealt treacherously</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">with Abimelech</w>:

verses.name: Judges 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02555">That the cruelty</w> <transChange type="added">done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07657">to the threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">upon Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">them; and upon the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which aided</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him in the killing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brethren</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>aided…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengthened his hands to kill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01167">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">liers in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">for him in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">along that way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">by them: and it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01603">And Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05651">of Ebed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01167">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put their confidence</w> in him.

verses.name: Judges 9:27
