verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">their vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trode</w> <transChange type="added">the grapes</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01974">merry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>merry</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">songs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01603">And Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05651">of Ebed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>, and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we should serve</w> him? <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02083">and Zebul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06496">his officer</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02544">of Hamor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for why should we serve</w> him?

verses.name: Judges 9:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And would to God this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were under</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then would I remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">to Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">thine army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come out</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02083">And when Zebul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01603">of Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05651">of Ebed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kindled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">unto Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08649">privily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01603">Behold, Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05651">of Ebed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, they fortify</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>privily</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">craftily</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">to Tormah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with thee, and lie in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>:

verses.name: Judges 9:33
verses.text: And it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">as soon as the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt rise early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon the city</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">he and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, then mayest thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to them as thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt find occasion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as thou shalt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as thine hand shall find</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">with him, by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they laid wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">against Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">companies</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01603">And Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05651">of Ebed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H040">and Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03993">with him, from lying in wait</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01603">And when Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02083">to Zebul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-155">Behold, there come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-155">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02083">And Zebul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him, Thou seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w> as <transChange type="added">if they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01603">And Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-156">See there come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-156">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02872">by the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">company</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0436">along by the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">Meonenim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>middle</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">navel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Meonenim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the regarders of times</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02083">Zebul</w> unto him, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0645">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith thou saidst</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we should serve</w> him? <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not this the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast despised</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04994">I pray now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and fight</w> with them.

verses.name: Judges 9:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01603">And Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">with Abimelech</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">him, and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were overthrown</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">wounded</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0725">at Arumah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02083">and Zebul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thrust out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01603">Gaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">in Shechem</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">them into three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">companies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and, behold, the people</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against them, and smote</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 9:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the company</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him, rushed forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">companies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ran upon</w> all <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 9:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all that day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, and beat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">it with salt</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:46
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01167">And when all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">of the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06877">into an hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of the god</w> <w lemma="strong:H01286">Berith</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">that all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">of the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were gathered together</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gat him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06756">Zalmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">he and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H040">with him; and Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07134">an axe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07754">a bough</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">from the trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07926">on his shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him, What ye have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">make haste</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">as I</w> <transChange type="added">have done</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>me do</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I have done</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 9:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">likewise cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07754">his bough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06877">to the hold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06877">the hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">upon them; so that all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">of the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">also, about a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:50
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08405">to Thebez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08405">against Thebez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> it.

verses.name: Judges 9:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05797">But there was a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thither fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">and all they</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shut</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to them, and gat them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">of the tower</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H040">And Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">unto the tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against it, and went hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">of the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06400">a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of a millstone</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">upon Abimelech’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and all to brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">his skull</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">hastily</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his armourbearer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thy sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, that men say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">not of me, A woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">him. And his young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thrust him through</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">that Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto his place</w>.

verses.name: Judges 9:56
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">Thus God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rendered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">of Abimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in slaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">his seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brethren</w>:

verses.name: Judges 9:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">And all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">of Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">did God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">render</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and upon them came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">of Jerubbaal</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen255" osisID="Judg.9"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08439">Tola</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06312">of Puah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01734">of Dodo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08069">in Shamir</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>defend</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deliver</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">save</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08069">in Shamir</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02971">Jair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01569">a Gileadite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">And he had thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">on thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05895">ass colts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">and they had thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which are called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02334">Havoth–jair</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Havoth–jair</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the villages of Jair</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02971">And Jair</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07056">in Camon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06252">and Ashtaroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">of Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and served</w> not him.

verses.name: Judges 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">And that year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">and oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppressed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">crushed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Moreover the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">also against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and against Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">so that Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">distressed</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, both because we have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and also served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">Did</transChange> not <transChange type="added">I deliver you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and from the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and from the Philistines</w>?

verses.name: Judges 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06722">The Zidonians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">also, and the Amalekites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04584">and the Maonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did oppress</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you; and ye cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to me, and I delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of their hand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet ye have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">wherefore I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you no more</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye have chosen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01992">let them</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">you in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of your tribulation</w>.

verses.name: Judges 10:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thou unto us whatsoever seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto thee; deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">us only, we pray thee, this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seemeth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is good in thine eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">for the misery</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strange…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gods of strangers</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>grieved</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shortened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Then the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">assembled themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">in Mizpeh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gathered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cried</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">What man</w> <transChange type="added">is he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that will begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07218">he shall be head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen256" osisID="Judg.10"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">Now Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">was a mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181 strong:H0802" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of an harlot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01568">and Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">Jephthah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jephthah</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Jephthae</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>an harlot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a woman an harlot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01568">And Gilead’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grew up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they thrust out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Thou shalt not inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in our father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">of a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">Then Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02897">of Tob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and there were gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">to Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>from</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the face <transChange type="added">of</transChange></rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass in process of time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">made war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in process…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And it was so, that when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">made war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02897">of Tob</w>:

verses.name: Judges 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">unto Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07101">and be our captain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that we may fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Did not ye hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and expel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">me out of my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and why are ye come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me now when ye are in distress</w>?

verses.name: Judges 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">unto Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore we turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to thee now, that thou mayest go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with us, and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and be our head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">If ye bring me home again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">me, shall I be your head</w>?

verses.name: Judges 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">unto Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">be witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">between us, if we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not so according to thy words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>witness…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the hearer between us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">Then Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">with the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">him head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07101">and captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">over them: and Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">in Mizpeh</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">against me to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in my land</w>?

verses.name: Judges 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">of Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Because Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">my land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0769">from Arnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02999">even unto Jabbok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03383">and unto Jordan</w>: now therefore restore those <transChange type="added">lands</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peaceably</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>:

verses.name: Judges 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">nor the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>:

verses.name: Judges 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">But when Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">through the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">unto the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">to Kadesh</w>;

verses.name: Judges 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Then Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me, I pray thee, pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thy land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">but the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not hearken</w> <transChange type="added">thereto</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And in like manner they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he would</w> not <transChange type="added">consent</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">in Kadesh</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they went along</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">through the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">by the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">not within the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0769">for Arnon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">unto Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Let us pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">we pray thee, through thy land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">into</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">my place</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05511">But Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">not Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">through his coast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05511">but Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-157">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-157">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03096">in Jahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">them: so Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of that country</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0769">from Arnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02999">even unto Jabbok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">and from the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">even unto Jordan</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath dispossessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shouldest thou possess</w> it?

verses.name: Judges 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt not thou possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03645">that which Chemosh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy god</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">giveth thee to possess</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">So whomsoever the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, them will we possess</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:25
verses.text: And now <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thou any thing better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01111">than Balak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06834">of Zippor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did he ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">or did he ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fight</w> against them,

verses.name: Judges 11:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">While Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">in Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06177">and in Aroer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in all the cities</w> that <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">along by the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">of Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">why therefore did ye not recover</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">within that time</w>?

verses.name: Judges 11:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore I have not sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0853 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thee, but thou doest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me wrong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against me: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the Judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">between the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Howbeit the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not unto the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">of Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he sent</w> him.

verses.name: Judges 11:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07307">Then the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">came upon Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">Mizpeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04708">and from Mizpeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he passed over</w> <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If thou shalt without fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into mine hands</w>,

verses.name: Judges 11:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Then it shall be, that whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">of the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, when I return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">shall surely be the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will offer it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whatsoever…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that which cometh forth, which shall come forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">or I will offer it</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Judges 11:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03316">So Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against them; and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into his hands</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06177">them from Aroer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even till thou come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04511">to Minnith</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H058">and unto the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H064 strong:H03754" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of the vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thus the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the plain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Abel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and, behold, his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">him with timbrels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04246">and with dances</w>: and she <transChange type="added">was his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03173">only child</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">beside her he had neither son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0176">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>beside…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he had not of his own either son or daughter</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0162">Alas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast brought me</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">very low</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thou art one of them that trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: for I have opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go back</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto him, My father</w>, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">to me according to that which</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath proceeded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of thy mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for thee of thine enemies</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto her father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">Let this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">for me: let me alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bewail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">my virginity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07474 strong:H07464" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">I and my fellows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>go up…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go and go down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent her away</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07464">with her companions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bewailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01331">her virginity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>.

verses.name: Judges 11:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto her father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who did</w> with her <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05088">to his vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had vowed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and she knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02706">And it was a custom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>custom</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ordinance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 11:40
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">yearly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08567" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to lament</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">of Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in a year</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yearly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from year to year</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to lament</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to talk with</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen257" osisID="Judg.11"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">unto Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore passedst thou over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and didst not call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee? we will burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">upon thee with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gathered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto them, I and my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">at great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379 strong:H0376">strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you, ye delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me not out of their hands</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that ye delivered</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in my hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into my hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore then are ye come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto me this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> against me?

verses.name: Judges 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">Then Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">with Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01568">Ye Gileadites</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06412">fugitives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">the Ephraimites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">the Manassites</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01568">And the Gileadites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">the passages</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">before the Ephraimites</w>: and it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">that when those Ephraimites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06412">which were escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me go over</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">that the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0673">thou an Ephraimite</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he said</w>, Nay;

verses.name: Judges 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">they unto him, Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">now Shibboleth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05451">Sibboleth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-158">for he could not frame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to pronounce</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-158">right</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">him at the passages</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of the Ephraimites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03316">And Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then died</w> <w lemma="strong:H03316">Jephthah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> in <transChange type="added">one of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H078">him Ibzan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">And he had thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>, <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">in thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">from abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for his sons</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then died</w> <w lemma="strong:H078">Ibzan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">at Beth–lehem</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0356">him Elon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02075">a Zebulonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0356">And Elon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02075">the Zebulonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0357">in Aijalon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05658">him Abdon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01985">of Hillel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06553">a Pirathonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">And he had forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01121">nephews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">on threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05895">ass colts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>nephews</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons’ sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05658">And Abdon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01985">of Hillel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06553">the Pirathonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06552">in Pirathon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06003">of the Amalekites</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen258" osisID="Judg.12"/>

verses.name: Judges 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>did evil…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">added to commit</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Judges 13:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">And there was a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06881">of Zorah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01839">of the Danites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04495">Manoah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06135">barren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bare</w> not.

verses.name: Judges 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto her, Behold now, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06135">barren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bearest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: but thou shalt conceive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Now therefore beware</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">not wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">nor strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02931">not any unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>:

verses.name: Judges 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02030">For, lo, thou shalt conceive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04177">and no razor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on his head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">for the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">shall be a Nazarite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">from the womb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">Then the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">unto me, and his countenance</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04758">like the countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I asked</w> him not whence he <transChange type="added">was</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">he me his name</w>:

verses.name: Judges 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02030">unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07941">and now drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">no wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">any unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">for the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H05139">shall be a Nazarite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">from the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of his death</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04495">Then Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">my Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04994">let</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou didst send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto us, and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us what we shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that shall be born</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04495">of Manoah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04397">and the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as she sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04495">but Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> not with her.

verses.name: Judges 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, Behold, the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, that came</w> unto me the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:11
