verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04495">And Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thou the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>.

verses.name: Judges 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04495">And Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">Now let thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come to pass</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04941">How shall we order</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the child</w>, and <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">shall we do</w> unto him?<note type="study"><catchWord>How shall we order…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What shall be the manner of the</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>how shall we do…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">what shall he do?</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">what shall be his work?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04495">unto Manoah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Of all that I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let her beware</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She may not eat</w> of any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">of the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither let her drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">or strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">any unclean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">all that I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her let her observe</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04495">And Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, let us detain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, until we shall have made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795 strong:H01423">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>for thee</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04495">unto Manoah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though thou detain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, I will not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of thy bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0518">and if</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou wilt offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou must offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H04495">For Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> not that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04495">And Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that when thy sayings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we may do thee honour</w>?

verses.name: Judges 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Why askest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thou thus after my name</w>, seeing it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06383 strong:H06383" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">secret</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>secret</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wonderful</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04495">So Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795 strong:H01423">a kid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">with a meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and offered</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">upon a rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: and <transChange type="added">the angel</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">wondrously</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04495">and Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looked on</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03851">For it came to pass, when the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">from off the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">that the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ascended</w> <w lemma="strong:H03851">in the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04495">And Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looked on</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">But the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04495">to Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and to his wife</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04495">Then Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04495">And Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">We shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">But his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03863">unto him, If</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, he would not have received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and a meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at our hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither would he have shewed</w> us all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">nor would as at this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have told</w> us <transChange type="added">such things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02063">as these</w>.

verses.name: Judges 13:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> him.

verses.name: Judges 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H06470" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to move him at times</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06881">between Zorah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0847">and Eshtaol</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the camp…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Mahaneh–dan</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen259" osisID="Judg.13"/>

verses.name: Judges 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">to Timnath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">in Timnath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">in Timnath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now therefore get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">her for me to wife</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Then his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">never</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">among the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">or among all my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">Philistines</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her for me; for she pleaseth me well</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleaseth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is right in mine eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">But his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> not that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that he sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08385">an occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">against the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">for at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">had dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-159">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-159">down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08553">to Timnath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">to the vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">of Timnath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03715">and, behold, a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">roared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>against…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in meeting him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came mightily</w> <w lemma="strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon him, and he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him as he would have rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">a kid</w>, and <transChange type="added">he had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03972">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">not his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what he had done</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the woman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">well</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And after a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and he turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04658">the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of the lion</w>: and, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05712">a swarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01682">of bees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">in the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of the lion</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thereof in his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">eating</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they did eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not them that he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">the honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">out of the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of the lion</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01">So his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08123">and Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">there a feast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0970">for so used the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to do</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, that they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04828">companions</w> to be with him.

verses.name: Judges 14:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02330" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, I will now put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">a riddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto you: if ye can certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">it me within the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">of the feast</w>, and find <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">you thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05466">sheets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">change</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of garments</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>sheets</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shirts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">declare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, then shall ye give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">me thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05466">sheets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">change</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of garments</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02330" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">thy riddle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may hear</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>sheets</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shirts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them, Out of the eater</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05794">and out of the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweetness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">not in three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">expound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">the riddle</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And it came to pass on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">unto Samson’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Entice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thy husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he may declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">unto us the riddle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest we burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thee and thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ye called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us to take that we have</w>? <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> not <transChange type="added">so</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">possess us</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">impoverish us?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou dost but hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and lovest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02330" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me not: thou hast put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">a riddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hast not told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me. And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto her, Behold, I have not told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">nor my mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall I tell</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> thee?

verses.name: Judges 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">before him the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04960">while their feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lasted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07637">and it came to pass on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">her, because she lay sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon him: and she told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">the riddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of her people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the seven…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the rest of the seven days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">unto him on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02775">before the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweeter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">than honey</w>? and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05794">stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">than a lion</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03884">unto them, If</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye had not plowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697">with my heifer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye had not found out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">my riddle</w>.

verses.name: Judges 14:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0831">to Ashkelon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02488">their spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">change</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of garments unto them which expounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">the riddle</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0639">And his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spoil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">apparel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">But Samson’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> was <transChange type="added">given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04828">to his companion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom he had used as his friend</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen260" osisID="Judg.14"/>

verses.name: Judges 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">But it came to pass within a while after</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08123">that Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795 strong:H01423">with a kid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to my wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into the chamber</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01">But her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to go in</w>.

verses.name: Judges 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou hadst utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her; therefore I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04828">her to thy companion</w>: <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">not her younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">fairer</w> than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.<note type="study"><catchWord>take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let her be thine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 15:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">concerning them, Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall I be more blameless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">than the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">though I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">them a displeasure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>more…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">blameless from the Philistines though</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Judges 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07776">foxes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">firebrands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">tail</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">to tail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">firebrand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">between two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">tails</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>firebrands</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">torches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when he had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">the brands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w>, he let <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07054">into the standing corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and burnt up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01430">both the shocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07054">and also the standing corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">with the vineyards</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olives</w>.

verses.name: Judges 15:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">Then the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">this? And they answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02860">the son in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H08554">of the Timnite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04828">her to his companion</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">her and her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Judges 15:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">unto them, Though</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">yet will I be avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">of you, and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I will cease</w>.

verses.name: Judges 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">them hip</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05585">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05862">Etam</w>.

verses.name: Judges 15:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">Then the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03896">themselves in Lehi</w>.

verses.name: Judges 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why are ye come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against us? And they answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are we come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him as he hath done</w> to us.

verses.name: Judges 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Then three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05585">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05862">Etam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">to Samson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">thou not that the Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rulers</w> over us? what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto us? And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, As they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, so have I done</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>went</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, We are come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, that we may deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">unto them, Swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, that ye will not fall upon</w> me yourselves.

verses.name: Judges 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">No; but we will bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into their hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">but surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">we will not kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. And they bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">him with two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">cords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">from the rock</w>.

verses.name: Judges 15:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03896">unto Lehi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">him: and the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came mightily</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">upon him, and the cords</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02220">upon his arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H06593">became as flax</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that was burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0612">and his bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">loosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from off his hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>loosed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were melted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02961">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">jawbone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> therewith.<note type="study"><catchWord>new</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moist</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03895">With the jawbone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02565">heaps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02565">upon heaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03895">with the jaw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of an ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have I slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heaps upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an heap, two heaps</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, when he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">the jawbone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07437">Ramath–lehi</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ramath–lehi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the lifting up of the jawbone</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">casting away of the jawbone</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 15:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03966">And he was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">athirst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">deliverance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and now shall I die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">for thirst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w>?

verses.name: Judges 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04388">an hollow place</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03895">in the jaw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereout; and when he had drunk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he revived</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherefore he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05875">thereof En–hakkore</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03896">in Lehi</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>En–hakkore</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the well of him that called</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">cried</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the jaw</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Lehi</rdg>, as called in this chapter</note>

verses.name: Judges 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen261" osisID="Judg.15"/>

verses.name: Judges 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">to Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181 strong:H0802" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there an harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went in</w> unto her.<note type="study"><catchWord>harlot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a woman an harlot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And it was told</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05841">the Gazites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> hither. And they compassed <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">for him all night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and were quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">In the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">when it is day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we shall kill</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>quiet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">silence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H02677">till midnight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H02677">at midnight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">posts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">with them, bar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and all, and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">upon his shoulders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of an hill</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bar…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the bar</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass afterward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07796">of Sorek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01807">Delilah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by the brook</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05633">And the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto her, Entice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him, and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">wherein his great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w> <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange>, and by what <transChange type="added">means</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we may prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against him, that we may bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him to afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and we will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967 strong:H0505">of us eleven hundred</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>afflict</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">humble</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01807">And Delilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">to Samson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">me, I pray thee, wherein thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w> <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and wherewith thou mightest be bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to afflict</w> thee.

verses.name: Judges 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, If they bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">me with seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03892">green</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">withs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that were never dried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall I be weak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and be as another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>green…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">new cords</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moist</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>another</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">one</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05633">Then the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">to her seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03892">green</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">withs</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">which had not been dried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bound</w> him with them.<note type="study"><catchWord>green…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">new cords</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moist</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:9
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">men lying in wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abiding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">with her in the chamber</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">unto him, The Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08123">upon thee, Samson</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the withs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06616">as a thread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05296">of tow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when it toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03581">So his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not known</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>toucheth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smelleth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01807">And Delilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">unto Samson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Behold, thou hast mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">me lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">now tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, If they bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">with new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">ropes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H04399" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that never were occupied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then shall I be weak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and be as another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that never…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wherewith work hath not been done</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01807">Delilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">ropes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him therewith, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">unto him, The Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08123">upon thee, Samson</w>. And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">liers in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abiding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">in the chamber</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">them from off his arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H02339">like a thread</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01807">And Delilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">unto Samson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02008">Hitherto</w> <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">me lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">me wherewith thou mightest be bound</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, If thou weavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04253">locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04545">with the web</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she fastened</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03489">with the pin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">unto him, The Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08123">upon thee, Samson</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he awaked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">out of his sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">with the pin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0708">of the beam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04545">and with the web</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0349">unto him, How</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">canst thou say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thee, when thine heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">not with me? thou hast mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">me these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hast not told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">me wherein thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w> <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange>.

verses.name: Judges 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And it came to pass, when she pressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with her words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0509" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and urged</w> him, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">that his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto death</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>vexed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shortened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">That he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">her all his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto her, There hath not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04177">a razor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon mine head</w>; for I <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05139">a Nazarite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">from my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">womb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">if I be shaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">then my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from me, and I shall become weak</w>, and be like any <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01807">And when Delilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he had told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">her all his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">for the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">this once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he hath shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">me all his heart</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05633">Then the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto her, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And she made him sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">upon her knees</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">for a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and she caused him to shave off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04253">locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of his head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and she began</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">him, and his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> from him.

verses.name: Judges 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">The Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08123">upon thee, Samson</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he awoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">out of his sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">as at other times before</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">myself. And he wist</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was departed</w> from him.

verses.name: Judges 16:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">But the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05365" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">to Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">him with fetters of brass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he did grind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put out</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bored out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08181">Howbeit the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to grow again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">he was shaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as when he was shaven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05633">Then the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered them together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">unto Dagon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">and to rejoice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Our god</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into our hand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, they praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their god</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Our god</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and the destroyer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of our country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">which slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">many</w> of us.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and who multiplied our slain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">And it came to pass, when their hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">were merry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">for Samson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he may make us sport</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">for Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">out of the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and he made them</w> <w lemma="strong:H06711" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sport</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">him between the pillars</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>them</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that held</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him by the hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03237 strong:H04184" morph="strongMorph:TH8685 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8685">me that I may feel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">whereupon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">standeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that I may lean</w> upon them.

verses.name: Judges 16:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">Now the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05633">and all the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> there; and <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the roof</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">about three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H08123">while Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">made sport</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">me, I pray thee, and strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">me, I pray thee, only this once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">that I may be at once</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359 strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for my two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>.

verses.name: Judges 16:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H03943" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon which the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and on which it was borne up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">with his right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">with his left</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>on which…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he leaned on them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08123">And Samson</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he bowed</w> himself with <transChange type="added">all his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">might</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">upon the lords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and upon all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">therein. So the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">at his death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">were more</w> than <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">in his life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 16:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">Then his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> him, and brought <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06881">him between Zorah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0847">and Eshtaol</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">in the buryingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04495">of Manoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen262" osisID="Judg.16"/>

verses.name: Judges 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And there was a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">unto his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967 strong:H0505">The eleven hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that were taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee, about which thou cursedst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">of also in mine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">behold, the silver</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with me; I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">it. And his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>.

verses.name: Judges 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when he had restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967 strong:H0505">the eleven hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">to his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I had wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dedicated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a graven image</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">and a molten image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">now therefore I will restore</w> it unto thee.

verses.name: Judges 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Yet he restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">unto his mother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them to the founder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">thereof a graven image</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">and a molten image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and they were in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">of Micah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">had an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">an ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08655">and teraphim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">who became his priest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consecrated</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own eyes</w>.

verses.name: Judges 17:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05288">And there was a young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">out of Beth–lehem–judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">a Levite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he sojourned</w> there.

verses.name: Judges 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">from Beth–lehem–judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where he could find</w> <transChange type="added">a place</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he journeyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in making his way</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04318">And Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0370">unto him, Whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And he said</w> unto him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">a Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem–judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where I may find</w> <transChange type="added">a place</transChange>.

verses.name: Judges 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04318">And Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with me, and be unto me a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and a priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">thee ten</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by the year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06187">and a suit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04241">and thy victuals</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03881">So the Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a suit…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a double suit</rdg>, etc: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an order of garments</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was content</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with the man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">was unto him as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>.

verses.name: Judges 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04318">And Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levite</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">became his priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and was in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">I that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will do me good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">seeing I have a Levite</w> to <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen263" osisID="Judg.17"/>

verses.name: Judges 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01839">of the Danites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">them an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">for unto that day</w> <transChange type="added">all their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had not fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">unto them among</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of their family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">from their coasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06881">from Zorah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0847">and from Eshtaol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to spy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to search</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it; and they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">search</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they lodged</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>men of</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 18:3
verses.text: When they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they turned in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto him, Who brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">thee hither</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and what makest</w> thou in this <transChange type="added">place</transChange>? and what hast thou here?

verses.name: Judges 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02090">unto them, Thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H02090">and thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with me, and hath hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">me, and I am his priest</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Ask counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">we pray thee, of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">whether our way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which we go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be prosperous</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:6
