verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">your way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein ye go</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02568">Then the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03919">to Laish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">therein</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">how they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">careless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">of the Zidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and secure</w>; and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06114 strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">no magistrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, that might put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to shame</w> in <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>; and they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">from the Zidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and had no business</w> with <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Laish</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Leshem</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>magistrate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">possessor</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">heir of restraints</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H06881">to Zorah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0847">and Eshtaol</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">and their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto them, What <transChange type="added">say</transChange> ye?

verses.name: Judges 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against them: for we have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, and, behold, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">ye still</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06101" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not slothful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When ye go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">secure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07342">and to a large</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into your hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> where <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">no want</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of any thing</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">from thence of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01839">of the Danites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06881">out of Zorah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0847">and out of Eshtaol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appointed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">girded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">in Kirjath–jearim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04265">Mahaneh–dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>: behold, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">Kirjath–jearim</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">thence unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to spy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03919">of Laish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Do ye know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in these houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">an ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08655">and teraphim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06459">and a graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04541">and a molten image</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now therefore consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what ye have to do</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thitherward, and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levite</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965 strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saluted</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>saluted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">asked him of peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">And the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with their weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">by the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to spy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came in</w> thither, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">the graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0646">and the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08655">and the teraphim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04541">and the molten image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">with the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And these went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">into Micah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">the carved image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08655">and the teraphim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04541">and the molten image</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them, What do</w> ye?

verses.name: Judges 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto him, Hold thy peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with us, and be to us</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and a priest</w>: <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for thee to be a priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">or that thou be a priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">unto a tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">and a family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>?

verses.name: Judges 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08655">and the teraphim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06459">and the graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">the little ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">and the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03520">and the carriage</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 18:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">when they were a good way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">near to Micah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">unto Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>comest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">art gathered together?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye are gone away</w>: and what have I more? and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye say</w> unto me, What aileth thee?

verses.name: Judges 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto him, Let not thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H04751">among us, lest angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">fellows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and thou lose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">with the lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thy household</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>angry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter of soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04318">and when Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">too strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for him, he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they took</w> <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04318">which Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he had, and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03919">unto Laish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto a people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">at quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and secure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:28
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">no deliverer</w>, because it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">from Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and they had no business</w> with <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06010">and it was in the valley</w> that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01050">by Beth–rehob</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> therein.

verses.name: Judges 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">after the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">who was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0199">howbeit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03919">Laish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">at the first</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">the graven image</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">of Gershom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">he and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">were priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">to the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01839">of Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: Judges 18:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they set them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">Micah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">graven image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">that the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">was in Shiloh</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen264" osisID="Judg.18"/>

verses.name: Judges 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass in those days</w>, when <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that there was a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sojourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">on the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370 strong:H0802">to him a concubine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">out of Beth–lehem–judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a concubine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a woman a concubine</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">a wife a concubine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06370">And his concubine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">played the whore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, and went away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">from him unto her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem–judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and was there four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H02320">whole months</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>four whole months</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a year and four month</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">days, four months</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">her, to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">friendly</w> unto her, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring her again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">having his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">with him, and a couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of asses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and she brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him into her father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and when the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">of the damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, he rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>friendly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to her heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And his father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05291">the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">retained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and he abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">with him three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lodged</w> there.

verses.name: Judges 19:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07243">And it came to pass on the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when they arose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05291">and the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">unto his son in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">with a morsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go your way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Comfort</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Strengthen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they sat down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">of them together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05291">for the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Be content</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, and tarry all night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and let thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be merry</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06484" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">urged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: therefore he lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there again</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he arose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">on the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05291">and the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8701">I pray thee. And they tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186 strong:H03117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until afternoon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> of them.<note type="study"><catchWord>until afternoon</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">till the day declined</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06370">he, and his concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his father in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05291">the damsel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto him, Behold, now the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">draweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06150" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">toward evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray you tarry all night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">behold, the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">groweth to an end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">here, that thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be merry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04279">and to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">get you early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on your way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou mayest go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">home</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>draweth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is weak</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the day groweth to an end</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it is the pitching time of the day</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>home</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to thy tent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not tarry that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H02982">Jebus</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>; and <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06776">with him two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saddled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06370">his concubine</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>over against</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to over against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> when they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02982">by Jebus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07286" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto his master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, and let us turn in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">of the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lodge</w> in it.

verses.name: Judges 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">And his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, We will not turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">hither into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of a stranger</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we will pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us draw near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of these places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to lodge all night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07414">or in Ramah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went their way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08121">and the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> upon them <transChange type="added">when they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">Gibeah</w>, which <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01144">to Benjamin</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thither, to go in</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sat him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in a street</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>: for <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them into his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lodging</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">an old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">from his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">also</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he sojourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">but the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the place</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01145">Benjamites</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he had lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0732" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a wayfaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whither goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0370">thou? and whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">comest</w> thou?

verses.name: Judges 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto him, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">from Beth–lehem–judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">toward the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>; from thence <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I: and I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem–judah</w>, but I <transChange type="added">am now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; and there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that receiveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me to house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>receiveth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gathereth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Yet there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">both straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04554">and provender</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">for our asses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03899">and there is bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">also for me, and for thy handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and for the young man</w> <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servants</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">no want</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of any thing</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07535">with thee; howsoever</w> <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">all thy wants</w> <transChange type="added">lie</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon me; only lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">not in the street</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him into his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave provender</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">unto the asses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">as they were making their hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">merry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">behold, the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738" type="x-split-160">beset</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8738" type="x-split-160">round about</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01849" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">at the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to the master</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may know</w> him.

verses.name: Judges 19:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">the master</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0408">unto them, Nay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w>, <transChange type="added">nay</transChange>, I pray you, do not <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wickedly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">not this folly</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:24
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">here is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a maiden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06370">and his concubine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them I will bring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">now, and humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye them, and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with them what seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto you: but unto this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">not so</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">vile</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a thing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>so vile…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the matter of this folly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">But the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to him: so the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">his concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">her forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them; and they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">her, and abused</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">her all the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07837">and when the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">began to spring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they let her go</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in the dawning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">where her lord</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">till it was light</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">And her lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">and, behold, the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">his concubine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was fallen down</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and her hands</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05592">upon the threshold</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us be going</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But none answered</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">Then the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> her <transChange type="added">up</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02543">upon an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">him unto his place</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03979">a knife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">on his concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and divided</w> her, <transChange type="added">together</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">with her bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">into twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05409">pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">her into all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 19:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And it was so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that all that saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02063">There was no such deed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">done nor seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H05779" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">of it, take advice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and speak</w> <transChange type="added">your minds</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen265" osisID="Judg.19"/>

verses.name: Judges 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Then all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">from Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">even to Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">with the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">in Mizpeh</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06438">And the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">themselves in the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273 strong:H0376">footmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:3
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpeh</w>.) <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Tell</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how was</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">this wickedness</w>?

verses.name: Judges 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H03881">And the Levite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">into Gibeah</w> that <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01144">to Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06370">I and my concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lodge</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Levite</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the man the Levite</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01167">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">of Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-161">against me, and beset</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-161">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">upon me by night</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">me: and my concubine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have they forced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she is dead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forced</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">humbled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">my concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut her in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">her throughout all the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">lewdness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">and folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:7
verses.text: Behold, ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">here</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">your advice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">and counsel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">We will not any</w> <transChange type="added">of us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to his tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">neither will we any</w> <transChange type="added">of us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into his house</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:9
verses.text: But now this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which we will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w>; <transChange type="added">we will go up</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> against it;

verses.name: Judges 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And we will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">throughout all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">out of ten thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">victual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">to Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05039">according to all the folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they have wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">So all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02270">knit together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>knit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fellows</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07626">And the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">through all the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">What wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">this that is done</w> among you?

verses.name: Judges 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore deliver</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that we may put them to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">But the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: Judges 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">unto Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">beside the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">of Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">which were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Among all this people</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225 strong:H03027 strong:H0334">lefthanded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07049" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one could sling</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08185">at an hair</w> <transChange type="added">breadth</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and not miss</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">beside Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>: all these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008 strong:H0430" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">counsel of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04310">Which</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of us shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <transChange type="added">shall go up</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08462">first</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">against Gibeah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">against Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">against them at Gibeah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">out of Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroyed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">encouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">themselves, and set their battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where they put themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:23
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">counsel of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Shall I go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> against him.)

verses.name: Judges 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01144">And Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">them out of Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroyed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">again eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all these drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Then all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008 strong:H0430" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">there before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, (<w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">there in those days</w>,

verses.name: Judges 20:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06372">And Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it in those days</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Shall I yet again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or shall I cease</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04279">for to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into thine hand</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">liers in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">Gibeah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">against Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">as at other times</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">were drawn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they began</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">kill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">as at other times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04546">in the highways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">of which one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008 strong:H0430" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">about thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to smite…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to smite of the people wounded as at</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>the house…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Beth–el</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">smitten down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">us, as at the first</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">But the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">them from the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">unto the highways</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of their place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H01193">at Baal–tamar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the liers in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01518" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of their places</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04629">out of the meadows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">of Gibeah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was sore</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not that evil</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">near</w> them.

verses.name: Judges 20:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01145">of the Benjamites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all these drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">So the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they were smitten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01145">to the Benjamites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the liers in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">beside Gibeah</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the liers in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">upon Gibeah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the liers in wait</w> drew <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">along</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drew…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made a long sound with the trumpet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04150">Now there was an appointed sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">between the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the liers in wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">that they should make a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">with smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sign</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">time</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>flame</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">elevation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">retired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to smite</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">about thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">they are smitten down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> us, as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to smite…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to smite the wounded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04864">But when the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to arise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">with a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">of smoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">the Benjamites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">them, and, behold, the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ascended up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the flame of</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the whole consumption of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were amazed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>was come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">touched them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore they turned</w> <transChange type="added">their backs</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04421">but the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">overtook</w> them; and them which <transChange type="added">came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">they destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> of them.

verses.name: Judges 20:43
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Thus</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they inclosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01145">the Benjamites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">round about</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">chased</w> them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">trode them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">with ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">toward the sunrising</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with ease…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from Menuchah</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>over…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto over against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 20:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; all these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">toward the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">unto the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">of Rimmon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">and they gleaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">of them in the highways</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">hard after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01440">them unto Gidom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> of them.

verses.name: Judges 20:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">So that all which fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">were twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>; all these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">But six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">unto the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">Rimmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">in the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">Rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>.

verses.name: Judges 20:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04974">as well the men</w> of <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">the beast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and all that came to hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that they came to</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came to hand</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were found</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen266" osisID="Judg.20"/>

verses.name: Judges 21:1
