verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Now the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">had sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">in Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">There shall not any</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of us give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">unto Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008 strong:H0430" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">there till even</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01065 strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">sore</w>;

verses.name: Judges 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">why is this come to pass in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">that there should be to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">lacking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>?

verses.name: Judges 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">among all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">not up with the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H01419">For they had made a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">concerning him that came not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">He shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">them for Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">There is one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">for wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for them that remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">seeing we have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that we will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">them of our daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wives</w>?

verses.name: Judges 21:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">What one</w> <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">from Jabesh–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">to the assembly</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">were numbered</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w> there.

verses.name: Judges 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">thither twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428 strong:H01121">of the valiantest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">and the children</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:11
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye shall utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">every male</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and every woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">that hath lain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">by man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hath lain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">knoweth the lying with man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that had known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">by lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">with any male</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">them unto the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">to Shiloh</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>young…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">young women virgins</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">And the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05553">in the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">Rimmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peaceably</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>to speak…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and spake and called</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>call…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">proclaim peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01144">And Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">them wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which they had saved alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and yet so they sufficed</w> them not.

verses.name: Judges 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">them for Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">a breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">in the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02205">Then the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">for wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for them that remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">seeing the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">out of Benjamin</w>?

verses.name: Judges 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <transChange type="added">There must be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">for them that be escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">that a tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Howbeit we may</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">them wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of our daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have sworn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">to Benjamin</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they said</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">yearly</w> <transChange type="added">in a place</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06828">on the north side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">of the highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">from Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and on the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03829">of Lebonah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yearly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from year to year</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>on the east…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward the sunrising</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of the highway</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on the highway</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Therefore they commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lie in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">in the vineyards</w>;

verses.name: Judges 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and, behold, if the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">of Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04246">in dances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then come ye out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of the vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">you every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">of Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And it shall be, when their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">or their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto us to complain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Be favourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them for our sakes: because we reserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not to each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye did not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">unto them at this time</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye should be guilty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Be favourable…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Gratify us in them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Judges 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to their number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">of them that danced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom they caught</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">unto their inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> in them.

verses.name: Judges 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">thence at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">to his tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">and to his family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">from thence every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">to his inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Judges 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own eyes</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen267" osisID="Judg.21"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen246" osisID="Judg" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ruth 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Now it came to pass in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">ruled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">that there was a famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">And a certain man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem–judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">he, and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ruled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0458">Elimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">Naomi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04248">Mahlon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03630">and Chilion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0673">Ephrathites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem–judah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, and continued there.<note type="study"><catchWord>continued</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0458">And Elimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">Naomi’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and she was left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and her two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">them wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">of Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06204">Orpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07327">Ruth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they dwelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">there about ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04248">And Mahlon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03630">and Chilion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">also both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of them; and the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of her two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and her husband</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">with her daughters in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she might return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">from the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">how that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in giving</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them bread</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore she went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">where she was, and her two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">daughters in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with her; and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">And Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto her two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">daughters in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">each</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">to her mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with you, as ye have dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">with the dead</w>, and with me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you that ye may find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">each</w> <transChange type="added">of you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of her husband</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; and they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, Surely we will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with thee unto thy people</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">And Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">why will ye go</w> with me? <transChange type="added">are</transChange> there yet <transChange type="added">any more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">in my womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">that they may be your husbands</w>?

verses.name: Ruth 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <transChange type="added">your way</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I am too old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to have an husband</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I should say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">I have</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w>, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">I should have an husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">also to night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and should also bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>should have…</catchWord>: or <rdg type="alternate">were with an husband</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Would ye tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03860">for them</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till they were grown</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05702" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">would ye stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03860">for them</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">from having husbands</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01323">nay, my daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it grieveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">me much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for your sakes that the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone out</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>tarry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hope</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>it grieveth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I have much bitterness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06204">and Orpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">her mother in law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07327">but Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">clave</w> unto her.

verses.name: Ruth 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02994">Behold, thy sister in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto her people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and unto her gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thou after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02994">thy sister in law</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07327">And Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me not to leave</w> thee, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: for whither thou goest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and where thou lodgest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will lodge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Intreat…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Be not against me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Where thou diest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and there will I be buried</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so to me, and more</w> also, <transChange type="added">if ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">but death</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">part</w> thee and me.

verses.name: Ruth 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When she saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that she was stedfastly minded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with her, then she left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaking</w> unto her.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengthened herself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 1:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08147">So they two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when they were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">that all the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01949" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">about them, and they said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05281">this Naomi</w>?

verses.name: Ruth 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">me not Naomi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H04755">me Mara</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07706">for the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">hath dealt very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bitterly</w> with me.<note type="study"><catchWord>Naomi</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Pleasant</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Mara</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Bitter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath brought me home again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">empty</w>: why <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">ye me Naomi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">seeing the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">against me, and the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath afflicted</w> me?

verses.name: Ruth 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">So Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07327">and Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">the Moabitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03618">her daughter in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with her, which returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen269" osisID="Ruth.1"/>

verses.name: Ruth 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">And Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045 strong:H04129" morph="strongMorph:TH8794 strongMorph:TH8675">had a kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of her husband’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H0458">of Elimelech</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Boaz</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Booz</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07327">And Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">the Moabitess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">unto Naomi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me now go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">to the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and glean</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">ears of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in whose sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gleaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the reapers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04745">and her hap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was to light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">on a part</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <transChange type="added">belonging</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01162">unto Boaz</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the kindred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0458">of Elimelech</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hap…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hap happened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 2:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01162">And, behold, Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">from Beth–lehem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the reapers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you. And they answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> thee.

verses.name: Ruth 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over the reapers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05291">Whose damsel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this?

verses.name: Ruth 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over the reapers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04125">the Moabitish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">with Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>:

verses.name: Ruth 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I pray you, let me glean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the reapers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">among the sheaves</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so she came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0227">even</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">from the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until now, that she tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07327">unto Ruth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hearest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thou not, my daughter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to glean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">in another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from hence, but abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">here fast by my maidens</w>:

verses.name: Ruth 2:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">on the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they do reap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thou after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them: have I not charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they shall not touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee? and when thou art athirst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">unto the vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drink</w> of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">which the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have drawn</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on her face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">herself to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Why have I found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that thou shouldest take knowledge</w> of me, seeing I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05237">a stranger</w>?

verses.name: Ruth 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01162">And Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">unto her, It hath fully</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">been shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, all that thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">unto thy mother in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">since</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of thine husband</w>: and <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and thy mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of thy nativity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou knewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H08543">not heretofore</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">thy work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08003">and a full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04909">reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">be given thee of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">under whose wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to trust</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for that thou hast comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">me, and for that thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">friendly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">unto thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">though I be not like unto one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">of thine handmaidens</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Let me…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I find</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>friendly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01162">And Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400 strong:H06256">unto her, At mealtime</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">thou hither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of the bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dip</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">thy morsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02558">in the vinegar</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the reapers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06642" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he reached</w> <w lemma="strong:H07039">her parched</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was sufficed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and left</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when she was risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to glean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Let her glean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">even among the sheaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and reproach</w> her not:<note type="study"><catchWord>reproach…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shame her not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And let fall</w> also <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06653">of the handfuls</w> <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for her, and leave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that she may glean</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rebuke</w> her not.

verses.name: Ruth 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So she gleaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02251" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and beat out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that she had gleaned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0374">and it was about an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And she took <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02545">and her mother in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">what she had gleaned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and she brought forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to her that she had reserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07648">after she was sufficed</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02545">And her mother in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">unto her, Where hast thou gleaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0375">and where</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wroughtest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thou? blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">be he that did take knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of thee. And she shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">her mother in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with whom she had wrought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">The man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with whom I wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">And Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">unto her daughter in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">he of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath not left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and to the dead</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05281">And Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto her, The man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near of kin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto us, one of our next kinsmen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>one of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">one that hath right to redeem</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07327">And Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">the Moabitess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">by my young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">until they have ended</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">all my harvest</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">And Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07327">unto Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">her daughter in law</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">with his maidens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">thee not in any other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>meet…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fall upon thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So she kept fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">by the maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">of Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to glean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">and of wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">with her mother in law</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen270" osisID="Ruth.2"/>

verses.name: Ruth 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">Then Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">her mother in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto her, My daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall I not seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04494">rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thee, that it may be well</w> with thee?

verses.name: Ruth 3:2
verses.text: And now <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01162">not Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04130">of our kindred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05291">with whose maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">to night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in the threshingfloor</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thyself therefore, and anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">thy raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon thee, and get thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">to the floor</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">make not thyself known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">until he shall have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and drinking</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall be, when he lieth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shalt mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where he shall lie</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt go in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and uncover</w> <w lemma="strong:H04772">his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay thee down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he will tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee what thou shalt do</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>uncover</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lift up the clothes that are on</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, All that thou sayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me I will do</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">unto the floor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">according to all that her mother in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">bade</w> her.

verses.name: Ruth 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01162">And when Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drunk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was merry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">of the heap of corn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03909">softly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04772">his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid her down</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H02677">And it came to pass at midnight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03943" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">himself: and, behold, a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04772">at his feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>turned</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">took hold on</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And she answered</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07327">Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">thine handmaid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">therefore thy skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">over thine handmaid</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a near kinsman</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a near…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">one that hath right to redeem</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">more kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">in the latter end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">than at the beginning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">inasmuch as thou followedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01800">whether poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06223">or rich</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">And now, my daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee all that thou requirest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08179">for all the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth know</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">a virtuous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>city</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">And now it is true</w> that I <transChange type="added">am thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">near kinsman</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03426">howbeit there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nearer</w> than I.

verses.name: Ruth 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">this night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and it shall be in the morning</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him do the kinsman’s part</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but if he will</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not do the part of a kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman</w> to thee, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04772">at his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02958">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">could know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Let it not be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">that a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">into the floor</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04304">the vail</w> that <transChange type="added">thou hast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">upon thee, and hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it. And when she held</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, he measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <transChange type="added">measures</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on her: and she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vail</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sheet</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">apron</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">to her mother in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thou, my daughter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And she told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her all that the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> to her.

verses.name: Ruth 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">These six</w> <transChange type="added">measures</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he me; for he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me, Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">not empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02545">unto thy mother in law</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">she, Sit still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">my daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until thou know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">how the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will fall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not be in rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">until</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he have finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen271" osisID="Ruth.3"/>

verses.name: Ruth 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-162">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-162">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there: and, behold, the kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">of whom Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by; unto whom he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">Ho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06423">such</w> <w lemma="strong:H0492">a one</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sit down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">here. And he turned aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat down</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sit ye down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">here. And they sat down</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the kinsman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05281">Naomi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that is come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">selleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">a parcel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of land</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0458">Elimelech’s</w>:

verses.name: Ruth 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to advertise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Buy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">before the inhabitants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and before the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou wilt redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but if thou wilt not redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, that I may know</w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">none to redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02108">beside</w> thee; and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I thought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I said, I will reveal in thine ear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">What day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou buyest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">of Naomi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou must buy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07327">also of Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">the Moabitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">upon his inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for myself, lest I mar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">mine own inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">thou my right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thyself; for I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">redeem</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:7
verses.text: Now this <transChange type="added">was the manner</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in former time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01353">concerning redeeming</w> <w lemma="strong:H08545">and concerning changing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for to confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all things</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">plucked off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">his shoe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>: and this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08584">a testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore the kinsman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">unto Boaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Buy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thee. So he drew off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">his shoe</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01162">And Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w>, and <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have bought</w> all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0458">Elimelech’s</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03630">Chilion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04248">and Mahlon’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">of Naomi</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07327">Moreover Ruth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">the Moabitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04248">of Mahlon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I purchased</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to be my wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">upon his inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and from the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of his place</w>: ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">We are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">like Rachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03812">and like Leah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">which two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">thou worthily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">in Ephratah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034 strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">in Beth–lehem</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>do thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">get thee riches</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">power</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>be famous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">proclaim thy name</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And let thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">be like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Pharez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08559">whom Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">unto Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">thee of this young woman</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01162">So Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07327">Ruth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and she was his wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto her, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02032">her conception</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">unto Naomi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which hath not left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">without a kinsman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>left…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to cease unto thee</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>kinsman</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">redeemer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And he shall be unto thee a restorer</w> of <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8771">and a nourisher</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">of thine old age</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03618">for thy daughter in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thee, which is better</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">to thee than seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath born</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>a nourisher of</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to nourish</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>thine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy gray hairs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05281">And Naomi</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">it in her bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and became nurse</w> unto it.

verses.name: Ruth 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07934">And the women her neighbours</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">it a name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">There is a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H05281">to Naomi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05744">Obed</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: Ruth 4:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Pharez</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06557">Pharez</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron</w>,

verses.name: Ruth 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02696">And Hezron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07410">Ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07410">and Ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05992">Amminadab</w>,

verses.name: Ruth 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05992">And Amminadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05177">Nahshon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05177">and Nahshon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08009">Salmon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Salmon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Salmah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ruth 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08012">And Salmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01162">and Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05744">Obed</w>,

verses.name: Ruth 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05744">And Obed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03448">and Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen272" osisID="Ruth.4"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen268" osisID="Ruth" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Now there was a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07436">of Ramathaim–zophim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0511">Elkanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0453">of Elihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08459">of Tohu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06689">of Zuph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0673">an Ephrathite</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And he had two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02584">Hannah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06444">Peninnah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06444">and Peninnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">had children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02584">but Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">had no children</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01931">And this</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of his city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">yearly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08147">And the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">of Eli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02652">Hophni</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">and Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>yearly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from year to year</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:4
