verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And when the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">was that Elkanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06444">to Peninnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to all her sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04490">portions</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02584">But unto Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">portion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02584">Hannah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">her womb</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>worthy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">double</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06869">And her adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">her sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for to make her fret</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">her womb</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>provoked</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">angered</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">so year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01767">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">she went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so she provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her; therefore she wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did not eat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from the time that she</rdg>, etc: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from her going up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">Elkanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H02584">to her, Hannah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">why weepest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? and why eatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thou not? and why is thy heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grieved</w>? <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not I better</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">to thee than ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 1:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02584">So Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they had drunk</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05941">Now Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon a seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">by a post</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:10
verses.text: And she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">in bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter of soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">if thou wilt indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">on the affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but wilt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">unto thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">him unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04177">and there shall no razor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a man…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seed of men</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And it came to pass, as she continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">praying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05941">that Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">marked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>continued…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiplied to pray</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02584">Now Hannah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">she spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in her heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08193">only her lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">moved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">but her voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was not heard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05941">therefore Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">she had been drunken</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05941">And Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">thy wine</w> from thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02584">And Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">No, my lord</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">of a sorrowful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">neither wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941">nor strong drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but have poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of a sorrowful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard of spirit</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Count</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">not thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">a daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">for out of the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07879">of my complaint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">and grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I spoken</w> hitherto.<note type="study"><catchWord>complaint</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">meditation</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05941">Then Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grant</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07596">thy petition</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast asked</w> of him.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">Let thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0802">So the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">her way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and her countenance</w> was no more <transChange type="added">sad</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-163">And they rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-163">early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to their house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">to Ramah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0511">and Elkanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02584">Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remembered</w> her.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Wherefore it came to pass, when the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08622">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02584">about after Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I have asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">him of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in revolution of days</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Samuel</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Asked of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">Elkanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the yearly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05088">and his vow</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02584">But Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went not up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto her husband</w>, <transChange type="added">I will not go up</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">until the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be weaned</w>, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him, that he may appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0511">And Elkanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">what seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thee good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until thou have weaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">him; only the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0802">So the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and gave her son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">suck</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until she weaned</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when she had weaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, she took him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">with her, with three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">of flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">and a bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the child</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">a bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">to Eli</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">Oh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">by thee here, praying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">For this child</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">I prayed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">me my petition</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I asked</w> of him:

verses.name: I Samuel 1:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Therefore also I have lent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">him to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">as long as he liveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">he shall be lent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And he worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>lent him</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">returned him, whom I have obtained by petition</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he whom I have obtained by petition shall be returned</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen274" osisID="1Sam.1"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02584">And Hannah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejoiceth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07161">mine horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is enlarged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over mine enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">in thy salvation</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">none holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01115">none beside</w> thee: neither <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">any rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">like our God</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">so exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">proudly</w>; let <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06277">arrogancy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of your mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01844">of knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05949">and by him actions</w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are weighed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>arrogancy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07198">The bows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02844">broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and they that stumbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with strength</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07649">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have hired out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">themselves for bread</w>; and <transChange type="added">they that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07457">hungry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceased</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06135">so that the barren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and she that hath many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0535" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">is waxed feeble</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">killeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and maketh alive</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he bringeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bringeth up</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">maketh poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and maketh rich</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he bringeth low</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0637">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">lifteth up</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He raiseth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">out of the dust</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lifteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the beggar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0830">from the dunghill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to set</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05081">among princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and to make them inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04690">for the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> upon them.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">of his saints</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be silent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03581">for by strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">shall no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevail</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">The adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken to pieces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08064">out of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon them: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto his king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">of his anointed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0511">And Elkanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">to Ramah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">of Eli</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">custom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with the people</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">when any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">while the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">was in seething</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04207">with a fleshhook</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he struck</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03595">into the pan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01731">or kettle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07037">or caldron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06517">or pot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04207">all that the fleshhook</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for himself. So they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> thither.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Also before they burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sacrificed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06740" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to roast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he will not have</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">sodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thee, but raw</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:16
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto him, Let them not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">presently</w>, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <transChange type="added">as much</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">as thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">desireth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then he would answer</w> him, <transChange type="added">Nay</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt give</w> <transChange type="added">it me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">now: and if not, I will take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02394">by force</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>presently</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as on the day</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">Wherefore the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">for men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">But Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with a linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">ephod</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0517">Moreover his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">him a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">coat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to him from year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when she came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the yearly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05941">And Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">Elkanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thee seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of this woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">for the loan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which is lent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto their own home</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>loan…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">petition which she asked</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03588">And</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H02584">Hannah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05941">Now Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all that his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and how they lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that assembled</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>assembled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">assembled by troops</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Why do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye such things</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for I hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of your evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">dealings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">by all this people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of your…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">evil words of you</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Nay, my sons</w>; for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">report</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I hear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye make the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to transgress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>transgress</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cry out</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">If one man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">him: but if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">who shall intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">slay</w> them.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01432">grew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and was in favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">both with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and also with men</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">unto Eli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">Did I plainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">when they were in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">in Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 2:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And did I choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">him out of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">my priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon mine altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">an ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me? and did I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0801">all the offerings made by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 2:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01163" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore kick</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">ye at my sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and at mine offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have commanded</w> <transChange type="added">in my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04583">habitation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and honourest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">above me, to make yourselves fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">with the chiefest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">of all the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Wherefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">indeed</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thy house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">should walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">me for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">Be it far from me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">for them that honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me I will honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me shall be lightly esteemed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">thine arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and the arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">that there shall not be an old man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">an enemy</w> <transChange type="added">in my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04583">habitation</w>, in all <transChange type="added">the wealth</transChange> which <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02205">and there shall not be an old man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an enemy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the affliction of the tabernacle, for all the wealth which God would have given Israel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 2:33

verses.name: I Samuel 2:34
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, that shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02652">on Hophni</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">and Phinehas</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> of them.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will raise me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall do</w> according to <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and in my mind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">him a sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and he shall walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">mine anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 2:36

verses.name: I Samuel 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">Eli</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">was precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in those days</w>; <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">no open</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">vision</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05941">when Eli</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">laid down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H03544">to wax dim</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not see</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05216">And ere the lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">where the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was laid down</w> <transChange type="added">to sleep</transChange>;

verses.name: I Samuel 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he answered</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">unto Eli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02009">I</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou calledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not; lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">again</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay down</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">to Eli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I; for thou didst call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me. verses.name: I Samuel 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">Now Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02962">did not yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">neither was the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">yet revealed</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>Now…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Thus did Samuel before he knew the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and before the word of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> was revealed unto him</rdg></note>

And Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">had called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the child</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 3:9

verses.name: I Samuel 3:10

verses.name: I Samuel 3:11

verses.name: I Samuel 3:13

verses.name: I Samuel 3:14

I pray thee hide</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not from me: God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do so</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to thee, and more also</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">if thou hide</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">from me of all the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he said</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>more also</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">so add</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>thing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">word</rdg></note>

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when they joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">of the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">about four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they joined…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the battle was spread</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>army</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">array</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Wherefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">us to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">out of Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto us, that, when it cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">us, it may save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of our enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fetch</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">take unto us</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">to Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they might bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">from thence the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelleth</w> <transChange type="added">between</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">of Eli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02652">Hophni</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">and Phinehas</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">there with the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">And when the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">so that the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01949" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">rang again</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">of the shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w>, What <transChange type="added">meaneth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">of the Hebrews</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">that the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">into the camp</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H0865">unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heretofore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yesterday</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">the third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0188">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto us! who shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">of these mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">Gods</w>? these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the Gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">with all the plagues</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and quit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">yourselves like men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">O ye Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye be not servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05680">unto the Hebrews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as they have been</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to you: quit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">yourselves like men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>quit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be men</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">fought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was smitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into his tent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">and there was a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">footmen</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">And the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">of Eli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02652">Hophni</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">and Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were slain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were slain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">died</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">out of the army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">to Shiloh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">with his clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and with earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05941">lo, Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon a seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03197 strong:H03027 strong:H01870" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">by the wayside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">watching</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">for his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02730">trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried out</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05941">And when Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">of the crying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, What <transChange type="added">meaneth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of this tumult</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in hastily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">Eli</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05941">Now Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">was ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were dim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not see</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were dim</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">unto Eli</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">out of the army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">out of the army</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">What is there done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is the thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and there hath been also a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02652">also, Hophni</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">and Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And it came to pass, when he made mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">of the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">from off the seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0322">backward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04665">and his neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">brake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he was an old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and heavy</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he had judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 4:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03618">And his daughter in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06372">Phinehas’</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02030">was with child</w>, <transChange type="added">near</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be delivered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">the tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02524">and that her father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">herself and travailed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06735">for her pains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">came</w> upon her.<note type="study"><catchWord>be delivered</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cry out</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>came</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were turned</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And about the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of her death</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the women that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">by her said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not; for thou hast born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But she answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, neither did she regard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>neither…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set not her heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she named</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H0350">I–chabod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">The glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0413">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02524">and because of her father in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and her husband</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I–chabod</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Where is the glory?</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">There is no glory</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">The glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen277" osisID="1Sam.4"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H072">it from Eben–ezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">unto Ashdod</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">When the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">it into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">of Dagon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">it by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">Dagon</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0796">And when they of Ashdod</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">arose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01712">behold, Dagon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">Dagon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-164">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">him in his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-164">again</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when they arose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01712">behold, Dagon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">of Dagon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">the palms</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04670">upon the threshold</w>; only <transChange type="added">the stump of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01712">Dagon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was left</w> to him.<note type="study"><catchWord>the stump…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the fishy part</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Therefore neither the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">of Dagon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor any that come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">into Dagon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04670">on the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">of Dagon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">in Ashdod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">But the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0796">upon them of Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06076 strong:H02914" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">them with emerods</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0795">Ashdod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the coasts</w> thereof.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And when the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">of Ashdod</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so, they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">The ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with us: for his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">upon us, and upon Dagon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our god</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">all the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">with the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">Let the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-165">be carried about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">unto Gath</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-165">And they carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">about</w> <transChange type="added">thither</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:9
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">that, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they had carried it about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">was against the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">destruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">both small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06076 strong:H02914" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and they had emerods</w> <w lemma="strong:H08368" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">in their secret parts</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 5:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Therefore they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">to Ekron</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0727">And it came to pass, as the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">to Ekron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06139">that the Ekronites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They have brought about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to us, to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">us and our people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>us, to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">me to slay me and my</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">all the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Send away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let it go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to his own place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that it slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">us not, and our people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04194">for there was a deadly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">throughout all the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heavy</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>us not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">me not, and my</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that died</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">not were smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06076 strong:H02914" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">with the emerods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07775">and the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen278" osisID="1Sam.5"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">And the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">was in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the diviners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">to the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">us wherewith we shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">it to his place</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">If ye send away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">it not empty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">but in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">him a trespass offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">then ye shall be healed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it shall be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to you why his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is not removed</w> from you.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> they, What <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">the trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which we shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him? They answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">Five</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06076 strong:H02914" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">emerods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05909">mice</w>, <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">of the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">plague</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05633">on you all, and on your lords</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>you</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore ye shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">images</w> <w lemma="strong:H06076 strong:H02914" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of your emerods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06754">and images</w> <w lemma="strong:H05909">of your mice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that mar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">peradventure he will lighten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from off you, and from off your gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and from off your land</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Wherefore then do ye harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">as the Egyptians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">and Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their hearts</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">when he had wrought wonderfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">among them, did they not let the people go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they departed</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>wonderfully</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reproachfully</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the people</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">cart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05763" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">milch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">on which there hath come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">no yoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tie</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">the kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">to the cart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from them</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 6:8
