verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">it upon the cart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which ye return</w> him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">a trespass offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0712">in a coffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">by the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thereof; and send it away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that it may go</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if it goeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of his own coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">to Beth–shemesh</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">us this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but if not, then we shall know</w> that <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not his hand</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">smote</w> us; it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04745">a chance</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">happened to us</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did so</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05763" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">milch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and tied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">them to the cart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">at home</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">upon the cart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0712">and the coffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05909">with the mice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">and the images</w> <w lemma="strong:H02914">of their emerods</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06510">And the kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took the straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went along</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H04546">the highway</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01600" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">lowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as they went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turned not aside</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w> or <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">the left</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05633">and the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">them unto the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:13
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">they of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01053">Beth–shemesh</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">reaping</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">their wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05699">And the cart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01030">a Beth–shemite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> there, where <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">of the cart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06510">the kine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">took down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0712">and the coffer</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with it, wherein the jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">on the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And when the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">to Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:17
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02914">emerods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">which the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">returned</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0817">a trespass offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0795">for Ashdod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05804">for Gaza</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0831">for Askelon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01661">for Gath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">for Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">And the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05909">mice</w>, <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">belonging</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">to the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">lords</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04013">of fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06521">and of country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">villages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">even unto the great</w> <transChange type="added">stone of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H059">Abel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whereon they set down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">which stone remaineth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01030">the Beth–shemite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">great stone</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 6:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they had looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">into the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">even he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">and threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">lamented</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had smitten</w> <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">of Beth–shemesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who is able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">this holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and to whom shall he go up</w> from us?

verses.name: I Samuel 6:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">of Kirjath–jearim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">The Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come ye down</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">fetch it up</w> to you. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen279" osisID="1Sam.6"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">of Kirjath–jearim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and fetched up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">it into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H041">of Abinadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">in the hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass, while</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">in Kirjath–jearim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">that the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was long</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06242">for it was twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05091" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">lamented</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">If ye do return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all your hearts</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06252">and Ashtaroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">you, and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him only: and he will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Then the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">did put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06252">and Ashtaroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> only.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">to Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and I will pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for you unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And they gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, and poured <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there, We have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">in Mizpeh</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">to Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05633">the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they were afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">to Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for us, that he will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Cease…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be not silent from us from crying</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">sucking</w> <w lemma="strong:H02924">lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <transChange type="added">it for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">wholly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>heard</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">answered</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And as Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">was offering up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thundered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">upon the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and discomfited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them; and they were smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">of Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> them, until <transChange type="added">they came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01033">under Beth–car</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">Then Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04709">between Mizpeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08129">and Shen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H072">of it Eben–ezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Hitherto hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">helped</w> us.<note type="study"><catchWord>Eben–ezer</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The stone of help</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">So the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were subdued</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">into the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">and the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">was against the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of Samuel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">which the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">from Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">even unto Gath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">thereof did Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07965">And there was peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">between Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">to year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in circuit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">to Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01537">and Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04709">and Mizpeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in all those places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in circuit</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and he circuited</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08666">And his return</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07414">to Ramah</w>; for there <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there he judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen280" osisID="1Sam.7"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And it came to pass, when Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">Now the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060 strong:H01121">of his firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03100">was Joel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">of his second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H029">Abiah</w>: <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">in Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not in his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">lucre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">bribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and perverted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">Then all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">gathered themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">to Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">unto Ramah</w>,

verses.name: I Samuel 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Behold, thou art old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not in thy ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">us a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">us like all the nations</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">But the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">us a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">us. And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>displeased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was evil in the eyes of</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in all that they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto thee: for they have not rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, but they have rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, that I should not reign</w> over them.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">According to all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I brought them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">even unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so do</w> they also unto thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto their voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0389">howbeit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet protest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">solemnly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto them, and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">them the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall reign</w> over them.<note type="study"><catchWord>hearken…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">obey</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>howbeit…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">notwithstanding when thou hast solemnly protested against them then thou shalt</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of him a king</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">This will be the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">over you: He will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and appoint</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04818">for himself, for his chariots</w>, and <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06571">his horsemen</w>; and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall run</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">his chariots</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And he will appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">him captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">over fifties</w>; and <transChange type="added">will set them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02758">his ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">his harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of his chariots</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">your daughters</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07548">confectionaries</w>, and <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02879">cooks</w>, and <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bakers</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">your fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">and your vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02132">and your oliveyards</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the best</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to his servants</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he will take the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of your seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">and of your vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">to his officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and to his servants</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eunuchs</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">your menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">and your maidservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and your goodliest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and your asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">to his work</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will take the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of your sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">and ye shall be his servants</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And ye shall cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of your king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye shall have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">you; and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">you in that day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">Nevertheless the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of Samuel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Nay; but we will have a king</w> over us;

verses.name: I Samuel 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">That we also may be like all the nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and that our king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, and go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">us, and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">our battles</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he rehearsed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">them in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">to Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them a king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto his city</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen281" osisID="1Sam.8"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Now there was a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07027">Kish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H022">of Abiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06872">of Zeror</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01064">of Bechorath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0647">of Aphiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">a Benjamite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of power</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a Benjamite</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the son of a man of Jemini</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">substance</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And he had a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">a choice young man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and a goodly</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a goodlier</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">than he: from his shoulders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w> <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01364">higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">than any of the people</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0860">And the asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">of Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were lost</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07027">And Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">now one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with thee, and arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">the asses</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08031">of Shalisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they found</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not: then they passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08171">of Shalim</w>, and <transChange type="added">there they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not: and he passed through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01145">of the Benjamites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they found</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> not.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06689">of Zuph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to his servant</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with him, Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us return</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">lest my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">leave</w> <transChange type="added">caring</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0860">for the asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take thought</w> for us.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto him, Behold now, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, and <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">an honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">all that he saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">surely to pass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thither; peradventure he can shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">us our way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we should go</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to his servant</w>, But, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">what shall we bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03899">for the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is spent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in our vessels</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08670">not a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: what have we?<note type="study"><catchWord>is spent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is gone out of</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>have we</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is with us?</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Behold, I have</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">here at hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07253">the fourth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">of a shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">us our way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there is found in my hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:9
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H06440">Beforetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">when a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus he spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the seer</w>: for <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">now</w> <transChange type="added">called</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">a Prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">was beforetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a Seer</w>.)

verses.name: I Samuel 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">Well</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us go</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">where the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Well said</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Thy word is good</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">young maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">unto them, Is</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the seer</w> here?<note type="study"><catchWord>the hill…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the ascent of the city</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">He is</w>; behold, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">you: make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">now, for he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>; for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high place</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>sacrifice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">feast</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">As soon as ye be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03651">ye shall straightway</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, before he go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">to the high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">because he doth bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifice</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03651 strong:H0310">afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that be bidden</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore get you up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">for about this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall find</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>this time</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to day</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when they were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">behold, Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, for to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">to the high place</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in his ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>told…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">revealed the ear of Samuel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">about this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt anoint</w> him <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he may save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06818">because their cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> unto me.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And when Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, Behold the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee of! this same shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>reign over</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">restrain in</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">to Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0335">me, I pray thee, where</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the seer’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the seer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">me unto the high place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">with me to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I will let thee go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will tell</w> thee all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0860">And as for thine asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that were lost</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">ago</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not thy mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">on them; for they are found</w>. And on whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02532">all the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">not on thee, and on all thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>three…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to day three days</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01145">not I a Benjamite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">of the smallest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04940">and my family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">wherefore then speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou so</w> to me?<note type="study"><catchWord>so…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to this word</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">and his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">them into the parlour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made them sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the chiefest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">among them that were bidden</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">about thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">unto the cook</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, of which I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee, Set</w> it by thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02876">And the cook</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">the shoulder</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon it, and set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>. And <transChange type="added">Samuel</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Behold that which is left</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04150">for unto this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hath it been kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thee since I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have invited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">So Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">with Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>left</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reserved</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 9:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they were come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">from the high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <transChange type="added">Samuel</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">with Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the top of the house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they arose early</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it came to pass about the spring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">of the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">that Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">to the top of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I may send thee away</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of them, he and Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 9:27
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as they were going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">us, (and he passed on</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thou still a while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thee the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a while</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to day</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen282" osisID="1Sam.9"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">Then Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06378">a vial</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and poured</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath anointed</w> thee <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">over his inheritance</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When thou art departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">from me</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou shalt find</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07354">by Rachel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06766">at Zelzah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">unto thee, The asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou wentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and, lo, thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the care</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">of the asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sorroweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for my son</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>care</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">business</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then shalt thou go on</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thence, and thou shalt come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0436">to the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">of Tabor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there shall meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thee three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">to Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">carrying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01423">kids</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">carrying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">loaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">carrying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">a bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they will</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">salute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thee two</w> <transChange type="added">loaves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou shalt receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>salute…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ask thee of peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">to the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05333">the garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shalt meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">a company</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">coming down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">from the high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">with a psaltery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08596">and a tabret</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02485">and a pipe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">and a harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">them; and they shall prophesy</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with them, and shalt be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">into another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0226">And let it be, when these signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are come</w> unto thee, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thee; for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>And…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And it shall come to pass, that when these signs</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do for thee as thine hand shall find</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">me to Gilgal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, I will come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">unto thee, to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou tarry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to thee, and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee what thou shalt do</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that when he had turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">his back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">from Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">him another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0226">and all those signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to pass that day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>back</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>gave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turned</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">thither to the hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02256">behold, a company</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">him; and the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">upon him, and he prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And it came to pass, when all that knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H0865">him beforetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that, behold, he prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">among the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">then the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> this <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">is come unto the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">of Kish</w>? <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">also among the prophets</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man to his neighbour</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of the same place answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, But who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04912">Therefore it became a proverb</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">also among the prophets</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from thence</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And when he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">of prophesying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">to the high place</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">uncle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto him and to his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0575">Whither</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">To seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">the asses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when we saw</w> that <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">no where</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">to Samuel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">uncle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">me, I pray thee, what Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> unto you.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">unto his uncle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">us plainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">that the asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were found</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">But of the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">of the kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">whereof Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he told</w> him not.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">together unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpeh</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of all kingdoms</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of them that oppressed</w> you:

verses.name: I Samuel 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And ye have this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who himself saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">you out of all your adversities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">and your tribulations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye have said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Nay</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">over us. Now therefore present</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">yourselves before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">by your tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and by your thousands</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And when Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">had caused all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to come near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07626">When he had caused the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04309">of Matri</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">of Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and when they sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him, he could not be found</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore they enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">further, if the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">should yet come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">thither</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Behold, he hath hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">himself among the stuff</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">him thence: and when he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he was higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">than any of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">from his shoulders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">See</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye him whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w>, that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">none like him among all the people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shouted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let the king live</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">Then Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">of the kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wrote</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w>, and laid <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-166">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-166">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with him a band of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">whose hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had touched</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">How shall this man save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us?
