And they despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">him no presents</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">But he held his peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>held…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">was as though he had been deaf</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen283" osisID="1Sam.10"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05176">Then Nahash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05984">the Ammonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">against Jabesh–gilead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05176">unto Nahash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us, and we will serve</w> thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05176">And Nahash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05984">the Ammonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">them, On this</w> <transChange type="added">condition</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I make</w> <transChange type="added">a covenant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05365" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with you, that I may thrust out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">all your right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02781">a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon all Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">unto him, Give us seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">respite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">unto all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: and then, if <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">no man to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, we will come out</w> to thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>Give…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Forbear us</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And, behold, Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">the herd</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">out of the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, What <transChange type="added">aileth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they weep</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him the tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">upon Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">those tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">and his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">a yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hewed them in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">throughout all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whosoever cometh not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so shall it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">unto his oxen</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06343">And the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">on the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">consent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as one man</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0966">them in Bezek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">were three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w>, by <transChange type="added">that time</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">be hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08668">ye shall have help</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shewed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they were glad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>help</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deliverance</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Therefore the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto you, and ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with us all that seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> unto you.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:11
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">in three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">companies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0821">watch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">the Ammonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">until the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and it came to pass, that they which remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were scattered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">so that two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of them were not left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Shall Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">over us? bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that we may put them to death</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">There shall not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and renew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the kingdom</w> there.

verses.name: I Samuel 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and there they made Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there they sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and there Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen284" osisID="1Sam.11"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto your voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in all that ye said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me, and have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> over you.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And now, behold, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you: and I am old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07867" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and grayheaded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and, behold, my sons</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">with you: and I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">you from my childhood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:3
verses.text: Behold, here I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against me before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04899">and before his anointed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07794">whose ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I taken</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02543">or whose ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I taken</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or whom have I defrauded</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom have I oppressed</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03027">or of whose hand</w> have I received <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03724">bribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therewith? and I will restore</w> it you.<note type="study"><catchWord>bribe</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ransom</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to blind…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that I should hide mine eyes at him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast not defrauded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, nor oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, neither hast thou taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of any man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">against you, and his anointed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have not found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in my hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w>, <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that advanced</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-167">and that brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-167">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>advanced</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Now therefore stand still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that I may reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with you before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of all the righteous acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to you and to your fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>righteous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousnesses</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">benefits</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03290">When Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made them dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they forgat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">of Sisera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H02674">of Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they fought</w> against them.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06252">and Ashtaroth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">but now deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of our enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will serve</w> thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03378">Jerubbaal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0917">and Bedan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03316">and Jephthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of your enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye dwelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safe</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when ye saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05176">that Nahash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against you, ye said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto me, Nay; but a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">over us: when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">your king</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Now therefore behold the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye have chosen</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom ye have desired</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03068">and, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> over you.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If ye will fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and not rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">then shall both ye and also the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that reigneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">over you continue following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>commandment</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>continue…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be after</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye will not obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">against the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">then shall the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> be against you, as <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">against your fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01571">Now therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before your eyes</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02406">not wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">and rain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">that ye may perceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that your wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in asking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">you a king</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">So Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">and rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: for we have added</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">unto all our sins</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">us a king</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all this wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet turn not aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all your heart</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 12:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And turn ye not aside</w>: for <transChange type="added">then should ye go</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">vain</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which cannot profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor deliver</w>; for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08414">vain</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">for his great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sake: because it hath pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">you his people</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0595">Moreover as for me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">God forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in ceasing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for you: but I will teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">you the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Only fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">him in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all your heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">for consider</w> how great <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath done</w> for you.<note type="study"><catchWord>how…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">what a great thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 12:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">But if ye shall still</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do wickedly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">ye shall be consumed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">both ye and your king</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen285" osisID="1Sam.12"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H01121">one year</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when he had reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>reigned one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the son of one year in his reigning</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">him three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <transChange type="added">whereof</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">were with Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04363">in Michmash</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">and in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">were with Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03499">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to his tent</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03129">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">the garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01387">in Geba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">Let the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Geba</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">a garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">also was had in abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were called together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">did stink</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">shore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in multitude</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H04363">in Michmash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06926">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01007">from Beth–aven</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">When the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they were in a strait</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were distressed</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H05971">then the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">did hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">themselves in caves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02337">and in thickets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05553">and in rocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06877">and in high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0953">and in pits</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:7
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">some of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05680">the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">and Gilead</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">As for Saul</w>, he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01537">yet in Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him trembling</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>followed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">trembled after him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03176 strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">And he tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">according to the set time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">that Samuel</w> <transChange type="added">had appointed</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08050">but Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">not to Gilgal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">were scattered</w> from him.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">to me, and peace offerings</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">behold, Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, that he might salute</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>salute</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bless</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What hast thou done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were scattered</w> from me, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou camest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not within the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">appointed</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04363">at Michmash</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">I, The Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">now upon me to Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I have not made supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0662" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I forced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">myself therefore, and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">intreated the face</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Thou hast done foolishly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee: for now would the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have established</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">thy kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04467">But now thy kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not continue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">him a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">after his own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath commanded</w> him <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hast not kept</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gat him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">from Gilgal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">unto Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">present</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">with him, about six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them, abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">in Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06430">but the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04363">in Michmash</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Gibeah</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Geba</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And the spoilers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">in three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">companies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">company</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto the way</w> <transChange type="added">that leadeth to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06084">Ophrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07777">of Shual</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">company</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01032">Beth–horon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">company</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">to the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H06650">of Zeboim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">toward the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02796">Now there was no smith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06430">for the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">Lest the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">swords</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">or spears</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">But all the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">to the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03913" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sharpen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04282">his share</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0855">and his coulter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07134">and his axe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04281">and his mattock</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310 strong:H06477">Yet they had a file</w> <w lemma="strong:H04281">for the mattocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0855">and for the coulters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07053 strong:H07969">and for the forks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07134">and for the axes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to sharpen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01861">the goads</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a file</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a file with mouths</rdg>, or Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a pim, a third of a shekel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sharpen</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">So it came to pass in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">that there was neither sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">nor spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of any of the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">with Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">and Jonathan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">but with Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">and with Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was there found</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04673">And the garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04569">to the passage</w> <w lemma="strong:H04363">of Michmash</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>garrison</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">standing camp</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen286" osisID="1Sam.13"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Now it came to pass upon a day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">that Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">to the Philistines’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04673">garrison</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01975 strong:H05676">on the other side</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But he told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">not his father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it came…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">there was a day</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the uttermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">part of Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">under a pomegranate tree</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04051">in Migron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">about six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0281">And Ahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0350">I–chabod’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">of Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">of Eli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">an ephod</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">not that Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was gone</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ahiah</catchWord>: called <rdg type="x-identity">Ahimelech</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04569">And between the passages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">by which Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">unto the Philistines’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04673">garrison</w>, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08127">a sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the one side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">and a sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0949">Bozez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05573">Seneh</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08127">The forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04690">situate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04363">Michmash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">Gibeah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forefront</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tooth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04673">unto the garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of these uncircumcised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">it may be that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will work</w> for us: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04622">no restraint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">by many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">or by few</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Do</w> all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> thee; behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with thee according to thy heart</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, we will pass over</w> unto <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and we will discover</w> ourselves unto them.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thus unto us, Tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">until we come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to you; then we will stand still</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in our place, and will not go up</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>Tarry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be still</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thus, Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto us; then we will go up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into our hand</w>: and this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> unto us.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And both</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of them discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04673">themselves unto the garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05680">Behold, the Hebrews</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02356">out of the holes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">where they had hid</w> themselves.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04675">of the garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his armourbearer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to us, and we will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">you a thing</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03129">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto his armourbearer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03129">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">climbed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">upon his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and upon his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">Jonathan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">And that first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">which Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">was about twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">within as it were an half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04618">acre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of land</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06776">a yoke</w> <transChange type="added">of oxen might plow</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">half a furrow of an acre of land</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02731">And there was trembling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and among all the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04673">the garrison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and the spoilers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they also trembled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">quaked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">so it was a very great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02731">trembling</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a trembling of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01995">and, behold, the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">melted away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on beating down</w> <transChange type="added">one another</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with him, Number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who is gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from us. And when they had numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">behold, Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his armourbearer</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> not <transChange type="added">there</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">unto Ahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0727">For the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">was at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And it came to pass, while Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">that the noise</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">and increased</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>noise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tumult</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">with him assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves, and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and, behold, every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">was against his fellow</w>, <transChange type="added">and there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">discomfiture</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>assembled…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were cried together</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05680">Moreover the Hebrews</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06430">were with the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0865">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">with them into the camp</w> <transChange type="added">from the country</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, even they also <transChange type="added">turned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to be with the Israelites</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">with Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">and Jonathan</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Likewise all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">which had hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">themselves in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">that the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">even they also followed hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">them in the battle</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">and the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01007">unto Beth–aven</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were distressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">for Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0422" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">had adjured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that eateth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that I may be avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on mine enemies</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">So none of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">tasted</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:25
verses.text: And all <transChange type="added">they of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">to a wood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01706">and there was honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the ground</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And when the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">into the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">behold, the honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H01982">dropped</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but no man put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to his mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">the oath</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03129">But Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">not when his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-168">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-168">with the oath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherefore he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the rod</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706 strong:H03295">it in an honeycomb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to his mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were enlightened</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-169">straitly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-169">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with an oath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that eateth</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were faint</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>faint</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">weary</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">I pray you, how mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have been enlightened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I tasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">of this honey</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">How much more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">if haply</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">freely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they found</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for had there not been now a much greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">among the Philistines</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 14:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04363">from Michmash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0357">to Aijalon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">were very</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">faint</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H05860" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8799">flew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">upon the spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and calves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did eat</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">Behold, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in that they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have transgressed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">roll</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto me this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>transgressed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dealt treacherously</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">yourselves among the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto them, Bring me hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">his ox</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">his sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slay</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">here, and eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with the blood</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">his ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with him</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>with him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">the same was the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the same…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that altar he began to build unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">them until the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let us not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them. And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">whatsoever seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee. Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us draw near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">counsel of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him not that day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Draw ye near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">hither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06438">all the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">this sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">hath been this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">corners</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:39
verses.text: For, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which saveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">though it be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">in Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>. But <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not a man among all the people</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">answered</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">he unto all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">Be ye on one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">and I and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">will be on the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">side</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">what seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> unto thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Therefore Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">a perfect</w> <transChange type="added">lot</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were taken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">but the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">escaped</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Give…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shew the innocent</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>escaped</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Cast</w> <transChange type="added">lots</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03129">between me and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03129">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:43
