verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">to Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me what thou hast done</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03129">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I did but</w> <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">with the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the rod</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02009">lo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I must die</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do so</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and more also</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">Jonathan</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">Shall Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02486">God forbid</w>: <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08185">there shall not one hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rescued</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he died</w> not.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to their own place</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:47
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">So Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against all his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">against Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0123">and against Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and against the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and against the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and whithersoever he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">himself, he vexed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">an host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">the Amalekites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that spoiled</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>gathered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wrought mightily</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">were Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03440">and Ishui</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04444">and Melchi–shua</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <transChange type="added">were these</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01067">of the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04764">Merab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of the younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">Michal</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 14:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0293">Ahinoam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0290">of Ahimaaz</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of his host</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">uncle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abner</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Abiner</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 14:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07027">And Kish</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05369">and Ner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">of Abner</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H022">of Abiel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 14:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02389">And there was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">against the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">any strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">or any valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he took</w> him unto him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen287" osisID="1Sam.14"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to anoint</w> thee <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now therefore hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thou unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I remember</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06002">which Amalek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how he laid</w> <transChange type="added">wait</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">for him in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">from Egypt</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all that they have, and spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them not; but slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05768">infant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and suckling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">and sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">camel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">and ass</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-170">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-170">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02923">them in Telaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">footmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693 strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8799">and laid wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valley</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>laid…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fought</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">unto the Kenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get you down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">the Amalekites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest I destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you with them: for ye shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07017">So the Kenites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06003">the Amalekites</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02341">from Havilah</w> <transChange type="added">until</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07793">to Shur</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H090">Agag</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">But Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H090">Agag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04315">and the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and of the oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04932">and of the fatlings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03733">and the lambs</w>, and all <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and would</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">them: but every thing</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05240">vile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and refuse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that they destroyed utterly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fatlings</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">second sort</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Then came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Samuel 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">It repenteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me that I have set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he is turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, and hath not performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my commandments</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all night</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And when Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">to Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and, behold, he set him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">a place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and is gone about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto him, Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, What <transChange type="added">meaneth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">then this bleating</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in mine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the lowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I hear</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06003">them from the Amalekites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04315">the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and of the oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">we have utterly destroyed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">Then Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Stay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">to me this night</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto him, Say on</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, When thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine own sight</w>, <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> thou not <transChange type="added">made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee on a journey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and utterly destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">the sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">the Amalekites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">against them until they be consumed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they consume them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore then didst thou not obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05860" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but didst fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">upon the spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, I have obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H090">Agag</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">the Amalekites</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">But the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of the spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">of the things which should have been utterly destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">as great</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">in burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">and sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as in obeying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Behold, to obey</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">than sacrifice</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">than the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04805">For rebellion</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">of witchcraft</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06484" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and stubbornness</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08655">and idolatry</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he hath also rejected</w> thee from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>witchcraft</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">divination</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and thy words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">my sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">with me, that I may worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee: for thou hast rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee from being king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And as Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">turned about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he laid hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">upon the skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">of his mantle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it rent</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04468">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">it to a neighbour</w> of thine, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> than thou.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05331">And also the Strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will not lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor repent</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">not a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that he should repent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Strength</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Eternity</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Victory</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 15:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w>: <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">me now, I pray thee, before the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and before Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">with me, that I may worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">So Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring ye hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H090">to me Agag</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of the Amalekites</w>. <w lemma="strong:H090">And Agag</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04574">unto him delicately</w>. <w lemma="strong:H090">And Agag</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0403">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">the bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is past</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">As thy sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">hath made women</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">childless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">so shall thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be childless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">among women</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08158" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-171">hewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H090">Agag</w> <w lemma="strong:H08158" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-171">in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">in Gilgal</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">Then Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">to Ramah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 15:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of his death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03588">nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">for Saul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that he had made Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen288" osisID="1Sam.15"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">How long wilt thou mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">for Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seeing I have rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him from reigning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">thine horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">thee to Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01022">the Beth–lehemite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have provided</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">me a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among his sons</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How can I go</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07586">if Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he will kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me. And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05697 strong:H01241">an heifer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with thee</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in thine hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">to the sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee what thou shalt do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt anoint</w> unto me <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom I name</w> unto thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the town</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at his coming</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">thou peaceably</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>coming</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meeting</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peaceably</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yourselves, and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">with me to the sacrifice</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">them to the sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when they were come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0446">on Eliab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Surely the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> before him.<note type="study"><catchWord>Eliab</catchWord>: called <rdg type="x-identity">Elihu</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">unto Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">not on his countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01364">or on the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">of his stature</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I have refused</w> him: for <transChange type="added">the <divineName>Lord</divineName> seeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">not as man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">for man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">on the outward appearance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">on the heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>outward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03448">Then Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H041">Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made him pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Neither hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">chosen</w> this.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03448">Then Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08048">made Shammah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to pass by</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Neither hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">chosen</w> this.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shammah</catchWord>: Shimeah, also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shimma</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03448">Again, Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">made seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">unto Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not chosen</w> these.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">unto Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Are here all</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">children</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">There remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">yet the youngest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, he keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">unto Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: for we will not sit down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till he come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06311">hither</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>down</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">round</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him in</w>. Now he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0132">ruddy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05973">withal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">of a beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07210">to look to</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">anoint</w> him: for this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he.<note type="study"><catchWord>of a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fair of eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">Then Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">him in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">upon David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">forward</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08050">So Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">to Ramah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07307">But the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">from Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">troubled</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>troubled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">terrified</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto him, Behold now, an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">troubleth</w> thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let our lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now command</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, to seek out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">player</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">on an harp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">and it shall come to pass, when the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">is upon thee, that he shall play</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt be well</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Provide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me now a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that can play</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> to me.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01022">the Beth–lehemite</w>, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in playing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiant man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and prudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in matters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08389">and a comely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>matters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">speech</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 16:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">Wherefore Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">unto Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">me David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with the sheep</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03448">And Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">an ass</w> <transChange type="added">laden</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04997">and a bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and a</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795 strong:H01423">kid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">him greatly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he became his armourbearer</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">to Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Let David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me; for he hath found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 16:23
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the <transChange type="added">evil</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">was upon Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">an harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and played</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">so Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07304" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was refreshed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and was well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> from him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen289" osisID="1Sam.16"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">Now the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">their armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07755">at Shochoh</w>, which <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07755">between Shochoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05825">and Azekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0658">in Ephes–dammim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ephes–dammim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the coast of Dammim, called Pas–dammim</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">by the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and set the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ranged the battle</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">on a mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">on the one side, and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">on a mountain</w> on the other side: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">a valley</w> between them.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01143 strong:H0376">a champion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">out of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">named</w> <w lemma="strong:H01555">Goliath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01363">whose height</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02239">and a span</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:5
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03553">an helmet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08302">with a coat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07193">of mail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04948">and the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08302">of the coat</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>armed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">clothed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04697">greaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon his legs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03591">and a target</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">between his shoulders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>target</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gorget</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671 strong:H06086" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">And the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">of his spear</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a weaver’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04500">beam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02595">and his spear’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">head</w> <transChange type="added">weighed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and one bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">a shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">unto the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Why are ye come out</w> to set <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in array</w>? <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06430">not I a Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and ye servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">you a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for you, and let him come down</w> to me.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with me, and to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">me, then will we be your servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but if I prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against him, and kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">him, then shall ye be our servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> us.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I defy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that we may fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">When Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">those words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they were dismayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">Now David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0673 strong:H0376">of that Ephrathite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063 strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem–judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03448">Jesse</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08083">and he had eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">among men</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">an old man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of his three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0446">Eliab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04932">and next</w> <w lemma="strong:H041">unto him Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08048">Shammah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">the youngest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">and the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">But David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">from Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">at Beth–lehem</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06150" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and presented</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">himself forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03448">And Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">now for thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0374">an ephah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">of this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07039">parched</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and these ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">loaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and run</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to thy brethren</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">these ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02757 strong:H02461">cheeses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto the captain</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">how thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">fare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06161">their pledge</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cheeses</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cheeses of milk</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of a thousand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Now Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and they, and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fighting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with a keeper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03448">as Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">to the trench</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">as the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was going forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">to the fight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for the battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trench</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">place of the carriage</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fight</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">battle array</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">place of fight</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">For Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had put the battle in array</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04634">army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">army</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his carriage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of the carriage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">into the army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965 strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his carriage</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the vessels from upon him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>saluted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">asked his brethren of peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And as he talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them, behold, there came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01143 strong:H0376">the champion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01555">Goliath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04630 strong:H04634" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">out of the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">according to the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and were sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from his face</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Have ye seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that is come up</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">surely to defy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is he come up</w>: and it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will enrich</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">him with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">him his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">What shall be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01975">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and taketh away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>? for who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06189">this uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he should defy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 17:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him after this manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">So shall it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that killeth</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0446">And Eliab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">his eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0446">and Eliab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">against David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why camest thou down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hither? and with whom hast thou left</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">those</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02087">thy pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">and the naughtiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of thine heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou art come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mightest see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What have I now done</w>? <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not a cause</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 17:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">from him</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">after the same manner</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">after the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">manner</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>manner</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And when the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">which David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they rehearsed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sent</w> for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>sent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">took him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">Let no man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">because of him; thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with this Philistine</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou art not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">against this Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> with him: for thou <transChange type="added">art but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and he a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from his youth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01677">and a bear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02089 strong:H07716" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">a lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">out of the flock</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>lamb</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kid</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him, and delivered</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of his mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against me, I caught</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02206">by his beard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him, and slew</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">both the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01677">and the bear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06189">and this uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">shall be as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of them, seeing he hath defied</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">moreover, The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me out of the paw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of the lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and out of the paw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01677">of the bear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of this Philistine</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> be with thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">with his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06959">an helmet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also he armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08302">him with a coat of mail</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>armed David…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">clothed David with his clothes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">upon his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he assayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for he had not proved</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with these; for I have not proved</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">put</w> them off him.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">his staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">him five</w> <w lemma="strong:H02512">smooth</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">out of the brook</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them in a shepherd’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">bag</w> <w lemma="strong:H03219">which he had, even in a scrip</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07050">and his sling</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">to the Philistine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brook</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>bag</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on</w> <w lemma="strong:H07131">and drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">the shield</w> <transChange type="added">went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And when the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">looked about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he disdained</w> him: for he was <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0132">and ruddy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">and of a fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">countenance</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03611">I a dog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04731">to me with staves</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">by his gods</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:44
