verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to me, and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">thy flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">unto the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and to the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">to the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to me with a sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02595">and with a spear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03591">and with a shield</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to thee in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">of the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom thou hast defied</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into mine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee, and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">thine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee; and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">the carcases</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">unto the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and to the wild beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">that all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deliver…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut thee up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 17:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all this assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">saveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">not with sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">and spear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">for the battle</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you into our hands</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And it came to pass, when the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">toward the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in his bag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">thence a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07049" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and slang</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">in his forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">that the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">into his forehead</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07050">with a sling</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and with a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> him; but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">no sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Therefore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">upon the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">it out of the sheath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">thereof, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">therewith. And when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">their champion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they fled</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shouted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until thou come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">to the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and to the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">of Ekron</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02491">And the wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08189">to Shaaraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01661">even unto Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06138">and unto Ekron</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from chasing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08155" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">their tents</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">it to Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his armour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in his tent</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:55
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">unto Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">whose son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">this youth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">tell</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou whose son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05958">the stripling</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">with the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 17:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to him, Whose son</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> thou, <transChange type="added">thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01022">the Beth–lehemite</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen290" osisID="1Sam.17"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, when he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">that the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was knit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">with the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him as his own soul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and would let</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him go no more home</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">Then Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">because he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him as his own soul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">stripped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">himself of the robe</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">it to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04055">and his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">even to his sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">and to his bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02289">and to his girdle</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">whithersoever Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">behaved himself wisely</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">him over the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he was accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and also in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>behaved…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prospered</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass as they came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">that the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of all cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">singing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04246">and dancing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08596">with tabrets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07991">and with instruments of musick</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Philistine</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Philistines</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>instruments…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">three stringed instruments</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <transChange type="added">one another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">as they played</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">his thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">his ten thousands</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have ascribed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">ten thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and to me they have ascribed</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousands</w>: and <transChange type="added">what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04410">can he have more but the kingdom</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>displeased him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was evil in his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05770" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">eyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">and forward</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">that the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">upon Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and he prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">played</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at other times</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02595">a javelin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">in Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">the javelin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">even to the wall</w> <transChange type="added">with it</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">avoided out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">twice</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was with him, and was departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">from Saul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Therefore Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him from him, and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">him his captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over a thousand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">behaved himself wisely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all his ways</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>behaved…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prospered</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Wherefore when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-172">that he behaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">himself very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-172">wisely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">But all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">Behold my elder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04764">Merab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thee to wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02428 strong:H01121">only be thou valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">for me, and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battles</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">For Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">Let not mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">be upon him, but let the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> be upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>valiant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a son of valour</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, Who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I? and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02860">that I should be son in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">But it came to pass at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04764">when Merab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should have been given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that she was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05741">unto Adriel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04259">the Meholathite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04324">And Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was right in his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">him her, that she may be a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to him, and that the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">may be against him. Wherefore Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">Thou shalt this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be my son in law</w> in <transChange type="added">the one of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the twain</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03909">secretly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Behold, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">in thee, and all his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">love</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee: now therefore be the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">son in law</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">those words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">Seemeth</w> it to you <transChange type="added">a</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">light</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to be a king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">son in law</w>, seeing that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07034" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and lightly esteemed</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">On this manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>On…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">According to these words</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">desireth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04119">not any dowry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">but an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">foreskins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemies</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">But Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to make David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And when his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H01697 strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">well to be the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">son in law</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not expired</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>expired</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fulfilled</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Wherefore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">he and his men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">their foreskins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they gave them in full tale</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that he might be the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">son in law</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">him Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04324">Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loved</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was yet the more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">became David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Then the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01767">and it came to pass, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they went forth</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behaved himself more wisely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">than all the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">so that his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set by</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">precious</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen291" osisID="1Sam.18"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">to Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and to all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they should kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">But Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">in David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">to thyself until the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in a secret</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and hide</w> thyself:

verses.name: I Samuel 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> where thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">of thee; and what</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I will tell</w> thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto him, Let not the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">against his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">against David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath not sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">against thee, and because his works</w> <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">to thee-ward very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he did put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou sawest</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and didst rejoice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherefore then wilt thou sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">against innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without a cause</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">he shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be slain</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him all those things</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and he was in his presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H0865">as in times past</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in times…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yesterday, third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">them with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his face</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">And the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">was upon Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">with his javelin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">played</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">even to the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">with the javelin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06362" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he slipped away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">out of Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">the javelin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">into the wall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him, and to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">him in the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04324">and Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">If thou save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">to night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">thou shalt be slain</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04324">So Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-173">let</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-173">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">through a window</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and escaped</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04324">And Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08655">an image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04296">in the bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03523">a pillow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04763">for his bolster</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">with a cloth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>image</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">teraphim</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she said</w>, He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sick</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">to me in the bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I may slay</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And when the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were come in</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08655">an image</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">in the bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03523">with a pillow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of goats’</w> <transChange type="added">hair</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04763">for his bolster</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">unto Michal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Why hast thou deceived me so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that he is escaped</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04324">And Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto me, Let me go</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">why should I kill</w> thee?

verses.name: I Samuel 19:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">to Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">to Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">him all that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">to him. And he and Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05121">in Naioth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Behold, David</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05121">at Naioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03862">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">prophesying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">over them, the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">was upon the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they also prophesied</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">likewise. And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">time, and they prophesied</w> also.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">he also to Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">to a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">well</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07906">in Sechu</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0375">Where</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w>? And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05121">at Naioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05121">thither to Naioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was upon him also, and he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prophesied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05121">to Naioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he stripped off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">also</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in like manner, and lay down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and all that night</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore they say</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">also among the prophets</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>lay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fell</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen292" osisID="1Sam.19"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05121">from Naioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What have I done</w>? what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">mine iniquity</w>? and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">my sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that he seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02486">unto him, God forbid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">behold, my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">either great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">or small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but that he will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">it me: and why should my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> from me? it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">so</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">uncover mine ear</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">moreover, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">Let not Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">this, lest he be grieved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0199">but truly</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06587">but a step</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">between me and death</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">Whatsoever thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">desireth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will even do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> for thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>Whatsoever…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Say what is thy mind and I will do</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>desireth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">speaketh</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">thinketh</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">unto Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">Behold, to morrow</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">the new moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and I should not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at meat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but let me go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that I may hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">myself in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">unto the third</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">If thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">miss</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, then say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">earnestly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">asked</w> <transChange type="added">leave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of me that he might run</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">his city</w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a yearly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">there for all the family</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sacrifice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">feast</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he say</w> thus, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">shall have peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but if he be very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is determined</w> by him.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thou shalt deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">into a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">with thee: notwithstanding, if there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in me iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">me to thy father</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">Far be it from thee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for if I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">by my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon thee, then would not I tell</w> it thee?

verses.name: I Samuel 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">to Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Who shall tell</w> me? or what <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">thee roughly</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 20:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of them into the field</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when I have sounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">about to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">any time</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">if there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">toward David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I then send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not unto thee, and shew</w> it thee;<note type="study"><catchWord>sounded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">searched</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">uncover thine ear</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">so</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and much more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">to Jonathan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but if it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <transChange type="added">to do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thee evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">it thee, and send thee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou mayest go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01">be with thee, as he hath been with my father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">uncover thine ear</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">And thou shalt not only while yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">I live</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">me the kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I die</w> not:

verses.name: I Samuel 20:15
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt not cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">no, not when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hath cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">So Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <transChange type="added">a covenant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Let the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">even require</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">caused David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">because he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: for he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">him as he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by his love toward him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">Then Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">the new moon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and thou shalt be missed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">because thy seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will be empty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>empty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">missed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:19
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast stayed three days</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">quickly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">where thou didst hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thyself when</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the business</w> was <transChange type="added">in hand</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0237">Ezel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>quickly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">diligently</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">greatly</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>when the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the day of the business</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ezel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that sheweth the way</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I will shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">on the side</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">as though I shot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">at a mark</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And, behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a lad</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">the arrows</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If I expressly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02671">Behold, the arrows</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">on this side of thee, take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">them; then come</w> thou: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to thee, and no hurt</w>; <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>no hurt</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not any thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05958">thus unto the young man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02671">Behold, the arrows</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01973">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee; go thy way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath sent thee away</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:23
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">as touching</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou and I have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05704">between thee and me for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">himself in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02320">and when the new moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was come, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sat him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">meat</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">upon his seat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">as at other times</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04186">upon a seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">by the wall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">and Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">by Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was empty</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Nevertheless Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">not any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he thought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04745">Something hath befallen</w> him, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01115">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>; surely he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">not clean</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was empty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">unto Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">to meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08543">neither yesterday</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">nor to day</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 20:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">earnestly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">asked</w> <transChange type="added">leave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05978">of me</w> <transChange type="added">to go</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01035">to Beth–lehem</w>:

verses.name: I Samuel 20:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Let me go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">I pray thee; for our family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">hath a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">and my brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath commanded</w> me <transChange type="added">to be there</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and now, if I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let me get away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">against Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto him, Thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04780">rebellious</w> <transChange type="added">woman</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do not I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou hast chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">to thine own confusion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01322">and unto the confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06172">nakedness</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Thou perverse rebel</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Son of perverse rebellion</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">liveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">upon the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt not be established</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">nor thy kingdom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Wherefore now send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194 strong:H01121">him unto me, for he shall surely die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is the son of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what hath he done</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 20:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">a javelin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">at him to smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">him: whereby Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">that it was determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">So Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">from the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H02750">in fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he was grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">because his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had done him shame</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">that Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">at the time appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">and a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">lad</w> with him.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto his lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Run</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">now the arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which I shoot</w>. <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">as the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">ran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02678">an arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">beyond</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>beyond…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to pass over him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And when the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02678">of the arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">which Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had shot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02678">not the arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01973">beyond</w> thee?

verses.name: I Samuel 20:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04120">Make speed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">not. And Jonathan’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">gathered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02678 strong:H02671" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to his master</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">But the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">not any thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03083">only Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his artillery</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto his lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">carry</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>artillery</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">instruments</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his lad</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the lad that was his</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 20:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">as soon as the lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was gone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arose</w> out of <transChange type="added">a place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">on his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">himself three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">with another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">until David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">exceeded</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 20:42
