verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">forasmuch as we have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of us in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">be between me and thee, and between my seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">and thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forasmuch…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the <divineName>Lord</divineName> be witness of that which</rdg> etc</note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen293" osisID="1Sam.20"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05011">to Nob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">to Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0288">and Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at the meeting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, Why <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thou alone, and no man</w> with thee?<note type="study"><catchWord>Ahimelech</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Ahiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">unto Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">me a business</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto me, Let no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the business</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereabout I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, and what I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">thee: and I have appointed</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06423">to such</w> <w lemma="strong:H0492">and such</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Now therefore what is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under thine hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <transChange type="added">loaves of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">or what there is present</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02455">no common</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">but there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05288">if the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">themselves at least</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">from women</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">unto him, Of a truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">from us about these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08543">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">since I came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">are holy</w>, and <transChange type="added">the bread is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in a manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02455">common</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, though it were sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in the vessel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yea…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">especially when this day there is other sanctified in the vessel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">So the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">him hallowed</w> <transChange type="added">bread</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03899">for there was no bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H03899">there but the shewbread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when it was taken away</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Now a certain man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">there that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">detained</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01673">Doeg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0130">an Edomite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H047">the chiefest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the herdmen</w> that <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">unto Ahimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">And is there</w> <w lemma="strong:H0371">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">here under thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">or sword</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have neither brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">nor my weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">because the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">business</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">required</w> <w lemma="strong:H05169" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">haste</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">The sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01555">of Goliath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom thou slewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w>, behold, it <transChange type="added">is here</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03874" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">wrapped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">in a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou wilt take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">that, take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0312">no other</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">that here</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">none like that; give</w> it me.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">to Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">of Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">not this David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did they not sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">one to another of him</w> <w lemma="strong:H04246">in dances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">his thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">his ten thousands</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">his behaviour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">them, and feigned himself mad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08427" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and scrabbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">on the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07388">and let his spittle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">upon his beard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scrabbled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">made marks</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lo, ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07696" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">is mad</w>: wherefore <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have ye brought</w> him to me?<note type="study"><catchWord>is mad</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">playeth the mad man</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02638">Have I need</w> <w lemma="strong:H07696" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">of mad men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that ye have brought</w> this <transChange type="added">fellow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07696" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to play the mad man</w> in my presence? shall this <transChange type="added">fellow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into my house</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen294" osisID="1Sam.21"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thence, and escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">to the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05725">Adullam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">and when his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">and all his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went down</w> thither to him.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And every one</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04689">in distress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05378" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">in debt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H04751">discontented</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">themselves unto him; and he became a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">over them: and there were with him about four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was in debt</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">had a creditor</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>discontented</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter of soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708">thence to Mizpeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Let my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and my mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, come forth</w>, <transChange type="added">and be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you, till I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">what God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will do</w> for me.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">with him all the while</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">was in the hold</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05030">And the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">not in the hold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">into the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02802">of Hareth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">When Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was discovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">with him, (now Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0815">under a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">in Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02595">having his spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and all his servants</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">standing</w> about him;)<note type="study"><catchWord>tree…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grove in a high place</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">about him, Hear now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">ye Benjamites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">will the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">every one of you fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">you all captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">That all of you have conspired</w> against me, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me that my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath made a league</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none of you that is sorry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for me, or sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me that my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath stirred up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against me, to lie in wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>sheweth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">uncovereth mine ear</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01673">Doeg</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">the Edomite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which was set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">over the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">coming</w> <w lemma="strong:H05011">to Nob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0288">to Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for him, and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">him victuals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">him the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01555">of Goliath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and all his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05011">in Nob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all of them to the king</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">now, thou son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, Here I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Here…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Behold me</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Why have ye conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against me, thou and the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in that thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">him bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and a sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and hast enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for him, that he should rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against me, to lie in wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0288">Then Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, And who <transChange type="added">is so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">among all thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">as David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">which is the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02860">son in law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04928">at thy bidding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and is honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Did I then</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02486">for him? be it far from me</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">let not the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">impute</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servant</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of all this, less</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">or more</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>less…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">little or great</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0288">Ahimelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">thou, and all thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">unto the footmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">about him, Turn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">because their hand</w> also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and because they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when he fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did not shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">it to me. But the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">upon the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>footmen</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">guard</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">runners</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01673">to Doeg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou, and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">upon the priests</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01673">And Doeg</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">the Edomite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">upon the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that did wear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">a linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">ephod</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05011">And Nob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">he with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">both men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05768">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sucklings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07716">and sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">of Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">named</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">Abiathar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H054">And Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">unto Abiathar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I knew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01673">when Doeg</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">the Edomite</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">there, that he would surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have occasioned</w> <transChange type="added">the death</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of all the persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou with me, fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">not: for he that seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>: but with me thou <transChange type="added">shalt be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04931">in safeguard</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen295" osisID="1Sam.22"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">Behold, the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">against Keilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they rob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">the threshingfloors</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Therefore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">these Philistines</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">Keilah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">unto him, Behold, we be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">here in Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how much more then if we come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">to Keilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04634">against the armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet again</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">to Keilah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">to Keilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">their cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">them with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">of Keilah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H054">And it came to pass, when Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">of Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">to Keilah</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he came down</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0646">an ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">to Keilah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into mine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he is shut in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into a town</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">that hath gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">and bars</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-174">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-174">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">to Keilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">secretly practised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him; and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">to Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">to Keilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> for my sake.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01167">Will the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">of Keilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into his hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07586">will Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">as thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">I beseech thee, tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will come down</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">Will the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">of Keilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">me and my men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, They will deliver <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deliver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">about six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">out of Keilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">whithersoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they could go</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">from Keilah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he forbare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go forth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04679">in strong holds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in a mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02128">of Ziph</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him every day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">but God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him not into his hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02128">of Ziph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02793">in a wood</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02793">into the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in God</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not: for the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; and thou shalt be king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04932">and I shall be next</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto thee; and that also Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And they two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H02793">in the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02130">the Ziphites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Doth not David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04679">himself with us in strong holds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02793">in the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">in the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02444">of Hachilah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">of Jeshimon</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>on…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">on the right hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jeshimon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the wilderness</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Now therefore, O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0185">according to all the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come down</w>; and our part <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for ye have compassion</w> on me.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">I pray you, prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yet, and know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">where his haunt</w> is, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him there: for it is told</w> me <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he dealeth very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">subtilly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>haunt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">foot shall be</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore, and take knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04224">of all the lurking places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">where he hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">himself, and come ye again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to me with the certainty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I will search</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">him out throughout all the thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02128">to Ziph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04584">of Maon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06160">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">of Jeshimon</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">also and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherefore he came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">into a rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04584">of Maon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04584">of Maon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from the rock</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">on that side</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02648" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">made haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to get away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">for Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-175">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-175">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> them.

verses.name: I Samuel 23:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">a messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee, and come</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06430">for the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have invaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>invaded…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spread themselves upon</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Wherefore Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from pursuing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05555">Sela–hammahlekoth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sela–hammahlekoth</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The rock of divisions</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 23:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thence, and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04679">in strong holds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05872">at En–gedi</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen296" osisID="1Sam.23"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And it came to pass, when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Behold, David</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05872">of En–gedi</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>following</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03277">of the wild goats</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H01448">to the sheepcotes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, where <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04631">a cave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">in the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">of the cave</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto him, Behold the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thee, Behold, I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou mayest do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him as it shall seem good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto thee</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">the skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03909">privily</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Saul’s…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the robe which was Saul’s</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass afterward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, because he had cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">skirt</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto his men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02486">forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> against him, seeing he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04899">the anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08156" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them not to rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">against Saul</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">But Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">out of the cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> on <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stayed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afterward, and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">of the cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">him, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stooped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">with his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> himself.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore hearest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">thou men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Behold, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thy hurt</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">how that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in the cave</w>: and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bade</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">kill</w> thee: but <transChange type="added">mine eye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; and I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">against my lord</w>; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Moreover, my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yea, see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">the skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">of thy robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in my hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for in that I cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">the skirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">of thy robe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee not, know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou and see</w> that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">neither evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">nor transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I have not sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06658" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thee; yet thou huntest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> it.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">between me and thee, and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me of thee: but mine hand</w> shall not be upon thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">As saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">the proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06931">of the ancients</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07562">Wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">proceedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">from the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">but mine hand</w> shall not be upon thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom is the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come out</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whom dost thou pursue</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">dog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H06550">flea</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01781">therefore be judge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">between me and thee, and see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">my cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me out of thine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deliver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judge</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And it came to pass, when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">this thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">more righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">than I: for thou hast rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">me good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereas I have rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thee evil</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how that thou hast dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with me: forasmuch as when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me into thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou killedst</w> me not.<note type="study"><catchWord>delivered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">For if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">will he let him go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">away</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thee good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for that thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto me this day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And now, behold, I know well</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and that the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">now therefore unto me by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">that thou wilt not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">my seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and that thou wilt not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">out of my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gat them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">unto the hold</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen297" osisID="1Sam.24"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lamented</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him in his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">at Ramah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">of Paran</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:2
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04584">in Maon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">whose possessions</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03760">in Carmel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and he had three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">goats</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and he was shearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">his sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">in Carmel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>possessions</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">business</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">Now the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05037">Nabal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H026">Abigail</w>: and <transChange type="added">she was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03303">and of a beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H08389">countenance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but the man</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07186">churlish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">in his doings</w>; and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03614">of the house of Caleb</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">that Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did shear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">his sheep</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">to Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">to Nabal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965 strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and greet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">him in my name</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>greet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ask him in my name of peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to him that liveth</w> <transChange type="added">in prosperity</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">both to thee, and peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">and peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> unto all that thou hast.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And now I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou hast shearers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">now thy shepherds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which were with us, we hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">them not, neither was there ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">missing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto them, all the while</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">they were in Carmel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hurt</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shamed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">thy young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">thee. Wherefore let the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for we come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, whatsoever cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">to Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to all those words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ceased</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ceased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rested</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05037">And Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>? and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there be many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">now a days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that break away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his master</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Shall I then take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">my bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and my water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02878">and my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for my shearers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I know</w> not whence they <transChange type="added">be</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>flesh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">slaughter</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him all those sayings</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto his men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gird ye on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they girded on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also girded on</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">about four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">by the stuff</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">But one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H026">Abigail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05037">Nabal’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Behold, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">out of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to salute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our master</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05860" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he railed</w> on them.<note type="study"><catchWord>railed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flew upon them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">But the men</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">unto us, and we were not hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither missed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">we any thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">we were conversant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">with them, when we were in the fields</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>hurt</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shamed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02346">They were a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">unto us both by night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">and day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the while</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">we were with them keeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what thou wilt do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07451">for evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">against our master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and against all his household</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, that <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">cannot speak</w> to him.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:18
