verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H026">Then Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">loaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">bottles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">ready dressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05429">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07039">of parched</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06778">clusters of raisins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01690">cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of figs, and laid</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02543">on asses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>clusters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lumps</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto her servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me; behold, I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">you. But she told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">Nabal</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:20
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">on the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that she came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">by the covert</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and, behold, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her; and she met</w> them.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Now David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">Surely in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">all that this</w> <transChange type="added">fellow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">hath in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03972">so that nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was missed</w> of all that <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto him: and he hath requited</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03541">So</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and more</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">if I leave</w> of all that <transChange type="added">pertain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05704">to him by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H08366" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">any that pisseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">against the wall</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H026">And when Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">she hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lighted off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on her face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">herself to the ground</w>,

verses.name: I Samuel 25:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">at his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Upon me, my lord</w>, <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> me <transChange type="added">let this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0519">and let thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I pray thee, speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in thine audience</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0589">of thine handmaid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>audience</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ears</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">not my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">I pray thee, regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05037">Nabal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">for as his name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05037">he; Nabal</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05039">and folly</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0519">with him: but I thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">not the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou didst send</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>regard</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lay it to his heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Nabal</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Fool</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Now therefore, my lord</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">seeing the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath withholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee from coming</w> to <transChange type="added">shed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and from avenging</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thyself with thine own hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">now let thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05037">be as Nabal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>avenging…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saving thyself</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">And now this blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">which thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">let it even be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blessing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">present</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>follow…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walk at the feet of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">the trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of thine handmaid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">will certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0113">because my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">hath not been found</w> in thee <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thy days</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Yet a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is risen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee, and to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">but the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall be bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06872">in the bundle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07049" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them shall he sling out</w>, <transChange type="added">as out</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709 strong:H08432">of the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07050">of a sling</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as out…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst of the bought of a sling</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And it shall come to pass, when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">according to all the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">concerning thee, and shall have appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">thee ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 25:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06330">That this shall be no grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04383">unto thee, nor offence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">either that thou hast shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">causeless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">or that my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hath avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">himself: but when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall have dealt well</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">with my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">thine handmaid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>no grief</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">no staggering</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">stumbling</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H026">to Abigail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> me:

verses.name: I Samuel 25:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02940">thy advice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou, which hast kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from coming</w> to <transChange type="added">shed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and from avenging</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">myself with mine own hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">For in very deed</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath kept me back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from hurting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03884">thee, except</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hadst hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">me, surely there had not been left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">unto Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">by the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H08366" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">any that pisseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">against the wall</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of her hand</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which she had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thine house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy person</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H026">And Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">to Nabal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04960">and, behold, he held a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04960">like the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of a king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05037">and Nabal’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">merry</w> within him, for he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">drunken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">wherefore she told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him nothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">less</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">or more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">But it came to pass in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">when the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">of Nabal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">had told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">that his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> him, and he became <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">And it came to pass about ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <transChange type="added">after</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">Nabal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he died</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:39
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">that Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath pleaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">of my reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">of Nabal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">of Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his own head</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H026">with Abigail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">her to him to wife</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And when the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H026">to Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">to Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto her, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us unto thee, to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thee to him to wife</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> herself on <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0519">thine handmaid</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08198">a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H026">And Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">upon an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">with five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">damsels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of hers that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her; and she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and became his wife</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after her</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at her feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 25:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0293">Ahinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and they were also both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of them his wives</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 25:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">But Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06406">to Phalti</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03919">of Laish</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01554">of Gallim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Phalti</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Phaltiel</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen298" osisID="1Sam.25"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02130">And the Ziphites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">to Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Doth not David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">himself in the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02444">of Hachilah</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">Jeshimon</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02128">of Ziph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">having three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">with him, to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02128">of Ziph</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">in the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02444">of Hachilah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">Jeshimon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">But David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">him into the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">spies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">in very deed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">where Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had pitched</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">where Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">and Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of his host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">in the trench</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>trench</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">midst of his carriages</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">to Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H052">and to Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who will go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">with me to Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w>? <w lemma="strong:H052">And Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go down</w> with thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">and Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and, behold, Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03463">sleeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">within the trench</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02595">and his spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04600" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stuck</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H04763">at his bolster</w>: <w lemma="strong:H074">but Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> him.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">now therefore let me smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">him, I pray thee, with the spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">even to the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H06471">at once</w>, and I will not <transChange type="added">smite</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him the second time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>delivered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">to Abishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him not: for who can stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and be guiltless</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> furthermore, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him; or his day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or he shall descend</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">into battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and perish</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02486">forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but, I pray thee, take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">thou now the spear</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04763">at his bolster</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06835">and the cruse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us go</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">the spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06835">and the cruse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">from Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07226">bolster</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they gat them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and no man saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor knew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">neither awaked</w>: for they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03463">all asleep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08639">because a deep sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was fallen</w> upon them.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">to the other side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of an hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">space</w> <transChange type="added">being</transChange> between them:

verses.name: I Samuel 26:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">and to Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Answerest</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">thou not, Abner</w>? <w lemma="strong:H074">Then Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">art</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">criest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">to Abner</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> not thou a <transChange type="added">valiant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>? and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">like to thee in Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore then hast thou not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy lord</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">This thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast done</w>. <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">to die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because ye have not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">your master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And now see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">where the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spear</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06835">and the cruse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04763">at his bolster</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>worthy to die</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">this thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Wherefore doth my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thus pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for what have I done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07451">or what evil</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in mine hand</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">If the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have stirred thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me, let him accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w>: but if <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cursed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">they before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for they have driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me out this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05596" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">from abiding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">in the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accept</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smell</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>abiding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cleaving</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818">Now therefore, let not my blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H06550">flea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as when one doth hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07124">a partridge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I will no more do thee harm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">because my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">behold, I have played the fool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have erred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">exceedingly</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Behold the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spear</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0259">and let one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetch</w> it.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">render</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">and his faithfulness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delivered</w> thee into <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And, behold, as thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was much set by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">so let my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be much set by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let him deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">me out of all tribulation</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 26:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou, my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt both do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">great</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and also shalt still</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevail</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to his place</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen299" osisID="1Sam.26"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I shall now perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">nothing better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">for me than that</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">I should speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02976" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall despair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of me, to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">me any more in any coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">so shall I escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>perish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be consumed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">with the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0397">with him unto Achish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04582">of Maoch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">with Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">at Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">he and his men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with his household</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">with his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0293">Ahinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03159">the Jezreelitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H026">and Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03762">the Carmelitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05037">Nabal’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">to Gath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and he sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254 strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">no more again</w> for him.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">unto Achish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I have now found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">me a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in some</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">town</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">there: for why should thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">in the royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> with thee?

verses.name: I Samuel 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0397">Then Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06860">him Ziklag</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06860">wherefore Ziklag</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">pertaineth unto the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H04557">And the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">was a full year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the time</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the number of days</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a full year</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a year of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and invaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01651">the Geshurites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01511">and the Gezrites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06003">and the Amalekites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02007">for those</w> <transChange type="added">nations were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07793">to Shur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">even unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gezrites</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Gerzites</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and left neither man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">nor woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and the oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and the asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and the camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and the apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">to Achish</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0397">And Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0408">Whither</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have ye made a road</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">Against the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and against the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03397">of the Jerahmeelites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and against the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">of the Kenites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Whither…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Did you not make a road</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Samuel 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">neither man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">nor woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <transChange type="added">tidings</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01661">to Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Lest they should tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on us, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, and so <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">his manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the while</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0397">And Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">He hath made his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">him; therefore he shall be my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>utterly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to stink</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen300" osisID="1Sam.27"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">that the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-176">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">their armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-176">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for warfare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0397">And Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou assuredly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">with me to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">thou and thy men</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">to Achish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03651">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">what thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can do</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0397">And Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of mine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">Now Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had lamented</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">him in Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">even in his own city</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">those that had familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">and the wizards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-177">gathered themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07766">in Shunem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-177">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">in Gilboa</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he was afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trembled</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">him not, neither by dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0224">nor by Urim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">nor by prophets</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">me a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01172">that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">a familiar spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to her, and enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of her. And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> to him, Behold, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01172">that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">a familiar spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05874">at En–dor</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">disguised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, divine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">unto me by the familiar spirit</w>, and bring me <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom I shall name</w> unto thee.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Behold, thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">what Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">how he hath cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">those that have familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">and the wizards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05367" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">wherefore then layest thou a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cause me to die</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to her by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">there shall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">no punishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">happen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to thee for this thing</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Whom shall I bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And when the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Why hast thou deceived</w> me? for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, Be not afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for what sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thou? And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ascending</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08389">unto her, What form</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he of? And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">An old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh up</w>; and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">with a mantle</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceived</w> that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he stooped</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> himself.<note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What is his form?</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08050">And Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Why hast thou disquieted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me, to bring me up</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">I am sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">distressed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06430">for the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">make war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against me, and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from me, and answereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me no more, neither by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02472">nor by dreams</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore I have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee, that thou mayest make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me what I shall do</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by prophets</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of prophets</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore then dost thou ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of me, seeing the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06145">from thee, and is become thine enemy</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">to him, as he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by me</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">it to thy neighbour</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>to him</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for himself</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mine hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0834">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou obeyedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor executedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">upon Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto thee this day</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will also deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thee into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04279">and to morrow</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou and thy sons</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with me: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Then Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">straightway</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">along</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">because of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of Samuel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03581">and there was no strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in him; for he had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">nor all the night</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fell…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made haste, and fell with the fulness of his stature</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 28:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">that he was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">troubled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">unto him, Behold, thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou spakest</w> unto me.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thou also unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">of thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let me set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">a morsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee; and eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">that thou mayest have strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on thy way</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But he refused</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05650">But his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">together with the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">compelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto their voice</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">upon the bed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 28:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04770">had a fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and she hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03888" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kneaded</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0644" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did bake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">unleavened bread</w> thereof:

verses.name: I Samuel 28:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And she brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen301" osisID="1Sam.28"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">Now the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">all their armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0663">to Aphek</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">and the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">by a fountain</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05633">And the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">by hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and by thousands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">in the rereward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">with Achish</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, What <transChange type="added">do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05680">these Hebrews</w> <transChange type="added">here</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H0397">And Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">not this David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">which hath been with me these days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">or these years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">no fault</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in him since</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he fell</w> <transChange type="added">unto me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">with him; and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-178">unto him, Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">this fellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-178">return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and let him not go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with us to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">lest in the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">he be an adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">to us: for wherewith should he reconcile</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">himself unto his master</w>? <transChange type="added">should it</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">with the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of these men</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 29:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">not this David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of whom they sang</w> <w lemma="strong:H04246">one to another in dances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">his thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">his ten thousands</w>?

verses.name: I Samuel 29:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0397">Then Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, Surely, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03477">thou hast been upright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and thy going out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and thy coming in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">with me in the host</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have not found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in thee since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of thy coming</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto me unto this day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05633">nevertheless the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thee not</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the lords…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thou art not good in the eyes of the lords</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Wherefore now return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H07451 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou displease</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">not the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>displease…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do not evil in the eyes of the lords</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">unto Achish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But what have I done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and what hast thou found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">in thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">so long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">I have been with thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0397">And Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">as an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08269">notwithstanding the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with us to the battle</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Wherefore now rise up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">with thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with thee: and as soon as ye be up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">depart</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 29:11
