verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">to Jezreel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen302" osisID="1Sam.29"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And it came to pass, when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06860">to Ziklag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06003">that the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had invaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06860">and Ziklag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06860">Ziklag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And had taken the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">captives</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therein: they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not any</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">either great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">or small</w>, but carried <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on their way</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were taken captives</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">until they had no more power</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to weep</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were taken captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0293">Ahinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03159">the Jezreelitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H026">and Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">of Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03761">the Carmelite</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">distressed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of stoning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him, because the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was grieved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and for his daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">encouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">himself in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grieved</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">to Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0288">Ahimelech’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">I pray thee, bring me hither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">the ephod</w>. <w lemma="strong:H054">And Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">thither the ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">at the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">this troop</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall I overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them? And he answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him, Pursue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">overtake</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and without fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">recover</w> <transChange type="added">all</transChange>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">he and the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">to the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H01308">Besor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">where those that were left behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stayed</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">But David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">he and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03967">for two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode behind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06296" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which were so faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they could not go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H01308">Besor</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713 strong:H0376">an Egyptian</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">him to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">him bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they made him drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>;

verses.name: I Samuel 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06400">him a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H01690">of a cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of figs, and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06778">clusters of raisins</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he had eaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him: for he had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor drunk</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, To whom <transChange type="added">belongest</transChange> thou? and whence <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">a young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06003 strong:H0376">to an Amalekite</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0113">and my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">me, because three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">agone I fell sick</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We made an invasion</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03774">of the Cherethites</w>, and upon <transChange type="added">the coast</transChange> which <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and upon the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of Caleb</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06860">Ziklag</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to him, Canst thou bring me down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">to this company</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto me by God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that thou wilt neither kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">me, nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will bring thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">to this company</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when he had brought him down</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spread abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drinking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and dancing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">because of all the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">them from the twilight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">even unto the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H04283">of the next day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">of them, save four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">upon camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the next…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their morrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">recovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">all that the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had carried away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">rescued</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And there was nothing lacking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04480">to them, neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">nor great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">nor daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">neither spoil</w>, nor any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to them: David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">recovered</w> all.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">all the flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and the herds</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they drave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">those</w> <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">to the two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06296" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which were so faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they could not follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whom they had made also to abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">at the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H01308">Besor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with him: and when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965 strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he saluted</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>saluted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">asked them how they did</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> and <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">of those</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not with us, we will not give</w> them <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that we have recovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">save to every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his children</w>, that they may lead <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and depart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>those</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not do so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">with that which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, who hath preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">against us into our hand</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For who will hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto you in this matter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02506">but as his part</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381 strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8717 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">that goeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>, so <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">his part</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that tarrieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">by the stuff</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">alike</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 30:25
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">forward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">it a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and forward</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06860">to Ziklag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his friends</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">Behold a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">for you of the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">blessing</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 30:27
verses.text: To <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H0834">them</w></transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05045">in south</w> <w lemma="strong:H07418">Ramoth</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03492">in Jattir</w>,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:28
verses.text: And to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06177">in Aroer</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08224">in Siphmoth</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0851">in Eshtemoa</w>,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:29
verses.text: And to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07403">in Rachal</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03397">of the Jerahmeelites</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07017">of the Kenites</w>,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:30
verses.text: And to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02767">in Hormah</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03565">in Chor–ashan</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06269">in Athach</w>,

verses.name: I Samuel 30:31
verses.text: And to <transChange type="added">them</transChange> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and to all the places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">where David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">himself and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were wont to haunt</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen303" osisID="1Sam.30"/>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">Now the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">Gilboa</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wounded</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">followed hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">upon Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and upon his sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H041">and Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04444">and Malchi–shua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">against Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198 strong:H0582 strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and the archers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">him; and he was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198 strong:H0582 strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the archers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and the archers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and the shooters, men with bows</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto his armourbearer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thy sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and thrust me through</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">therewith; lest these uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thrust me through</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and abuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me. But his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">not; for he was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">afraid</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">Therefore Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> upon it.<note type="study"><catchWord>abuse…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mock me</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And when his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">likewise upon his sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> with him.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">So Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and his three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his armourbearer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all his men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">that same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And when the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valley</w>, and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">that the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> in them.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to strip</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">the slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and his three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">Gilboa</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and stripped off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to publish</w> <transChange type="added">it in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">of their idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and among the people</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his armour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01045 strong:H06252" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Ashtaroth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">his body</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">to the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01052">of Beth–shan</w>.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And when the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of that which the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>of that</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">concerning him that</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Samuel 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">All the valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0381 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">the body</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">and the bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">from the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01052">of Beth–shan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">to Jabesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> them there.

verses.name: I Samuel 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">their bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0815">under a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">at Jabesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen304" osisID="1Sam.31"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen273" osisID="1Sam" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of the Amalekites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06860">in Ziklag</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">It came even to pass on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that, behold, a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">out of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">from Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">with his clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>: and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it was, when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and did obeisance</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, From whence comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto him, Out of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">am I escaped</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">unto him, How</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">went the matter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">I pray thee, tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me. And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">That the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">from the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also are fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dead</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dead</w> also.<note type="study"><catchWord>How…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What was</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, How knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">thou that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be dead</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">As I happened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">by chance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">Gilboa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">behold, Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">leaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">upon his spear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07393">and, lo, the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571 strong:H01167">and horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">followed hard</w> after him.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me. And I answered</w>, Here <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I.<note type="study"><catchWord>Here…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Behold me</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto me, Who <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And I answered</w> him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06003">an Amalekite</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me again, Stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">I pray thee, upon me, and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07661">me: for anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">upon me, because my life</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> yet whole in me.<note type="study"><catchWord>anguish…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my coat of mail (or, <rdg type="alternate">my embroidered coat</rdg>) hindereth me, that my</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">upon him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, because I was sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he could not live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he was fallen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">the crown</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0685">and the bracelet</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02220">on his arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">them hither unto my lord</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">on his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">them; and likewise all the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him:

verses.name: II Samuel 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they mourned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until even</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">for Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">and for Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they were fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that told</w> him, Whence <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And he answered</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616 strong:H0376">of a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06003">an Amalekite</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, How wast thou not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go near</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon him. And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him that he died</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">unto him, Thy blood</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon thy head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">for thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">I have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">lamented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">with this lamentation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">over Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and over Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 1:18
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also he bade</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">the use of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w>: behold, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of Jasher</w>.)<note type="study"><catchWord>of Jasher</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the upright</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06643">The beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">is slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">upon thy high places</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01368">how are the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fallen</w>!

verses.name: II Samuel 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Tell</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01661">not in Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">publish</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">not in the streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0831">of Askelon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">lest the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">lest the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">of the uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">triumph</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Ye mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">of Gilboa</w>, <transChange type="added">let there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02919">no dew</w>, neither <transChange type="added">let there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">upon you, nor fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">of offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04043">for there the shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01602" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is vilely cast away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <transChange type="added">as though he had</transChange> not <transChange type="added">been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818">From the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of the slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">from the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07734" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">not back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">not empty</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">lovely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05273">and pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">in their lives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04194">and in their death</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they were not divided</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were swifter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">than eagles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">than lions</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sweet</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 1:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">Ye daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">weep over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08144">you in scarlet</w>, with <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05730">delights</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">on ornaments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">upon your apparel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01368">How are the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of the battle</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03083">O Jonathan</w>, <transChange type="added">thou wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in thine high places</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am distressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">for thee, my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">hast thou been unto me: thy love</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">to me was wonderful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0160">passing the love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of women</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01368">How are the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fallen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perished</w>! <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen306" osisID="2Sam.1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">into any</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go up</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whither shall I go up</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">Unto Hebron</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thither, and his two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0293">also, Ahinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03159">the Jezreelitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H026">and Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">Nabal’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03761">the Carmelite</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And his men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with him did David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with his household</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there they anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w> <transChange type="added">were they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto them, Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">this kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto your lord</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have buried</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you: and I also will requite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">you this kindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because ye have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Therefore now let your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be strengthened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428 strong:H01121">and be ye valiant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0113">for your master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and also the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">me king</w> over them.<note type="study"><catchWord>be ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be ye the sons of valour</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H074">But Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">to Mahanaim</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Saul’s host</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the host which was Saul’s</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ish–bosheth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Esh–baal</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And made him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">over Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0805">and over the Ashurites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03157">and over Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">and over Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and over Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and over all Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0378">Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01004">But the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H04557">And the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">was seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>time</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">number of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">of Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">from Mahanaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">to Gibeon</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and met</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">by the pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they sat down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01295">the one on the one side of the pool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01295">and the other on the other side of the pool</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>together</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">them together</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">Let the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and play</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">us. And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them arise</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then there arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">by number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, which <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0378">to Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his fellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">by the head</w>, and <transChange type="added">thrust</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">in his fellow’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so they fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04725">wherefore that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02521">Helkath–hazzurim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">in Gibeon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Helkath–hazzurim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The field of strong men</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966">And there was a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H074">and Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was beaten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969">And there were three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">there, Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H052">and Abishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06214">and Asahel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06214">and Asahel</w> <transChange type="added">was as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07031">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as a</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">roe</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of foot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of his feet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>as a wild…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as one of the roes that is in the field</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06214">And Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and in going</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">not to the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">nor to the left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after Abner</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">Then Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06214">thou Asahel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to him, Turn thee aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">to thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">or to thy left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and lay thee hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">on one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02488">thee his armour</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06214">But Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> of him.<note type="study"><catchWord>armour</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spoil</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06214">to Asahel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn thee aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me: wherefore should I smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee to the ground</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how then should I hold up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Howbeit he refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to turn aside</w>: <w lemma="strong:H074">wherefore Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">with the hinder end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">of the spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">him under</w> <w lemma="strong:H02570">the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">rib</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02595">that the spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and he fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there, and died</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">in the same place</w>: and it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as many as came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06214">where Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood still</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">also and Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08121">and the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">to the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0522">of Ammah</w>, that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01520">Giah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and became one</w> <w lemma="strong:H092">troop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">of an hill</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">Then Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">Shall the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">thou not that it will be bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">in the latter end</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how long shall it be then, ere thou bid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03884">unless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hadst spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">surely then in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">had gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the morning</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>gone…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gone away</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 2:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">a trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">no more, neither fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they any more</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">through the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went through</w> <w lemma="strong:H01338">all Bithron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">to Mahanaim</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-179">and when he had gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-179">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">there lacked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08672">nineteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06214">and Asahel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">But the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">and of Abner’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 2:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06214">Asahel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">him in the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, which <transChange type="added">was in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01035">Beth–lehem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">and they came to Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">at break of day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen307" osisID="2Sam.2"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0752">Now there was long</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">between the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">waxed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02390">stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02390">and stronger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">waxed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">weaker</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">and weaker</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">were sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205 strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8735">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01060">and his firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">was Amnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0293">of Ahinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03159">the Jezreelitess</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04932">And his second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03609">Chileab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H026">of Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05037">of Nabal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03761">the Carmelite</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">of Maacah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08526">of Talmai</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">of Geshur</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Chileab</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Daniel</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">And the fourth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02294">of Haggith</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02549">and the fifth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08203">Shephatiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H037">of Abital</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08345">And the sixth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03507">Ithream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05698">by Eglah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">These were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04421">And it came to pass, while there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">between the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">that Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">made himself strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">had a concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07532">Rizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0345">of Aiah</w>: and <transChange type="added">Ish–bosheth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">to Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore hast thou gone in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubine</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">Then was Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">of Ish–bosheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03611">I a dog’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">which against Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04828">and to his friends</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have not delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou chargest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">with a fault</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">concerning this woman</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">to Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and more also</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">except, as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">even so I do</w> to him;

verses.name: II Samuel 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To translate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and over Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">from Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">even to Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">again, because he feared</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on his behalf, saying</w>, Whose <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thy league</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with me, and, behold, my hand</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">with thee, to bring about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> unto thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">Well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with thee: but one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I require</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of thee, that is</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">except thou first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that is</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saying</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:14
