verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">to Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deliver</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">my wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">Michal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0781" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I espoused</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">to me for an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06190">foreskins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0378">And Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> her from <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">husband</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06409">from Phaltiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03919 strong:H03889" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of Laish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Phaltiel</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Phalti</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8800">with her along weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0980">her to Bahurim</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he returned</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>along…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">going and weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had communication</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">with the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Ye sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08543">in times</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">past</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> over you:<note type="study"><catchWord>in times…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">both yesterday and the third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now then do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">By the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all their enemies</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H074">and Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">also to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">all that seemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and that seemed good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">So Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">to Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with him. And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04960">with him a feast</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">And Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, and that thou mayest reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">over all that thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">desireth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-180">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-180">away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05650">And, behold, the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">and Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> from <transChange type="added">pursuing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01416">a troop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">with them: but Abner</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">not with David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for he had sent him away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he was gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">When Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him were come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he hath sent him away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he is gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">Then Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What hast thou done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H074">behold, Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> unto thee; why <transChange type="added">is</transChange> it <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast sent him away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and he is quite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gone</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, and to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">thy going out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996 strong:H04126" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and thy coming in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that thou doest</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And when Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">from David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which brought him again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">from the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05626">of Sirah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H074">And when Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">to Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took him aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432 strong:H0413">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07987">with him quietly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02570">him there under the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">rib</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">for the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06214">of Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>quietly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">peaceably</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">I and my kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">guiltless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">from the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">of Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let it rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and on all his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and let there not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">one that hath an issue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">or that is a leper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">or that leaneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">on a staff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or that falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">on the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02638">or that lacketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">and Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06214">Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">at Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with him, Rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">your clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">you with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">the bier</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bier</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">at the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">of Abner</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">lamented</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">over Abner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Died</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">as a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">dieth</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 3:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Thy hands</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not bound</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">nor thy feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">into fetters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as a man falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou. And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> over him.<note type="study"><catchWord>wicked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">children of iniquity</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03605">And when all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-181">to cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-181">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">while it was yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to me, and more also</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if I taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03972">or ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">else, till</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be down</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">took notice</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them: as whatsoever the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896 strong:H05869">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased them</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was good in their eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 3:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that it was not of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 3:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">ye not that there is a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 3:39
verses.text: And I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07390">weak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">though anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">and these men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07186">too hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for me: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the doer of evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">according to his wickedness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weak</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tender</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen308" osisID="2Sam.3"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">that Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were feeble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were troubled</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">of bands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01196">Baanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">Rechab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">of Rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0886">a Beerothite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H0881">for Beeroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also was reckoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">to Benjamin</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>other</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">second</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0886">And the Beerothites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01664">to Gittaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and were sojourners</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">there until this day</w>.)

verses.name: II Samuel 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">And Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">had a son</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05223">lame</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02568">He was five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">when the tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">out of Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his nurse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took him up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02648" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it came to pass, as she made haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he fell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06452" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and became lame</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08034">And his name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04648">Mephibosheth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Mephibosheth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Merib–baal</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">of Rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0886">the Beerothite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07394">Rechab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01196">and Baanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">about the heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">of Ish–bosheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">on a bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noon</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they came thither</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <transChange type="added">as though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they would have fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02570">him under the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">rib</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07394">and Rechab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01196">and Baanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">escaped</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">on his bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904 strong:H02315">in his bedchamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and beheaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gat them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">all night</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">of Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">to Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">Behold the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">of Ish–bosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and of his seed</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 4:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">Rechab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01196">and Baanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">of Rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0886">the Beerothite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">out of all adversity</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">When one told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Behold, Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">thinking to have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">good tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06860">him in Ziklag</w>, who <transChange type="added">thought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I would have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01309">him a reward for his tidings</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>thinking…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he was in his own eyes as a bringer</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>who…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which was the reward I gave him for his tidings</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">How much more, when wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">a righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">person</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his own house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon his bed</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall I not therefore now require</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and take you away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and their feet</w>, and hanged <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">over the pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0378">of Ish–bosheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06913">in the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">of Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen309" osisID="2Sam.4"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">unto Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, Behold, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">thy bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and thy flesh</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08032 strong:H0865">Also in time past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">over us, thou wast he that leddest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and broughtest in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee, Thou shalt feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">and thou shalt be a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">So all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">to Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">with them in Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02275">In Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">unto the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Except thou take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">the blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06455">and the lame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hither: thinking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot come in</w> hither.<note type="study"><catchWord>thinking…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">saying David shall not</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Nevertheless David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">the strong hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whosoever getteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06794">to the gutter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06455">and the lame</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">and the blind</w>, <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>, <transChange type="added">he shall be chief and captain</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05787">The blind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06455">and the lame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Wherefore…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Because they had said, even the blind and the lame, He shall not</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">in the fort</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">it the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04407">from Millo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and inward</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and grew great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went, going and growing</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 5:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02438">And Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">and carpenters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H07023">and masons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>masons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hewers of the stone of the wall</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had established</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and that he had exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel’s</w> sake.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06370">more concubines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">out of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">from Hebron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and there were yet sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:14
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H03209">of those that were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto him in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08051">Shammua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07727">and Shobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02984">Ibhar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0474">also, and Elishua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05298">and Nepheg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03309">and Japhia</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0476">And Elishama</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0450">and Eliada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0467">and Eliphalet</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">But when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">all the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">to the hold</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">The Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">themselves in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of Rephaim</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">to the Philistines</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into mine hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for I will doubtless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01188">to Baal–perazim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them there, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath broken forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">me, as the breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01188">Baal–perazim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Baal–perazim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the plain of breaches</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">their images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burned</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>burned…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">took them away</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 5:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">themselves in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of Rephaim</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not go up</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">fetch a compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">upon them over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01057">the mulberry trees</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And let it be, when thou hearest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06807">of a going</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H01057">of the mulberry trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that then thou shalt bestir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thyself: for then shall the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee, to smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him; and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">from Geba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until thou come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">to Gazer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Geba</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Gibeon</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen310" osisID="2Sam.5"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Again, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254 strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> all <transChange type="added">the</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01184">with him from Baale of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">from thence the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> <transChange type="added">between</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Baale</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Baalah</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Kirjath–jearim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>whose name…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">at which the name, even the name of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> of hosts, was called upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">upon a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">cart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">it out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H041">of Abinadab</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05798">and Uzzah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0283">and Ahio</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H041">of Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">drave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">the new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">cart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made to ride</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Gibeah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">it out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H041">of Abinadab</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01390">at Gibeah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05973">accompanying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0283">and Ahio</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accompanying</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">played</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> on all manner of <transChange type="added">instruments made of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01265">fir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">even on harps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">and on psalteries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08596">and on timbrels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04517">and on cornets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06767">and on cymbals</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05225">to Nachon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">threshingfloor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05798">Uzzah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <transChange type="added">his hand</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">to the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of it; for the oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shook</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Nachon</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Chidon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shook it</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stumbled</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05798">against Uzzah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> him there for <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07944">error</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">by the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>error</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rashness</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was displeased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">a breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05798">upon Uzzah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the name of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06560">Perez–uzzah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Perez–uzzah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the breach of Uzzah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">How shall the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> to me?

verses.name: II Samuel 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto him into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">carried it aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">And the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">Obed–edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all his household</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">pertaineth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">unto him, because of the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with gladness</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:13
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that when they that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">paces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04806">and fatlings</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03769" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">danced</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> with all <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">might</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">with a linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0646">ephod</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with shouting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and with the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">And as the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04324">Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">through a window</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06339" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">leaping</w> <w lemma="strong:H03769" morph="strongMorph:TH8772">and dancing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">him in her heart</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">in the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">it in his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for it: and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pitched</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stretched</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And as soon as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all the people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">among the whole multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">as well to the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">as men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H02471">cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0829">and a good piece</w> <transChange type="added">of flesh</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0809">and a flagon</w> <transChange type="added">of wine</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">So all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his household</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04324">And Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">How glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">who uncovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">himself to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of the handmaids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">of the vain fellows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">shamelessly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">uncovereth</w> himself!<note type="study"><catchWord>shamelessly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">openly</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">unto Michal</w>, <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">me before thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and before all his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">me ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">therefore will I play</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And I will yet be more vile</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">than thus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08217">and will be base</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in mine own sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0519">and of the maidservants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of, of them shall I be had in honour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the handmaids of my servants</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04324">Therefore Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206 strong:H02056" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">had no child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of her death</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen311" osisID="2Sam.6"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had given him rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from all his enemies</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">That the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">unto Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">now, I dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">but the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">curtains</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05416">And Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915">And it came to pass that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">came unto Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shalt thou build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for me to dwell in</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>my servant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to my servant, to David</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Whereas I have not dwelt</w> in <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">since the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even to this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">but have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in a tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">and in a tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:7
verses.text: In all <transChange type="added">the places</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">wherein I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">I a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with any</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">ye not me an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>any of…</catchWord>: <rdg>any of the judges</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore so shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">thee from the sheepcote</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">to be ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>from following</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thee a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">like unto the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>out of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from thy face</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover I will appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, that they may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in a place of their own, and move</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">no more; neither shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">of wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them any more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">as beforetime</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And as since the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judges</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have caused thee to rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from all thine enemies</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">Also the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">telleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee that he will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee an house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And when thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be fulfilled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, which shall proceed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">out of thy bowels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">his kingdom</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">and I will stablish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">I will be his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and he shall be my son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">If he commit iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I will chasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">him with the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05061">and with the stripes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">But my mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not depart away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from him, as I took</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">from Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom I put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">and thy kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">thee: thy throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">According to all these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02384">and according to all this vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">so did Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in, and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">I, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>? and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">my house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">me hitherto</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06994" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And this was yet a small thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">also of thy servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">for a great while to come</w>. And <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08452">this the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>manner</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">law</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-182">And what can</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-182">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto thee? for thou, Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">For thy word’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">sake, and according to thine own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">all these great things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">to make thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">know</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore thou art great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none like thee, neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, according to all that we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with our ears</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And what one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">like thy people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">like Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to himself, and to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">him a name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">for you great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">for thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou redeemedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to thee from Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">and their gods</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">For thou hast confirmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to thyself thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">unto thee for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">art become</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And now, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">concerning thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and concerning his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">establish</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou hast said</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:26
