verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And let thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and let the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast revealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee an house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">therefore hath thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">this prayer</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>revealed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">opened the ear</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 7:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">And now, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">be true</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou hast promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">this goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 7:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Therefore now let it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">thee to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">that it may continue for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">thee: for thou, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hast spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01293">and with thy blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">let the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let it…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be thou pleased and bless</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen312" osisID="2Sam.7"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">this it came to pass, that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">them: and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04965">Metheg–ammah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Metheg–ammah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the bridle of Ammah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">them with a line</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">casting them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">even with two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">lines</w> <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">measured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he to put to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and with one full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">line</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to keep alive</w>. And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04124">the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">became David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">gifts</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">also Hadadezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07340">of Rehob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his border</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">at the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hadadezer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hadarezer</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">from him a thousand</w> <transChange type="added">chariots</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273 strong:H0376">footmen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06131" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">houghed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">all the chariot</w> <transChange type="added">horses</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but reserved</w> of them <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of his chariots</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">And when the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to succour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">Hadadezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">garrisons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">in Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0758">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">became servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">gifts</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whithersoever he went</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07982">the shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that were on the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">of Hadadezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">them to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0984">And from Betah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01268">and from Berothai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">of Hadadezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08583">When Toi</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">of Hadadezer</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08583">Then Toi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965 strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to salute</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him, and to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him, because he had fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">against Hadadezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">him: for Hadadezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421 strong:H0376">had wars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08583">with Toi</w>. And <transChange type="added">Joram</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">brought with him</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Joram</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Hadoram</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>salute…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ask him of peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>had wars…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was a man of wars with</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his hand were</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Which also king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did dedicate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">with the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he had dedicated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he subdued</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">Of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">and of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06002">and of Amalek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">and of the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">of Hadadezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07340">of Rehob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gat</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">a name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from smiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>smiting</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his smiting</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">garrisons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0123">throughout all Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">he garrisons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0123">and all they of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">became David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whithersoever he went</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all his people</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">over the host</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0286">of Ahilud</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">recorder</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>recorder</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">remembrancer</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">writer of chronicles</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">And Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0288">and Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">of Abiathar</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08304">and Seraiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>scribe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretary</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">And Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <transChange type="added">was over</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03774">both the Cherethites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06432">and the Pelethites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">were chief rulers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief rulers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">princes</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen313" osisID="2Sam.8"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">Is there yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">any that is left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">him kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">for Jonathan’s</w> sake?

verses.name: II Samuel 9:2
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06717">Ziba</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they had called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">him unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06717">thou Ziba</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <transChange type="added">is he</transChange>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">there not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">yet any</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">the kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06717">unto him? And Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">hath yet a son</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05223">lame</w> on <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0375">unto him, Where</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06717">he? And Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, Behold, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05988">of Ammiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03810">in Lo–debar</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05988">of Ammiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03810">from Lo–debar</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04648">Now when Mephibosheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and did reverence</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04648">Mephibosheth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold thy servant</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>Mephibosheth</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Merib–baal</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 9:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not: for I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thee kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">for Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sake, and will restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thee all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at my table</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And he bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and said</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shouldest look</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">upon such a dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">dog</w> as I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>?

verses.name: II Samuel 9:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06717">to Ziba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all that pertained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to all his house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thou therefore, and thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall till</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for him, and thou shalt bring</w> in <transChange type="added">the fruits</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">that thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">may have food</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04648">but Mephibosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">alway</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at my table</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06717">Now Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">had fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06717">Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">According to all that my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">so shall thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04648">As for Mephibosheth</w>, <transChange type="added">said the king</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at my table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04648">And Mephibosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">had a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04316">Micha</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04186">And all that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06717">of Ziba</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04648">unto Mephibosheth</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04648">So Mephibosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for he did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06455">and was lame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">on both</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen314" osisID="2Sam.9"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02586">and Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02586">unto Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05176">of Nahash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto me. And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for his father</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02586">unto Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">their lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">Thinkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">thou that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">doth honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">comforters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto thee? hath not David</w> <transChange type="added">rather</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05668">unto thee, to</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">search</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to spy it out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to overthrow</w> it?<note type="study"><catchWord>Thinkest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">In thine eyes doth David</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02586">Wherefore Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shaved off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">the one half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">of their beards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04063">their garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">in the middle</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08357">to their buttocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent them away</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">When they told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">them, because the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">were greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">at Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">until your beards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">be grown</w>, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">return</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they stank</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">before David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01050">of Beth–rehob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zoba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">footmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maacah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0382">and of Ish–tob</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147 strong:H06240">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ish–tob</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the men of Tob</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> of <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and put the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0758">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zoba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07340">and of Rehob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0382">and Ish–tob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04601">and Maacah</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0905">by themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">When Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that the front</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">was against him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">and behind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of all the choice</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, and put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">of Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, that he might put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">If the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be too strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">for me, then thou shalt help</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me: but if the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be too strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thee, then I will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and help</w> thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be of good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and let us play the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for our people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and for the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">that which seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">him good</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew nigh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with him, unto the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">against the Syrians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">that the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">they also before</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">Abishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0758">And when the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they were smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">themselves together</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01928">And Hadarezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02431">to Helam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07731">and Shobach</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">of Hadarezer</w> <transChange type="added">went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>the river</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Euphrates</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shobach</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shophach</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And when it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-183">he gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-183">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02431">to Helam</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0758">And the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set themselves in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> with him.

verses.name: II Samuel 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">And the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <transChange type="added">the men of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07731">Shobach</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of their host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who died</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>horsemen</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">footmen</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And when all the kings</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">to Hadarezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they were smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they made peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">them. So the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> any more. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen315" osisID="2Sam.10"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">And it came to pass, after the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08666">was expired</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397 strong:H04428" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">when kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go forth</w> <transChange type="added">to battle</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with him, and all Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">Rabbah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">But David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">tarried still</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the return of the year</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">in the spring</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256 strong:H06153">And it came to pass in an eveningtide</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">from off his bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the roof</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01406">and from the roof</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">washing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">herself; and the woman</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to look upon</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">after the woman</w>. And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01339">not this Bath–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0463">of Eliam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Bath–sheba</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Bath–shuah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Eliam</catchWord>: or <rdg type="alternate">Ammiel</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her; and she came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and he lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">with her; for she was purified</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">from her uncleanness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto her house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for she…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and when she had purified herself, etc, she returned</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02030">with child</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">me Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0223">And when Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto him, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">demanded</w> <transChange type="added">of him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03097">how Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and how the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and how the war</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">prospered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>how Joab…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the peace of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">to Uriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thy house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy feet</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0223">And Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and there followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">him a mess</w> <transChange type="added">of meat</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">from the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>followed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went out after him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0223">But Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with all the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went not down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when they had told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went not down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">unto Uriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Camest</w> thou not from <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w>? why <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">didst thou not go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto thine house</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0223">And Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">The ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in tents</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0113">and my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">are encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">fields</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0589">shall I</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with my wife</w>? <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">thou livest</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">to Uriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">here to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">also, and to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will let thee depart</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0223">So Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04283">and the morrow</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, he did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07937" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him; and he made him drunk</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06153">and at even</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">on his bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but went not down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">a letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Uriah</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the letter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">ye Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136 strong:H06440">in the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">of the hottest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and retire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">ye from him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that he may be smitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hottest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>from him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And it came to pass, when Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">observed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he assigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">where he knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">that valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">with Joab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there fell</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0223">and Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> also.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03097">Then Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">concerning the war</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messenger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">When thou hast made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of telling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of the war</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And if so be that the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when ye did fight</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye not that they would shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">from the wall</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Who smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03380">of Jerubbesheth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0802">did not a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06400">a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of a millstone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon him from the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H08405">in Thebez</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">why went ye nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thou, Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w> also.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jerubbesheth</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jerubbaal</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">So the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">all that Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> him for.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">Surely the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against us, and came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">unto us into the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">and we were upon them even unto the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And the shooters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">from off the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">upon thy servants</w>; and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w> also.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the messenger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">unto Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">Let not this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">displease</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thee, for the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02090">one as well as another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">make thy battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">more strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">it: and encourage</w> thou him.<note type="study"><catchWord>displease…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be evil in thine eyes</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">so and such</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 11:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">And when the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">that Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">for her husband</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 11:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H060">And when the mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">her to his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and she became his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him a son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">But the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>displeased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was evil in the eyes of</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen316" osisID="2Sam.11"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto him, There were two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06223">rich</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">poor</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">had exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and herds</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But the poor</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">had nothing, save one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">ewe lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and nourished up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it grew up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with him, and with his children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">of his own meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drank</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">of his own cup</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in his bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and was unto him as a daughter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>meat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">morsel</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01982">a traveller</w> <w lemma="strong:H06223">unto the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of his own flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and of his own herd</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0732" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for the wayfaring man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him; but took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">lamb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">it for the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that was come</w> to him.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against the man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">to Nathan</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hath done</w> this <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">die</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is worthy to die</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">is a son of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03535">the lamb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0706">fourfold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06118">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">and because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he had no pity</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05416">And Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thee out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thee thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">and thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into thy bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and of Judah</w>; and if <transChange type="added">that had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">too little</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I would moreover have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">unto thee such</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">and such things</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore hast thou despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">him with the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">Now therefore the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H05704">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from thine house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06118">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and hast taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to be thy wife</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against thee out of thine own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thy wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto thy neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with thy wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of this sun</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thou didst</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">secretly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">before all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">and before the sun</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">unto Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H05416">And Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also hath put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">thy sin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not die</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0657">Howbeit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">because by this deed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thou hast given great occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">to blaspheme</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the child</w> also <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03209">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05416">And Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">struck</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">that Uriah’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it was very sick</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">for the child</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685 strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all night</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fasted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fasted a fast</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <transChange type="added">and went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to him, to raise him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, neither did he eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> with them.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And it came to pass on the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">that the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">him that the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">Behold, while the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">was yet alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, and he would not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto our voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-184">how will he then</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-184">himself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if we tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">him that the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>vex</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do hurt</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">But when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03907" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">whispered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">that the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">therefore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">Is the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dead</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He is dead</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and washed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and anointed</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08071">his apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his own house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he required</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before him, and he did eat</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto him, What thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this that thou hast done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou didst fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">for the child</w>, <transChange type="added">while it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03206">but when the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou didst rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">While the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">was yet alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who can tell</w> <transChange type="added">whether</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02603 strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8762 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">will be gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">to me, that the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">may live</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But now he is dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherefore should I fast</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">I bring him back again</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, but he shall not return</w> to me.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01339">Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with her: and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loved</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">of Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03041">Jedidiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jedidiah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Beloved of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">against Rabbah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:27
