verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I have fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">against Rabbah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-185">Now therefore gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798" type="x-split-185">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it: lest I take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after my name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it be called…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my name be called upon it</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-186">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-186">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">to Rabbah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against it, and took</w> it.

verses.name: II Samuel 12:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from off his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04948">the weight</w> whereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">with the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>: and it was <transChange type="added">set</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">on David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">abundance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">very great</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 12:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04050">under saws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02757">and under harrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04037">and under axes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and made them pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04404">through the brickkiln</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">he unto all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen317" osisID="2Sam.12"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">this, that Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">had a fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0550">and Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> her.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0550">And Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was so vexed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that he fell sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">for his sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>; for she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01330">a virgin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0550">and Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for him to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any thing</w> to her.<note type="study"><catchWord>Amnon thought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it was marvellous</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">hidden in the eyes of Amnon</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0550">But Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">had a friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03122">Jonadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08093">of Shimeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03122">and Jonadab</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">subtil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto him, Why <transChange type="added">art</transChange> thou, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01800">lean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">from day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">to day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wilt thou not tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">me? And Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him, I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lean</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thin</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>from day…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">morning by morning</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03082">And Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Lay thee down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">on thy bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and make thyself sick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and when thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">unto him, I pray thee, let my sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">me meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01279">the meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at her hand</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0550">So Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lay down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made himself sick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">him, Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08559">I pray thee, let Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">me a couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03834">of cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at her hand</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">to Tamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">now to thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">Amnon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01279">him meat</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08559">So Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to her brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">Amnon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he was laid down</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01217">flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03888" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kneaded</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and made cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and did bake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03834">the cakes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>flour</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">paste</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04958">a pan</w>, and poured <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him; but he refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0550">And Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Have out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">all men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me. And they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> from him.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0550">And Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">unto Tamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01279">the meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into the chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01262" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08559">And Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03834">the cakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which she had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">to Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">her brother</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when she had brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of her, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">with me, my sister</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">him, Nay, my brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">do not force</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">me; for no such thing ought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">to be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05039">not thou this folly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>force…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">humble me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>no such…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it ought not so to be done</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02781">And I, whither shall I cause my shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to go</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0259">and as for thee, thou shalt be as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">of the fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Now therefore, I pray thee, speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he will not withhold</w> me from thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Howbeit he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto her voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but, being stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">than she, forced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and lay</w> with her.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0550">Then Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419 strong:H03966">her exceedingly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08135">so that the hatred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith he hated</w> her <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">than the love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherewith he had loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">her. And Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be gone</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>exceedingly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with great hatred greatly</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0182">no cause</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in sending me away</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">than the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me. But he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not hearken</w> unto her.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> now this <transChange type="added">woman</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">from me, and bolt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> her.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">she had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03801">a garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06446">of divers colours</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">upon her: for with such robes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">were the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">apparelled</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Then his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">her out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bolted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> her.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08559">And Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on her head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">her garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06446">of divers colours</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on her, and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on her head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">crying</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">her brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">unto her, Hath Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">been with thee? but hold now thy peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not this thing</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08559">So Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">in her brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Amnon</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Aminon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>regard…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set not thy heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and desolate</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">But when king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of all these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">he was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">unto his brother Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">neither good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">nor bad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H053">for Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">Amnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he had forced</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass after two full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">that Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">had sheepshearers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01178">in Baal–hazor</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">beside Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H053">and Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">invited</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold now, thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath sheepshearers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-187">let</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">I beseech thee, and his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-187">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">to Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Nay, my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us not all now go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest we be chargeable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee. And he pressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: howbeit he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but blessed</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">If not, I pray thee, let my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with us. And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Why should he go</w> with thee?

verses.name: II Samuel 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">But Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">him, that he let Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> with him.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">Now Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">ye now when Amnon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">is merry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">with wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when I say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto you, Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">Amnon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">not: have not I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you? be courageous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428 strong:H01121">and be valiant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">will you not, since I have commanded you?</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>valiant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of valour</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">unto Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">as Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gat him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06505">upon his mule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gat…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rode</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01870">And it came to pass, while they were in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08052">that tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and there is not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of them left</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and tare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">and all his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">by with their clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">rent</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03122">And Jonadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08093">of Shimeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let not my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">suppose</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">all the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0550">for Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">only is dead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">for by the appointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">this hath been determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he forced</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">his sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appointment</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>determined</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">settled</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Now therefore let not my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to think</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are dead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0550">for Amnon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">only is dead</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">But Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that kept the watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03122">And Jonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Behold, the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">as thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">said</w>, so it is.<note type="study"><catchWord>as thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the word of thy servant</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">of speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that, behold, the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">also and all his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419 strong:H01065">sore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with a great weeping greatly</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">But Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08526">to Talmai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05989 strong:H05991" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of Ammihud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">of Geshur</w>. And <transChange type="added">David</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ammihud</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ammihur</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 13:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">So Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">to Geshur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and was there three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 13:39
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the soul of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">longed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he was comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">concerning Amnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seeing he was dead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>longed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">was consumed</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen318" osisID="2Sam.13"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">Now Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H053">toward Absalom</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08620">to Tekoah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">thence a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">now mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">not thyself with oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">but be as a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">that had a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for the dead</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">on this manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">unto him. So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in her mouth</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">And when the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08621">of Tekoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">on her face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and did obeisance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Help</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Save</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H061">indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and mine husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is dead</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08198">And thy handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">had two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and they two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">strove together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them, but the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the other</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">no deliverer between them</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">And, behold, the whole family</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is risen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">against thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that we may kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him, for the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he slew</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the heir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also: and so they shall quench</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">my coal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">which is left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and shall not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to my husband</w> <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">nor remainder</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon the face of the earth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will give charge</w> concerning thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08621">of Tekoah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">on me, and on my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">and his throne</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">guiltless</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Whosoever saith</w> <transChange type="added">ought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto thee, bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to me, and he shall not touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee any more</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">she, I pray thee, let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">any more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lest they destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08185">there shall not one hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that the revenger of blood do not multiply to destroy</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">Then the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">Let thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I pray thee, speak</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Say on</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore then hast thou thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">such a thing against the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">doth speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0818">as one which is faulty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">in that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">doth not fetch home again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his banished</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">For we must needs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">spilt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which cannot be gathered up again</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">neither doth God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">respect</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">person</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet doth he devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">means</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that his banished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not expelled</w> from him.<note type="study"><catchWord>neither…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">because God hath not taken away his life, he hath also devised means</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now therefore that I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">because the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have made me afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08198">and thy handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will now speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">it may be that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the request</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of his handmaid</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">his handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <transChange type="added">that would</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me and my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">out of the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08198">Then thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">shall now be comfortable</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04397">for as an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and bad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> will be with thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>comfortable</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for rest</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to discern</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to hear</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not from me, I pray thee, the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I shall ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">thee. And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">now speak</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with thee in all this? And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H0786">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H03231" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">turn to the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08041" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">or to the left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">from ought that my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he bade</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">of thine handmaid</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05668">To</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">fetch about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">this form</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">hath thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0113">and my lord</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">according to the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">unto Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold now, I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-188">therefore, bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-188">again</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">himself, and thanked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03097">and Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">To day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">in that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the request</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thanked</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">blessed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his servant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thy servant</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">to Geshur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Let him turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let him not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>. <w lemma="strong:H053">So Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">But in all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">there was none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">to be so much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">as Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">for his beauty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03709">from the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of his foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">even to the crown of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03971">there was no blemish</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>But…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And as Absalom there was not a beautiful man in all Israel to praise greatly</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when he polled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">for it was at every year’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that he polled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: because <transChange type="added">the hair</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">on him, therefore he polled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it:) he weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">at two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">after the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">weight</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And unto Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">there were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08559">Tamar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">she was a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">of a fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">countenance</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">So Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">two full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">Therefore Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">for Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him to the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him: and when he sent again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not come</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">is near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08184">and he hath barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">there; go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it on fire</w>. <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>near…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">near my place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 14:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">Then Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">to Absalom</w> unto <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto him, Wherefore have thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">my field</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 14:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hither, that I may send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore am I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">from Geshur</w>? <transChange type="added">it had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> for me <transChange type="added">to have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there still: now therefore let me see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03426">and if there be</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in me, let him kill</w> me.

verses.name: II Samuel 14:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and when he had called</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">for Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">himself on his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen319" osisID="2Sam.14"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">that Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">him chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to run</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">rose up early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>: and it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that when any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">that had a controversy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">then Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0335">Of what</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to come</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy matters</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05228">and right</w>; but <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> no man <transChange type="added">deputed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to hear</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>there…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">none will hear thee from the king downward</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">moreover, Oh that I were made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">which hath any suit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">or cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto me, and I would do him justice</w>!

verses.name: II Samuel 15:5
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that when any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came nigh</w> <transChange type="added">to him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to do him obeisance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and kissed</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And on this manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H053">so Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">stole</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">that Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, let me go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">my vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">For thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">a vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">while I abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">at Geshur</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">in Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">If the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8799">shall bring me again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">indeed to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then I will serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">to Hebron</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">But Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">spies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">throughout all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">As soon as ye hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then ye shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">in Hebron</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And with Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">out of Jerusalem</w>, <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">called</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">in their simplicity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not any thing</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">for Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01526">the Gilonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsellor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">from his city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01542">from Giloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">while he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07195">And the conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0533">was strong</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">with Absalom</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">The hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">are after</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto all his servants</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">with him at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us flee</w>; for we shall not <transChange type="added">else</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06413">escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">make speed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">lest he overtake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">us suddenly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">upon us, and smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thrust</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold, thy servants</w> <transChange type="added">are ready to do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">whatsoever my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall appoint</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appoint</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">choose</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all his household</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him. And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at his feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01023 strong:H04801" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">that was far off</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And all his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03774">him; and all the Cherethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06432">and all the Pelethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01663">and all the Gittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">him from Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0863">to Ittai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore goest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou also with us? return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to thy place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w>: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05237">a stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and also an exile</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Whereas thou camest</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08543">yesterday</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">should I this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">make thee go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128 strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">up and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with us? seeing I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">whither I may, return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thou, and take back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>go up…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wander in going</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0863">And Ittai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">surely in what place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">shall be, whether in death</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">or life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">even there also will thy servant</w> be.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0863">to Ittai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and pass over</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0863">And Ittai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all his men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">and all the little ones</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And all the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed over</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also himself passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Kidron</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Cedron</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06659">And lo Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">also, and all the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him, bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they set down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">until all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">passing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">unto Zadok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Carry back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if I shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he will bring me again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shew</w> me <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05116">it, and his habitation</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if he thus say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have no delight</w> in thee; behold, <transChange type="added">here am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I, let him do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to me as seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> unto him.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">also unto Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <transChange type="added">Art not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou a seer</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and your two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0290">with you, Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">of Abiathar</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8700">I will tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05679 strong:H06160" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until there come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from you to certify</w> me.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">therefore and Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-189">carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-189">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they tarried</w> there.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:30
