verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">by the ascent</w> of <transChange type="added">mount</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02132">Olivet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as he went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and had his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">covered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03182">barefoot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as they went up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and wept…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">going up and weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 15:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0302">Ahithophel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among the conspirators</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">with Absalom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">I pray thee, turn the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">of Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">into foolishness</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And it came to pass, that <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <transChange type="added">of the mount</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">where he worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02365">behold, Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0757">the Archite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">him with his coat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Unto whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If thou passest on</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">with me, then thou shalt be a burden</w> unto me:

verses.name: II Samuel 15:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if thou return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">I will be thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>; <transChange type="added">as</transChange> I <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0227">hitherto</w>, so <transChange type="added">will</transChange> I now also <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then mayest thou for me defeat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">of Ahithophel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:35
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">hast thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06659">not there with thee Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>? therefore it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">what thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">soever thou shalt hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">out of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt tell</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06659">to Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:36
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">they have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">there with them their two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0290">Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">Zadok’s</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">Abiathar’s</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and by them</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto me every thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye can hear</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 15:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02365">So Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07463">friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">and Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">into Jerusalem</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen320" osisID="2Sam.15"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">was a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">past</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the top</w> <transChange type="added">of the hill</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06717">behold, Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04648">of Mephibosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">him, with a couple</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saddled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and upon them two hundred</w> <transChange type="added">loaves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06778">bunches of raisins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">of summer fruits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">and a bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06717">unto Ziba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06717">What meanest thou by these? And Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">The asses</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to ride on</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03899">and the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">and summer fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">for the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03196">and the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03287">that such as be faint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may drink</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, And where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06717">And Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, he abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">To day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">shall the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04468">me the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06717">to Ziba</w>, Behold, thine <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all that <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04648">unto Mephibosheth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06717">And Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">I humbly</w> beseech thee <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I humbly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I do obeisance</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And when king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0980">to Bahurim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, thence came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01617">of Gera</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he came forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">still as he came</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he came forth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he still came forth and cursed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">at David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and at all the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">and all the mighty men</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">and on his left</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thus said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he cursed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">thou bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and thou man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>bloody…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">man of blood</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">upon thee all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in whose stead thou hast reigned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>: and, behold, thou <transChange type="added">art taken</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in thy mischief</w>, because thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">a bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>behold…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">behold thee in thy evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Why should this dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">dog</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me go over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I pray thee, and take off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">What have I to do with you, ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so let him curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto him, Curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall then say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore hast thou done so</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">to Abishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and to all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Behold, my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">of my bowels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>: how much more now <transChange type="added">may this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01145">Benjamite</w> <transChange type="added">do it</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">let him alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and let him curse</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath bidden</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">It may be that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040 strong:H05869" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">on mine affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">will requite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">me good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">for his cursing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>affliction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tears</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eye</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went along</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">on the hill’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and threw</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H06080" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dusted him with dust</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05889">weary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05314" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and refreshed</w> themselves there.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0302">and Ahithophel</w> with him.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02365">And it came to pass, when Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0757">the Archite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07463">friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02365">that Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let the king live</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02365">to Hushai</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">this thy kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to thy friend</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">why wentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thou not with thy friend</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02365">And Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Nay; but whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">choose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">his will I be, and with him will I abide</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom should I serve</w>? <transChange type="added">should I</transChange> not <transChange type="added">serve</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his son</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I have served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">so will I be in thy presence</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">to Ahithophel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among you what we shall do</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0302">And Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he hath left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that thou art abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">then shall the hands</w> of all that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee be strong</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So they spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">a tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the top of the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H053">and Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06098">And the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">of Ahithophel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he counselled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in those days</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">as if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">at the oracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: so <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098">all the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">of Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">both with David</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">and with Absalom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oracle</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen321" osisID="2Sam.16"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0302">Moreover Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me now choose out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">this night</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will come</w> upon him while he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03023">weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H07504">and weak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">handed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will make him afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him shall flee</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> only:

verses.name: II Samuel 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And I will bring back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto thee: the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">whom thou seekest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as if all returned</w>: <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">shall be in peace</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was right in the eyes of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H02365">now Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0757">the Archite</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also, and let us hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">likewise what he saith</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>what…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">what is in his mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02365">And when Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">to Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0302">Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">after this manner</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall we do</w> <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his saying</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">if not; speak</w> thou.<note type="study"><catchWord>his saying</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his word</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02365">And Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">unto Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">The counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">that Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">at this time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>given</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">counselled</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For, said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02365">Hushai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">and his men</w>, that they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w>, and they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">chafed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in their minds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01677">as a bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07909">robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of her whelps in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and thy father</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chafed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter of soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Behold, he is hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">now in some</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">or in some</w> <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">at the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it will say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04046">There is a slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">that follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overthrown</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fallen</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:10
verses.text: And he also <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428 strong:H01121">valiant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">whose heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">as the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of a lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">shall utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">melt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that thy father</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty man</w>, and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> which <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with him <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">that all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">be generally</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">unto thee, from Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">even to Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and that thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in thine own person</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that thy face</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">presence go</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So shall we come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon him in some</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">where he shall be found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05168">and we will light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">upon him as the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">on the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and of him and of all the men</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with him there shall not be left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">so much as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">Moreover, if</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he be gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into a city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">then shall all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">ropes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to that city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we will draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">it into the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01571">until there be not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06872">small stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">found</w> there.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">The counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02365">of Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0757">the Archite</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">than the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">of Ahithophel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to defeat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">of Ahithophel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05668">to the intent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">might bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">upon Absalom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appointed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">commanded</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02365">Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">unto Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">and to Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0302">Thus and thus did Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thus and thus have I counselled</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">quickly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">not this night</w> <w lemma="strong:H05679 strong:H06160" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass over</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">lest the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be swallowed up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with him.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">Now Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0290">and Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05883">by En–rogel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they might</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">not be seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08198">and a wench</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">Nevertheless a lad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">of them away quickly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0980">in Bahurim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0875">which had a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in his court</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08033">whither</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went down</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">over the well’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07849" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07383">ground corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thereon; and the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not known</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And when Absalom’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0290">Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, They be gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04323">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And when they had sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and could not find</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they were departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">out of the well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04120">and pass quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0302">for thus hath Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">counselled</w> against you.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and they passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01242">by the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there lacked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them that was not gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0302">And when Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">that his counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not followed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he saddled</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02543">ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gat him home</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">to his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and put his household</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">in order</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02614" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">in the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>followed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">done</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>put his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave charge concerning his house</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">to Mahanaim</w>. <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">he and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> with him.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">captain of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">instead of Joab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06021">which Amasa</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03501">Ithra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03481">an Israelite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H026">to Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05176">of Nahash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">to Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ithra an Israelite</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jether an Ishmaelite</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Abigail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Abigal</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Nahash</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jesse</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">So Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">and Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And it came to pass, when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">to Mahanaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07629">that Shobi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05176">of Nahash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">of Rabbah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04353">and Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05988">of Ammiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03810">of Lo–debar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01271">and Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07274">of Rogelim</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 17:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">beds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05592">and basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and earthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02406">and wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08184">and barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07058">and flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07039">and parched</w> <transChange type="added">corn</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06321">and beans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05742">and lentiles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07039">and parched</w> <transChange type="added">pulse</transChange>,<note type="study"><catchWord>basons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cups</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01706">And honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02529">and butter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08194">and cheese</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of kine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and for the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him, to eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07457">hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05889">and weary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06771">and thirsty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen322" osisID="2Sam.17"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w> over them.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sent forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">of Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0863">of Ittai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0589">with you myself</w> also.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">But the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not go forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for if we flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they will not care</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">for us; neither if half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of us die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will they care</w> for us: but now <transChange type="added">thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03644">worth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> of us: therefore now <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826 strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8687 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8800">that thou succour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">us out of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>care…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set their heart on us</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>worth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as ten thousand of us</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>succour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be to succour or help</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto them, What seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you best</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">by hundreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">and by thousands</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">and Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0863">and Ittai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">Deal</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0328">gently</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">for my sake with the young man</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H053">with Absalom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">gave all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">and the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">was in the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Where the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and there was there a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">For the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">was there scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">over the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the country</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03293">and the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">than the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">devoured</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>devoured</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiplied to devour</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650 strong:H06440">the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H06505">upon a mule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06505">and the mule</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07730">under the thick boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">oak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">caught hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">of the oak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">and he was taken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">between the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06505">and the mule</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">under him went away</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">in an oak</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, And, behold, thou sawest</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and why didst thou not smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him there to the ground</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and I would have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">thee ten</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and a</w> <w lemma="strong:H02290">girdle</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">unto Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">Though</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I should receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in mine hand</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would I not put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0241">for in our hearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">thee and Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0863">and Ittai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Beware</w> that none <transChange type="added">touch</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>receive</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weigh upon mine hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Beware…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Beware whosoever ye be of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0176">Otherwise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I should have wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsehood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against mine own life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">for there is no matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">from the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and thou thyself wouldest have set</w> thyself against <transChange type="added">me</transChange>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I may not tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thus with thee</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">darts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">them through the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Absalom</w>, while he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">yet alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">in the midst of the oak</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before thee</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">And ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">armour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">compassed about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from pursuing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03097">for Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">held back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">him into a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06354">pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">in the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">heap</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon him: and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to his tent</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H053">Now Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">in his lifetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04678">for himself a pillar</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">dale</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">I have no son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to keep my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in remembrance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04678">the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after his own name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">place</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0290">Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me now run</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-190">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-190">tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">how that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341 strong:H03027" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him of his enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>avenged…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judged him from the hand</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, Thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H01309">shalt not bear tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but thou shalt bear tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">but this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt bear no tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">because the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bear tidings this</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be a man of tidings</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">to Cushi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what thou hast seen</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03569">And Cushi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">himself unto Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0290">Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04100">But howsoever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me, I pray thee, also run</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">Cushi</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Wherefore wilt thou run</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01309">seeing that thou hast no tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ready</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>howsoever</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be what may</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>ready</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">convenient</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:23
verses.text: But howsoever, <transChange type="added">said he</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me run</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Run</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0290">Then Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and overran</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">Cushi</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">between the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">to the roof</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">over the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">unto the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and behold a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">running</w> alone.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, If he <transChange type="added">be</transChange> alone, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01309">tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in his mouth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">apace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07131">and drew near</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">running</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">unto the porter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Behold <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">running</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">alone. And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He also bringeth tidings</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Me thinketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04794">the running</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the foremost</w> <w lemma="strong:H04794">is like the running</w> <w lemma="strong:H0290">of Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01309">tidings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Me…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I see the running</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0290">And Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">All is well</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And he fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">upon his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">before the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which hath delivered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">against my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>All…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Peace be to thee</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>delivered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">Is the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">safe</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0290">And Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">When Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>, and <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">tumult</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I knew</w> not what <transChange type="added">it was</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Is there peace?</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <transChange type="added">unto him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn aside</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">here</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And he turned aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood still</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03569">And, behold, Cushi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03569">and Cushi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath avenged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of all them</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that rose up</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>Tidings</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Tidings is brought</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">unto Cushi</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">safe</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03569">And Cushi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that rise</w> against thee to do <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">hurt</w>, be as <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was much moved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">to the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">over the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and as he went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>! <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">would God I had died</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">O Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>! <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen323" osisID="2Sam.18"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Behold, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">weepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and mourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">for Absalom</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08668">And the victory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> was <transChange type="added">turned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H060">into mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">how the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for his son</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>victory</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">salvation</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">deliverance</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">gat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">them by stealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">as people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">being ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">steal away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in battle</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03813" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">O Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>!

verses.name: II Samuel 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast shamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of all thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">which this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">have saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and of thy daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of thy wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the lives</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">of thy concubines</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">In that thou lovest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and hatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy friends</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For thou hast declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">that thou regardest neither princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">nor servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I perceive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03863">that if</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">had lived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and all we had died</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03477">then it had pleased thee well</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>In…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">By loving</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>that thou regardest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that princes or servants are not to thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">comfortably</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for I swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">if thou go not forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there will not tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">with thee this night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and that will be worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto thee than all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that befell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">thee from thy youth</w> until now.<note type="study"><catchWord>comfortably…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the heart of thy servants</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Behold, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to his tent</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:9
