verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">were at strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">throughout all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of our enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and now he is fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">for Absalom</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H053">And Absalom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom we anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">over us, is dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in battle</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Now therefore why speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-191">ye not a word of bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-191">back</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>speak…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are ye silent?</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">to Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">and to Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0314">Why are ye the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-192">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-192">back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01697">seeing the speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:12
verses.text: Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w>, ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and my flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0314">wherefore then are ye the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring back</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">ye to Amasa</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">thou not of my bone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and of my flesh</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so to me, and more</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">also, if thou be not captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">in the room</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, even as <transChange type="added">the heart of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that they sent</w> <transChange type="added">this word</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thou, and all thy servants</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">to Jordan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-193">to conduct</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-193">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08096">And Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01617">of Gera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">a Benjamite</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0980">of Bahurim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01145">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06717">with him, and Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">and his fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and his twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him; and they went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05679">a ferry boat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to carry over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">what he thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08096">And Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01617">of Gera</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he was come over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>what…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the good in his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let not my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">impute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, neither do thou remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that which thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did perversely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">that my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">it to his heart</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">For thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have sinned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore, behold, I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H052">But Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shall not Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for this, because he cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">anointed</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">What have I to do with you, ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">that ye should this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">be adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto me? shall there any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for do not I know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Therefore the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">unto Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not die</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> unto him.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04648">And Mephibosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">and had neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor trimmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08222">his beard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">nor washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he came</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it came to pass, when he was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Wherefore wentest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04648">not thou with me, Mephibosheth</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">me: for thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will saddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">me an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereon, and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">because thy servant</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06455">lame</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he hath slandered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0113">but my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04397">as an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> therefore <transChange type="added">what is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:28
verses.text: For all <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">were but</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">before my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet didst thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them that did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at thine own table</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06666">What right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">therefore have</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I yet to cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">any more unto the king</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>dead…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto him, Why speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou any more of thy matters</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06717">Thou and Ziba</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the land</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04648">And Mephibosheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, let him take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">all, forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto his own house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01271">And Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07274">from Rogelim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to conduct</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">him over Jordan</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01271">Now Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">aged</w> man, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and he had provided the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">of sustenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07871">while he lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">at Mahanaim</w>; for he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">unto Barzillai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come thou over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">with me, and I will feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">thee with me in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01271">And Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">How long</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416 strong:H08141">have I to live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I should go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>How…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">How many days are the years of my life</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:35
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can I discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">between good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and evil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05650">can thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">what</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">or what</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I drink</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can I hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">any more the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of singing men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and singing women</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05650">wherefore then should thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">be yet a burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-194">will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-194">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and why should the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01578">it me with such a reward</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Let thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, turn back again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in mine own city</w>, <transChange type="added">and be buried</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06913">by the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and of my mother</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05650">But behold thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03643">Chimham</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him go over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">with my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H02896">to him what shall seem good</w> unto thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03643">Chimham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">over with me, and I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H02896">to him that which shall seem good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require</w> of me, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I do</w> for thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>require</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">choose</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">Barzillai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto his own place</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03643">and Chimham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with him: and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8689">conducted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and also half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Chimham</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Chimhan</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">And, behold, all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">Why have our brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stolen thee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and all David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">with him, over Jordan</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Because the king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near of kin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to us: wherefore then be ye angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for this matter</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have we eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <transChange type="added">cost</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">or hath he given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05379">us any gift</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">We have ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0589">and we</w> have also more <transChange type="added">right</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">in David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">than ye: why then did ye despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">us, that our advice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">should not be first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">had in bringing back</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">our king</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were fiercer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">than the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>despise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set us at light</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen324" osisID="2Sam.19"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And there happened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to be there a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07652">Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">a Benjamite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">a trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">We have no part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">in David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">neither have we inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">in the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to his tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">So every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07652">Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto their king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03383">from Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">even to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">them in ward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">and fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, but went not in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">unto them. So they were shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of their death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02424">living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0491">in widowhood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an house of ward</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shut…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bound</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>living…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in widowhood of life</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">to Amasa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Assemble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">within three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be thou here present</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Assemble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Call</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06021">So Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to assemble</w> <transChange type="added">the men of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03186 strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">but he tarried longer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">than the set time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had appointed</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>Assemble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Call</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">to Abishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07652">Now shall Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do us more harm</w> than <transChange type="added">did</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thou thy lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, lest he get</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">him fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">us</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>escape…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">deliver himself from our eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">him Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03774">and the Cherethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06432">and the Pelethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and all the mighty men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07652">Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:8
verses.text: When they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">at the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">in Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06021">Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">them. And Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">that he had put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">was girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02289">unto him, and upon it a girdle</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06775" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">upon his loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">in the sheath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; and as he went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it fell out</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">to Amasa</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">thou in health</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">by the beard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">with the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to kiss</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06021">But Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">took no heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03097">in Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02570">him therewith in the fifth</w> <transChange type="added">rib</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shed out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">his bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and struck him not again</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">and Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07652">Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>struck…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">doubled not his stroke</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04310">He</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that favoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, and he that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w>, <transChange type="added">let him go</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06021">And Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8706">wallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">of the highway</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">out of the highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">a cloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him, when he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that every one that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by him stood still</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03014" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">When he was removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">out of the highway</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07652">Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">through all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H059">unto Abel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01038">and to Beth–maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01276">and all the Berites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07035 strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8735">and they were gathered together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">also after</w> him.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H059">him in Abel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01038">of Beth–maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they cast up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">in the trench</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03097">with Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">battered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to throw it down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the trench</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against the outmost wall</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>battered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">marred to throw down</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">I pray you, unto Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hither, that I may speak</w> with thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto her, the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03097">thou Joab</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, I <transChange type="added">am he</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of thine handmaid</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I do hear</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">They were wont</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">in old time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">They shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ask</w> <transChange type="added">counsel</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H059">at Abel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and so they ended</w> <transChange type="added">the matter</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They were…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">They plainly spake in the beginning, saying, Surely they will ask of Abel, and so make an end</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:19
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am one of them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">peaceable</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thou seekest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and a mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">why wilt thou swallow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">Far be it</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">far be it</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">from me, that I should swallow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">or destroy</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The matter</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not so: but a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07652">Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">against David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him only, and I will depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">unto Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">Behold, his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">shall be thrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">to thee over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by name</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by his name</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">Then the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">in her wisdom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07652">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01075">of Bichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03097">out to Joab</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">a trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they retired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to his tent</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>retired</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were scattered</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03097">Now Joab</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">over all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03746 strong:H03774" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">over the Cherethites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06432">and over the Pelethites</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0151">And Adoram</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04522">over the tribute</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0286">of Ahilud</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">recorder</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>recorder</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">remembrancer</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07724 strong:H07864" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">And Sheva</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06659">and Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05896">And Ira</w> <w lemma="strong:H02972">also the Jairite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">was a chief ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">about David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a prince</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen325" osisID="2Sam.20"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07458">Then there was a famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">for Saul</w>, and for <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01393">the Gibeonites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enquired…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sought the face</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01393">the Gibeonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01393">unto them; (now the Gibeonites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">but of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">had sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto them: and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them in his zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>.)

verses.name: II Samuel 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Wherefore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01393">unto the Gibeonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">that ye may bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01393">And the Gibeonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">unto him, We will have no silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">nor gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">nor of his house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">neither for us shalt thou kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">What ye shall say</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I do</w> for you.<note type="study"><catchWord>We will…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">It is not silver nor gold that we have to do with Saul or his house, neither pertains it to us to kill</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">The man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">us, and that devised</w> against us <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">we should be destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">from remaining</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in any of the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>devised…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cut us off</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Let seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto us, and we will hang them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">in Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0972">did choose</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>whom…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chosen of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04648">Mephibosheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">oath</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">between them, between David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07532">of Rizpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0345">of Aiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">unto Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0764">Armoni</w> <w lemma="strong:H04648">and Mephibosheth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02568">and the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04324">of Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom she brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05741">for Adriel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">of Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H04259">the Meholathite</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Michal</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Michal’s sister</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bear to Adriel</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01393">of the Gibeonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">them in the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fell</w> <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07659 strong:H07651" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">and were put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of harvest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <transChange type="added">days</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08462">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">harvest</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07532">And Rizpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0345">of Aiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">it for her upon the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08462">from the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">of harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">until water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">dropped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">upon them out of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">neither the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">on them by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">nor the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07532">what Rizpah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0345">of Aiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06370">the concubine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">and the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">from the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">of Jabesh–gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which had stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">them from the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H01052">of Beth–shan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">where the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518 strong:H08511" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">had hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them, when</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">in Gilboa</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">from thence the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">and the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03363" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">of them that were hanged</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">And the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">they in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06762">in Zelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06913">in the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">of Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">Moreover the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">had yet war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">again with Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">with him, and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">against the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed faint</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03430">And Ishbi–benob</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03211">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04948">the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07013">of whose spear</w> <transChange type="added">weighed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">in weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">he being girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">with a new</w> <transChange type="added">sword</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the giant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Rapha</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>spear</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the staff</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">the head</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H052">But Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">succoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">him. Then the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">no more out with us to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that thou quench</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">not the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>light</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">candle</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">lamp</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">that there was again a battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01359">at Gob</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05444">then Sibbechai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02843">the Hushathite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05593">Saph</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03211">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the giant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Rapha</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Saph</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Sippai</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was again a battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01359">in Gob</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0445">where Elhanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03296">of Jaare–oregim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01022">a Beth–lehemite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <transChange type="added">the brother of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01555">Goliath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">of whose spear</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a weaver’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04500">beam</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jaare–oregim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jair</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was yet a battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">in Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">where was a man</w> of <transChange type="added">great</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04055 strong:H04067" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">stature</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">that had on every hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">fingers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and on every foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">toes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">in number</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">and he also was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">to the giant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the giant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Rapha</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And when he defied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08092">of Shimea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>defied</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reproached</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shimea</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shammah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">These four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">to the giant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">in Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen326" osisID="2Sam.21"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">him out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all his enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05553">my rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04686">and my fortress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and my deliverer</w>;

verses.name: II Samuel 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">of my rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in him will I trust</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">my shield</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07161">and the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04869">my high tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04498">and my refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">my saviour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou savest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">me from violence</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">worthy to be praised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so shall I be saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from mine enemies</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04867">When the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0661" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">me, the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of ungodly men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made me afraid</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>waves</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pangs</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>ungodly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">The sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">compassed me about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04170">the snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">prevented</w> me;<note type="study"><catchWord>sorrows</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cords</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">In my distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">out of his temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07775">and my cry</w> <transChange type="added">did enter</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">into his ears</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Then the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607 strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8691">shook</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trembled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04146">the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and shook</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he was wroth</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">There went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">a smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">out of his nostrils</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devoured</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01513">coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were kindled</w> by it.<note type="study"><catchWord>out of his nostrils</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also, and came down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06205">and darkness</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under his feet</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">upon a cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did fly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he was seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">upon the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the wind</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">pavilions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02841">him, dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05645">thick clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">of the skies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dark…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">binding of waters</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05051">Through the brightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">before him were coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kindled</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thundered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">and the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">them; lightning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and discomfited</w> them.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0650">And the channels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04146">the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were discovered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01606">at the rebuking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05397">at the blast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his nostrils</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">from above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04871" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me; he drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">me out of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>many</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">great</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">me from my strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from them that hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: for they were too strong</w> for me.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They prevented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of my calamity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04937">was my stay</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He brought me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04800">also into a large place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, because he delighted</w> in me.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">me according to my righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01252">according to the cleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath he recompensed</w> me.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not wickedly departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from my God</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">For all his judgments</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> before me: and <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I did not depart</w> from them.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08549">I was also upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">before him, and have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">myself from mine iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>before</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath recompensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">me according to my righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01252">according to my cleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H05048">in his eye sight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02623">With the merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02616" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself merciful</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">with the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself upright</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">With the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself pure</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06141">and with the froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06617" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shew thyself unsavoury</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wrestle</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06041">And the afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou wilt save</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">but thine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon the haughty</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> thou mayest bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">down</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:29
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05216">my lamp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05050" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will lighten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">my darkness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For by thee I have run</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">through a troop</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">by my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01801" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have I leaped over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07791">a wall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>run</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:31
