verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0565">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">tried</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">a buckler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to all them that trust</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>tried</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">refined</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:32
verses.text: For who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01107">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? and who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">a rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01107">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 22:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">my strength</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maketh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">riddeth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">looseth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8764" type="x-split-195">He maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8764" type="x-split-195">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H0355">hinds’</w> <transChange type="added">feet</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">me upon my high places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maketh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">equalleth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07198">so that a bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05154">of steel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">is broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">by mine arms</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to war</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the war</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast also given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">me the shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of thy salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06038 strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8800">and thy gentleness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath made me great</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiplied me</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou hast enlarged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">my steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H07166">under me; so that my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04571" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did not slip</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>feet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ankles</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; and turned not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">until I had consumed</w> them.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I have consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, that they could not arise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, they are fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under my feet</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For thou hast girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">me with strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">them that rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me hast thou subdued</w> under me.<note type="study"><catchWord>subdued</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to bow</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast also given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">me the necks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I might destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them that hate</w> me.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They looked</w>, but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to save</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he answered</w> them not.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07833" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then did I beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">them as small as the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I did stamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">them as the mire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of the street</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did spread them abroad</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou also hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">me from the strivings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast kept</w> me <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not shall serve</w> me.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">Strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall submit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves unto me: as soon as they hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall be obedient</w> unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>Strangers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Sons of the stranger</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>submit…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">yield feigned obedience</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">Strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fade away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">out of their close places</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">my rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">be the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:48
verses.text: It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that avengeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">me, and that bringeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> under me,<note type="study"><catchWord>avengeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">giveth avengement for</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And that bringeth me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from mine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">thou also hast lifted me up on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">above them that rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me: thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">me from the violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore I will give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto thy name</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:51
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431 strong:H04024" morph="strongMorph:TH8688 strongMorph:TH8675">the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for his king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">to his anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and to his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">evermore</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen327" osisID="2Sam.22"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:1
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0314">the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">and the man</w> <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">raised up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05920">on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04899">the anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05273">and the sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02158">psalmist</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">said</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">by me, and his word</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03956">in my tongue</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">the Rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to me, He that ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">over men</w> <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">just</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ruling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">in the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Be thou ruler</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">as the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of the morning</w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">riseth</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01242">a morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">clouds</w>; <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01877">the tender grass</w> <transChange type="added">springing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05051">by clear shining</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">after rain</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">Although my house</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">not so with God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">with me an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">ordered</w> in all <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and sure</w>: for <transChange type="added">this is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03468">all my salvation</w>, and all <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">desire</w>, although he make <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not to grow</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>But <transChange type="added">the sons</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06975">all of them as thorns</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">thrust away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because they cannot be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with hands</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">But the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them must be fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">with iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">of a spear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and they shall be utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> in the <transChange type="added">same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07675" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fenced</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08461">had: The Tachmonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03429 strong:H07675" morph="strongMorph:TH8677 strongMorph:TH8800">in the seat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">among the captains</w>; the same <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05722">Adino</w> <w lemma="strong:H06112">the Eznite</w>: <transChange type="added">he lift up his spear</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">against eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">whom he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">at one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The Tachmonite…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Joshebbassebet the Tachmonite, head of the three</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>whom he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">slain</rdg></note><note type="study">1ch 11:11 he lift…: from whom he…: Heb. slain</note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01734">of Dodo</w> <w lemma="strong:H0266">the Ahohite</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when they defied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were there gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were gone away</w>:

verses.name: II Samuel 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03588">until</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was weary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">unto the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">victory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him only to spoil</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08048">Shammah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H089">of Agee</w> <w lemma="strong:H02043">the Hararite</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">into a troop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02513">where was a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05742">of lentiles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for foraging</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">But he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">of the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and defended</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">victory</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970 strong:H07969" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">And three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">in the harvest time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">unto the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05725">of Adullam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the troop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of Rephaim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>three…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the three captains over the thirty</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04686">then in an hold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04673">and the garrison</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> then <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01035">Beth–lehem</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">longed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Oh that one would give me drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w>!

verses.name: II Samuel 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brake through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nevertheless he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, but poured it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02486">Be it far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I should do</w> this: <transChange type="added">is not this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in jeopardy of their lives</w>? <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore he would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it. These things did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H052">And Abishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">was chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">among three</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">And he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">his spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">against three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slew</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and had the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">among three</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and slew them</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">slain</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Was he not most honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08269">therefore he was their captain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">howbeit he attained</w> not unto the <transChange type="added">first</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">And Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of a valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0381 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06909">of Kabzeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">who had done many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">acts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0739">lionlike men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of a pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">of snow</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>who…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great of acts</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lionlike…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lion of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">an Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04758">a goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04713">and the Egyptian</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">had a spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">to him with a staff</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and plucked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">the spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04713">out of the Egyptian’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">him with his own spear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a goodly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of countenance</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sight</rdg>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">a man of great stature</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:22
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and had the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">among three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">He was more honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">than the thirty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he attained</w> not to the <transChange type="added">first</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04928">him over his guard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>more…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">honourable among the thirty</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>guard</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">council</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at his command</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06214">Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">one of the thirty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0445">Elhanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01734">of Dodo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08048">Shammah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02733">the Harodite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0470">Elika</w> <w lemma="strong:H02733">the Harodite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02503">Helez</w> <w lemma="strong:H06407">the Paltite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05896">Ira</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06142">of Ikkesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08621">the Tekoite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H044">Abiezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06069">the Anethothite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04012">Mebunnai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02843">the Hushathite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06756">Zalmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0266">the Ahohite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04121">Maharai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05200">the Netophathite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02460">Heleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01196">of Baanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05200">a Netophathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0863">Ittai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07380">of Ribai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">out of Gibeah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06553">the Pirathonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01914">Hiddai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01608">of Gaash</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>brooks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valleys</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H045">Abi–albon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06164">the Arbathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05820">Azmaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01273">the Barhumite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0455">Eliahba</w> <w lemma="strong:H08170">the Shaalbonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03464">of Jashen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08048">Shammah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02043">the Hararite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0279">Ahiam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08325">of Sharar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02043">the Hararite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0467">Eliphelet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0308">of Ahasbai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04602">of the Maachathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0463">Eliam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">of Ahithophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01526">the Gilonite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02695">Hezrai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03761">the Carmelite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06474">Paarai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0701">the Arbite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03008">Igal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">of Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01137">Bani</w> <w lemma="strong:H01425">the Gadite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06768">Zelek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05984">the Ammonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05171">Naharai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0886">the Beerothite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05896">Ira</w> <w lemma="strong:H03505">an Ithrite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01619">Gareb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03505">an Ithrite</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0223">Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> in all. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen328" osisID="2Sam.23"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against them to say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the host</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with him, Go now through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">from Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">even to Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">ye the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Go</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Compass</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">add</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">how many soever</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471 strong:H03967">they be, an hundredfold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and that the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">may see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0113">but why doth my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in this thing</w>?

verses.name: II Samuel 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Notwithstanding the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">against Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and against the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the host</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06177">in Aroer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> that <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03270">and toward Jazer</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>river</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">to Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08483">of Tahtim–hodshi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01842">to Dan–jaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">and about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">to Zidon</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>land of Tahtim–hodshi</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">nether land newly inhabited</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">to the strong hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and to all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02340">of the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">and of the Canaanites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">to the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0884">to Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So when they had gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through all the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">of nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H04662">of the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">and there were in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0381 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">him after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in that I have done</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and now, I beseech thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03966">for I have done very</w> <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">foolishly</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">For when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">came unto the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">seer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Samuel 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05190" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thee three</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">thee one</w> of them, that I may <transChange type="added">do it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01410">So Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">unto him, Shall seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">of famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thee in thy land</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">or wilt thou flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">while they pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thee? or that there be three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in thy land</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now advise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">what answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that sent</w> me.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">unto Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">I am in a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">strait</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">now into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07356">for his mercies</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let me not fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are great</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">are many</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">a pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">from the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">even to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">appointed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there died</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">from Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">even to Beer–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And when the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him of the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">to the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">It is enough</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">now thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">was by the threshingplace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0728">of Araunah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Araunah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ornan</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Lo, I have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I have done wickedly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06629">but these sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what have they done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03027">let thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">I pray thee, be against me, and against my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01410">And Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">rear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0728">of Araunah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Araunah</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Araniah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0728">And Araunah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">coming on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0728">toward him: and Araunah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">himself before the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">on his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0728">And Araunah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Wherefore is my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to his servant</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of thee, to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04046">that the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0728">And Araunah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offer up</w> what <transChange type="added">seemeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">unto him</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">behold</w>, <transChange type="added">here be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04173">and threshing instruments</w> and <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">for wood</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:23
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0728">did Araunah</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0728">And Araunah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">accept</w> thee.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0728">unto Araunah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Nay; but I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">buy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04242">of thee at a price</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither will I offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">of that which doth cost me nothing</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and the oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">for fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04046">and the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen329" osisID="2Sam.24"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen305" osisID="2Sam" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Now king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was old</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">him with clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he gat no heat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stricken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">entered into days</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Wherefore his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto him, Let there be sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">for my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and let her stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and let her cherish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and let her lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in thy bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">that my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may get heat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Let there…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let them seek</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a young…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a damsel, a virgin</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cherish…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be a cherisher unto him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So they sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">for a fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">damsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">throughout all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H049">Abishag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">a Shunammite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">her to the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">And the damsel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and cherished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to him: but the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> her not.

verses.name: I Kings 1:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0138">Then Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02294">of Haggith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04984" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">himself, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">him chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to run</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>be king</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">reign</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had not displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him at any time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why hast thou done so</w>? and he also <transChange type="added">was a</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H08389 strong:H02896">goodly</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>; and <transChange type="added">his mother</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">him after</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at any…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from his days</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And he conferred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">with Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H054">and with Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and they following</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">helped</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his words were with</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>following…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">helped after Adonijah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">But Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07472">and Rei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and the mighty men</w> which <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">were not with Adonijah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0138">And Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04806">and fat cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">by the stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02120">of Zoheleth</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05883">En–rogel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">all his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>En–rogel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the well Rogel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05416">But Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and the mighty men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he called</w> not.

verses.name: I Kings 1:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05416">Wherefore Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01339">unto Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou not heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">that Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02294">of Haggith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not?

verses.name: I Kings 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098 strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">that thou mayest save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thine own life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and get thee in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto him, Didst not thou, my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">unto thine handmaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">Assuredly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and he shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon my throne</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0138">why then doth Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reign</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Behold, while thou yet talkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">there with the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I also will come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, and confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>confirm</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fill up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01339">And Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into the chamber</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H049">and Abishag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">the Shunammite</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01339">And Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and did obeisance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, What wouldest thou?<note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What to thee?</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto him, My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou swarest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">unto thine handmaid</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">Assuredly Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and he shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon my throne</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0138">And now, behold, Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0113">and now, my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not:

verses.name: I Kings 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he hath slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04806">and fat cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">and Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">but Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he not called</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">And thou, my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">upon thee, that thou shouldest tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them who shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0113">Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that I and my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">shall be counted offenders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offenders</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sinners</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And, lo, while she yet talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also came in</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">Behold Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">himself before the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">with his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05416">And Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and he shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon my throne</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he is gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04806">and fat cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">Adonijah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let king Adonijah live</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:26
verses.text: But me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">me thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06659">and Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath he not called</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Is this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">by my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou hast not shewed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who should sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him?

verses.name: I Kings 1:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01339">me Bath–sheba</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">out of all distress</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 1:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Even as I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">Assuredly Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and he shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon my throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in my stead; even so will I certainly do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01339">Then Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bowed</w> with <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and did reverence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Let my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">me Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with you the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of your lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and cause Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H06506">upon mine own mule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01521">to Gihon</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which belongeth to me</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">And let Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him there king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">ye with the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then ye shall come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, that he may come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon my throne</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he shall be king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in my stead: and I have appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">him to be ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and over Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">And Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> so <transChange type="added">too</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">As the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">hath been with my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">even so be he with Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-196">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-196">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">than the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">So Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03774">and the Cherethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06432">and the Pelethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and caused Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">upon king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06506">mule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01521">him to Gihon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">And Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">an horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">out of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him, and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">piped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02485">with pipes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08056">and rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">so that the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the sound</w> of them.<note type="study"><catchWord>pipes</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">flutes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 1:41
