verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0138">And Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and all the guests</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as they had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of eating</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And when Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, Wherefore <transChange type="added">is this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">being in an uproar</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 1:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And while he yet spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">behold, Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">of Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0138">and Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Come in</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">a valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0381 strong:H0376" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-197">and bringest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-197">tidings</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03129">And Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">to Adonijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H061">Verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">hath made Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">with him Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03774">and the Cherethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06432">and the Pelethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they have caused him to ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">upon the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06506">mule</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 1:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">And Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01521">in Gihon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they are come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">from thence rejoicing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">so that the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01949" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">rang again</w>. This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye have heard</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And also Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">of the kingdom</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And moreover the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">make the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">than thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-198">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-198">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">than thy throne</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">himself upon the bed</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And also thus said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath given</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on my throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">even seeing</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And all the guests</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0138">with Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:50
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0138">And Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and caught hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">on the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">Behold, Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for, lo, he hath caught hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">on the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Let king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto me to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he will not slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">If he will shew himself a worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08185">there shall not an hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of him fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">but if wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in him, he shall die</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 1:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">from the altar</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">himself to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thine house</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen331" osisID="1Kgs.1"/>

verses.name: I Kings 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Now the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he should die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be thou strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">therefore, and shew thyself a man</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05715">and his testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as it is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that thou mayest prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in all that thou doest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and whithersoever thou turnest</w> thyself:<note type="study"><catchWord>prosper</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">do wisely</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">concerning me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">If thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to their way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">me in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all their soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">there shall not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee (said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">he) a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fail…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be cut off from thee from the throne</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">also what Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> to me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">to the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">unto Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06021">and unto Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03500">of Jether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom he slew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H02290">upon his girdle</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">about his loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05275">and in his shoes</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on his feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">put</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">therefore according to thy wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07872">and let not his hoar head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">of Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and let them be of those that eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at thy table</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for so they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to me when I fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:8
verses.text: And, behold, <transChange type="added">thou hast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08096">with thee Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01617">of Gera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">a Benjamite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0980">of Bahurim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04834" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">me with a grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04266">to Mahanaim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">me at Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to him by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not put thee to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grievous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Now therefore hold him not guiltless</w>: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what thou oughtest to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">unto him; but his hoar head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring thou down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">he in Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">he in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04438">and his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was established</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0138">And Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02294">of Haggith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01339">to Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">thou peaceably</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peaceably</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">moreover, I have somewhat to say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee. And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Say on</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">that the kingdom</w> was mine, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on me, that I should reign</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04410">howbeit the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is turned about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and is become my brother’s</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for it was his from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And now I ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">petition</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of thee, deny</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not. And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto him, Say on</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deny…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turn not away my face</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">I pray thee, unto Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-199">for he will not say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-199">nay</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he give</w> <w lemma="strong:H049">me Abishag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">the Shunammite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01339">And Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">Well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for thee unto the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01339">Bath–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">unto him for Adonijah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">her, and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself unto her, and sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">and caused a seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to be set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on his right hand</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">petition</w> of thee; <transChange type="added">I pray thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-200">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-200">not nay</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Ask on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">my mother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-201">for I will not say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-201">nay</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H049">Let Abishag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">the Shunammite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">to Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">unto his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And why dost thou ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H049">Abishag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">the Shunammite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">for Adonijah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">for him the kingdom</w> also; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">mine elder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H054">even for him, and for Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">and for Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so to me, and more also</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">if Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have not spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against his own life</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:24
verses.text: Now therefore, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which hath established</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">me on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and who hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he promised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">of Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him that he died</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H054">And unto Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H06068">thee to Anathoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">unto thine own fields</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">worthy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">but I will not at this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">put thee to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou barest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and because thou hast been afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in all wherein my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">was afflicted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>worthy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">So Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thrust out</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">from being priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that he might fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">concerning the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05941">of Eli</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">in Shiloh</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08052">Then tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03097">for Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0138">Adonijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">though he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not after</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and caught hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">on the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">that Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; and, behold, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">fall</w> upon him.

verses.name: I Kings 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">And Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come forth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Nay; but I will die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">here. And Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-202">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-202">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thus said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thus he answered</w> me.

verses.name: I Kings 2:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him, and bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him; that thou mayest take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">which Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from me, and from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his own head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">more righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and better</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">than he, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">them with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not knowing</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H074">Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06021">and Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03500">of Jether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818">Their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall therefore return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but upon David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and upon his seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and upon his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">and upon his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">shall there be peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">So Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him: and he was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his own house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">in his room over the host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06659">and Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">did the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">in the room of Abiathar</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">for Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there, and go not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0575">thence any whither</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:37
verses.text: For it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou goest out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and passest over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">thy blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">shall be upon thine own head</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08096">And Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">The saying</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0113">as my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">so will thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08096">And Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">that two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">of Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">unto Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">of Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Behold, thy servants</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01661">in Gath</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08096">And Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">his ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">to Gath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0397">to Achish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">from Gath</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">that Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">to Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was come again</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">for Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">unto him, Did I not make thee to swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and protested</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for a certain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou goest out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0575">abroad any whither</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou saidst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto me, The word</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why then hast thou not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I have charged</w> thee with?

verses.name: I Kings 2:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">moreover to Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">which thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is privy to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thy wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon thine own head</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 2:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">blessed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">and the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 2:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, that he died</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04467">And the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was established</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen332" osisID="1Kgs.2"/>

verses.name: I Kings 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">made affinity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">with Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">her into the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">until he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of building</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Only the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">because there was no house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">until those days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">only he sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in high places</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">to Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">there; for that</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">high place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">did Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon that altar</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01391">In Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">in a dream</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what I shall give</w> thee.

verses.name: I Kings 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according as he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thee in truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03483">and in uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee; and thou hast kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">for him this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on his throne</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mercy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bounty</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And now, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">thou hast made thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">instead of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>: and I <transChange type="added">am but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">child</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I know</w> not <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">or come in</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And thy servant</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that cannot be numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">therefore thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">an understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I may discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">between good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and bad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for who is able</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">this thy so great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>understanding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hearing</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">that Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Because thou hast asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast not asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for thyself long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither hast asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thyself, nor hast asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but hast asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for thyself understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>long life</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">many days</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>discern</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hear</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lo, I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">thee a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and an understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">so that there was none like thee before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thee, neither after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee shall any arise</w> like unto thee.

verses.name: I Kings 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I have also given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee that which thou hast not asked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06239">both riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">so that there shall not be any</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">among the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">like unto thee all thy days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hath not been</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if thou wilt walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then I will lengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thy days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">awoke</w>; and, behold, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02472">a dream</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to all his servants</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">there two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">harlots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">I and this woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I was delivered of a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with her in the house</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">And it came to pass the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after that I was delivered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">that this woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was delivered</w> also: and we <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>; <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">no stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with us in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02108">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">we two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And this woman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because she overlaid</w> it.

verses.name: I Kings 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H08432">at midnight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">from beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">me, while thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03463">slept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">it in her bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">her dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in my bosom</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when I rose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to give my child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">suck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, it was dead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">but when I had considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">it in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">behold, it was not my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I did bear</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0312">And the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">Nay; but the living</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the dead</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And this said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">No; but the dead</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the living</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thus they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02063">The one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saith</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the dead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02063">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Nay; but thy son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and my son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">me a sword</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">child</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in two</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to the one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to the other</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">whose the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">child</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07356">for her bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03648" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">yearned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon her son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0994">O</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">her the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and in no wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it. But the other said</w>, Let it be neither mine nor thine, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">divide</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>yearned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were hot</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">her the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and in no wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slay</w> it: she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> thereof.

verses.name: I Kings 3:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">which the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had judged</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">that the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst of him</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen333" osisID="1Kgs.3"/>

verses.name: I Kings 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:2
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">which he had; Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>priest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief officer</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0456">Elihoreph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">and Ahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07894">of Shisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0286">of Ahilud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the recorder</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scribes</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretaries</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>recorder</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">remembrancer</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">And Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">over the host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06659">and Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">of Nathan</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">over the officers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02071">and Zabud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">of Nathan</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">principal officer</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07463">friend</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0301">And Ahishar</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the household</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0141">and Adoniram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05653">of Abda</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04522">over the tribute</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tribute</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">levy</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">had twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">which provided victuals</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his household</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">each man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">his month</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in a year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8771">made provision</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:8
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01133">The son of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>The son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ben–hur</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01857 strong:H01128" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">The son of Dekar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04739">in Makaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08169">and in Shaalbim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01053">and Beth–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0358">and Elon–beth–hanan</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>The son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ben–dekar</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02618 strong:H01136" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">The son of Hesed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0700">in Aruboth</w>; to him <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07755">Sochoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02660">of Hepher</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>The son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ben–hesed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01125">The son of Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05299">in all the region</w> <w lemma="strong:H01756">of Dor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02955">which had Taphath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>The son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ben–abinadab</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01195">Baana</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0286">of Ahilud</w>; <transChange type="added">to him pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08590">Taanach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">and Megiddo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01052">and all Beth–shean</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H06891">Zartanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">beneath Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01052">from Beth–shean</w> <w lemma="strong:H065">to Abel–meholah</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> unto <transChange type="added">the place that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03361">Jokneam</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01127">The son of Geber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07433 strong:H01568">in Ramoth–gilead</w>; to him <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02333">the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02971">of Jair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w>; to him <transChange type="added">also pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02256">the region</w> <w lemma="strong:H0709">of Argob</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">with walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>The son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ben–geber</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0292">Ahinadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05714">of Iddo</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04266">Mahanaim</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Mahanaim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to Mahanaim</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0290">Ahimaaz</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05321">in Naphtali</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he also took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01315">Basmath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01195">Baanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02365">of Hushai</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0836">in Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H01175">and in Aloth</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06515">of Paruah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">in Issachar</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0414">of Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">in Benjamin</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01398">Geber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0221">of Uri</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05747">and of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>; and <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the only</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">officer</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drinking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08056">and making merry</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">over all kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and unto the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">presents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">provision</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">was thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">of meal</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>provision</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bread</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>measures</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cors</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">Ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01277">fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07471">out of the pastures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0354">beside harts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06643">and roebucks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03180">and fallowdeer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H075" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and fatted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01257">fowl</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For he had dominion</w> over all <transChange type="added">the region</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08607">from Tiphsah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">even to Azzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">over all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07965">and he had peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676 strong:H05650" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">on all sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">under his vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">and under his fig tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">from Dan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">even to Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>safely</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">confidently</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">had forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0723">stalls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04817">for his chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And those officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">provided victual</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07131">and for all that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">in his month</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05737" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they lacked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08184">Barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">also and straw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">for the horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07409">and dromedaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">they unto the place</w> where <transChange type="added">the officers</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">were, every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to his charge</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dromedaries</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mules</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">swift beasts</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 4:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and largeness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02344">even as the sand</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">on the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">shore</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">excelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">and all the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:31
