verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he was wiser</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">than all men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0387">than Ethan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0250">the Ezrahite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01968">and Heman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03633">and Chalcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01862">and Darda</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04235">of Mahol</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">was in all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">proverbs</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07892">and his songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">were a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">from the cedar tree</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0231">even unto the hyssop</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that springeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">of the wall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">also of beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05775">and of fowl</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07431">and of creeping things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01709">and of fishes</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 4:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">from all kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of his wisdom</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen334" osisID="1Kgs.4"/>

verses.name: I Kings 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02438">And Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto Solomon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in the room of his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02438">for Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">was ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a lover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hiram</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Huram</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">to Hiram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">how that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the wars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which were about him on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">until the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">them under the soles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of his feet</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath given me rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>, <transChange type="added">so that there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07854">neither adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">nor evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06294">occurrent</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And, behold, I purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon thy throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in thy room, he shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto my name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>purpose</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">say</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Now therefore command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou that they hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">me cedar trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">out of Lebanon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">and my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">shall be with thy servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and unto thee will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">according to all that thou shalt appoint</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou knowest</w> that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not among us any</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that can skill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">like unto the Sidonians</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appoint</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">say</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 5:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02438">And it came to pass, when Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">over this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02438">And Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">the things which thou sentest</w> to me for: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">all thy desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">concerning timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and concerning timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">of fir</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>considered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heard</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">My servants</w> shall bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">from Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will convey</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">them by sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01702">in floats</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">me, and will cause them to be discharged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there, and thou shalt receive</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">my desire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in giving</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for my household</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appoint</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">send</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02438">So Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">and fir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <transChange type="added">according to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">all his desire</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04361">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H03795">of pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thus gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">to Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>measures</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cors</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">him: and there was peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">between Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147" type="x-split-203">and they two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147" type="x-split-203">together</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">raised</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">a levy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of all Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04522">and the levy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">was thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>levy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tribute of men</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">them to Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">by courses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02320">a month</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">they were in Lebanon</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">at home</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0141">and Adoniram</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04522">over the levy</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">had threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05449">burdens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Beside the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">officers</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">over the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which ruled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in the work</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">costly</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01496">hewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to lay the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">builders</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">and Hiram’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">builders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06458" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did hew</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01382">and the stonesquarers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so they prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stonesquarers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Giblites</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen335" osisID="1Kgs.5"/>

verses.name: I Kings 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">And it came to pass in the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and eightieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">after the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02099">Zif</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he began to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>began…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">built</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">which king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">thereof twenty</w> <transChange type="added">cubits</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thereof thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0197">And the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">thereof, according to the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thereof before the house</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0331" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of narrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08261">lights</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">broad within, and narrow without</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">skewed and closed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07023">And against the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326 strong:H03326" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07023">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">and of the oracle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>against the wall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upon</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">joining to the wall</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>built chambers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">built floors</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made chambers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made ribs</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08481">The nethermost</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326 strong:H03326" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">chamber</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08484">and the middle</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>: for without <transChange type="added">in the wall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04052">narrowed rests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, that <transChange type="added">the beams</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">should not be fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">in the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>narrowed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">narrowings</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">rebatements</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when it was in building</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was built</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H04551">before it was brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04717">thither: so that there was neither hammer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01631">nor axe</w> <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">any tool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">while it was in building</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06607">The door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08484">for the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">chamber</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03233">in the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03883">with winding stairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08484">into the middle</w> <transChange type="added">chamber</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08484">and out of the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">into the third</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>side</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it; and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01356">with beams</w> <w lemma="strong:H07713">and boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the vaultbeams and the panellings with cedar</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:10
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326 strong:H03326" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against all the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">high</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">on the house</w> with <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">came to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 6:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which thou art in building</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou wilt walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all my commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in them; then will I perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with thee, which I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">So Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and finished</w> it.

verses.name: I Kings 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">with boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07172">both the floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07023">and the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05604">of the cieling</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he covered</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">on the inside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">with wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07172">the floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">with planks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">of fir</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>both…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from the floor of the house unto the walls</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">on the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04480">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H07172">the floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">and the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">with boards</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he even built</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for it within</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01687">for the oracle</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03942">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">it, was forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">long</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0730">And the cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">within</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04734">carved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06497">with knops</w> <w lemma="strong:H06362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">flowers</w>: all <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H068">there was no stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">seen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>knops</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gourds</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>open</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">openings of</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01687">And the oracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">within</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">there the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01687">And the oracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the forepart</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">in length</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">in breadth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">in the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thereof: and he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>; and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <transChange type="added">which was of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">So Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he made a partition</w> <w lemma="strong:H07572 strong:H07572" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">by the chains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">the oracle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">it with gold</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he had finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04196">also the whole altar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01687">by the oracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01687">And within the oracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <transChange type="added">each</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">high</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>olive</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oily</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">trees of oil</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">And five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherub</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07098">from the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of the one wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">unto the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of the other</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07095">size</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06967">The height</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, and so <transChange type="added">was it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they stretched forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">so that the wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">touched</w> the <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07023">wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and the wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">wall</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03671">and their wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the cherubims stretched forth their wings</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07049" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he carved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">all the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04524">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06603">with carved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04734">figures</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H08561">and palm trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">flowers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06441">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">and without</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>open flowers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">openings of flowers</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07172">And the floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06441">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">and without</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06607">And for the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">of the oracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">doors</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0352">the lintel</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04201">side posts</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02549">a fifth part</w> <transChange type="added">of the wall</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a fifth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fivesquare</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">The two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">doors</w> also <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07049" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he carved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04734">upon them carvings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H08561">and palm trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">flowers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and overlaid</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07286" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">upon the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08561">and upon the palm trees</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>two…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">leaves of the doors</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>open flowers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">openings of flowers</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So also made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">he for the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">posts</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">a fourth part</w> <transChange type="added">of the wall</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a fourth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">foursquare</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 6:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">doors</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01265">fir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">leaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">door</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01550">folding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07050">leaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">door</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01550">folding</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07049" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he carved</w> <transChange type="added">thereon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H08561">and palm trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">flowers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and covered</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">fitted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02707" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">upon the carved work</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">with three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">of hewed stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02905">and a row</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03773">beams</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 6:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07243">In the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8795" type="x-split-204">was the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8795" type="x-split-204">laid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03391">in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02099">Zif</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 6:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">And in the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03391">in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0945">Bul</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08066">the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">was the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">throughout all the parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thereof, and according to all the fashion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of it. So was he seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in building</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>throughout…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with all the parts thereof, and with all the ordinances thereof</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen336" osisID="1Kgs.6"/>

verses.name: I Kings 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">But Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was building</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his own house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all his house</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">also the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">thereof fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thereof thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">upon four</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">with cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03773">beams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">upon the pillars</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:3
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05603" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">with cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">upon the beams</w>, that <transChange type="added">lay</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">on forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240">fifteen</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02905">a row</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>beams</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ribs</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08261">windows</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04237">and light</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04237">against light</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">ranks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>light was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sight against sight</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06607">And all the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">and posts</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">square</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08260">with the windows</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04237">and light</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04136">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04237">light</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">ranks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>doors…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spaces and pillars were square in prospect</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">a porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of pillars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thereof thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0197">and the porch</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them: and the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05646">and the thick beam</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> before them.<note type="study"><catchWord>before them</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">according to them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">a porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">for the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where he might judge</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0197">the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>: and <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05603" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">with cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07172">from one side of the floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07172">to the other</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from floor to floor</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01004">And his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where he dwelt</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">the porch</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">was of the like work</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">also an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">for Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he had taken</w> <transChange type="added">to wife</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0197">like unto this porch</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:9
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">costly</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">according to the measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">of hewed stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01641" morph="strongMorph:TH8775">sawed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04050">with saws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">and without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04527">even from the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02947">unto the coping</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">on the outside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">toward the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">And the foundation</w> <transChange type="added">was of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">costly</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">even great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">and stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">of eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04605">And above</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">costly</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">after the measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">of hewed stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and cedars</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">And the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">with three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">of hewed stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02905">and a row</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03773">beams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06442">both for the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0197">and for the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">out of Tyre</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hiram</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Huram</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:14
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0490 strong:H0802">a widow’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06876">of Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a worker</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">in brass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">with wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08394">and understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all works</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">in brass</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all his work</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a widow’s…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the son of a widow woman</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">of eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259 strong:H05982">apiece</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02339">and a line</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">of twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-205">did compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">either</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-205">of them about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fashioned</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiters</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 7:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07638">nets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">of checker</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01434">and wreaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08333">of chain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03805">for the chapiters</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">for the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiter</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">network</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">the chapiters</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07416">with pomegranates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">he for the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiter</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03805">And the chapiters</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07799">of lily</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">in the porch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03805">And the chapiters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <transChange type="added">had pomegranates</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">also above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05980">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">the belly</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">the network</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07416">and the pomegranates</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">in rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">upon the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">chapiter</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">in the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03199">thereof Jachin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08042">the left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">thereof Boaz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jachin</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">He shall establish</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Boaz</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">In it is strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">And upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07799">lily</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04399">so was the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">finished</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">a molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">from the one brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">to the other</w>: <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05696">round</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">all about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06967">and his height</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06961 strong:H06957" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and a line</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">it round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from his brim to his brim</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">And under the brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">of it round about</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06497">knops</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">compassing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">it, ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">in a cubit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">compassing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06497">the knops</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03333">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">when it was cast</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">It stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">upon twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">toward the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">toward the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the east</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03220">and the sea</w> <transChange type="added">was set</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">upon them, and all their hinder parts</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">inward</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:26
verses.text: And it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02947">an hand breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05672">thick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and the brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thereof was wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">like the brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">of a cup</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">with flowers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">of lilies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it contained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">baths</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">bases</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">base</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thereof, and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> of it.

verses.name: I Kings 7:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">And the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">of the bases</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> on this <transChange type="added">manner</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04526">they had borders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04526">and the borders</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07948">between the ledges</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 7:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04526">And on the borders</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07948">between the ledges</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03742">and cherubims</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07948">and upon the ledges</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03653">a base</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0738">and beneath the lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03914">certain additions</w> <w lemma="strong:H04174">made of thin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And every</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">base</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">had four</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05633">and plates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0702">and the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">thereof had undersetters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03595">under the laver</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">undersetters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">molten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05676">at the side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every</w> <w lemma="strong:H03914">addition</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">And the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of it within</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">the chapiter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and above</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">but the mouth</w> thereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05696">round</w> <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03653">of the base</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and an half</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">and also upon the mouth</w> of it <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04734">gravings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">with their borders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07251" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">foursquare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05696">not round</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08478">And under</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">the borders</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and the axletrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of the wheels</w> <transChange type="added">were joined</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04350">to the base</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">a cubit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>joined…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the base</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">And the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">of the wheels</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">like the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">of a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">wheel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">their axletrees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01354">and their naves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02839">and their felloes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02840">and their spokes</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">all molten</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 7:34

verses.name: I Kings 7:36

verses.name: I Kings 7:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">bases</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">on the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>side</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:40

verses.name: I Kings 7:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">The two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>, and the <transChange type="added">two</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01543">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">of the chapiters</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">networks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">of the chapiters</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 7:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">And four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">networks</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">of pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">network</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">of the chapiters</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon the face of the pillars</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:43

verses.name: I Kings 7:44

verses.name: I Kings 7:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05518">And the pots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03257">and the shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the basons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all these vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02438">which Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04178" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bright</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made bright</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">scoured</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03603">In the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">did the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04568">them, in the clay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">between Succoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06891">and Zarthan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the thickness of the ground</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <transChange type="added">unweighed</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">because they were exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04948">neither was the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of the brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">found out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the exceeding multitude</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>found</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">searched</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04501">And the candlesticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right</w> <transChange type="added">side</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">the oracle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">with the flowers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">and the lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04457">and the tongs</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 7:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05592">And the bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04212">and the snuffers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04289">and the censers</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06596">and the hinges</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01817">for the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01817">for the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>censers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ash pans</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 7:51

verses.name: I Kings 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and all the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they might bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">princes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">themselves unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">at the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0388">Ethanim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:3

verses.name: I Kings 8:4

verses.name: I Kings 8:5

verses.name: I Kings 8:6

verses.name: I Kings 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">For the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">spread forth</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">two wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">over the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03742">and the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">and the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">thereof above</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they drew out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">that the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">of the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were seen out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">the oracle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they were not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and there they are unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ends</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heads</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>holy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ark</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">nothing in the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H07535">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">there at Horeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <transChange type="added">a covenant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when the</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">where the</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:10

verses.name: I Kings 8:11

verses.name: I Kings 8:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he would dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">in the thick darkness</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I have surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02073">to dwell in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04349">a settled place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thee to abide in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-206">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-206">about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w>;)

verses.name: I Kings 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and hath with his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">fulfilled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">no city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might be therein; but I chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to be over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:17
