verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">And it was in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834 strong:H03282">Whereas</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">it was in thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou didst well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">that it was in thine heart</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07535">Nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">but thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shall come forth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02504">of thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto my name</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I am risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">in the room of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">promised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">there a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w>, wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when he brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">in the presence of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">like thee, in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">or on earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">beneath, who keepest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thee with all their heart</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 8:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hast kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou promisedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him: thou spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">also with thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and hast fulfilled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thine hand</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore now, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou promisedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">There shall not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in my sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07535">so</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to their way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me as thou hast walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>fail…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be cut off unto thee a man from my sight</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>so that</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">only if</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And now, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">let thy word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I pray thee, be verified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But will God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0552">indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08064">behold, the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">cannot contain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0637">thee; how much less</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have builded</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 8:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet have thou respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08467">and to his supplication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">unto the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">and to the prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">which thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">prayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee to day</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">That thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">may be open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">toward this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">and day</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">toward the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of which thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">My name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall be there: that thou mayest hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">which thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">toward this place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>toward this place</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">thou to the supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">when they shall pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">toward this place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when thou hearest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forgive</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>toward this place</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">and an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0422" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">upon him to cause him to swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">and the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thine altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in this house</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>and an oath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and he require an oath of him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">condemning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and justifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">him according to his righteousness</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">When thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">be smitten down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because they have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and shall turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to thee, and confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and make supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto thee in this house</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08064">When heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">is shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04306">and there is no rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because they have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">against thee; if they pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">toward this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from their sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when thou afflictest</w> them:

verses.name: I Kings 8:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that thou teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">them the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein they should walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0776">If there be in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">if there be pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07711">blasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03420">mildew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0697">locust</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02625">if there be caterpiller</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">if their enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of their cities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05061">whatsoever plague</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04245">whatsoever sickness</w> <transChange type="added">there be</transChange>;<note type="study"><catchWord>cities</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">jurisdiction</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08605">What prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">and supplication</w> soever be <transChange type="added">made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">by any man</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">by all thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of his own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">toward this house</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 8:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">according to his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou knowest</w>; (for thou, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou only, knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>;)

verses.name: I Kings 8:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that they live</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto our fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05237">Moreover concerning a stranger</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but cometh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">of a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04616">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name’s</w> sake;

verses.name: I Kings 8:42
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and of thy strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and of thy stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when he shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">toward this house</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 8:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">according to all that the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to thee for: that all people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> thee, as <transChange type="added">do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and that they may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">that this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have builded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>this…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy name is called upon this house</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">If thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against their enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">whithersoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">them, and shall pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast chosen</w>, and <transChange type="added">toward</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>toward the city</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the way of the city</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">their prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">and their supplication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">their cause</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cause</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">right</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If they sin</w> against thee, (for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that sinneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not,) and thou be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with them, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them to the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that they carry them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">or near</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 8:47
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">if they shall bethink</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">themselves in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">whither they were carried captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and repent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and make supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thee in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that carried them captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have done perversely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have committed wickedness</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>bethink…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bring back to their heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:48
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">unto thee with all their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all their soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which led them away captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto thee toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 8:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">thou their prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">and their supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">their cause</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>cause</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">right</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">against thee, and all their transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein they have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">them compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them who carried them captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that they may have compassion</w> on them:

verses.name: I Kings 8:51
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">and thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou broughtest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">from the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03564">of the furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 8:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">That thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">may be open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">unto the supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08467">and unto the supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them in all that they call</w> for unto thee.

verses.name: I Kings 8:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For thou didst separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them from among all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when thou broughtest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:54
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">that when Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">of praying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">all this prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">and supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from kneeling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">on his knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">with his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spread up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 8:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according to all that he promised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there hath not failed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of all his good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">promise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>failed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fallen</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">be with us, as he was with our fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, nor forsake</w> us:

verses.name: I Kings 8:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That he may incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">our hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And let these my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">wherewith I have made supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07138">be nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">at all times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">as the matter</w> shall require:<note type="study"><catchWord>at all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the thing of a day in his day</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 8:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">That all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <transChange type="added">and that there is</transChange> none else.

verses.name: I Kings 8:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">Let your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">therefore be perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:62
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him, offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02596" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dedicated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">The same day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">did the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for there he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05178">because the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">too little</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">held</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with him, a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">in of Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 8:66
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">On the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-207">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-207">away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto their tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for all the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and for Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blessed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thanked</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen338" osisID="1Kgs.8"/>

verses.name: I Kings 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And it came to pass, when Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">the building</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and all Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02837">desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he was pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">That the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">as he had appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">unto him at Gibeon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">thy prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">and thy supplication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">that thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me: I have hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast built</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">there for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">and mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shall be there perpetually</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And if thou wilt walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">me, as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08537">in integrity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03476">and in uprightness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according to all that I have commanded</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and my judgments</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of thy kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as I promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">There shall not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">if ye shall at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me, ye or your children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, but go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and worship</w> them:

verses.name: I Kings 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then will I cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them; and this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I have hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my sight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">shall be a proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H08148">and a byword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all people</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And at this house</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05945">is high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that passeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by it shall be astonished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall hiss</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Why hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thus unto this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and to this house</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they shall answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have taken hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">upon other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and have worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them: therefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">upon them all this evil</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07097">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">when Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 9:11
verses.text: (<transChange type="added">Now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02438">Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had furnished</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">with cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">and fir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02656">according to all his desire</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H0227">that then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01551">of Galilee</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02438">And Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">from Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him; and they pleased</w> him not.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were not right in his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">What cities</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">these which thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">me, my brother</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03521">of Cabul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Cabul</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">displeasing</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">dirty</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02438">And Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242 strong:H03967">sixscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">of the levy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">which king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">raised</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04407">and Millo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02674">and Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04023">and Megiddo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01507">and Gezer</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gone up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">Gezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">it with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and given</w> it <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07964">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">Gezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01032">and Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">the nether</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01191">And Baalath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08412">and Tadmor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04543">of store</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">that Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">had, and cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">for his chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">for his horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02837">and that</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">and in Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">of his dominion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the desire of Solomon which he desired</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 9:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and Jebusites</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that were left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">whom the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also were not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">utterly to destroy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">upon those did Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">levy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">a tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of bondservice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">did Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">no bondmen</w>: but they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07991">and his captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of his chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and his horsemen</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:23
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the officers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08010">over Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which bare rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in the work</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06547">But Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto her house</w> which <transChange type="added">Solomon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for her: then did he build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04407">Millo</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969">And three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in a year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">did Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and he burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">So he finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon the altar that</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon it</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Kings 9:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0590">a navy of ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H06100">in Ezion–geber</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0359">beside Eloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">on the shore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">of the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02438">And Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0590">in the navy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0591 strong:H0582">shipmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that had knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">with the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">to Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">from thence gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen339" osisID="1Kgs.9"/>

verses.name: I Kings 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04436">And when the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">of the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">concerning the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">him with hard questions</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">train</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">with camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">she communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with him of all that was in her heart</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">her all her questions</w>: there was not <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">from the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he told</w> her not.<note type="study"><catchWord>questions</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04436">And when the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">all Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had built</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03978">And the meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">of his table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">and the sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04612">and the attendance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of his ministers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04403">and their apparel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and his cupbearers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and his ascent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by which he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">there was no more spirit</w> in her.<note type="study"><catchWord>attendance</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">standing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cupbearers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">butlers</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">It was a true</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">report</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in mine own land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of thy acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">and of thy wisdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>report</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>acts</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sayings</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Howbeit I believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not the words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">until I came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02677">and, behold, the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was not told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">me: thy wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">exceedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I heard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thou hast added wisdom and goodness to</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">thy men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0835">happy</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">these thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">thy wisdom</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">be the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which delighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in thee, to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">thee on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">he thee king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and of spices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">great store</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">no more such</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">of spices</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">as these which the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0590">And the navy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">also of Hiram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">from Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">from Ophir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0484">of almug</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>almug…</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">algum trees</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0484">of the almug</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H04552">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">harps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">also and psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for singers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0484">no such almug</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">nor were seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pillars</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rails</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a prop</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">unto the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">all her desire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whatsoever she asked</w>, beside <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">her of his royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">bounty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So she turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to her own country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">she and her servants</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the hand of king Solomon</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04948">Now the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">was six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 10:15
verses.text: Beside <transChange type="added">that he had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08446 strong:H0582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the merchantmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04536">and of the traffick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the spice merchants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and of all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">of Arabia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">and of the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>governors</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">captains</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">targets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07820" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">target</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shields</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07820" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H04488">pound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shield</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Moreover the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of ivory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06338" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">it with the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03678">The throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">had six</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of the throne</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05696">round</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w>: and <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">stays</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">on either side on the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07675" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of the seat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the stays</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>behind</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">on the hinder part thereof</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>stays</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">And twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">there on the one side and on the other upon the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651">there was not the like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">in any kingdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the like</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">so</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And all king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04945">drinking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>; none <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03972">it was nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">accounted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">there was no silver in them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">had at sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0590">a navy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tharshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0590">with the navy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02438">of Hiram</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">once</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">in three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0590">the navy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tharshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08143">ivory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06971">and apes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08500">and peacocks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ivory</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">elephants’ teeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">exceeded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">for riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">and for wisdom</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0776">And all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">his wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sought to</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sought the face of</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">his present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08008">and garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05402">and armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06505">and mules</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">a rate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0505">and he had a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whom he bestowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">for chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">as stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> he <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08256">as the sycomore trees</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08219">in the vale</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">for abundance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">had horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04723">and linen yarn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H04723">the linen yarn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242">at a price</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And Solomon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And the going forth of the horses which was Solomon’s</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04818">And a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">for six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and an horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">for an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and so for all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">of the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and for the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, did they bring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by their means</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by their hand</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen340" osisID="1Kgs.10"/>

verses.name: I Kings 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">together with the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04125">women of the Moabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05984">Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0130">Edomites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06722">Zidonians</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02850">Hittites</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>together…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">beside</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:2
