verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Of the nations</w> <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to them, neither shall they come in</w> unto you: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0403">surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they will turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto these in love</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And he had seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08282">princesses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">For it came to pass, when</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02209">was old</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03824">and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">was not perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, as <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">For Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06253">Ashtoreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the goddess</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">of the Zidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04445">Milcom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H05984">of the Ammonites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Milcom</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Molech</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and went not fully</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, as <transChange type="added">did</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fulfilled not after</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Then did Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">an high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03645">for Chemosh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the hill</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04432">and for Molech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And likewise did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">he for all his strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto their gods</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">was angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">with Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">because his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which had appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">unto him twice</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him concerning this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he should not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not that which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Wherefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, I will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from thee, and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">it to thy servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is done…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is with thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Notwithstanding in thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">it for David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> sake: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy son</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07535">Howbeit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not rend away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">all the kingdom</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">sake, and for Jerusalem’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sake which I have chosen</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stirred up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">an adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01908">Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">the Edomite</w>: he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">For it came to pass, when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">was in Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">and Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">the slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">after he had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 11:16
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H08337">For six</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">did Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">there with all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until he had cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">every male</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w>:)

verses.name: I Kings 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0111">That Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">he and certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him, to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01908">Hadad</w> <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06996">yet a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">child</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">out of Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">to Paran</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06290">with them out of Paran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">unto Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">him victuals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him land</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01908">And Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">him to wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of his own wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08472">of Tahpenes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01377">the queen</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">And the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H08472">of Tahpenes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01592">him Genubath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08472">whom Tahpenes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">weaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01592">and Genubath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">was in Pharaoh’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01908">And when Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">and that Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01908">Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Let me depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to mine own country</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Send me away</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06547">Then Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">unto him, But what hast thou lacked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">with me, that, behold, thou seekest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to thine own country</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Nothing: howbeit let me go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in any wise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Nothing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Not</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stirred him up</w> <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07854">adversary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07331">Rezon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0450">of Eliadah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">from his lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01909">Hadadezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto him, and became captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">over a band</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">slew</w> them <transChange type="added">of Zobah</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">to Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">in Damascus</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07854">And he was an adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">beside the mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01908">that Hadad</w> <transChange type="added">did</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">over Syria</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0673">an Ephrathite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06868">of Zereda</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">whose mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06871">Zeruah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">even he lifted up</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:27
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he lifted up</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04407">Millo</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>repaired</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">closed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that he was industrious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he made him ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05447">over all the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was industrious</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">did work</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>charge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">burden</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And it came to pass at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">when Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">that the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07888">the Shilonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">him in the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and he had clad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">himself with a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">garment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and they two</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">alone in the field</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 11:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0281">And Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">the new</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">garment</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on him, and rent</w> it <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07168">pieces</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 11:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">to Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">thee ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07168">pieces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w> to thee:

verses.name: I Kings 11:32
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H0259">But he shall have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">sake, and for Jerusalem’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">sake, the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:)

verses.name: I Kings 11:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because that they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">me, and have worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06253">Ashtoreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the goddess</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">of the Zidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03645">Chemosh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the god</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of the Moabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04445">and Milcom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the god</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in mine eyes</w>, and <transChange type="added">to keep</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and my judgments</w>, as <transChange type="added">did</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Howbeit I will not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the whole kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">him prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sake, whom I chose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and my statutes</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 11:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">out of his son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> it unto thee, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribes</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And unto his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">may have a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">alway</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">me in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> there.<note type="study"><catchWord>light</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lamp</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and thou shalt reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">according to all that thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">desireth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and shalt be king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto all that I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and wilt walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I will be with thee, and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thee a sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as I built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> unto thee.

verses.name: I Kings 11:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I will for this afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">but not for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">therefore to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07895">unto Shishak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and was in Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">until the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 11:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">and his wisdom</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>acts</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">words</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">things</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">that Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>time</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">days</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 11:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07346">and Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Rehoboam</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Roboam</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen341" osisID="1Kgs.11"/>

verses.name: I Kings 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make him king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">And it came to pass, when Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">who was yet in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, (<w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he was fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>;)

verses.name: I Kings 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">him. And Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">unto Rehoboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-208">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">our yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-208">grievous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07186">now therefore make thou the grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03515">and his heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">upon us, lighter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will serve</w> thee.

verses.name: I Kings 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Depart</w> yet <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">then come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to me. And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">with the old men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">while he yet lived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">How do ye advise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I may</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">If thou wilt be a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wilt serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to them, then they will be thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the old men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, and consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">with the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that were grown up</w> with him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him:

verses.name: I Kings 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto them, What counsel give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye that we may</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">who have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-209">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-209">upon us lighter</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03206">And the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that were grown up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-210">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">our yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-210">heavy</w>, but make thou <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">lighter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto us; thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06995">unto them, My little</w> <transChange type="added">finger</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05666" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be thicker</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">than my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">loins</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And now whereas my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did lade</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">you with a heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">yoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will add</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">to your yoke</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath chastised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">you with whips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but I will chastise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06137">you with scorpions</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03379">So Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">to Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">as the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had appointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come to me again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">roughly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the old men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they gave</w> him;<note type="study"><catchWord>roughly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hardly</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">to them after the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">of the young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-211">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">your yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-211">heavy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will add</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">to your yoke</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">chastised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">you with whips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but I will chastise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06137">you with scorpions</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Wherefore the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not unto the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05438">for the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">was from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he might perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07888">the Shilonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">unto Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">when all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not unto them, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">What portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">have we in David</w>? neither <transChange type="added">have we</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">in the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0168">to your tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thine own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03478">So Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">unto their tents</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:17
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> over them.

verses.name: I Kings 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0151">Adoram</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04522">over the tribute</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he died</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">Therefore king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">made speed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to get him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">to his chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengthened himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">So Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rebelled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fell away</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And it came to pass, when all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">that Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">him unto the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">there was none that followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02108">but</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> only.

verses.name: I Kings 12:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07346">And when Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">with the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which were warriors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-212">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-212">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">to Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">came unto Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">unto Rehoboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and unto all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and to the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">for this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me. They hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">therefore to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03379">Then Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein; and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thence, and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H06439">Penuel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">Now shall the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 12:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">If this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">then shall the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto their lord</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07346">unto Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">to Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Whereupon the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">took counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calves</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">unto them, It is too much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for you to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">behold thy gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">he in Dan</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">became a sin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <transChange type="added">to worship</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the one</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01835">unto Dan</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">of the lowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">which were not of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 12:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08066">in the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">on the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">like unto the feast</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">he in Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">sacrificing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">unto the calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had made</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">went up to the altar</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>sacrificing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to sacrifice</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 12:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08066">of the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0908" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his own heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and burnt incense</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offered…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">went up to the altar</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>and burnt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to burn incense</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen342" osisID="1Kgs.12"/>

verses.name: I Kings 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">out of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">unto Beth–el</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">by the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn incense</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>burn</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">offer</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">against the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">O altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">Behold, a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and upon thee shall he offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon thee, and men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be burnt</w> upon thee.

verses.name: I Kings 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04159">the sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04196">Behold, the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01880">and the ashes</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">upon it shall be poured out</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which had cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">against the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">from the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">on him. And his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that he could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not pull it in again</w> to him.

verses.name: I Kings 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04196">The altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">also was rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01880">and the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">from the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04159">according to the sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">which the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">now the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for me, that my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be restored me again</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was restored him again</w>, and became as <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">before</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Kings 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with me, and refresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thyself, and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04991">thee a reward</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou wilt give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">me half</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, neither will I eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For so was it charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">me by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the same way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou camest</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">to Beth–el</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Now there dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">an</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">him all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">that the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">also to their father</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto them, What way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">he? For his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0335">what</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">from Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Saddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">me the ass</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they saddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">him the ass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he rode</w> thereon,

verses.name: I Kings 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">under an oak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thou the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that camest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">from Judah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with me, and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with thee, nor go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee: neither will I eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">with thee in this place</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">For it was said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to me by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there, nor turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou camest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a word was</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said</w> unto him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">a prophet</w> also as thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04397">and an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto me by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring him back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with thee into thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>. <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he lied</w> unto him.

verses.name: I Kings 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he went back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drank</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And it came to pass, as they sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at the table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">came unto the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought him back</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">from Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03282">Forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast disobeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> thee,

verses.name: I Kings 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But camest back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w>, of the which <transChange type="added">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">did say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee, Eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">no water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05038">thy carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">unto the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he had drunk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he saddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">for him the ass</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">for the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had brought back</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was gone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">him by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">him: and his carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">was cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">it, the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">by the carcase</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And, behold, men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">and the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">where the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelt</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And when the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought him back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who was disobedient</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">unto the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">him unto the lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which hath torn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him, according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>torn</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Saddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">me the ass</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they saddled</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 13:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">his carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">and the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0738">the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor torn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">the ass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>torn</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 13:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">it upon the ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought it back</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to bury</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 13:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05038">his carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">in his own grave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they mourned</w> over him, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01945">Alas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>!

verses.name: I Kings 13:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he had buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, that he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I am dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">me in the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">wherein the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">buried</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">his bones</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 13:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">For the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">against the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and against all the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, shall surely come to pass.

verses.name: I Kings 13:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not from his evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">of the lowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02655">whosoever would</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he consecrated</w> him, and he became <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">returned and made</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>consecrated…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 13:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">became sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, even to cut <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from off the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen343" osisID="1Kgs.13"/>

verses.name: I Kings 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell sick</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:2
