verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">I pray thee, and disguise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thyself, that thou be not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to be the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">thee to Shiloh</w>: behold, there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0281">Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which told</w> me that <transChange type="added">I should be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over this people</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">loaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05350">and cracknels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01228">and a cruse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">of honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to him: he shall tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">thee what shall become of the child</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in thine hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cracknels</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cakes</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cruse</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bottle</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">to Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">of Ahijah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0281">But Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not see</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">for his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07869">by reason of his age</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood for his hoariness</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 14:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">unto Ahijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">Behold, the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thee for her son</w>; for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02090">thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in</w>, that she shall feign herself <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">another</w> <transChange type="added">woman</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:6
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0281">when Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of her feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as she came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">thou wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>; why feignest thou thyself <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">another</w>? for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sent</w> to thee <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07186">heavy</w> <transChange type="added">tidings</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heavy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03282">Forasmuch as</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">thee from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">thee prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-213">And rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-213">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> it thee: and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thou hast not been as my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and who followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">me with all his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> only <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in mine eyes</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">above all that were before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: for thou hast gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">thee other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04541">and molten images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke me to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hast cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">me behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01458">thy back</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Therefore, behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">from Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H08366" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him that pisseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">against the wall</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">him that is shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">as a man taketh away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01557">dung</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till it be all gone</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Him that dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">shall the dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and him that dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">shall the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou therefore, get</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee to thine own house</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">when thy feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall die</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for him, and bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">him: for he only of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">to the grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">because in him there is found</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">toward the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall raise him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who shall cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: but what? even now.

verses.name: I Kings 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07070">as a reed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is shaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall root up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">out of this good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and shall scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">them beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">their groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">provoking the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to anger</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-214">And he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-214">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01558">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who did sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">to Tirzah</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">to the threshold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">him; and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05594" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for him, according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how he warred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and how he reigned</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">which Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05070">and Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>slept</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lay down</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 14:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07651">seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">there. And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05279">Naamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05985">an Ammonitess</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they provoked him to jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">with their sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had committed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">above all that their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they also built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">them high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04676">and images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0842">and groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01364">on every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07488">and under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">standing images</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">statues</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06945">And there were also sodomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">according to all the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02549">And it came to pass in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07895">Shishak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 14:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he even took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all: and he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">all the shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">in their stead brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and committed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>guard</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">runners</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 14:28
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01767">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and brought them back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">into the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08372">chamber</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">of Rehoboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">between Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 14:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05279">Naamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05985">an Ammonitess</w>. <w lemma="strong:H038">And Abijam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abijam</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Abijah</rdg>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Abia</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen344" osisID="1Kgs.14"/>

verses.name: I Kings 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">Now in the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H038">Abijam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">he in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Abishalom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maachah…</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Michaiah the daughter of Uriel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Abishalom</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Absalom</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">in all the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">him: and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">was not perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">as the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Nevertheless for David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">sake did the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">him a lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him, and to establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>lamp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Because David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turned not aside</w> from any <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">save only in the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittite</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">between Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H038">of Abijam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H038">between Abijam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H038">And Abijam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0609">and Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Kings 15:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06242">And in the twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">And forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">he in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Abishalom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mother’s</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">grandmother’s</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, as <transChange type="added">did</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06945">the sodomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">all the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04601">And also Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">even her he removed</w> from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01377">queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because she had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04656">an idol</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">in a grove</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0609">and Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04656">her idol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">by the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">But the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not removed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0609">nevertheless Asa’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">was perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all his days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944" type="x-split-215">in the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">which his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944" type="x-split-215">had dedicated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the things which himself had dedicated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>things</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holy</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">between Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">and Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all their days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01201">And Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he might not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">any to go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">to Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">Then Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">all the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">them to Ben–hadad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02886">of Tabrimon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02383">of Hezion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">at Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 15:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> between me and thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">between my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">and thy father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">unto thee a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thy league</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">with Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may depart</w> from me.<note type="study"><catchWord>depart</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01130">So Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">which he had against the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05859">Ijon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">and Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H062">and Abel–beth–maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03672">and all Cinneroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">with all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01201">And it came to pass, when Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">building</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">of Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">in Tirzah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">made a proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">throughout all Judah</w>; none <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05355">exempted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">away the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">of Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">thereof, wherewith Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had builded</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">with them Geba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04709">and Mizpah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>exempted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">free</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">The rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of all the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and all his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he built</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06256">Nevertheless in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02209">of his old age</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he was diseased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">in his feet</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoshaphat</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Josaphat</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05070">And Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>began…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">reigned</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and in his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">wherewith he made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01201">And Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">of Ahijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">against him; and Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01405">him at Gibbethon</w>, which <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06430">to the Philistines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05070">for Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">laid siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H01405">to Gibbethon</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Even in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">did Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Kings 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when he reigned</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">not to Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">any that breathed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until he had destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him, according unto the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07888">the Shilonite</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 15:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">Because of the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and which he made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03708">by his provocation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherewith he provoked the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to anger</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05070">of Nadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 15:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">between Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">and Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all their days</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">In the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">began Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">of Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">in Tirzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 15:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and in his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">wherewith he made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen345" osisID="1Kgs.15"/>

verses.name: I Kings 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Then the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">came to Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02607">of Hanani</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">against Baasha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Forasmuch as I exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">thee out of the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">thee prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and hast made my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">with their sins</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Behold, I will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">the posterity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and the posterity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Him that dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">shall the dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and him that dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of his in the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">shall the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and what he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01201">So Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">in Tirzah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0425">and Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Kings 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And also by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02607">of Hanani</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">came the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">against Baasha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and against his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">even for all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in provoking him to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">in being like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and because he killed</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06242">In the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">began Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">in Tirzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">two years</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02174">Zimri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04276">of half</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">against him, as he was in Tirzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">drinking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">himself drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0777">of Arza</w> steward of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">in Tirzah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>steward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which was over</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02174">And Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">him, in the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Kings 16:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as soon as he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on his throne</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08366" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him not one that pisseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">against a wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">neither of his kinsfolks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07453">nor of his friends</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>neither…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">both his kinsmen and his friends</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02174">Thus did Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">against Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">For all the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by which they sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and by which they made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">in provoking the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">with their vanities</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 16:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06242">In the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02174">did Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">in Tirzah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01405">against Gibbethon</w>, which <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06430">to the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02174">Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath conspired</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hath also slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03478">wherefore all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">made Omri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06018">And Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01405">from Gibbethon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and they besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">Tirzah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02174">And it came to pass, when Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">that the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">into the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">over him with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02403">For his sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in walking</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and in his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">to make Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to sin</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02174">of Zimri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07195">and his treason</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he wrought</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 16:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">Then were the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">into two parts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08402">Tibni</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01527">of Ginath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make him king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">Omri</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">But the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">that followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">that followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08402">Tibni</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01527">of Ginath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08402">so Tibni</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06018">and Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07970">In the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">began Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">he in Tirzah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H08106">of Shemer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">for two talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">on the hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he built</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">after the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08106">of Shemer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">owner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Samaria</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Shomeron</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 16:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06018">But Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and did worse</w> than all that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and in his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">wherewith he made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">to provoke the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">with their vanities</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he shewed</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06018">So Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0256">and Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Kings 16:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07970">And in the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">began Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0256">and Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> above all that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for him to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">in the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0856">of Ethbaal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">of the Zidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>as if…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was it a light thing</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Kings 16:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 16:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">a grove</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0256">and Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to provoke the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">than all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that were before</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 16:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02419">did Hiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01017">the Beth–elite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">Jericho</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he laid the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">thereof in Abiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06810">thereof in his youngest</w> <transChange type="added">son</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07687">Segub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen346" osisID="1Kgs.16"/>

verses.name: I Kings 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08664">the Tishbite</w>, <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08453">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">unto Ahab</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02919">there shall not be dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">nor rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">these years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">but according</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to my word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Elijah</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Elijahu</rdg>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Elias</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto him, saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee hence, and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">thee eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">thyself by the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03747">Cherith</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:4
verses.text: And it shall be, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brook</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06158">the ravens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8771">to feed</w> thee there.

verses.name: I Kings 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according unto the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">by the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03747">Cherith</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06158">And the ravens</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">him bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">and bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">in the evening</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he drank</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brook</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">that the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">because there had been no rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the end of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 17:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came unto him, saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H06886">thee to Zarephath</w>, which <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06721">to Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">there: behold, I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8771">there to sustain</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zarephath</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Sarepta</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06886">to Zarephath</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">to the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0490">behold, the widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">there gathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of sticks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to her, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">me, I pray thee, a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in a vessel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may drink</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And as she was going</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fetch</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to her, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">me, I pray thee, a morsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">I have</w> <w lemma="strong:H04580">not a cake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709 strong:H04393">but an handful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">of meal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">in a barrel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">and a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06835">in a cruse</w>: and, behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07197" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">gathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">sticks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I may go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it for me and my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that we may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and die</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not; go</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">as thou hast said</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08033">me thereof</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05692">cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0314">unto me, and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for thee and for thy son</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03537">The barrel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">of meal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06835">neither shall the cruse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">until the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sendeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">giveth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">of Elijah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and she, and he, and her house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did eat</w> <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a full year</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 17:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03537">the barrel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">of meal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06835">not, neither did the cruse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">fail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 17:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01172">the mistress</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell sick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02483">and his sickness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was so</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05397">that there was no breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w> in him.

verses.name: I Kings 17:18
