verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">unto Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">What have I to do with thee, O thou man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">art thou come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-216">unto me to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">my sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-216">to remembrance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto her, Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me thy son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">him out of her bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">into a loft</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">where he abode</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">him upon his own bed</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hast thou also brought evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">upon the widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">with whom I sojourn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by slaying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her son</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">And he stretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">himself upon the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03206">I pray thee, let this child’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-217">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">into him</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-217">again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stretched</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">measured</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">into his inward parts</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">of Elijah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">of the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-218">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">into him</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-218">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he revived</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">the child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">out of the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">him unto his mother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0452">and Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">See</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 17:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">to Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02088">Now by this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in thy mouth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen347" osisID="1Kgs.17"/>

verses.name: I Kings 18:1
verses.text: And it came to pass <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">came to Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">thyself unto Ahab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">himself unto Ahab</w>. And <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">a sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05662">Obadiah</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> the governor of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>. (<w lemma="strong:H05662">Now Obadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Obadiah</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Obadiahu</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the governor…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">over his house</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:4
verses.text: For it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0348">when Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05662">that Obadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572 strong:H0376">them by fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in a cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">and fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them with bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and water</w>.)<note type="study"><catchWord>Jezebel</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Izebel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05662">unto Obadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04599">unto all fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">and unto all brooks</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0194">peradventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we may find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02682">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06505">and mules</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that we lose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">not all the beasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that we cut not off ourselves from the beasts</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So they divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">between them to pass throughout</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">it: Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05662">by himself, and Obadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> by himself.

verses.name: I Kings 18:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05662">And as Obadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">was in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">behold, Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: and he knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thou that my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w> him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">Behold, Elijah</w> <transChange type="added">is here</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What have I sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou wouldest deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> me?

verses.name: I Kings 18:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">there is no</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">or kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">whither</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee: and when they said</w>, <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">there</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he took an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">and nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they found</w> thee not.

verses.name: I Kings 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And now thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">Behold, Elijah</w> <transChange type="added">is here</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:12
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">as soon as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I am gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">from thee, that the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee whither I know</w> not; and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he cannot find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, he shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">me: but I thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from my youth</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">Was it not told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what I did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">when Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">how I hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">by fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in a cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">and fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them with bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and water</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And now thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">Behold, Elijah</w> <transChange type="added">is here</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he shall slay</w> me.

verses.name: I Kings 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I will surely shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">myself unto him to day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05662">So Obadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">him: and Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0256">And it came to pass, when Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0256">that Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou he that troubleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">but thou, and thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in that ye have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baalim</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore send</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to me all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">of the groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">at Jezebel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">So Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-219">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-219">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">Carmel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05921">How long</w> <w lemma="strong:H06452" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">halt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">ye between two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05587">opinions</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">if the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01168">follow him: but if Baal</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him. And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him not a word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>opinions</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thoughts</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I only, remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01168">but Baal’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them therefore give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">us two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for themselves, and cut it in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">no fire</w> <transChange type="added">under</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will dress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">no fire</w> <transChange type="added">under</transChange>:

verses.name: I Kings 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">ye on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of your gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that answereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">by fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">let him be God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">It is well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">spoken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>It is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The word is good</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">unto the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">you one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">for yourselves, and dress</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w>; for ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of your gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">no fire</w> <transChange type="added">under</transChange>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they dressed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">from morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">even until noon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01168">O Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> us. But <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0369">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor any that answered</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06452" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they leaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which was made</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hear</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">answer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>answered</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heard</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>leaped…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">leaped up and down at the altar</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06672">And it came to pass at noon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">that Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H01419">aloud</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a god</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07879">either he is talking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07873">or he is pursuing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">or he is in a journey</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0194">peradventure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03463">he sleepeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and must be awaked</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>aloud</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with a great voice</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he is talking</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he meditateth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>is pursuing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath a pursuit</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419 strong:H06963">aloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8704">and cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">themselves after their manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with knives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">and lancets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">till the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">gushed out</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>the blood…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">poured out blood upon them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06672">And it came to pass, when midday</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they prophesied</w> until the <transChange type="added">time</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of the offering</w> of the <transChange type="added">evening</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">sacrifice</w>, that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">neither voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor any to answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07182">nor any that regarded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>offering</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascending</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that regarded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">attention</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto me. And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto him. And he repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">broken down</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto whom the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">shall be thy name</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 18:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">And with the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08585">a trench</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">as great as would contain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05429">two measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of seed</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-220">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-220">in order</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05408" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">the bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in pieces, and laid</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03537">barrels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and pour</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">on the burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and on the wood</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Do <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">the second time</w>. And they did <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">the second time</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, Do <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">the third time</w>. And they did <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08027" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">the third time</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08585">the trench</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">also with water</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ran</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:36
verses.text: And it came to pass at <transChange type="added">the time of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">the offering</w> of the <transChange type="added">evening</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">that Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let it be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all these things at thy word</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">me, that this people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-221">thou hast turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-221">back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0322">again</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">Then the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">and the stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06083">and the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03897" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and licked up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08585">in the trench</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And when all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on their faces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">let not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of them escape</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">them: and Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">to the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H07028">Kishon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> them there.<note type="study"><catchWord>Take</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Apprehend</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">unto Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get thee up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and drink</w>; for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">of rain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a sound…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a sound of a noise of rain</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">So Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of Carmel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01457" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he cast himself down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">between his knees</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 18:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">now, look</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03972">nothing</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And it came to pass at the seventh time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, there ariseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">out of the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">like a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">unto Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Prepare</w> <transChange type="added">thy chariot</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and get thee down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">that the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stop</w> thee not.<note type="study"><catchWord>Prepare</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Tie</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Bind</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 18:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03541">And it came to pass in the mean while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">that the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">was black</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">with clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">and wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and there was a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rode</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">to Jezreel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 18:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">was on Elijah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08151" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he girded up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">his loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">till thou come to Jezreel</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen348" osisID="1Kgs.18"/>

verses.name: I Kings 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">all that Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and withal how he had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">all the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0348">Then Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">a messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">unto Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">So let the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <transChange type="added">to me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also, if I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">as the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">of them by to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">about this time</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he saw</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for his life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">to Beer–sheba</w>, which <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his servant</w> there.

verses.name: I Kings 19:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he himself went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under a</w> <w lemma="strong:H07574">juniper tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he requested</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he might die</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">It is enough</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">now, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">than my fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for himself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for his life</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And as he lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">under a</w> <w lemma="strong:H07574">juniper tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">behold, then an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Arise</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he looked</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05692">a cake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07529">baken on the coals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06835">and a cruse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04763">at his head</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>head</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bolster</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">because the journey</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">too great</w> for thee.

verses.name: I Kings 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0396">of that meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">unto Horeb</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">thither unto a cave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">there; and, behold, the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">I have been very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thy covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thrown down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thine altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">thy prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>; and I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I only, am left</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take it away</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">and strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and brake in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">the rocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">not in the wind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">an earthquake</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07494">not in the earthquake</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">the earthquake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">not in the fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01827">a still</w> <w lemma="strong:H01851">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:13
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">when Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03874" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he wrapped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">in his mantle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">of the cave</w>. And, behold, <transChange type="added">there came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">What doest thou here, Elijah</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">I have been very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">jealous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">because the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thy covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thrown down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thine altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">thy prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>; and I, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I only, am left</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take it away</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">to the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when thou comest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">anoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">Hazael</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">over Syria</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05250">of Nimshi</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou anoint</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0477">and Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08202">of Shaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H065">of Abel–meholah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou anoint</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophet</w> in thy room.<note type="study"><catchWord>Elisha</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Eliseus</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 19:17
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">him that escapeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">of Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">shall Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slay</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and him that escapeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">from the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">shall Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slay</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Yet I have left</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01290">all the knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have not bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and every mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath not kissed</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>I have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I will leave</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 19:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thence, and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08202">of Shaphat</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">plowing</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">yoke</w> <transChange type="added">of oxen</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">him, and he with the twelfth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0452">and Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">by him, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">his mantle</w> upon him.

verses.name: I Kings 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">the oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me, I pray thee, kiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and my mother</w>, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for what have I done</w> to thee?<note type="study"><catchWord>Go…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Go return</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he returned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">a yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and boiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">their flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of the oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and ministered</w> unto him. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen349" osisID="1Kgs.19"/>

verses.name: I Kings 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01130">And Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-222">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">all his host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-222">together</w>: and <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">with him, and horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and warred</w> against it.

verses.name: I Kings 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">to Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">Ben–hadad</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03701">Thy silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and thy gold</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">mine; thy wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">also and thy children</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the goodliest</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> mine.

verses.name: I Kings 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy saying</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> thine, and all that I have.

verses.name: I Kings 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">Ben–hadad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Although I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">me thy silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and thy gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and thy wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy children</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">unto thee to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">about this time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they shall search</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall be</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04261">whatsoever is pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>, and take <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desirable</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Mark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray you, and see</w> how this <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischief</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto me for my wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and for my children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and for my silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and for my gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I denied</w> him not.<note type="study"><catchWord>I denied…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I kept not back from him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Hearken</w> not <transChange type="added">unto him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor consent</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">unto the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">of Ben–hadad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">All that thou didst send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for to thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">at the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">but this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not do</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-223">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-223">again</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01130">And Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">The gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do so</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto me, and more also</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06083">if the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall suffice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08168">for handfuls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">that follow</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>follow…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are at my feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Tell</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let not him that girdeth</w> on <transChange type="added">his harness</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">boast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">himself as he that putteth it off</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:12
verses.text: And it came to pass, when <transChange type="added">Ben–hadad</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this message</w>, as he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">drinking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">he and the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in the pavilions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves in array</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they set</w> <transChange type="added">themselves in array</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>message</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pavilions</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tents</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Set yourselves…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Place the engines. And they placed the engines</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">unto Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">approached</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">By whom? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">by the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the provinces</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall order</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, Thou.<note type="study"><catchWord>young…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">servants</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>order</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bind</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">tie</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and they were two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them he numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01130">But Ben–hadad</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">drinking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">himself drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in the pavilions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">he and the kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that helped</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">And the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01130">and Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">There are men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Whether they be come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">for peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">them alive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or whether they be come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">them alive</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">So these young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">which followed</w> them.

verses.name: I Kings 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">his man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0758">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">them: and Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">on an horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">with the horsemen</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05030">And the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thyself, and mark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what thou doest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08666">for at the return</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will come up</w> against thee.

verses.name: I Kings 20:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto him, Their gods</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hills</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they were stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0199">than we; but</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let us fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">against them in the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">and surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall be stronger</w> than they.

verses.name: I Kings 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">away, every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">captains</w> in their rooms:

verses.name: I Kings 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">thee an army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">like the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou hast lost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">for horse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">for chariot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and we will fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0854">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">them in the plain</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">surely we shall be stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">than they. And he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did so</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that was fallen</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08666">And it came to pass at the return</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01130">that Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0663">to Aphek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to fight…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the war with Israel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8719">were numbered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8791">and were all present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them: and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">before them like two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02835">little flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">of kids</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0758">but the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were all…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">were nourished</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">Because the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hills</w>, but he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">of the valleys</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore will I deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.
