And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">it was, that in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was joined</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">footmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">But the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0663">to Aphek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>; and <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">upon twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the men</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01130">And Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02315">into an inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">chamber</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from chamber to chamber</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">into a chamber within a chamber</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Behold now, we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us, I pray thee, put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">on our loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02256">and ropes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon our heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">peradventure he will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy life</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">on their loins</w>, and <transChange type="added">put</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02256">ropes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray thee, let me live</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">he yet alive</w>? he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brother</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Now the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">did diligently observe</w> whether <transChange type="added">any thing would come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">from him, and did hastily</w> <w lemma="strong:H02480" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">catch</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">Thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">Ben–hadad</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">him. Then Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to him; and he caused him to come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">into the chariot</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:34
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">Ben–hadad</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto him, The cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">which my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">from thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will restore</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">streets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">for thee in Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>. Then <transChange type="added">said Ahab</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will send thee away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">with this covenant</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him, and sent him away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>streets</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">market places</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">And a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">unto his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me, I pray thee. And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to smite</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, as soon as thou art departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">from me, a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. And as soon as he was departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">from him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0738">a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and slew</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 20:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me, I pray thee. And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him, so that in smiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06481" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he wounded</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>so that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smiting and wounding</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">So the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and disguised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0666">himself with ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">upon his face</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And as the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of the battle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and, behold, a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned aside</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">this man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">if by any means</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he be missing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">then shall thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">be for his life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or else thou shalt pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weigh</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And as thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was busy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0369">here and there, he was gone</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, So <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgment</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thyself hast decided</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he was not</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 20:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0666">and took the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from his face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">discerned</w> him that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Because thou hast let go</w> out of <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">whom I appointed to utter destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">therefore thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">shall go for his life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for his people</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 20:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05620">heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02198">and displeased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen350" osisID="1Kgs.20"/>

verses.name: I Kings 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05022">Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">had a vineyard</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0681">hard by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">unto Naboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">me thy vineyard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01588">that I may have it for a garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03419">of herbs</w>, because it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">my house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thee for it a better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyard</w> than it; <transChange type="added">or</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">if it seem good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242">thee the worth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of it in money</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seem…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be good in thine eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05022">And Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">to Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02486">forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it me, that I should give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my fathers</w> unto thee.

verses.name: I Kings 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05620">heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02198">and displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">because of the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">which Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him: for he had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thee the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my fathers</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he laid him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">upon his bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and would eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0348">But Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">unto him, Why is thy spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05620">so sad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou eatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto her, Because I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">unto Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">me thy vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for money</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02655">or else, if it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, I will give</w> thee <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for it: and he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">thee my vineyard</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0348">And Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Dost thou now govern</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">arise</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and let thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be merry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">thee the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So she wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">in Ahab’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sealed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02368">with his seal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">and to the nobles</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">with Naboth</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the letters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>on high…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the top of the people</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">And set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">before him, to bear witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou didst blaspheme</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w>. And <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carry him out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, that he may die</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">and the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who were the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">as Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> as it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which she had sent</w> unto them.

verses.name: I Kings 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">before him: and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">witnessed</w> against him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05022">against Naboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">in the presence of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05022">Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">did blaspheme</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then they carried him forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he died</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">to Jezebel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05022">Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is stoned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and is dead</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0348">And it came to pass, when Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">that Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05619" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was stoned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0348">that Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">to Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">thee for money</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05022">for Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">is not alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but dead</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And it came to pass, when Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">that Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0256">that Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">to the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take possession</w> of it.

verses.name: I Kings 21:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">came to Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08664">the Tishbite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>: behold, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03754">in the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither he is gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> it.

verses.name: I Kings 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou killed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and also taken possession</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And thou shalt speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">In the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">where dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03952" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">licked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">shall dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03952" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lick</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">thy blood</w>, even thine.

verses.name: I Kings 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">to Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me, O mine enemy</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have found</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">because thou hast sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thyself to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon thee, and will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thy posterity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">from Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08366" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him that pisseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">against the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and him that is shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">of Ahijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03708">for the provocation</w> wherewith thou hast provoked <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to sin</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0348">And of Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03611">The dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">by the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wall</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ditch</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Him that dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">the dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and him that dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">shall the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0256">But there was none like unto Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">which did sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">himself to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0348">whom Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">stirred up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stirred…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">incited</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966">And he did very</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">abominably</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in following</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">idols</w>, according to all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And it came to pass, when Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">those words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">upon his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">in sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0328">softly</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 21:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">came to Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08664">the Tishbite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Kings 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">thou how Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">humbleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">himself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03282">me? because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he humbleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">himself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, I will not bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in his days</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">in his son’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon his house</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen351" osisID="1Kgs.21"/>

verses.name: I Kings 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">without war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">between Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">And it came to pass in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03092">that Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07433">ye that Ramoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> ours, and we <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">still</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it not out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>still…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">silent from taking it</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with me to battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03644">as thou</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">as thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">my horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">as thy horses</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Enquire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">I pray thee, at the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-224">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-224">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">about four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Shall I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">against Ramoth–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or shall I forbear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0136">for the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall deliver</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">not here a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">besides</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we might enquire</w> of him?

verses.name: I Kings 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">yet one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03229">of Imlah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by whom we may enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">him; for he doth not prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">concerning me, but evil</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Let not the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> so.

verses.name: I Kings 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">an</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">officer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Hasten</w> <transChange type="added">hither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03229">of Imlah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuch</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">each</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">having put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">their robes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01637">in a void place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05030">and all the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>void…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">floor</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">And Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03668">of Chenaanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">him horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">With these shalt thou push</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">until thou have consumed</w> them.

verses.name: I Kings 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And all the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prosper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall deliver</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that was gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">Behold now, the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <transChange type="added">declare</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">let thy word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">I pray thee, be like the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of them, and speak</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04321">And Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">what the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto me, that will I speak</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">unto him, Micaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall we go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">against Ramoth–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or shall we forbear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prosper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall deliver</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">unto him, How many times</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shall I adjure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee that thou tell</w> me nothing but <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">true</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: I Kings 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">as sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that have not a shepherd</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">These have no master</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Did I not tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thee that he would prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">concerning me, but evil</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou therefore the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">by him on his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">and on his left</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Who shall persuade</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">at Ramoth–gilead</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And one said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">on this manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and another said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03541">on that manner</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>persuade</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deceive</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">a spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will persuade</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Wherewith? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">and I will be a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of all his prophets</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt persuade</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">also: go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> so.

verses.name: I Kings 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now therefore, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of all these thy prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> concerning thee.

verses.name: I Kings 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">But Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03668">of Chenaanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">on the cheek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0335">Which way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from me to speak</w> unto thee?

verses.name: I Kings 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04321">And Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into an inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H02247" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to hide</w> thyself.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from chamber to chamber</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a chamber in a chamber</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and carry him back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">unto Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03101">and to Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>;

verses.name: I Kings 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> this <transChange type="added">fellow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03608 strong:H01004">in the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">him with bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">of affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and with water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">of affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04321">And Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath not spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by me. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">O people</w>, every one of you.

verses.name: I Kings 22:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">I will disguise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">myself, and enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">into the battle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but put thou on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thy robes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">disguised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">into the battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I will…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when he was to disguise himself, and enter into the battle</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">his thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">that had rule over his chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">neither with small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">nor great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">save only with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And it came to pass, when the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they said</w>, Surely it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">against him: and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried out</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And it came to pass, when the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">perceived</w> that it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from pursuing</w> him.

verses.name: I Kings 22:34
verses.text: And a <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">a bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">at a venture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01694">between the joints</w> <w lemma="strong:H08302">of the harness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherefore he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07395">unto the driver of his chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and carry me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the host</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">for I am wounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his simplicity</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>joints…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">joints and the breastplate</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wounded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made sick</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">was stayed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">in his chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at even</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ran out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">of the wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>increased</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascended</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>midst</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bosom</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">a proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">throughout the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">about the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to his city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to his own country</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was brought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">came</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:38
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">in the pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03611">and the dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03952" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">licked up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">his blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02185">his armour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">according unto the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">and the ivory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he built</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 22:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">So Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0274">and Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Kings 22:41
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05806">Azubah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07977">of Shilhi</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he turned not aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from it, doing</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01116">nevertheless the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not taken away</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">yet in the high places</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">made peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he shewed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and how he warred</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: I Kings 22:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06945">of the sodomites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:47
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">then no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a deputy</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tharshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">to Ophir</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">for gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">not; for the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06100">at Ezion–geber</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">had ten ships</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Kings 22:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Let my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">in the ships</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03092">But Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> not.

verses.name: I Kings 22:50
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03088">and Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Kings 22:51
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0274">Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07651">the seventeenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">two years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Kings 22:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>:

verses.name: I Kings 22:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and provoked to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen352" osisID="1Kgs.22"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen330" osisID="1Kgs" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Kings 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Then Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0274">And Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">through a lattice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">in his upper chamber</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was sick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01176">of Baal–zebub</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the god</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">of Ekron</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whether I shall recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">of this disease</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">But the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">to Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08664">the Tishbite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and say</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01176">of Baal–zebub</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the god</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">of Ekron</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">from that bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">on which thou art gone up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thou shalt…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The bed whither thou art gone up, thou shalt not come down from it</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 1:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">And when the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">unto them, Why are ye now</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned back</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-225">unto him, There came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-225">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto us, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">you, and say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou sendest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01176">of Baal–zebub</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the god</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">of Ekron</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore thou shalt not come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">from that bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">on which thou art gone up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">unto them, What manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w> <transChange type="added">was he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">you, and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">you these words</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What was the manner of the man</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they answered</w> him, <transChange type="added">He was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08181">an hairy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H01167">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and girt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">with a girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of leather</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">about his loins</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08664">the Tishbite</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto him a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">with his fifty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him: and, behold, he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of an hill</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, Thou man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come down</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">to the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w>, If I <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">then let fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">thee and thy fifty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">him and his fifty</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto him another</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">with his fifty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, O man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">thus hath the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">quickly</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and said</w> unto them, If I <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">let fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">thee and thy fifty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0784">And the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">him and his fifty</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:13
