verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">with his fifty</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07992">And the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">on his knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, O man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">I pray thee, let my life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of these fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fell</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bowed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-226">Behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-226">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifties</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">with their fifties</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">therefore let my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now be precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">unto Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him: be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of him</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with him unto the king</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Forasmuch as thou hast sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01176">of Baal–zebub</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the god</w> <w lemma="strong:H06138">of Ekron</w>, <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> not because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of his word</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore thou shalt not come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">off that bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">on which thou art gone up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">but shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">which Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03088">And Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in his stead in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">of Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">because he had no son</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen354" osisID="2Kgs.1"/>

verses.name: II Kings 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And it came to pass, when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">would take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">into heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">by a whirlwind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">that Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">with Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">from Gilgal</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">unto Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">here, I pray thee; for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">me to Beth–el</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <transChange type="added">unto him</transChange>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. So they went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">to Beth–el</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">at Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">to Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from thy head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, I know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hold ye your peace</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">unto him, Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">here, I pray thee; for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">me to Jericho</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. So they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">to Jericho</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">at Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">to Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from thy head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, I know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hold ye your peace</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Tarry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">I pray thee, here; for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">me to Jordan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">thee. And they two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went on</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02572">And fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">to view</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">and they two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">by Jordan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to view</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in sight</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">over against</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0452">And Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">his mantle</w>, and wrapped <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01563" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they were divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">hither and thither, so that they two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02724">on dry</w> ground.

verses.name: II Kings 2:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when they were gone over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">that Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">unto Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what I shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">for thee, before I be taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">from thee. And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">I pray thee, let a double</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of thy spirit</w> be upon me.

verses.name: II Kings 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Thou hast asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">a hard thing</w>: <transChange type="added">nevertheless</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou see</w> me <transChange type="added">when I am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">taken</w> from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be <transChange type="added">so</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thou hast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Thou hast done hard in asking</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, as they still</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and talked</w>, that, behold, <transChange type="added">there appeared</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and parted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">asunder</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0452">and Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">by a whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">into heaven</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and he cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and the horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof. And he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him no more: and he took hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of his own clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">them in two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07168">pieces</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">also the mantle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">of Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from him, and went back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">by the bank</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>bank</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0155">the mantle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">of Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">of Elijah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when he also had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they parted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">hither and thither: and Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went over</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03405">to view at Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">The spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">of Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">doth rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">on Elisha</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">him, and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">themselves to the ground</w> before him.

verses.name: II Kings 2:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">unto him, Behold now, there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582 strong:H01121">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">we pray thee, and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy master</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">lest peradventure the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken him up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him upon some</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">or into some</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">valley</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not send</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strong…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of strength</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>some mountain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">one of the mountains</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06484" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they urged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him till he was ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">therefore fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but found</w> him not.

verses.name: II Kings 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him, (for he tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">at Jericho</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Did I not say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you, Go</w> not?

verses.name: II Kings 2:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">unto Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">Behold, I pray thee, the situation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of this city</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">pleasant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">as my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">but the water</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">naught</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">barren</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>barren</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">causing to miscarry</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">me a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H06746">cruse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein. And they brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to him.

verses.name: II Kings 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">unto the spring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">the salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in there, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">these waters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04194">there shall not be from thence any more death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07921" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">or barren</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">So the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">of Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">from thence unto Beth–el</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and as he was going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07046" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07142">thou bald head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07142">thou bald head</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">on them, and cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">them in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01677">she bears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">out of the wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and tare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">children</w> of them.

verses.name: II Kings 2:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from thence to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">Carmel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and from thence he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen355" osisID="2Kgs.2"/>

verses.name: II Kings 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03088">Now Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">but not like his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">and like his mother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for he put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>image</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statue</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Nevertheless he cleaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">unto the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">which made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> not therefrom.

verses.name: II Kings 3:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04338">And Mesha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05349">was a sheepmaster</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and rendered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06785">with the wool</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">But it came to pass, when Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">to Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me: wilt thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">with me against Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go up</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> as thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">as thy people</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05483">my horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">as thy horses</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">Which way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall we go up</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">through the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fetched a compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">of seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">and there was no water</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">for the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and for the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">that followed</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at their feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0162">Alas</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-227">hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-227">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>!

verses.name: II Kings 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">But Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">not here a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">by him? And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Here <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0477">Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08202">of Shaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">on the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">of Elijah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">The word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">is</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with him. So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> to him.

verses.name: II Kings 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">What have I to do with thee? get</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">thee to the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and to the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto him, Nay: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-228">hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-228">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03884">surely, were it not that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I would not look</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">toward thee, nor see</w> thee.

verses.name: II Kings 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But now bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">me a minstrel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And it came to pass, when the minstrel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">played</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">that the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> came upon him.

verses.name: II Kings 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">this valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01356">full of ditches</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05158">yet that valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that ye may drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">both ye, and your cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and your beasts</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:18
verses.text: And this is <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">a light thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">also into your hand</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And ye shall smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">every fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04004">and every choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">every good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stop</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">all wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and mar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">every good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of land with stones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mar</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">grieve</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">when the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was offered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 3:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04124">And when all the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">against them, they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that were able to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02290">on armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in the border</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gathered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were cried together</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>put on…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gird himself with a girdle</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">and the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shone</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">upon the water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">and the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">on the other side</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0122">red</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">as blood</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">are surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they have smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04124">now therefore, Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">to the spoil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">destroyed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">the Moabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them: but they went forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">smiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">the Moabites</w>, even in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> country.<note type="study"><catchWord>they went…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they smote in it even smiting</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they beat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and on every good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of land cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">his stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it; and they stopped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">all the wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and felled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">all the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07025">only in Kir–haraseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">they the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07051">thereof; howbeit the slingers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went about</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>only in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">until he left its stones in Kir–haraseth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 3:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">that the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was too sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for him, he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">with him seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">swords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to break through</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they could</w> not.

verses.name: II Kings 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that should have reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">in his stead, and offered</w> him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01419">And there was great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from him, and returned</w> to <transChange type="added">their own</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen356" osisID="2Kgs.3"/>

verses.name: II Kings 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now there cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">unto Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">my husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dead</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">did fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the creditor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">unto him my two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to be bondmen</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, What shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">for thee? tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">me, what hast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thou in the house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">Thine handmaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">hath not any thing in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0610">save a pot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">borrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">thee vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">of all thy neighbours</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07386">empty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">borrow not a few</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>borrow not…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scant not</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when thou art come in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon thee and upon thy sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shalt pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">into all those vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou shalt set aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">that which is full</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from him, and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">upon her and upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">who</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w> <transChange type="added">the vessels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">to her; and she poured out</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627">And it came to pass, when the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto her son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">me yet a vessel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto her, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">not a vessel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">more. And the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stayed</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05386">thy debt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and live</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou and thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the rest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>debt</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">creditor</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it fell on a day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0477">that Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07766">to Shunem</w>, where <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and she constrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>. And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> it was, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01767">as oft</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he passed by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in thither to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it fell on a day</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there was a day</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>constrained him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">laid hold on him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold now, I perceive</w> that this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">an holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which passeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">by us continually</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07023">I pray thee, on the wall</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">for him there a bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07979">and a table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">and a stool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04501">and a candlestick</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and it shall be, when he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to us, that he shall turn</w> in thither.

verses.name: II Kings 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it fell on a day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither, and he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">into the chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> there.

verses.name: II Kings 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01522">to Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">this Shunammite</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he had called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, she stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: II Kings 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02731">for us with all this care</w>; what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">for thee? wouldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thou be spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">or to the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">mine own people</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, What then <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01522">for her? And Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H061">Verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">she hath no child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and her husband</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is old</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her. And when he had called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, she stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the door</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">About this season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">according to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou shalt embrace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Nay, my lord</w>, <transChange type="added">thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">do not lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">unto thine handmaid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>season</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set time</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">at that season</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">that Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">unto her, according to the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03206">And when the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was grown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">it fell on a day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the reapers</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">My head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to a lad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">him to his mother</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">him to his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">on her knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">till noon</w>, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">him on the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shut</w> <transChange type="added">the door</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and went out</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto her husband</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">me, I pray thee, one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">of the asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may run</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come again</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Wherefore wilt thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to him to day</w>? <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">neither new moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">nor sabbath</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w>, <transChange type="added">It shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>well</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she saddled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">an ass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">to her servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Drive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go forward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slack</w> not <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">riding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for me, except I bid</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>slack…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">restrain not for me to ride</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">Carmel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">And it came to pass, when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw her afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01522">to Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his servant</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">yonder is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01975">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">Shunammite</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Run</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">now, I pray thee, to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">her, and say</w> unto her, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w> with thee? <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with thy husband</w>? <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">with the child</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she answered</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to the hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">she caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">him by the feet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01522">but Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to thrust her away</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Let her alone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">for her soul</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">within her: and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath hid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from me, and hath not told</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>him…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by his feet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>vexed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bitter</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Did I desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did I not say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07952" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Do not deceive</w> me?

verses.name: II Kings 4:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01522">to Gehazi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gird up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">my staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go thy way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">salute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">him not; and if any</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">salute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, answer him not again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">my staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the child</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0517">And the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee. And he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and followed</w> her.

verses.name: II Kings 4:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01522">And Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the child</w>; but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">neither voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07182">nor hearing</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore he went again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">The child</w> <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">is not awaked</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hearing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">attention</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And when Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">behold, the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">was dead</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">upon his bed</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore, and shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon them twain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">upon the child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">upon his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">upon his hands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01457" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he stretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">himself upon the child; and the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">of the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed warm</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008 strong:H0259">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008 strong:H0259">and fro</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01457" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">himself upon him: and the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02237" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">sneezed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the child</w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to and fro</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">once hither and once thither</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H01522">Gehazi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07767">this Shunammite</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her. And when she was come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then she went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">at his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">herself to the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:38
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01537">to Gilgal</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07458">a dearth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">unto his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08239" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">on the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">pot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and seethe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05138">pottage</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0219">herbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thereof wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H06498">gourds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his lap</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shred</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05518">into the pot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05138">of pottage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they knew</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> not.

verses.name: II Kings 4:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">for the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, as they were eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H05138">of the pottage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they cried out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, O <transChange type="added">thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">in the pot</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not eat</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Then bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07058">meal</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05518">into the pot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may eat</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07451 strong:H01697">And there was no harm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">in the pot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>harm</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evil thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:42
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01190">from Baal–shalisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">of the firstfruits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">loaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03759">and full ears of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06861">in the husk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may eat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the husk…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his scrip</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">garment</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 4:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And his servitor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What, should I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">this before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He said again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may eat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">They shall eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and shall leave</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 4:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he set</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and left</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen357" osisID="2Kgs.4"/>

verses.name: II Kings 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05283">Now Naaman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">was a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and honourable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because by him the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">deliverance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">unto Syria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01368">he was also a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">in valour</w>, <transChange type="added">but he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">a leper</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>honourable</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gracious</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifted up</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">accepted in countenance</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>deliverance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">victory</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">And the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">by companies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had brought away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">maid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and she waited on</w> <w lemma="strong:H05283">Naaman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>waited…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was before</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01404">unto her mistress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0305">Would</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">God my lord</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0227">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he would recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">him of his leprosy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>recover</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gather in</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:4
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thus and thus said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">the maid</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:5
