verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go to</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">a letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with him</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">changes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of raiment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05612">Now when this letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is come</w> unto thee, behold, I have <transChange type="added">therewith</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05283">Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to thee, that thou mayest recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">him of his leprosy</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had read</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the letter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">I God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to make alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02088">that this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me to recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06883">of his leprosy</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0389">wherefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">consider</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray you, and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0579" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">how he seeketh a quarrel</w> against me.

verses.name: II Kings 5:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0477">when Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore hast thou rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thy clothes</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now to me, and he shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05283">So Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">with his horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">and with his chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">of Elisha</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">a messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">in Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">and thy flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to thee, and thou shalt be clean</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05283">But Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I thought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">He will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to me, and stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and strike</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">over the place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">the leper</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I thought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I said</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>I thought…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I said with myself, He will surely come out</rdg>, etc: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I said</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>strike</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">move up and down</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0549 strong:H071" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">not Abana</w> <w lemma="strong:H06554">and Pharpar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">than all the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may I not wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in them, and be clean</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in a rage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abana</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Amana</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w>, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had bid</w> thee <transChange type="added">do some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wouldest thou not have done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H0637">how much rather then</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when he saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to thee, Wash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be clean</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then went he down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">himself seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">in Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">and his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">like unto the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">child</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he was clean</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">he and all his company</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, now I know</w> that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">but in Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now therefore, I pray thee, take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">a blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom I stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06484" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">none. And he urged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but he refused</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05283">And Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06505">mules’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will henceforth offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">neither burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">nor sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">but unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">In this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">when my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">of Rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">there, and he leaneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">on my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and I bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">myself in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">of Rimmon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">when I bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">myself in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07417">of Rimmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in this thing</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03530">from him a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a little…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a little piece of ground</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01522">But Gehazi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">of Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">Behold, my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05283">Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">this Syrian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in not receiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that which he brought</w>: but, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will run</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03972">somewhat</w> of him.

verses.name: II Kings 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01522">So Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05283">Naaman</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05283">And when Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">running</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, he lighted down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">from the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">all well</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Is there peace?</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, All <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">well</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0113">My master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, even now there be come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to me from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">them, I pray thee, a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">changes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of garments</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05283">And Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Be content</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">two talents</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he urged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02754">bags</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">with two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02487">changes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of his servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they bare</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: II Kings 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06076">to the tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he took</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bestowed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and he let the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they departed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tower</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secret place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But he went in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">before his master</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0370">unto him, Whence</w> <transChange type="added">comest thou</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01522">Gehazi</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0575">no whither</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>no whither</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not hither or thither</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not mine heart</w> <transChange type="added">with thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">again from his chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> thee? <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02132">and oliveyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and menservants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08198">and maidservants</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06883">The leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05283">therefore of Naaman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">unto thee, and unto thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from his presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">a leper</w> <transChange type="added">as white</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07950">as snow</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen358" osisID="2Kgs.5"/>

verses.name: II Kings 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">Behold now, the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">where we dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">with thee is too strait</w> for us.

verses.name: II Kings 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03383">we pray thee, unto Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thence every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H06982">beam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">us a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">there, where we may dwell</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> ye.

verses.name: II Kings 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Be content</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servants</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them. And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">to Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">But as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">was felling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06982">a beam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">the axe head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">into the water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0162">Alas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">master</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for it was borrowed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>axe head</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">iron</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0575">Where</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it? And he shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">him the place</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07094" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">a stick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">in thither; and the iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06687" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">did swim</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore said</w> he, Take <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee. And he put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> it.

verses.name: II Kings 6:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">warred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and took counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06423">In such</w> <w lemma="strong:H0492">and such</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08466">my camp</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>camp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">encamping</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Beware</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">not such</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0758">for thither the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05185">are come down</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">to the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">which the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him and warned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him of, and saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">himself there, not once</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">nor twice</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Therefore the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05590" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was sore troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for this thing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto them, Will ye not shew</w> me which of us <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">None, my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0477">but Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">telleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that thou speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904 strong:H02315">in thy bedchamber</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>None</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">No</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and spy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0351">where</w> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">him. And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01886">in Dothan</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">he thither horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03515">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-229">and compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-229">about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heavy</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And when the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was risen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gone forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">behold, an host</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">both with horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05288">And his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0162">unto him, Alas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my master</w>! <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how shall we do</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>the servant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the minister</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Fear</w> not: for they that <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with us <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">more</w> than they that <transChange type="added">be</transChange> with them.

verses.name: II Kings 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may see</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of the young man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he saw</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02022">and, behold, the mountain</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">and chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">Elisha</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">to him, Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05575">I pray thee, with blindness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05575">them with blindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">of Elisha</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto them, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not the way</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02090">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">you to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">whom ye seek</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But he led</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">them to Samaria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>follow…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">come ye after me</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when they were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">into Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0477">that Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> of these <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may see</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they saw</w>; and, behold, <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">unto Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">them, My father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall I smite</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall I smite</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>?

verses.name: II Kings 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt not smite</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">wouldest thou smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">those whom thou hast taken captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with thy sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">and with thy bow</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, that they may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to their master</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03739" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03740">provision</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for them: and when they had eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drunk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he sent them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to their master</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01416">So the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01130">that Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">all his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">And there was a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, behold, they besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">it, until an ass’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w> was <transChange type="added">sold</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08084">for fourscore</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07255">and the fourth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H06894">of a cab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02755 strong:H03123 strong:H01686" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of dove’s dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">for five</w> <transChange type="added">pieces</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And as the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was passing by</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">If the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do not help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0370">thee, whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall I help</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">thee? out of the barnfloor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03342">or out of the winepress</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>If…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Let not the <divineName>Lord</divineName> save thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">This woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So we boiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto her on the next</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: and she hath hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her son</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>next</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">other</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 6:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he passed by</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">he had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">upon his flesh</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so and more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">also to me, if the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">of Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08202">of Shaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on him this day</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 6:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">But Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> with him; and <transChange type="added">the king</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">him: but ere the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him, he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">to the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">See</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye how this son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of a murderer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">mine head</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">look</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">when the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hold him fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">at the door</w>: <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> him?

verses.name: II Kings 6:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And while he yet talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">with them, behold, the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him: and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">Behold, this evil</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">what should I wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> any longer? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen359" osisID="2Kgs.6"/>

verses.name: II Kings 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">Then Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">ye the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">about this time</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05429">a measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <transChange type="added">be sold</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08255">for a shekel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05429">and two measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">for a shekel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07991">Then a lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">on whose hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">leaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">would make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0699">windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">might this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, thou shalt see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but shalt not eat</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>a lord…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a lord which belonged to the king leaning upon his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 7:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0702">And there were four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">leprous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Why sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we here until we die</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If we say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">then the famine</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there: and if we sit still</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">here, we die</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">also. Now therefore come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">if they save us alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and if they kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, we shall but die</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">in the twilight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">unto the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when they were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> there.

verses.name: II Kings 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">For the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">had made the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of horses</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Lo, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against us the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">of the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> upon us.

verses.name: II Kings 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore they arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">in the twilight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and their horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and their asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04264">even the camp</w> as it <transChange type="added">was</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for their life</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">And when these lepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">into one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">thence silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">into another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">tent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carried</w> thence <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">We do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not well: this day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01309">of good tidings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and we hold our peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">if we tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">till the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">some mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">upon us: now therefore come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>some…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">we shall find punishment</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">unto the porter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>, and, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">there, neither voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">but horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">tied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">tied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">and the tents</w> as they <transChange type="added">were</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">the porters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">within</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will now shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">you what the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to us. They know</w> that we <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07457">hungry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore are they gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02247" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">themselves in the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When they come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">them alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and get</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Let <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">I pray thee, five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of the horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which are left</w> in the city, (behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">as all the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that are left</w> in it: behold, <transChange type="added">I say</transChange>, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">even as all the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of the Israelites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that are consumed</w>:) <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the city</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in it</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">therefore two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">them unto Jordan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">and, lo, all the way</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">which the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02648" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in their haste</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05429">So a measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> was <transChange type="added">sold</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08255">for a shekel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05429">and two measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">for a shekel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 7:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">the lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">on whose hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he leaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to have the charge of the gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trode</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">upon him in the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">as the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">who spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came down</w> to him.

verses.name: II Kings 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And it came to pass as the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05429">Two measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">for a shekel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05429">and a measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05560">of fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">for a shekel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">shall be to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">about this time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07991">And that lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Now, behold, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">should make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0699">windows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">might such a thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">it with thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but shalt not eat</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Kings 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And so it fell out unto him: for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trode</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">upon him in the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen360" osisID="2Kgs.7"/>

verses.name: II Kings 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">whose son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he had restored to life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thou and thine household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0834">wheresoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou canst sojourn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">for a famine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it shall also come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">after the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with her household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sojourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">And it came to pass at the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years’</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">that the woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for her house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">and for her land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">talked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01522">with Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">me, I pray thee, all the great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">that Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And it came to pass, as he was telling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-230">how he had restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a dead body</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-230">to life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">that, behold, the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">whose son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he had restored to life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for her house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">and for her land</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01522">And Gehazi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">My lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w>, and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">her son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0477">whom Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">restored to life</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">she told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him. So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">unto her a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">officer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Restore</w> all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08393">hers, and all the fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that she left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, even until now.<note type="study"><catchWord>officer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuch</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 8:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">to Damascus</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01130">and Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was sick</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">and it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">The man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02008">hither</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">unto Hazael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">of this disease</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02371">So Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02898">even of every good thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">camels’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">burden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">of this disease</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, Thou mayest certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">recover</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">howbeit the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me that he shall surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he settled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stedfastly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until he was ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stedfastly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and set it</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02371">And Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Why weepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">my lord</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou wilt do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04013">their strong holds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wilt thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">on fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0970">and their young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07376" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and wilt dash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and rip up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02030">their women with child</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02371">And Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, But what, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">a dog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shewed</w> me that thou <transChange type="added">shalt be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">over Syria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">from Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to his master</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him, What said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee? And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He told</w> me <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou shouldest surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">recover</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04346">a thick cloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dipped</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">on his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that he died</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02371">and Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 8:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02568">And in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">of Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03088">Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>began…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">reigned</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">Thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was he when he began to reign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01323">for the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">was his wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Yet the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sake, as he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him alway</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">a light</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to his children</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>light</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">candle</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">lamp</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 8:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">revolted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> over themselves.

verses.name: II Kings 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03141">So Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06811">to Zair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and all the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him: and he rose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which compassed him about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariots</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into their tents</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">Yet Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">revolted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03841">Then Libnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">revolted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01931">at the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:23
