verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">of Joram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 8:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03141">And Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0274">and Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ahaziah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Azariah, and Jehoahaz</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 8:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06240 strong:H08147">In the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">of Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">did Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">of Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begin to reign</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">Two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0274">Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06271">Athaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>daughter</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">granddaughter</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, as <transChange type="added">did</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>: for he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02860">the son in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">with Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the war</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">against Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">in Ramoth–gilead</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0761">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to be healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">of the wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">which the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">him at Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">against Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0274">And Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">of Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because he was sick</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wherewith the Syrians had wounded</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ramah</catchWord>: called <rdg type="x-identity">Ramoth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sick</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wounded</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen361" osisID="2Kgs.8"/>

verses.name: II Kings 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Gird up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06378">this box</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And when thou comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thither, look out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">there Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05250">of Nimshi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and go in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and make him arise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">him to an inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">chamber</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>inner…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chamber in a chamber</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06378">the box</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pour</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and flee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and tarry</w> not.

verses.name: II Kings 9:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05288">So the young man</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">behold, the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the host</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">I have an errand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">to thee, O captain</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Unto which of all us? And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">To thee, O captain</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou shalt smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I may avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of all the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">at the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">of Jezebel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">For the whole house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">from Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08366" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him that pisseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">against the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and him that is shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">of Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">of Ahijah</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03611">And the dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">in the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>, and <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to bury</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03058">Then Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of his lord</w>: and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">all well</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07696" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">this mad</w> <transChange type="added">fellow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to thee? And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Ye know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07879">and his communication</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">false</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us now. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus and thus spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he to me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Then they hasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01634">under him on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of the stairs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">with trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is king</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">reigneth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">So Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05250">of Nimshi</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">against Joram</w>. (<w lemma="strong:H03141">Now Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">had kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">Ramoth–gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">he and all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">of Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to be healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">of the wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">which the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">him, when he fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">with Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>.) <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">If it be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your minds</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0408">let none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w> <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06412">escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to tell</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Joram</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Jehoram</rdg> but not in verse sixteen</note><note type="study"><catchWord>had given</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smote</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>let none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let no escaper go</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">So Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rode in a chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">to Jezreel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03141">for Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">there. And Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And there stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">on the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he spied</w> <w lemma="strong:H08229">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H08229">a company</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03088">And Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07395">an horseman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and let him say</w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So there went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483 strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">one on horseback</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">What hast thou to do with peace</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thee behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me. And the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">The messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to them, but he cometh not again</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">a second</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483 strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on horseback</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to them, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">What hast thou to do with peace</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thee behind</w> me.

verses.name: II Kings 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even unto them, and cometh not again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04491">and the driving</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04491">like the driving</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05250">of Nimshi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he driveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07697">furiously</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>driving</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">marching</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>furiously</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in madness</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03088">And Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make ready</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07393">And his chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was made ready</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03088">And Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">and Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">each</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in his chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and met</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">him in the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Make ready</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Bind</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>met</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03088">And it came to pass, when Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">What peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">so long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H02183">the whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03785">and her witchcrafts</w> <transChange type="added">are so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03088">And Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">to Ahaziah</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04820">treachery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0274">O Ahaziah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">drew a bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with his full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">between his arms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02678">and the arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">at his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sunk down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in his chariot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled his hand with a bow</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sunk</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bowed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <transChange type="added">Jehu</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0920">to Bidkar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">his captain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">him in the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03158">the Jezreelite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">for remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">how that, when I and thou rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">this burden</w> upon him;

verses.name: II Kings 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Surely I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0570">yesterday</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05022">of Naboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and I will requite</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">thee in this plat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore take</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">him into the plat</w> <transChange type="added">of ground</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>plat</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">portion</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0274">But when Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">of the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">him also in the chariot</w>. <transChange type="added">And they did so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04608">at the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01483">to Gur</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02991">by Ibleam</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">to Megiddo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> there.

verses.name: II Kings 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">him in a chariot to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">him in his sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06240 strong:H0259">And in the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">of Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">began Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03058">And when Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">to Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0348">Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06320 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she painted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">her face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and tired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">her head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and looked out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">at a window</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>painted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">put her eyes in painting</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And as Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">entered in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she said</w>, <transChange type="added">Had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02174">Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his master</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 9:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">to the window</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">on my side? who? And there looked out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">to him two</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">eunuchs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eunuchs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chamberlains</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Throw her down</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they threw her down</w>: and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of her blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05137" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">on the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and on the horses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he trode her under foot</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was come in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">see now this cursed</w> <transChange type="added">woman</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and bury</w> her: for she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her: but they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0518">no more of her than</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">the skull</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and the feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the palms</w> of <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 9:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore they came again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him. And he said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08664">the Tishbite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">In the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">shall dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">of Jezebel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 9:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05038">And the carcase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0348">of Jezebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01828">shall be as dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">in the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>; <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they shall not say</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0348">Jezebel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen362" osisID="2Kgs.9"/>

verses.name: II Kings 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">had seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">of Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">to the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to them that brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab’s</w> <transChange type="added">children</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nourishers</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05612">Now as soon as this letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to you, seeing your master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with you, and <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">with you chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04013">a fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05402">also, and armour</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Look even out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the best</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and meetest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of your master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and set</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">on his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">for your master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H03966">But they were exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">Behold, two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: how then shall we stand</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 10:5
verses.text: And he that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the house</w>, and he that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">over the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also, and the bringers up</w> <transChange type="added">of the children</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">to Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all that thou shalt bid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">us; we will not make any</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> thou <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">a letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to them, saying</w>, If ye <transChange type="added">be</transChange> mine, and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye will hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">ye the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">your master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">to me to Jezreel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">by to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">this time</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">Now the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with the great men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which brought them up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for me</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05612">And it came to pass, when the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to them, that they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01731">in baskets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> him <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03157">to Jezreel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">a messenger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">ye them in two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06652">heaps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">And it came to pass in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to all the people</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">against my master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him: but who slew</w> all these?

verses.name: II Kings 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0645">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that there shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing of the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">concerning the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">Elijah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">So Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all that remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and all his great men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and his kinsfolks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and his priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H08300">him none remaining</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>kinsfolks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">acquaintance</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>. <transChange type="added">And</transChange> as he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">at the shearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01044 strong:H01004" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>shearing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of shepherds binding sheep</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">met</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with the brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye? And they answered</w>, We <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">to salute</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01377">of the queen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>met with</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to salute…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the peace of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">them alive</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">them alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">them at the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01044">of the shearing house</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">he any</w> of them.

verses.name: II Kings 10:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thence, he lighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03082">on Jehonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w> <transChange type="added">coming</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him: and he saluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">to him, Is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">as my heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with thy heart</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03082">And Jehonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">It is</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">If it be, give</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gave</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he took him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">to him into the chariot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lighted on</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>saluted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">blessed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with me, and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07068">my zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So they made him ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in his chariot</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all that remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">unto Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">till he had destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him, according to the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">to Elijah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-231">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-231">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">unto them, Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him much</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore call</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">unto me all the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and all his priests</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">let none</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be wanting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for I have a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifice</w> <transChange type="added">to do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01168">to Baal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">whosoever shall be wanting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not live</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03058">But Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06122">in subtilty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to the intent that he might destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the worshippers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06116">a solemn assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baal</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they proclaimed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Proclaim</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Sanctify</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">through all Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the worshippers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">so that there was not a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not. And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from one end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to another</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>full…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">so full that they stood mouth to mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> unto him that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04458">over the vestry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">vestments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for all the worshippers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04403">vestments</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03082">and Jehonadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the worshippers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Search</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and look</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">that there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">here with you none of the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but the worshippers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> only.

verses.name: II Kings 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">and burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whom I have brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">escape</w>, <transChange type="added">he that letteth him go</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for the life</w> of him.

verses.name: II Kings 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03058">that Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">and to the captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go in</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">them; let none</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come forth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">them with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">and the captains</w> cast <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the edge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the images</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burned</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the image</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04280 strong:H04163" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">it a draught house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">Thus Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Howbeit <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02399">the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not from after</w> them, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calves</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>, and that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01835">in Dan</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">unto Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Because thou hast done well</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in executing</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in mine eyes</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> according to all that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">of the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">generation</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 10:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">But Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took no heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all his heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not from the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">which made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>took…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">observed not</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H07096" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-232">to cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07096" morph="strongMorph:TH8763" type="x-split-232">short</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02371">and Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">them in all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>to cut</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to cut off the ends</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03383">From Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121 strong:H04217">eastward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07206">and the Reubenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04520">and the Manassites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06177">from Aroer</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0769">Arnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01568">even Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">and Bashan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eastward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">toward the rising of the sun</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>even…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">even to Gilead and Bashan</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 10:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and all his might</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 10:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">him in Samaria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03059">And Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 10:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">that Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the time</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the days were</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen363" osisID="2Kgs.10"/>

verses.name: II Kings 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06271">And when Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that her son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">all the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">royal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">seed of the kingdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03089">But Jehosheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stole</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">him from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">slain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they hid</w> him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him and his nurse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04296 strong:H02315">in the bedchamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06271">Athaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">so that he was not slain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehosheba</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jehoshabeath</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Joash</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jehoash</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And he was with her hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06271">And Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07637">And the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03746">with the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them to him into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with them, and took an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of them in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07992">A third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of you that enter in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall even be keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">of the watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">And a third part</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05495">of Sur</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07992">and a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the guard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so shall ye keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04535">that it be not broken down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from breaking up</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">And two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all you that go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even they shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>parts</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">companies</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And ye shall compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with his weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07713">within the ranges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">let him be slain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and be ye with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and as he cometh in</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over the hundreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> according to all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03077">that Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that were to come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that should go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">to Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And to the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over hundreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">did the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07982">and shields</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">And the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with his weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03233">from the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H08042">to the left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the temple</w>, <transChange type="added">along</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">by the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the temple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>corner</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">the crown</w> upon him, and <transChange type="added">gave him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they made him king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him; and they clapped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let the king live</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 11:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06271">And when Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the guard</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when she looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">behold, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">by a pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">as the manner</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">and the trumpeters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and blew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06271">and Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">her clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07195">Treason</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07195">Treason</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03077">But Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of the hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto them, Have her forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H07713">the ranges</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and him that followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">her kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03548">For the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">Let her not be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on her; and she went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">by the which the horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">and there was she slain</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03077">And Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">between the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that they should be the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">between the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">also and the people</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake it down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04196">his altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">and his images</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">brake they in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thoroughly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04977">Mattan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486 strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8803">officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">offices</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 11:19
