verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03746">and the captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was in quiet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06271">Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w> <transChange type="added">beside</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03060">Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen364" osisID="2Kgs.11"/>

verses.name: II Kings 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">In the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">he in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06645">Zibiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">of Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03060">And Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">wherein Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">instructed</w> him.

verses.name: II Kings 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">But the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not taken away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">still sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high places</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03060">And Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">to the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">All the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the dedicated things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">that is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that passeth</w> <transChange type="added">the account</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">that every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">is set at</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">all the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">into any man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>dedicated things</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">holy things</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holinesses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the souls of his estimation</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cometh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascendeth upon the heart of a man</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Let the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to them, every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04378">of his acquaintance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and let them repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0919">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0919">wheresoever any breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be found</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:6
verses.text: But it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07969">in the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had not repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0919">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>three…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">twentieth year and third year</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">for Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, and the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto them, Why repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0919">ye not the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now therefore receive</w> no <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04378">of your acquaintance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0919">it for the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0225" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">consented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01115">no</w> <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">neither</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0919">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03077">But Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">chest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bored</w> <w lemma="strong:H02356">a hole</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">in the lid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of it, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">it beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">therein all the money</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">threshold</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:10
verses.text: And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they saw</w> that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">in the chest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they put up in bags</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scribe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretary</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bound up</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">being told</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485 strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8716">that had the oversight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they laid it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086 strong:H02796">to the carpenters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and builders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>laid…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">brought it forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And to masons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H04274">and hewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0919">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and for all that was laid out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02394">to repair</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Howbeit there were not made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">bowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04212">snuffers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02689">trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">any vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">or vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the money</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: II Kings 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H04399" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that to the workmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">therewith the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Moreover they reckoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">not with the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">into whose hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be bestowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">on workmen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for they dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithfully</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0817">The trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">was not brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">it was the priests’</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02371">Then Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">against Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">it: and Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03060">And Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">all the hallowed things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">that Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03088">and Jehoram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0274">and Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had dedicated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and his own hallowed things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and all the gold</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02371">to Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went up</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07195">a conspiracy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01037 strong:H04407" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Millo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which goeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05538">to Silla</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the house…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Bethmillo</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 12:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03108">For Jozachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08100">of Shimeath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03075">and Jehozabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07763">of Shomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and he died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0558">and Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen365" osisID="2Kgs.12"/>

verses.name: II Kings 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07969">In the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <transChange type="added">and reigned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07651">seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>three…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">twentieth year and third year</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">which made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> not therefrom.<note type="study"><catchWord>followed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walked after</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">of Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">of Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">of Hazael</w>, all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03059">And Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: for he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">because the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">oppressed</w> them.

verses.name: II Kings 13:5
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a saviour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08543 strong:H08032">as beforetime</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as beforetime</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as yesterday, and third day</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Nevertheless they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not from the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sin</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therein: and there remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the grove</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">also in Samaria</w>.)<note type="study"><catchWord>walked</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he walked</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>remained</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Neither did he leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">to Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">but fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273">footmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">them like the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by threshing</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03059">And Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">him in Samaria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03101">and Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Joash</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jehoash</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07970">In the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">began Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <transChange type="added">and reigned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not from all the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sin</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he walked</w> therein.

verses.name: II Kings 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">wherewith he fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">against Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">And Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon his throne</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03101">and Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0477">Now Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was fallen sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">of his sickness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereof he died</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03101">And Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">over his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">O my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06571">and the horsemen</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Kings 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">and arrows</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">unto him bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">and arrows</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">upon the bow</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <transChange type="added">upon it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0477">and Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">upon the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Put thine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Make thine hand to ride</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">the window</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">eastward</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he opened</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0477">Then Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Shoot</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shot</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02671">The arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">deliverance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02671">and the arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">of deliverance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">from Syria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou shalt smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0663">in Aphek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">till thou have consumed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">the arrows</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471 strong:H07969">thrice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stayed</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Thou shouldest have smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">or six</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">then hadst thou smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">till thou hadst consumed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whereas now thou shalt smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">Syria</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06471 strong:H07969">thrice</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0477">And Elisha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">him. And the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">invaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">at the coming in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And it came to pass, as they were burying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that, behold, they spied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">a band</w> <transChange type="added">of men</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">into the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">of Elisha</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and when the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was let down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0477">of Elisha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he revived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on his feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went down</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02371">But Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto them, and had compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on them, and had respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H04616">unto them, because of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">with Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, neither cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">he them from his presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">as yet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>presence</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">face</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02371">So Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01130">and Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03060">And Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">of Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">of Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">by war</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07969">Three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">did Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and recovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>took…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">returned and took</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen366" osisID="2Kgs.13"/>

verses.name: II Kings 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">In the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03099">of Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">He was twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03086">Jehoaddan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07535">yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">not like David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">according to all things as Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">Howbeit the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not taken away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05750">as yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">did sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">on the high places</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04467">And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was confirmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the murderers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">not: according unto that which is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">wherein the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">The fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall not be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">nor the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for the fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">but every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be put to death</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">for his own sin</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05554">Selah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">by war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03371">of it Joktheel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Selah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the rock</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 14:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0558">Then Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">to Jehoash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">let us look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">one another in the face</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03060">And Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">to Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02336">The thistle</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">to the cedar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thy daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">by a wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trode down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02336">the thistle</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Thou hast indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath lifted thee up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">glory</w> <transChange type="added">of this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">at home</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">for why shouldest thou meddle</w> to <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shouldest fall</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">thou, and Judah</w> with thee?<note type="study"><catchWord>at home</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at thy house</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0558">But Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not hear</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03060">Therefore Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0558">and he and Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">one another in the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">at Beth–shemesh</w>, which <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was put to the worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to their tents</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smitten</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03060">And Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">of Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01053">at Beth–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">from the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">unto the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">all the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and in the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08594 strong:H01121">and hostages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">of Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and how he fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">with Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03060">And Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 14:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0558">And Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03060">of Jehoash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">of Amaziah</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07195">a conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against him in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">to Lachish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">him to Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> him there.

verses.name: II Kings 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">him on horses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">instead of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Azariah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Uzziah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He built</w> <w lemma="strong:H0359">Elath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">it to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06240 strong:H02568">In the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">of Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <transChange type="added">and reigned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not from all the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the coast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">of the plain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03124">Jonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0573">of Amittai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01662">of Gath–hepher</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">the affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">that it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bitter</w>: for <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0657">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">any shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">nor any left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor any helper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not that he would blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from under heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but he saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 14:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">how he warred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and how he recovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02574">and Hamath</w>, <transChange type="added">which belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 14:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">And Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zachariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen367" osisID="2Kgs.14"/>

verses.name: II Kings 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06242">In the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">began Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">of Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Azariah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Uzziah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">Sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was he when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03203">Jecholiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">Save that the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not removed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">still on the high places</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">so that he was a leper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of his death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02669">in a several</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03147">And Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judging</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">So Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03147">and Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 15:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H07970">In the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">did Zachariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not from the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07967">And Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06905">him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zachariah</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:12
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">unto Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">unto the fourth</w> <transChange type="added">generation</transChange>. And so it came to pass.

verses.name: II Kings 15:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">in the nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Uzziah</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Ozias</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a full…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a month of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04505">For Menahem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01424">of Gadi</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">from Tirzah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">of Jabesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07195">and his conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04505">Then Menahem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08607">Tiphsah</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">therein, and the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08656">thereof from Tirzah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they opened</w> not <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore he smote</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02030">all the women therein that were with child</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he ripped up</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08672">In the nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04505">began Menahem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01424">of Gadi</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">and reigned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not all his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06322">Pul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04505">and Menahem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06322">Pul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">that his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">might be with him to confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04505">And Menahem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">exacted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of all the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">of each</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not there in the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>exacted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to come forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 15:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04505">of Menahem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04505">And Menahem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06494">and Pekahiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 15:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H02572">In the fiftieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06494">Pekahiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04505">of Menahem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <transChange type="added">and reigned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">two years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not from the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06492">But Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07991">a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of his, conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">him in Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0759">in the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0709">with Argob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0745">and Arieh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and with him fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569 strong:H01121">of the Gileadites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and reigned</w> in his room.

verses.name: II Kings 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06494">of Pekahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08147">In the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fiftieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06492">Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>, <transChange type="added">and reigned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not from the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06492">of Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08407">Tiglath–pileser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05859">Ijon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H062">and Abel–beth–maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03239">and Janoah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06943">and Kedesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02674">and Hazor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01568">and Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01551">and Galilee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried them captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">to Assyria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01954">And Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07195">a conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06492">against Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">in his stead, in the twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06492">of Pekah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:32
