verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08147">In the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06492">of Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">began Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">Five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was he when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03388">Jerusha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01116">Howbeit the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not removed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">still in the high places</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 15:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07526">Rezin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06492">and Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 15:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03147">And Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0271">and Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen368" osisID="2Kgs.15"/>

verses.name: II Kings 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06240 strong:H07651">In the seventeenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H06492">of Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">Twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did</w> not <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">like David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">yea, and made his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">according to the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and on the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07488">and under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07526">Then Rezin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06492">and Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">not overcome</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07526">Rezin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">recovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0359">Elath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130 strong:H0758" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">to Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05394" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and drave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H0359">from Elath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0726">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0359">to Elath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">there unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from Elath</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from Eloth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">So Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08407">to Tiglath–pileser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">me out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">which rise up</w> against me.

verses.name: II Kings 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">And Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and in the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <transChange type="added">it for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07810">a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto him: for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">against Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> it, and carried <transChange type="added">the people of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07024">to Kir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07526">Rezin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Damascus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Dammesek</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 16:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">to Damascus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H08407">Tiglath–pileser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01834">at Damascus</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">to Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01823">the fashion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08403">and the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of it, according to all the workmanship</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>Damascus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Dammesek</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0223">And Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">according to all that king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">from Damascus</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0223">so Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">from Damascus</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">from Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">approached</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">to the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> thereon.

verses.name: II Kings 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">his burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and his meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H05262">his drink offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of his peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his peace offerings</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the peace offerings which were his</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">also the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">from between the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">it on the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03409">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">Upon the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt sacrifice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and his meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">with the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and their meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and their drink offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sprinkle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">upon it all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">and all the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of the sacrifice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05178">and the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01239" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">shall be for me to enquire</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">according to all that king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">of the bases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">the laver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from off them; and took down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">from off the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">under it, and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04837">it upon a pavement</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04329 strong:H04329" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">And the covert</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">for the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">he from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 16:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">of Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">And Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02396">and Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen369" osisID="2Kgs.16"/>

verses.name: II Kings 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">In the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">of Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">began Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">but not as the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that were before</w> him.

verses.name: II Kings 17:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Against him came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08022">Shalmaneser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01954">and Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">became his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">him presents</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rendered</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>presents</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tribute</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07195">conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">in Hoshea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he had sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05471">to So</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">no present</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, as <transChange type="added">he had done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">therefore the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shut him up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608 strong:H01004">him in prison</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tribute</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 17:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">it three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08671">In the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">of Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-233">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-233">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">into Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02477">them in Halah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02249">and in Habor</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H01470">of Gozan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of the Medes</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:7
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">it was, that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which had brought them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had made</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">did secretly</w> <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not right against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">them high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in all their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">from the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">to the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they set them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">images</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">and groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">in every high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07488">and under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And there they burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in all the high places</w>, as <transChange type="added">did</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; and wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to provoke the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to anger</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whereof the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Ye shall not do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Yet the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">all the prophets</w>, <transChange type="added">and by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02374">all the seers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">ye from your evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">according to all the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and which I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to you by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Notwithstanding they would not hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">their necks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06203">like to the neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that did not believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05715">and his testimonies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against them; and they followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and became vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and went after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> them, <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, that they should not do</w> like them.

verses.name: II Kings 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">them molten images</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">a grove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baal</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And they caused their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">through the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07080" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and used</w> <w lemma="strong:H07081">divination</w> <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and enchantments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke him to anger</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them out of his sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there was none left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">but the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> only.

verses.name: II Kings 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Also Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">not the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">in the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they made</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejected</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">all the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of spoilers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until he had cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them out of his sight</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03379">and they made Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05077 strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">drave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and made them sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02401">sin</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">in all the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they departed</w> not from them;

verses.name: II Kings 17:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Until the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of his sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">all his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03478">So was Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">out of their own land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">to Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03575">and from Cuthah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05755">and from Ava</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02574">and from Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05617">and from Sepharvaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and placed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">instead of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Kings 17:25
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08462">it was at the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of their dwelling</w> there, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them, which slew</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of them.

verses.name: II Kings 17:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">The nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore he hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">among them, and, behold, they slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them, because they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">thither one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom ye brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thence; and let them go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">there, and let him teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">them the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Then one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom they had carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">from Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them how they should fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Howbeit every nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">of their own, and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H08118">which the Samaritans</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">every nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wherein they dwelt</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05524">Succoth–benoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03575">of Cuth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05370">Nergal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0807">Ashima</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 17:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05757">And the Avites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05026">Nibhaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08662">and Tartak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05616">and the Sepharvites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0152">to Adrammelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06048">and Anammelech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05617">of Sepharvaim</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03373">So they feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">unto themselves of the lowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of them priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for them in the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03373">They feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their own gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom they carried away</w> from thence.<note type="study"><catchWord>whom…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">who carried them away from thence</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 17:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Unto this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">after the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">manners</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03373">they fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">neither do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">they after their statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">or after their ordinances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">or after the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he named</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 17:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">With whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">nor bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yourselves to them, nor serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, nor sacrifice</w> to them:

verses.name: II Kings 17:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who brought you up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and a stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him shall ye fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and him shall ye worship</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and to him shall ye do sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02706">And the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the ordinances</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and the commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for you, ye shall observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for evermore</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall not fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01285">And the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you ye shall not forget</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall ye fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall fear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all your enemies</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Howbeit they did not hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">after their former</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">manner</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 17:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">So these nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">their graven images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">both their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">they unto this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen370" osisID="2Kgs.17"/>

verses.name: II Kings 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Now it came to pass in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">of Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">of Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hezekiah</catchWord>: he is called <rdg type="x-identity">Ezekias</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">Twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was he when he began to reign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">His mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H021">Abi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zachariah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abi</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Abijah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">according to all that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 18:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and brake in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">serpent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for unto those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">did burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to it: and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05180">it Nehushtan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Nehushtan</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A piece of brass</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">so that after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him was none like him among all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, nor <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that were before</w> him.

verses.name: II Kings 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, but kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> was with him; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he prospered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whithersoever he went forth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and served</w> him not.

verses.name: II Kings 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05804">unto Gaza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">thereof, from the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the watchmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">to the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gaza</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Azzah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07243">And it came to pass in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">of Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08022">Shalmaneser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">against Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> it.

verses.name: II Kings 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07097">And at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they took</w> it: <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">in the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">of Hezekiah</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08672">the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01954">of Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was taken</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">did carry away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">unto Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02477">them in Halah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02249">and in Habor</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H01470">of Gozan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of the Medes</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">all that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and would not hear</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor do</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: II Kings 18:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">Now in the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">did Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against all the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sennacherib</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Sanherib</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">to Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have offended</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me: that which thou puttest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on me will I bear</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">unto Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">all the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and in the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">did Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">cut off</w> <transChange type="added">the gold from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0547">the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">which Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had overlaid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">it to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">them</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08661">Tartan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07249">and Rabsaris</w> <w lemma="strong:H07262">and Rab–shakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">from Lachish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they were come up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08585">by the conduit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the upper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">pool</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04546">in the highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the fuller’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">field</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heavy</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they had called</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">to them Eliakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03098">and Joah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the recorder</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scribe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretary</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07262">And Rab–shakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">ye now to Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0986">What confidence</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this wherein thou trustest</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou sayest</w>, (but <transChange type="added">they are but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>,) <transChange type="added">I have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for the war</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now on whom dost thou trust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou rebellest</w> against me?<note type="study"><catchWord>sayest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">talkest</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>vain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word of the lips</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>I have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">but counsel and strength are for the war</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now, behold, thou trustest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">upon the staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of this bruised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">reed</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">upon Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">on which if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">lean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">into his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and pierce</w> it: so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto all that trust</w> on him.<note type="study"><catchWord>trustest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">trustest thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, We trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>: <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01116">not that he, whose high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and whose altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Ye shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">this altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thee two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on thy part to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">riders</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>pledges</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hostages</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">How then wilt thou turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">of the least</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my master’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put thy trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">on Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">for chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and for horsemen</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Am I now come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">against this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it? The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to me, Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">against this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and destroy</w> it.

verses.name: II Kings 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03098">and Joah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07262">unto Rab–shakeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">I pray thee, to thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0762">in the Syrian language</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for we understand</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03066">not with us in the Jews’ language</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07262">But Rab–shakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto them, Hath my master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">me to thy master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to thee, to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>? <transChange type="added">hath he</transChange> not <transChange type="added">sent me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">to the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02755 strong:H06675" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their own dung</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07890 strong:H07272 strong:H04325" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their own piss</w> with you?<note type="study"><catchWord>their own piss</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the water of their feet</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07262">Then Rab–shakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03066">in the Jews’ language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">Let not Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you: for he shall not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of his hand</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">Neither let Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make you trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">us, and this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 18:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">not to Hezekiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <transChange type="added">an agreement</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01293">with me by a present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come out</w> to me, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">of his own vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">of his fig tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of his cistern</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Make…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Seek my favour</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Make with me a blessing</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cistern</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pit</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Until I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and take you away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">like your own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03323">of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">and of honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">that ye may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not die</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">not unto Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when he persuadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will deliver</w> us.<note type="study"><catchWord>persuadeth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deceiveth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 18:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Hath any</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">at all</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 18:34
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0774">and of Arpad</w>? where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05617">of Sepharvaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02012">Hena</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05755">and Ivah</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have they delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 18:35
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">they among all the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their country</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">should deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 18:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">But the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">held their peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him not a word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Answer</w> him not.

verses.name: II Kings 18:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03098">and Joah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the recorder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w> with <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">rent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">him the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07262">of Rab–shakeh</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen371" osisID="2Kgs.18"/>

verses.name: II Kings 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">himself with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the household</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07644">and Shebna</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03470">to Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08433">and of rebuke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05007">and blasphemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04866">to the birth</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">not strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to bring forth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blasphemy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">provocation</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:4
