verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0194">It may be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07262">of Rab–shakeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and will reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore lift up</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08605">prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">for the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are left</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>left</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">So the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">to Isaiah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03470">And Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to your master</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">with which the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have blasphemed</w> me.

verses.name: II Kings 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">a blast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon him, and he shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">a rumour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to his own land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will cause him to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in his own land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07262">So Rab–shakeh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">warring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">against Libnah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he was departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">from Lachish</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08640">of Tirhakah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, he is come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against thee: he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">unto Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Let not thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in whom thou trustest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, thou hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">what the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to all lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by destroying them utterly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and shalt thou be delivered</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Have the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">them which my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have destroyed</w>; <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01470">Gozan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02771">and Haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07530">and Rezeph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05729">of Eden</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08515">in Thelasar</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 19:13
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0774">of Arpad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05617">of Sepharvaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02012">of Hena</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05755">and Ivah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 19:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of the messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and read</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">it: and Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwellest</w> <transChange type="added">between</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou art the God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">thou alone, of all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">open</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">of Sennacherib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him to reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">Of a truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and their lands</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And have cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">into the fire</w>: for they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">but the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">and stone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">therefore they have destroyed</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">given</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now therefore, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">I beseech thee, save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thou us out of his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">that all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> that thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> thou only.

verses.name: II Kings 19:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03470">Then Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">which thou hast prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">to me against Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:21
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">concerning him; The virgin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath despised</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laughed thee to scorn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">her head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">at thee</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Whom hast thou reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H01442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and blasphemed</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and against whom hast thou exalted</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>? <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">against the Holy</w> <transChange type="added">One</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">By</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">thy messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">With the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393 strong:H07393" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of my chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">to the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03411">to the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the tall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar trees</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04004">the choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">fir trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof: and I will enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04411">into the lodgings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">of his borders</w>, <transChange type="added">and into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03293">the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03760">of his Carmel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>By</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">By the hand of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>tall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tallness</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>of his Carmel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and his fruitful field</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06979" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drunk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and with the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">of my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have I dried</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">up all the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04693">of besieged places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>besieged</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fenced</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou not heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">long ago</w> <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> it, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it? now have I brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07582" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ruinous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">heaps</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>long…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">how I have made it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? should I now bring it to be laid waste, and fenced cities to be ruinous heaps?</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Therefore their inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07116">were of small</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they were dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and confounded</w>; they were <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06212">the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03419">the green</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">herb</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">on the housetops</w>, and <transChange type="added">as corn</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07711">blasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07054">it be grown up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of small…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">short of hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy abode</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and thy going out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and thy coming in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and thy rage</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>abode</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sitting</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">Because thy rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H07600">against me and thy tumult</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">into mine ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore I will put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02397">my hook</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in thy nose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04964">and my bridle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in thy lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will turn thee back</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by which thou camest</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:29
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">a sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, Ye shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">this year</w> <w lemma="strong:H05599">such things as grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of themselves, and in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H07823">that which springeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of the same; and in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and reap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruits</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Kings 19:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">that is escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall yet again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">take root</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">downward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">upward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>remnant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">escaping of the house of Judah that remaineth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">For out of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">a remnant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06413">and they that escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">out of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07068">the zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H06635" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of hosts</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall do</w> this.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the escaping</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 19:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">concerning the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">an arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">there, nor come before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">it with shield</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05550">a bank</w> against it.

verses.name: II Kings 19:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">By the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by the same shall he return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I will defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">it, for mine own sake, and for my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> sake.

verses.name: II Kings 19:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915">And it came to pass that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">that the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of the Assyrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when they arose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">all dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">corpses</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05576">So Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05210">at Nineveh</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 19:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And it came to pass, as he was worshipping</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05268">of Nisroch</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0152">that Adrammelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H08272">and Sharezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">him with the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0780">of Armenia</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0634">And Esarhaddon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Armenia</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ararat</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen372" osisID="2Kgs.19"/>

verses.name: II Kings 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">was Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto death</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05030">And the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">Set thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">in order</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for thou shalt die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not live</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Give charge concerning thine house</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">to the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0577">I beseech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">now how I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thee in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">and with a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have done</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065 strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">sore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with a great weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03470">And it came to pass, afore Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08484">into the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H02691" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came to him, saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>court</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">city</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">thy prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">thy tears</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">behold, I will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">thee: on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And I will add</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">thee and this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01598" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for mine own sake, and for my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> sake.

verses.name: II Kings 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03470">And Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01690">a lump</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">of figs</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07822">on the boil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he recovered</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 20:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">unto Isaiah</w>, What <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">the sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and that I shall go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03470">And Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0226">This sign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">shalt thou have of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he hath spoken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06738">shall the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">degrees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or go back</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">degrees</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">It is a light thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">for the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">degrees</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06738">nay, but let the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0322">backward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">degrees</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03470">And Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H0322">backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04609">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which it had gone down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">in the dial</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">of Ahaz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dial</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">degrees</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 20:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01255">Berodach–baladan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01081">of Baladan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and a present</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">unto Hezekiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">that Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had been sick</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Berodach–baladan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Merodach–baladan</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto them, and shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05238">of his precious things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and the spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">ointment</w>, and <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and all that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in his treasures</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">there was nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04475">nor in all his dominion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">that Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shewed</w> them not.<note type="study"><catchWord>precious things</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spicery</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>armour</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">jewels</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 20:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, What said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">these men</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0370">and from whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">they unto thee? And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What have they seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, All <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in mine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they seen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">there is nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">among my treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I have not shewed</w> them.

verses.name: II Kings 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03470">And Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">unto Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Behold, the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">come</w>, that all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and that which thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0686" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have laid up in store</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">into Babylon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall issue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from thee, which thou shalt beget</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they take away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05631">and they shall be eunuchs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">unto Isaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">Good</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou hast spoken</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not <transChange type="added">good</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">if peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">be in my days</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Is it…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shall there not be peace and truth</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Kings 20:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">of Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and all his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and how he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">a pool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08585">and a conduit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen373" osisID="2Kgs.20"/>

verses.name: II Kings 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02657">Hephzi–bah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">after the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he built up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">which Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had destroyed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">a grove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> them.

verses.name: II Kings 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">of which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">In Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And he made his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">through the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">and observed times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and used enchantments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">with familiar spirits</w> <w lemma="strong:H03049">and wizards</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, to provoke <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to anger</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a graven image</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">of the grove</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">of which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">In this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of all tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">Neither will I make the feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">move</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">any more</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">only if they will observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according to all that I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">them, and according to all the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> them.

verses.name: II Kings 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But they hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">not: and Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">seduced</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">more evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">than did the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">Because Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">these abominations</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath done wickedly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">above all that the Amorites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">him, and hath made Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also to sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">with his idols</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">bringing</w> <transChange type="added">such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that whosoever heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of it, both</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">his ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H06750" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tingle</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will stretch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">over Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">the line</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04949">and the plummet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will wipe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> as <transChange type="added">a man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wipeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06747">a dish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wiping</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turning</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upside down</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wiping…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he wipeth and turneth it upon the face thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of mine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0957">and they shall become a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H04933">and a spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to all their enemies</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have done</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04480">and have provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">me to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">even unto this day</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">Moreover Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">till he had filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from one end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02403">beside his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">wherewith he made Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in doing</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from mouth to mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 21:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and his sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he sinned</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">And Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05798">of Uzza</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0526">and Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 21:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0526">Amon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04922">Meshullemeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02743">of Haruz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03192">of Jotbah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H01544">the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">served</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> them:

verses.name: II Kings 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">of Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his own house</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all them that had conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">Amon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">made Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">of Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">in his sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">in the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05798">of Uzza</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02977">and Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Josiah</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Josias</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen374" osisID="2Kgs.21"/>

verses.name: II Kings 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03040">Jedidah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05718">of Adaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01218">of Boscath</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turned not aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">to the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">or to the left</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">And it came to pass in the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0683">of Azaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">of Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">to Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he may sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">which is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which the keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">threshold</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And let them deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the doers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">of the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that have the oversight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it to the doers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">of the work</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0919">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>,

verses.name: II Kings 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02796">Unto carpenters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and builders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and masons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H04274">and hewn</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Howbeit there was no reckoning made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with them of the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because they dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithfully</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02518">And Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">unto Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H02518">And Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">to Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he read</w> it.

verses.name: II Kings 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08227">And Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-234">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-234">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">Thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that have the oversight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gathered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melted</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08227">And Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">me a book</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08227">And Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0296">and Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05907">and Achbor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04320">of Michaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08227">and Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06222">and Asahiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Achbor</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Abdon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Michaiah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Micah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for me, and for the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and for all Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of this book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that is found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">against us, because our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of this book</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according unto all that which is written</w> concerning us.

verses.name: II Kings 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02518">So Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0296">and Ahikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05907">and Achbor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08227">and Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06222">and Asahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02468">unto Huldah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05031">the prophetess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08616">of Tikvah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02745">of Harhas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of the wardrobe</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">now she dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">in the college</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they communed</w> with her.<note type="study"><catchWord>wardrobe</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">garments</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the second part</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 22:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that sent</w> you to me,

verses.name: II Kings 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon the inhabitants</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">which the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath read</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and have burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they might provoke me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02534">therefore my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">against this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not be quenched</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thus shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">As touching</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast heard</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">Because thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was tender</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou hast humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thyself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">what I spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">against this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">thereof, that they should become a desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">and a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thy clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me; I also have heard</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Kings 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold therefore, I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thee unto thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and thou shalt be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">into thy grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-235">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-235">again</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen375" osisID="2Kgs.22"/>

verses.name: II Kings 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">unto him all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">with him, and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">both small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>both…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from small even unto great</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">by a pillar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">and his testimonies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">and his statutes</w> with all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> and all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of this covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that were written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">to the covenant</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">of the second order</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">out of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that were made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0842">and for the grove</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and for all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">them without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07709">in the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">of Kidron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of them unto Beth–el</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:5
