verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he put down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03649">the idolatrous priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04524">and in the places round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them also that burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08121">to the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">and to the moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04208">and to the planets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and to all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to cease</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>idolatrous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Chemarim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>planets</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">twelve signs</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">constellations</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the grove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">it at the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>, and stamped <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">to powder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the powder</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">thereof upon the graves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06945">of the sodomites</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">where the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">hangings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">for the grove</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hangings</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">houses</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">all the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">where the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had burned incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01387">from Geba</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">to Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gates</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03091">of Joshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">on a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">left hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Nevertheless the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">to the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of the unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08612">Topheth</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01121" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">might make his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">or his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04432">to Molech</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">the horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">to the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">at the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">by the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H05419">of Nathan–melech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">the chamberlain</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06503">in the suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chamberlain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuch</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">officer</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04196">And the altars</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01406">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">of the upper chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">of Ahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">which the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">which Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">did the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">beat down</w>, and brake <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from thence, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of them into the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brake…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ran from thence</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">And the high places</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">of corruption</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06253">for Ashtoreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H06722">of the Zidonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03645">and for Chemosh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of the Moabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04445">and for Milcom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">the abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">did the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">defile</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the mount…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the mount of Olives</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he brake in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">their places</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">with the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04196">Moreover the altar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01008">at Beth–el</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">which Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">who made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">both that altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">and the high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he brake down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high place</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">stamped</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">small to powder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the grove</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02977">And as Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, he spied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">the sepulchres</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">there in the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">out of the sepulchres</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burned</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">it, according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">which the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">proclaimed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06725">What title</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01975">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I see</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">told</w> him, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06913">the sepulchre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">from Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">against the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">of Beth–el</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Let him alone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">let no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">move</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">his bones</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06106">So they let his bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">with the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bones alone</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bones to escape</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And all the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">also of the high places</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">which the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> to provoke <transChange type="added">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">took away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">to them according to all the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">in Beth–el</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">all the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">of the high places</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there upon the altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them, and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slew</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sacrificed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of this covenant</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Surely there was not holden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">such a passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">nor in all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">nor of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">But in the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w>, <transChange type="added">wherein</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06453">this passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was holden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Moreover the <transChange type="added">workers with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0178">familiar spirits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">and the wizards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08655">and the images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01544">and the idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08251">and all the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that were spied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02977">did Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">put away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he might perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which were written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">that Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">teraphim</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And like unto him was there no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, that turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all his soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and with all his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">according to all the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">neither after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him arose</w> there <transChange type="added">any</transChange> like him.

verses.name: II Kings 23:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Notwithstanding the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">not from the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of his great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">wherewith his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03708">because of all the provocations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">that Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had provoked</w> him withal.<note type="study"><catchWord>provocations</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">angers</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">also out of my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">as I have removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of which I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">My name</w> shall be there.

verses.name: II Kings 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 23:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06549">Pharaoh–nechoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">to the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him; and he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">him at Megiddo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he had seen</w> him.

verses.name: II Kings 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">carried him in a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">from Megiddo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">him to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">him in his own sepulchre</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and made him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in his father’s</w> stead.

verses.name: II Kings 23:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03059">Jehoahaz</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02537">Hamutal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">of Libnah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoahaz</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shallum</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06549">And Pharaoh–nechoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put him in bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">at Riblah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he might not reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06066">to a tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03603">and a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">because he reigned</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>put the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set a fine upon the land</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 23:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06549">And Pharaoh–nechoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">made Eliakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">in the room of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">to Jehoiakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-236">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-236">away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> there.

verses.name: II Kings 23:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03079">And Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">to Pharaoh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but he taxed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he exacted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">according to his taxation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06549">unto Pharaoh–nechoh</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03079">Jehoiakim</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02080">Zebudah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06305">of Pedaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07316">of Rumah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 23:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen376" osisID="2Kgs.23"/>

verses.name: II Kings 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03079">and Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">became his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then he turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rebelled</w> against him.

verses.name: II Kings 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">against him bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01416">and bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01416">and bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of the Moabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01416">and bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">them against Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">it, according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Surely at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> came <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">upon Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to remove</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">out of his sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">for the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according to all that he did</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05355">And also for the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he shed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for he filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">with innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not pardon</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and all that he did</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>?

verses.name: II Kings 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03079">So Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03078">and Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Kings 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">any more out of his land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all that pertained to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03078">Jehoiachin</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05179">Nehushta</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0494">of Elnathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoiachin</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Jeconiah and Coniah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">of Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was besieged</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">came into siege</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05019">And Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did besiege</w> it.

verses.name: II Kings 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03078">And Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0517">he, and his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">and his officers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">him in the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuchs</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his reign</catchWord>: <transChange type="amplified">Nebuchadnezzar’s eighth year</transChange></note>

verses.name: II Kings 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he carried out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">thence all the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had said</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">all Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and all the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and all the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">and all the craftsmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04525">and smiths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">none remained</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02108">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01803">the poorest sort</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03078">Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">and his officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0193 strong:H0352" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">he into captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuchs</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of might</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">and craftsmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04525">and smiths</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w>, all <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">strong</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">apt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">even them the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04983">made Mattaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">his father’s brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">in his stead, and changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">to Zedekiah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">and one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02537">Hamutal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03841">of Libnah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03079">according to all that Jehoiakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">For through the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">it came to pass in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">until he had cast them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from his presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06667">that Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen377" osisID="2Kgs.24"/>

verses.name: II Kings 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08671">And it came to pass in the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06218">in the tenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">he, and all his host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against it; and they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01785">forts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against it round about</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">unto the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08672">And on the ninth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of the <transChange type="added">fourth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">the famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">and there was no bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05892">And the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was broken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <transChange type="added">fled</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">between two walls</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">garden</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H03778">now the Chaldees</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>:) and <transChange type="added">the king</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">toward the plain</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">And the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and overtook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">him in the plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02428">and all his army</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were scattered</w> from him.

verses.name: II Kings 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">to Riblah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spake judgment with him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05786" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">of Zedekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">him with fetters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made blind</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02549">And in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">on the seventh</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H06240 strong:H08672">the nineteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05018">Nebuzar–adan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>captain…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chief marshal</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and every great</w> <transChange type="added">man’s</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">he with fire</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">And all the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>, that <transChange type="added">were with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the fugitives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that fell away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">with the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">of the multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05018">did Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carry away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fugitives</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fallen away</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">But the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01803">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03755">vinedressers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01461 strong:H03009" morph="strongMorph:TH8801 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">and husbandmen</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05982">And the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04350">and the bases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">did the Chaldees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">break in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of them to Babylon</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05518">And the pots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03257">and the shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04212">and the snuffers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wherewith they ministered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took they away</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04289">And the firepans</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the bowls</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> such things as <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and of silver</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took away</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08147">The two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04350">and the bases</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of all these vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">was without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">weight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>one…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the one sea</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06967">The height</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03805">and the chapiter</w> upon it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06967">and the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">of the chapiter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07639">and the wreathen work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07416">and pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">upon the chapiter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">all of brass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08145">and like unto these had the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">with wreathen work</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07227">And the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08304">Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06846">and Zephaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the door</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">threshold</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">an</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">officer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06496">that was set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">over the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that were</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">presence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06633" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which mustered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>officer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuch</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>were in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saw the king’s face</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>principal…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scribe of the captain of the host</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05018">And Nebuzar–adan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02876">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">these, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">to Riblah</w>:

verses.name: II Kings 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07247">them at Riblah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03063">So Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">out of their land</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">whom Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01436">even over them he made Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0296">of Ahikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ruler</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And when all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the armies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">they and their men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">had made Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">governor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">to Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">to Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">even Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03110">and Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07143">of Careah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08304">and Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08576">of Tanhumeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05200">the Netophathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02970">and Jaazaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04602">of a Maachathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">they and their men</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01436">And Gedaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">to them, and to their men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">not to be the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall be well</w> with you.

verses.name: II Kings 25:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">But it came to pass in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">that Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05418">of Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0476">of Elishama</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">royal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with him, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01436">Gedaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">and the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">and the Chaldees</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">that were with him at Mizpah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>royal</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the kingdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">both small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the armies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">to Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they were afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">the Chaldees</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07651">And it came to pass in the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H01546">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03078">of Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">on the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0192">Evil–merodach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he began to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03078">of Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608 strong:H01004">out of prison</w>;

verses.name: II Kings 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">kindly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">above the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0894">with him in Babylon</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>kindly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good things with him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Kings 25:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08132" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03608">his prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">garments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>.

verses.name: II Kings 25:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0737">And his allowance</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H0737">allowance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">a daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">rate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for every day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of his life</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen378" osisID="2Kgs.25"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen353" osisID="2Kgs" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0121">Adam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08352">Sheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0583">Enosh</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07018">Kenan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04111">Mahalaleel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03382">Jered</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02585">Henoch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04968">Methuselah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03929">Lamech</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05146">Noah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08035">Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02526">Ham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03315">and Japheth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03315">of Japheth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01586">Gomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04031">and Magog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04074">and Madai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03120">and Javan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08422">and Tubal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04902">and Meshech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08494">and Tiras</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01586">of Gomer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0813">Ashchenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07384">and Riphath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08425">and Togarmah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Riphath</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Diphath</rdg> as it is in some copies</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03120">of Javan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0473">Elishah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08659">and Tarshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03794">Kittim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01721">and Dodanim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Dodanim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Rodanim</rdg>, according to some copies</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03568">Cush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04714">and Mizraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06316">Put</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03667">and Canaan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Cush</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05434">Seba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02341">and Havilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05454">and Sabta</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07484">and Raamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05455">and Sabtecha</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07484">of Raamah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07614">Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01719">and Dedan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03568">And Cush</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05248">Nimrod</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he began</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">to be mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">And Mizraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03866">Ludim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06047">and Anamim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03853">and Lehabim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05320">and Naphtuhim</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06625">And Pathrusim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03695">and Casluhim</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of whom came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H03732">and Caphthorim</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03667">And Canaan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06721">Zidon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02845">and Heth</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02983">The Jebusite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">also, and the Amorite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01622">and the Girgashite</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02340">And the Hivite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06208">and the Arkite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05513">and the Sinite</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0721">And the Arvadite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06786">and the Zemarite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02577">and the Hamathite</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08035">of Shem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05867">Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0804">and Asshur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0775">and Arphaxad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03865">and Lud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">and Aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05780">and Uz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02343">and Hul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01666">and Gether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04902">and Meshech</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Meshech</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Mash</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0775">And Arphaxad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07974">Shelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07974">and Shelah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05677">Eber</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05677">And unto Eber</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the one</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06389">Peleg</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">because in his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06385" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was divided</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03355">Joktan</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Peleg</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">division</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03355">And Joktan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0486">Almodad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08026">and Sheleph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02700">and Hazarmaveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03392">and Jerah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01913">Hadoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0187">also, and Uzal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01853">and Diklah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05858">And Ebal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H039">and Abimael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07614">and Sheba</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0211">And Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02341">and Havilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03103">and Jobab</w>. All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03355">of Joktan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08035">Shem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0775">Arphaxad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07974">Shelah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05677">Eber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06389">Peleg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07466">Reu</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08286">Serug</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05152">Nahor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08646">Terah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w>; the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">and Ishmael</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08435">their generations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01060">The firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05032">Nebaioth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06938">then Kedar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0110">and Adbeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04017">and Mibsam</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04927">Mishma</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01746">and Dumah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04854">Massa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02301">Hadad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08485">and Tema</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Hadad</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Hadar</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03195">Jetur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05305">Naphish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06929">and Kedemah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">These are the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06989">of Keturah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02175">Zimran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03370">and Jokshan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04091">and Medan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04080">and Midian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03435">and Ishbak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07744">and Shuah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03370">of Jokshan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07614">Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01719">and Dedan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">of Midian</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05891">Ephah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06081">and Epher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02585">and Henoch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H028">and Abida</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0420">and Eldaah</w>. All these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06989">of Keturah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H085">And Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">of Isaac</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06215">Esau</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06215">of Esau</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0464">Eliphaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07467">Reuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03266">and Jeush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03281">and Jaalam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07141">and Korah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">of Eliphaz</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08487">Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0201">and Omar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06825">Zephi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01609">and Gatam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07073">Kenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08555">and Timna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06002">and Amalek</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zephi</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zepho</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">of Reuel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05184">Nahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02226">Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08048">Shammah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04199">and Mizzah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03877">Lotan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07732">and Shobal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06649">and Zibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06034">and Anah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01787">and Dishon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0687">and Ezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01789">and Dishan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03877">of Lotan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02753">Hori</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01950">and Homam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08555">and Timna</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03877">Lotan’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sister</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Homam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hemam</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07732">of Shobal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05935">Alian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04506">and Manahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05858">and Ebal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08195">Shephi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0208">and Onam</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06649">of Zibeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0345">Aiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06034">and Anah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Alian</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Alvan</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shephi</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shepho</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06034">of Anah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01787">Dishon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01787">of Dishon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02566">Amram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0790">and Eshban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03506">and Ithran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03763">and Cheran</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Amram</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hemdan</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0687">of Ezer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01092">Bilhan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02190">and Zavan</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03292">Jakan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01789">of Dishan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05780">Uz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0765">and Aran</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jakan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Akan</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:43
