verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">over the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01106">Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01160">of Beor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01838">Dinhabah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01106">And when Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03103">Jobab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01224">of Bozrah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03103">And when Jobab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02367">Husham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08489">of the Temanites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02367">And when Husham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01908">Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0911">of Bedad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04080">Midian</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in his stead: and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05762">Avith</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01908">And when Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08072">Samlah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04957">of Masrekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08072">And when Samlah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">Shaul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07344">of Rehoboth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">And when Shaul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01177">Baal–hanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05907">of Achbor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01177">And when Baal–hanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01908">Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in his stead: and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of his city</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06464">Pai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04105">Mehetabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04308">of Matred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04314">of Mezahab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hadad</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hadar</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Pai</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Pau</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:51
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01908">Hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">also. And the dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">were; duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H08555">Timnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05933">Aliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03509">Jetheth</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0173">Aholibamah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06373">Pinon</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">Kenaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H08487">Teman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04014">Mibzar</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 1:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0441">Duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04025">Magdiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">duke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05902">Iram</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the dukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen380" osisID="1Chr.1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:1
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07205">Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08095">Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03878">Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">and Zebulun</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Israel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jacob</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01835">Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05321">Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0836">and Asher</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06147">Er</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0209">and Onan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07956">and Shelah</w>: <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">unto him of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01340 strong:H07774" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Shua</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanitess</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06147">And Er</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">was evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he slew</w> him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08559">And Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03618">his daughter in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">him Pharez</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">and Zerah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">All the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Pharez</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02538">and Hamul</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02174">Zimri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0387">and Ethan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01968">and Heman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03633">and Calcol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01873">and Dara</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> of them in all.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zimri</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zabdi</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Dara</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Darda</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03756">of Carmi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05917">Achar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the troubler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02764">in the thing accursed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Achar</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Achan</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0387">of Ethan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">also of Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03396">unto him; Jerahmeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07410">and Ram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03621">and Chelubai</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ram</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Aram</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Chelubai</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Caleb</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07410">And Ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05992">Amminadab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05992">and Amminadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05177">Nahshon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05177">And Nahshon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08007">Salma</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08007">and Salma</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Salma</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Salmon</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01162">And Boaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05744">Obed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05744">and Obed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">Jesse</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03448">And Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0446">Eliab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H041">and Abinadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08092">and Shimma</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Shimma</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shammah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05417">Nethaneel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07288">Raddai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0684">Ozem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">Whose sisters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06870">Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H026">and Abigail</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H052">Abishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">and Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06214">and Asahel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H026">And Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">Amasa</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06021">of Amasa</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03500">Jether</w> <w lemma="strong:H03459">the Ishmeelite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jether…</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ithra an Israelite</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03612">And Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">of Hezron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <transChange type="added">children</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0854">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05806">Azubah</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03408">and of Jerioth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">her sons</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03475">these; Jesher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07727">and Shobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0715">and Ardon</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05806">And when Azubah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">unto him Ephrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">him Hur</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02354">And Hur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0221">Uri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0221">and Uri</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01212">Bezaleel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">to the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he married</w> when he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07687">him Segub</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>married</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">took</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07687">And Segub</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02971">Jair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">who had three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">Geshur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">and Aram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02333">with the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H02971">of Jair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07079">from them, with Kenath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and the towns</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>. All these <transChange type="added">belonged to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">that Hezron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">was dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03613">in Caleb–ephratah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H029">then Abiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0806">him Ashur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08620">of Tekoa</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03396">of Jerahmeel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02696">of Hezron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07410">were, Ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0946">and Bunah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0767">and Oren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0684">and Ozem</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0281">Ahijah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03396">Jerahmeel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">had also another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05851">Atarah</w>; she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0208">of Onam</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07410">of Ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03396">of Jerahmeel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04619">were, Maaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03226">and Jamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06134">and Eker</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0208">of Onam</w> <w lemma="strong:H08060">were, Shammai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03047">and Jada</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08060">of Shammai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05070">Nadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H051">and Abishur</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H051">of Abishur</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H032">Abihail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0257">him Ahban</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04140">and Molid</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05070">of Nadab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05540">Seled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0649">and Appaim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05540">but Seled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">without children</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0649">of Appaim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03469">Ishi</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03469">of Ishi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08348">Sheshan</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08348">of Sheshan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0304">Ahlai</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03047">of Jada</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08060">of Shammai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03500">Jether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03129">and Jonathan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03500">and Jether</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">without children</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">of Jonathan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06431">Peleth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02117">and Zaza</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">These were the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03396">of Jerahmeel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:34
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08348">Now Sheshan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">had no sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">but daughters</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08348">And Sheshan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">had a servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04713">an Egyptian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03398">Jarha</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08348">And Sheshan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">his daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03398">to Jarha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06262">him Attai</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06262">And Attai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02066">Zabad</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02066">And Zabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0654">Ephlal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0654">and Ephlal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05744">Obed</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05744">And Obed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03058">and Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02503">Helez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02503">and Helez</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0501">Eleasah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0501">And Eleasah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05581">Sisamai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05581">and Sisamai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07967">And Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03359">Jekamiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03359">and Jekamiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0476">Elishama</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:42
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03396">of Jerahmeel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04337">Mesha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02128">of Ziph</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04762">of Mareshah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07141">Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08599">and Tappuah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07552">and Rekem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08087">and Shema</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08087">And Shema</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07357">Raham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03421">of Jorkoam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07552">and Rekem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08060">Shammai</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08060">of Shammai</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04584">Maon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04584">and Maon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01049">of Beth–zur</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05891">And Ephah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02771">Haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04162">and Moza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01495">and Gazez</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02771">and Haran</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01495">Gazez</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03056">of Jahdai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07276">Regem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03147">and Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01529">and Geshan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06404">and Pelet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05891">and Ephah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08174">and Shaaph</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03612">Caleb’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07669">Sheber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08647">and Tirhanah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08174">also Shaaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04089">of Madmannah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07724">Sheva</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04343">of Machbenah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01388">of Gibea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01323">and the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of Caleb</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05915">Achsah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:50
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">These were the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">of Ephratah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07732">Shobal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">of Kirjath–jearim</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Ephratah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ephreth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08007">Salma</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02780">Hareph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01013">of Beth–gader</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07732">And Shobal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">of Kirjath–jearim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">had sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07204">Haroeh</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02679">of the Manahethites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Haroeh</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Reaiah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>half…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">half of the Menuchites</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Hatsi–ham–menuchoth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">And the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">of Kirjath–jearim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03505">the Ithrites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06336">and the Puhites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08126">and the Shumathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04954">and the Mishraites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06882">the Zareathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0848">and the Eshtaulites</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08007">of Salma</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01035">Beth–lehem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05200">and the Netophathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05852">Ataroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05854">the house of Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02680">of the Manahethites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06882">the Zorites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ataroth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Atarites</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">crowns of the house of Joab</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 2:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04940">And the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the scribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427 strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03258">at Jabez</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08654">the Tirathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08101">the Shimeathites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07756">Suchathites</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01992">These</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07017">the Kenites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hemath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen381" osisID="1Chr.2"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now these were the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">unto him in Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0550">Amnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0293">of Ahinoam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03159">the Jezreelitess</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H026">of Abigail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03762">the Carmelitess</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Daniel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Chileab</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">The third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">of Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08526">of Talmai</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01650">of Geshur</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">Adonijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02294">of Haggith</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02549">The fifth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08203">Shephatiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H037">of Abital</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03507">Ithream</w> <w lemma="strong:H05698">by Eglah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">These</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">unto him in Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And these were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto him in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08092">Shimea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07727">and Shobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01340">of Bath–shua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05988">of Ammiel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Shimea</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shammua</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Bath–shua</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Bath–sheba</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ammiel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Eliam</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02984">Ibhar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0476">also, and Elishama</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0467">and Eliphelet</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Elishama</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Elishua</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05052">And Nogah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05298">and Nepheg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03309">and Japhia</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0476">And Elishama</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0450">and Eliada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0467">and Eliphelet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Eliada</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Beeliada</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">These were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">beside the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">of the concubines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08559">and Tamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H029">Abia</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Abia</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Abijam</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0274">Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03101">Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Ahaziah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Azariah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03147">Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Azariah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Uzziah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0526">Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03110">Johanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">Jehoiakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Johanan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jehoahaz</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoiakim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Eliakim</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Zedekiah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Mattaniah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03204">Jeconiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jeconiah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jehoiachin or Coniah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03204">of Jeconiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0617">Assir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07597">Salathiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Salathiel</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Shealtiel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04443">Malchiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06305">also, and Pedaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08137">and Shenazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03359">Jecamiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01953">Hoshama</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05072">and Nedabiah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06305">of Pedaiah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02216">Zerubbabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02216">of Zerubbabel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04918">Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02608">and Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08019">and Shelomith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02807">And Hashubah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0169">and Ohel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01296">and Berechiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02619">and Hasadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03142">Jushab–hesed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">of Hananiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06410">Pelatiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03470">and Jesaiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07509">of Rephaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0770">of Arnan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05662">of Obadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07935">of Shechaniah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07935">of Shechaniah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02407">Hattush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03008">and Igeal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01282">and Bariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05294">and Neariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08202">and Shaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05294">of Neariah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0454">Elioenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02396">and Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05840">and Azrikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hezekiah</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hiskijah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0454">of Elioenai</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01939">Hodaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0475">and Eliashib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06411">and Pelaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06126">and Akkub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03110">and Johanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01806">and Dalaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06054">and Anani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen382" osisID="1Chr.3"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06557">Pharez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03756">and Carmi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02354">and Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07732">and Shobal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Carmi</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Chelubai or Caleb</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07211">And Reaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07732">of Shobal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03189">Jahath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03189">and Jahath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0267">Ahumai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03855">and Lahad</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06882">of the Zorathites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Reaiah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Haroeh</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:3
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05862">of Etam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03157">Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03457">and Ishma</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03031">and Idbash</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">of their sister</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06753">Hazelelponi</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06439">And Penuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01446">of Gedor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05829">and Ezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02364">of Hushah</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">of Ephratah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0806">And Ashur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H08620">of Tekoa</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">had two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02458">Helah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05292">and Naarah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05292">And Naarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0275">him Ahuzam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02660">and Hepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08488">and Temeni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0326">and Haahashtari</w>. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05292">of Naarah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02458">of Helah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06889">Zereth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03328 strong:H06714" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">and Jezoar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0869">and Ethnan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06976">And Coz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06036">Anub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06637">and Zobebah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H0316">of Aharhel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02037">of Harum</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03258">And Jabez</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">was more honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">than his brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0517">and his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03258">Jabez</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06090">him with sorrow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jabez</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Sorrowful</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03258">And Jabez</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">on the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou wouldest bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me indeed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">my coast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and that thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that it may not grieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me! And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">granted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him that which he requested</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Oh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">If thou wilt</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>keep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do me</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03620">And Chelub</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H07746">of Shuah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04243">Mehir</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0850">of Eshton</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0850">And Eshton</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01051">Beth–rapha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06454">and Paseah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08468">and Tehinnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05904">of Ir–nahash</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07397">of Rechah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ir–nahash</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the city of Nahash</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07073">of Kenaz</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06274">Othniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08304">and Seraiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06274">of Othniel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02867">Hathath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hathath…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hathath, and Meonothai, who begat</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04587">And Meonothai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06084">Ophrah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08304">and Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">of the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H02798">of Charashim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02791">for they were craftsmen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>valley</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">inhabitants of the valley</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Charashim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">craftsmen</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Hathath…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hathath, and Meonothai, who begat</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">of Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05900">Iru</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0425">Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05277">and Naam</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0425">of Elah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07073">even Kenaz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>even Kenaz</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Uknaz</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03094">of Jehaleleel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02128">Ziph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02129">and Ziphah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08493">Tiria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0840">and Asareel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05834">of Ezra</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03500">Jether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04778">and Mered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06081">and Epher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03210">and Jalon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04813">Miriam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08060">and Shammai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03431">and Ishbah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0851">of Eshtemoa</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">And his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03057">Jehudijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03382">Jered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01446">of Gedor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02268">and Heber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07755">of Socho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03354">and Jekuthiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02182">of Zanoah</w>. And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01332">of Bithiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04778">which Mered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehudijah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the Jewess</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01940">Hodiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05163">of Naham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">of Keilah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01636">the Garmite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0851">and Eshtemoa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04602">the Maachathite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hodiah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jehudijah, mentioned before</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07889">of Shimon</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0550">Amnon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07441">and Rinnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01135">Ben–hanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08436">and Tilon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03469">of Ishi</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02105">Zoheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01132">and Ben–zoheth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07956">of Shelah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06147">Er</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03922">of Lecah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03935">and Laadah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04762">of Mareshah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">and the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of them that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0948">fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0791">of Ashbea</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03137">And Jokim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03578">of Chozeba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03101">and Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08315">and Saraph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01166" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who had the dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">in Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03433">and Jashubi–lehem</w>. And <transChange type="added">these are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06267">ancient</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:23
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the potters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and those that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05196">among plants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01448">and hedges</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for his work</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05241">Nemuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03226">and Jamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03402">Jarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02226">Zerah</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Shaul</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Nemuel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jemuel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jarib, Zerah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jachin Zohar</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04017">Mibsam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04927">Mishma</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04927">of Mishma</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02536">Hamuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02139">Zacchur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08096">And Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">had sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">but his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">had not many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">neither did all their family</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">multiply</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">like to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>like…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">at Beer–sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04137">and Moladah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02705">and Hazar–shual</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01090">And at Bilhah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06107">and at Ezem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08434">and at Tolad</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Bilhah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Balah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Tolad</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Eltolad</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01328">And at Bethuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02767">and at Hormah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06860">and at Ziklag</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01024">And at Beth–marcaboth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02702">and Hazar–susim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01011">and at Beth–birei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08189">and at Shaaraim</w>. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hazar–susim</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hazar–susah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02691">And their villages</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05862">Etam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05871">and Ain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07417">Rimmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08507">and Tochen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06228">and Ashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Etam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ether</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02691">And all their villages</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the same cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01168">unto Baal</w>. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04186">their habitations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and their genealogy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Baal</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Baalath–beer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>their genealogy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as they divided themselves by nations among them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04877">And Meshobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03230">and Jamlech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03144">and Joshah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">of Amaziah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03100">And Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03058">and Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03143">of Josibiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08304">of Seraiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06221">of Asiel</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0454">And Elioenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03291">and Jaakobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03439">and Jeshohaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06222">and Asaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05717">and Adiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03450">and Jesimiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02124">And Ziza</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08230">of Shiphi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0438">of Allon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03042">of Jedaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08113">of Shimri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">These mentioned</w> by <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">names</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">in their families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">greatly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mentioned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">coming</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:39
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">to the entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01446">of Gedor</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04217">unto the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">of the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">pasture</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">for their flocks</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08082">fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04829">pasture</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H07342">wide</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and quiet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07961">and peaceable</w>; for <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">had dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">there of old</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And these written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04583">and the habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">there, and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them utterly unto this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> in their rooms: because <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04829">pasture</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">there for their flocks</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:42
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">some</transChange> of them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">having for their captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06410">Pelatiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05294">and Neariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07509">and Rephaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05816">and Uzziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03469">of Ishi</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 4:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06002">of the Amalekites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">that were escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">there unto this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen383" osisID="1Chr.4"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, (for he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">but, forasmuch as he defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326">bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01062">his birthright</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and the genealogy is not to be reckoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01062">after the birthright</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">For Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">above his brethren</w>, and of him <transChange type="added">came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the chief ruler</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01062">but the birthright</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph’s</w>:)<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prince</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w>, <transChange type="added">I say</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02585">Hanoch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06396">and Pallu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02696">Hezron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03756">and Carmi</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03100">of Joel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01463">Gog</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04318">Micah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07211">Reaia</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01168">Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0880">Beerah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08407">whom Tilgath–pilneser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">carried away</w> <transChange type="added">captive</transChange>: he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05387">prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">of the Reubenites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Tilgath–pilneser</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Tiglath–pileser</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">by their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692" type="x-split-237">when the genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08435">of their generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692" type="x-split-237">was reckoned</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03273">Jeiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01106">And Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05811">of Azaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08087">of Shema</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03100">of Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06177">in Aroer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05015">even unto Nebo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01186">and Baal–meon</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Shema</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shemaiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04217">And eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he inhabited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in of the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04735">because their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01905">with the Hagarites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by their hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in their tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">throughout</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">all the east</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>throughout…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon all the face of the east</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over against them, in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05548">unto Salchah</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03100">Joel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08223">and Shapham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">the next</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03285">and Jaanai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08202">and Shaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04317">Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04918">and Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07652">and Sheba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03140">and Jorai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03275">and Jachan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02127">and Zia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05677">and Heber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:14
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H032">of Abihail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02359">of Huri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03386">of Jaroah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04317">of Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03454">of Jeshishai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03163">of Jahdo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0938">of Buz</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0277">Ahi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05661">of Abdiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01476">of Guni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and in her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04054">and in all the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08289">of Sharon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08444">upon their borders</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their goings forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">All these were reckoned by genealogies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">of Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">and the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valiant men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">able to bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">buckler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">and sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">with bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and skilful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in war</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to the war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>valiant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of valour</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01905">with the Hagarites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03195">with Jetur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05305">and Nephish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05114">and Nodab</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And they were helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01905">against them, and the Hagarites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into their hand</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with them: for they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">and he was intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them; because they put their trust</w> in him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">their cattle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01581">of their camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02543">and of asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315 strong:H0120">and of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>took…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">led captive</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">souls of men</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">down many</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">because the war</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">in their steads until the captivity</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">from Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01179">unto Baal–hermon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08149">and Senir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and unto mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">Hermon</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:24
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06081">even Epher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03469">and Ishi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0447">and Eliel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05837">and Azriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03414">and Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01938">and Hodaviah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03164">and Jahdiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>famous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of names</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stirred up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06322">of Pul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08407">of Tilgath–pilneser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he carried them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07206">even the Reubenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">and the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02477">them unto Halah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02249">and Habor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02024">and Hara</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">and to the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H01470">Gozan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen384" osisID="1Chr.5"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01648">Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06955">Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04847">and Merari</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gershon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Gershom</rdg></note>

And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">according to their fathers</w>.
