verses.name: I Chronicles 6:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of Samuel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02059">Vashni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H029">and Abiah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Vashni</catchWord>: called also <rdg type="x-identity">Joel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04249">Mahli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03845">Libni</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05798">Uzza</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:31
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">over the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of song</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">after that the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04494">had rest</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">And they ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">place of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">with singing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">until Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">on their office</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to their order</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:33
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with their children</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01968">Heman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">a singer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03100">of Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of Shemuel</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>waited</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">of Elkanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0447">of Eliel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08430">of Toah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06689">of Zuph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">of Elkanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04287">of Mahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06022">of Amasai</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">of Elkanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03100">of Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06846">of Zephaniah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08480">of Tahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0617">of Assir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H043">of Ebiasaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03324">of Izhar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">Asaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on his right hand</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0623">Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01296">of Berachiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08092">of Shimea</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04317">of Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01202">of Baaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">of Malchiah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0867">of Ethni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05718">of Adaiah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0387">of Ethan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02155">of Zimmah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">of Shimei</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03189">of Jahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">of Gershom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <transChange type="added">stood</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0387">Ethan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07029">of Kishi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05660">of Abdi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04409">of Malluch</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Kishi</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Kushaiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02811">of Hashabiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">of Amaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0557">of Amzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01137">of Bani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08106">of Shamer</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04249">of Mahli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04187">of Mushi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">Their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">also the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">unto all manner of service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:49
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0175">But Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and on the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">of incense</w>, <transChange type="added">and were appointed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for all the work</w> of the <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">according to all that Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:50
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06372">Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H050">Abishua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01231">Bukki</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05813">Uzzi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02228">Zerahiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04812">Meraioth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0568">Amariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0285">Ahitub</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0290">Ahimaaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:54
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04186">their dwelling places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02918">throughout their castles</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in their coasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01486">for theirs was the lot</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">them Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04054">and the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">thereof round about</w> it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">But the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">and the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03612">to Caleb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03312">of Jephunneh</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And to the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> of Judah, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>, <transChange type="added">the city</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03841">and Libnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03492">and Jattir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0851">and Eshtemoa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02432">And Hilen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01688">Debir</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Hilen</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Holon</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06228">And Ashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01053">and Beth–shemesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Ashan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ain</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01387">Geba</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05964">and Alemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06068">and Anathoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05892">All their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">throughout their families</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Alemeth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Almon</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of that tribe</w>, <transChange type="added">were cities given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">out of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <transChange type="added">out of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04276">the half</w> <transChange type="added">tribe</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And to the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">of Gershom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">throughout their families</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <transChange type="added">were given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">throughout their families</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">to the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with their suburbs</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08095">of Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04294">and out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which are called</w> by <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">names</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:66
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">the residue</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">had cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of their coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:67
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> unto them, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04733">of refuge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>; <transChange type="added">they gave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01507">also Gezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:68
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03361">And Jokmeam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01032">and Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:69
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0357">And Aijalon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01667">and Gath–rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:70
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04276">And out of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06063">Aner</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01109">and Bileam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">for the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:71
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Unto the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">of Gershom</w> <transChange type="added">were given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">out of the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01474">Golan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">in Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06252">and Ashtaroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:72
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06943">Kedesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01705">Daberath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:73
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07216">And Ramoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06046">and Anem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:74
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04913">Mashal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05658">and Abdon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:75
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02712">And Hukok</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07340">and Rehob</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:76
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06943">Kedesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01551">in Galilee</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02540">and Hammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07156">and Kirjathaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:77
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Unto the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <transChange type="added">were given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07417">Rimmon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08396">Tabor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:78
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05676">And on the other side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">by Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">on the east side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <transChange type="added">were given them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04294">out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07205">of Reuben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01221">Bezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03096">and Jahzah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:79
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06932">Kedemoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">also with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04158">and Mephaath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:80
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04294">And out of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07216">Ramoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04266">and Mahanaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:81
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02809">And Heshbon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03270">and Jazer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">with her suburbs</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen385" osisID="1Chr.6"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08439">Tola</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06312">and Puah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03437">Jashub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08110">and Shimron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08439">of Tola</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05813">Uzzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07509">and Rephaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03400">and Jeriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03181">and Jahmai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03005">and Jibsam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Shemuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08439">of Tola</w>: <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">valiant men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of might</w> <w lemma="strong:H08435">in their generations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04557">whose number</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05813">of Uzzi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03156">Izrahiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03156">of Izrahiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04317">Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05662">and Obadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03100">and Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03449">Ishiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">all of them chief men</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08435">And with them, by their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">after the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01416">bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of soldiers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for they had many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and sons</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">among all the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">men of might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">reckoned in all by their genealogies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">The sons</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01106">Bela</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01071">and Becher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03043">and Jediael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01106">of Bela</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0675">Ezbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05813">and Uzzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05816">and Uzziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">and Jerimoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05901">and Iri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">men of valour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and were reckoned by their genealogies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01071">of Becher</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02160">Zemira</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03135">and Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0461">and Eliezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0454">and Elioenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06018">and Omri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">and Jerimoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H029">and Abiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06068">and Anathoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05964">and Alameth</w>. All these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01071">of Becher</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">And the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08435">of them, after their genealogy by their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03043">also of Jediael</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01092">Bilhan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01092">of Bilhan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03274">Jeush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0164">and Ehud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03668">and Chenaanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02133">and Zethan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08659">and Tharshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0300">and Ahishahar</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">All these the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03043">of Jediael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">by the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">men of valour</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07651">seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w> <transChange type="added">soldiers</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fit to go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for war</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">battle</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08206">Shuppim</w> <w lemma="strong:H02650">also, and Huppim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05893">of Ir</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02366">Hushim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0313">of Aher</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ir</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Iri</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Aher</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ahiram</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03185">Jahziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01476">and Guni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03337">and Jezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07967">and Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01090">of Bilhah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0844">Ashriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom she bare</w>: (<transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06370">his concubine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0761">the Aramitess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04353">And Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w> <transChange type="added">the sister</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02650">of Huppim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08206">and Shuppim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">whose sister’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06765">Zelophehad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06765">and Zelophehad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">had daughters</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04601">And Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06570">Peresh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08329">Sheresh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0198">Ulam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07552">and Rakem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0198">of Ulam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0917">Bedan</w>. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04353">of Machir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0269">And his sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H04447">Hammoleketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0379">Ishod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H044">and Abiezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04244">and Mahalah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08061">of Shemida</w> <w lemma="strong:H0291">were, Ahian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07928">and Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03949">and Likhi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0593">and Aniam</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07803">Shuthelah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01260">and Bered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08480">and Tahath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0497">and Eladah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08480">and Tahath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02066">And Zabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07803">and Shuthelah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05827">and Ezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0496">and Elead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">whom the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">born</w> in <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">their cattle</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0669">And Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to comfort</w> him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she conceived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01283">Beriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">because it went evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with his house</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:24
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H01323">And his daughter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07609">Sherah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">the nether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">and the upper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0242">and Uzzen–sherah</w>.)

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07506">And Rephah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07566">also Resheph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08520">and Telah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08465">and Tahan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03936">Laadan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05989">Ammihud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0476">Elishama</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05126">Non</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03091">Jehoshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Non</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Nun</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoshua</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Joshua</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0272">And their possessions</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">and habitations</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01008">Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">thereof, and eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05295">Naaran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04628">and westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">Gezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">thereof; Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">also and the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H05804">thereof, unto Gaza</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and the towns</w> thereof:<note type="study"><catchWord>towns</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>unto Gaza</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Adassa</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And by the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01052">Beth–shean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08590">Taanach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04023">Megiddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01756">Dor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">In these dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>towns</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">daughters</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03232">Imnah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03438">and Isuah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03440">and Ishuai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01283">and Beriah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08294">and Serah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01283">of Beriah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02268">Heber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04439">and Malchiel</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01269">of Birzavith</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02268">And Heber</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03310">Japhlet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07763">and Shomer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02369">and Hotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07774">and Shua</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">their sister</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03310">of Japhlet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06457">Pasach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01118">and Bimhal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06220">and Ashvath</w>. These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03310">of Japhlet</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08106">of Shamer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0277">Ahi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07303">and Rohgah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03160">Jehubbah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">and Aram</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01987">Helem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06690">Zophah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03234">and Imna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08028">and Shelesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06000">and Amal</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06690">of Zophah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05477">Suah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02774">and Harnepher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07777">and Shual</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01275">and Beri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03236">and Imrah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01221">Bezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01936">and Hod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08037">and Shamma</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08030">and Shilshah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03506">and Ithran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0878">and Beera</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03500">of Jether</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03312">Jephunneh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06462">and Pispah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0690">and Ara</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05925">of Ulla</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0733">Arah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02592">and Haniel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07525">and Rezia</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:40
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">choice</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05387">of the princes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04557">And the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">throughout the genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of them that were apt to the war</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen386" osisID="1Chr.7"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01144">Now Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01106">Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0788">Ashbel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0315">and Aharah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05119">Nohah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07498">and Rapha</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01106">of Bela</w> <w lemma="strong:H0146">were, Addar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01617">and Gera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H031">and Abihud</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Addar</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ard</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H050">And Abishua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05283">and Naaman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0265">and Ahoah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01617">And Gera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08197">and Shephuphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02361">and Huram</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shephuphan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shupham</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:6
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0261">of Ehud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07218">these are the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">of Geba</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04506">them to Manahath</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05283">And Naaman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0281">and Ahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01617">and Gera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05798">Uzza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0284">and Ahihud</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07842">And Shaharaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <transChange type="added">children</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04480">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he had sent them away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02366">Hushim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01199">and Baara</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wives</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02321">of Hodesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03103">Jobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06644">and Zibia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04331">and Mesha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04445">and Malcham</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03263">And Jeuz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07634">and Shachia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04821">and Mirma</w>. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02366">And of Hushim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H036">Abitub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0508">and Elpaal</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0508">of Elpaal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05677">Eber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04936">and Misham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08106">and Shamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who built</w> <w lemma="strong:H0207">Ono</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03850">and Lod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the towns</w> thereof:

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01283">Beriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08087">also, and Shema</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">who</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0357">of Aijalon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who drove away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0283">And Ahio</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08349">Shashak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">and Jeremoth</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02069">And Zebadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06166">and Arad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05738">and Ader</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04317">And Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03472">and Ispah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03109">and Joha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01283">of Beriah</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02069">And Zebadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04918">and Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02395">and Hezeki</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02268">and Heber</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03461">Ishmerai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03152">also, and Jezliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03103">and Jobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0508">of Elpaal</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03356">And Jakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02147">and Zichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02067">and Zabdi</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0462">And Elienai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06769">and Zilthai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0447">and Eliel</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05718">And Adaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01256">and Beraiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08119">and Shimrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">of Shimhi</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Shimhi</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shema</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03473">And Ishpan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05677">and Heber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0447">and Eliel</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05658">And Abdon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02147">and Zichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02605">and Hanan</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02608">And Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05867">and Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06070">and Antothijah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03301">And Iphedeiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06439">and Penuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08349">of Shashak</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08125">And Shamsherai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07841">and Shehariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06271">and Athaliah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03298">And Jaresiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">and Eliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02147">and Zichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:28
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">by their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">These dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01391">And at Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H025 strong:H01391" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Gibeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0802">whose wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>father…</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Jehiel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">And his firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05658">Abdon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06698">and Zur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07027">and Kish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01168">and Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05070">and Nadab</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01446">And Gedor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0283">and Ahio</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02144">and Zacher</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zacher</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zechariah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04732">And Mikloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08039">Shimeah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0637">And these also</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05048">over against them</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shimeah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shimeam</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05369">And Ner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">Kish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07027">and Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04444">and Malchi–shua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H041">and Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0792">and Esh–baal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abinadab</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ishui</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Esh–baal</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ish–bosheth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04807">Merib–baal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04807">and Merib–baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">Micah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Merib–baal</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Mephibosheth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06377">Pithon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04429">and Melech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08390">and Tarea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0271">and Ahaz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Tarea</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Tahrea</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">And Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03085">Jehoadah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03085">and Jehoadah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05964">Alemeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05820">and Azmaveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02174">and Zimri</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02174">and Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04162">Moza</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoadah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jarah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04162">And Moza</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01150">Binea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07498">Rapha</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0501">Eleasah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0682">Azel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Rapha</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Rephaiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0682">And Azel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">had six</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose names</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05840">these, Azrikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01074">Bocheru</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">and Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08187">and Sheariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05662">and Obadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02605">and Hanan</w>. All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0682">of Azel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06232">of Eshek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0198">Ulam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">his firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03266">Jehush</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0467">and Eliphelet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0198">of Ulam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">were mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198 strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">archers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and had many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>. All these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen387" osisID="1Chr.8"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">So all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were reckoned by genealogies</w>; and, behold, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">were carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">for their transgression</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07223">Now the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">inhabitants</w> that <transChange type="added">dwelt</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">in their possessions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">the Israelites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05411">and the Nethinims</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">And in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05793">Uthai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05989">of Ammihud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0566">of Imri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01137">of Bani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Pharez</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07888">And of the Shilonites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06222">Asaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">of Zerah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03262">Jeuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">and ninety</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05543">Sallu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">of Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01938">of Hodaviah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05574">of Hasenuah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02997">And Ibneiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0425">and Elah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05813">of Uzzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04381">of Michri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04918">and Meshullam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08203">of Shephathiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07467">of Reuel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02998">of Ibnijah</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">according to their generations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0582">All these men</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">And of the priests</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03048">Jedaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03080">and Jehoiarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03199">and Jachin</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">of Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04812">of Meraioth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Azariah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Seraiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05718">And Adaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06583">of Pashur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">of Malchijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04640">and Maasiai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05717">of Adiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03170">of Jahzerah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">of Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04921">of Meshillemith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0564">of Immer</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02428">very able</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mighty men of valour</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And of the Levites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02815">of Hasshub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05840">of Azrikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02811">of Hashabiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01230">And Bakbakkar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02792">Heresh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01559">and Galal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04983">and Mattaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04316">of Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02147">of Zichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05662">And Obadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01559">of Galal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03038">of Jeduthun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01296">and Berechiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">of Elkanah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H05200">of the Netophathites</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07778">And the porters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06126">and Akkub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02929">and Talmon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0289">and Ahiman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and their brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:18
verses.text: Who hitherto <transChange type="added">waited</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>: they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07778">porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the companies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07967">And Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06981">of Kore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H043">of Ebiasaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07145">the Korahites</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">over the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and their fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04264">over the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">of the entry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gates</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thresholds</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06372">And Phinehas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">was the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">over them in time past</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04920">of Meshelemiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07778">porter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:22
verses.text: All these <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">to be porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">in the gates</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">These were reckoned by their genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in their villages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the seer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">did ordain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">in their set office</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>did…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">founded</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trust</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">So they and their children</w> <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the oversight of the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">by wards</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">In four</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">quarters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">were the porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and south</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in their villages</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">after seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">from time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">to time</w> with them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">For these Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">porters</w>, were in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">set office</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">and were over the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">and treasuries</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trust</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>chambers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">storehouses</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">because the charge</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04668">upon them, and the opening</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">thereof every morning</w> <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> to them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:28
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05921">of them had the charge of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">the ministering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they should bring them in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557 strong:H04557">by tale</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bring them in by tale, and carry them out by tale</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Some</transChange> of them also <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">to oversee the vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05560">and the fine flour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03828">and the frankincense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and the spices</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>instruments</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">vessels</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:30
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04842">the ointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">of the spices</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04993">And Mattithiah</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H07145">the Korahite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0530">had the set office</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">over the things that were made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02281">in the pans</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trust</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on flat plates</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">slices</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:32
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04635 strong:H03899">over the shewbread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to prepare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">every sabbath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shewbread</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bread of ordering</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:33
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">who remaining</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03957">in the chambers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06359 strong:H06362" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8803">free</w>: for they were employed in <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon them</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">These chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08435">throughout their generations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">these dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01391">And in Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H025 strong:H01391" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03273">Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">whose wife’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">And his firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05658">Abdon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06698">then Zur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07027">and Kish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01168">and Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05369">and Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05070">and Nadab</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01446">And Gedor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0283">and Ahio</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04732">and Mikloth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04732">And Mikloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08043">Shimeam</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they also dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">over against their brethren</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05369">And Ner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">Kish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07027">and Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04444">and Malchi–shua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H041">and Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0792">and Esh–baal</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03083">of Jonathan</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04807">Merib–baal</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04810">and Merib–baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">Micah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06377">Pithon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04429">and Melech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08475">and Tahrea</w>, <transChange type="added">and Ahaz</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">And Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03294">Jarah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03294">and Jarah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05964">Alemeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05820">and Azmaveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02174">and Zimri</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02174">and Zimri</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04162">Moza</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:43
