verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04162">And Moza</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01150">Binea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07509">and Rephaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0501">Eleasah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0682">Azel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0682">And Azel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">had six</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose names</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05840">these, Azrikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01074">Bocheru</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">and Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08187">and Sheariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05662">and Obadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02605">and Hanan</w>: these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0682">of Azel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen388" osisID="1Chr.9"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">Now the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">Gilboa</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wounded</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">followed hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H041">and Abinadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04444">and Malchi–shua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abinadab</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ishui</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">against Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198 strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and the archers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and he was wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the archers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and the archers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and the shooters with bows</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hit</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to his armourbearer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Draw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thy sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01856" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and thrust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06189">me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and abuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me. But his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">not; for he was sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">afraid</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07586">So Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">a sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> upon it.<note type="study"><catchWord>abuse me</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mock me</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And when his armourbearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">likewise on the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07586">So Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and his three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and all his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">And when all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and that Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> in them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04283">And it came to pass on the morrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to strip</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">the slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01533">Gilboa</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And when they had stripped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and his armour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to carry tidings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">unto their idols</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to the people</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">his armour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H01712">of Dagon</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H03003">And when all Jabesh–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">all that the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">all the valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01480">the body</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01480">and the bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">them to Jabesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">their bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0424">under the oak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03003">in Jabesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07586">So Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">for his transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">against the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not, and also for asking</w> <transChange type="added">counsel</transChange> of <transChange type="added">one that had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0178">a familiar spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>;<note type="study"><catchWord>committed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">transgressed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04410">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jesse</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Isai</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen389" osisID="1Chr.10"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Then all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">themselves to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">unto Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, Behold, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">thy bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and thy flesh</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08543">And moreover in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08032">past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">even when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was king</w>, thou <transChange type="added">wast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that leddest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and broughtest in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, Thou shalt feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">and thou shalt be ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01571">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in time…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">both yesterday and the third day</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>feed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rule</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">to Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">with them in Hebron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">Samuel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02982">Jebus</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02983">where the Jebusites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02982">of Jebus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">hither. Nevertheless David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">the castle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Whosoever smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">shall be chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captain</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-238">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-238">up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and was chief</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">head</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04679">in the castle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">it the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Zion</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04407">even from Millo</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03097">and Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07605">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>repaired</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">revived</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and greater</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>waxed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went in going and increasing</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These also <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">had, who strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">themselves with him in his kingdom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make him king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">concerning Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strengthened…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">held strongly with him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:11
verses.text: And this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03434">had; Jashobeam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02453">an Hachmonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970 strong:H07991" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of the captains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">his spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">against three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <transChange type="added">by him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">at one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an Hachmonite</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">son of Hachmoni</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01734">of Dodo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0266">the Ahohite</w>, who <transChange type="added">was one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">of the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighties</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">He was with David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06450">at Pas–dammim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and there the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02513">where was a parcel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Pas–dammim</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ephes–dammim</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">themselves in the midst</w> of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02513">parcel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">saved</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">by a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">deliverance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stood</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>deliverance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">salvation</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969">Now three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">to the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04631">into the cave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05725">of Adullam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04264">and the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of Rephaim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>three…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">three captains over the thirty</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04686">then in the hold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and the Philistines’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">garrison</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01035">then at Beth–lehem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">longed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Oh that one would give me drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">of the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w>!

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brake through</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07579" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of the well</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">of Beth–lehem</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">but David</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not drink</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it, but poured it out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:19

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:17

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there fell</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">against Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05633">them not: for the lords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">upon advisement</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him away, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to his master</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> to <transChange type="added">the jeopardy of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">our heads</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">on our heads</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:21

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:22

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:40

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:1

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:3

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they would do so</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">for the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-239">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-239">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07883">from Shihor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even unto the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hemath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">from Kirjath–jearim</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01173">to Baalah</w>, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07157">to Kirjath–jearim</w>, which <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">thence the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelleth</w> <transChange type="added">between</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is called</w> <transChange type="added">on it</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">in a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">cart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H041">of Abinadab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05798">and Uzza</w> <w lemma="strong:H0283">and Ahio</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">drave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">the cart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>carried…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made the ark to ride</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">played</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> with all <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">and with singing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">and with harps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">and with psalteries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08596">and with timbrels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04700">and with cymbals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02689">and with trumpets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>singing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">songs</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">unto the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03592">of Chidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05798">Uzza</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01241">for the oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stumbled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Chidon</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Nachon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>stumbled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shook it</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">And the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05798">against Uzza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, because he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">to the ark</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was displeased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">a breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05798">upon Uzza</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04725">wherefore that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06560">Perez–uzza</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Perez–uzza</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">The breach of Uzza</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01963">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall I bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">home</transChange> to me?

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">not the ark</w> <transChange type="added">home</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to himself to the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but carried it aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">removed</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0727">And the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remained</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with the family</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w>, and all that he had. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen392" osisID="1Chr.13"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02361 strong:H02438" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">Now Hiram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07023">with masons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">and carpenters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had confirmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">for his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">because of his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">more wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">more sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>more</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yet</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:4
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the names</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">which he had in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08051">Shammua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07727">and Shobab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02984">And Ibhar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0474">and Elishua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0467">and Elpalet</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05052">And Nogah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05298">and Nepheg</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03309">and Japhia</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0476">And Elishama</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01182">and Beeliada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0467">and Eliphalet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Beeliada</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Eliada</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06430">And when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">all the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against</w> them.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">themselves in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of Rephaim</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall I go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">against the Philistines</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wilt thou deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into mine hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Go up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into thine hand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01188">to Baal–perazim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">them there. Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath broken in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">like the breaking forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of that place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01188">Baal–perazim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Baal–perazim</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">A place of breaches</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they had left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">there, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave a commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they were burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">And the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spread themselves abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Therefore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enquired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">again of God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, Go not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">them; turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from them, and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">upon them over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01057">the mulberry trees</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it shall be, when thou shalt hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06807">of going</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H01057">of the mulberry trees</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then thou shalt go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee to smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">as God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">from Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">even to Gazer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gibeon</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Geba</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">And the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into all lands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of him upon all nations</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen393" osisID="1Chr.14"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:1
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">David</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">for it a tent</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">None ought to carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">but the Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for them hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">unto him for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>None…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">It is not to carry the ark of God, but for the Levites</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-240">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-240">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he had prepared</w> for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0222">Uriel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>brethren</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kinsmen</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06222">Asaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">of Gershom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03100">Joel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0469">of Elizaphan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0447">Eliel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05816">of Uzziel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05992">Amminadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">for Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and for the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0222">for Uriel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06222">Asaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03100">and Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0447">and Eliel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05992">and Amminadab</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> unto them, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">sanctify</w> yourselves, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">ye and your brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that ye may bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> unto <transChange type="added">the place that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have prepared</w> for it.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:13
verses.text: For because ye <transChange type="added">did it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">not at the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made a breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon us, for that we sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">him not after the due order</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">So the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">themselves to bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">upon their shoulders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04133">with the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">thereon, as Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">to the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harps</w> <w lemma="strong:H04700">and cymbals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">sounding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by lifting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">So the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01968">Heman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03100">of Joel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">and of his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0623">Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01296">of Berechiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0387">Ethan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06984">of Kushaiah</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And with them their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">of the second</w> <transChange type="added">degree</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01122">Ben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03268">and Jaaziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08070">and Shemiramoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06042">and Unni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0446">Eliab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">and Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04993">and Mattithiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0466">and Elipheleh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04737">and Mikneiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05654">and Obed–edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03273">and Jeiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">the porters</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">So the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01968">Heman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0623">Asaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0387">and Ethan</w>, <transChange type="added">were appointed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04700">with cymbals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02148">And Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05815">and Aziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08070">and Shemiramoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06042">and Unni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0446">and Eliab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">and Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">with psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05961">on Alamoth</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04993">And Mattithiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0466">and Elipheleh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04737">and Mikneiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05654">and Obed–edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03273">and Jeiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05812">and Azaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">with harps</w> <w lemma="strong:H08067">on the Sheminith</w> <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to excel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>on the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on the eighth to oversee</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03663">And Chenaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04853">for song</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03256">he instructed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">about the song</w>, because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">skilful</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">was for the carriage: he instructed about the carriage</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>song</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifting up</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01296">And Berechiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0511">and Elkanah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07778">doorkeepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07645">And Shebaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03146">and Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05417">and Nethaneel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06022">and Amasai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0461">and Eliezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02690 strong:H02690" morph="strongMorph:TH8764 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8688">did blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05654">and Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03174">and Jehiah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07778">doorkeepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And it came to pass, when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03736" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">with a robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0948">of fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and all the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03663">and Chenaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the master</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">of the song</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">with the singers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> also <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0646">upon him an ephod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0906">of linen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>song</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">carriage</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Thus all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with shouting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and with sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the cornet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02689">and with trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04700">and with cymbals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">making a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">with psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harps</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04324">that Michal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">looking out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02474">at a window</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">dancing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and playing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">him in her heart</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen394" osisID="1Chr.15"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">it in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for it: and they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and the peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">both man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a loaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0829">and a good piece of flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0809">and a flagon</w> <transChange type="added">of wine</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he appointed</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to record</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to thank</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0623">Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04932">and next</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">to him Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03273">Jeiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08070">and Shemiramoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04993">and Mattithiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0446">and Eliab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05654">and Obed–edom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03273">and Jeiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627 strong:H05035">with psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and with harps</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0623">but Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">made a sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H04700">with cymbals</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>with psalteries…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with instruments of psalteries and harps</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03166">also and Jahaziel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Then on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">first</w> <transChange type="added">this psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to thank</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">his deeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto him, sing psalms</w> <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ye of all his wondrous</w> works.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">ye in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">let the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">and his strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his marvellous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">works that he hath done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04159">his wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">O ye seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0972">his chosen ones</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:14
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">his judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be ye mindful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">always</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of his covenant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">to a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even of the covenant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">with Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07621">and of his oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03327">unto Isaac</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And hath confirmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">the same to Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">for a law</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Unto thee will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02256">the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of your inheritance</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>the lot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the cord</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04962 strong:H04557">When ye were but few</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">even a few</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and strangers</w> in it.<note type="study"><catchWord>few, even</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of number</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:20
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">from nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">to nation</w>, and from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do them wrong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yea, he reproved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> for their sakes,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">not mine anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and do my prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no harm</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">his salvation</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his marvellous works</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all nations</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">For great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">to be praised</w>: he also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to be feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">above all gods</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For all the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0457">idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01935">Glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and honour</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his presence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H02304">and gladness</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in his place</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">ye kindreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">and strength</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <transChange type="added">due</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto his name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">him: worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01927">in the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holiness</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him, all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also shall be stable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it be not moved</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Let the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>: and let <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">Let the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and the fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">thereof: let the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> therein.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">Then shall the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sing out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">ye, Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">us, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of our salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and gather us together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">us from the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that we may give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">to thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">in thy praise</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:37
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he left</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">there before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as every day’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">required</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05654">And Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05654">Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">also the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03038">of Jeduthun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02621">and Hosah</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07778">porters</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">And Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high place</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">at Gibeon</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">and evening</w>, and <transChange type="added">to do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">according to all that is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>morning…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the morning, and in the evening</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01968">And with them Heman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03038">and Jeduthun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07605">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that were chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">who were expressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">because his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01968">And with them Heman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03038">and Jeduthun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H04700">and cymbals</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for those that should make a sound</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">and with musical</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03038">of Jeduthun</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">porters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>porters</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the gate</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen395" osisID="1Chr.16"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:1
