verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Now it came to pass, as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">to Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Lo, I dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">but the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">remaineth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03407">under curtains</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05416">Then Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Do</w> all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915">And it came to pass the same night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">came to Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell in</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have not dwelt in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0168">but have gone from tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to tent</w>, and from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">tabernacle</w> <transChange type="added">to another</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have gone</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">have been</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">Wheresoever I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">I a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to any</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why have ye not built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">of cedars</w>?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">thee from the sheepcote</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">that thou shouldest be ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>from following</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, and have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee a name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">like the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">of the great men</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Also I will ordain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and will plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and they shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in their place, and shall be moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">no more; neither shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">of wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them any more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">as at the beginning</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And since the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judges</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Moreover I will subdue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all thine enemies</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Furthermore I tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee an house</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And it shall come to pass, when thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be expired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou must go</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">with thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I will raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thee, which shall be of thy sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">his kingdom</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">and I will stablish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">I will be his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and he shall be my son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-241">and I will not take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">my mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-241">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from him, as I took</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> from <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">that was before</w> thee:

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But I will settle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him in mine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">and in my kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03678">and his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">evermore</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">According to all these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02377">and according to all this vision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">so did Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">I, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">me hitherto</w>?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06994" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">this was a small thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>; for thou hast <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">for a great while to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast regarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08448">me according to the estate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of high degree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-242">What can</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <transChange type="added">speak</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-242">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">to thee for the honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servant’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">sake, and according to thine own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">all this greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in making known</w> all <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01420">great things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">greatnesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> none like thee, neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, according to all that we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with our ears</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">And what one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">like thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to redeem</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his own people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee a name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">of greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terribleness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">by driving out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou hast redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">For thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">didst thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thine own people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">becamest their God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore now, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">let the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">concerning thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and concerning his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou hast said</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Let it even be established</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>: and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For thou, O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast told</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou wilt build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">therefore thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath found</w> <transChange type="added">in his heart</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>hast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hast revealed the ear of thy servant</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And now, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou art God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hast promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">this goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Now therefore let it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">that it may be before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for thou blessest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it hath pleased thee</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen396" osisID="1Chr.17"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now after this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">it came to pass, that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">Gath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and her towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04124">and the Moabites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">became David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">gifts</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">Hadarezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">unto Hamath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to stablish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">by the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">Euphrates</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hadarezer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hadadezer</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">from him a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273 strong:H0376">footmen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06131" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also houghed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">all the chariot</w> <transChange type="added">horses</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but reserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of them an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seven…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">seven hundred</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">And when the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">Hadarezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Damascus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Darmesek</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <transChange type="added">garrisons</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01834 strong:H0758">in Syria–damascus</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0758">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">became David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">gifts</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">Thus the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whithersoever he went</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07982">the shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that were on the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">of Hadarezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">them to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02880">Likewise from Tibhath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03560">and from Chun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">of Hadarezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">wherewith Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">and the pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Tibhath…</catchWord>: called in the book of Samuel <rdg type="x-identity">Betah, and Berothai</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08583">Now when Tou</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">how David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">of Hadarezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06678">of Zobah</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Tou</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Toi</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01913">Hadoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of his welfare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to congratulate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him, because he had fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">against Hadarezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">him; (for Hadarezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421 strong:H0376">had war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08583">with Tou</w>;) and <transChange type="added">with him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all manner of vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hadoram</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Joram</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to enquire…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to salute</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to congratulate</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to bless</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>had war</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was the man of wars</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Them also king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dedicated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">with the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he brought</w> from all <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0123">from Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">and from Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and from the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and from the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06002">and from Amalek</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H052">Moreover Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abishai</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Abshai</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">garrisons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">in Edom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0123">and all the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">became David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">Thus the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whithersoever he went</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all his people</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">over the host</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0286">of Ahilud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">recorder</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>recorder</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">remembrancer</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06659">And Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H040">and Abimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">of Abiathar</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07798">and Shavsha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was scribe</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Abimelech</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ahimelech</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shavsha</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Seraiah or Shisha</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">And Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03774">over the Cherethites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06432">and the Pelethites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>about…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the hand of the king</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen397" osisID="1Chr.18"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now it came to pass after this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05176">that Nahash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02586">unto Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05176">of Nahash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">because his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to me. And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him concerning his father</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05650">So the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02586">to Hanun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to comfort</w> him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">But the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02586">to Hanun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">Thinkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">thou that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">doth honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">comforters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thee? are not his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee for to search</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to overthrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to spy out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Thinkest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">In thine eyes doth David</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02586">Wherefore Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01548" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04063">their garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04667">hard by their buttocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sent them away</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then there went</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">how the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were served. And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">them: for the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">were greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ashamed</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">at Jericho</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">until your beards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">be grown</w>, and <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">return</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">that they had made themselves odious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02586">Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">them chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0763">out of Mesopotamia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04601 strong:H0758">and out of Syria–maachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06678">and out of Zobah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>odious</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to stink</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">of Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04311">Medeba</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and put the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">before the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that were come</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">by themselves in the field</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">Now when Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">that the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">was set against him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">and behind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he chose out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of all the choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, and put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the battle…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of the battle was</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>choice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">young men</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">of Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, and they set <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abishai</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Abshai</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0758">If the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be too strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">for me, then thou shalt help</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me: but if the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be too strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thee, then I will help</w> thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be of good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and let us behave ourselves valiantly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for our people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and for the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and let the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">So Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him drew nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">unto the battle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">that the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were fled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they likewise fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H052">Abishai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">into the city</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">Then Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0758">And when the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they were put to the worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and drew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07780">and Shophach</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">of Hadarezer</w> <transChange type="added">went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>river</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Euphrates</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shophach</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shobach</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">And it was told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and passed over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> upon them, and set <transChange type="added">the battle</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">against them. So when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">had put the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they fought</w> with him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0758">But the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">men which fought in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07273 strong:H0376">footmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07780">Shophach</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And when the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01928">of Hadarezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they were put to the worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they made peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and became his servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither would</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">help</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> any more. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen398" osisID="1Chr.19"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And it came to pass, that after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08666">was expired</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">at the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">go out</w> <transChange type="added">to battle</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">led forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and wasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and besieged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">Rabbah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">But David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07237">Rabbah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and destroyed</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the return of the year</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of their king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from off his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">it to weigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, and <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">in it; and it was set upon David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">also exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to weigh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the weight of</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07787" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in it, and cut</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04050">with saws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02757">and with harrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04050">and with axes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Even so dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">with all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after this</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that there arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01507">at Gezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">with the Philistines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0227">at which time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05444">Sibbechai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02843">the Hushathite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05598">Sippai</w>, <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03211">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they were subdued</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>arose</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">continued</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Gezer</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Gob</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Sippai</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Saph</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the giant</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Rapha</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">again with the Philistines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0445">and Elhanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03265">of Jair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03902">Lahmi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01555">of Goliath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01663">the Gittite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02595">whose spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">staff</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0707" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a weaver’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04500">beam</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jair</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jaare–oregim</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And yet again there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">at Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">where was a man</w> of <transChange type="added">great</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04060">stature</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0676">whose fingers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">and toes</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <transChange type="added">on each hand</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <transChange type="added">on each foot</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and he also was the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">of the giant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">measure</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the son…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">born to the giant</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Rapha</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But when he defied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08092">of Shimea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>defied</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reproached</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shimea</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Shammah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0411">These</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07497">unto the giant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">in Gath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen399" osisID="1Chr.20"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07854">And Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and to the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">from Beer–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">even to Dan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them to me, that I may know</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">make his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so many more</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">as they</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0113">but, my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">they not all my lord’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0113">why then doth my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">require</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>?

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Nevertheless the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">against Joab</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03097">Wherefore Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">throughout all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03097">And Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H04662">of the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>. And all <transChange type="added">they of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">were a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03878">But Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">he not among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them: for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">to Joab</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was displeased</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with this thing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And it was evil in the eyes of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> concerning this thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">but now, I beseech thee, do away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03966">for I have done very</w> <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">foolishly</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">unto Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">seer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">thee three</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">thee one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">of them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>offer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stretch out</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01410">So Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Choose</w> thee<note type="study"><catchWord>Choose…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Take to thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Either three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years’</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">famine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07969">or three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to be destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">thy foes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">while that the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">overtaketh</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0518">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">else three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">even the pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">and the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">destroying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">throughout all the coasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore advise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thyself what word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I shall bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that sent</w> me.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">unto Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">I am in a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">strait</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">now into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03966">for very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07356">his mercies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but let me not fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>very great</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">very many</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">it: and as he was destroying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">beheld</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him of the evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">to the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">It is enough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">now thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">by the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">of Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ornan</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Araunah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">between the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">having a drawn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">over Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w> <transChange type="added">of Israel</transChange>, <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">in sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon their faces</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> not I <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be numbered</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even I it is that have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and done evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">indeed</w>; but <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">these sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what have they done</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03027">let thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">I pray thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">be on me, and on my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">but not on thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04046">that they should be plagued</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04397">Then the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">of Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusite</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">at the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0771">And Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">and his four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">with him hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">themselves. Now Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01758" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was threshing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And Ornan…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">When Ornan turned back and saw the angel, then he and his four sons with him hid themselves</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">to Ornan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0771">Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">of the threshingfloor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">himself to David</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">to Ornan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">me the place</w> of <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01637">threshingfloor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">therein unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou shalt grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">it me for the full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">price</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04046">that the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be stayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Grant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Give</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0771">And Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to thee, and let my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I give</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">the oxen</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04173">and the threshing instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">for wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02406">and the wheat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">for the meat offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I give</w> it all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">to Ornan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Nay; but I will verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">it for the full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">price</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will not take</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thine for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">nor offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cost</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">to Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">for the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">there an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">him from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">by fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the angel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-243">and he put up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-243">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05084">into the sheath</w> thereof.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">him in the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">of Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then he sacrificed</w> there.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04908">For the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that season</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">at Gibeon</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 21:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">But David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">it to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">of the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen400" osisID="1Chr.21"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to gather together</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">the strangers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">masons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01496">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04548">for the nails</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">for the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04226">and for the joinings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">without weight</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0730">Also cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557 strong:H0369">in abundance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06722">for the Zidonians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06876">and they of Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H07390">and tender</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">must be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">magnifical</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">of fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and of glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all countries</w>: I will <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">now make preparation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">for it. So David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">abundantly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">his death</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">for Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">as for me, it was in my mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:8
