verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came to me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">abundantly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">wars</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hast shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in my sight</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Behold, a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall be born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to thee, who shall be a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">of rest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will give him rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from all his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">for his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">shall be Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H08253">and quietness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in his days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Solomon</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Peaceable</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and he shall be my son</w>, and I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now, my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">be with thee; and prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou, and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as he hath said</w> of thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Only the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">thee wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">and understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and give thee charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">concerning Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then shalt thou prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou takest heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">with concerning Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of good courage</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dread</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, nor be dismayed</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06040">Now, behold, in my trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05178">and of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">and iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">without weight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07230">for it is in abundance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">also and stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have I prepared</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou mayest add</w> thereto.<note type="study"><catchWord>trouble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">poverty</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:15
verses.text: Moreover <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">workmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">with thee in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">and workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">and timber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and all manner of cunning men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for every manner of work</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>workers…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">masons and carpenters</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">Of the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and the brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and the iron</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">no number</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be doing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> be with thee.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> with you? and hath he <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">given you rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into mine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and your soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">therefore, and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">ye the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that is to be built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen401" osisID="1Chr.22"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">So when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">he made Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">with the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">Now the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the age</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04557">and their number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">by their polls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">man by man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">was thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0428">Of which</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to set forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and judges</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oversee</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">Moreover four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07778">porters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I made</w>, <transChange type="added">said David</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to praise</w> <transChange type="added">therewith</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">them into courses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01648">Gershon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06955">Kohath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04847">and Merari</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>courses</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">divisions</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01649">Of the Gershonites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03936">Laadan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Laadan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Libni</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03936">of Laadan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03171">Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02241">and Zetham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03100">and Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">of Shimei</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08013 strong:H08019" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">Shelomith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02381">and Haziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02039">and Haran</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03936">of Laadan</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">of Shimei</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03189">Jahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02126">Zina</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03266">and Jeush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01283">and Beriah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0702">These four</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">of Shimei</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zina</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zizah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03189">And Jahath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">was the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02125">and Zizah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03266">but Jeush</w> <w lemma="strong:H01283">and Beriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had not many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0259">therefore they were in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">reckoning</w>, according to <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">did not multiply sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06955">of Kohath</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06019">Amram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03324">Izhar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05816">and Uzziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06019">of Amram</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">and Moses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was separated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he should sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">he and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto him, and to bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:14
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were named</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01647">Gershom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0461">and Eliezer</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">of Gershom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07619">Shebuel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shebuel</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shubael</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0461">of Eliezer</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07345">Rehabiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0461">And Eliezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">had none other</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">but the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07345">of Rehabiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">were very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">many</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the chief</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the first</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>very many</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">highly multiplied</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03324">of Izhar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08019">Shelomith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shelomith</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shelomoth</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">of Hebron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03404">Jeriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0568">Amariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03166">Jahaziel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03360">and Jekameam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05816">of Uzziel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04318">Michah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03449">and Jesiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04249">Mahli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04187">and Mushi</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04249">of Mahli</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07027">and Kish</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0499">And Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and had no sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">but daughters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">and their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">of Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>brethren</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kinsmen</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04187">of Mushi</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04249">Mahli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05740">and Eder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">and Jeremoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">after the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as they were counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">by number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01538">by their polls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">from the age</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">For David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath given rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and he dwelleth in Jerusalem</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And also unto the Levites</w>; they shall no <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">nor any vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of it for the service</w> thereof.

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0314">For by the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and above</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>numbered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">number</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04612">Because their office</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">on the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the courts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">and in the chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02893">and in the purifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of all holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their station was at the hand of the sons of Aaron</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04635 strong:H03899">Both for the shewbread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05560">and for the fine flour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">for meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04682">and for the unleavened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07550">cakes</w>, and for <transChange type="added">that which is baked in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04227">the pan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07246" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">and for that which is fried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04884">and for all manner of measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">and size</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>pan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">flat plate</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to thank</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and likewise at even</w>;

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">all burnt sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">in the sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">in the new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and on the set feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">by number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the order</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">commanded unto them, continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 23:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And that they should keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">in the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen402" osisID="1Chr.23"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:1
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">these are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04256">the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05070">Nadab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05070">But Nadab</w> <w lemma="strong:H030">and Abihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and had no children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0499">therefore Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">and Ithamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">executed the priest’s office</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">distributed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">them, both Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0288">and Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">of Ithamar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06486">according to their offices</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">in their service</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And there were more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">than of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">of Ithamar</w>; and <transChange type="added">thus</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were they divided</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">Among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">of Ithamar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus were they divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">by lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0428">one sort</w> <w lemma="strong:H0428">with another</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08269">for the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and governors</w> <transChange type="added">of the house</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">were of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">of Ithamar</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08098">And Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05417">of Nethaneel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06659">and Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0288">and Ahimelech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H054">of Abiathar</w>, and <transChange type="added">before</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">household</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">being taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">for Eleazar</w>, and <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">for Ithamar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>principal…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house of the father</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">Now the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03080">to Jehoiarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03048">to Jedaiah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">The third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02766">to Harim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08188">to Seorim</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02549">The fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">to Malchijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04326">to Mijamin</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">The seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06976">to Hakkoz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08066">the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">to Abijah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08671">The ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03442">to Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06224">the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07935">to Shecaniah</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">The eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">to Eliashib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03356">to Jakim</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">The thirteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02647">to Huppah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03428">to Jeshebeab</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">The fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01083">to Bilgah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">the sixteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0564">to Immer</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07651">The seventeenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02387">to Hezir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06483">to Aphses</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08672">The nineteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06611">to Pethahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">the twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03168">to Jehezekel</w>,

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04256">Concerning the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">of the porters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07145">Of the Korhites</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04920">Meshelemiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06981">of Kore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Meshelemiah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Shelemiah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Asaph</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ebiasaph</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04920">of Meshelemiah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03043">Jediael</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02069">Zebadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03496">Jathniel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05867">Elam</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03076">Jehohanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0454">Elioenai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Moreover the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03075">Jehozabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03098">Joah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07940">and Sacar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05417">and Nethaneel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05988">Ammiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">Issachar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06469">Peulthai</w> <w lemma="strong:H08066">the eighth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blessed</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>him</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Obed–edom</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08098">Also unto Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">were sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">born</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04474">that ruled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">throughout the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their father</w>: for they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06273">Othni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07501">and Rephael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05744">and Obed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0443">Elzabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">whose brethren</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0453">Elihu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05565">and Semachiah</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">All these of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">they and their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">for strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">of Obed–edom</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04920">And Meshelemiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">had sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02621">Also Hosah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">had sons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08113">Simri</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>, (for <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">he was not the firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">yet his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">him the chief</w>;)

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02882">Tebaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">the third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07243">the fourth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H02621">of Hosah</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">thirteen</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:12
verses.text: Among these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04256">the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">of the porters</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">among the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">men</w>, <transChange type="added">having</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04931">wards</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">one against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">as well the small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">as the great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">for every gate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as well…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as well for the small as for the great</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01486">And the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08018">to Shelemiah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02148">Then for Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07922">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsellor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01486">and his lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Shelemiah</catchWord>: also called <rdg type="x-identity">Meshelemiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05654">To Obed–edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and to his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0624">of Asuppim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Asuppim</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gatherings</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08206">To Shuppim</w> <w lemma="strong:H02621">and Hosah</w> <transChange type="added">the lot came forth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04628">westward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">with the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07996">Shallecheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04546">by the causeway</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the going up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04929">ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05980">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">ward</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04217">Eastward</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">northward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">southward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0624">and toward Asuppim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06503">At Parbar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04628">westward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">at the causeway</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06503">at Parbar</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:19
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04256">the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">of the porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07145">of Kore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03881">And of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0281">Ahijah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">over the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and over the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the dedicated things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dedicated…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holy things</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03936">of Laadan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">of the Gershonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03936">Laadan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03936">of Laadan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">the Gershonite</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03172">Jehieli</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Laadan</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Libni</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jehieli</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jehiel</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03172">of Jehieli</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02241">Zetham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03100">and Joel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">over the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06020">Of the Amramites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03325">the Izharites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02276">the Hebronites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05817">the Uzzielites</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07619">And Shebuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01647">of Gershom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">of the treasures</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0461">by Eliezer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07345">Rehabiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03470">and Jeshaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03141">and Joram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02147">and Zichri</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08013 strong:H08019" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and Shelomith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08013">Which Shelomith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">over all the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the dedicated things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">which David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had dedicated</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07998">Out of the spoils</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">won in battles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did they dedicate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spoils…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">battles and spoils</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08050">And all that Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the seer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07586">and Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">of Kish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H074">and Abner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05369">of Ner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">and Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had dedicated</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">whosoever had dedicated</w> <transChange type="added">any thing</transChange>, <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08019">of Shelomith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and of his brethren</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03325">Of the Izharites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03663">Chenaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">for the outward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">business</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and judges</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:30
verses.text: <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02276">of the Hebronites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02811">Hashabiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06486">officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">among them of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04628">westward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in all the business</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">and in the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">over the charge</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02276">Among the Hebronites</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03404">Jerijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02276">among the Hebronites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08435">according to the generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0705">In the fortieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they were sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">for, and there were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">among them mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03270">at Jazer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">of Gilead</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 26:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">made rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">over the Reubenites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01425">the Gadites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04520">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">for every matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">pertaining to God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and affairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>affairs</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thing</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen405" osisID="1Chr.26"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Now the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">after their number</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and their officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that served</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in any matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">of the courses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">by month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">throughout all the months</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">of every</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">Over the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">course</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">for the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03434">Jashobeam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02068">of Zabdiel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Perez</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of all the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">for the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04256">And over the course</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01737">Dodai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0266">an Ahohite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04256">and of his course</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04732">Mikloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">also the ruler</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">in his course</w> likewise <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Dodai</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Dodo</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">The third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">for the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">a chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">principal officer</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:6
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w>, <transChange type="added">who was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <transChange type="added">among</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">the thirty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">and above the thirty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05990">Ammizabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07243">The fourth</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07243">for the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06214">Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02069">and Zebadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">him: and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02549">The fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">for the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08049">Shamhuth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03155">the Izrahite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08345">The sixth</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08345">for the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05896">Ira</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06142">of Ikkesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08621">the Tekoite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">The seventh</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">for the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02503">Helez</w> <w lemma="strong:H06397">the Pelonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">The eighth</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08066">for the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05444">Sibbecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02843">the Hushathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02227">of the Zarhites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08671">The ninth</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08671">for the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H044">Abiezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06069">the Anetothite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">of the Benjamites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06224">The tenth</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06224">for the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04121">Maharai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05200">the Netophathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02227">of the Zarhites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">The eleventh</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H06249">for the eleventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06553">the Pirathonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">The twelfth</w> <transChange type="added">captain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">for the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02469">Heldai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05200">the Netophathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06274">of Othniel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04256">and in his course</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Heldai</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Heled</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07626">Furthermore over the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05057">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H07206">of the Reubenites</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0461">Eliezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02147">of Zichri</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08099">of the Simeonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08203">Shephatiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">of Maachah</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">Of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02811">Hashabiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07055">of Kemuel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0175">of the Aaronites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06659">Zadok</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0453">Elihu</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of the brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03485">of Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06018">Omri</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04317">of Michael</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Elihu</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Eliab</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02074">Of Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03460">Ishmaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05662">of Obadiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">Jerimoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05837">of Azriel</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01954">Hoshea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05812">of Azaziah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03100">Joel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06305">of Pedaiah</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02677">Of the half</w> <transChange type="added">tribe</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568">in Gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03035">Iddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zechariah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03300">Jaasiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H074">of Abner</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01835">Of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05832">Azareel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>. These <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">But David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">not the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of them from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">and under</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">he would increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">like to the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heavens</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06870">of Zeruiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">but he finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">not, because there fell wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">for it</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04557">neither was the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">in the account</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascended</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And over the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">treasures</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05820">Azmaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05717">of Adiel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0214">and over the storehouses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03723">and in the villages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">and in the castles</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03083">Jehonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And over them that did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for tillage</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05836">Ezri</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03620">of Chelub</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03754">And over the vineyards</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H07435">the Ramathite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03754">over the increase of the vineyards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">for the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">cellars</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02067">Zabdi</w> <w lemma="strong:H08225">the Shiphmite</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>over the increase…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">over that which was of the vineyards</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02132">And over the olive trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08256">and the sycomore trees</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08219">in the low plains</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01177">Baal–hanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01451">the Gederite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0214">and over the cellars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03135">Joash</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01241">And over the herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08289">in Sharon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07861">Shitrai</w> <w lemma="strong:H08290">the Sharonite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01241">and over the herds</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valleys</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08202">Shaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05724">of Adlai</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01581">Over the camels</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0179">Obil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03459">the Ishmaelite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0860">and over the asses</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03165">Jehdeiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04824">the Meronothite</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">And over the flocks</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03151">Jaziz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01905">the Hagerite</w>. All these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">of the substance</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03083">Also Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">uncle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was a counsellor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a scribe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02453">of Hachmoni</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>scribe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretary</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hachmonite</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0302">And Ahithophel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsellor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02365">and Hushai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0757">the Archite</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">companion</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 27:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0302">Ahithophel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03077">Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">of Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H054">and Abiathar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the general</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">army</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03097">Joab</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen406" osisID="1Chr.27"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">of the companies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">by course</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over the thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over the hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the stewards</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">over all the substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">and possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05631">with the officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and with the mighty men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">and with all the valiant men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>possession</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cattle</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and his sons</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>officers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuchs</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">upon his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">me, my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and my people</w>: <transChange type="added">As for me</transChange>, I <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">of rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">for the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272 strong:H01916">and for the footstool</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and had made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for the building</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, Thou shalt not build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w>, because thou <transChange type="added">hast been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blood</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Howbeit the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">me before all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to be king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the ruler</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01004">and of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he liked</w> me to make <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of all my sons</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">me many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto me, Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">and my courts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have chosen</w> him <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and I will be his father</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Moreover I will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if he be constant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and my judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">as at this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>constant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Now therefore in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and in the audience</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">for all the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">this good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, and leave <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">you for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:9
