verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And thou, Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">him with a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02655">and with a willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">mind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">searcheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">all hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and understandeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03336">all the imaginations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">of the thoughts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, he will be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee; but if thou forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, he will cast thee off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">now; for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">for the sanctuary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">Then David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">of the porch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and of the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01597">thereof, and of the treasuries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">thereof, and of the upper chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">thereof, and of the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">parlours</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thereof, and of the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03727">of the mercy seat</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08403">And the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of all that he had by the spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">and of all the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">of the treasuries</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and of the treasuries</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the dedicated things</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>of all that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of all that was with him</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04256">Also for the courses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">and for all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and for all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He gave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w> for <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">for all instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of all manner of service</w>; <transChange type="added">silver also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">for all instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">for all instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of every kind of service</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04948">Even the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">for the candlesticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">and for their lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">for every candlestick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">and for the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">thereof: and for the candlesticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04501">for the candlestick</w>, and <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05216">for the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">thereof, according to the use</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">of every candlestick</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04948">And by weight</w> <transChange type="added">he gave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">for the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H04635">of shewbread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07979">for every table</w>; and <transChange type="added">likewise</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">for the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02889">Also pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04207">for the fleshhooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the bowls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07184">and the cups</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02091">and for the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03713">basons</w> <transChange type="added">he gave gold</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03713">for every bason</w>; and <transChange type="added">likewise silver</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03713">for every bason</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04196">And for the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">of incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H02212" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">refined</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">for the pattern</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">of the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that spread out</w> <transChange type="added">their wings</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:19
verses.text: All <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <transChange type="added">said David</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">made me understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">in writing</w> by <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> upon me, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">of this pattern</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and of good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, nor be dismayed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with thee; he will not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, nor forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, until thou hast finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04256">And, behold, the courses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">even they shall be with thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for all the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: and <transChange type="added">there shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">with thee for all manner of workmanship</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">every willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">skilful man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">for any manner of service</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08269">also the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">wholly at thy commandment</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen407" osisID="1Chr.28"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01732">Furthermore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">unto all the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">whom alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w>, <transChange type="added">is yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H07390">and tender</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">and the work</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01002">for the palace</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">not for man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">but for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Now I have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">with all my might</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the gold</w> for <transChange type="added">things to be made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w> for <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and the brass</w> for <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">the iron</w> for <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and wood</w> for <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07718">onyx</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, and <transChange type="added">stones</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04394">to be set</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06320">glistering</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07553">and of divers colours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and all manner of precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07893">and marble</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Moreover, because I have set my affection</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">I have</w> <w lemma="strong:H05459">of mine own proper good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04605">over and above</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">all that I have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">of the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">of Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02212" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">of refined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02902" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to overlay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the houses</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">The gold</w> for <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w> for <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">and for all manner of work</w> <transChange type="added">to be made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">of artificers</w>. And who <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">is willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>consecrate his service</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fill his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08269">Then the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">with the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">offered willingly</w>,

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H07239">and ten thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0150">drams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and of brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07239 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and one hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:8
verses.text: And they with whom <transChange type="added">precious</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">to the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03171">of Jehiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01649">the Gershonite</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Then the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">for that they offered willingly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08003">because with perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">they offered willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">Wherefore David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">all the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">and David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Thine, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01420">the greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01369">and the power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">and the glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05331">and the victory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01935">and the majesty</w>: for all <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in the earth</w> <transChange type="added">is thine</transChange>; thine <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04984" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and thou art exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">as head</w> above all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06239">Both riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w> <transChange type="added">come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thee</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and thou reignest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">over all; and in thine hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and might</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">and in thine hand</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to give strength</w> unto all.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Now therefore, our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">we thank</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thee, and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thy glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:14
verses.text: But who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> I, and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we should be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to offer so willingly</w> after this sort? for all things <transChange type="added">come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thee, and of thine own</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have we given</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>be able</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">retain</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">obtain strength</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of thine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of thine hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:15
verses.text: For we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08453">thee, and sojourners</w>, as <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">all our fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">our days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">as a shadow</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04723">none abiding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abiding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">expectation</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">all this store</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that we have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">for thine holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>, and <transChange type="added">is</transChange> all thine own.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">also, my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou triest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">the heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hast pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">in uprightness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04339">As for me, in the uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">I have willingly offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">all these things: and now have I seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which are present</w> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">here, to offer willingly</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">this for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03336">in the imagination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">of the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">their heart</w> unto thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>prepare</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stablish</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05715">thy testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and thy statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> all <transChange type="added">these things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">the which I have made provision</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">And David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">to all the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Now bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bowed down their heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04283">on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">after that day</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">with their drink offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02077">and sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w>:

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">gladness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08010">And they made Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the chief governor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06659">and Zadok</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sat on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">as king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">instead of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and prospered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">obeyed</w> him.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And all the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and the mighty men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">likewise of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08478 strong:H03027 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">submitted themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>submitted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave the hand under Solomon</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bestowed</w> upon him <transChange type="added">such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04438">royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">as had not been on any king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">him in Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01732">Thus David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02275">he in Hebron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <transChange type="added">years</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">he in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">old age</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07649">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Now the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the seer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">of Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01410">of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">the seer</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>book</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">history</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: I Chronicles 29:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04438">With all his reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">and the times</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">him, and over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and over all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the countries</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen408" osisID="1Chr.29"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen379" osisID="1Chr" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">was strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">in his kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him, and magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">him exceedingly</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">to the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to the judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">and to every governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">So Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">to the high place</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">at Gibeon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0168">for there was the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H061">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">had David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07157">from Kirjath–jearim</w> to <transChange type="added">the place which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for it: for he had pitched</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">a tent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">for it at Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05178">Moreover the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01212">that Bezaleel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0221">of Uri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">and the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sought</w> unto it.<note type="study"><catchWord>he put</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">was there</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">thither to the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">at the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> upon it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03915">In that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">did God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what I shall give</w> thee.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hast made me to reign</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">let thy promise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be established</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou hast made me king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">like the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in multitude</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>like…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">much as the dust of the earth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">me now wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04093">and knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for who can judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">this thy people</w>, <transChange type="added">that is so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">Because this was in thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hast not asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05233">wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">or honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">nor the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither yet hast asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but hast asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04093">and knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thyself, that thou mayest judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">over whom I have made thee king</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04093">and knowledge</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">granted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee; and I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">thee riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05233">and wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">such as none of the kings</w> have had that <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">thee, neither shall there any after</w> thee have the like.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <transChange type="added">from his journey</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01116">to the high place</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01391">at Gibeon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0505">and he had a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which he placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <transChange type="added">as plenteous</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">as stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and cedar trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08256">he as the sycomore trees</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08219">in the vale</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for abundance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">had horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04723">and linen yarn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H04723">the linen yarn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04242">at a price</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Solomon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the going forth of the horses which was Solomon’s</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they fetched up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">a chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">for six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and an horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">for an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and so brought they out</w> <transChange type="added">horses</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">of the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and for the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by their means</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>means</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen410" osisID="2Chr.1"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">for his kingdom</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">told out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05449">to bear burdens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to hew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to oversee</w> them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02361">to Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">As thou didst deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and didst send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">him cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> therein, <transChange type="added">even so deal with me</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Huram</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hiram</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to dedicate</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> to him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">him sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">and for the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H04635">shewbread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and for the burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">and evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">and on the new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and on the solemn feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>. This <transChange type="added">is an ordinance</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sweet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">incense of spices</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I build</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">above all gods</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03581 strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But who is able</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">seeing the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">cannot contain</w> him? who <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I then, that I should build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0518">save only</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him?<note type="study"><catchWord>is able</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath retained</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">obtained strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">me now therefore a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">in gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and in silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">and in brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">and in iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0710">and in purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03758">and crimson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">and blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and that can skill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06603 strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">with the cunning men</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">with me in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did provide</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to grave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to grave gravings</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">me also cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01265">fir trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0418">and algum trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">out of Lebanon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">that thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">can skill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">and, behold, my servants</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servants</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>algum</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">almuggim</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Even to prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">me timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which I am about to build</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">wonderful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wonderful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great and wonderful</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, I will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">timber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">of beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">baths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">baths</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02361">Then Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">in writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">hath loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thee king</w> over them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02361">Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">moreover, Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">endued</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">with prudence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">and understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that might build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">for his kingdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>endued…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">knowing prudence and understanding</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And now I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a cunning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">endued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">with understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02361">of Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father’s</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">of Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and his father</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06876">of Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">skilful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">in gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and in silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">in brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01270">in iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">in stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and in timber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">in purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">in blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0948">and in fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03758">and in crimson</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">also to grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06603">any manner of graving</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">every device</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which shall be put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">to him, with thy cunning men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">and with the cunning men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02406">Now therefore the wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08184">and the barley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">which my lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of, let him send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto his servants</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we will cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">out of Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06878">as much as thou shalt need</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and we will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07513">it to thee in floats</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">by sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03305">to Joppa</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou shalt carry it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as much…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to all thy need</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Joppa</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Japho</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616 strong:H0582">all the strangers</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05610">the numbering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">wherewith David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them; and they were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the strangers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the men the strangers</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> of them <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05449">bearers of burdens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hewers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">overseers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-244">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-244">a work</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen411" osisID="2Chr.2"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H04179">Moriah</w>, where <transChange type="added">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in the threshingfloor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0771">of Ornan</w> <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which was seen of David his father</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ornan</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Araunah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he began</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">in the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his reign</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are the things wherein</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was instructed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for the building</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0753">The length</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">by cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">after the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">measure</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>instructed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">founded</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0197">And the porch</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the front</w> <transChange type="added">of the house</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <transChange type="added">of it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07341">according to the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01363">and the height</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">it within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">And the greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he cieled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01265">with fir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with fine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08561">thereon palm trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08333">and chains</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he garnished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">with precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">for beauty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06516">of Parvaim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>garnished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">covered</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">also the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06982">the beams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05592">the posts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07023">and the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">thereof, and the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">thereof, with gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and graved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">on the walls</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> whereof <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">according to</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">thereof twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">it with fine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">amounting</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">to six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04948">And the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04548">of the nails</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And he overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">the upper chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">And in the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06816">of image</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">them with gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>image…</catchWord>: or, (as some think) <rdg type="alternate">of moveable work</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03671">And the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wing</w> <transChange type="added">of the one cherub was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">reaching</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">to the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0312">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wing</w> <transChange type="added">was likewise</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">reaching</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">to the wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">reaching</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">to the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0312">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wing</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01695">joining</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">to the wing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">of the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherub</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03671">The wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of these cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">spread themselves forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on their feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and their faces</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">inward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>inward</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward the house</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06532">the vail</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08504">blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03758">and crimson</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0948">and fine linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">cherubims</w> thereon.<note type="study"><catchWord>wrought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to ascend</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06858">and the chapiter</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> of each of them <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>high</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">long</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08333">chains</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01687">in the oracle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">pomegranates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08333">on the chains</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03227 strong:H03233" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of that on the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03199">Jachin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08042">of that on the left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01162">Boaz</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jachin</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">He shall establish</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Boaz</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">In it is strength</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen412" osisID="2Chr.3"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">an altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">the length</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">thereof, and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">thereof, and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">a molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">from brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">to brim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05696">round</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">in compass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">thereof; and a line</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">it round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from his brim to his brim</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:3
verses.text: And under it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01823">the similitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which did compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">it round about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">in a cubit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">compassing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08147">Two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of oxen</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04166">when it was cast</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">It stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">upon twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">toward the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">toward the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">toward the south</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">looking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the east</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03220">and the sea</w> <transChange type="added">was set</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">upon them, and all their hinder parts</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">inward</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05672">And the thickness</w> of it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02947">an handbreadth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and the brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of it like the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of the brim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">of a cup</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06525">with flowers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">of lilies</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">it received</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and held</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01324">baths</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with flowers…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">like a lilyflower</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">also ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">lavers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in them: such things as they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01740" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in them; but the sea</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to wash in</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>such…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the work of burnt offering</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04501">candlesticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to their form</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">also ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">tables</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and placed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">on the left</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04219">basons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>basons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bowls</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:9
