verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Furthermore he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01817">and doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">for the court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of them with brass</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03233">on the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">the south</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02361">And Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">the pots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03257">and the shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the basons</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02438 strong:H02361" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">And Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8762">finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he was to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>basons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bowls</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>finished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">finished to make</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">To wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01543">and the pommels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03805">and the chapiters</w> <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the two pillars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">wreaths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">pommels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">of the chapiters</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">of the pillars</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0702">And four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">on the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">wreaths</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02905">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07416">of pomegranates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">on each</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">wreath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01543">pommels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03805">of the chapiters</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon the face of</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">also bases</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03595">and lavers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">he upon the bases</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>lavers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">caldrons</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> under it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05518">The pots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03257">also, and the shovels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04207">and the fleshhooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all their instruments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02361">did Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04838" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">brass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bright</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made bright</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">scoured</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03603">In the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">did the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">them, in the clay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">between Succoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06868">and Zeredathah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>clay…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thicknesses of the ground</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Thus Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all these vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">abundance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04948">for the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of the brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">could not be found out</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">all the vessels</w> that <transChange type="added">were for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">also, and the tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H03899">whereon the shewbread</w> <transChange type="added">was set</transChange>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04501">Moreover the candlesticks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">with their lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that they should burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">after the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">the oracle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06525">And the flowers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">and the lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04457">and the tongs</w>, <transChange type="added">made he of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04357">that perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>perfect…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">perfections of gold</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04212">And the snuffers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04219">and the basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and the spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04289">and the censers</w>, <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06607">and the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06442">the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">thereof for the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01817">and the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w>, <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>basons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bowls</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen413" osisID="2Chr.4"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04399">Thus all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">that Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was finished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> in <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944" type="x-split-245">the things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944" type="x-split-245">had dedicated</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the instruments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">he among the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and all the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">of the tribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05387">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Wherefore all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">themselves unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">in the feast</w> which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02205">And all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">and the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of the congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and all the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">these did the priests</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bring up</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Also king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">which could not be told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for multitude</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01687">to the oracle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">into the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">under the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">of the cherubims</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03742">For the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">spread forth</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">over the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">of the ark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03742">and the cherubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">and the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">thereof above</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they drew out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the staves</w> <transChange type="added">of the ark</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">that the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">of the staves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">from the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">the oracle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but they were not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03117">And there it is unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>there…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they are there</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0727">nothing in the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">save the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">tables</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">which Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <transChange type="added">therein</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02722">at Horeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <transChange type="added">a covenant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">where</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">And it came to pass, when the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>: (<w lemma="strong:H03548">for all the priests</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">present</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were sanctified</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> did not <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">by course</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">Also the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0623">all of them of Asaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01968">of Heman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03038">of Jeduthun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">with their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and their brethren</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">arrayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0948">in white linen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04700">having cymbals</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">and psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">at the east end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with them an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02690" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">sounding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w>:)

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02690 strong:H02690" morph="strongMorph:TH8764 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8764">It came even to pass, as the trumpeters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and singers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">to make one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in praising</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and thanking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and when they lifted up</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H04700">and cymbals</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, For <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: that <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">with a cloud</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">So that the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">for the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen414" osisID="2Chr.5"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he would dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">in the thick darkness</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02073">of habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">for thee, and a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">who hath with his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">fulfilled</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Since the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that I brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">no city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">among all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in, that my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">might be there; neither chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">I any man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">to be a ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might be there; and have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to be over my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">Now it was in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">Forasmuch as it was in thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou didst well</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in that it was in thine heart</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07535">Notwithstanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">but thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02504">out of thy loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore hath performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that he hath spoken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I am risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">in the room of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and am set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">promised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08033">And in it</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the ark</w>, wherein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in the presence of all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">For Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">a brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03595">scaffold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">of five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0753">long</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H07341">broad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06967">high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">it in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05835">of the court</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and upon it he stood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kneeled down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">upon his knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">before all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the length thereof</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">like thee in the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">nor in the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which keepest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>, and <transChange type="added">shewest</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thee with all their hearts</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou which hast kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that which thou hast promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him; and spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and hast fulfilled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thine hand</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now therefore, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that which thou hast promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">There shall not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in my sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07535">yet so</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in my law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as thou hast walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>There…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">There shall not a man be cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now then, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">let thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be verified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But will God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0552">in very deed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">with men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08064">behold, heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">cannot contain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee; how much less this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have built</w>!

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">therefore to the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08467">and to his supplication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">unto the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">and the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">which thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">prayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee:

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">That thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">may be open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereof thou hast said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou wouldest put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">there; to hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">which thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">toward this place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">therefore unto the supplications</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">which they shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">toward this place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thou from thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and when thou hearest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forgive</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>make</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pray</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0376">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">and an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0422" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">upon him to make him swear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0423">and the oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thine altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in this house</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>and an oath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and he require an oath of him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">by requiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by recompensing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his own head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and by justifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by giving</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">him according to his righteousness</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">And if thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be put to the worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because they have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee; and shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and make supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thee in this house</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>be put…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be smitten</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou from the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to them and to their fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08064">When the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">is shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04306">and there is no rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because they have sinned</w> against thee; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">if they pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">toward this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from their sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when thou dost afflict</w> them;<note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when thou hast taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">them the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein they should walk</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon thy land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an inheritance</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07458">If there be dearth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">if there be pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07711">if there be blasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03420">or mildew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0697">locusts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02625">or caterpillers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">if their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">besiege</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">them in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of their land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05061">whatsoever sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04245">or whatsoever sickness</w> <transChange type="added">there be</transChange>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in the cities…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the land of their gates</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08605">what prayer</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08467">what supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">soever shall be made of any man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">or of all thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">when every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">his own sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">and his own grief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall spread forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in this house</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">toward</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and render</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">according unto all his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">whose heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou knowest</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou only knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>:)

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in thy ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">so long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H02416">they live</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto our fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>so long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the days which</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in the land</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon the face of the land</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05237">Moreover concerning the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">which is not of thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from a far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">country</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">for thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">sake, and thy mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and thy stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in this house</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>toward…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou from the heavens</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">according to all that the stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to thee for; that all people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and fear</w> thee, as <transChange type="added">doth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">that this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>this…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy name is called upon this house</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">If thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shalt send</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">them, and they pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">unto thee toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">this city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou from the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">their prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">and their supplication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">their cause</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cause</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">right</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If they sin</w> against thee, (for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which sinneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not,) and thou be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with them, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them over before</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they carry them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto a land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">or near</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>they carry them away captives</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they that take them captives carry them away</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:37
verses.text: Yet <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they bethink</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">themselves in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">whither they are carried captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thee in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of their captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">we have done amiss</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have dealt wickedly</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>bethink…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bring back to their heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If they return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">to thee with all their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of their captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither they have carried them captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto their fathers</w>, and <transChange type="added">toward</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and toward the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thou from the heavens</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from thy dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08605">their prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">and their supplications</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">their cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have sinned</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>cause</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">right</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Now, my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">let, I beseech thee, thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">be open</w>, and <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ears</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07183">attent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto the prayer</w> <transChange type="added">that is made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the prayer of this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05118">into thy resting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">place, thou, and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of thy strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">let thy priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">with salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02623">and let thy saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in goodness</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 6:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">turn not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">of thine anointed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">the mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen415" osisID="2Chr.6"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Now when Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">of praying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">and the sacrifices</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">because the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And when all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">how the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">themselves with their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H07531">upon the pavement</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, For <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">a sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">so the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02596" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dedicated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">on their offices</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">also with instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of musick</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">which David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">because his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">when David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by their ministry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02690 strong:H02690" morph="strongMorph:TH8764 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8688">sounded trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">before them, and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by their hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Moreover Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">the middle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the court</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for there he offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05178">because the brasen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">and the meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">Also at the same time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">with him, a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">of Hamath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">unto the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08066">And in the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06116">a solemn assembly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02598">the dedication</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">and the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a solemn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a restraint</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And on the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-246">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-246">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into their tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08056">glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and merry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and to Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Thus Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">into Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and in his own house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he prosperously effected</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">thy prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">this place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to myself for an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02005">If</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">that there be no rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">or if I command</w> <w lemma="strong:H02284">the locusts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">or if I send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">pestilence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among my people</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">If my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which are called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">themselves, and pray</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from their wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then will I hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon whom my name is called</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Now mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shall be open</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and mine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07183">attent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto the prayer</w> <transChange type="added">that is made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in this place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the prayer of this place</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For now have I chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">that my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">may be there for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">and mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">and mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">shall be there perpetually</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And as for thee, if thou wilt walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">me, as David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">according to all that I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, and shalt observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and my judgments</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then will I stablish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of thy kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">according as I have covenanted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">There shall not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">thee a man</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>There…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">There shall not be cut off to thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if ye turn away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">you, and shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and worship</w> them;

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will I pluck them up by the roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">out of my land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them; and this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I have sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for my name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will make</w> it <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a proverb</w> <w lemma="strong:H08148">and a byword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all nations</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">And this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">which is high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be an astonishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to every one that passeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">by it; so that he shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Why hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thus unto this land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and unto this house</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And it shall be answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">on other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them: therefore hath he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all this evil</w> upon them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen416" osisID="2Chr.7"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">of twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">wherein Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and his own house</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">That the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02361">which Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them, and caused the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to dwell</w> there.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02578">to Hamath–zobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and prevailed</w> against it.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H08412">Tadmor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04543">and all the store</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02574">in Hamath</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the upper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01032">and Beth–horon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08481">the nether</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04692">fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">with walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01817">gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01280">and bars</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01191">And Baalath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04543">and all the store</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">that Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">had, and all the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">of the horsemen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08010">and all that Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02837 strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03844">and in Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">of his dominion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the desire of Solomon which he desired to build</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w> <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H02850">of the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02340">and the Hivites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">not of Israel</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">who were left</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">whom the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">not, them did Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make to pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">until this day</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">But of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">did Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">no servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">for his work</w>; but they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">of his captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of his chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:10
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333 strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8737">officers</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">of Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for her: for he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">My wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, because <transChange type="added">the places are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0727">whereunto the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath come</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">Then Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">the porch</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Even after a certain rate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">and on the new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and on the solemn feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in the year</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02282">in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">and in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07620">of weeks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">and in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he appointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the order</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04256">the courses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">to their service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">to their charges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">before the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">as the duty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">required</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07778">the porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">also by their courses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at every gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01732">for so had David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commanded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>so had David…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">so was the commandment of David the man of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">not from the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning any matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">or concerning the treasures</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:16
