verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04399">Now all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04143">of the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and until it was finished</w>. <transChange type="added">So</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">was perfected</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06100">to Ezion–geber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0359">and to Eloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">at the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Eloth</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Elath</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02361">And Huram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him by the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591 strong:H0591" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">ships</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that had knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">to Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">thence four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen417" osisID="2Chr.8"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04436">And when the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">of the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">with hard questions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">with a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">company</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01581">and camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when she was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">she communed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with him of all that was in her heart</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">her all her questions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and there was nothing hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">from Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he told</w> her not.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04436">And when the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had built</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03978">And the meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">of his table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04186">and the sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04612">and the attendance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of his ministers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04403">and their apparel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">his cupbearers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04403">also, and their apparel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05944">and his ascent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by which he went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">there was no more spirit</w> in her.<note type="study"><catchWord>cupbearers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">butlers</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <transChange type="added">It was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">a true</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">report</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in mine own land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of thine acts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">and of thy wisdom</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>report</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">word</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>acts</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sayings</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Howbeit I believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not their words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">until I came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02677">and, behold, the one half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04768">of the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of thy wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">was not told</w> me: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou exceedest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I heard</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">thy men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0835">and happy</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">these thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">thy wisdom</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">be the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which delighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in thee to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">thee on his throne</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">because thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">them for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">he thee king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">over them, to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and justice</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and of spices</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01314">neither was there any such spice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">as the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02361">also of Huram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">from Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0418">algum</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>algum…</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">almug trees</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0418">the algum</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H04546">terraces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">and psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for singers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01992">and there were none such</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>terraces</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stairs</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">highways</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">to the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">all her desire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whatsoever she asked</w>, beside <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which she had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So she turned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to her own land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">she and her servants</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04948">Now the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">was six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:14
verses.text: Beside <transChange type="added">that which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08446 strong:H0582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">chapmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06152">of Arabia</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">and governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">to Solomon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>governors</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">captains</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">targets</w> <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07820" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07820" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">target</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">And three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shields</w> <transChange type="added">made he of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07820" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">shekels</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shield</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Moreover the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of ivory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06823" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overlaid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">it with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">to the throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03534">with a footstool</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">to the throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and stays</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">on each side of the sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the stays</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>stays</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">And twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">there on the one side and on the other upon the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">steps</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">There was not the like made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">in any kingdom</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04945">And all the drinking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>: none <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>; it was <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03972">any</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thing accounted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>none were of silver</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">there was no silver in them</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">to Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02361">of Huram</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">every three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">once</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08143">ivory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06971">and apes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08500">and peacocks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ivory</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">elephants’ teeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">in riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">and wisdom</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">his wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">his present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08008">and raiment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05402">harness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06505">and mules</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">a rate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">had four</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0723">stalls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">for horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">and chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">whom he bestowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">over all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">even unto the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01366">and to the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>river</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Euphrates</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">as stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and cedar trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08256">he as the sycomore trees</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08219">in the low plains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made silver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave silver</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">unto Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">horses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and out of all lands</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07605">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H05416">of Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05016">and in the prophecy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">of Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07888">the Shilonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02378">and in the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03260">of Iddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">the seer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">against Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>book</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">And Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07346">and Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen418" osisID="2Chr.9"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">to Shechem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07927">for to Shechem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">were all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make him king</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">And it came to pass, when Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whither he had fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03379">that Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">him. So Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">to Rehoboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">made our yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">grievous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">now therefore ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">thou somewhat the grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">servitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03515">and his heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon us, and we will serve</w> thee.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">unto me after three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">departed</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">took counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">with the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">men that had stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">while he yet lived</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0349">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">counsel give</w> ye <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to this people</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">If thou be kind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and please</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to them, they will be thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">which the old men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, and took counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">with the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that were brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him, that stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto them, What advice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">give ye that we may return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to this people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">somewhat the yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did put</w> upon us?

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03206">And the young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that were brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shalt thou answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">Thy father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-247">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">our yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-247">heavy</w>, but make thou <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">somewhat lighter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for us; thus shalt thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06995">unto them, My little</w> <transChange type="added">finger</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05666" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be thicker</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">than my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">loins</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06258">For whereas</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03515">a heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon you, I will put more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">to your yoke</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">chastised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">you with whips</w>, but I <transChange type="added">will chastise you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06137">with scorpions</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my father put</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my father laded</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">So Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">to Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">as the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">bade</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">to me on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">them roughly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the old men</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">them after the advice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">of the young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">My father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05923">made your yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">heavy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but I will add</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thereto: my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">chastised</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">you with whips</w>, but I <transChange type="added">will chastise you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06137">with scorpions</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not unto the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05252">for the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">was of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">might perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0281">of Ahijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07888">the Shilonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">to Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03478">And when all Israel</w> <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto them, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">What portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">have we in David</w>? and <transChange type="added">we have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">none inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">in the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to your tents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">now, David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to thine own house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03478">So all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to their tents</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:17
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> over them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01913">Hadoram</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04522">over the tribute</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he died</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">But king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">made speed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to get him up</w> to <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made speed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengthened himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen419" osisID="2Chr.10"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And when Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04421 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which were warriors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-248">that he might bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-248">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">to Rehoboam</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">But the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">came to Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">unto Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and to all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against your brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">for this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of me. And they obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from going</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">against Jeroboam</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">for defence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01035">even Beth–lehem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05862">and Etam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08620">and Tekoa</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01049">And Beth–zur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07755">and Shoco</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05725">and Adullam</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01661">And Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04762">and Mareshah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02128">and Ziph</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0115">And Adoraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03923">and Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05825">and Azekah</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06881">And Zorah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0357">and Aijalon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02275">and Hebron</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and in Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04694">fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he fortified</w> <w lemma="strong:H04694">the strong holds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in them, and store</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">of victual</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and of oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And in every several city</w> <transChange type="added">he put</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06793">shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">and spears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966 strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and made them exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">having Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> on his side.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">resorted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">to him out of all their coasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>resorted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">presented themselves to him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">For the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">their suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">and their possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03379">for Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had cast them off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03547" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from executing the priest’s office</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">him priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">for the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08163">and for the devils</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05695">and for the calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">them out of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">such as set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">their hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So they strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07346">and made Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">for three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">and Solomon</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04258">him Mahalath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H01323" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03406">of Jerimoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H032">Abihail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0446">of Eliab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him children</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03266">Jeush</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08114">and Shamariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02093">and Zaham</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">her he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Absalom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">him Abijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06262">and Attai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02124">and Ziza</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08019">and Shelomith</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maachah</catchWord>: she is also called <rdg type="x-identity">Michaiah the daughter of Uriel</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">of Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">above all his wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">and his concubines</w>: (<w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">concubines</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>.)

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04601">of Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>, <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">among his brethren</w>: for <transChange type="added">he thought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make him king</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he dealt wisely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dispersed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the countries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04694">unto every fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04202">them victual</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many wives</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a multitude of wives</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen420" osisID="2Chr.11"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And it came to pass, when Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">had established</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">the kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02393">and had strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">himself, he forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> with him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:2
verses.text: And it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02549">in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07895">Shishak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they had transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0505 strong:H03967">With twelve hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">horsemen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">without number</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">with him out of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03864">the Lubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05525">the Sukkiims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03569">and the Ethiopians</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04694">the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> which <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">to Rehoboam</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07895">of Shishak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Ye have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0637">me, and therefore have I also</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07895">of Shishak</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Whereupon the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves; and they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">themselves, the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">came to Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">They have humbled</w> themselves; <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, but I will grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">them some</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">deliverance</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02534">and my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">upon Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07895">of Shishak</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>some</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a little while</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Nevertheless they shall be his servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">my service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">and the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the countries</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07895">So Shishak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">all: he carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">also the shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Instead of which king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and committed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the guard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01767">And when</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fetched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and brought them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">into the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08372">chamber</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">And when he humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">himself, the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from him, that he would not destroy</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03617">altogether</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">and also in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">went well</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and also…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and yet in Judah there were good things</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">So king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">himself in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and reigned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07346">for Rehoboam</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07651">seventeen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">out of all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">there. And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05279">Naamah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05985">an Ammonitess</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prepared</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fixed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Now the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">of Rehoboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05714">and of Iddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">the seer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">concerning genealogies</w>? And <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">wars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">between Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>book</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07346">And Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H029">and Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abijah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Abijam</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen421" osisID="2Chr.12"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">Now in the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">began Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">His mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04322">Michaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0222">of Uriel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01390">of Gibeah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04421">And there was war</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">between Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">and Jeroboam</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H029">And Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-249">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-249">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with an army</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of valiant men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">also set the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">against him with eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abijah set</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Abijah bound together</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H029">And Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06787">Zemaraim</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">me, thou Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Ought ye not to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to him and to his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">by a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">Yet Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05028">of Nebat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is risen up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">against his lord</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And there are gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">unto him vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of Belial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and have strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07346">themselves against Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07346">when Rehoboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">was young</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824 strong:H07390">and tenderhearted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and could not withstand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And now ye think</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to withstand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467 strong:H06440">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>; and ye <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w>, and <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">with you golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03379">which Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">you for gods</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Have ye not cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">you priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">after the manner of the nations</w> of <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">lands</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so that whosoever cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to consecrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241 strong:H01121">himself with a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <transChange type="added">the same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">may be a priest</w> of <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to consecrate…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to fill his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But as for us, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and we have not forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">him; and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">wait</transChange> upon <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">business</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And they burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">and every evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H05561">and sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04635 strong:H03899">the shewbread</w> also <transChange type="added">set they in order</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">upon the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04501">and the candlestick</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">with the lamps</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thereof, to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">every evening</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for we keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but ye have forsaken</w> him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And, behold, God</w> himself <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with us for <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">captain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and his priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with sounding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cry alarm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against you. O children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye not against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for ye shall not prosper</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03379">But Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03993">caused an ambushment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them: so they were before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03993">and the ambushment</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And when Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">behold, the battle</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">and behind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02690 strong:H02690" morph="strongMorph:TH8764 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8688">sounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Then the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gave a shout</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and as the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">shouted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">it came to pass, that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into their hand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H029">And Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">them with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so there fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thus the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">under at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevailed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">because they relied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H029">And Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03379">Jeroboam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01008">from him, Beth–el</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H03466">thereof, and Jeshanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the towns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06085">thereof, and Ephrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the towns</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03379">Neither did Jeroboam</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">again in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">of Abijah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">struck</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and he died</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H029">But Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">waxed mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and married</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">and sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H029">of Abijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and his sayings</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H04097">in the story</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05714">Iddo</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen422" osisID="2Chr.13"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H029">So Abijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0609">and Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in his stead. In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of the strange</w> <transChange type="added">gods</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01116">and the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the groves</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and the commandment</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:5
