verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Also he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02553">and the images</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04467">and the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sun images</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04694">fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and he had no war</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">in those years</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had given him rest</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">unto Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">these cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and make about</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">and towers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01817">gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01280">and bars</w>, <transChange type="added">while</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">yet before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us; because we have sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have sought</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath given us rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and prospered</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">had an army</w> <transChange type="added">of men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">targets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">and spears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">out of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01144">and out of Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>: all these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02226">against them Zerah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">the Ethiopian</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with an host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariots</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04762">unto Mareshah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">Then Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">him, and they set the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in array</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H06859">of Zephathah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04762">at Mareshah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nothing with thee to help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0996">whether</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">with many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">or with them that have no power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">us, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for we rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on thee, and in thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">against this multitude</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">let not man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevail</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>man</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mortal man</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">the Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03569">and the Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fled</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">them unto Gerar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03569">and the Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were overthrown</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04241">that they could not recover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">themselves; for they were destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">his host</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01642">Gerar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06343">for the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came upon them: and they spoiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">all the cities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">for there was exceeding much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0961">spoil</w> in them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">also the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">of cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">and camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen423" osisID="2Chr.14"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">came upon Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05752">of Oded</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him, Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">ye me, Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, he will be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of you; but if ye forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, he will forsake</w> you.<note type="study"><catchWord>to meet…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before Asa</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Now for a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">season</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <transChange type="added">hath been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the true</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and without a teaching</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and without law</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">But when they in their trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, he was found</w> of them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">And in those times</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">no peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to him that went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor to him that came in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">but great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">vexations</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the countries</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">And nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">them with all adversity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">beaten in pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be ye strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">therefore, and let not your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be weak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06468">for your work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07939">rewarded</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And when Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05016">and the prophecy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05752">of Oded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">he took courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08251">the abominable idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and out of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">from mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and renewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abominable…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">abominations</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">with them out of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08095">and out of Simeon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to him out of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> with him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">So they gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">in the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">of the spoil</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they had brought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the same…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in that day</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">into a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all their soul</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That whosoever would not seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">should be put to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04480">whether</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">or great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">whether man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or woman</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And they sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08643">and with shouting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02689">and with trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07782">and with cornets</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621">at the oath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for they had sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">him with their whole desire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and he was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of them: and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave them rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And also <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04601">Maachah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he removed</w> her from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01377">queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because she had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04656">an idol</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">in a grove</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0609">and Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04656">her idol</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and stamped</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and burnt</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">at the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mother</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">grandmother</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>idol</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">horror</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">But the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03824">nevertheless the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H08003">was perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all his days</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">the things that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">had dedicated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and that he himself had dedicated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 15:19
verses.text: And there was no <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">unto the five</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen424" osisID="2Chr.15"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08337">In the six</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01115">to the intent that</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he might let</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">to Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">Then Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">out of the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">and of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01130">to Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">at Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Damascus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Darmesek</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a league</w> between me and thee, as <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">between my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">and thy father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I have sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">thee silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">break</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">thy league</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">with Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may depart</w> from me.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01130">And Ben–hadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of his armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">against the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05859">Ijon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01835">and Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H066">and Abel–maim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04543">and all the store</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which were his</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01201">And it came to pass, when Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">building</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">of Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">and let his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cease</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">Then Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">of Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and the timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01201">thereof, wherewith Baasha</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was building</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01387">therewith Geba</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">and Mizpah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">And at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02607">Hanani</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the seer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">to Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">unto him, Because thou hast relied</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">on the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and not relied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">therefore is the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of thine hand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03569">Were not the Ethiopians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03864">and the Lubims</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">a huge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">with very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">yet, because thou didst rely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into thine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a huge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in abundance</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">For the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">run to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout the whole earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to shew himself strong</w> in the behalf of <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">whose heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08003">perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H05528" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06258">therefore from henceforth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">thou shalt have</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">wars</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to shew…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strongly to hold with them</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">Then Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the seer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04115">him in a prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; for <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02197">in a rage</w> with him because of this <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">oppressed</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">the same time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppressed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">crushed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And, behold, the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, lo, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">in the thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H02456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was diseased</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">in his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02483">until his disease</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">exceeding</w> <transChange type="added">great</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H02483">yet in his disease</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but to the physicians</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0609">And Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and died</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and fortieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">him in his own sepulchres</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">for himself in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">him in the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which was filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">with sweet odours</w> <w lemma="strong:H02177">and divers kinds</w> <transChange type="added">of spices</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07543" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04842">by the apothecaries’</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">art</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">burning</w> for him.<note type="study"><catchWord>had made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">had digged</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen425" osisID="2Chr.16"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">in his stead, and strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">himself against Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">forces</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in all the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05333">garrisons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0609">which Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">was with Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">not unto Baalim</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of his father, and of David</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But sought</w> to the <transChange type="added"><divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">in his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">and not after the doings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stablished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">to Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">presents</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06239">and he had riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gave</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">And his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">moreover he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">and groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">out of Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">was encouraged</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07969">Also in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">to his princes</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01134">to Ben–hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05662">and to Obadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and to Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05417">and to Nethaneel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04322">and to Michaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:8
verses.text: And with them <transChange type="added">he sent</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05418">and Nethaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02069">and Zebadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06214">and Asahel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08070">and Shemiramoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03083">and Jehonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0138">and Adonijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02900">and Tobijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02899">and Tob–adonijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">Levites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0476">and with them Elishama</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">and Jehoram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>, and <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with them, and went about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">throughout all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06343">And the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">fell upon all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the lands</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">so that they made no war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">against Jehoshaphat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fell</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:11
verses.text: Also <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">presents</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">and tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06163">and the Arabians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">him flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08495">he goats</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">waxed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01432">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">exceedingly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01003">castles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04543">of store</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>castles</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">palaces</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And he had much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">business</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:14
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06486">the numbers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of them according to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of thousands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05734">Adnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">and with him mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next</w> to him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03076">Jehohanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with him two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>next…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next</w> him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06007">Amasiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02147">of Zichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">who willingly offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">himself unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with him two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01144">And of Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0450">Eliada</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and with him armed men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">with bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next</w> him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03075">Jehozabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with him an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">ready prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for the war</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">These waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">on the king</w>, beside <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">in the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">throughout all Judah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen426" osisID="2Chr.17"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">Now Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">had riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and joined affinity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">with Ahab</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07093">And after</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">to Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">for him in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and for the people</w> that <transChange type="added">he had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with him, and persuaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to go up</w> <transChange type="added">with him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the end of years</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0256">And Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">with me to Ramoth–gilead</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he answered</w> him, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> as thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">as thy people</w>; and <transChange type="added">we will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with thee in the war</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Enquire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">I pray thee, at the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Therefore the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Shall we go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or shall I forbear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will deliver</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">But Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">not here a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">besides, that we might enquire</w> of him?<note type="study"><catchWord>besides</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yet</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">more</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">yet one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by whom we may enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">him; for he never prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto me, but always</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03229">of Imla</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Let not the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> so.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">for one</w> <transChange type="added">of his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05631">officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Fetch quickly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04319">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03229">of Imla</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuchs</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Fetch…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hasten</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">either</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of them on his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">clothed</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0899">robes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01637">in a void place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05030">and all the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>void…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">floor</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">And Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03668">of Chenaanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">him horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">With these thou shalt push</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">until they be consumed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thou consume them</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">And all the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prosper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall deliver</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">And the messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to call</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">Behold, the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w> <transChange type="added">declare</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">assent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">let thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">therefore, I pray thee, be like one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of theirs, and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thou good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with one mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04321">And Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">even what my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that will I speak</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">unto him, Micaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall we go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or shall I forbear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go ye up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they shall be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into your hand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">to him, How many times</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shall I adjure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee that thou say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">nothing but the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to me in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I did see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">as sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that have no shepherd</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0113">These have no master</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them return</w> <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">to Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Did I not tell</w> thee <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he would not prophesy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto me, but evil</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>but evil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">but for evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon his throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on his right hand</w> and <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">his left</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Who shall entice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">at Ramoth–gilead</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And one spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03602">after this manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and another saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03602">after that manner</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then there came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">a spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will entice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">him. And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him, Wherewith?

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">and be a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of all his prophets</w>. And <transChange type="added">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt entice</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou shalt also prevail</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> so.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Now therefore, behold, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of these thy prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> against thee.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06667">Then Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03668">of Chenaanah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">upon the cheek</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0335">Which</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from me to speak</w> unto thee?

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04321">And Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when thou shalt go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into an inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to hide</w> thyself.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from chamber to chamber</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a chamber in a chamber</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04321">ye Micaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and carry him back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">to Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03101">and to Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> this <transChange type="added">fellow</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03608 strong:H01004">in the prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">him with bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">of affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and with water</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">of affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until I return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04321">And Micaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If thou certainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">hath not the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by me. And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">all ye people</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">to Ramoth–gilead</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">unto Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">I will disguise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">myself, and will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thou on thy robes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">disguised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself; and they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to the battle</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Now the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariots</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">ye not with small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">or great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">save only with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And it came to pass, when the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore they compassed about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">him to fight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03092">but Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cried out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">him; and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">moved</w> them <transChange type="added">to depart</transChange> from him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">For it came to pass, that, when the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that it was not the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they turned back again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from pursuing</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:33
verses.text: And a <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">man drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">a bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">at a venture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01694">between the joints</w> <w lemma="strong:H08302">of the harness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07395">to his chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that thou mayest carry me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the host</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">for I am wounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at a venture</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his simplicity</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>between…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">between the joints and between the breastplate</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wounded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made sick</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 18:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">And the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">howbeit the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> stayed <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">up</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04818">chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the even</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">and about the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he died</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen427" osisID="2Chr.18"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02607">of Hanani</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">the seer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Shouldest thou help</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the ungodly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H02063">therefore</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07110">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon thee from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H061">Nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">there are good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in thee, in that thou hast taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hast prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">through the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">from Beer–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought them back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he returned and went out</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">throughout all the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">by city</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">what ye do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for ye judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">not for man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">but for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941 strong:H01697">with you in the judgment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the matter of judgment</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">Wherefore now let the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be upon you; take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05766">no iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04856">nor respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04727">nor taking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">of gifts</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03389">Moreover in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">did Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">for the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07379">and for controversies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus shall ye do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">in the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithfully</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08003">and with a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07379">And what cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">soever shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to you of your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01818">between blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">and blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">between law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">ye shall even warn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them that they trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07110">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">come upon you, and upon your brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03541">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye shall not trespass</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0568">And, behold, Amariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">over you in all matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02069">and Zebadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03458">of Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">for all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">also the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">you. Deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">courageously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">shall be with the good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Deal…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Take courage and do</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen428" osisID="2Chr.19"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">It came to pass after this</w> also, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, and with them <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05984">beside the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">against Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to battle</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">some that told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">There cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">against thee from beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">on this side Syria</w>; and, behold, they <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02688">in Hazazon–tamar</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05872">En–gedi</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">throughout</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>himself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his face</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to ask</w> <transChange type="added">help</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">even out of all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:5
