verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">the new</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not thou God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and rulest</w> <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">thou over all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03027">and in thine hand</w> <transChange type="added">is there not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">so that none is able to withstand</w> thee?

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not thou our God</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">didst drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of this land</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">it to the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>who</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thou</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therein, and have built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">thee a sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">therein for thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:9
verses.text: If, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> upon us, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08196">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01698">or pestilence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">or famine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and in thy presence</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in this house</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">unto thee in our affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then thou wilt hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and help</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And now, behold, the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">and mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou wouldest not let</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">invade</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">from them, and destroyed</w> them not;

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:11
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">I say</transChange>, <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">us, to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cast us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03425">of thy possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which thou hast given us to inherit</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou not judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">them? for we have no might</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">company</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against us; neither know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0587">we</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what to do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">but our eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon thee.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01571">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">their little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their children</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03166">Then upon Jahaziel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01141">of Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03273">of Jeiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04983">of Mattaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">a Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">came the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the congregation</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">ye, all Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and thou king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto you, Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04421">for the battle</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not yours, but God’s</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04279">To morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go ye down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against them: behold, they come up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">by the cliff</w> <w lemma="strong:H06732">of Ziz</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ye shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05490">them at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brook</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03385">of Jeruel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cliff</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascent</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>brook</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">valley</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:17
verses.text: Ye shall not <transChange type="added">need</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">in this</w> <transChange type="added">battle</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yourselves, stand</w> ye <transChange type="added">still</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">with you, O Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not, nor be dismayed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them: for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> with you.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bowed</w> his head with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">worshipping</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07145">of the Korhites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">on high</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they rose early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08620">of Tekoa</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and as they went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03092">Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">me, O Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and ye inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so shall ye be established</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">his prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">so shall ye prosper</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And when he had consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and that should praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01927">the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holiness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">as they went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">praisers</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">And when</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they began</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">to sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">and to praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ambushments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which were come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and they were smitten</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>And when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">And in the time that they</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>to sing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in singing and praise</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they were…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they smote one another</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04124">and Moab</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">utterly to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and destroy</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and when they had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">another</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the destruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And when Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04708 strong:H04707" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">toward the watch tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">unto the multitude</w>, and, behold, they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06297">dead bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06413">and none escaped</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there was not an escaping</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">And when Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">among them in abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">both riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H06297">with the dead bodies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">which they stripped off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0369">for themselves, more than</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">they could carry away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07969">and they were three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in gathering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">of the spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">it was so much</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07243">And on the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">themselves in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01294">of Berachah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for there they blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">therefore the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of the same place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06010">The valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01294">of Berachah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Berachah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">blessing</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03092">and Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the forefront</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them, to go again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had made them to rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over their enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forefront</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">head</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">with psalteries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">and trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">And the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">was on all the kingdoms</w> of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">countries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04438">So the realm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was quiet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave him rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03092">And Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w>: <transChange type="added">he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05806">Azubah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07977">of Shilhi</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not from it, doing</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01116">Howbeit the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were not taken away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for as yet the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had not prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">their hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02607">of Hanani</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">mentioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>book of Jehu</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>is mentioned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was made to ascend</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:35
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">this did Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">join</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">himself with Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">who did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">very wickedly</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">himself with him to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">to Tarshish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H06100">in Ezion–geber</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 20:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0461">Then Eliezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01735">of Dodavah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04762">of Mareshah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05012" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">against Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">Because thou hast joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">thyself with Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thy works</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0591">And the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they were not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">to Tarshish</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen429" osisID="2Chr.20"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03092">Now Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03088">And Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And he had brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">and Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04317">and Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08203">and Shephatiah</w>: all these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">them great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04030">and of precious things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04694">with fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04467">but the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">he to Jehoram</w>; because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03088">Now when Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">to the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">all his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>, and <transChange type="added">divers</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">also of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03088">Jehoram</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">like as did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01323">for he had the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he wrought</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Howbeit the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">because of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">with David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and as he promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to him and to his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>light</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lamp</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">revolted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under the dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">themselves a king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dominion</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03088">Then Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">with his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">and all his chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him: and he rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which compassed him in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">of the chariots</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0123">So the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">revolted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06256">The same time</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03841">did Libnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">revolt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from under his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he had forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and caused the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to commit fornication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and compelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <transChange type="added">thereto</transChange>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04385">a writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0452">to him from Elijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast not walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">nor in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H0609">of Asa</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But hast walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and hast made Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to go a whoring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">like to the whoredoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and also hast slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">thy brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> than thyself:

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">Behold, with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04046">plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">will the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and thy children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and thy wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and all thy goods</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a great stroke</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:15
verses.text: And thou <transChange type="added">shalt have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">sickness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04245">by disease</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">of thy bowels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04578">until thy bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">by reason of the sickness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Moreover the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stirred up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">against Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">of the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06163">and of the Arabians</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H05921">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H03569">the Ethiopians</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">into Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">into it, and carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">all the substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">also, and his wives</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">so that there was never a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">him, save Jehoahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">the youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his sons</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>carried…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">carried captive</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoahaz</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ahaziah</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Azariah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">all this the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">him in his bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04832 strong:H0369">with an incurable</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">disease</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass, that in process of time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256 strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">of two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04578">his bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">of his sickness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he died</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08463">diseases</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">no burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08316">for him, like the burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 21:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07970">Thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">years old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was he when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">without being desired</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Howbeit they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06913">but not in the sepulchres</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>without…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">without desire</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen430" osisID="2Chr.21"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-250">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">his youngest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-250">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">in his stead: for the band of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06163">with the Arabians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">to the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">all the eldest</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0274">So Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">of Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">Forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0274">Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">His mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06271">Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06018">of Omri</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He also walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0517">for his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was his counsellor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do wickedly</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore he did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">like the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for they were his counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H04889">to his destruction</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">also after their counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">with Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">against Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01568 strong:H07433">at Ramoth–gilead</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07421">and the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">Joram</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to be healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">in Jezreel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">because of the wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which were given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07414">him at Ramah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">when he fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02371">with Hazael</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">of Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H03157">at Jezreel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because he was sick</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wherewith they wounded him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Azariah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Ahaziah</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Jehoahaz</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08395">And the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">was of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by coming</w> <w lemma="strong:H03141">to Joram</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for when he was come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">with Jehoram</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">against Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05250">of Nimshi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destruction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">treading down</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03058">And it came to pass, that, when Jehu</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was executing judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0256">of Ahab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of the brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">to Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he slew</w> them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And he sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">Ahaziah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">him, (for he was hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">in Samaria</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">him to Jehu</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when they had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: Because, said</w> they, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03092">of Jehoshaphat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all his heart</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01004">So the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">had no power</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">still the kingdom</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06271">But when Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">the mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that her son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">all the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03090">But Jehoshabeath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stole</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">him from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that were slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him and his nurse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296 strong:H02315">in a bedchamber</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03090">So Jehoshabeath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03088">Jehoram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H0269">for she was the sister</w> <w lemma="strong:H0274">of Ahaziah</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him from</w> <w lemma="strong:H06271">Athaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">so that she slew</w> him not.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoshabeath</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jehosheba</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And he was with them hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06271">and Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the land</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen431" osisID="2Chr.22"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">and Ishmael</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03076">of Jehohanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">and Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05744">of Obed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">and Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05718">of Adaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0478">and Elishaphat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02147">of Zichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">into covenant</w> with him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they went about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">out of all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto them, Behold, the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:4
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye shall do</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07992">A third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of you entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and of the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07778">porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the doors</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>doors</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thresholds</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">And a third part</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07992">and a third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">of the foundation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But let none come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">save the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they that minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall go in</w>, for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">but all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shall compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with his weapons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>; and whosoever <transChange type="added">else</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">he shall be put to death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">but be ye with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he cometh in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when he goeth out</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">So the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">according to all things that Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">his men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that were to come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that were to go</w> <transChange type="added">out</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03077">for Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06358" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dismissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">not the courses</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03077">Moreover Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">to the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04043">and bucklers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07982">and shields</w>, that <transChange type="added">had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07973">having his weapon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03233">from the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H08042">to the left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">along by the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>side</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>temple</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then they brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">upon him the crown</w>, and <transChange type="added">gave him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made him king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03077">And Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">God save</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let the king live</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06271">Now when Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">running</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and praising</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and, behold, the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">at his pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">at the entering in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">and the trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">also the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of musick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and such as taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sing praise</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06271">Then Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">her clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07195">Treason</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07195">Treason</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Treason</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Conspiracy</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03077">Then Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that were set over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">the host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto them, Have her forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07713 strong:H01004">of the ranges</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and whoso followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">her, let him be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03548">For the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">her not in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on her; and when she was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">to the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they slew</w> her there.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03077">And Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">between him, and between all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and between the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">that they should be the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Then all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake it down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-251">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">his altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">and his images</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-251">in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04977">Mattan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03077">Also Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">the offices</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had distributed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">with rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">and with singing</w>, <transChange type="added">as it was ordained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as it was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hands of David</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">the porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, that none <transChange type="added">which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in any thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should enter in</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">of hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">and the nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">through</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">of the kingdom</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 23:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was quiet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">after that they had slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06271">Athaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen432" osisID="2Chr.23"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">Joash</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">His mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06645">Zibiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0884">of Beer–sheba</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">And Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03077">And Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">for him two</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he begat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">And it came to pass after</w> this, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03101">Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">was minded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to repair</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to renew</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">to them, Go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">to year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and see that ye hasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03881">Howbeit the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hastened</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">for Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Why hast thou not required</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">out of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and out of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">the collection</w>, <transChange type="added">according to the commandment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">for the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of witness</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06271">of Athaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04849">that wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">woman, had broken up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06944">and also all the dedicated things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did they bestow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">upon Baalim</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And at the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">chest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">it without</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">through Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">the collection</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">laid</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a proclamation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">into the chest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">until they had made an end</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">Now it came to pass, that at what time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the chest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">office</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when they saw</w> that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">and the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06496">officer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and emptied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">the chest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-252">it, and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">it to his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-252">again</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">and Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it to such as did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">masons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02796">and carpenters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">and also such as wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">and brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to mend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H04399" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">So the workmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">and the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was</w> <w lemma="strong:H0724">perfected</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04971">in his state</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and strengthened</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>the work…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the healing went up upon the work</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when they had finished</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07605">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">and Jehoiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whereof were made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08335">to minister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to offer</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and spoons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to offer…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pestils</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03077">But Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">waxed old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he died</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">was he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">when he died</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:16
