verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">among the kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">both toward God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and toward his house</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and made obeisance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hearkened</w> unto them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">and idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07110">and wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">came upon Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">for this their trespass</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to them, to bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">against them: but they would not give ear</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">And the Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">upon Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">above the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Why transgress</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">ye the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that ye cannot prosper</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because ye have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he hath also forsaken</w> you.<note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">clothed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, and stoned</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">him with stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">Thus Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">not the kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">which Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, but slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04194">And when he died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">look</w> upon <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and require</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08622">And it came to pass at the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him: and they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">all the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from among the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">all the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of them unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the revolution of the year</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Damascus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Darmesek</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">For the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of the Syrians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04705">with a small</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">company of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">host</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into their hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they had forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">So they executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08201">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">against Joash</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when they were departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from him, (for they left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">him in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04251">diseases</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H05650">his own servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">against him for the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03077">of Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">him on his bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">him not in the sepulchres</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And these are they that conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02066">against him; Zabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08100">of Shimeath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05985">an Ammonitess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03075">and Jehozabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08116">of Shimrith</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">a Moabitess</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zabad</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Jozacher</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shimrith</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shomer</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 24:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230 strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">and the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">of the burdens</w> <transChange type="added">laid</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03247">upon him, and the repairing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H04097">in the story</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0558">And Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>repairing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">founding</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>story</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">commentary</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen433" osisID="2Chr.24"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03086">Jehoaddan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08003">but not with a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04467">Now it came to pass, when the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was established</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, that he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that had killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>established…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">confirmed upon him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not their children</w>, but <transChange type="added">did</transChange> as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">where the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">The fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">neither shall the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for the fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">but every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">for his own sin</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0558">Moreover Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-253">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-253">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">them captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">over thousands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">over hundreds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">according to the houses</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">throughout all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he numbered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">them from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">them three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">choice</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <transChange type="added">able</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that could handle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">and shield</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">also an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">men of valour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">for an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">let not the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with thee; for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">not with Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But if thou wilt go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for the battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall make thee fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to cast down</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0558">And Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But what shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">for the hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">to the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0376">And the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">is</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">able to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">thee much more</w> than this.<note type="study"><catchWord>army</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">band</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0558">Then Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">separated</w> them, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01416">the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">to him out of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-254">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-254">again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0639">wherefore their anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">against Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H02750">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>home again</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to their place</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in heat of anger</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0558">And Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and led forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">to the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:12
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">left</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">did the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">carry away captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">them unto the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that they all were broken in pieces</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">But the soldiers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">of the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">which Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">sent back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should not go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">with him to battle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08111">from Samaria</w> <w lemma="strong:H01032">even unto Beth–horon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0961">spoil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the soldiers…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of the band</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">Now it came to pass, after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">that Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">from the slaughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">of the Edomites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08165">of Seir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set them up</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">himself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and burned incense</w> unto them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">Wherefore the anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">against Amaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">unto him a prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Why hast thou sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">after the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which could not deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">their own people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of thine hand</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And it came to pass, as he talked</w> with him, that <transChange type="added">the king</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Art thou made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsel</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forbear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">why shouldest thou be smitten</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05030">Then the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forbare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, because thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this, and hast not hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">unto my counsel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>determined</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">counselled</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0558">Then Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">took advice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">to Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03058">of Jehu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">let us see one another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the face</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">And Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">to Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02336">The thistle</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">to the cedar</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">thy daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to my son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there passed by</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">a wild</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beast</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trode down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02336">the thistle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thistle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">furze bush</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">thorn</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a wild…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a beast of the field</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Lo, thou hast smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">the Edomites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">and thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lifteth thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to boast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">now at home</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">why shouldest thou meddle</w> to <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou shouldest fall</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">thou, and Judah</w> with thee?

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0558">But Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not hear</w>; for it <transChange type="added">came</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he might deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <transChange type="added">of their enemies</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">after the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">So Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they saw one another</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the face</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0558">he and Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01053">at Beth–shemesh</w>, which <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">to Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was put to the worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">to his tent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smitten</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03101">And Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01053">at Beth–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">him to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">from the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the corner…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the gate of it that looketh</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:24
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">he took</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">all the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05654">with Obed–edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08594 strong:H01121">the hostages</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also, and returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0558">And Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">the death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03101">of Joash</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">of Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">fifteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">of Amaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, behold, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">Now after the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">that Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07195">a conspiracy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against him in Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">to Lachish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03923">to Lachish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and slew</w> him there.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">conspired a conspiracy</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 25:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">him upon horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Judah</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the city of David</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen434" osisID="2Chr.25"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Then all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">Uzziah</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in the room of his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Uzziah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Azariah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He built</w> <w lemma="strong:H0359">Eloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and restored</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">it to Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">Sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05818">Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">His mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03203">Jecoliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0558">Amaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And he sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who had understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">made him to prosper</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the visions…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the seeing of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and warred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">against the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">of Gath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02996">of Jabneh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">of Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0795">about Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">and among the Philistines</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>about…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the country of Ashdod</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06430">him against the Philistines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06163">and against the Arabians</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01485">in Gur–baal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04586">and the Mehunims</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05984">And the Ammonites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">to Uzziah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spread abroad</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the entering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he strengthened</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">exceedingly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spread…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05818">Moreover Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">towers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">at the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01516">and at the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04740">and at the turning</w> <transChange type="added">of the wall</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and fortified</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>fortified</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">repaired</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">towers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">wells</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">for he had much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08219">both in the low country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04334">and in the plains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0406">husbandmen</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03755">and vine dressers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03760">and in Carmel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">husbandry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>digged…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cut out many cisterns</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Carmel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fruitful fields</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>husbandry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ground</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05818">Moreover Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">had an host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of fighting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">to war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">by bands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">of their account</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03273">of Jeiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">and Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the ruler</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">of Hananiah</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">The whole number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And under their hand</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635 strong:H02428">an army</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">with mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the enemy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an army</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the power of an army</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05818">And Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for them throughout all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">shields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07420">and spears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03553">and helmets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08302">and habergeons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">and bows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07050">and slings</w> <transChange type="added">to cast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slings…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stones of slings</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02810">engines</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04284">invented</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">by cunning men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">to be on the towers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">and upon the bulwarks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">withal. And his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far abroad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he was marvellously</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">helped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he was strong</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spread</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">went forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02393">But when he was strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was lifted up</w> to <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">destruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">into the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">of incense</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">him, and with him fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">that were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they withstood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">It appertaineth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05818">not unto thee, Uzziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">but to the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">that are consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn incense</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast trespassed</w>; neither <transChange type="added">shall it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">for thine honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05818">Then Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02196" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was wroth</w>, and <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04730">a censer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to burn incense</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02196" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and while he was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">with the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06883">the leprosy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">even rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">in his forehead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07004">from beside the incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and all the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looked</w> upon him, and, behold, he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">leprous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04696">in his forehead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they thrust him out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01765" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">from thence; yea, himself hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">also to go out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had smitten</w> him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05818">And Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">was a leper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of his death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02669 strong:H02669" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">a several</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">a leper</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for he was cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03147">and Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">over the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judging</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>several</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">free</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03470">did Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">write</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 26:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05818">So Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">him with his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06900">of the burial</w> which <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the kings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they said</w>, He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06879" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">a leper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03147">and Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen435" osisID="2Chr.26"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03147">Jotham</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">His mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> also <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03388">Jerushah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">according to all that his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">Uzziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">howbeit he entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">not into the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">did yet corruptly</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and on the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06077">of Ophel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">much</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ophel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the tower</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02793">and in the forests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01003">castles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">and towers</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">He fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">also with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05984">of the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and prevailed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against them. And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">him the same year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">of barley</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">So much did the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05983">of Ammon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H02063">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">him, both the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07992">and the third</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>So…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">This</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03147">So Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">became mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because he prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prepared</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">established</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03147">of Jotham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and all his wars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and his ways</w>, lo, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02568">He was five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 27:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03147">And Jotham</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0271">and Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen436" osisID="2Chr.27"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">sixteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he did</w> not <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">like David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he walked in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">also molten images</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baalim</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Moreover he burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">after the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>burnt…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">offered sacrifice</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also and burnt incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">in the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and on the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07488">and under every green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">tree</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Wherefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">of them captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01834">to Damascus</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And he was also delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">him with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">slaughter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Damascus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Darmesek</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06492">For Pekah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07425">of Remaliah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">all valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">because they had forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>valiant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of valour</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02147">And Zichri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05840">and Azrikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0511">and Elkanah</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04932">next</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>next…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the second to the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">carried away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and took also away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from them, and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05030">But a prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">was there, whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05752">Oded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto them, Behold, because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">with Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into your hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02197">them in a rage</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">reacheth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto heaven</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And now ye purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep under</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for bondmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and bondwomen</w> unto you: <transChange type="added">but are there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07535">not with you, even</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">with you, sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me therefore, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">again, which ye have taken captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of your brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02740">for the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> upon you.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Then certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03076">of Johanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01296">Berechiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04919">of Meshillemoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03169">and Jehizkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06021">and Amasa</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02311">of Hadlai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against them that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">from the war</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto them, Ye shall not bring in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">hither: for whereas we have offended</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">already</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye intend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to add</w> <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">to our sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">and to our trespass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0819">for our trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">is great</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02740">fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">So the armed men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">the captives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0961">and the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which were expressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">the captives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07998">and with the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04636">all that were naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">among them, and arrayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05274" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and shod</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and gave them to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05480" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">of them upon asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">them to Jericho</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05899 strong:H08558" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of palm trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0681">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">to Samaria</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">At that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">did king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0130">For again the Edomites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">captives</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>captives</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a captivity</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06430">The Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also had invaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08219">of the low country</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05045">and of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01053">Beth–shemesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0357">and Ajalon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01450">and Gederoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07755">and Shocho</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H08553">thereof, and Timnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">with the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H01579">thereof, Gimzo</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">also and the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof: and they dwelt</w> there.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-255">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-255">low</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">because of Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-256">for he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-256">naked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08407">And Tilgath–pilneser</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and distressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, but strengthened</w> him not.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">For Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took away a portion</w> <transChange type="added">out</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">out</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and of the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05833">but he helped</w> him not.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06256">And in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of his distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">did he trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: this <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01834">of Damascus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Because the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0758">of Syria</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">help</w> them, <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to them, that they may help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me. But they were the ruin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of him, and of all Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Damascus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Darmesek</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">And Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">him altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">in every corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05892">And in every several city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and provoked to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to burn</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to offer</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:26
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of his acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">and of all his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 28:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0271">And Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him in the city</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">him not into the sepulchres</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03169">and Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen437" osisID="2Chr.28"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to reign</w> <transChange type="added">when he was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0517">And his mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H029">Abijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zechariah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">according to all that David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had done</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:3
