verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07223">He in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and repaired</w> them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered them together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">into the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">street</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">me, ye Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">now yourselves, and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and carry forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">the filthiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">out of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">For our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have trespassed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and done</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and have turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">from the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turned</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203">backs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>turned their…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">given the neck</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Also they have shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">of the porch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the lamps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and have not burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07110">Wherefore the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">was upon Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02113 strong:H02189" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">them to trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08047">to astonishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08322">and to hissing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with your eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trouble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">commotion</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">For, lo, our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and our sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and our daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and our wives</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07628">in captivity</w> for this.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:10
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02740">that his fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may turn away</w> from us.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07952" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be not now negligent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him, to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him, and that ye should minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto him, and burn incense</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be not…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be not now deceived</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>burn…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">offer sacrifice</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03881">Then the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04287">Mahath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06022">of Amasai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03100">and Joel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the Kohathites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07027">Kish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05660">of Abdi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">and Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03094">of Jehalelel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01649">and of the Gershonites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03098">Joah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02155">of Zimmah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05731">and Eden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03098">of Joah</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0469">of Elizaphan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08113">Shimri</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03273">and Jeiel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04983">and Mattaniah</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01968">of Heman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03171">Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03038">of Jeduthun</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05816">and Uzziel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves, and came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">by the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by the words…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the business of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">into the inner part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cleanse</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">all the uncleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">into the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">took</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, to carry <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">into the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Now they began</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">on the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sanctify</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08083">and on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0197">they to the porch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so they sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">in eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08337">and in the sixteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">day of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they made an end</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">to Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">We have cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">with all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04635">thereof, and the shewbread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">table</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">with all the vessels</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627">Moreover all the vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">which king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0271">Ahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">in his reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">in his transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have we prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and sanctified</w>, and, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03169">Then Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rose early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06842">he</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795">goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">for a sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">for the kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04720">and for the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and for Judah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">the bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sprinkled</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">on the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">likewise, when they had killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">the rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">also the lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08163">the he goats</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">and the congregation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> upon them:<note type="study"><catchWord>forth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">near</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and they made reconciliation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">commanded</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and the sin offering</w> <transChange type="added">should be made</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04700">with cymbals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">with psalteries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03658">and with harps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01410">and of Gad</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">seer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>: for <transChange type="added">so was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">his prophets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandment of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">commandment by the hand of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">And the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06256">And when</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">the song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with the trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and with the instruments</w> <transChange type="added">ordained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the time</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the instruments</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands of instruments</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">worshipped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">and the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">sang</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02689">and the trumpeters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02690 strong:H02690" morph="strongMorph:TH8764 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8688">sounded</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> all <transChange type="added">this continued</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">until the burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was finished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>singers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">song</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">And when they had made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and all that were present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">themselves, and worshipped</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">Moreover Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sing praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">with the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0623">and of Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">the seer</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they sang praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they bowed their heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">Then Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Now ye have consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">yourselves unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">and thank offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H06951">And the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">and thank offerings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05081">and as many as were of a free</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consecrated…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">filled your hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">And the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of the burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">which the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">was threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w>: all these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06944">And the consecrated things</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">But the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">were too few</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not flay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">all the burnt offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0251">wherefore their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">did help</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">them, till the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was ended</w>, and until the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">had sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">themselves: for the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">more upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">themselves than the priests</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>did help…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strengthened them</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05930">And also the burnt offerings</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02459">with the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">of the peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05262">and the drink offerings</w> for <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05656">So the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was set in order</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 29:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">for the thing</w> was <transChange type="added">done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen438" osisID="2Chr.29"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">also to Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">had taken counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">it at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">because the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">had not sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767 strong:H04078" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">themselves sufficiently</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">neither had the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was right in the eyes of the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So they established</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to make proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">throughout all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0884">from Beer–sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H01835">even to Dan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they had not done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">of a long</w> <transChange type="added">time in such sort</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as it was written</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">So the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">with the letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">throughout all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03327">Isaac</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">of you, that are escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And be not ye like your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and like your brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore gave them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08047">to desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as ye see</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06203 strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Now be ye not stiffnecked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as your fathers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">yourselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into his sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he hath sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02740">that the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may turn away</w> from you.<note type="study"><catchWord>be ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">harden not your necks</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>yield…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">For if ye turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and your children</w> <transChange type="added">shall find</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07356">compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that lead them captive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so that they shall come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">into this land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07349">and merciful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will not turn away</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from you, if ye return</w> unto him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">So the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the country</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">even unto Zebulun</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but they laughed them to scorn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and mocked</w> them.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Nevertheless divers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0836">of Asher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">and of Zebulun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves, and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Also in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">them one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and of the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And there assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999">and all the altars for incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">took they away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05158">into the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06939">Kidron</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">on the fourteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">themselves, and brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">in their place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">after their manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">according to the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w>, <transChange type="added">which they received</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their place</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their standing</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:17
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">that were not sanctified</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">therefore the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07821">had the charge of the killing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">of the passovers</w> for every one <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">not clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to sanctify</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04768">For a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03485">Issachar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02074">and Zebulun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03808">had not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">themselves, yet did they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">otherwise than it was written</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03169">But Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for them, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">The good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">pardon</w> every one

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">prepareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>, though <transChange type="added">he be</transChange> not <transChange type="added">cleansed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02893">according to the purification</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">to Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">gladness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w>, <transChange type="added">singing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">with loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>loud…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">instruments of strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">comfortably</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto all the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">throughout the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and making confession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>comfortably…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the heart of all</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And the whole assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">took counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">other</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they kept</w> <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with gladness</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02396">For Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">to the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">to the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">and a great number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">sanctified</w> themselves.<note type="study"><catchWord>did give</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifted up</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">offered</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>gave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifted up</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">offered</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">with the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">and all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">So there was great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for since the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">not the like in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 30:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">Then the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06963">and their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08605">and their prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <transChange type="added">up</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">to his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04583">dwelling place</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his holy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the habitation of his holiness</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen439" osisID="2Chr.30"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Now when all this was finished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-257">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04676">the images</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-257">in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">the groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and threw down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and the altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">out of all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">in Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">also and Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">until they had utterly destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them all. Then all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">to his possession</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">into their own cities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>images</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">statues</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>until…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">until to make an end</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:2
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">the courses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">after their courses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">to his service</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">and for peace offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to minister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to give thanks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He appointed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">also the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04521">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">of his substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for the burnt offerings</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">for the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">and evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">and the burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">for the sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">and for the new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and for the set feasts</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04521">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they might be encouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">And as soon as the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01706">and honey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08393">and of all the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04643">and the tithe</w> of all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">they in abundantly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">brake forth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>honey</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dates</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they also brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04643">and the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holy things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">which were consecrated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06194 strong:H06194">by heaps</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by heaps</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heaps, heaps</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">In the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they began</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lay the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">of the heaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and finished</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">And when Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">the heaps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">Then Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">questioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">with the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">concerning the heaps</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and said</w>, Since <transChange type="added">the people</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">we have had enough</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and have left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">plenty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that which is left</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01995">this great store</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03169">Then Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they prepared</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>,<note type="study"><catchWord>chambers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">storehouses</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">and the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the dedicated</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithfully</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03562">over which Cononiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levite</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">ruler</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04932">the next</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03171">And Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05812">and Azaziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05184">and Nahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06214">and Asahel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">and Jerimoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03107">and Jozabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0447">and Eliel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03253">and Ismachiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04287">and Mahath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06496">overseers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03562">of Cononiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04662">at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">and Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>under…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06981">And Kore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03232">of Imnah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">the porter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the east</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05071">over the freewill offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to distribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the oblations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:15
verses.text: And next him <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05731">Eden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04509">and Miniamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03442">and Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">and Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0568">Amariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07935">and Shecaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">set office</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">courses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">as well to the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">as to the small</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>next…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at his hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trust</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">Beside their genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of males</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">from three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto every one that entereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">his daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for their service</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">in their charges</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">according to their courses</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">Both to the genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">in their charges</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">by their courses</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">And to the genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">of all their little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06951">through all the congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0530">for in their set office</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">themselves in holiness</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trust</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Also of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H04054">of the suburbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">in every several city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that were expressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">to all the males</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">among the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and to all that were reckoned by genealogies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">among the Levites</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">throughout all Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wrought</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 31:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">And in every work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he began</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">in the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and in the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">and in the commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he did</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and prospered</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen440" osisID="2Chr.31"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">and the establishment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">thereof, Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">into Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and encamped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to win</w> them for himself.<note type="study"><catchWord>to win…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to break them up</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">And when Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">that Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and that he was purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>he was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his face was to war</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">He took counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">with his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">and his mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stop</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of the fountains</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they did help</w> him.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-258">So there was gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735" type="x-split-258">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who stopped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">all the fountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">and the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">through the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Why should the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and find</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>ran</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">overflowed</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Also he strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself, and built up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">all the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that was broken</w>, and raised <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">to the towers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04407">Millo</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07973">darts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>darts</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">swords</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">weapons</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered them together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">to him in the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">comfortably</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to them, saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>spake…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he spoke to their heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and courageous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor dismayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">nor for all the multitude</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with him: for <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">more</w> with us than with him:

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:8
verses.text: With him <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02220">an arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of flesh</w>; but with us <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">us, and to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">our battles</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">themselves upon the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rested…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">leaned</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">this did Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, (but he <transChange type="added">himself laid siege</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03923">against Lachish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04475">and all his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">with him,) unto Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and unto all Judah</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dominion</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whereon do ye trust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that ye abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">in the siege</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>siege</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strong hold</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">Doth not Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">persuade</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">over yourselves to die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">by famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">and by thirst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">us out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hath not the same Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">his high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">and his altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Ye shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and burn incense</w> upon it?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">ye not what I and my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> of <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">lands</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0430">were the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of those lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">any ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:14
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">was there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">among all the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of those nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">that my fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">utterly destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of mine hand</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03808">Now therefore let not</w> <w lemma="strong:H02396">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you, nor persuade</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">you on this manner, neither yet believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">him: for no god</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of any nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">or kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">how much less shall your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you out of mine hand</w>?

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> yet <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and against his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">also letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to rail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">As the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> of <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have not delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">their people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">so shall not the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">of Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of mine hand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03066">in the Jews’ speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to affright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, and to trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them; that they might take</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">as against the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:20
