verses.text: And for this <transChange type="added">cause</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to heaven</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">an angel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">all the mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">and the leaders</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">in the camp</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">with shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to his own land</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when he was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his god</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03329">they that came forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">of his own bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">him there with the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made him fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Thus the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05576">of Sennacherib</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and from the hand</w> of all <transChange type="added">other</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and guided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">them on every side</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04030">and presents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">to Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so that he was magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from thenceforth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>presents</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">precious things</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was sick</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to the death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, and he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">him a sign</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wrought a miracle for him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">But Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">rendered not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">according to the benefit</w> <transChange type="added">done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto him; for his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was lifted up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07110">therefore there was wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">upon him, and upon Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">Notwithstanding Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">himself for the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07110">so that the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not upon them in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">of Hezekiah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pride</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifting up</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">had exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">himself treasuries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and for gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">and for precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01314">and for spices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04043">and for shields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">and for all manner of pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">instruments of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04543">Storehouses</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">also for the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">and wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and oil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0723">and stalls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">for all manner of beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0220">and cotes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">for flocks</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Moreover he provided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">him cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and possessions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">and herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">him substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">This same Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also stopped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the upper</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325 strong:H04161">watercourse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01521">of Gihon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and brought it straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04628">to the west side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">prospered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in all his works</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03651">Howbeit</w> in <transChange type="added">the business of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the ambassadors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">who sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">of the wonder</w> that was <transChange type="added">done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">him, to try</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him, that he might know</w> all <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in his heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ambassadors</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">interpreters</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:32
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">of Hezekiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">and his goodness</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">in the vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">of Isaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0531">of Amoz</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>goodness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">kindnesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 32:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03169">And Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">him in the chiefest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">of the sepulchres</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did him</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">at his death</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04519">And Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>chiefest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">highest</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen441" osisID="2Chr.32"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">like unto the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H03169">which Hezekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had broken down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he reared up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">for Baalim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>he built…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he returned and built</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Also he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whereof the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">In Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">shall my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">be for ever</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">for all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">in the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-259">And he caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-259">to pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02011">of Hinnom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06049" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">also he observed times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05172" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and used enchantments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03784" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and used witchcraft</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">with a familiar spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03049">and with wizards</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to provoke him to anger</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">a carved image</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05566">the idol</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">of which God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">and to Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">In this house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">before all the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05865">for ever</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Neither will I any more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">the foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">from out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which I have appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">for your fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0518">so that</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they will take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">all that I have commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">them, according to the whole law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">and the statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04519">So Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-260">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-260">to err</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">worse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">than the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">to Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but they would not hearken</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Wherefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">upon them the captains of</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">the host of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02336">among the thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound him</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">with fetters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the king</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which were the king’s</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fetters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chains</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And when he was in affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">himself greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto him: and he was intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of him, and heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">his supplication</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">into his kingdom</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04519">Then Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now after this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04628">on the west side</w> <w lemma="strong:H01521">of Gihon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">in the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">even to the entering in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">at the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06077">about Ophel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and raised it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very great height</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of war</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">in all the fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ophel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the tower</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05566">and the idol</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04196">and all the altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">in the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08002">thereon peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">and thank offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H061">Nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">still in the high places</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> only.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08605">and his prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">of the seers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to him in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are written</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08605">His prayer</w> also, and <transChange type="added">how God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of him, and all his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04604">and his trespass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and the places</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">groves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">and graven images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">he was humbled</w>: behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">among the sayings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02335 strong:H02374" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of the seers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the seers</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Hosai</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04519">So Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with his fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him in his own house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0526">and Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0526">Amon</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">as did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0526">for Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">unto all the carved images</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">which Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and served</w> them;

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">And humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not himself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">as Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">had humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">himself; but Amon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">more and more</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trespassed more and more</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiplied trespass</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">And his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against him, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him in his own house</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 33:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">But the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all them that had conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0526">Amon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-261">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-261">king</w> in his stead. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen442" osisID="2Chr.33"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and declined</w> <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">to the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08040">nor to the left</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08083">For in the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">while he was yet young</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he began</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">after the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">and in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he began</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to purge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">from the high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0842">and the groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06456">and the carved images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04541">and the molten images</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01168">of Baalim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his presence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02553">and the images</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">on high above them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he cut down</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0842">and the groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06456">and the carved images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04541">and the molten images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he brake in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and made dust</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and strowed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">the graves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that had sacrificed</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>the images</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the sun images</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>graves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">face of the graves</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon their altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">so did he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08095">and Simeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05321">even unto Naphtali</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">with their mattocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mattocks</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mauls</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And when he had broken down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0842">and the groves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and had beaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">the graven images</w> <w lemma="strong:H01854" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">into powder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02553">all the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">throughout all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to make powder</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">Now in the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he had purged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0683">of Azaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">and Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03098">and Joah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03099">of Joahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the recorder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">to Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that was brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">which the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">of Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">and Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07611">and of all the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and of all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">and they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they put</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the workmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that had the oversight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it to the workmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0918" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and amend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02796">Even to the artificers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and builders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> they <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04274">hewn</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">and timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H04226">for couplings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to floor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">which the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to floor</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to rafter</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">And the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithfully</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and the overseers</w> of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03189">Jahath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05662">and Obadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">and Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06956">of the sons of the Kohathites</w>, to set <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">forward</w>; and <transChange type="added">other of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">all that could skill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of musick</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:13
verses.text: Also <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05449">over the bearers of burdens</w>, and <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">overseers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all that wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">in any manner of service</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">and of the Levites</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and officers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">and porters</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And when they brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">that was brought into</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">a book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02518">And Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">to Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H02518">And Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">to Shaphan</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08227">And Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-262">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-262">back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">again, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">All that was committed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the hand of</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they have gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">of the overseers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and to the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the workmen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gathered together</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">poured out</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">melted</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08227">Then Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">me a book</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08227">And Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">it before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>it</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in it</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it came to pass, when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0296">and Ahikam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">of Shaphan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05658">and Abdon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04318">of Micah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08227">and Shaphan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06222">and Asaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Abdon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Achbor</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for me, and for them that are left</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that is poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">upon us, because our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">after all that is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02518">And Hilkiah</w>, and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <transChange type="added">had appointed</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02468">to Huldah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05031">the prophetess</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08445 strong:H08616" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of Tikvath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02641">of Hasrah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of the wardrobe</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">now she dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">in the college</w>:) <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they spake</w> to her to that <transChange type="added">effect</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hasrah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Harhas</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wardrobe</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">garments</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in the college</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the school</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">in the second part</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And she answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">ye the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that sent</w> you to me,

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Behold, I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon the inhabitants</w> thereof, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0423">all the curses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they have read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>:

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06999 strong:H06999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8762">me, and have burned incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto other</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they might provoke me to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with all the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02534">therefore my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not be quenched</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0413">And as for</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">you to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall ye say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast heard</w>;

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">Because thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was tender</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and thou didst humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thyself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">against this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof, and humbledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thyself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and didst rend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">thy clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me; I have even heard</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">also, saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, I will gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thee to thy fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and thou shalt be gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">to thy grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">neither shall thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that I will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">upon this place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and upon the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-263">of the same. So they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-263">again</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:29
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">all the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and small</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he read</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in their ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from great even to small</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">in his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05715">and his testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and with all his soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which are written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in this book</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And he caused all that were present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to stand</w> <transChange type="added">to it</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">according to the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 34:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02977">And Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">all the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of all the countries</w> that <transChange type="added">pertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and made all that were present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to serve</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>. <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">not from following</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from after</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen443" osisID="2Chr.34"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02977">Moreover Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">a passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">on the fourteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">in their charges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and encouraged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">them to the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04000 strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8688">that taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">which were holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0727">ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">which Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did build</w>; <transChange type="added">it shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04853">a burden</w> upon <transChange type="added">your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">shoulders</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">now the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559 strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8734 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8685">And prepare</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">by the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04256">after your courses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03791">according to the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04385">and according to the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And stand in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06391">according to the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of your brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971 strong:H01121">the people</w>, and <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02515">the division</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004 strong:H01">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the families of the fathers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the house of the fathers</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the people</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of the people</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">So kill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">yourselves, and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w>, that <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02977">And Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971 strong:H01121">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05795 strong:H01121">and kids</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06453">all for the passover offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">for all that were present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">of thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">bullocks</w>: these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07399">substance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">offered</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">to the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and to the Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02518">Hilkiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05057">rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">for the passover offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">small cattle</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave willingly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">offered</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03562">Conaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">also, and Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05417">and Nethaneel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02811">and Hashabiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03273">and Jeiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03107">and Jozabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">for passover offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <transChange type="added">small cattle</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">oxen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">offered</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05656">So the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was prepared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">in their place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04256">in their courses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">according to the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandment</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sprinkled</w> <transChange type="added">the blood</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">flayed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">the burnt offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they might give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04653">according to the divisions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004 strong:H01">of the families</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971 strong:H01121">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>. And so <transChange type="added">did they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01241">with the oxen</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they roasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the ordinance</w>: but the <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <transChange type="added">offerings</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">sod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">they in pots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01731">and in caldrons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06745">and in pans</w>, and divided <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971 strong:H01121">among all the people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>divided…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made them run</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they made ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for themselves, and for the priests</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03548">because the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <transChange type="added">were busied</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">of burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">and the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">until night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03881">therefore the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for themselves, and for the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">And the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04612">in their place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0623">and Asaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01968">and Heman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03038">and Jeduthun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02374">seer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w> <transChange type="added">waited</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at every gate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they might not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">from their service</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0251">for their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">prepared</w> for them.<note type="study"><catchWord>place</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">station</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05656">So all the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the same day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were present</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">and the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06453">And there was no passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">to that kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08050">of Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">such a passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">as Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">In the eighteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">was this passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">kept</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">all this, when Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05224">Necho</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03751">against Carchemish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06578">by Euphrates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02977">and Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>temple</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">ambassadors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">What have I to do with thee, thou king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>? <transChange type="added">I come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not against thee this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">but against the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">wherewith I have war</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me to make haste</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forbear</w> thee from <transChange type="added">meddling with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with me, that he destroy</w> thee not.<note type="study"><catchWord>the house…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the house of my war</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02977">Nevertheless Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">would not turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">from him, but disguised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">himself, that he might fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with him, and hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not unto the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05224">of Necho</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04023">of Megiddo</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And the archers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">Josiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Have me away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03966">for I am sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">wounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wounded</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made sick</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">His servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04818">him out of that chariot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">him in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H07393">chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he had; and they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">him to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he died</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was buried</w> in <transChange type="added">one of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06913">the sepulchres</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03063">And all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">for Josiah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in one…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">among the sepulchres</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:25
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03414">And Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06969" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">lamented</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">for Josiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the singing men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the singing women</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">in their lamentations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">them an ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>: and, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H07015">in the lamentations</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">and his goodness</w>, according to <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>goodness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">kindnesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 35:27
