verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And his deeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">and last</w>, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen444" osisID="2Chr.35"/>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Then the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03059">Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02977">of Josiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">in his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">stead in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03099">Jehoahaz</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">put him down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and condemned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">in an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">and a talent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">removed him</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0471">made Eliakim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">to Jehoiakim</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05224">And Necho</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03099">Jehoahaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">him to Egypt</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03079">Jehoiakim</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Against him came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">him in fetters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fetters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chains</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">of the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">them in his temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">at Babylon</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Now the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03079">of Jehoiakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">and his abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and that which was found</w> in him, behold, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03078">and Jehoiachin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reigned</w> in his stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jehoiachin</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jeconiah</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Coniah</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03078">Jehoiachin</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08141">And when the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08666">was expired</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">him to Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">with the goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06667">and made Zedekiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">over Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the return of the year</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>goodly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vessels of desire</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Zedekiah…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Mattaniah, his father’s brother</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06667">Zedekiah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he began to reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and reigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0259">eleven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he did</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not himself before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <transChange type="added">speaking</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And he also rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05019">Nebuchadnezzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who had made him swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">by God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but he stiffened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">his neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from turning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08269">Moreover all the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">after all the abominations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he had hallowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to them by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">his messengers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">rising up betimes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and sending</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he had compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">on his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04583">and on his dwelling place</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>betimes</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">continually and carefully</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03931" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">But they mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">the messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08591" morph="strongMorph:TH8700">and misused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">his prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">until the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against his people</w>, till <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04832">no remedy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>remedy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">healing</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">upon them the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">their young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of their sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and had no compassion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">upon young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">or maiden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">old man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03486">or him that stooped for age</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">all into his hand</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03627">And all the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">and the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and of his princes</w>; all <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and brake down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and burnt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">all the palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">thereof with fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04261">all the goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> thereof.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07611">And them that had escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">from the sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">carried he away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">to Babylon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">where they were servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to him and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">until the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the remainder from the sword</rdg></note>

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">To fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">until the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had enjoyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">her sabbaths</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8715">she lay desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she kept sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">threescore and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>.

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0259">Now in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">spoken</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might be accomplished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">stirred up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he made a proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">throughout all his kingdom</w>, and <transChange type="added">put it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04385">also in writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,

verses.name: II Chronicles 36:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">All the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me; and he hath charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>. Who <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among you of all his people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, and let him go up</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen445" osisID="2Chr.36"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen409" osisID="2Chr" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ezra 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Now in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">that the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03414">of Jeremiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might be fulfilled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">stirred up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he made a proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">throughout all his kingdom</w>, and <transChange type="added">put it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04385">also in writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused a voice to pass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thus saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">me all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he hath charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">him an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 1:3
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among you of all his people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be with him, and let him go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, (he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w>,) which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">And whosoever remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in any place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">where he sojourneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">let the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">him with silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and with goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and with beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">beside the freewill offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>help…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lift him up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 1:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, with all <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">whose spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had raised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 1:6
verses.text: And all they that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">with vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">with gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">with goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and with beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04030">and with precious things</w>, beside all <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">was willingly offered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strengthened…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">helped them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 1:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03566">Also Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">which Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">out of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">them in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his gods</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 1:8

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01302">of Barkos</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05516">of Sisera</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08547">of Thamah</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 2:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05335">of Neziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02412">of Hatipha</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 2:55
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05479">of Sotai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05618">of Sophereth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06514">of Peruda</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Peruda</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Perida</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 2:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03279">of Jaalah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01874">of Darkon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01435">of Giddel</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 2:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08203">of Shephatiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02411">of Hattil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06380">of Pochereth of Zebaim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0532">of Ami</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ami</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Amon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 2:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05411">All the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 2:59
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they which went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08528">from Tel–melah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08521">Tel–harsa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03743">Cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0135">Addan</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0564">Immer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and their seed</w>, whether they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Addan</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Addon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>seed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pedigree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 2:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01806">of Delaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">of Tobiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05353">of Nekoda</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 2:61
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02252">of Habaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06976">of Koz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">of Barzillai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">of Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after their name</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 2:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">These sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">their register</w> <transChange type="added">among</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">those that were reckoned by genealogy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but they were not found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">therefore were they, as polluted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03550">put from the priesthood</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they were polluted from the priesthood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 2:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08660">And the Tirshatha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, that they should not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till there stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">a priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0224">with Urim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08550">and with Thummim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Tirshatha</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">governor</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 2:64
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06951">The whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">together</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07239 strong:H0702">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">and two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 2:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Beside their servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">and their maids</w>, of whom <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w>: and <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H0428">there were</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">among them two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">singing men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and singing women</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 2:66
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">Their horses</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06505">their mules</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 2:67
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01581">Their camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w>; <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02543">asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 2:68
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>And <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">offered freely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to set it up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">in his place</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 2:69
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">after their ability</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">unto the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">of the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07239 strong:H08337">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">and one thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01871">drams</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04488">pound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and one hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">garments</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 2:70
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">So the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05411">and the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen448" osisID="Ezra.2"/>

verses.name: Ezra 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07637">And when the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03442">Jeshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03136">of Jozadak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02216">and Zerubbabel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07597">of Shealtiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> thereon, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jeshua</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Joshua</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Zerubbabel</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Zorobabel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Shealtiel</catchWord>: Gr. <rdg type="x-equivalent">Salathiel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04350">upon his bases</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0367">for fear</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon them because of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of those countries</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thereon unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">and evening</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">also the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of tabernacles</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w>, and <transChange type="added">offered</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">the daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">by number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to the custom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">as the duty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">required</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>as the duty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the matter of the day in his day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And afterward</w> <transChange type="added">offered</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">both of the new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">and of all the set feasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">that were consecrated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and of every one that willingly offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">a freewill offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezra 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">From the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">they to offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8795" type="x-split-264">But the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> was not <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8795" type="x-split-264">laid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the foundation…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the temple of the <divineName>Lord</divineName> was not yet founded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also unto the masons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02796">and to the carpenters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03978">and meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04960">and drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06722">unto them of Zidon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06876">and to them of Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">from Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03305">of Joppa</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07558">according to the grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">that they had of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>carpenters</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">workmen</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08145">Now in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of their coming</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">in the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H02216">Zerubbabel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07597">of Shealtiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03442">and Jeshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03136">of Jozadak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07605">and the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all they that were come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">and upward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to set forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezra 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03442">Jeshua</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06934">Kadmiel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to set forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the workmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02582">of Henadad</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Judah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Hodaviah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>together</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as one</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And when the builders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">laid the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">in their apparel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04700">with cymbals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">after the ordinance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they sang together by course</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">in praising</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and giving thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; because <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">toward Israel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">shouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when they praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8717" type="x-split-265">because the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8717" type="x-split-265">was laid</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">But many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">and chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>, <transChange type="added">who were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02205">ancient men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-266">when the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of this house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-266">was laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">shouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">for joy</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So that the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">could not discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">of the shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">from the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">of the weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shouted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen449" osisID="Ezra.3"/>

verses.name: Ezra 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">Now when the adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>the children…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of the transportation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02216">to Zerubbabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and to the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, Let us build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with you: for we seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>, as ye <transChange type="added">do</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and we do sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto him since the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0634">of Esar–haddon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which brought us up hither</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02216">But Zerubbabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03442">and Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07605">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03162">but we ourselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">as king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> us.

verses.name: Ezra 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Then the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">weakened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01089 strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8764 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8764">and troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them in building</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against them, to frustrate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">their purpose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03566">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">even until the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01867">of Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04438">And in the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">of Ahasuerus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08462">in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wrote</w> they <transChange type="added">unto him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07855">an accusation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ahasuerus</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ahashverosh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">of Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01312">Bishlam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04990">Mithredath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02870">Tabeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07605">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03674">of their companions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0783">unto Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03791">and the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05406">of the letter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H0762">in the Syrian tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08638" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and interpreted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0762">in the Syrian tongue</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Bishlam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>companions</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">societies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07348">Rehum</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942 strong:H01169">the chancellor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08124">and Shimshai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05613">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02298">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H0104">letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">to Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03660">in this sort</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>scribe</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <transChange type="added">wrote</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07348">Rehum</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942 strong:H01169">the chancellor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08124">and Shimshai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05613">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07606">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03675">of their companions</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01784">the Dinaites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0671">the Apharsathchites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02967">the Tarpelites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0670">the Apharsites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0756">the Archevites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0896">the Babylonians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07801">the Susanchites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01723">the Dehavites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05962">the Elamites</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>companions</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">societies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07606">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0524">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">whom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03358">and noble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0620">Asnappar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">brought over</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01994 strong:H03488" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H08115">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07606">and the rest</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05675">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03706">and at such a time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at such…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">Cheeneth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01836">This</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06573">the copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0104">of the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto him</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0783">unto Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05649">Thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0606">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03706">and at such a time</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">Be it</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03062">that the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H05559" morph="strongMorph:TH8760">came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H03890">thee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">to us</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">unto Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">building</w> <w lemma="strong:H04779">the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0873">and the bad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03635 strong:H03635" morph="strongMorph:TH8720 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8806">and have set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07792">the walls</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02338" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0787">the foundations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set up</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">finished</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>joined</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">sewed together</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01934 strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748 strongMorph:TH8752">Be it known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03705">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02006">that, if</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8731">be builded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07792">and the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03635" morph="strongMorph:TH8720">set up</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809">will they not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05415" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04061">toll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01093">tribute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01983">and custom</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05142" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">thou shalt endamage</w> <w lemma="strong:H0674">the revenue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the kings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pay</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">give</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>revenue</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03705">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606 strong:H06903">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">we have</w> <w lemma="strong:H04416 strong:H04415" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">maintenance</w> from <transChange type="added">the king’s</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01965">palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">and it was not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0749" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02370" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">for us to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06173">dishonour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01836 strong:H05922">therefore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">have we sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and certified</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>we have…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">we are salted with the salt of the palace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01240" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">That search</w> <w lemma="strong:H05609">may be made in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01799">of the records</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">of thy fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">so shalt thou find</w> <w lemma="strong:H05609">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H01799">of the records</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">that this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04779">a rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05142" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">and hurtful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">and provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">and that they have moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0849">sedition</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">within the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05922">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">cause was this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02718" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>moved</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">made</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>within…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0586">We</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">certify</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02006">that, if</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8731">be builded</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07792">and the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03635" morph="strongMorph:TH8720">thereof set up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01836">by this</w> <w lemma="strong:H06903">means</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">thou shalt have</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H02508">portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 4:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06600">an answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H07348">Rehum</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942 strong:H01169">the chancellor</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08124">Shimshai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05613">the scribe</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07606">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03675">of their companions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03488" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08115">in Samaria</w>, and <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07606">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08001">Peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03706">and at such a time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>companions</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">societies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05407">The letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">which ye sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto us</w> <w lemma="strong:H06568" morph="strongMorph:TH8744">hath been plainly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> me.

verses.name: Ezra 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481">And I</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942 strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01240" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and search</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">hath been made, and it is found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">that this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05957">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05376" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">hath made insurrection</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04776">rebellion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0849">and sedition</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">have been made</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>I commanded</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">by me a decree is set</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made insurrection</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">lifted up itself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">There have been</w> <w lemma="strong:H08624">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">also over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07990">which have ruled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">over all</w> <transChange type="added">countries</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05675">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04061">and toll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01093">tribute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01983">and custom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">was paid</w> unto them.

verses.name: Ezra 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03705">ye now</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0989" morph="strongMorph:TH8749" type="x-split-267">to cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0989" morph="strongMorph:TH8749" type="x-split-267">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01791">and that this</w> <w lemma="strong:H07149">city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">be not</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8731">builded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05705">until</w> <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02941">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from me</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Give…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">Make a decree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02095 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8747">Take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07960">now that ye fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648 strong:H05922" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">not to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04101">why</w> <w lemma="strong:H02257">should damage</w> <w lemma="strong:H07680" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05142" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to the hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the kings</w>?

verses.name: Ezra 4:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768 strong:H04481">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H06573">the copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">Artaxerxes’</w> <w lemma="strong:H05407">letter</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07123" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07348">Rehum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08124">and Shimshai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05613">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03675">and their companions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0924">in haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01994">and made them</w> <w lemma="strong:H0989" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0153">by force</w> <w lemma="strong:H02429">and power</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by force…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">by arm and power</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0989" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05673">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0989 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8750 strongMorph:TH8754">So it ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H08648">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H08140">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">of Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06540">of Persia</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen450" osisID="Ezra.4"/>

verses.name: Ezra 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05029">Then the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02292">Haggai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05029">the prophet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01247">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05714">of Iddo</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05013" morph="strongMorph:TH8724">prophesied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">the Jews</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03061">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08036">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">of Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> them.

verses.name: Ezra 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02217">Zerubbabel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01247">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07598">of Shealtiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03443">and Jeshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01247">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03136">of Jozadak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08271" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and began</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05974">and with them</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05029">the prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05583" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">helping</w> them.

verses.name: Ezra 5:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02166">At the same time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08674">to them Tatnai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08370">and Shethar–boznai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03675">and their companions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03652">thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto them</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04479">Who</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942 strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">you to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03635" morph="strongMorph:TH8805">and to make up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H0846">wall</w>?

verses.name: Ezra 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03660">we unto them after this manner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04479">What</w> <w lemma="strong:H0581">are</w> <w lemma="strong:H08036">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">that make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01147">building</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>make</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">build</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05870">But the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of their God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">was</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07868" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">of the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">that they could not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0989" morph="strongMorph:TH8754" type="x-split-268">cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H0989" morph="strongMorph:TH8754" type="x-split-268">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05705">till</w> <w lemma="strong:H02941">the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01946" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">to Darius</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0116">and then</w> <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">they returned answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05407">by letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <transChange type="added">matter</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezra 5:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06573">The copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0104">of the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08674">that Tatnai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08370">and Shethar–boznai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03675">and his companions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0671">the Apharsachites</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05675">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">They sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06600">a letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H01459">him, wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">was written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">thus</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01868">Unto Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H08001">peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wherein</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst whereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03046 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8752 strongMorph:TH8748">Be it known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0236" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that we went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">into the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H03061">of Judea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01005">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07229">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8732">which is builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01560">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H069">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0636">and timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">is laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03797">in the walls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01791">and this</w> <w lemma="strong:H05673">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0629">fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06744" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">on, and prospereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">in their hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">stones of rolling</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H07593" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">we those</w> <w lemma="strong:H07868" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">elders</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03660">unto them thus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04479">Who</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942 strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">you to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03635" morph="strongMorph:TH8805">and to make up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H0846">walls</w>?

verses.name: Ezra 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07593" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">We asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08036">their names</w> <w lemma="strong:H0638">also</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to certify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thee, that we might write</w> <w lemma="strong:H08036">the names</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">of the men</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07217">the chief</w> of them.

verses.name: Ezra 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03660">And thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06600">us answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0586">We</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994">are</w> <w lemma="strong:H05649">the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0772">and earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">that was</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H07690">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08140">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06928">ago</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07229">which a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03635" morph="strongMorph:TH8806">and set up</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03861">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02">that our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07265" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-269">had provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07265" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-269">unto wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05020">of Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03679">the Chaldean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05642" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">who destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-270">and carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01541" morph="strongMorph:TH8684" type="x-split-270">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">into Babylon</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01297">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H02298">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08140">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03567">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w> <transChange type="added">the same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03567">Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 5:14
