verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03984">And the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H0638">also</w> <w lemma="strong:H01768">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">and silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05020">which Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">the temple</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02987" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">them into the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01994">those</w> <w lemma="strong:H03567">did Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8753">and they were delivered</w> unto <transChange type="added">one</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08036">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08340">Sheshbazzar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">whom he had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06347">governor</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>governor</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deputy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0560" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05376" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">unto him, Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0412">these</w> <w lemma="strong:H03984">vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0236" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05182" morph="strongMorph:TH8680">carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">into the temple</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01005">and let the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8731">be builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0870">his place</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H0858" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">the same</w> <w lemma="strong:H08340">Sheshbazzar</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0787">the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04481">and since</w> <w lemma="strong:H0116">that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">even until</w> <w lemma="strong:H03705">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8732">hath it been in building</w>, and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809">it is not</w> <w lemma="strong:H08000" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">finished</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03705">Now</w> <w lemma="strong:H02006">therefore, if</w> <transChange type="added">it seem</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02869">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01240" morph="strongMorph:TH8721">let there be search</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">made in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01596">treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08536">there</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">at Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02006">whether</w> <w lemma="strong:H0383">it be</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02942">that a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">was made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03567">Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">and let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">send</w> <w lemma="strong:H07470">his pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">to us concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this matter</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen451" osisID="Ezra.5"/>

verses.name: Ezra 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01240" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">and search</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">was made in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05609">of the rolls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08536">where</w> <w lemma="strong:H01596">the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05182" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">were laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">in Babylon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rolls</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">books</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>laid up</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">made to descend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8728">And there was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0307">at Achmetha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01001">in the palace</w> that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04083">in the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H04076">of the Medes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02298">a</w> <w lemma="strong:H04040">roll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01459">and therein</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01799">a record</w> <w lemma="strong:H03652">thus</w> <w lemma="strong:H03790" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">written</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Achmetha</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ecbatana</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">in a coffer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02298">In the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H08140">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H03567">of Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <transChange type="added">the same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03567">Cyrus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w> <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01005">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01005">Let the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8731">be builded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0870">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01684" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">where they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01685">sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0787">and let the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05446" morph="strongMorph:TH8775">thereof be strongly laid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07314">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H08361">thereof threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0521">cubits</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06613">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08361">thereof threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0521">cubits</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 6:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">With</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08532">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H05073">rows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01560">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H069">stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05073">and a row</w> <w lemma="strong:H02323">of new</w> <w lemma="strong:H0636">timber</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05313">and let the expenses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0638">And also</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">let the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">and silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03984">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05020">which Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05312" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">took forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">the temple</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02987" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">and brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">unto Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08421" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">be restored</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01946" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">and brought again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01965">unto the temple</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>, <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0870">to his place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05182" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and place</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01005">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought again</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">go</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03705">Now</w> <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08674">Tatnai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08370">Shethar–boznai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03675">and your companions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0671">the Apharsachites</w>, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05675">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">be ye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07352">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H08536">thence</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>your…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">their societies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05673">Let the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">of this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07662" morph="strongMorph:TH8747">alone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06347">let the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07868" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H0870">his place</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481">Moreover I</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03964">what</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">ye shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H07868" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">of these</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">for the building</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">of this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04430">that of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05232">goods</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01768">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04061">the tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0629">forthwith</w> <w lemma="strong:H05313">expenses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0479">unto these</w> <w lemma="strong:H01400">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">that they be not</w> <w lemma="strong:H0989" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">hindered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I make…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">by me a decree is made</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hindered</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">made to cease</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04101">And that which</w> <w lemma="strong:H02818" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">they have need of</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01123">both young</w> <w lemma="strong:H08450">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01798">and rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0563">and lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05928">for the burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02591">wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04416">salt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02562">wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04887">and oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03983">according to the appointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03549">of the priests</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">let it be</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">them day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">by day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H07960">fail</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07127 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8683 strongMorph:TH8748">That they may offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05208">sacrifices of sweet savours</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06739" morph="strongMorph:TH8743">and pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H02417">for the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01123">and of his sons</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of sweet…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">of rest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481">Also</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0606 strong:H03606">that whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">shall alter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H06600">word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0636">let timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H05256" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">be pulled down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02211" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">and being set up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04223" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">let him be hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">thereon</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01005">and let his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05122">a dunghill</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">this</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let him…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">let him be destroyed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0426">And the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08036">that hath caused his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07932" morph="strongMorph:TH8745">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08536">there</w> <w lemma="strong:H04049" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">and people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that shall put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03028">to their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08133" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">to alter</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02255" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01791">this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">let it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0629">with speed</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 6:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0116">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H08674">Tatnai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06347">governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05675">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08370">Shethar–boznai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03675">and their companions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06903">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">to that which Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">had sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03660">so</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0629">speedily</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07868" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">And the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03062">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">builded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06744" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">and they prospered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05017">through the prophesying</w> <w lemma="strong:H02292">of Haggai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05029">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">and Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01247">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05714">of Iddo</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01124" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">And they builded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03635" morph="strongMorph:TH8806">and finished</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04481">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H02941">to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02942">and according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03567">of Cyrus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01868">and Darius</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0783">and Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06540">of Persia</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>commandment</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">decree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01836">And this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03319" morph="strongMorph:TH8806">was finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05705">on</w> <w lemma="strong:H08532">the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03118">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03393">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0144">Adar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01932">which was</w> <w lemma="strong:H08353">in the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08140">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">of the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H01868">of Darius</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 6:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01123">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03549">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03879">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07606">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01123">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01547">of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8754">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02597">the dedication</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">of this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02305">with joy</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>the children of the captivity</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of the transportation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">And offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02597">at the dedication</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">of this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03969">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08450">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03969">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01798">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0703">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03969">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0563">lambs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02409 strong:H02402" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and for a sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06236 strong:H08648">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06841">he</w> <w lemma="strong:H05796">goats</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04510">according to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07625">of the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06966" morph="strongMorph:TH8684">And they set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03549">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H06392">in their divisions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03879">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04255">in their courses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05922">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05673">the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">at Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03792">as it is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05609">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04873">of Moses</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as it is…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">according to the writing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">upon the fourteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">For the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">were purified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">together</w>, all of them <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06453">the passover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and for their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, and for themselves.

verses.name: Ezra 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which were come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">out of captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and all such as had separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">themselves unto them from the filthiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did eat</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04682">of unleavened bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with joy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had made them joyful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto them, to strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen452" osisID="Ezra.6"/>

verses.name: Ezra 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">Now after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">in the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">of Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05830">Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08304">of Seraiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">of Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0568">of Amariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04812">of Meraioth</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02228">of Zerahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05813">of Uzzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01231">of Bukki</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The son</w> <w lemma="strong:H050">of Abishua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">of Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0499">of Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">This Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>; and he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04106">a ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had given</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">granted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01246">him all his request</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">according to the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w> upon him.

verses.name: Ezra 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And there went up</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05411">and the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">of Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">in the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07637">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">For upon the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H03246">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">he to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">from Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and on the first</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02549">of the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">he to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">according to the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w> upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>began…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was the foundation of the going up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">For Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgments</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>Now this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06572">the copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05406">of the letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05830">unto Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and of his statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0783">Artaxerxes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05831">unto Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03549">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05613">a scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01882">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01585" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">perfect</w> <transChange type="added">peace</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03706">and at such a time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to Ezra the priest, a perfect scribe of the law of the God of heaven, peace</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Ezra 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">that all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">they of</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">of Israel</w>, and <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03549">his priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03879">and Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04437">in my realm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05069" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">which are minded of their own freewill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01946" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01946" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05974">with thee</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H01768">Forasmuch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H07972" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">thou art sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925 strong:H04481">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07655">and of his seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03272" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01240" morph="strongMorph:TH8742">to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">concerning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03061">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">and Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01882">according to the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of thy God</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03028">in thine hand</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>of the king</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">from before the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02987" morph="strongMorph:TH8682">And to carry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04430">which the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03272" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">and his counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05069" morph="strongMorph:TH8724">have freely offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03479">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01768">whose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04907">habitation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">in Jerusalem</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03606">And all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">and gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07912" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">that thou canst find</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">in all</w> <w lemma="strong:H04083">the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H0895">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05974">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H05069" morph="strongMorph:TH8722">the freewill offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03549">and of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05069" morph="strongMorph:TH8723">offering willingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of their God</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">in Jerusalem</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06903 strong:H03606">That</w> <w lemma="strong:H07066" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">thou mayest buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0629">speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">with this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H08450">bullocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01798">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0563">lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04504">with their meat offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05261">and their drink offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07127" morph="strongMorph:TH8741">and offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01994">them</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04056">the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of your God</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03390">in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01768 strong:H04101">And whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03191" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall seem good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">to thee, and to</w> <w lemma="strong:H0252">thy brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07606">with the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">of the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01722">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07470">after the will</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of your God</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03984">The vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03052" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">also that are given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06402">thee for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of thy God</w>, <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08000" morph="strongMorph:TH8680">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06925">thou before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03390">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07606">And whatsoever more</w> <w lemma="strong:H02819">shall be needful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05308" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">which thou shalt have occasion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05415" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to bestow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05415" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">bestow</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04481">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01596">treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04481">And I</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0576">I</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07761" morph="strongMorph:TH8752">do make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02942">a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01490">the treasurers</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05675">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05831">that whatsoever Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03549">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05613">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01882">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07593" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">shall require</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">of you, it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0629">speedily</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05705">Unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H03969">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03604">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03702">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03969">and to an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03734">measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H02591">of wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03969">and to an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01325">baths</w> <w lemma="strong:H02562">of wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03969">and to an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H01325">baths</w> <w lemma="strong:H04887">of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04416">and salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03792">prescribing</w> <transChange type="added">how much</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>measures</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">cors</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03606">Whatsoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481 strong:H02941">is commanded by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0149">let it be diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8725">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08065">of heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01768">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H04101">why</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">should there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07109">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05922">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04437">the realm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01123">and his sons</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Whatsoever…</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">Whatsoever is of the decree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 7:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8683">Also we certify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">you, that touching any</w> <w lemma="strong:H03549">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03879">and Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02171">singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08652">porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05412">Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06399" morph="strongMorph:TH8750">or ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01836">of this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01005">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03809">it shall not</w> <w lemma="strong:H07990">be lawful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07412" morph="strongMorph:TH8749">to impose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04061">toll</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01093">tribute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01983">or custom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05922">upon</w> them.

verses.name: Ezra 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0607">And thou</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05831">Ezra</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02452">after the wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of thy God</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03028">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04483" morph="strongMorph:TH8740">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08200" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">magistrates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01782">and judges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01778 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8748">which may judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H05972">the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05675">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05103">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03606">all</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">such as know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01882">the laws</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of thy God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8681">and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03046" morph="strongMorph:TH8751">ye them that know</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03809">not</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03606">And whosoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03809">will not</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648 strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8751 strongMorph:TH8748">do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01882">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0426">of thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01882">and the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04430">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01780">let judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01934" morph="strongMorph:TH8748">be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05648" morph="strongMorph:TH8727">executed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0629">speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H04481">upon him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02006">whether</w> <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04193">unto death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02006">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H08332">to banishment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02006">or</w> <w lemma="strong:H06065">to confiscation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05232">of goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0613">or to imprisonment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to banishment</catchWord>: Chaldee, <rdg type="x-literal">to rooting out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 7:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which hath put</w> <transChange type="added">such a thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">as this in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to beautify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 7:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And hath extended</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto me before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and before all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">And I was strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">as the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon me, and I gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">out of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go up</w> with me. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen453" osisID="Ezra.7"/>

verses.name: Ezra 8:1
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">now the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, and <transChange type="added">this is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">the genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">with me from Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04438">in the reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">of Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">of Phinehas</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01647">Gershom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0385">of Ithamar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01840">Daniel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02407">Hattush</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07935">of Shechaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06551">of Pharosh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and with him were reckoned by genealogy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">of the males</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06355">of Pahath–moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0454">Elihoenai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02228">of Zerahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with him two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07935">of Shechaniah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03166">of Jahaziel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and with him three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05720">also of Adin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05651">Ebed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">of Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">and with him fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03470">Jeshaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06271">of Athaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">and with him seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08203">of Shephatiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02069">Zebadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04317">of Michael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08084">and with him fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03097">of Joab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05662">Obadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03171">of Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with him two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">and eighteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08019">of Shelomith</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03131">of Josiphiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with him an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0893">of Bebai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0893">of Bebai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">and with him twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05803">of Azgad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03110">Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06997">of Hakkatan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">and with him an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the youngest son</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0314">And of the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0140">of Adonikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose names</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0467">these, Eliphelet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03273">Jeiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">and Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and with them threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0902">also of Bigvai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05793">Uthai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02139 strong:H02072" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and Zabbud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">and with them seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02145">males</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zabbud</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Zaccur</rdg>, as some read</note>

verses.name: Ezra 8:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I gathered them together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">to the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that runneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0163">to Ahava</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there abode we in tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I viewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">there none of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abode</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pitched</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0461">I for Eliezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0740">for Ariel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">for Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0494">and for Elnathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03402">and for Jarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0494">and for Elnathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and for Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">and for Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04918">and for Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03114">also for Joiarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0494">and for Elnathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">men of understanding</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them with commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0112">unto Iddo</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">at the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03703">Casiphia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">them what</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">they should say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0112">unto Iddo</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H05411 strong:H05411" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">at the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03703">Casiphia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they should bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto us ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I told…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I put words in their mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">And by the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon us they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">us a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">of understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04249">of Mahli</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08274">and Sherebiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">with his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08083">eighteen</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02811">And Hashabiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03470">and with him Jeshaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04847">of Merari</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05411">Also of the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">whom David</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05411">Nethinims</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">all of them were expressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">a fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">there, at the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0163">of Ahava</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that we might afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">ourselves before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of him a right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02945">for us, and for our little ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">and for all our substance</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I was ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to require</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">a band of soldiers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">us against the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because we had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">The hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">upon all them for good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">him; but his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">and his wrath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against all them that forsake</w> him.

verses.name: Ezra 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So we fasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">for this: and he was intreated</w> of us.

verses.name: Ezra 8:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then I separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08274">Sherebiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02811">Hashabiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of their brethren</w> with them,

verses.name: Ezra 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">unto them the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">which the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and his counsellors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and his lords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w> <transChange type="added">there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">present</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had offered</w>:

verses.name: Ezra 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I even weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto their hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">Also twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03713">basons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">of a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0150">drams</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06668 strong:H02896" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">of fine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">copper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02532">precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">as gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yellow</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">shining brass</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>precious</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desirable</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 8:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> unto them, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">also; and the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05071">a freewill offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ye, and keep</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until ye weigh</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">in the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">So took</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then we departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0163">of Ahava</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">on the twelfth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">and the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was upon us, and he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">us from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of such as lay in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And we came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">there three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07243">Now on the fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">was the silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04822">of Meremoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Uriah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>; and with him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0499">Eleazar</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">of Phinehas</w>; and with them <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03107">Jozabad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03442">of Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05129">and Noadiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01131">of Binnui</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">Levites</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 8:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">By number</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04948">by weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">of every one: and all the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:35
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of those that had been carried away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which were come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08673">ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">lambs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06842">he goats</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">a sin offering</w>: all <transChange type="added">this was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05930">a burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Ezra 8:36
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">commissions</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0323">lieutenants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">and to the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and they furthered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen454" osisID="Ezra.8"/>

verses.name: Ezra 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Now when these things were done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">The people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have not separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">themselves from the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the lands</w>, <transChange type="added">doing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">according to their abominations</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05984">the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04125">the Moabites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04713">the Egyptians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">and the Amorites</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for themselves, and for their sons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06944">so that the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">have mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">themselves with the people</w> of <transChange type="added">those</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">lands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">yea, the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">and rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">hath been chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">in this trespass</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And when I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">my garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">and my mantle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and plucked off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08181">the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">and of my beard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">astonied</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Then were assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02730">unto me every one that trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">at the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04604">because of the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of those that had been carried away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and I sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">astonied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 9:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06153">And at the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I arose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08589">from my heaviness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and having rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">my garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">and my mantle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">upon my knees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spread out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>heaviness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">affliction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and blush</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to thee, my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05771">for our iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">over</w> <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0819">and our trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is grown up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto the heavens</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trespass</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">guiltiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Since the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w> <transChange type="added">have</transChange> we <transChange type="added">been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">in a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05771">and for our iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">have we, our kings</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">our priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">been delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">to the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">to captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0961">and to a spoil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01322">and to confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of face</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">And now for a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">space</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">grace</w> hath been <transChange type="added">shewed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">us a remnant to escape</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03489">us a nail</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">that our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">may lighten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">our eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">us a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H04241">reviving</w> <w lemma="strong:H05659">in our bondage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>space</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moment</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a nail</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a pin</rdg>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">a constant and sure abode</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 9:9
verses.text: For we <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">bondmen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">yet our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05659">us in our bondage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but hath extended</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto us in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04241">us a reviving</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8788">to set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to repair</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">the desolations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof, and to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">us a wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to repair</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to set up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">And now, O our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall we say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this? for we have forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Which thou hast commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">The land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto which ye go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">it, is an unclean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05079">with the filthiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08441">with their abominations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which have filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it from one end</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02932">with their uncleanness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from mouth to mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">not your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">their peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">or their wealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may be strong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, and leave <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to your children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">upon us for our evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">deeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and for our great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">trespass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">seeing that thou our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast punished</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">us less</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">than our iniquities</w> <transChange type="added">deserve</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast given</w> us <transChange type="added">such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06413">deliverance</w> as this;<note type="study"><catchWord>hast punished…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hast withheld beneath our iniquities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Should we again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02859" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and join in affinity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">with the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">of these abominations</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wouldest not thou be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">with us till thou hadst consumed</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange>, so that <transChange type="added">there should be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07611">no remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">nor escaping</w>?

verses.name: Ezra 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for we remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">yet escaped</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>: behold, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">thee in our trespasses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for we cannot stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee because of this. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen455" osisID="Ezra.9"/>

verses.name: Ezra 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">Now when Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">had prayed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and when he had confessed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and casting himself down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">there assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto him out of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">and children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wept</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01059">sore</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wept…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wept a great weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:2
