verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07935">And Shechaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03171">of Jehiel</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05830">unto Ezra</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have trespassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03426">yet now there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H04723">hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w> concerning this thing.

verses.name: Ezra 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Now therefore let us make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">all the wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and such as are born</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">of them, according to the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of my lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02730">and of those that tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">at the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and let it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">according to the law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to put…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to bring forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>; for <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w> <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> unto thee: we also <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with thee: be of good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05830">Ezra</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and made the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to this word</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And they sware</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05830">Then Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">into the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H03076">of Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">of Eliashib</w>: and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thither, he did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">no bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">for he mourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04604">because of the transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of them that had been carried away</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they made proclamation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">throughout Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">and Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that they should gather themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w>;

verses.name: Ezra 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And that whosoever would not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">within three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">according to the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and the elders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07399">all his substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02763" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">should be forfeited</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and himself separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">from the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of those that had been carried away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forfeited</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">devoted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0582">Then all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">unto Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">within three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>. It <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08671">the ninth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">on the twentieth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07460" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">trembling</w> because of <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01653">and for the great rain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the showers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">And Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto them, Ye have transgressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">the trespass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have taken</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">have caused to dwell</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">have brought back</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">confession</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of your fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">his pleasure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and separate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">yourselves from the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05237">and from the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">Then all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">As thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">so must we do</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H061">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>, and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">of much rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">and we are not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">a work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">or two</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for we are many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that have transgressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in this thing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>we are many…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">we have greatly offended in this thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Let now our rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and let all them which have taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in our cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02163" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">at appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02205">and with them the elders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of every city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">thereof, until the fierce</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for this matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">be turned</w> from us.<note type="study"><catchWord>for this…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">till this matter be dispatched</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03129">Only Jonathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06214">of Asahel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03167">and Jahaziah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08616">of Tikvah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were employed</w> about this <transChange type="added">matter</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04918">and Meshullam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07678">and Shabbethai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levite</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">helped</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did so</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05830">And Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">after the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, and all of them by <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">names</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were separated</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">of the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to examine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they made an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">with all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">by the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:18
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">And among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">there were found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>: <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03442">of Jeshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03136">of Jozadak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and his brethren</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04641">Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0461">and Eliezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03402">and Jarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01436">and Gedaliah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they would put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">their wives</w>; and <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0818">guilty</w>, <transChange type="added">they offered</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0352">a ram</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of the flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0819">for their trespass</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0564">of Immer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02607">Hanani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02069">and Zebadiah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02766">of Harim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04641">Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">and Elijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">and Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05818">and Uzziah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06583">of Pashur</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0454">Elioenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03458">Ishmael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05417">Nethaneel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03107">Jozabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0501">and Elasah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">Also of the Levites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03107">Jozabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">and Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07041">and Kelaiah</w>, (the same <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07042">Kelita</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H06611">Pethahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0461">and Eliezer</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">Of the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">also; Eliashib</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07778">and of the porters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02928">and Telem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0221">and Uri</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Moreover of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06551">of Parosh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07422">Ramiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03150">and Jeziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04441">and Malchiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04326">and Miamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04441">and Malchijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">and Benaiah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05867">of Elam</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04983">Mattaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03171">and Jehiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05660">and Abdi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">and Jeremoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0452">and Eliah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02240">of Zattu</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0454">Elioenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0475">Eliashib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04983">Mattaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03406">and Jeremoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02066">and Zabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05819">and Aziza</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0893">also of Bebai</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03076">Jehohanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02079 strong:H02140" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">Zabbai</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06270">Athlai</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01137">of Bani</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04918">Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04409">Malluch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05718">and Adaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03437">Jashub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07594">and Sheal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07433">and Ramoth</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06355">of Pahath–moab</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05733">Adna</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03636">and Chelal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04983">Mattaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01212">Bezaleel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01131">and Binnui</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:31
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02766">of Harim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0461">Eliezer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03449">Ishijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04441">Malchiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08095">Shimeon</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04409">Malluch</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08114">Shemariah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02828">of Hashum</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04982">Mattenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04992">Mattathah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02066">Zabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0467">Eliphelet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03413">Jeremai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04519">Manasseh</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01137">of Bani</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04572">Maadai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06019">Amram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0177">and Uel</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0912">Bedeiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03622">Chelluh</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02057">Vaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04822">Meremoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0475">Eliashib</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04983">Mattaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04982">Mattenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03299">and Jaasau</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01137">And Bani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01131">and Binnui</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08096">Shimei</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08018">And Shelemiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">and Nathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05718">and Adaiah</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04367">Machnadebai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08343">Shashai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08298">Sharai</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>Machnadebai</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Mabnadebai</rdg>, according to some copies</note>

verses.name: Ezra 10:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05832">Azareel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08018">and Shelemiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08114">Shemariah</w>,

verses.name: Ezra 10:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0568">Amariah</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05015">of Nebo</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03273">Jeiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04993">Mattithiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02066">Zabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02081">Zebina</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03035">Jadau</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03100">and Joel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01141">Benaiah</w>.

verses.name: Ezra 10:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">All these had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>: and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03426">of them had</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by whom they had</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen456" osisID="Ezra.10"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen446" osisID="Ezra" type="book"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05166">of Nehemiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02446">of Hachaliah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02320">And it came to pass in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H03691">Chisleu</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">in the twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07800">as I was in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02607">That Hanani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, he and <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">them concerning the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06413">that had escaped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which were left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of the captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and concerning Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto me, The remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07604" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that are left</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">there in the province</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">and reproach</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">broken down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof are burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And it came to pass, when I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and mourned</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and fasted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">I beseech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for them that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him and observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">Let thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07183">now be attentive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">open</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that thou mayest hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">which I pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which we have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">against thee: both I and my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have sinned</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">We have dealt very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">corruptly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee, and have not kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">nor the statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">nor the judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which thou commandedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">I beseech thee, the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that thou commandedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye transgress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will scatter you abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the nations</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:9
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ye turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto me, and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">them; though there were of you cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the uttermost part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them from thence, and will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">them unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w> there.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:10
verses.text: Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou hast redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">by thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02389">and by thy strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">I beseech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thee, let now thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07183">be attentive</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">to the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08605">and to the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02655">who desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">I pray thee, thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">him mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of this man</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">For I was the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">cupbearer</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen458" osisID="Neh.1"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02320">And it came to pass in the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H05212">Nisan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">in the twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">of Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: and I took up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>. Now I had not been <transChange type="added">beforetime</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">sad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his presence</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Wherefore the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto me, Why <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">sad</w>, seeing thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not sick</w>? this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> nothing <transChange type="added">else</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07455">but sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03966">Then I was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">afraid</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">Let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">why should not my countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be sad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">when the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">sepulchres</w>, <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02720">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">thereof are consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>?

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">unto me, For what dost thou make request</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">So I prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and if thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have found favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou wouldest send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">me unto Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">unto the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of my fathers’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">sepulchres</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may build</w> it.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07694">unto me, (the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by him</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H04109">For how long shall thy journey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be? and when wilt thou return</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So it pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me; and I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02165">him a time</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>queen</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wife</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0107">let letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">me to the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they may convey me over</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">into Judah</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0107">And a letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">unto Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06508">forest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he may give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">me timber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make beams</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">for the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">of the palace</w> which <transChange type="added">appertained</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and for the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall enter into</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">granted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">me, according to the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w> upon me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">to the governors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">beyond</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">them the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">letters</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">Now the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">captains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H06571">and horsemen</w> with me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05571">When Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02772">the Horonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02900">and Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05984">the Ammonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">of it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419 strong:H07451">them exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that there was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the welfare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and was there three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">I and some</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with me; neither told</w> I <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">what my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">had put</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>: neither <transChange type="added">was there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">with me, save the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that I rode upon</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">of the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">even before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">the dragon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05886 strong:H05869" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0830">and to the dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">port</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665 strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">and viewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which were broken down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">thereof were consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I went on</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of the fountain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and to the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">pool</w>: but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">no place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">for the beast</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">under me to pass</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Then went I up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">by the brook</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07665 strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">and viewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turned back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">by the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">of the valley</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05461">And the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not whither I went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or what I did</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03651">neither had I as yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03064">to the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">nor to the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02715">nor to the nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05461">nor to the rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">nor to the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I unto them, Ye see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the distress</w> that we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in, how Jerusalem</w> <transChange type="added">lieth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02720">waste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03341" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thereof are burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us build up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">that we be no more a reproach</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then I told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">which was good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">upon me; as also the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me. And they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and build</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So they strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> for <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <transChange type="added">work</transChange>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05571">But when Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02772">the Horonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02900">and Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05984">the Ammonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01654">and Geshem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06163">the Arabian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they laughed us to scorn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, and said</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">this thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that ye do</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will ye rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against the king</w>?

verses.name: Nehemiah 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I them, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto them, The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he will prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">us; therefore we his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and build</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02506">but ye have no portion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">nor right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02146">nor memorial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen459" osisID="Neh.2"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0475">Then Eliashib</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rose up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">with his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">of it; even unto the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03968">of Meah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">it, unto the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H02606">of Hananeel</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto him</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03405">of Jericho</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And next to them builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02139">Zaccur</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0566">of Imri</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>next unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at his hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01709">But the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">did the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H05570">of Hassenaah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">build</w>, who <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">laid the beams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04514">thereof, the locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">thereof, and the bars</w> thereof.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04822">Meremoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Urijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06976">of Koz</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">Meshullam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01296">of Berechiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04898">of Meshezabeel</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01195">of Baana</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto them</w> <w lemma="strong:H08621">the Tekoites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0117">but their nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">not their necks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of their Lord</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03465">Moreover the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03111">Jehoiada</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06454">of Paseah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04918">and Meshullam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01152">of Besodeiah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they laid the beams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof, and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04514">thereof, and the locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">thereof, and the bars</w> thereof.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04424">Melatiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01393">the Gibeonite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03036">and Jadon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04824">the Meronothite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01391">of Gibeon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04709">and of Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">unto the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">of the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">on this side</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the river</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Next unto him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05816">Uzziel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02736">of Harhaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the goldsmiths</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03027">Next unto him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> of <transChange type="added">one of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07546">the apothecaries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they fortified</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">unto the broad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fortified…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">left Jerusalem unto the broad wall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07509">Rephaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02354">of Hur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto them</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03042">Jedaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02739">of Harumaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">even over against his house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02407">Hattush</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02813">of Hashabniah</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04441">Malchijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02766">of Harim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02815">and Hashub</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06355">of Pahath–moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">piece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">and the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">of the furnaces</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>other…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">second measure</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next unto him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07967">Shallum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03873">of Halohesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">he and his daughters</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01516">The valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02586">Hanun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02182">of Zanoah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04514">thereof, the locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">thereof, and the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thereof, and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0830">unto the dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0830">But the dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">Malchiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07394">of Rechab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">of part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01021">of Beth–haccerem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04514">thereof, the locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">thereof, and the bars</w> thereof.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">But the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07968">Shallun</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03626">of Col–hozeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">of part</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">of Mizpah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it, and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it, and set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04514">thereof, the locks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">thereof, and the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">thereof, and the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01295">of the pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H07975">of Siloah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01588">garden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04609">and unto the stairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05166">Nehemiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05802">of Azbuk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H01049">of Beth–zur</w>, unto <transChange type="added">the place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06913">over against the sepulchres</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01295">and to the pool</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that was made</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07348">Rehum</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01137">of Bani</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03027">Next unto him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02811">Hashabiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">of Keilah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06418">in his part</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0942">Bavai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02582">of Henadad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">of the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H06418">part</w> <w lemma="strong:H07084">of Keilah</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">And next to him</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05829">Ezer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03442">of Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H04709">of Mizpah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">over against the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05402">to the armoury</w> <w lemma="strong:H04740">at the turning</w> <transChange type="added">of the wall</transChange>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">him Baruch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02079">of Zabbai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">earnestly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">piece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04740">from the turning</w> <transChange type="added">of the wall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06607">unto the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">of Eliashib</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Zabbai</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Zaccai</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04822">Meremoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0223">of Urijah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06976">of Koz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">piece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">from the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">of Eliashib</w> <w lemma="strong:H08503">even to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">of Eliashib</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">of the plain</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H02815">and Hashub</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over against their house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">of Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06055">of Ananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01131">Binnui</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02582">of Henadad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">piece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">from the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05838">of Azariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04740">unto the turning</w> <transChange type="added">of the wall</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06438">even unto the corner</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06420">Palal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0186">of Uzai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04740">over against the turning</w> <transChange type="added">of the wall</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">and the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which lieth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">from the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">by the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">of the prison</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H06305">him Pedaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06551">of Parosh</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05411">Moreover the Nethinims</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06077">in Ophel</w>, unto <transChange type="added">the place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">over against the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">toward the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">and the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lieth out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dwelt…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which dwelt in Ophel, repaired unto</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Ophel</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tower</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H08621">them the Tekoites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">piece</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">over against the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lieth out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">even unto the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06077">of Ophel</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">From above the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0564">of Immer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over against his house</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">also Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07935">of Shechaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">of the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08018">of Shelemiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02586">and Hanun</w> <w lemma="strong:H08345">the sixth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06764">of Zalaph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08145">another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">piece</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">Meshullam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01296">of Berechiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05393">over against his chamber</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">him repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">Malchiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06885">the goldsmith’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05411">of the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of the merchants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">over against the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04663">Miphkad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05944">and to the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">of the corner</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>going…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">corner chamber</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 3:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05944">And between the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">of the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">unto the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">repaired</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the goldsmiths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the merchants</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>going…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">corner chamber</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen460" osisID="Neh.3"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05571">But it came to pass, that when Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that we builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he was wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and took great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">indignation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">and the army</w> <w lemma="strong:H08111">of Samaria</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">What do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0537">these feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">Jews</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will they fortify</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves? will they sacrifice</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will they make an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in a day</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will they revive</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">out of the heaps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the rubbish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">which are burned</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>fortify…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">leave to themselves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02900">Now Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05984">the Ammonite</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Even that which they build</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07776">if a fox</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall even break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">their stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0939">for we are despised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">their reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their own head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0961">them for a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07633">of captivity</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>despised</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">despite</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">not their iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and let not their sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be blotted out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from before</w> thee: for they have provoked <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">before the builders</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">we the wall</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02346">and all the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was joined together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">unto the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thereof: for the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">had a mind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>But it came to pass, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05571">when Sanballat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02900">and Tobiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06163">and the Arabians</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05984">and the Ammonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0796">and the Ashdodites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">that the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927 strong:H0724" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were made up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">began</w> <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be stopped</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">then they were very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>were made up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascended</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And conspired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">all of them together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">against Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08442 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to hinder</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>to hinder…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to make an error to it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Nevertheless we made our prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">a watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">against them day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> of them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">And Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">The strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05449">of the bearers of burdens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is decayed</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">rubbish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that we are not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to build</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">And our adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till we come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">them, and cause the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">And it came to pass, that when the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by them</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">unto us ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">From all places</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whence ye shall return</w> unto us <transChange type="added">they will be upon you</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>From all…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">That from all places ye must return to us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">I in the lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06708 strong:H06706" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">on the higher places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I even set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">after their families</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">with their swords</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07420">their spears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">and their bows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the lower parts of the place</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rose up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">unto the nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05461">and to the rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and to the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not ye afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of them</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">for your brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">your sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and your daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">your wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and your houses</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And it came to pass, when our enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that it was known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto us, and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-271">had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">their counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-271">to nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">all of us to the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">unto his work</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it came to pass from that time</w> forth, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and the other half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of them held</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">both the spears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">and the bows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08302">and the habergeons</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the rulers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They which builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">on the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that bare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05447">burdens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with those that laded</w>, <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">with one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">and with the other</w> <transChange type="added">hand</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">held</w> <w lemma="strong:H07973">a weapon</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For the builders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">had his sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">by his side</w>, and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">builded</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he that sounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0681">by me</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by his side</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">on his loins</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:19
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">unto the nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05461">and to the rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and to the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399">The work</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">and large</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and we are separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">another</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:20
