verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04725">In what place</w> <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">resort</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">ye thither unto us: our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fight</w> for us.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">So we laboured</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in the work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of them held</w> <w lemma="strong:H07420">the spears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">of the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">till the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">appeared</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">Likewise at the same time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">I unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">Let every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">with his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">that in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">they may be a guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">to us, and labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">on the day</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 4:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">So neither I, nor my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">nor my servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">nor the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">of the guard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">which followed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0587">me, none of us</w> <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">our clothes</w>, <transChange type="added">saving that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07973">put them off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">for washing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>saving…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every one went with his weapon for water</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen461" osisID="Neh.4"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">And there was a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and of their wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">For there were</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">We, our sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and our daughters</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore we take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">corn</w> <transChange type="added">for them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we may eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and live</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03426">also there were</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">We have mortgaged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">our lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that we might buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07458">because of the dearth</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There were</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also that said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have borrowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">money</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">tribute</w>, <transChange type="added">and that upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">our lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">Yet now our flesh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">as the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of our brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">our children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">as their children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and, lo, we bring into bondage</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">our sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and our daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to be servants</w>, and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of our daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">are</w> <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">brought unto bondage</w> <transChange type="added">already</transChange>: neither <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H0410">in our power</w> <transChange type="added">to redeem them</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0312">for other men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">have our lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">and vineyards</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03966">And I was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">their cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">and these words</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Then I consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with myself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I rebuked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">the nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05461">and the rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375 strong:H05383 strong:H05378" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8678 strongMorph:TH8801">unto them, Ye exact</w> <w lemma="strong:H04855">usury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brother</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06952">assembly</w> against them.<note type="study"><catchWord>I consulted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my heart consulted in me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">unto them, We after our ability</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">our brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which were sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto the heathen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will ye even sell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">your brethren</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">or shall they be sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto us? Then held they their peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <transChange type="added">to answer</transChange>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also I said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye do</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ought ye not to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">in the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">because of the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our enemies</w>?

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:10
verses.text: I likewise, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and my servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">might exact</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of them money</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">and corn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pray you, let us leave off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04855">this usury</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Restore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">I pray you, to them, even this day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07704">their lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">their vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02132">their oliveyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">and their houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">also the hundredth</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01715">and of the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">the wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that ye exact</w> of them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they, We will restore</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will require</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nothing of them; so will we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as thou sayest</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and took an oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them, that they should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to this promise</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Also I shook</w> <w lemma="strong:H02684">my lap</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">So God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shake out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03018">and from his labour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that performeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not this promise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">even thus be he shaken out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07386">and emptied</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to this promise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>emptied</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">empty</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">void</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Moreover from the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">that I was appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">to be their governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06242">from the twentieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">even unto the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">of Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">I and my brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have not eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">of the governor</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07223">But the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">governors</w> that <transChange type="added">had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me were chargeable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of them bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">and wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">shekels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01571">yea, even</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">their servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bare rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">over the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but so did</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not I, because</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">of the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Yea, also I continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">of this wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither bought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">we any land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05288">and all my servants</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">thither unto the work</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:17
verses.text: Moreover <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07979">at my table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H02572">and fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">and rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">beside those that came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">unto us from among the heathen</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about us</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:18
verses.text: Now <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which was prepared</w> <transChange type="added">for me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06833">also fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">for me, and once in ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">store</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of all sorts of wine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05973">yet for all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">this required</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">not I the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06346">of the governor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05656">because the bondage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon this people</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Think</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon me, my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>, <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to all that I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for this people</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen462" osisID="Neh.5"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05571">Now it came to pass, when Sanballat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02900">and Tobiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01654">and Geshem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06163">the Arabian</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of our enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I had builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06556">there was no breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">left</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704 strong:H01571">therein; (though</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I had not set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">upon the gates</w>;)

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05571">That Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01654">and Geshem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto me, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let us meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> in <transChange type="added">some one of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03715">the villages</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">in the plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0207">of Ono</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But they thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me mischief</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto them, saying</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that I cannot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04399">why should the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0834">whilst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, and come down</w> to you?

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet they sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">unto me four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">after this sort</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">them after the same manner</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05571">Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto me in like manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02549">the fifth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">with an open</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:6
verses.text: Wherein <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">It is reported</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01654">and Gashmu</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">saith</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03064">thou and the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">think</w> <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rebel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03651">for which cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou buildest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01933" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that thou mayest be</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to these words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Gashmu</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Geshem</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And thou hast also appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to preach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of thee at Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and now shall it be reported</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to these words</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">now therefore, and let us take counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738" type="x-split-272">There are</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">no such things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738" type="x-split-272">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0908" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but thou feignest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">them out of thine own heart</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">For they all made us afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">Their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be weakened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">from the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it be not done</w>. Now therefore, <transChange type="added">O God</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Afterward I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01806">of Delaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04105">of Mehetabeel</w>, who <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Let us meet together</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">the temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let us shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of the temple</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for they will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">thee; yea, in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">will they come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> thee.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03644">Should such</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as I flee</w>? and who <transChange type="added">is there</transChange>, that, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> as I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">into the temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H02425" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to save his life</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not go in</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And, lo, I perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had not sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him; but that he pronounced</w> <w lemma="strong:H05016">this prophecy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">against me: for Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05571">and Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had hired</w> him.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:13
verses.text: Therefore <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">he hired</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I should be afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and do so</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sin</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> they might have <transChange type="added">matter</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">for an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">report</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that they might reproach</w> me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">My God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">think</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">thou upon Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H05571">and Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">according to these their works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05031">and on the prophetess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05129">Noadiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">of the prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that would have put me in fear</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02346">So the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was finished</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">in the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and fifth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> of <transChange type="added">the month</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0435">Elul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">in fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And it came to pass, that when all our enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">and all the heathen</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about us</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <transChange type="added">these things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">they were much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their own eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for they perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">that this work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:17
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Moreover in those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">unto Tobiah</w>, and <transChange type="added">the letters</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02900">of Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">came</w> unto them.<note type="study"><catchWord>sent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">multiplied their letters passing to Tobiah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:18
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">in Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07621 strong:H01167">sworn</w> unto him, because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02860">the son in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H07935">of Shechaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0733">of Arah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03076">Johanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">of Meshullam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01296">of Berechiah</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Also they reported</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">his good deeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">me, and uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> to him. <transChange type="added">And</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02900">Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to put me in fear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>words</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">matters</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen463" osisID="Neh.6"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02346">Now it came to pass, when the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was built</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I had set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were appointed</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">That I gave my brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02607">Hanani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02608">and Hananiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">of the palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">over Jerusalem</w>: for he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">a faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">above many</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto them, Let not the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">until the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">be hot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and while they stand by</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01479" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let them shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and bar</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">watches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">in his watch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over against his house</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:4
