verses.name: Nehemiah 7:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05411">All the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08673">ninety</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:61
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they which went up</w> <transChange type="added">also</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08528">from Tel–melah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08521">Tel–haresha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03743">Cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0114">Addon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0564">and Immer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they could</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">their father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">nor their seed</w>, whether they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pedigree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01806">of Delaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">of Tobiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05353">of Nekoda</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:63
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03548">And of the priests</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02252">of Habaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06976">of Koz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">of Barzillai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which took</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01271">of Barzillai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01569">the Gileadite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and was called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after their name</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">These sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">their register</w> <transChange type="added">among</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03187" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">those that were reckoned by genealogy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but it was not found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01351" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">therefore were they, as polluted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03550">put from the priesthood</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08660">And the Tirshatha</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto them, that they should not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of the most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till there stood</w> <transChange type="added">up</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">a priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0224">with Urim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08550">and Thummim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Tirshatha</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the governor</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:66
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06951">The whole congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">together</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07239 strong:H0702">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">and two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:67
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Beside their manservants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">and their maidservants</w>, of whom <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03967">and they had two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">singing men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and singing women</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:68
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">Their horses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06505">their mules</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:69
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01581">camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">asses</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:70
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07117">And some of</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">unto the work</w>. <w lemma="strong:H08660">The Tirshatha</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">to the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01871">drams</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04219">basons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">garments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>some</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">part.</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>The Tirshatha</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the governor</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:71
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">to the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">of the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07239">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01871">drams</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">and two hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H04488">pound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:72
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07611">which the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08147">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07239">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01871">drams</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and two thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04488">pound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08346">and threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">garments</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 7:73
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">So the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w>, and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05411">and the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and all Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07637">and when the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen464" osisID="Neh.7"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">into the street</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05830">unto Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">And Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">both of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and all that could hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">with understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">upon the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that understood in hearing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">therein before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">the street</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">from the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H04276">until midday</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">before the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and those that could understand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0241">and the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w> <transChange type="added">were attentive</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05612">unto the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the light</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">And Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">upon a pulpit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for the purpose</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0681">and beside</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H04993">Mattithiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08087">and Shema</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06043">and Anaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0223">and Urijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02518">and Hilkiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">and Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">on his right hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08040">and on his left hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06305">Pedaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04332">and Mishael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04441">and Malchiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02828">and Hashum</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02806">and Hashbadana</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04918">Meshullam</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pulpit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tower of wood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">And Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>; (<w lemma="strong:H05971">for he was above all the people</w>;) <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and when he opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">it, all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood up</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>sight</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05830">And Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04607">with lifting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06915" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">their heads, and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> with <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03442">Also Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01137">and Bani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08274">and Sherebiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03226">Jamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06126">Akkub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07678">Shabbethai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01941">Hodijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07042">Kelita</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05838">Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03107">Jozabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02605">Hanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06411">Pelaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">caused the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <transChange type="added">stood</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05977">in their place</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they read</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06567" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">distinctly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">the sense</w>, and caused <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04744">the reading</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05166">And Nehemiah</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08660">the Tirshatha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05830">and Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">This day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, nor weep</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05971">For all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the Tirshatha</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the governor</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto them, Go your way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04924">the fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04477">the sweet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto them for whom nothing is prepared</w>: for <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto our Lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither be ye sorry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02304">for the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">is your strength</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">So the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">stilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02013" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Hold your peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">neither be ye grieved</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">portions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">mirth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">because they had understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that were declared</w> unto them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08145">And on the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of all the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05830">unto Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">even to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to understand…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that they might instruct in the words of the law</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">which the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">that the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in booths</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">in the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">of the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And that they should publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in all their cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the mount</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and pine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929 strong:H06086">branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01918">and myrtle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08558">and palm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05929">and branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05687">of thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">booths</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05971">So the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">themselves booths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the roof of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">and in their courts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">and in the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07339">and in the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07339">and in the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06951">And all the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that were come again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">out of the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">booths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">under the booths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">for since the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03442">of Jeshua</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05126">of Nun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">had not the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">done so</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03966">And there was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">gladness</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Also day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223">from the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">unto the last</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he read</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08066">and on the eighth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06116">a solemn assembly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">according unto the manner</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a solemn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a restraint</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen465" osisID="Neh.8"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06242">Now in the twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">and fourth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of this month</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were assembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">with fasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08242">and with sackclothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0127">and earth</w> upon them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">And the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">themselves from all strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and confessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">their sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">and the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strangers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strange children</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">in their place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and read</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07243">fourth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w>; and <transChange type="added">another</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07243">fourth part</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">they confessed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04608">upon the stairs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03442">Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01137">and Bani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06934">Kadmiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07645">Shebaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01138">Bunni</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08274">Sherebiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01137">Bani</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03662">Chenani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stairs</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">scaffold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">Then the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03442">Jeshua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06934">and Kadmiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01137">Bani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02813">Hashabniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08274">Sherebiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01941">Hodijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07645">Shebaniah</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06611">Pethahiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand up</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">be thy glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8784">which is exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">above all blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">and praise</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:6
verses.text: Thou, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> thou, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">alone; thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06635">with all their host</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, and all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">therein, the seas</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">therein, and thou preservest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">them all; and the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">worshippeth</w> thee.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:7
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who didst choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H087">Abram</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and broughtest him forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0218">out of Ur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03778">of the Chaldees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">him the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And foundest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee, and madest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">with him to give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03669">of the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02850">the Hittites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0567">the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06522">and the Perizzites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02983">and the Jebusites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01622">and the Girgashites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">I say</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">to his seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hast performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And didst see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">the affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">their cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">by the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And shewedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">upon Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and on all his servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and on all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou knewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that they dealt proudly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against them. So didst thou get</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thee a name</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou didst divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, so that they went through</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">on the dry land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and their persecutors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou threwest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">into the deeps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H068">as a stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">into the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Moreover thou leddest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">them in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">by a cloudy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03915">and in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">by a pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give them light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein they should go</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou camest down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">also upon mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">with them from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">them right</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">and true</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">laws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">and commandments</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>true…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">laws of truth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And madest known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">unto them thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and commandedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">them precepts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and laws</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">for their hunger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and broughtest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">for them out of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">for their thirst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and promisedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">them that they should go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375 strong:H03027" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hadst sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to give</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which thou hadst lift up thine hand to give them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">But they and our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">dealt proudly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">their necks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">not to thy commandments</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to obey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither were mindful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of thy wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">among them; but hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">their necks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04805">and in their rebellion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">a captain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to return</w> <w lemma="strong:H05659">to their bondage</w>: but thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0433">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05547">ready to pardon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02587">gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07349">and merciful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forsookest</w> them not.<note type="study"><catchWord>a God…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a God of pardons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yea, when they had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">them a molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">calf</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that brought thee up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and had wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05007">provocations</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Yet thou in thy manifold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forsookest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them not in the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">not from them by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">them in the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05982">neither the pillar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew them light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherein they should go</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">also thy good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to instruct</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, and withheldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">not thy manna</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">them water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">for their thirst</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">Yea, forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">didst thou sustain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them in the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they lacked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08008">nothing; their clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waxed not old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and their feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01216" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">swelled</w> not.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">them kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">and nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and didst divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06285">them into corners</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so they possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05511">of Sihon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02809">of Heshbon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05747">of Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also multipliedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">thou as the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and broughtest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them into the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">concerning which thou hadst promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to possess</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">So the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou subduedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03669">the Canaanites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into their hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">with their kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they might do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">with them as they would</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to their will</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08082">and a fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">of all goods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0953">wells</w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">digged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02132">and oliveyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03978">and fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in abundance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so they did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and were filled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and became fat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05727" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and delighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">themselves in thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">goodness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wells</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cisterns</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fruit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tree of food</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Nevertheless they were disobedient</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against thee, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01458">their backs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">thy prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against them to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them to thee, and they wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05007">provocations</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore thou deliveredst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">them: and in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of their trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, thou heardest</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and according to thy manifold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">them saviours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of their enemies</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But after they had rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: therefore leftest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thou them in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that they had the dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">over them: yet when they returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, thou heardest</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">didst thou deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">them according to thy mercies</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>they did…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they returned to do evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And testifiedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against them, that thou mightest bring them again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">unto thy law</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02102" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">yet they dealt proudly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">not unto thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">against thy judgments</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H0120">which if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8799">in them;) and withdrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03802">the shoulder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">their neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and would not hear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>withdrew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they gave a withdrawing shoulder</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Yet many</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">didst thou forbear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and testifiedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">against them by thy spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">thy prophets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">yet would they not give ear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thou them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the lands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>forbear…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">protract over them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the hand of thy prophets</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Nevertheless for thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">mercies’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sake thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03617">not utterly consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, nor forsake</w> them; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">a gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07349">and merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Now therefore, our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">the mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and the terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who keepest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08513">let not all the trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seem little</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee, that hath come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">upon us, on our kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">on our princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and on our priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and on our prophets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and on our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and on all thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">since the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0804">of Assyria</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto this day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trouble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weariness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that hath found us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:33
verses.text: Howbeit thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in all that is brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon us; for thou hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">but we have done wickedly</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Neither have our kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">our princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">our priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">nor our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto thy commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">and thy testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">wherewith thou didst testify</w> against them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they have not served</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">thee in their kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and in thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">them, and in the large</w> <w lemma="strong:H08082">and fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, neither turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">they from their wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">works</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:36
verses.text: Behold, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou gavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">unto our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">thereof and the good</w> thereof, behold, we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> in it:

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">And it yieldeth much</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">over us because of our sins</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also they have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01472">over our bodies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and over our cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">at their pleasure</w>, and we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">distress</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 9:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And because of all this we make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0548">a sure</w> <transChange type="added">covenant</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and write</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08269">and our princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">seal</w> <transChange type="added">unto it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seal</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are at the sealing</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sealed</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen466" osisID="Neh.9"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:28
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07605">And the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">the porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05411">the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and all they that had separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">themselves from the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">unto the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">their wives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one having knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and having understanding</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">They clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">their nobles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">into a curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07621">and into an oath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in God’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">all the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">and his statutes</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>by</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the hand of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And that we would not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">our daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for our sons</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:31
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04728">ware</w> <w lemma="strong:H07668">or any victuals</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sell</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we would not buy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">it of them on the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">or on the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we would leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07637">the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04853">and the exaction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of every debt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">every hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Also we made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for us, to charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">ourselves yearly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">with the third part</w> <w lemma="strong:H08255">of a shekel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03899 strong:H04635">For the shewbread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">and for the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">meat offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">and for the continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07676">of the sabbaths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the new moons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04150">for the set feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and for the holy</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02403">and for the sin offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make an atonement</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And we cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">the lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">among the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">for the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">after the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">at times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02163" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">And to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01061">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of our ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01061">and the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of all fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of all trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">by year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01060">Also the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of our sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and of our cattle</w>, as <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01062">and the firstlings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of our herds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and of our flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that minister</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:37
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">we should bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H06182">of our dough</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08641">and our offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06529">and the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of all manner of trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">of wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03323">and of oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">unto the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">to the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04643">and the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of our ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">that the same Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">might have the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in all the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">of our tillage</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">shall be with the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">when the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06237" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">take tithes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">of the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">to the chambers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0214">into the treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 10:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">For the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08641">the offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">of the new wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03957">unto the chambers</w>, where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">of the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">and the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that minister</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we will not forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen467" osisID="Neh.10"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07605">the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">also cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">of ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08672">and nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">parts</w> <transChange type="added">to dwell</transChange> in <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">And the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">all the men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05068" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that willingly offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">themselves to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/>Now these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the province</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">but in the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0272">in his possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05411">and the Nethinims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">And at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01121">Of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06265">Athaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05818">of Uzziah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0568">of Amariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08203">of Shephatiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04111">of Mahalaleel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Perez</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>Perez</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Pharez</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04641">And Maaseiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01263">of Baruch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03626">of Col–hozeh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02382">of Hazaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05718">of Adaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03114">of Joiarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08023">of Shiloni</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">All the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H06557">of Perez</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08346">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:7
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">of Benjamin</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05543">Sallu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">of Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03133">of Joed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06305">of Pedaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06964">of Kolaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04641">of Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0384">of Ithiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03470">of Jesaiah</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H01373">him Gabbai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05543">Sallai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08672">nine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03100">And Joel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02147">of Zichri</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06496">their overseer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05574">of Senuah</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04932">second</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">over the city</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Of the priests</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03048">Jedaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03114">of Joiarib</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03199">Jachin</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08304">Seraiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02518">of Hilkiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04918">of Meshullam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06659">of Zadok</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04812">of Meraioth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0285">of Ahitub</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05057">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08083">eight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05718">and Adaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03395">of Jeroham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06421">of Pelaliah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0557">of Amzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02148">of Zechariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H06583">of Pashur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04441">of Malchiah</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of the fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">and two</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06023">and Amashai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05832">of Azareel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0273">of Ahasai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04919">of Meshillemoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0564">of Immer</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And their brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of valour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08083">and eight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06496">and their overseer</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02068">Zabdiel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> of <transChange type="added">one of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the great men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the son…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the son of Haggedolim</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03881">Also of the Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02815">of Hashub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05840">of Azrikam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02811">of Hashabiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01138">of Bunni</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07678">And Shabbethai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03107">and Jozabad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w>, <transChange type="added">had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02435">the oversight of the outward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">business</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were over</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04983">And Mattaniah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04316">of Micha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02067">of Zabdi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the principal</w> <w lemma="strong:H08462">to begin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">the thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">in prayer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01229">and Bakbukiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">among his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05653">and Abda</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08051">of Shammua</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01559">of Galal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03038">of Jeduthun</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 11:18

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">purified</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">themselves, and purified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">and the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02346">and the wall</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then I brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <transChange type="added">companies of them that gave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08426">thanks</w>, <transChange type="added">whereof one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08418">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">on the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0830">toward the dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">And after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01955">Hoshaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and half</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05838">And Azariah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05830">Ezra</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04918">and Meshullam</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">and Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03414">and Jeremiah</w>,

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:35
