verses.text: And <transChange type="added">certain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w>; <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03129">of Jonathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08098">of Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04983">of Mattaniah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04320">of Michaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02139">of Zaccur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>:

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">And his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05832">and Azarael</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04450">Milalai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01562">Gilalai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04597">Maai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05417">Nethaneel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03063">and Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02607">Hanani</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">with the musical</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05830">and Ezra</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And at the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which was over against them, they went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">by the stairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04608">at the going up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">of the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">above the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">even unto the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">eastward</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08145">And the other</w> <transChange type="added">company of them that gave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08426">thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04136">over against</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and I after</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">them, and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">upon the wall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">from beyond the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">of the furnaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">even unto the broad</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">And from above the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03465">and above the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01709">and above the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">and the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H02606">of Hananeel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04026">and the tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H03968">of Meah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">even unto the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they stood still</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">in the prison</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">the two</w> <transChange type="added">companies of them that gave</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08426">thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02677">and I, and the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">of the rulers</w> with me:

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">And the priests</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0471">Eliakim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04641">Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04509">Miniamin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04320">Michaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0454">Elioenai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02148">Zechariah</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02608">Hananiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02689">with trumpets</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04641">And Maaseiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08098">and Shemaiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0499">and Eleazar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05813">and Uzzi</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03076">and Jehohanan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04441">and Malchijah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05867">and Elam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05829">and Ezer</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">And the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sang loud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03156">with Jezrahiah</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06496">overseer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sang…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made their voice to be heard</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Also that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoiced</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had made them rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0802">the wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">also and the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejoiced</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08057">so that the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">even afar off</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:44
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">were some</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05393">over the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">for the treasures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08641">for the offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">for the firstfruits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04643">and for the tithes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">into them out of the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04521">the portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">of the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and Levites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03063">for Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">for the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and for the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that waited</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the law</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">appointed by the law</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for Judah…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the joy of Judah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>waited</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">And both the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of their God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04931">and the ward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02893">of the purification</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">according to the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">and Asaph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w> <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">of the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">and songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and thanksgiving</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 12:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And all Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02216">of Zerubbabel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05166">of Nehemiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04521">the portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">of the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his portion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and they sanctified</w> <transChange type="added">holy things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">unto the Levites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">sanctified</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sanctified</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">set apart</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen469" osisID="Neh.12"/>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">On that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they read</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in the audience</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and therein was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05984">that the Ammonite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04125">and the Moabite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">into the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there was read</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>audience</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ears</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Because they met</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">not the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and with water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but hired</w> <w lemma="strong:H01109">Balaam</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">against them, that he should curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">them: howbeit our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">the curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">into a blessing</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Now it came to pass, when they had heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">the law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0914" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that they separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">from Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06154">all the mixed multitude</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06440">And before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">this, Eliashib</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">having the oversight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">of the chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">allied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">unto Tobiah</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>having…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">being set over</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">for him a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">chamber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">where aforetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">the meat offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03828">the frankincense</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03627">and the vessels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04643">and the tithes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of the corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08492">the new wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03323">and the oil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04687">which was commanded</w> <transChange type="added">to be given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03881">to the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07778">and the porters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08641">and the offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the commandment of the Levites</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:6
verses.text: But in all this <transChange type="added">time</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03389">was not I at Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">for in the two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">and thirtieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H0783">of Artaxerxes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">I unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">certain days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">obtained I leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>after…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at the end of days</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>obtained…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I earnestly requested</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">to Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">that Eliashib</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">for Tobiah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in preparing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05393">him a chamber</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And it grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">me sore</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore I cast forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">all the household</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">stuff</w> <w lemma="strong:H02900">of Tobiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">the chamber</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03957">the chambers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thither brought I again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04503">with the meat offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03828">and the frankincense</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H04521">that the portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">of the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">had not been given</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03881">for the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">and the singers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that did</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">the work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">to his field</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then contended</w> <w lemma="strong:H05461">I with the rulers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">Why is the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">forsaken</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I gathered them together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05977">them in their place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>place</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">standing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Then brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">all Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04643">the tithe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">of the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and the new wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03323">and the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">unto the treasuries</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>treasuries</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">storehouses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I made treasurers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">over the treasuries</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08018">Shelemiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">the priest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06659">and Zadok</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the scribe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and of the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06305">Pedaiah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">and next to them</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02605">Hanan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02139">of Zaccur</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04983">of Mattaniah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for they were counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">faithful</w>, and their office <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to distribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto their brethren</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>treasuries</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">storehouses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>next…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at their hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>their office…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it was upon them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">concerning this, and wipe not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">my good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">deeds that I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">for the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04929">and for the offices</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>good…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">kindnesses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>offices</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">observations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">I in Judah</w> <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">treading</w> <w lemma="strong:H01660">wine presses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and bringing in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06194">sheaves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and lading</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">asses</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03196">as also wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06025">grapes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08384">and figs</w>, and all <transChange type="added">manner of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04853">burdens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which they brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">into Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I testified</w> <transChange type="added">against them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">wherein they sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">victuals</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">There dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06876">men of Tyre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">also therein, which brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709 strong:H01709" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">fish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04377">and all manner of ware</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">and in Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I contended</w> <w lemma="strong:H02715">with the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">unto them, What evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">this that ye do</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and profane</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>?

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">not your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-273">thus, and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-273">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">upon us, and upon this city</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet ye bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">by profaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">And it came to pass, that when the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06751" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">began to be dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">that the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should be shut</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they should not be opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">till after</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w>: and <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">of my servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">I at the gates</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04853">there should no burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07402" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">So the merchants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sellers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04465">of all kind of ware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lodged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">once</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">or twice</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then I testified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against them, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">unto them, Why lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">ye about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">the wall</w>? if ye do <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">on you. From that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forth came</w> they no <transChange type="added">more</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07676">on the sabbath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>about</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">the Levites</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that they should cleanse</w> themselves, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they should come</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sanctify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O my God</w>, <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">this also, and spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">me according to the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>greatness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">multitude</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">I Jews</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had married</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H0796">of Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05984">of Ammon</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04125">of Moab</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">had made to dwell with them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">half</w> <w lemma="strong:H0797">in the speech of Ashdod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and could</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03066">in the Jews’ language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">but according to the language</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of each</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>could…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they discerned not to speak</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of each…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of people and people</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I contended</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with them, and cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them, and plucked off their hair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made them swear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">by God</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Ye shall not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">your daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto their sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto your sons</w>, or for yourselves.<note type="study"><catchWord>cursed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">reviled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08010">Did not Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">by these things? yet among many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">was there no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">like him, who was beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over all Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01571">nevertheless even him</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">did outlandish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">women</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">cause to sin</w>.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Shall we then hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto you to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">all this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to transgress</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in marrying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wives</w>?

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:28
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03111">of Joiada</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0475">of Eliashib</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">priest</w>, <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02860">son in law</w> <w lemma="strong:H05571">to Sanballat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02772">the Horonite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore I chased</w> him from me.

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">them, O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01352">because they have defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">the priesthood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03550">of the priesthood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03881">and of the Levites</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>because…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the defilings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thus cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">I them from all strangers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04931">the wards</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">of the priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03881">and the Levites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in his business</w>;

verses.name: Nehemiah 13:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">And for the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07133">offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">at times</w> <w lemma="strong:H02163" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">appointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01061">and for the firstfruits</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen470" osisID="Neh.13"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen457" osisID="Neh" type="book"/>

verses.name: Esther 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Now it came to pass in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">of Ahasuerus</w>, (this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which reigned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01912">from India</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">even unto Ethiopia</w>, <transChange type="added">over</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w>:)

verses.name: Esther 1:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his kingdom</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>,

verses.name: Esther 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">In the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto all his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02428">the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">and Media</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06579">the nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the provinces</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him:

verses.name: Esther 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">When he shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">the riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of his glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">and the honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of his excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H08084">and fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Esther 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And when these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were expired</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that were present</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">both unto great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H01594">of the garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01055">palace</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Where were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02353">white</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03768">green</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">and blue</w>, <transChange type="added">hangings</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">fastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">with cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H0948">of fine linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">to silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01550">rings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">and pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08336">of marble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04296">the beds</w> <transChange type="added">were of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07531">upon a pavement</w> <w lemma="strong:H0923">of red</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08504">and blue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01858">and white</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05508">and black</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08336">marble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blue, hangings</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">violet</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>of red…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of porphyre, and marble and alabaster, and stone of blue colour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:7
verses.text: And they gave <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">in vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03627">the vessels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">being diverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">one from another</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H04438">and royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">according to the state</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>royal…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wine of the kingdom</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>state</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08360">And the drinking</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01881">according to the law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0597" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none did compel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for so the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">to all the officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">according to every man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">pleasure</w>.

verses.name: Esther 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02060">Also Vashti</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">for the women</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04438">the royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> which <transChange type="added">belonged</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>.

verses.name: Esther 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07637">On the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">when the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">was merry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">with wine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04104">Mehuman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0968">Biztha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02726">Harbona</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0903">Bigtha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05">and Abagtha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02242">Zethar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03752">and Carcas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that served</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">of Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>chamberlains</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">eunuchs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02060">Vashti</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03804">with the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">royal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">her beauty</w>: for she <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">to look on</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fair…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">good of countenance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04436">But the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02060">Vashti</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">therefore was the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">burned</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>by his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which was by the hand of his eunuchs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">to the wise men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">the times</w>, (for so <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">toward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">and judgment</w>:

verses.name: Esther 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07138">And the next</w> unto him <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03771">Carshena</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08369">Shethar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0133">Admatha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08659">Tarshish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04825">Meres</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04826">Marsena</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04462">Memucan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">the seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">and Media</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">in the kingdom</w>;)

verses.name: Esther 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">What shall we do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">unto the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02060">Vashti</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">according to law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because she hath not performed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03982">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">the chamberlains</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>What…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">What to do</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04462">And Memucan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02060">Vashti</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not done wrong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">only, but also to all the princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and to all the people</w> that <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in all the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>.

verses.name: Esther 1:17
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">deed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">of the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">unto all women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">so that they shall despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">their husbands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when it shall be reported</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02060">Vashti</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, but she came</w> not.

verses.name: Esther 1:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Likewise</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08282">shall the ladies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of Persia</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">and Media</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the deed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">of the queen</w>. Thus <transChange type="added">shall there arise</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01767">too much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0963">contempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">and wrath</w>.

verses.name: Esther 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let there go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">a royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and let it be written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">among the laws</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">of the Persians</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">and the Medes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that it be not altered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02060">That Vashti</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">no more before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">her royal estate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07468">unto another</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">that is better</w> than she.<note type="study"><catchWord>If it…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">If it be good with the king</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto her companion</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>from him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from before him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>be not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass not away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And when the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06599">decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which he shall make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be published</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">throughout all his empire</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H07227">for it is great</w>,) <w lemma="strong:H0802">all the wives</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to their husbands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">both to great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06996">and small</w>.

verses.name: Esther 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and the princes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H04462">of Memucan</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>pleased…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">was good in the eyes of the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04082">into every province</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">according to the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thereof, and to every people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">after their language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08323" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">should bear rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his own house</w>, and that <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">should be published</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">according to the language</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of every people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that it…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that one should publish it according to the language of his people</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen472" osisID="Esth.1"/>

verses.name: Esther 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">when the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07918" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was appeased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02060">Vashti</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and what she had done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and what was decreed</w> against her.

verses.name: Esther 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758 strong:H02896">unto him, Let there be fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w>:

verses.name: Esther 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06496">officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in all the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may gather together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758 strong:H02896">all the fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">unto Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto the custody</w> <w lemma="strong:H01896">of Hege</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08562">and let their things for purification</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be given</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>:<note type="study"><catchWord>unto the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto the hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Hege</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Hegai</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">And let the maiden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which pleaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02060">instead of Vashti</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he did so</w>.

verses.name: Esther 2:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><transChange type="added">Now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">there was a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">Jew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H02971">of Jair</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08096">of Shimei</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H07027">of Kish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01145">a Benjamite</w>;

verses.name: Esther 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">Who had been carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">from Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01473">with the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">which had been carried away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03204">with Jeconiah</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05019">whom Nebuchadnezzar</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had carried away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Jeconiah</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Jehoiachin</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And he brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01919">Hadassah</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01730">his uncle’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">for she had neither father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">nor mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05291">and the maid</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08389 strong:H03303">fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758 strong:H02896">and beautiful</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04782">whom Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">when her father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">were dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">for his own daughter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">nourished</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fair…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fair of form, and good of countenance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">So it came to pass, when the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">and his decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">was heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and when many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">unto Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">to the custody</w> <w lemma="strong:H01896">of Hegai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0635">that Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">also unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">to the custody</w> <w lemma="strong:H01896">of Hegai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>.

verses.name: Esther 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05291">And the maiden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and she obtained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of him</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08562">her her things for purification</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04490">with such things as belonged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">to her, and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">maidens</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">her, out of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he preferred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">her and her maids</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">unto the best</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>such…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">her portions</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>preferred</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">changed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had not shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">her people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">nor her kindred</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04782">for Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">her that she should not shew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Esther 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04782">And Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">the court</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">how Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">did</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and what should become</w> of her.<note type="study"><catchWord>to know…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to know the peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05291">Now when every maid’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08447">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07093">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">that she had been twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01881">according to the manner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H03117">for so were the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04795">of their purifications</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">accomplished</w>, <transChange type="added">to wit</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">six</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">of myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H01314">with sweet odours</w>, and with <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08562">things for the purifying</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>;)

verses.name: Esther 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Then thus came</w> <transChange type="added">every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05291">maiden</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whatsoever she desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">her to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with her out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.

verses.name: Esther 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">In the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and on the morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">she returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">into the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">to the custody</w> <w lemma="strong:H08190">of Shaashgaz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06370">the concubines</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she came in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">no more, except the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">in her, and that she were called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by name</w>.

verses.name: Esther 2:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08447">Now when the turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">of Esther</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H032">of Abihail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">the uncle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">of Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">her for his daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">she required</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01896">but what Hegai</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">appointed</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0635">And Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">obtained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all them that looked</w> upon her.

verses.name: Esther 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0635">So Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06224">in the tenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02887">Tebeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07651">in the seventh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his reign</w>.

verses.name: Esther 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">above all the women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she obtained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">more than all the virgins</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">the royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03804">crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon her head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made her queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02060">instead of Vashti</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>favour</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kindness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">unto all his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">and his servants</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">feast</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02010">a release</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">to the provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04864">gifts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">according to the state</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>release</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01330">And when the virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">were gathered together</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">the second time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04782">then Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>.

verses.name: Esther 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w> had not <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">her kindred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">nor her people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04782">as Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">her: for Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03982">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">of Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0545">like as when she was brought up</w> with him.

verses.name: Esther 2:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">In those days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04782">while Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0904">Bigthan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08657">and Teresh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of those which kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">on the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Bigthan</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Bigthana</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the threshold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">to Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0635">unto Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0635">and Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">certified</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04782">in Mordecai’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>.

verses.name: Esther 2:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">And when inquisition</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">was made of the matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it was found out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">therefore they were both</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on a tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it was written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen473" osisID="Esth.2"/>

verses.name: Esther 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">did king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">promote</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04099">of Hammedatha</w> <w lemma="strong:H091">the Agagite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and advanced</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him, and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">above all the princes</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Esther 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bowed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and reverenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had so commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">concerning him. But Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bowed</w> not, nor did <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">reverence</w>.

verses.name: Esther 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">unto Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Why transgressest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thou the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandment</w>?

verses.name: Esther 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Now it came to pass, when they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, and he hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not unto them, that they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">whether Mordecai’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would stand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he had told</w> them that he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03064">a Jew</w>.

verses.name: Esther 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">And when Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">that Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">not, nor did him reverence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02001">then was Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of wrath</w>.

verses.name: Esther 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">And he thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">scorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">on Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">alone; for they had shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">of Mordecai</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02001">wherefore Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">all the Jews</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04438">throughout the whole kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">of Ahasuerus</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">of Mordecai</w>.

verses.name: Esther 3:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07223">In the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H05212">Nisan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">year</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">Pur</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01486">the lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">and from month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">to month</w>, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">the twelfth</w> <transChange type="added">month</transChange>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w>.

verses.name: Esther 3:8
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02001">And Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">a certain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">scattered abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and dispersed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in all the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of thy kingdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01881">and their laws</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">diverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from all people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">neither keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">they the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">laws</w>: therefore it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">not for the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to suffer</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meet</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">equal</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Esther 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let it be written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that they may be destroyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03603">talents</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of those that have the charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">of the business</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01595">treasuries</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to destroy them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>pay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weigh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">his ring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">it unto Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04099">of Hammedatha</w> <w lemma="strong:H091">the Agagite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enemy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">oppressor</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">unto Haman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">The silver</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to thee, the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">also, to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with them as it seemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> to thee.

verses.name: Esther 3:12
