verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then were the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">on the thirteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">of the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and there was written</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">according to all that Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0323">lieutenants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">and to the governors</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04082">over every province</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">and to the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of every people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of every province</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">according to the writing</w> thereof, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">every people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">after their language</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">was it written</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and sealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">ring</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scribes</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">secretaries</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05612">And the letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">were sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to kill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to cause to perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">all Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">both young</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">and old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02945">little children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">upon the thirteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">of the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w>, and <transChange type="added">to take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them for a prey</w>.

verses.name: Esther 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06572">The copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">of the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">for a commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in every province</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">was published</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06264">that they should be ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">against that day</w>.

verses.name: Esther 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">The posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01765" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">being hastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01881">and the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">and Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to drink</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05892">but the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0943" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">was perplexed</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen474" osisID="Esth.3"/>

verses.name: Esther 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04782">When Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">all that was done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his clothes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put on</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">with ashes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">with a loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">and a bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">cry</w>;

verses.name: Esther 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">even before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>: for none <transChange type="added">might</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">with sackcloth</w>.

verses.name: Esther 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04082">And in every province</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">whithersoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">and his decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">came</w>, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H060">mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">among the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06685">and fasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01065">and weeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04553">and wailing</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03331" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">in sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">and ashes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sackcloth and ashes were laid under many</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 4:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0635">So Esther’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">maids</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">and her chamberlains</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04436">her. Then was the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">grieved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and she sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">his sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">from him: but he received</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>chamberlains</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eunuchs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H02047">for Hatach</w>, <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom he had appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon her, and gave him a commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">to Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> what it <transChange type="added">was</transChange>, and why it <transChange type="added">was</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>appointed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set before her</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02047">So Hatach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">to Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">unto the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, which <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>.

verses.name: Esther 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04782">And Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him of all that had happened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06575">unto him, and of the sum</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of the money</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">that Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had promised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01595">treasuries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">for the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> them.

verses.name: Esther 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Also he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06572">him the copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">of the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">of the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">that was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">at Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">them, to shew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0635">unto Esther</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">and to declare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto her, and to charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">her that she should go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to make supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">unto him, and to make request</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">him for her people</w>.

verses.name: Esther 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02047">And Hatach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">of Mordecai</w>.

verses.name: Esther 4:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0635">Again Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02047">unto Hatach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and gave him commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">unto Mordecai</w>;

verses.name: Esther 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">All the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">that whosoever, whether man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">or woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">into the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">who is not called</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">law</w> of his to put <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0905">except</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">such to whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03447" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall hold out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H08275">sceptre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he may live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but I have not been called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07970">these thirty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>.

verses.name: Esther 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And they told</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">to Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>.

verses.name: Esther 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04782">Then Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Think</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not with thyself</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that thou shalt escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">more than all the Jews</w>.

verses.name: Esther 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">For if thou altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">holdest thy peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at this time</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07305">shall there enlargement</w> <w lemma="strong:H02020">and deliverance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">to the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">from another</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">but thou and thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be destroyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and who knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whether thou art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">to the kingdom</w> for <transChange type="added">such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">a time</w> as this?<note type="study"><catchWord>enlargement</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">respiration</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 4:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0635">Then Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bade</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w> <transChange type="added">this answer</transChange>,

verses.name: Esther 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">gather together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">all the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that are present</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye for me, and neither eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">or day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05291">I also and my maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06684" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03651">likewise; and so</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in unto the king</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01881">not according to the law</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and if I perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I perish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>present</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04782">So Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">according to all that Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had commanded</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">passed</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen475" osisID="Esth.4"/>

verses.name: Esther 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07992">Now it came to pass on the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0635">that Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put on</w> <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04438">royal</w> <transChange type="added">apparel</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06442">in the inner</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">upon his royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">in the royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05227">over against</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And it was so, when the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she obtained</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03447" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">held out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">to Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H08275">sceptre</w> that <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in his hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0635">So Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drew near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and touched</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H08275">of the sceptre</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">unto her, What wilt thou, queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w>? and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01246">thy request</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be even given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">thee to the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0635">And Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w>, If <transChange type="added">it seem</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">and Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">unto the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I have prepared</w> for him.

verses.name: Esther 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02001">Cause Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">to make haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">as Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">hath said</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">and Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">to the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">that Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had prepared</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">unto Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">at the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07596">thy petition</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it shall be granted</w> thee: and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01246">thy request</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02677">even to the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be performed</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07596">My petition</w> <w lemma="strong:H01246">and my request</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>;

verses.name: Esther 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and if it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">my petition</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H01246">my request</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">and Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">to the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for them, and I will do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">as the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">hath said</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>perform</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 5:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-274">Then went</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-274">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and with a glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02001">but when Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he stood not up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02111" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">for him, he</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">against Mordecai</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">Nevertheless Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0662" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">refrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">himself: and when he came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for his friends</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02238">and Zeresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>called…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to come</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">And Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">them of the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">of his riches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his children</w>, and all <transChange type="added">the things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">wherein the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had promoted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him, and how he had advanced</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">him above the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">and servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">moreover, Yea, Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did let no man come in</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">unto the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that she had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">but myself; and to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">am I invited</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto her also with the king</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Yet all this availeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">me nothing, so long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>.

verses.name: Esther 5:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02238">Zeresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all his friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">unto him, Let a gallows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-275">be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">of fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">thou unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">that Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thereon: then go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">thou in merrily</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">unto the banquet</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">And the thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-275">and he caused</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the gallows</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to be made</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gallows</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tree</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen476" osisID="Esth.5"/>

verses.name: Esther 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03915">On that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H02146">of records</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and they were read</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>could…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the king’s sleep fled away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And it was found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04782">that Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had told</w> <w lemma="strong:H0904">of Bigthana</w> <w lemma="strong:H08657">and Teresh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">two</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the keepers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05592">of the door</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">who sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">on the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Bigthana</catchWord>: also called, <rdg type="x-identity">Bigthan</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>door</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">threshold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03366">What honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">and dignity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath been done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">to Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for this? Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that ministered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">unto him, There is nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">done</w> for him.

verses.name: Esther 6:4
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02001">Now Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02435">into the outward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">court</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hang</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on the gallows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he had prepared</w> for him.

verses.name: Esther 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">unto him, Behold, Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the court</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let him come in</w>.

verses.name: Esther 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">So Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came in</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto him, What shall be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">to honour</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02001">Now Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">To whom would the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03148">more</w> than to myself?<note type="study"><catchWord>whom the king…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in whose honour the king delighteth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">And Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">For the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">to honour</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>whom the king…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in whose honour the king delighteth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04438">Let the royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">apparel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">which the king</w> <transChange type="added">useth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to wear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and the horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">that the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03804">upon, and the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which is set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his head</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let them bring the royal apparel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>which the king…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wherewith the king clotheth himself</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03830">And let this apparel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">to the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06579">most noble</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that they may array</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <transChange type="added">withal</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">to honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">him on horseback</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">through the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, Thus shall it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">to honour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bring…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause him to ride</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">to Haman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Make haste</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">the apparel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and the horse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">as thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">even so to Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">at the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">let nothing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">of all that thou hast spoken</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">suffer not a whit to fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">the apparel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and the horse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and arrayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and brought him on horseback</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">through the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and proclaimed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">him, Thus shall it be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">whom the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">to honour</w>.

verses.name: Esther 6:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04782">And Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">gate</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02001">But Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01765" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H057">mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and having his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">covered</w>.

verses.name: Esther 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">And Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">told</w> <w lemma="strong:H02238">Zeresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all his friends</w> every <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that had befallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him. Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">his wise men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02238">and Zeresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">unto him, If Mordecai</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02233">of the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom thou hast begun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against him, but shalt surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: Esther 6:14
verses.text: And while they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">yet talking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with him, came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">chamberlains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">unto the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">that Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had prepared</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen477" osisID="Esth.6"/>

verses.name: Esther 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">and Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">with Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to banquet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to drink</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">again unto Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">on the second</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">at the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>, What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07596">thy petition</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04436">queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it shall be granted</w> thee: and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01246">thy request</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it shall be performed</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02677">to the half</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w>.

verses.name: Esther 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0635">Then Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and if it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">let my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">me at my petition</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01246">at my request</w>:

verses.name: Esther 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">For we are sold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">I and my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be slain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to perish</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0432">But if</w> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">we had been sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for bondmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">and bondwomen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I had held my tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06862">although the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">could not countervail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05143">damage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to be destroyed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that they should destroy, and kill, and cause to perish</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 7:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">unto Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> so?<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">whose heart hath filled him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0635">And Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06862 strong:H0376">The adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and enemy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">this wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02001">Then Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">and the queen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The adversary</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The man adversary</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>before</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">at the presence of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 7:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arising</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">from the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in his wrath</w> <transChange type="added">went</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01055">into the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01594">garden</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02001">and Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make request</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">to Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that there was evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">determined</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against him by the king</w>.

verses.name: Esther 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01055">out of the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01594">garden</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">of the banquet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02001">and Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">was fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">upon the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">whereon Esther</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03533" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Will he force</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">also before me in the house</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01697">As the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>before me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02726">And Harbonah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05631">of the chamberlains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06086">Behold also, the gallows</w> <w lemma="strong:H02572">fifty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0520">cubits</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02001">which Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">for Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">who had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">for the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">of Haman</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hang</w> him thereon.<note type="study"><catchWord>gallows</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on the gallows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he had prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">for Mordecai</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then was the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07918" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pacified</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen478" osisID="Esth.7"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">On that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">did the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">of Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews’</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">unto Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w>. <w lemma="strong:H04782">And Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0635">for Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had told</w> what he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> unto her.

verses.name: Esther 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">took off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">his ring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which he had taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">from Haman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">it unto Mordecai</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0635">And Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">over the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">of Haman</w>.

verses.name: Esther 8:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0635">And Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and besought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him with tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">of Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H091">the Agagite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04284">and his device</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he had devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">against the Jews</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and besought…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and she wept, and besought him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03447" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">held out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">the golden</w> <w lemma="strong:H08275">sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">toward Esther</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0635">So Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>,

verses.name: Esther 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">If it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and if I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in his sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and the thing</w> <transChange type="added">seem</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03787" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, and I <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">pleasing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let it be written</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to reverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">by Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04099">of Hammedatha</w> <w lemma="strong:H091">the Agagite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in all the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>devised</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the device</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>which he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">who wrote</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0349">For how</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can I endure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto my people</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0349">or how</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can I endure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H013">the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04138">of my kindred</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>endure…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be able that I may see</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 8:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">Then the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">unto Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">and to Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">of Haman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and him they have hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">upon the gallows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">upon the Jews</w>.

verses.name: Esther 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">ye also for the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">as it liketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">you</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and seal</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">ring</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03791">for the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which is written</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and sealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">ring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">may no man reverse</w>.

verses.name: Esther 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Then were the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">scribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at that time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">in the third</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H05510">Sivan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">on the three</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">and twentieth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof; and it was written</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">according to all that Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">unto the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0323">and to the lieutenants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">and the deputies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">and rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the provinces</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01912">from India</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">unto Ethiopia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04082">unto every province</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">according to the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thereof, and unto every people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">after their language</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">and to the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">according to their writing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and according to their language</w>.

verses.name: Esther 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus’</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sealed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">with the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02885">ring</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">on horseback</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">riders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07409">on mules</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0327">camels</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">young</w> <w lemma="strong:H07424">dromedaries</w>:

verses.name: Esther 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Wherein the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">granted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w> which <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in every city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to gather themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for their life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to destroy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to cause to perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">all the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">and province</w> <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that would assault</w> them, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02945">little ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">and women</w>, and <transChange type="added">to take</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of them for a prey</w>,

verses.name: Esther 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Upon one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in all the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>, <transChange type="added">namely</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">upon the thirteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">of the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w>.

verses.name: Esther 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06572">The copy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">of the writing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">for a commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in every province</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">published</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto all people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">and that the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06259 strong:H06264" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">should be ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">against that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to avenge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">themselves on their enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>published</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">revealed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 8:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H07409">upon mules</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0327">camels</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">being hastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01765" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and pressed on</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">by the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01881">And the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">at Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>.

verses.name: Esther 8:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04782">And Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">in royal</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">apparel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08504">of blue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02353">and white</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and with a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08509">and with a garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0948">of fine linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0713">and purple</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">and the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">of Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">and was glad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blue</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">violet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">The Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H0219">had light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08342">and joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03366">and honour</w>.

verses.name: Esther 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04082">And in every province</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and in every city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">whithersoever</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">and his decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">had joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">and gladness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04960">a feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07227">And many</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03054" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">became Jews</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06343">for the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> upon them. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen479" osisID="Esth.8"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">Now in the twelfth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">month</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">on the thirteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the same, when the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">and his decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">drew near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be put in execution</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hoped</w> <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to have power</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">over them, (though it was turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">to the contrary, that the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">over them that hated</w> them;)

verses.name: Esther 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">The Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in their cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">throughout all the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">on such as sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">their hurt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">could withstand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06343">for the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon all people</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">And all the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">of the provinces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0323">and the lieutenants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06346">and the deputies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04399 strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and officers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">helped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06343">because the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">of Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> upon them.<note type="study"><catchWord>officers…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">those which did the business that belonged to the king</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04782">For Mordecai</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08089">and his fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">throughout all the provinces</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">for this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">waxed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">greater and greater</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">Thus the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">with the stroke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02027">and slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H012">and destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">what they would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto those that hated</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>what…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to their will</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07800">And in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06577">And Parshandatha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01813">and Dalphon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0630">and Aspatha</w>,

verses.name: Esther 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06334">And Poratha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0118">and Adalia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0743">and Aridatha</w>,

verses.name: Esther 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06534">And Parmashta</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0747">and Arisai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0742">and Aridai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02055">and Vajezatha</w>,

verses.name: Esther 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">The ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">of Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04099">of Hammedatha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0961">they; but on the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">they not their hand</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">On that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of those that were slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>was…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">came</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">unto Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03064">The Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H01002">the palace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06235">and the ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">of Haman</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what have they done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07605">in the rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w>? now what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07596">thy petition</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it shall be granted</w> thee: or what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01246">thy request</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">further</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it shall be done</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">Esther</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">If it please</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let it be granted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">to the Jews</w> which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04279">to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">also according unto this day’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01881">decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02001">and let Haman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">upon the gallows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let Haman’s…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let men hang</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Esther 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">it so to be done</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01881">and the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">at Shushan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02001">Haman’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06235">ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">For the Jews</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07800">in Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">on the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">also of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07800">at Shushan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0961">but on the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not their hand</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07605">But the other</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">Jews</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for their lives</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05118">and had rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of their foes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657">seventy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but they laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0961">on the prey</w>,

verses.name: Esther 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">On the thirteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">and on the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05118">day of the same rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they, and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">of feasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the same</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">But the Jews</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07800">at Shushan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">assembled together</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H07969">on the thirteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">thereof, and on the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">thereof; and on the fifteenth</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05118">of the same they rested</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">it a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">of feasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">Therefore the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06521">of the villages</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06519">in the unwalled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">towns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w> <transChange type="added">a day of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">and feasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">and a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04916">and of sending</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04782">And Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">unto all the Jews</w> that <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04082">in all the provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>, <transChange type="added">both</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">and far</w>,

verses.name: Esther 9:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">To stablish</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them, that they should keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">the fourteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H0143">Adar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H02568">and the fifteenth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08141">of the same, yearly</w>,

verses.name: Esther 9:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">As the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">wherein the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02320">and the month</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">which was turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">unto them from sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">to joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H060">and from mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">into a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they should make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">them days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">of feasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04916">and of sending</w> <w lemma="strong:H04490">portions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04979">and gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">to the poor</w>.

verses.name: Esther 9:23
