verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">And the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">undertook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">as they had begun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04782">and as Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had written</w> unto them;

verses.name: Esther 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02001">Because Haman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H04099">of Hammedatha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H091">the Agagite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">of all the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">against the Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and had cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">Pur</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01486">the lot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">them, and to destroy</w> them;<note type="study"><catchWord>consume</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">crush</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:25
verses.text: But when <transChange type="added">Esther</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">by letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">that his wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">device</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">against the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his own head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and that he and his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">should be hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">on the gallows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">when she came</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Wherefore they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">Purim</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">of Pur</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">Therefore for all the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">of this letter</w>, and <transChange type="added">of that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which they had seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03602">concerning this matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and which had come</w> unto them,<note type="study"><catchWord>Pur</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Lot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03064">The Jews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">ordained</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">upon them, and upon their seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and upon all such as joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves unto them, so as it should not fail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that they would keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">these two</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03791">according to their writing</w>, and according to their <transChange type="added">appointed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02165">time</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141 strong:H08141">every year</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:28
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">these days</w> <transChange type="added">should be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">every generation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">every family</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04082">every province</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">and every city</w>; and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">of Purim</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should not fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02143">nor the memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">from their seed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>perish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be ended</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0635">Then Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H032">of Abihail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04782">and Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jew</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wrote</w> <w lemma="strong:H08633">with all authority</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">this second</w> <w lemma="strong:H0107">letter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">of Purim</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>authority</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">the letters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">unto all the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03967">to the hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06242">twenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H04082">provinces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of the kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">of Ahasuerus</w>, <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w>,

verses.name: Esther 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">To confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">these days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">of Purim</w> <w lemma="strong:H02165">in their times</w> <transChange type="added">appointed</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04782">according as Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">and Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H04436">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had enjoined</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them, and as they had decreed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for themselves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">and for their seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">of the fastings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">and their cry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>themselves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their souls</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 9:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03982">And the decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H0635">of Esther</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">confirmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these matters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06332">of Purim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and it was written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen480" osisID="Esth.9"/>

verses.name: Esther 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">And the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">a tribute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>, and <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0339">the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.

verses.name: Esther 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">And all the acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08633">of his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and of his might</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06575">and the declaration</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">of the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04782">of Mordecai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">whereunto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">advanced</w> him, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they not written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H01697">of the chronicles</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04074">of Media</w> <w lemma="strong:H06539">and Persia</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>advanced…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made him great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Esther 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04782">For Mordecai</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">the Jew</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04932">next</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0325">Ahasuerus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03064">among the Jews</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">of the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">of his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seeking</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the wealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">to all his seed</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen481" osisID="Esth.10"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen471" osisID="Esth" type="book"/>

verses.name: Job 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">There was a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05780">of Uz</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">whose name</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">and that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08535">was perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and upright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03373">and one that feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and eschewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>.

verses.name: Job 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And there were born</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">unto him seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>.

verses.name: Job 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04735">His substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">also was seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02568">and five</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">she asses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05657">household</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">so that this man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">was the greatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of all the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of the east</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cattle</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>household</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">husbandry</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213 strong:H04960" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and feasted</w> <transChange type="added">in their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">his day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">for their three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0269">sisters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to drink</w> with them.

verses.name: Job 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">And it was so, when the days</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04960">feasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">were gone about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0347">that Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06942" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sanctified</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">them, and rose up early</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offerings</w> <transChange type="added">according</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">to the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">of them all: for Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0194">It may be</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">that my sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in their hearts</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus did</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>continually</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">Now there was a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">when the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">themselves before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07854">and Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">also among</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>Satan</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the adversary</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>among</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">unto Satan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0370">Whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">thou? Then Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">From going to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and from walking up and down</w> in it.

verses.name: Job 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">unto Satan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>, that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">none like him in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08535">a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and an upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03373">one that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and escheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>considered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set thy heart on</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07854">Then Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0347">Doth Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">for nought</w>?

verses.name: Job 1:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07753" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast not thou made an hedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">about him, and about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">and about all that he hath on every side</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and his substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cattle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, and touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808 strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">all that he hath, and he will curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee to thy face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">if he curse thee not to thy face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">unto Satan</w>, Behold, all that he hath <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thy power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">only upon himself put not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07854">So Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03117">And there was a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">when his sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and his daughters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drinking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">in their eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>:

verses.name: Job 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">a messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">unto Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01241">The oxen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">were plowing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0860">and the asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">feeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">beside</w> them:

verses.name: Job 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07614">And the Sabeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fell</w> <transChange type="added">upon them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took them away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">yea, they have slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I only am escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">alone to tell</w> thee.

verses.name: Job 1:16
verses.text: While he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">yet speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also another, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">The fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hath burned up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">the sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and the servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them; and I only am escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">alone to tell</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>The fire…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A great fire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:17
verses.text: While he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">yet speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also another, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03778">The Chaldeans</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">bands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">upon the camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have carried them away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">yea, and slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">the servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I only am escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">alone to tell</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>fell</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rushed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:18
verses.text: While he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">yet speaking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also another, and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">Thy sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and thy daughters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">eating</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and drinking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">in their eldest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>:

verses.name: Job 1:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And, behold, there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05676">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0702">the four</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">corners</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05288">upon the young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they are dead</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I only am escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">alone to tell</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from aside</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Job 1:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Then Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">his mantle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01494" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">his head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fell down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>mantle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">robe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06174">Naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came I out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06174">and naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thither: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken away</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">be the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Job 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">In all this Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, nor charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08604">foolishly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>charged…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">attributed folly to God</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen483" osisID="Job.1"/>

verses.name: Job 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Again there was a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">when the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">themselves before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07854">and Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">also among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">them to present</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">himself before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Job 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">unto Satan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0335">From whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">comest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">thou? And Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07751" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">From going to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">and from walking up and down</w> in it.

verses.name: Job 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">unto Satan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>, that <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">none like him in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08535">a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and an upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03373">one that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and escheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and still he holdeth fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H08538">his integrity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">although thou movedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me against him, to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">him without cause</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to destroy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to swallow him up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07854">And Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05785">Skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">for skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">yea, all that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath will he give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for his life</w>.

verses.name: Job 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, and touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">his bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and his flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he will curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thee to thy face</w>.

verses.name: Job 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">unto Satan</w>, Behold, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">but save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>but</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">only</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 2:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-276">So went</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-276">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">with sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07822">boils</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">from the sole</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of his foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">unto his crown</w>.

verses.name: Job 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">him a potsherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H01623" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to scrape</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">himself withal; and he sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">the ashes</w>.

verses.name: Job 2:9
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">unto him, Dost thou still retain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08538">thine integrity</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and die</w>.

verses.name: Job 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto her, Thou speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">as one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">of the foolish women</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">speaketh</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01571">What</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall we receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">at the hand of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall we not receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0347">In all this did not Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">with his lips</w>.

verses.name: Job 2:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0347">Now when Job’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of all this evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that was come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">from his own place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0464">Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08489">the Temanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01085">and Bildad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07747">the Shuhite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06691">and Zophar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05284">the Naamathite</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">for they had made an appointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">with him and to comfort</w> him.

verses.name: Job 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And when they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him not, they lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wept</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they rent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H04598">his mantle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02236" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sprinkled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon their heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">toward heaven</w>.

verses.name: Job 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they sat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">with him upon the ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him: for they saw</w> that <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03511">grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">was very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">great</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen484" osisID="Job.2"/>

verses.name: Job 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">his day</w>.

verses.name: Job 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">And Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>spake</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">answered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Let the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">wherein I was born</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and the night</w> <transChange type="added">in which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it was said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01397">There is a man child</w> <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">conceived</w>.

verses.name: Job 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Let that day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">be darkness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0433">let not God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">it from above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05105">neither let the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shine</w> upon it.

verses.name: Job 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02822">Let darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">and the shadow of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06053">it; let a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03650">upon it; let the blackness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">terrify</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>stain</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">challenge</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>let the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">let them terrify it, as those who have a bitter day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">that night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0652">let darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seize</w> <w lemma="strong:H02302" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon it; let it not be joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of the year</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let it not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">into the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">of the months</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let it not be…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">let it not rejoice among the days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03915">Lo, let that night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01565">be solitary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07445">let no joyful voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> therein.

verses.name: Job 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it that curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06264">who are ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8788">to raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03882">their mourning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">leviathan</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03556">Let the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">of the twilight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof be dark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let it look</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for light</w>, but <transChange type="added">have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">none; neither let it see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06079">the dawning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">of the day</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the dawning…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the eyelids of the morning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because it shut not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> of my <transChange type="added">mother’s</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">womb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from mine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Job 3:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why died</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">I not from the womb</w>? <transChange type="added">why</transChange> did I <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">give up the ghost</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when I came out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the belly</w>?

verses.name: Job 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01290">Why did the knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">prevent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">me? or why the breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I should suck</w>?

verses.name: Job 3:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For now should I have lain still</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and been quiet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I should have slept</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then had I been at rest</w>,

verses.name: Job 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">With kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which built</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">desolate places</w> for themselves;

verses.name: Job 3:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Or with princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">that had gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">who filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w>:

verses.name: Job 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Or as an hidden</w> <w lemma="strong:H05309">untimely birth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">I had not been; as infants</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">never saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>.

verses.name: Job 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">There the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cease</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07267">troubling</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03581 strong:H03019">and there the weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be at rest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weary</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wearied in strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0615">the prisoners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07599" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the oppressor</w>.

verses.name: Job 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06996">The small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">are there; and the servant</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">from his master</w>.

verses.name: Job 3:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">Wherefore is light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06001">to him that is in misery</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and life</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">unto the bitter</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>;

verses.name: Job 3:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Which long</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">for death</w>, but it <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; and dig</w> <w lemma="strong:H04301">for it more than for hid treasures</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>long</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wait</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08056">Which rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01524">exceedingly</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when they can find</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">the grave</w>?

verses.name: Job 3:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Why is light given</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">to a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">whose way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is hid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0433">and whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath hedged in</w>?

verses.name: Job 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0585">For my sighing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">I eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07581">and my roarings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like the waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I eat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my meat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">For the thing which I greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon me, and that which I was afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of is come</w> unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>the thing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I feared a fear, and it came upon me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07951" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I was not in safety</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither had I rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">neither was I quiet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07267">yet trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen485" osisID="Job.3"/>

verses.name: Job 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0464">Then Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08489">the Temanite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 4:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we assay</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee, wilt thou be grieved</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but who can</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">himself from speaking</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a word</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>withhold…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">refrain from words?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Behold, thou hast instructed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou hast strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07504">the weak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>.

verses.name: Job 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04405">Thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have upholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that was falling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou hast strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01290">knees</w>.

verses.name: Job 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But now it is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee, and thou faintest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thee, and thou art troubled</w>.

verses.name: Job 4:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03374">thy fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03690">thy confidence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08615">thy hope</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08537">and the uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of thy ways</w>?

verses.name: Job 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, I pray thee, who <transChange type="added">ever</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05355">being innocent</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0375">or where</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">were the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">cut off</w>?

verses.name: Job 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Even as I have seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that plow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reap</w> the same.

verses.name: Job 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05397">By the blast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and by the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his nostrils</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are they consumed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by the breath…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">by his anger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07581">The roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">of the lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07826">of the fierce lion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">and the teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of the young lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05421" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are broken</w>.

verses.name: Job 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03918">The old lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">perisheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01097">for lack</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">of prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03833">and the stout lion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">whelps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">are scattered abroad</w>.

verses.name: Job 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Now a thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">was secretly brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">to me, and mine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">received</w> <w lemma="strong:H08102">a little</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>secretly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by stealth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05587">In thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02384">from the visions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">of the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08639">when deep sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">on men</w>,

verses.name: Job 4:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07122" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07461">upon me, and trembling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">which made all</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to shake</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">met</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>all</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the multitude of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Then a spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before my face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08185">the hair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05568" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">stood up</w>:

verses.name: Job 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It stood still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but I could not discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">the form</w> <w lemma="strong:H08544">thereof: an image</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before mine eyes</w>, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01827">silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a voice</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,<note type="study"><catchWord>there…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">I heard a still voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Shall mortal man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be more just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">than God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01397">shall a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be more pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">than his maker</w>?

verses.name: Job 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Behold, he put no trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">in his servants</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04397">and his angels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he charged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08417">with folly</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>and his…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">nor in his angels, in whom he put light</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">How much less</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03247">whose foundation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">are crushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">the moth</w>?

verses.name: Job 4:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">They are destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">from morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">to evening</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">without any regarding</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">beaten in pieces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Doth not their excellency</w> <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">in them go away</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">even without wisdom</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen486" osisID="Job.4"/>

verses.name: Job 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">now, if there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">any that will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">thee; and to which of the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou turn</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>turn</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">look?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03708">For wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">the foolish man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07068">and envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the silly one</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>envy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">indignation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">the foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">taking root</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06597">but suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">his habitation</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">His children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">from safety</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they are crushed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>, neither <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">any to deliver</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07105">Whose harvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">the hungry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eateth up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0413">it even out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06791">of the thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06782">and the robber</w> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">swalloweth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">their substance</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0205">Although affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05999">neither doth trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the ground</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>affliction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">iniquity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Yet man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">unto trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07565 strong:H01121">as the sparks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trouble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">labour</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sparks…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons of the burning coal lift up to fly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875 strong:H0199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would I commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01700">my cause</w>:

verses.name: Job 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H02714 strong:H0369">and unsearchable</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">marvellous things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">without number</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>unsearchable</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there is no search</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>without…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">till there be no number</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">the fields</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>fields</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">outplaces</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">those that be low</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that those which mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">to safety</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He disappointeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">the devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H06175">of the crafty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">so that their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot perform</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08454">enterprise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their enterprise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">any thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06193">in their own craftiness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06098">and the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06617" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is carried headlong</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">with darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">in the daytime</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and grope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">in the noonday</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">as in the night</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>meet…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">run into</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But he saveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">from the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">from their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">of the mighty</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01800">So the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hath hope</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05766">and iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07092" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stoppeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Behold, happy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">whom God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">correcteth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">not thou the chastening</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w>:

verses.name: Job 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For he maketh sore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bindeth up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he woundeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make whole</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H08337">thee in six</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">troubles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">yea, in seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">there shall no evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">touch</w> thee.

verses.name: Job 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07458">In famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">thee from death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">and in war</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thou shalt be hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07752">from the scourge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">of the tongue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shalt thou be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07701">of destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when it cometh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when the tongue scourgeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07701">At destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03720">and famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt laugh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shalt thou be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Job 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01285">For thou shalt be in league</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">with the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">and the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">shall be at peace</w> with thee.

verses.name: Job 5:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">that thy tabernacle</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou shalt visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">thy habitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt not sin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy tabernacle…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">peace is thy tabernacle</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>sin</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">err</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou shalt know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">also that thy seed</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06631">and thine offspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">as the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>great</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">much</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt come</w> to <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06913">grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03624">in a full age</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01430">like as a shock of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh in</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his season</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cometh in</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascendeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 5:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Lo this, we have searched</w> it, so it <transChange type="added">is</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">it, and know</w> thou <transChange type="added">it</transChange> for thy good.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for thyself</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen487" osisID="Job.5"/>

verses.name: Job 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">But Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03863">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">my grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">were throughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">weighed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01962 strong:H01942" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and my calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">in the balances</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>laid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lifted up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For now it would be heavier</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">than the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">therefore my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are swallowed up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my words…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">I want words to express my grief</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">For the arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05978">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">me, the poison</w> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whereof drinketh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01161">the terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do set themselves in array</w> against me.

verses.name: Job 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06501">Doth the wild ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H05101" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bray</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">when he hath grass</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01600" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or loweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">the ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H01098">over his fodder</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>when he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at grass?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08602">Can that which is unsavoury</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">without salt</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03426">or is there</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02940">taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H07388">in the white</w> <w lemma="strong:H02495">of an egg</w>?

verses.name: Job 6:7
verses.text: The things <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to touch</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01741">as my sorrowful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">meat</w>.

verses.name: Job 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that I might have</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">my request</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0433">and that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would grant</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">the thing that I long for</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>the thing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my expectation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Even that it would please</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me; that he would let loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cut me off</w>!

verses.name: Job 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05165">Then should I yet have comfort</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05539" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">yea, I would harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02427">myself in sorrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him not spare</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have not concealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the Holy One</w>.

verses.name: Job 6:11
verses.text: What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I should hope</w>? and what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07093">mine end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I should prolong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>?

verses.name: Job 6:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>? or <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05153">of brass</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>of brass</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">brasen?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05833">not my help</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">in me? and is wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">driven quite</w> from me?

verses.name: Job 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04523">To him that is afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">pity</w> <transChange type="added">should be shewed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">from his friend</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he forsaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is afflicted</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">melteth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">My brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have dealt deceitfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">as a brook</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0650">as the stream</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of brooks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they pass away</w>;

verses.name: Job 6:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which are blackish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07140">by reason of the ice</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07950">wherein the snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">is hid</w>:

verses.name: Job 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">What time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02215" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">they wax warm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they vanish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02527">when it is hot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01846" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are consumed out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of their place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vanish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are cut off</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the heat thereof</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>consumed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">extinguished</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">The paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03943" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are turned aside</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">to nothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and perish</w>.

verses.name: Job 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">The troops</w> <w lemma="strong:H08485">of Tema</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">looked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01979">the companies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">waited</w> for them.

verses.name: Job 6:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They were confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they had hoped</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thither, and were ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Job 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For now ye are nothing; ye see</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02866">casting down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are afraid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ye are…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ye are like to them</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to it</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>nothing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Did I say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07809" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me? or, Give a reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">for me of your substance</w>?

verses.name: Job 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Or, Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">me from the enemy’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or, Redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of the mighty</w>?

verses.name: Job 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and I will hold my tongue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and cause me to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein I have erred</w>.

verses.name: Job 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04834" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">How forcible</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">are right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">words</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">but what doth your arguing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">reprove</w>?

verses.name: Job 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Do ye imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0561">and the speeches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02976" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of one that is desperate</w>, <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">as wind</w>?

verses.name: Job 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Yea, ye overwhelm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye dig</w> <transChange type="added">a pit</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">for your friend</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ye overwhelm</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ye cause to fall upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Now therefore be content</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">look</w> upon me; for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">evident</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto you if I lie</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>evident…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before your face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05766">I pray you, let it not be iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">yea, return again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">my righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in it.<note type="study"><catchWord>in it</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">in this matter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 6:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Is there</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">in my tongue</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02441">cannot my taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">discern</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">perverse things</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>my taste</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my palate</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen488" osisID="Job.6"/>

verses.name: Job 7:1
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">not an appointed time</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">to man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w>? <transChange type="added">are not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">also like the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07916">of an hireling</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>an appointed…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a warfare</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 7:2
