verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">As a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">earnestly desireth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">the shadow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07916">and as an hireling</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">looketh</w> for <transChange type="added">the reward of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06467">his work</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>earnestly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gapeth after</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">So am I made to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">of vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05999">and wearisome</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">nights</w> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">are appointed</w> to me.

verses.name: Job 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I lie down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When shall I arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153">and the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H04059">be gone</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I am full</w> <w lemma="strong:H05076">of tossings to and fro</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">unto the dawning of the day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the night…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the evening be measured?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">My flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07415">with worms</w> <w lemma="strong:H01487">and clods</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of dust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05785">my skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and become loathsome</w>.

verses.name: Job 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">My days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are swifter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0708">than a weaver’s shuttle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are spent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w>.

verses.name: Job 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">that my life</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall not return</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>see</catchWord>: to see, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">to enjoy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07210">of him that hath seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me shall see</w> me no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> upon me, and I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>I am…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">I can live no longer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 7:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and vanisheth away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so he that goeth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come up</w> no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">no more to his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">neither shall his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">know</w> him any more.

verses.name: Job 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore I will not refrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in the anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of my spirit</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will complain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">in the bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w>.

verses.name: Job 7:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">I a sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08577">or a whale</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou settest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">a watch</w> over me?

verses.name: Job 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06210">My bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">me, my couch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall ease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07879">my complaint</w>;

verses.name: Job 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then thou scarest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">me with dreams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and terrifiest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02384">me through visions</w>:

verses.name: Job 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">So that my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chooseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04267">strangling</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">rather than my life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>life</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I loathe</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would not live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">alway</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">let me alone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">for my days</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Job 7:17
verses.text: What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that thou shouldest magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him? and that thou shouldest set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> upon him?

verses.name: Job 7:18
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shouldest visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">him every morning</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">try</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">him every moment</w>?

verses.name: Job 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04100">How long</w> <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">from me, nor let me alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">till I swallow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07536">my spittle</w>?

verses.name: Job 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto thee, O thou preserver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">why hast thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04645">me as a mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">against thee, so that I am a burden</w> to myself?

verses.name: Job 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And why dost thou not pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">mine iniquity</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for now shall I sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and thou shalt seek me in the morning</w>, but I <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen489" osisID="Job.7"/>

verses.name: Job 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01085">Bildad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07747">the Shuhite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0575">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">long</w> <w lemma="strong:H04448" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wilt thou speak</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>? and <transChange type="added">how long shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w> <transChange type="added">be like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03524">a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>?

verses.name: Job 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Doth God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07706">or doth the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">justice</w>?

verses.name: Job 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">If thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">against him, and he have cast them away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">their transgression</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the hand of their transgression</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-277">If thou wouldest seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-277">betimes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and make thy supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">to the Almighty</w>;

verses.name: Job 8:6
verses.text: If thou <transChange type="added">wert</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02134">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and upright</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">surely now he would awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">for thee, and make the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">prosperous</w>.

verses.name: Job 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">Though thy beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04705">was small</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0319">yet thy latter end</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">should greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07685" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increase</w>.

verses.name: Job 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">For enquire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07223 strong:H07223" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">I pray thee, of the former</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">age</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02714">thyself to the search</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>:

verses.name: Job 8:9
verses.text: (For we <transChange type="added">are but of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08543">yesterday</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">nothing, because our days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">a shadow</w>:)<note type="study"><catchWord>nothing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Shall not they teach</w> thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, and utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">out of their heart</w>?

verses.name: Job 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01573">Can the rush</w> <w lemma="strong:H01342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01207">without mire</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07685" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-278">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H0260">the flag</w> <w lemma="strong:H07685" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-278">grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01097">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>?

verses.name: Job 8:12
verses.text: Whilst it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03">yet in his greenness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06998" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it withereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> any <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">herb</w>.

verses.name: Job 8:13
verses.text: So <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all that forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02611">and the hypocrite’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>:

verses.name: Job 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03689">Whose hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06990" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04009">and whose trust</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05908">a spider’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">web</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>web</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">house</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">He shall lean</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">upon his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but it shall not stand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it fast, but it shall not endure</w>.

verses.name: Job 8:16
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07373">green</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03127">and his branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shooteth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01593">in his garden</w>.

verses.name: Job 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08328">His roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H05440" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">are wrapped about</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">the heap</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">of stones</w>.

verses.name: Job 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">If he destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">him from his place</w>, then <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall deny</w> him, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not seen</w> thee.

verses.name: Job 8:19
verses.text: Behold, this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04885">the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06083">and out of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">shall others</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grow</w>.

verses.name: Job 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Behold, God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08535">a perfect</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither will he help</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">the evil doers</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>help…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">take the ungodly by the hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>come</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall not be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Till he fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07814">with laughing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and thy lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with rejoicing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rejoicing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shouting for joy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee shall be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">with shame</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0168">and the dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">place of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0369">shall come to nought</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall not be</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen490" osisID="Job.8"/>

verses.name: Job 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Then Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0551">so of a truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">but how should man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be just</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">with God</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>with God</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">before God?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he will</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with him, he cannot answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">of a thousand</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0533">and mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">who hath hardened</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, and hath prospered</w>?

verses.name: Job 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Which removeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not: which overturneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">them in his anger</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Which shaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of her place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05982">and the pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H06426" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thereof tremble</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which commandeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02775">the sun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it riseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; and sealeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">the stars</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which alone spreadeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and treadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">upon the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>waves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heights</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05906">Arcturus</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03685">Orion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03598">and Pleiades</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02315">and the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">of the south</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Arcturus…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ash, Cesil, and Cimah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H0369">past</w> <w lemma="strong:H02714">finding out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">yea, and wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">without number</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lo, he goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">by me, and I see</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not: he passeth on</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also, but I perceive</w> him not.

verses.name: Job 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02862" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he taketh away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who can hinder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him? who will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, What doest</w> thou?<note type="study"><catchWord>hinder…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turn him away?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will not withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">his anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07293">the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">helpers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do stoop</w> under him.<note type="study"><catchWord>proud…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">helpers of pride</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How much less shall I answer</w> him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">choose out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <transChange type="added">to reason</transChange> with him?

verses.name: Job 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Whom, though I were righteous</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would I not answer</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I would make supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">to my judge</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I had called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he had answered</w> me; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would I not believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he had hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto my voice</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08183">me with a tempest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and multiplieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06482">my wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me to take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my breath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but filleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04472">me with bitterness</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:19
verses.text: If <transChange type="added">I speak</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">of strength</w>, lo, <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0533">strong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">and if of judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who shall set</w> me a time <transChange type="added">to plead</transChange>?

verses.name: Job 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I justify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">myself, mine own mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall condemn</w> me: <transChange type="added">if I say</transChange>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08535">perfect</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall also prove me perverse</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Though</transChange> I <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08535">perfect</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would I not know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:22
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore I said</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08535">the perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07752">If the scourge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will laugh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04531">at the trial</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">of the innocent</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0645">thereof; if not, where</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he?

verses.name: Job 9:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Now my days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are swifter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">than a post</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they flee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are passed away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H016">the swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">ships</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05404">as the eagle</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02907" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">to the prey</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>swift…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ships of Ebeh</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ships of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">If I say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H07879">my complaint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will leave off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my heaviness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01082" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and comfort</w> <transChange type="added">myself</transChange>:

verses.name: Job 9:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06094">of all my sorrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that thou wilt not hold me innocent</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I be wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">why then labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">I in vain</w>?

verses.name: Job 9:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">If I wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">myself with</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119 strong:H04325">snow water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">and make my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01253 strong:H01252" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">never</w> <w lemma="strong:H02141" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">so clean</w>;

verses.name: Job 9:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0227">Yet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02881" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou plunge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">me in the ditch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08008">and mine own clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall abhor</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>abhor…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make me to be abhorred</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:32
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">not a man</w>, as I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I should answer</w> him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we should come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>.

verses.name: Job 9:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Neither is</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">there any daysman</w> betwixt us, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">upon us both</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>any…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">one that should argue</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>daysman</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">umpire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 9:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-279">Let him take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">his rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-279">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0367">from me, and let not his fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">terrify</w> me:

verses.name: Job 9:35
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">would I speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not fear</w> him; but <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not so with me.<note type="study"><catchWord>it is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I am not so with myself</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen491" osisID="Job.9"/>

verses.name: Job 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05354" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of my life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07879">my complaint</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon myself; I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">in the bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weary…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cut off while I live</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Do not condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me; shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me wherefore thou contendest</w> with me.

verses.name: Job 10:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee that thou shouldest oppress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou shouldest despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of thine hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">upon the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>work</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">labour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Hast thou eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of flesh</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or seest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">thou as man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">seeth</w>?

verses.name: Job 10:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">as the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of man</w>? <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">thy years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">as man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>,

verses.name: Job 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">That thou enquirest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">after mine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and searchest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">after my sin</w>?

verses.name: Job 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01847">Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I am not wicked</w>; and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none that can deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of thine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">It is upon thy knowledge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Thine hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me and fashioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">me together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">yet thou dost destroy</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">took pains about me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I beseech thee, that thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">me as the clay</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-280">and wilt thou bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">me into dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-280">again</w>?

verses.name: Job 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05413" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Hast thou not poured me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02461">as milk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07087" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and curdled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01385">me like cheese</w>?

verses.name: Job 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou hast clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">me with skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07753" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and hast fenced</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">me with bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01517">and sinews</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fenced</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hedged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast granted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">me life</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and favour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06486">and thy visitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w>.

verses.name: Job 10:13
verses.text: And these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> that this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with thee.

verses.name: Job 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">then thou markest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and thou wilt not acquit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">me from mine iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Job 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I be wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0480">woe</w> unto me; and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I be righteous</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I not lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w>. <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07649">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">of confusion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200 strong:H07202" morph="strongMorph:TH8798 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8798">therefore see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">thou mine affliction</w>;

verses.name: Job 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For it increaseth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou huntest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07826">me as a fierce lion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou shewest thyself marvellous</w> upon me.

verses.name: Job 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou renewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">thy witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me, and increasest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">thine indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">upon me</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02487">changes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">and war</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>witnesses</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">plagues</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">out of the womb</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that I had given up the ghost</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and no eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">had seen</w> me!

verses.name: Job 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">from the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">to the grave</w>.

verses.name: Job 10:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not my days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">few</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02308 strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8798">cease</w> <transChange type="added">then</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07896 strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8798">let me alone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01082" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may take comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w>,

verses.name: Job 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Before I go</w> <transChange type="added">whence</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall not return</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">and the shadow of death</w>;

verses.name: Job 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">A land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05890">of darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0652">as darkness</w> <transChange type="added">itself</transChange>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06757">of the shadow of death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05468">without any order</w>, and <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">the light</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0652">as darkness</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen492" osisID="Job.10"/>

verses.name: Job 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06691">Zophar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05284">the Naamathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">Should not the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be answered</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0376">and should a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">full of talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be justified</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>full…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of lips</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0907">Should thy lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-281">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-281">hold their peace</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when thou mockest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shall no man make thee ashamed</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>lies</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">devices</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou hast said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03948">My doctrine</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02134">pure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01249">and I am clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Job 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">would speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">his lips</w> against thee;

verses.name: Job 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And that he would shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08587">thee the secrets</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>, that <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03718">double</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">to that which is</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">therefore that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05382" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">exacteth</w> of thee <transChange type="added">less</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">than thine iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">deserveth</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02714">Canst thou by searching</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">canst thou find</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">out the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08503">unto perfection</w>?

verses.name: Job 11:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01363">as high</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">as heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what canst thou do</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06013">deeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">than hell</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what canst thou know</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>as high…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the heights of heaven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04055">The measure</w> thereof <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0752">longer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">than the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07342">and broader</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">than the sea</w>.

verses.name: Job 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06950" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">or gather together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then who can hinder</w> him?<note type="study"><catchWord>cut…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make a change</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hinder…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turn him away?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">also; will he not then consider</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>?

verses.name: Job 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05014" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">For vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03823" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">would be wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">though man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be born</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06501">a wild ass’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05895">colt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">empty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">If thou prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and stretch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">out thine hands</w> toward him;

verses.name: Job 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0205">If iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">put it far away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05766">and let not wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in thy tabernacles</w>.

verses.name: Job 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For then shalt thou lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03971">without spot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">yea, thou shalt be stedfast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt not fear</w>:

verses.name: Job 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Because thou shalt forget</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05999">misery</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remember</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as waters</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pass away</w>:

verses.name: Job 11:17
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02465">age</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be clearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">than the noonday</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt shine forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">thou shalt be as the morning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be clearer…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">arise above</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou shalt be secure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03426">because there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, thou shalt dig</w> <transChange type="added">about thee</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt take thy rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w>.

verses.name: Job 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Also thou shalt lie down</w>, and none shall make <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">afraid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">yea, many</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make suit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto thee</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>make suit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">intreat thy face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">But the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04498 strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they shall not escape</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08615">and their hope</w> <transChange type="added">shall be as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04646">the giving up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of the ghost</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">flight shall perish from them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the giving…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a puff of breath</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen493" osisID="Job.11"/>

verses.name: Job 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">And Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">No doubt</w> but ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">and wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w> with you.

verses.name: Job 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01571">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">I have understanding</w> as well as you; I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not inferior</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">to you: yea, who knoweth not such things</w> as these?<note type="study"><catchWord>understanding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>I am…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I fall not lower than you</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>who…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with whom are not such as these?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:4
verses.text: I am <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07814">one mocked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">upon God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he answereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">him: the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">upright</w> <transChange type="added">man is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07814">laughed to scorn</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">He that is ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H04571" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to slip</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03940">a lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06248">in the thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07600">of him that is at ease</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0168">The tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of robbers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07951" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prosper</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and they that provoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0987">are secure</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">into whose hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">bringeth</w> <transChange type="added">abundantly</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">now the beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">thee; and the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they shall tell</w> thee:

verses.name: Job 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Or speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01709">thee: and the fishes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall declare</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Job 12:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not in all these that the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath wrought</w> this?

verses.name: Job 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">In whose hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of every living thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320 strong:H0376">of all mankind</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>soul</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">life</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all flesh of man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">Doth not the ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">try</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02441">and the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">his meat</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03453">With the ancient</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0753">and in length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">understanding</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:13
verses.text: With him <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">and strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">he hath counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">and understanding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>With…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">With God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he breaketh down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and it cannot be built again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shutteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and there can be no opening</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>up</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he withholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they dry up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also he sendeth them out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they overturn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:16
verses.text: With him <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">and wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07683" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and the deceiver</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> his.

verses.name: Job 12:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He leadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07758">away spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and maketh the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">fools</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He looseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">the bond</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and girdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">their loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H0232">with a girdle</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He leadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07758">away spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05557" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and overthroweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">the mighty</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He removeth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">the speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the trusty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and taketh away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">the understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the aged</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>speech…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lip of the faithful</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He poureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">contempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">upon princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and weakeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04206">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0650">of the mighty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weakeneth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">looseth the girdle of the strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He discovereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deep things</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">out of darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bringeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">to light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">the shadow of death</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07679" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07849" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them: he enlargeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and straiteneth</w> them <transChange type="added">again</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>straiteneth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">leadeth in</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He taketh away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and causeth them to wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">in a wilderness</w> <transChange type="added">where there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">no way</w>.

verses.name: Job 12:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04959" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They grope</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in the dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">without light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he maketh them to stagger</w> like <transChange type="added">a</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07910">drunken</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stagger</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wander</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen494" osisID="Job.12"/>

verses.name: Job 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Lo, mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath seen</w> all <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">mine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and understood</w> it.

verses.name: Job 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01847">What ye know</w>, <transChange type="added">the same</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I know</w> also: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not inferior</w> unto you.

verses.name: Job 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I would speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">to the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">with God</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">But</w> ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02950" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">forgers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of lies</w>, ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all physicians</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">of no value</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">ye would altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hold your peace</w>! <w lemma="strong:H02451">and it should be your wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">now my reasoning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">to the pleadings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of my lips</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Will ye speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">wickedly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">for God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07423">deceitfully</w> for him?

verses.name: Job 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Will ye accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his person</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will ye contend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">for God</w>?

verses.name: Job 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Is it good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he should search you out</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0582">or as one man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">mocketh</w> another, do ye <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02048" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">mock</w> him?

verses.name: Job 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">He will surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">you, if ye do secretly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">persons</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07613">Shall not his excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">make you afraid</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06343">and his dread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> upon you?

verses.name: Job 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02146">Your remembrances</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04912">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">unto ashes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01354">your bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01354">to bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">of clay</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Hold your peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let me alone, that I may speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let come</w> on me what <transChange type="added">will</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hold…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be silent from me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore do I take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">in my teeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in mine hand</w>?

verses.name: Job 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02005">Though</w> <w lemma="strong:H06991" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, yet will I trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">in him: but I will maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">mine own ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>maintain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prove</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">argue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 13:16
verses.text: He also <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">my salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02611">for an hypocrite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: Job 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">diligently</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">my speech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0262">and my declaration</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with your ears</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold now, I have ordered</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">cause</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I shall be justified</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:19
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">with me? for now, if I hold my tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall give up the ghost</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Only do</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">not two</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">unto me: then will I not hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">myself from thee</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-282">Withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-282">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0367">from me: and let not thy dread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">make me afraid</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Then call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou, and I will answer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">or let me speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and answer</w> thou me.

verses.name: Job 13:23
verses.text: How many <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">mine iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and sins</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make me to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">and my sin</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Wherefore hidest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thou thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and holdest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me for thine enemy</w>?

verses.name: Job 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou break</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">a leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">driven to and fro</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wilt thou pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03002">the dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">stubble</w>?

verses.name: Job 13:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou writest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04846">bitter things</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me, and makest me to possess</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of my youth</w>.

verses.name: Job 13:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou puttest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05465">also in the stocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lookest narrowly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">unto all my paths</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02707" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou settest a print</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">upon the heels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of my feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lookest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">observest</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>heels</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">roots</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 13:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07538">And he, as a rotten thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consumeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">as a garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">that is moth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">eaten</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen495" osisID="Job.13"/>

verses.name: Job 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Man</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07116">of few</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07649">and full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07267">of trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>few…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">short of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He cometh forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06731">like a flower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and is cut down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he fleeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">also as a shadow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and continueth</w> not.

verses.name: Job 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And dost thou open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">upon such an one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bringest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">me into judgment</w> with thee?

verses.name: Job 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who can bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">a clean</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02931">out of an unclean</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0259">not one</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>can…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">will give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">Seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">his days</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02782" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">determined</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">of his months</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee, thou hast appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">his bounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he cannot pass</w>;

verses.name: Job 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from him, that he may rest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">till he shall accomplish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07916">as an hireling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">his day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cease</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">For there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">of a tree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">if it be cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that it will sprout again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03127">and that the tender branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof will not cease</w>.

verses.name: Job 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08328">Though the root</w> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof wax old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01503">and the stock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof die</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the ground</w>;

verses.name: Job 14:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07381">through the scent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it will bud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05194">like a plant</w>.

verses.name: Job 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">But man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dieth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02522" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wasteth away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">yea, man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">giveth up the ghost</w>, and where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he?<note type="study"><catchWord>wasteth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is weakened</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 14:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0235" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">from the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">and the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">decayeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and drieth up</w>:

verses.name: Job 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">So man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lieth down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and riseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">not: till the heavens</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01115">no more</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall not awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">nor be raised out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">of their sleep</w>.

verses.name: Job 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O that</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou wouldest hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">me in the grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that thou wouldest keep me secret</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">until thy wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou wouldest appoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me a set time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and remember</w> me!

verses.name: Job 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">If a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he live</w> <transChange type="added">again</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of my appointed time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02487">till my change</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">come</w>.

verses.name: Job 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt call</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03700" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee: thou wilt have a desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">to the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hands</w>.

verses.name: Job 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For now thou numberest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">my steps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dost thou not watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">over my sin</w>?

verses.name: Job 14:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06588">My transgression</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sealed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06872">in a bag</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02950" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou sewest up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">mine iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Job 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">And surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">falling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh to nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">and the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of his place</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cometh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fadeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">The waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07833" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wear</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou washest away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05599">the things which grow</w> <transChange type="added">out</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and thou destroyest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>washest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">overflowest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08630" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou prevailest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him, and he passeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">thou changest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sendest him away</w>.

verses.name: Job 14:21
