verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">His sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come to honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he knoweth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; and they are brought low</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he perceiveth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> not of them.

verses.name: Job 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">But his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him shall have pain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H056" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">within him shall mourn</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen496" osisID="Job.14"/>

verses.name: Job 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08489">the Temanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">Should a wise man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">his belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">with the east wind</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>vain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">knowledge of wind</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Should he reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with unprofitable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">talk</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04405">or with speeches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wherewith he can do no good</w>?

verses.name: Job 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Yea, thou castest off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and restrainest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07881">prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>castest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">makest void</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>prayer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">speech</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">For thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">thine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou choosest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06175">of the crafty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>uttereth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">teacheth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Thine own mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">condemneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">testify</w> against thee.

verses.name: Job 15:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223 strong:H07223" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">thou the first</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was born</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">or wast thou made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">the hills</w>?

verses.name: Job 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hast thou heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">the secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dost thou restrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> to thyself?

verses.name: Job 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">What knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou, that we know</w> not? <transChange type="added">what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understandest</w> thou, which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not in us?

verses.name: Job 15:10
verses.text: With us <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07867" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">both the grayheaded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03453">and very aged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03524">men, much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">elder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">than thy father</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08575">the consolations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H0328">with thee? is there any secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> with thee?

verses.name: Job 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Why doth thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">carry thee away</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05869">and what do thy eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07335" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wink at</w>,

verses.name: Job 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">That thou turnest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">thy spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">against God</w>, and lettest <transChange type="added">such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>?

verses.name: Job 15:14
verses.text: What <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he should be clean</w>? and <transChange type="added">he which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that he should be righteous</w>?

verses.name: Job 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Behold, he putteth no trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">in his saints</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08064">yea, the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H02141" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are not clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">How much more abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0444" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and filthy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which drinketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766 strong:H05766" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like water</w>?

verses.name: Job 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02331" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee, hear</w> me; and that <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will declare</w>;

verses.name: Job 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">Which wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">men have told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">from their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and have not hid</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>:

verses.name: Job 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Unto whom alone the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was given</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and no stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> them.

verses.name: Job 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">man travaileth</w> with pain all <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">and the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is hidden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">to the oppressor</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">A dreadful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">sound</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in his ears</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07965">in prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the destroyer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> upon him.<note type="study"><catchWord>A dreadful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A sound of fears</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He believeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not that he shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">out of darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and he is waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">for of the sword</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He wandereth abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">for bread</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, Where <transChange type="added">is it</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at his hand</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">Trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H04691">and anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall make him afraid</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08630" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall prevail</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">against him, as a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06264">ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H03593">to the battle</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he stretcheth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">against God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and strengtheneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">himself against the Almighty</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He runneth</w> upon him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> on <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06677">neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05672">upon the thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H01354">bosses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">of his bucklers</w>:

verses.name: Job 15:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Because he covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">with his fatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06371">collops of fat</w> on <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03689">flanks</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">in desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">cities</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which no man inhabiteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06257" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">which are ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">to become heaps</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not be rich</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02428">neither shall his substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">continue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither shall he prolong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04512">the perfection</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thereof upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">out of darkness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07957">the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall dry up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03127">his branches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and by the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he go away</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Let not him that is deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vanity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07723">for vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08545">shall be his recompence</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">It shall be accomplished</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">his time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03712">and his branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">shall not be green</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accomplished</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cut off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02554" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall shake off</w> <w lemma="strong:H01154">his unripe grape</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">as the vine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05328">his flower</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">as the olive</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">For the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02611">of hypocrites</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01565">desolate</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">of bribery</w>.

verses.name: Job 15:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">They conceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0990">and their belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">prepareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vanity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">iniquity</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen497" osisID="Job.15"/>

verses.name: Job 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Then Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many such things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05999">miserable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">comforters</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> ye all.<note type="study"><catchWord>miserable</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">troublesome</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Shall vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">have an end</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04834" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">or what emboldeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee that thou answerest</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>vain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words of wind</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I also could speak</w> as ye <transChange type="added">do</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03863">if</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">your soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">were</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in my soul’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stead, I could heap up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against you, and shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">mine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119">at</w> you.

verses.name: Job 16:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I would strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119">you with</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05205">and the moving</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should asswage</w> <transChange type="added">your grief</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Though I speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03511">my grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not asswaged</w>: and <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I forbear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what am I eased</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>what…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">what goeth from me?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But now he hath made me weary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast made desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">all my company</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07059" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And thou hast filled me with wrinkles</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05707">is a witness</w> <transChange type="added">against me</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03585">and my leanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rising up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in me beareth witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">to my face</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He teareth</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in his wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07852" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02786" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: he gnasheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">upon me with his teeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06862">mine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03913" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sharpeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> upon me.

verses.name: Job 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06473" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have gaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">upon me with their mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03895">me upon the cheek</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproachfully</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they have gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">themselves together</w> against me.

verses.name: Job 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05760">me to the ungodly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03399" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and turned me over</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath shut me up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 16:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07961">I was at ease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">but he hath broken me asunder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath also taken</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06203">by my neck</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">and shaken me to pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04307">for his mark</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07228">His archers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">compass me round about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-283">he cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">my reins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-283">asunder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and doth not spare</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he poureth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04845">my gall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the ground</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">me with breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">breach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he runneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">upon me like a giant</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08609" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01539">upon my skin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">and defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">my horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">My face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02560" morph="strongMorph:TH8777">is foul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">with weeping</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06079">and on my eyelids</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06757">the shadow of death</w>;

verses.name: Job 16:17
verses.text: Not for <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02555">injustice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in mine hands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08605">also my prayer</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02134">pure</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">O earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">not thou my blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02201">and let my cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">have no place</w>.

verses.name: Job 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05707">Also now, behold, my witness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07717">and my record</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>on high</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the high places</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07453">My friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">scorn</w> me: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H01811" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">poureth out</w> <transChange type="added">tears</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0433">unto God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scorn me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are my scorners</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">O that one might plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">for a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">with God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">as a man</w> <transChange type="added">pleadeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453 strong:H01121">for his neighbour</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>neighbour</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">friend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">When a few</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then I shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the way</w> <transChange type="added">whence</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall not return</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a few…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">years of number</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen498" osisID="Job.16"/>

verses.name: Job 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">My breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">is corrupt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">my days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02193" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are extinct</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06913">the graves</w> <transChange type="added">are ready</transChange> for me.<note type="study"><catchWord>breath…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">spirit is spent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Are there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02049">not mockers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with me? and doth not mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">in their provocation</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>continue</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lodge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lay down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now, put me in a surety</w> with thee; who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">will strike</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> with me?

verses.name: Job 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thou hast hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">from understanding</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">therefore shalt thou not exalt</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He that speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">flattery</w> to <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friends</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">even the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fail</w>.

verses.name: Job 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03322" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04914">me also a byword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and aforetime</w> <w lemma="strong:H08611">I was as a tabret</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>aforetime</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">before them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03543" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also is dim</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">by reason of sorrow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03338">and all my members</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">as a shadow</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my members</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my thoughts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03477">Upright</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be astonied</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">at this, and the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">shall stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02611">himself against the hypocrite</w>.

verses.name: Job 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02890">and he that hath clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be</w> <w lemma="strong:H0555">stronger and stronger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">add strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">as for you all, do ye return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come now</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I cannot find</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> among you.

verses.name: Job 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">My days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are past</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02154">my purposes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are broken off</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04180">the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of my heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the thoughts</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the possessions</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They change</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">into day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">short</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>short</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">near</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">If I wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07585">the grave</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">mine house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07502" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326">my bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in the darkness</w>.

verses.name: Job 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">to corruption</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07415">to the worm</w>, <transChange type="added">Thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">my mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">and my sister</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>said</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cried</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">called</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 17:15
verses.text: And where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0645">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">my hope</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08615">as for my hope</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who shall see</w> it?

verses.name: Job 17:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">to the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of the pit</w>, when <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05183">rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen499" osisID="Job.17"/>

verses.name: Job 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01085">Bildad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07747">the Shuhite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05704">How long</w> <transChange type="added">will it be ere</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07078">an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">of words</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mark</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">we will speak</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Wherefore are we counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">as beasts</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02933" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">reputed vile</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in your sight</w>?

verses.name: Job 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He teareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in his anger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">shall the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">for thee? and shall the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">out of his place</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>himself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">Yea, the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01846" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be put out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07632">and the spark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of his fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05050" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not shine</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">The light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in his tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">and his candle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01846" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be put out</w> with him.<note type="study"><catchWord>candle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lamp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06806">The steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H0202">of his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be straitened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06098">and his own counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cast him down</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">For he is cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">into a net</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">by his own feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and he walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07639">upon a snare</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06341">The gin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06119">by the heel</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06782">the robber</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall prevail</w> against him.

verses.name: Job 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">The snare</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for him in the ground</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04434">and a trap</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">for him in the way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>laid</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hidden</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01091">Terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall make him afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and shall drive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">him to his feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drive</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">scatter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0202">His strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">shall be hungerbitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0343">and destruction</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H06763">at his side</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">of his skin</w>: <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0905">his strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strength</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bars</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04009">His confidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be rooted out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of his tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">him to the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01091">of terrors</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in his tabernacle</w>, because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01097">none</w> <w lemma="strong:H01614">of his: brimstone</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">upon his habitation</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08328">His roots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">beneath, and above</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">shall his branch</w> <w lemma="strong:H05243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02143">His remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and he shall have no name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351 strong:H06440">in the street</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall be driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">from light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">into darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and chased</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">out of the world</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">They shall drive him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05209">He shall neither have son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05220">nor nephew</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08300">nor any remaining</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">in his dwellings</w>.

verses.name: Job 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0314">They that come after</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be astonied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at his day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06931">as they that went before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08178 strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were affrighted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>went…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lived with him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">laid hold on horror</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 18:21
verses.text: Surely such <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the dwellings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05767">of the wicked</w>, and this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <transChange type="added">of him that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">not God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen500" osisID="Job.18"/>

verses.name: Job 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Then Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03013" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">How long will ye vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">me in pieces with words</w>?

verses.name: Job 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06235">These ten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have ye reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: ye are not ashamed</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01970" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye make yourselves strange</w> to me.<note type="study"><catchWord>make…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">harden yourselves against me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">And be it indeed</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have erred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04879">mine error</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remaineth</w> with myself.

verses.name: Job 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">If indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">ye will magnify</w> <transChange type="added">yourselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me, and plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">against me my reproach</w>:

verses.name: Job 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0645">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, and hath compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">me with his net</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, I cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of wrong</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but I am not heard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I cry aloud</w>, but <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">no judgment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wrong</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">violence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01443" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath fenced up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">my way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I cannot pass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he hath set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">in my paths</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath stripped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">me of my glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">the crown</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He hath destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">me on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I am gone</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08615">and mine hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">like a tree</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He hath also kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me, and he counteth</w> me unto him as <transChange type="added">one of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">his enemies</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01416">His troops</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me, and encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">my tabernacle</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-284">He hath put</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">my brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-284">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from me, and mine acquaintance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are verily estranged</w> from me.

verses.name: Job 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07138">My kinsfolk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have failed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and my familiar friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forgotten</w> me.

verses.name: Job 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in mine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0519">and my maids</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">count</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">me for a stranger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05237">I am an alien</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in their sight</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>, and he gave <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">no answer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119">him with</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Job 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">My breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">to my wife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02589" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">though I intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the children’s</w> <transChange type="added">sake</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of mine own body</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05759">Yea, young children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me; I arose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they spake</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>young…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the wicked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05475">All my inward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: and they whom I loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are turned</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>my…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the men of my secret</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">My bone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">to my skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and to my flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and I am escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">with the skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">of my teeth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and to</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Have pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">upon me, have pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">upon me, O ye my friends</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">for the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath touched</w> me.

verses.name: Job 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why do ye persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">me as God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are not satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">with my flesh</w>?

verses.name: Job 19:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0645">were now</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">written</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">they were printed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">in a book</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>Oh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Who will give</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Job 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">That they were graven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">with an iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H05842">pen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05777">and lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">in the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>!

verses.name: Job 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">my redeemer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">at the latter</w> <transChange type="added">day</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">upon the earth</w>:

verses.name: Job 19:26
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05785">my skin</w> <transChange type="added">worms</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">destroy</w> this <transChange type="added">body</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">yet in my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>And…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">After I shall awake, though this body be destroyed, yet out of my flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whom I shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">for myself, and mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and not another</w>; <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03629">my reins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">within</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>another</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a stranger</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>though…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my reins within me are consumed with earnest desire <transChange type="added">(for that day)</transChange></rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>within…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in my bosom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But ye should say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">we him, seeing the root</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of the matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is found</w> in me?<note type="study"><catchWord>seeing…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and what root of matter is found in me?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 19:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be ye afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02534">for wrath</w> <transChange type="added">bringeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the punishments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that ye may know</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01779 strong:H01779" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">a judgment</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen501" osisID="Job.19"/>

verses.name: Job 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06691">Zophar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05284">the Naamathite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05587">Therefore do my thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cause me to answer</w>, and for <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I make haste</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I make…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my haste is in me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">the check</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">of my reproach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">of my understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">causeth me to answer</w>.

verses.name: Job 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Knowest</w> thou <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05703">this of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">since man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w>,

verses.name: Job 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07445">That the triumphing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">short</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">and the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02611">of the hypocrite</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07281">for a moment</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>short</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from near</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07863">Though his excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">mount up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">and his head</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">reach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">unto the clouds</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>clouds</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cloud</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 20:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01561">like his own dung</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they which have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0335">Where</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he?

verses.name: Job 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall fly away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02472">as a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not be found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">yea, he shall be chased away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02384">as a vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">of the night</w>.

verses.name: Job 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eye</w> also <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07805" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> him shall <transChange type="added">see him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04725">neither shall his place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">any more behold</w> him.

verses.name: Job 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">His children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall seek to please</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0202">their goods</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>His children…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The poor shall oppress his children</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">His bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are full</w> <transChange type="added">of the sin</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05934">of his youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">with him in the dust</w>.

verses.name: Job 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Though wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04985" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">be sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in his mouth</w>, <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">it under his tongue</w>;

verses.name: Job 20:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it not; but keep it still</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">his mouth</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>within…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst of his palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 20:14

verses.name: Job 20:15

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">Can a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be profitable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03588">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that is wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be profitable</w> unto himself?<note type="study"><catchWord>as he…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">if he may be profitable, doth his good success depend thereon?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">any pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">to the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou art righteous</w>? or <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01215">gain</w> <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">that thou makest thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">perfect</w>?

verses.name: Job 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Will he reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">thee for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of thee? will he enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">with thee into judgment</w>?

verses.name: Job 22:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not thy wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05771">and thine iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">infinite</w>?

verses.name: Job 22:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou hast taken a pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">from thy brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">for nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06584" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and stripped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">the naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">of their clothing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the naked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the clothes of the naked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">Thou hast not given water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05889">to the weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast withholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">from the hungry</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:8
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02220">the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">he had the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and the honourable man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelt</w> in it.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">man of arm</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>honourable…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">eminent</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">accepted for countenance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">widows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">away empty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">of the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">have been broken</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06341">Therefore snares</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">thee, and sudden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">troubleth</w> thee;

verses.name: Job 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02822">Or darkness</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou canst not see</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08229">and abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cover</w> thee.

verses.name: Job 22:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0433">not God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">in the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">of the stars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how high</w> they are!<note type="study"><catchWord>height of the stars</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">head of the stars</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">How doth God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">know</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can he judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">through the dark cloud</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>How</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">What</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05645">Thick clouds</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">a covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to him, that he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">not; and he walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02329">in the circuit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hast thou marked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">the old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">which wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have trodden</w>?

verses.name: Job 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07059" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">Which were cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">out of time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03247">whose foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">was overflown</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">with a flood</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>whose…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a flood was poured upon their foundation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">from us: and what can the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do</w> for them?<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Yet he filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">their houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with good</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06098">but the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is far</w> from me.

verses.name: Job 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are glad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05355">and the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laugh them to scorn</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0518">Whereas</w> <w lemma="strong:H07009">our substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">but the remnant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of them the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">consumeth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">estate</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the remnant…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">their excellency</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Acquaint</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">now thyself with him, and be at peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02896">thereby good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>him</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Receive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">I pray thee, the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">from his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and lay up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">to the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt be built up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-285">thou shalt put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-285">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">from thy tabernacles</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Then shalt thou lay up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01220">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05921">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w>, and the <transChange type="added">gold</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0211">of Ophir</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">as the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brooks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as dust</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">on the dust</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07706">Yea, the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01220">shall be thy defence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08443">and thou shalt have plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>defence</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gold</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>plenty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">silver of strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">For then shalt thou have thy delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">in the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shalt lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">unto God</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt make thy prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and he shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, and thou shalt pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">thy vows</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt also decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H0562">a thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">unto thee: and the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05050" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">upon thy ways</w>.

verses.name: Job 22:29
verses.text: When <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">are cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then thou shalt say</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01466">lifting up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07807">the humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">person</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the humble…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">him that hath low eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0336">the island</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">of the innocent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and it is delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01252">by the pureness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of thine hands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He shall…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The innocent shall deliver the island</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 22." eID="gen504" osisID="Job.22"/>

verses.name: Job 23:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Then Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Even to day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07879">my complaint</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">bitter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">my stroke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is heavier</w> <w lemma="strong:H0585">than my groaning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stroke</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">where I might find</w> him! <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I might come</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08499">to his seat</w>!

verses.name: Job 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would order</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">with arguments</w>.

verses.name: Job 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">the words</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he would answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what he would say</w> unto me.

verses.name: Job 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Will he plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">against</w> me with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">No; but he would put</w> <transChange type="added">strength</transChange> in me.

verses.name: Job 23:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03477">There the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">might dispute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with him; so should I be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from my judge</w>.

verses.name: Job 23:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">forward</w>, but he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">there</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0268">and backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I cannot perceive</w> him:

verses.name: Job 23:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08040">On the left hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">where he doth work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I cannot behold</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">himself on the right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I cannot see</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>:

verses.name: Job 23:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">that I take</w>: <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath tried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, I shall come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">as gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that is with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 23:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">My foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath held</w> <w lemma="strong:H0838">his steps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I kept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and not declined</w>.

verses.name: Job 23:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Neither have I gone back</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">from the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of his lips</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have esteemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">more than my necessary</w> <transChange type="added">food</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>esteemed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hid</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">laid up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>my…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my appointed portion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 23:13
verses.text: But he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">in one</w> <transChange type="added">mind</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and who can turn</w> him? and <transChange type="added">what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">desireth</w>, even <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he doeth</w>.

verses.name: Job 23:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For he performeth</w> <transChange type="added">the thing that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">for me: and many</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">such</w> <transChange type="added">things are</transChange> with him.

verses.name: Job 23:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Therefore am I troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at his presence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">when I consider</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I am afraid</w> of him.

verses.name: Job 23:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">For God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">maketh my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">soft</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07706">and the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">troubleth</w> me:

verses.name: Job 23:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Because I was not cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">the darkness</w>, <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath he covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0652">the darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from my face</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 23." eID="gen505" osisID="Job.23"/>

verses.name: Job 24:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">Why, seeing times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are not hidden</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">from the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">do they that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">his days</w>?

verses.name: Job 24:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">the landmarks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they violently take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">flocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and feed</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>feed…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">feed them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They drive away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02543">the ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">of the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-286">they take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">the widow’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-286">for a pledge</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06035 strong:H06041" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">themselves together</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:5
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06501">wild asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the desert</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go they forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">to their work</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">rising betimes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">for a prey</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06160">the wilderness</w> <transChange type="added">yieldeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w> for them <transChange type="added">and</transChange> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">children</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07114 strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">They reap</w> <transChange type="added">every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01098">his corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03953" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">the vintage</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>corn</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mingled corn</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">dredge</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they gather…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the wicked gather the vintage</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06174">They cause the naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">without clothing</w>, that <transChange type="added">they have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03682">no covering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07135">in the cold</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They are wet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02230">with the showers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and embrace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04268">for want of a shelter</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They pluck</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">from the breast</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take a pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:10
