verses.text: They cause <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">without clothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06016">the sheaf</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07457">the hungry</w>;

verses.name: Job 24:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06671" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H07791">their walls</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">tread</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03342">winepresses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and suffer thirst</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04962">Men</w> <w lemma="strong:H05008" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">groan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from out of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of the wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">crieth out</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0433">yet God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">layeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08604">not folly</w> <transChange type="added">to them</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 24:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04775" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They are of those that rebel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">against the light</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, nor abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">in the paths</w> thereof.

verses.name: Job 24:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The murderer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">with the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06991" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">is as a thief</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also of the adulterer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">for the twilight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">No eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760 strong:H05643" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: and disguiseth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>disguiseth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">setteth his face in secret</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 24:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02822">In the dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H02864" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they dig through</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">houses</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they had marked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">for themselves in the daytime</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">not the light</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">For the morning</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">to them even as</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">the shadow of death</w>: if <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">know</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <transChange type="added">they are in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01091">the terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">of the shadow of death</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:18
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07031">swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325 strong:H06440">as the waters</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02513">their portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">is cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he beholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">of the vineyards</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06723">Drought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02527">and heat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">the snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>: <transChange type="added">so doth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07585">the grave</w> <transChange type="added">those which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have sinned</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consume</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">violently take</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 24:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07358">The womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H07415">him; the worm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall feed sweetly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">on him; he shall be no more remembered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05766">and wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">as a tree</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He evil entreateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06135">the barren</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">beareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not: and doeth not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">to the widow</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He draweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">also the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">with his power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he riseth up</w>, and no <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">is sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>no…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he trusteth not his own life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 24:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it be given</w> him <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">whereon he resteth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">yet his eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">upon their ways</w>.

verses.name: Job 24:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07426" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">for a little while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04355" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">but are gone and brought low</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07092" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they are taken out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w> as all <transChange type="added">other</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">as the tops</w> <w lemma="strong:H07641">of the ears of corn</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are gone</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>taken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">closed up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 24:25
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> not <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0645">now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who will make</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me a liar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">my speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H0408">nothing worth</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 24." eID="gen506" osisID="Job.24"/>

verses.name: Job 25:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01085">Bildad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07747">the Shuhite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">Dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">and fear</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him, he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">in his high places</w>.

verses.name: Job 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Is there</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">any number</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">of his armies</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0216">and upon whom doth not his light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w>?

verses.name: Job 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">How then can man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be justified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">with God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or how can he be clean</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">born</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w>?

verses.name: Job 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03394">Behold even to the moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0166" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and it shineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">not; yea, the stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H02141" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are not pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his sight</w>.

verses.name: Job 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">How much less man</w>, <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07415">a worm</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08438">a worm</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 25." eID="gen507" osisID="Job.25"/>

verses.name: Job 26:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">But Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How hast thou helped</w> <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">without power</w>? <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">savest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">thou the arm</w> <transChange type="added">that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w>?

verses.name: Job 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How hast thou counselled</w> <transChange type="added">him that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">no</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>? and <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">hast thou plentifully</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">the thing as it is</w>?

verses.name: Job 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">To whom hast thou uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05397">and whose spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> from thee?

verses.name: Job 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07496">Dead</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">are formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">from under the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the inhabitants</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>and the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with the inhabitants</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07585">Hell</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06174">naked</w> <w lemma="strong:H011">before him, and destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03682">hath no covering</w>.

verses.name: Job 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He stretcheth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">the north</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">over the empty place</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hangeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01099">upon nothing</w>.

verses.name: Job 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He bindeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">in his thick clouds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06051">and the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not rent</w> under them.

verses.name: Job 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He holdeth back</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of his throne</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06576" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">spreadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">his cloud</w> upon it.

verses.name: Job 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02328" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325 strong:H06440">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">with bounds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">until the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H08503">come to an end</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>until…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">until the end of light with darkness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05982">The pillars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07322" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">tremble</w> <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and are astonished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">at his reproof</w>.

verses.name: Job 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">with his power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08394 strong:H08394" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and by his understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he smiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07293">through the proud</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the proud</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pride</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 26:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">By his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08235" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath garnished</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">hath formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01281">the crooked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">serpent</w>.

verses.name: Job 26:14
verses.text: Lo, these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07098">parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of his ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08102">but how little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07482">of him? but the thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">of his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">who can understand</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 26." eID="gen508" osisID="Job.26"/>

verses.name: Job 27:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Moreover Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375 strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8686">continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>continued</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">added to take up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 27:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07706">and the Almighty</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath vexed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>vexed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made my soul bitter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05750">All the while</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">my breath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in me, and the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in my nostrils</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>the spirit…</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the breath which God gave him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">My lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall not speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">nor my tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07423">deceit</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02486">God forbid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I should justify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">you: till I die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H08538">mine integrity</w> from me.

verses.name: Job 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">My righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">fast, and will not let it go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03824">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not reproach</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">so long as I live</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>so long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from my days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let mine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">be as the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and he that riseth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05767">against me as the unrighteous</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:8
verses.text: For what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H02611">of the hypocrite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">though he hath gained</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0433">when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07953" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taketh away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>?

verses.name: Job 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Will God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">his cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">when trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> upon him?

verses.name: Job 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Will he delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">himself in the Almighty</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06256">will he always</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">upon God</w>?

verses.name: Job 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">you by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07706">with the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I not conceal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">being in the hand</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Job 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, all ye yourselves have seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H01892">why then are ye thus altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">vain</w>?

verses.name: Job 27:13
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of a wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">with God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">and the heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of oppressors</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">If his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be multiplied</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03926">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06631">and his offspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08300">Those that remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of him shall be buried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">in death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0490">and his widows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not weep</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06651" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though he heap up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">as the dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04403">raiment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">as the clay</w>;

verses.name: Job 27:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He may prepare</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the just</w> shall put <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05355">and the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">the silver</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He buildeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">as a moth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05521">and as a booth</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the keeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">maketh</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">man shall lie down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but he shall not be gathered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w>, and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> not.

verses.name: Job 27:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01091">Terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">on him as waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05492">a tempest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stealeth him away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06921">The east</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wind carrieth him away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he departeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and as a storm hurleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">him out of his place</w>.

verses.name: Job 27:22
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, and not spare</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he would fain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of his hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in fleeing he would flee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 27:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall clap</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08319" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">at him, and shall hiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">him out of his place</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 27." eID="gen509" osisID="Job.27"/>

verses.name: Job 28:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">there is a vein</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for the silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">for gold</w> <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they fine</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vein</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01270">Iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">out of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05154">and brass</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06694" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">molten</w> <transChange type="added">out of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">the stone</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>earth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dust</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">to darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and searcheth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08503">all perfection</w>: <w lemma="strong:H068">the stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0652">of darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06757">and the shadow of death</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05158">The flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">breaketh out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from the inhabitant</w>; <transChange type="added">even the waters</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of the foot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are dried up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are gone away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">from men</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">out of it cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and under it is turned up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">as it were fire</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">The stones</w> of it <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05601">of sapphires</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06083">and it hath dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dust…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gold ore</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:7
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05410">a path</w> <w lemma="strong:H05861">which no fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0344">and which the vulture’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07805" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not seen</w>:

verses.name: Job 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07830">The lion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">whelps</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have not trodden</w> <w lemma="strong:H07826">it, nor the fierce lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed</w> by it.

verses.name: Job 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He putteth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02496">upon the rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he overturneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">by the roots</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rock</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">flint</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He cutteth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">among the rocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03366">every precious thing</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He bindeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">from overflowing</w>; and <transChange type="added">the thing that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08587">hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bringeth he forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">to light</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overflowing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0370">But where</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">shall wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be found</w>? and where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">of understanding</w>?

verses.name: Job 28:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">not the price</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thereof; neither is it found</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08415">The depth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">not in me: and the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> not with me.

verses.name: Job 28:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">It cannot be gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05458">for gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">neither shall silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be weighed</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04242">the price</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>It…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Fine gold shall not be given for it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05541" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">It cannot be valued</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">with the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">of Ophir</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03368">with the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07718">onyx</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05601">or the sapphire</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">The gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02137">and the crystal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cannot equal</w> <w lemma="strong:H08545">it: and the exchange</w> of it <transChange type="added">shall not be for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06337">of fine gold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>jewels…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">vessels of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">No mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H07215">shall be made of coral</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01378">or of pearls</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04901">for the price</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06443">above rubies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>coral</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Ramoth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06357">The topaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Ethiopia</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not equal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05541" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">it, neither shall it be valued</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">with pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">gold</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0370">Whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>? and where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">of understanding</w>?

verses.name: Job 28:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Seeing it is hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of all living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and kept close</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">from the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>air</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heaven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H011">Destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">and death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">the fame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thereof with our ears</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">understandeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, and he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> thereof.

verses.name: Job 28:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For he looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">to the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under the whole heaven</w>;

verses.name: Job 28:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04948">the weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">for the winds</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and he weigheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">by measure</w>.

verses.name: Job 28:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">for the rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02385">for the lightning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">of the thunder</w>:

verses.name: Job 28:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then did he see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">it, and declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">it; he prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, yea, and searched it out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>declare…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">number it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 28:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And unto man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03374">Behold, the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w>, that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 28." eID="gen510" osisID="Job.28"/>

verses.name: Job 29:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Moreover Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375 strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8800 strongMorph:TH8686">continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">his parable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>continued</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">added to take up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> I were as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03391">months</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">past</w>, as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">preserved</w> me;

verses.name: Job 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05216">When his candle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shined</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon my head</w>, <transChange type="added">and when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">by his light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I walked</w> <transChange type="added">through</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>candle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lamp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">As I was in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02779">of my youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05475">when the secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">upon my tabernacle</w>;

verses.name: Job 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07706">When the Almighty</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> yet with me, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05288">my children</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> me;

verses.name: Job 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01978">my steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H02529">with butter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">and the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06694" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">poured me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06388">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of oil</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07176">through the city</w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">my seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the street</w>!

verses.name: Job 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">The young men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">me, and hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03453">themselves: and the aged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">arose</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood up</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">The princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">refrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">talking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">on their mouth</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05057">The nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">held</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">to the roof of their mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The nobles…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The voice of the nobles was hid</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">When the ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">then it blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">me; and when the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it gave witness</w> to me:

verses.name: Job 29:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Because I delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03490">and the fatherless</w>, and <transChange type="added">him that had</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to help</w> him.

verses.name: Job 29:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">The blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that was ready to perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">upon me: and I caused the widow’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to sing for joy</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I put</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">on righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">me: my judgment</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04598">as a robe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06797">and a diadem</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">I was eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05787">to the blind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and feet</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06455">I to the lame</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:16
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">to the poor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07379">and the cause</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I knew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not I searched out</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And I brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04973">the jaws</w> <w lemma="strong:H05767">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and plucked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">out of his teeth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the jaws</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the jawteeth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">the grinders</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>plucked</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cast</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 29:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">in my nest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I shall multiply</w> <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">as the sand</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08328">My root</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">spread out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">by the waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02919">and the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lay all night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">upon my branch</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spread…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">opened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 29:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">My glory</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02319">fresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05978">in me</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">and my bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">was renewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in my hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fresh</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">new</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>renewed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">changed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 29:21
verses.text: Unto me <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gave ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and waited</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and kept silence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03926">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">my counsel</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they spake not again</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04405">and my speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dropped</w> upon them.

verses.name: Job 29:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And they waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">for me as for the rain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06473" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">their mouth</w> wide <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04456">for the latter rain</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:24
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I laughed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">on them, they believed</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">not; and the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they cast not down</w>.

verses.name: Job 29:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out their way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">chief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">as a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">in the army</w>, as one <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">comforteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H057">the mourners</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 29." eID="gen511" osisID="Job.29"/>

verses.name: Job 30:1
verses.text: But now <transChange type="added">they that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H06810">younger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">than I have me in derision</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">whose fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I would have disdained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">with the dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">of my flock</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>younger…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of fewer days than I</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04100">Yea, whereto</w> <transChange type="added">might</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w> <transChange type="added">profit</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03624">me, in whom old age</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was perished</w>?

verses.name: Job 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02639">For want</w> <w lemma="strong:H03720">and famine</w> <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01565">solitary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06207" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fleeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">into the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0570">in former time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07722">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04875">and waste</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>solitary</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">dark as the night</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">yesternight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06998" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Who cut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04408">mallows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07880">by the bushes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07574">and juniper</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">roots</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03899">their meat</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">They were driven forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01460">from among</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, (<w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they cried</w> after them as <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01590">a thief</w>;)

verses.name: Job 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06178">in the clifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the valleys</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02356">caves</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the earth</w>, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03710">the rocks</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>caves</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">holes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07880">Among the bushes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05101" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they brayed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02738">under the nettles</w> <w lemma="strong:H05596" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">they were gathered together</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">They were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">of fools</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">yea, children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of base men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05217" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they were viler</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">than the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>base…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of no name</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05058">And now am I their song</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04405">yea, I am their byword</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, they flee far</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from me, and spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07536">not to spit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in my face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and withhold not spittle from</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Because he hath loosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">my cord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">me, they have also let loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07448">the bridle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> me.

verses.name: Job 30:12
verses.text: Upon <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">right</w> <transChange type="added">hand</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06526">the youth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they push away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they raise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">against me the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of their destruction</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05420" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They mar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">my path</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they set forward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01962 strong:H01942" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">my calamity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they have no helper</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They came</w> <transChange type="added">upon me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07342">as a wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">breaking</w> in <transChange type="added">of waters</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08478">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07722">the desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8701">they rolled</w> themselves <transChange type="added">upon me</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 30:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01091">Terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">are turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon me: they pursue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05082">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">as the wind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03444">and my welfare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passeth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">as a cloud</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my soul</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my principal one</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And now my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">is poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">upon me; the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">of affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have taken hold</w> upon me.

verses.name: Job 30:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">My bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05365" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">are pierced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in me in the night season</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06207" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and my sinews</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take no rest</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">By the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">force</w> <transChange type="added">of my disease</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03830">is my garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">changed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it bindeth me about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">as the collar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03801">of my coat</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">me into the mire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and I am become like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">and ashes</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, and thou dost not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: I stand up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and thou regardest</w> me <transChange type="added">not</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 30:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Thou art become</w> <w lemma="strong:H0393">cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06108">to me: with thy strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07852" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou opposest</w> thyself against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>become…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turned to be cruel</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the strength of thy hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou liftest me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">to the wind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou causest me to ride</w> <transChange type="added">upon it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and dissolvest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07738 strong:H08454" morph="strongMorph:TH8762 strongMorph:TH8675">my substance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wisdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou wilt bring</w> me <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">for all living</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Howbeit he will not stretch out</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01164">to the grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07769">though they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06365">in his destruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grave</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heap</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Did not I weep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H07186">for him that was in trouble</w>? was <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05701" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">for the poor</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>in trouble</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hard of day?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">When I looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">then evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <transChange type="added">unto me</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and when I waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">for light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0652">darkness</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04578">My bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07570" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">boiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and rested</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not: the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">of affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">prevented</w> me.

verses.name: Job 30:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02535">without the sun</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I stood up</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in the congregation</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">I am a brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">to dragons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07453">and a companion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03284 strong:H01323">to owls</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>owls</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ostriches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 30:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05785">My skin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07835" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is black</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">upon me, and my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02721">with heat</w>.

verses.name: Job 30:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03658">My harp</w> also is <transChange type="added">turned</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H060">to mourning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05748">and my organ</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">into the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that weep</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 30." eID="gen512" osisID="Job.30"/>

verses.name: Job 31:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with mine eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">why then should I think</w> <w lemma="strong:H01330">upon a maid</w>?

verses.name: Job 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02506">For what portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">of God</w> <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">from above</w>? and <transChange type="added">what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">from on high</w>?

verses.name: Job 31:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0343">not destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05767">to the wicked</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05235">and a strange</w> <transChange type="added">punishment</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>?

verses.name: Job 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Doth not he see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and count</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">all my steps</w>?

verses.name: Job 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">with vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">or if my foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath hasted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">to deceit</w>;

verses.name: Job 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me be weighed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in an even</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">balance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0433">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08538">mine integrity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Let…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Let him weigh me in balances of justice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0838">If my step</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath turned out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03971">and if any blot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath cleaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">to mine hands</w>;

verses.name: Job 31:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let me sow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and let another</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">eat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06631">yea, let my offspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be rooted out</w>.

verses.name: Job 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">If mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have been deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">by a woman</w>, or <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have laid wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">at my neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">door</w>;

verses.name: Job 31:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0802">let my wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H02912" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0312">and let others</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bow down</w> upon her.

verses.name: Job 31:11
verses.text: For this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02154">an heinous crime</w>; yea, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">an iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">to be punished by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06414">the judges</w>.

verses.name: Job 31:12
verses.text: For it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consumeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H011">to destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and would root out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">all mine increase</w>.

verses.name: Job 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I did despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of my manservant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">or of my maidservant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07379">when they contended</w> with me;

verses.name: Job 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What then shall I do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">riseth up</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when he visiteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">what shall I answer</w> him?

verses.name: Job 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Did not he that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">me in the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him? and did not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">fashion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">us in the womb</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>did not one…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">did he not fashion us in one womb?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I have withheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> from <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">desire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">or have caused the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">of the widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to fail</w>;

verses.name: Job 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Or have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">my morsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">myself alone, and the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath not eaten</w> thereof;

verses.name: Job 31:18
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H05271">For from my youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he was brought up</w> with me, as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">a father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I have guided</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">her from my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">womb</w>;)<note type="study"><catchWord>her</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the widow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">any perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">for want of clothing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H034">or any poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03682">without covering</w>;

verses.name: Job 31:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02504">If his loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have not blessed</w> me, and <transChange type="added">if</transChange> he were <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">warmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01488">with the fleece</w> <w lemma="strong:H03532">of my sheep</w>;

verses.name: Job 31:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">If I have lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">against the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">my help</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>:

verses.name: Job 31:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03802">let mine arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07929">from my shoulder blade</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0248">and mine arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">from the bone</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bone</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">chanelbone</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0343">For destruction</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06343">a terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H07613">to me, and by reason of his highness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I could</w> not endure.

verses.name: Job 31:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03689">my hope</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">to the fine gold</w>, <transChange type="added">Thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04009">my confidence</w>;

verses.name: Job 31:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">because my wealth</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and because mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03524">much</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>gotten…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found much</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when it shined</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">or the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walking</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">brightness</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>sun</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">light</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bright</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">And my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">hath been secretly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enticed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">or my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath kissed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>my mouth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my hand hath kissed my mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:28
verses.text: This also <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">an iniquity</w> <transChange type="added">to be punished by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06416">the judge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I should have denied</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>.

verses.name: Job 31:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H06365">at the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of him that hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">me, or lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">myself when evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">found</w> him:

verses.name: Job 31:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Neither have I suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by wishing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">a curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to his soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04962">If the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of my tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, Oh that we had</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we cannot be satisfied</w>.

verses.name: Job 31:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01616">The stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did not lodge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the street</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">my doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">to the traveller</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>traveller</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">way</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">If I covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0121">as Adam</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by hiding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">mine iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02243">in my bosom</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>as Adam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">after the manner of men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Did I fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0937">or did the contempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H04940">of families</w> <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">terrify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, that I kept silence</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of the door</w>?

verses.name: Job 31:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">one would hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08420">me! behold, my desire</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07706">the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would answer</w> me, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07379 strong:H0376">mine adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had written</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">a book</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my sign is that the Almighty will</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Surely I would take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">it upon my shoulder</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06029" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bind</w> it <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05850">a crown</w> to me.

verses.name: Job 31:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I would declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">unto him the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">of my steps</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05057">as a prince</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">would I go near</w> unto him.

verses.name: Job 31:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0127">If my land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08525">against me, or that the furrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">likewise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof complain</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>complain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weep</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">the fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">thereof without money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01167">or have caused the owners</w> <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thereof to lose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their life</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>fruits</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strength</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the owners…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the soul of the owners thereof to expire</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">breathe out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 31:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02336">Let thistles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">instead of wheat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0890">and cockle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08184">instead of barley</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">of Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are ended</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cockle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">noisome weeds</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 31." eID="gen513" osisID="Job.31"/>

verses.name: Job 32:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">So these three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>, because he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from answering</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0453">of Elihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01292">of Barachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0940">the Buzite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">of the kindred</w> <w lemma="strong:H07410">of Ram</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0347">against Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">was his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kindled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">because he justified</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">himself</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">rather than God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>himself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07969">Also against his three</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">was his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">kindled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they had found</w> <w lemma="strong:H04617">no answer</w>, and <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">had condemned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0453">Now Elihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">till Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">had spoken</w>, because they <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H02205">elder</w> than he.<note type="study"><catchWord>waited…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">expected Job in words</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>elder</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">elder for days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0453">When Elihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saw</w> that <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04617">no answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in the mouth</w> of <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07969">three</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">then his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:6
