verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0453">And Elihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01292">of Barachel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0940">the Buzite</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H06810">young</w>, and ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03453">very old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02119" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherefore I was afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and durst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02331" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">not shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01843">you mine opinion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>young</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">few of days</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>durst…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">feared</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">Days</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">should speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">should teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0403">But</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">a spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">in man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05397">and the inspiration</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">giveth them understanding</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Great men</w> are not <transChange type="added">always</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02205">neither do the aged</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02331" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to me; I also will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01843">mine opinion</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Behold, I waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">for your words</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I gave ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">to your reasons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whilst ye searched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">what to say</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>reasons</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">understandings</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>what…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">Yea, I attended</w> unto you, and, behold, <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none of you that convinced</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">his words</w>:

verses.name: Job 32:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest ye should say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have found out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thrusteth him down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">not man</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now he hath not directed</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me: neither will I answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">him with your speeches</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>directed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ordered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They were amazed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">no more: they left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">speaking</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>left…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">removed speeches from themselves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">When I had waited</w>, (<w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not, but stood still</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">answered</w> no more;)

verses.name: Job 32:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">I said</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">also my part</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02331" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I also will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01843">mine opinion</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I am full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">of matter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H06693" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me constraineth</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>matter</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>spirit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spirit of my belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0990">Behold, my belly</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03196">as wine</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">hath no vent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it is ready to burst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">like new</w> <w lemma="strong:H0178">bottles</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is not opened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07304" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may be refreshed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and answer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">breathe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 32:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me not, I pray you, accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">any man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03655" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither let me give flattering titles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">unto man</w>.

verses.name: Job 32:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03655" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">not to give flattering titles</w>; <transChange type="added">in so doing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">my maker</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">would soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take me away</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 32." eID="gen514" osisID="Job.32"/>

verses.name: Job 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0199">Wherefore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">I pray thee, hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">my speeches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to all my words</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, now I have opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">my tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">in my mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in my mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in my palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0561">My words</w> <transChange type="added">shall be of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03476">the uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of my heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">and my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H04448" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">shall utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">clearly</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The Spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">me, and the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath given me life</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If thou canst</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">answer</w> me, set <transChange type="added">thy words</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">me, stand up</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:6
verses.text: Behold, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according to thy wish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">in God’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07169" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">stead: I also am formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">out of the clay</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mouth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>formed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0367">Behold, my terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall not make thee afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0405">neither shall my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be heavy</w> upon thee.

verses.name: Job 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Surely thou hast spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">in mine hearing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> of <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,<note type="study"><catchWord>hearing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ears</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02134">I am clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">without transgression</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02643">innocent</w>; neither <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> in me.

verses.name: Job 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Behold, he findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08569">occasions</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me, he counteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me for his enemy</w>,

verses.name: Job 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He putteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05465">in the stocks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he marketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">all my paths</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:12
verses.text: Behold, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this thou art not just</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">thee, that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is greater</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">than man</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why dost thou strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against him? for he giveth not account</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of any of his matters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he giveth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he answereth not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">For God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">once</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">yea twice</w>, <transChange type="added">yet man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perceiveth</w> it not.

verses.name: Job 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02472">In a dream</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02384">in a vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">of the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08639">when deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sleep falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">upon men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08572">in slumberings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon the bed</w>;

verses.name: Job 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">the ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04561">their instruction</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">he revealeth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">uncovereth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That he may withdraw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <transChange type="added">from his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">purpose</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01466">pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">from man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>purpose</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">work</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He keepeth back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">from the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from perishing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07973">by the sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from perishing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from passing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">He is chastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">also with pain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon his bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07379 strong:H07230" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">of his bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">with strong</w> <transChange type="added">pain</transChange>:

verses.name: Job 33:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">So that his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H02092" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">abhorreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">dainty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">meat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dainty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meat of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">His flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is consumed away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07210">that it cannot be seen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06106">and his bones</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08205 strong:H08192" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8795">stick out</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Yea, his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">draweth near</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">unto the grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to the destroyers</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">If there</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">be a messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">with him, an interpreter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">among a thousand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">unto man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">his uprightness</w>:

verses.name: Job 33:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then he is gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him from going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">to the pit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">a ransom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a ransom</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">an atonement</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">His flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07375" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be fresher</w> <w lemma="strong:H05290">than a child’s</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05934">of his youth</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a child’s</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">childhood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06279" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will be favourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him: and he shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with joy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for he will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">his righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">upon men</w>, and <transChange type="added">if any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and perverted</w> <transChange type="added">that which was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it profited</w> me not;<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">He shall look upon men, and say</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from going</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">into the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and his life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">He hath delivered my soul, etc, and my life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:29
verses.text: Lo, all these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969 strong:H06471">oftentimes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">with man</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>oftentimes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">twice and thrice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 33:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To bring back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">from the pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be enlightened</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">with the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Mark well</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0347">O Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me: hold thy peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will speak</w>.

verses.name: Job 33:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">If thou hast</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">any thing to say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">me: speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to justify</w> thee.

verses.name: Job 33:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">If not, hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me: hold thy peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">thee wisdom</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 33." eID="gen515" osisID="Job.33"/>

verses.name: Job 34:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0453">Furthermore Elihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02450">O ye wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto me, ye that have knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">For the ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02441">as the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">meat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">to us judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us know</w> among ourselves what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">For Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgment</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Should I lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">against my right</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02671">my wound</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">incurable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">without transgression</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my wound</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mine arrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">What man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0347">like Job</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drinketh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03933">scorning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like water</w>?

verses.name: Job 34:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0732" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Which goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02274">in company</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">with wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he hath said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">It profiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nothing that he should delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">himself with God</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">unto me, ye men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of understanding</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02486">far be it</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">from God</w>, <transChange type="added">that he should do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07562">wickedness</w>; and <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07706">the Almighty</w>, <transChange type="added">that he should commit</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>men…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06467">For the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he render</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">unto him, and cause every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to find</w> according to <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0734">ways</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">Yea, surely</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will not do wickedly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07706">neither will the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath given him a charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over the earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or who hath disposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the whole world</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>the whole</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all of it?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> upon man, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">unto himself his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05397">and his breath</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">All flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">and man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">unto dust</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:16
verses.text: If now <transChange type="added">thou hast</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">this: hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">of my words</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Shall even he that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">govern</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and wilt thou condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03524">him that is most</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">just</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>govern</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bind?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Is it fit</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to say</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to a king</w>, <transChange type="added">Thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01100">wicked</w>? <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05081">to princes</w>, <transChange type="added">Ye are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">ungodly</w>?

verses.name: Job 34:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">How much less to him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that accepteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not the persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">nor regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07771">the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">more than</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w>? for they all <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07281">In a moment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H02676">at midnight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pass away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H047">and the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">without hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they shall take away the mighty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">For his eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">upon the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">all his goings</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02822">no darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06757">nor shadow of death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">where the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">may hide</w> themselves.

verses.name: Job 34:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he will not lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">upon man</w> more <transChange type="added">than right</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he should enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">into judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">with God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enter</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03524">mighty men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02714">without number</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">others</w> in their stead.<note type="study"><catchWord>number</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">searching out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04566">their works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he overturneth</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">so that they are destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">crushed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He striketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">them as</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in the open</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sight</w> of others;<note type="study"><catchWord>open…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">place of beholders</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because they turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">from him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and would not consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">any of his ways</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06818">So that they cause the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto him, and he heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the afflicted</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">When he giveth quietness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who then can make trouble</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and when he hideth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who then can behold</w> him? whether <transChange type="added">it be done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">against a nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">or against a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">only</w>:

verses.name: Job 34:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02611 strong:H0120">That the hypocrite</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">not, lest the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">be ensnared</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">Surely it is meet to be said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have borne</w> <transChange type="added">chastisement</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not offend</w> <transChange type="added">any more</transChange>:

verses.name: Job 34:32
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou me: if I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will do</w> no more.

verses.name: Job 34:33
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Should it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">according to thy mind? he will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988 strong:H03588" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it, whether thou refuse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or whether thou choose</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and not I: therefore speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what thou knowest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>according…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from with thee?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Let men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">me, and let a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hearken</w> unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">without knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and his words</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">without wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Job 34:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01 strong:H015" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">My desire</w> <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be tried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">unto the end</w> because of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08666">answers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">for wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>My…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">My father, let Job be tried</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 34:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For he addeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">rebellion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">unto his sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05606" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he clappeth</w> <transChange type="added">his hands</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">among us, and multiplieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">against God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 34." eID="gen516" osisID="Job.34"/>

verses.name: Job 35:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0453">Elihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">moreover, and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thinkest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thou this to be right</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">My righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">more than God’s</w>?

verses.name: Job 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What advantage</w> will it be unto thee? <transChange type="added">and</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">What profit</w> shall I have, <transChange type="added">if I be cleansed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from my sin</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>if…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by it more than by my sin</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04405 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thee, and thy companions</w> with thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>answer…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">return to thee words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">the clouds</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are higher</w> than thou.

verses.name: Job 35:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If thou sinnest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what doest</w> thou against him? or <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">thy transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">be multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what doest</w> thou unto him?

verses.name: Job 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If thou be righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">what givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou him? or what receiveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">he of thine hand</w>?

verses.name: Job 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07562">Thy wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">may hurt</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> as thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06666">and thy righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">may profit</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.

verses.name: Job 35:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">By reason of the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06217">of oppressions</w> they make <transChange type="added">the oppressed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to cry</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they cry out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">by reason of the arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of the mighty</w>.

verses.name: Job 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But none saith</w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">my maker</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02158">songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>;

verses.name: Job 35:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0502" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Who teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">us more than the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and maketh us wiser</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">than the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>?

verses.name: Job 35:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">There they cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but none giveth answer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil men</w>.

verses.name: Job 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Surely God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07706">neither will the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">regard</w> it.

verses.name: Job 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">Although</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou sayest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07789" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not see</w> him, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01779">judgment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">him; therefore trust</w> thou in him.

verses.name: Job 35:15
verses.text: But now, because <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> not <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in his anger</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet he knoweth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">not in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06580">extremity</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>he hath</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">God hath</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>he knoweth</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Job knoweth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 35:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Therefore doth Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">in vain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03527" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he multiplieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01097">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 35." eID="gen517" osisID="Job.35"/>

verses.name: Job 36:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0453">Elihu</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also proceeded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03803" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02191">me a little</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02331" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will shew</w> thee that <transChange type="added">I have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04405">yet to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">on God’s</w> behalf.<note type="study"><catchWord>I have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there are yet words for God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will fetch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01843">my knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">from afar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will ascribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to my Maker</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0551">For truly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">my words</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">false</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08549">he that is perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01844">in knowledge</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> with thee.

verses.name: Job 36:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Behold, God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03524">mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and despiseth</w> not <transChange type="added">any</transChange>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03524">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in strength</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">wisdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wisdom</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He preserveth not the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">to the poor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>poor</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">afflicted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He withdraweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">not his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">from the righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">but with kings</w> <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03678">on the throne</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yea, he doth establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">them for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they are exalted</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:8
verses.text: And if <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02131">in fetters</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be holden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">in cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">of affliction</w>;

verses.name: Job 36:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then he sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">them their work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">and their transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">that they have exceeded</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">also their ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">to discipline</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and commandeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they return</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">from iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If they obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and serve</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall spend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">their days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">in prosperity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and their years</w> <w lemma="strong:H05273">in pleasures</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But if they obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, they shall perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07973">by the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">without knowledge</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>perish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02611">But the hypocrites</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heap up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not when he bindeth</w> them.

verses.name: Job 36:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">They</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w> <w lemma="strong:H05290">in youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">and their life</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06945">among the unclean</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Their soul dieth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>unclean</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sodomites</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">in his affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">their ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">in oppression</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>poor</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">afflicted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Even so would he have removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862 strong:H06310">thee out of the strait</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07338">a broad place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08478">where</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04164">no straitness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05183">and that which should be set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">on thy table</w> <transChange type="added">should be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">of fatness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the rest of thy table</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But thou hast fulfilled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01779">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take hold</w> <transChange type="added">on thee</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>take…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">should uphold thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:18
verses.text: Because <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">wrath</w>, <transChange type="added">beware</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05496" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lest he take thee away</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05607">stroke</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">then a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">ransom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cannot deliver</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>deliver…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turn thee aside</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Will he esteem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07769">thy riches</w>? <transChange type="added">no</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01222">not gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03981">nor all the forces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">of strength</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">not the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">when people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are cut off</w> in their place.

verses.name: Job 36:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Take heed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">not iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for this hast thou chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">rather than affliction</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Behold, God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">exalteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">by his power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who teacheth</w> like him?

verses.name: Job 36:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath enjoined</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">him his way</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or who can say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>?

verses.name: Job 36:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07679" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that thou magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">his work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">which men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">behold</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">it; man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may behold</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Behold, God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07689">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we know</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">not, neither can the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of his years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02714">be searched out</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01639" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For he maketh small</w> <w lemma="strong:H05198">the drops</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they pour down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0108">according to the vapour</w> thereof:

verses.name: Job 36:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07834">Which the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do drop</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">distil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">upon man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">abundantly</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:29
verses.text: Also can <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04666">the spreadings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">of the clouds</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08663">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">of his tabernacle</w>?

verses.name: Job 36:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, he spreadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">his light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon it, and covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">the bottom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bottom</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">roots</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 36:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For by them judgeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">he the people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04342" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">in abundance</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03709">With clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and commandeth</w> it <transChange type="added">not to shine</transChange> by <transChange type="added">the cloud</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06293" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that cometh betwixt</w>.

verses.name: Job 36:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07452">The noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04735">concerning it, the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">also concerning the vapour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the vapour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that which goeth up</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 36." eID="gen518" osisID="Job.36"/>

verses.name: Job 37:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02063">At this</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">also my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02729" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trembleth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and is moved out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">of his place</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">attentively</w> <w lemma="strong:H07267">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">of his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01899">and the sound</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Hear…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hear in hearing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 37:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He directeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08281" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">under the whole heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and his lightning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">unto the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lightning</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">light</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>ends</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 37:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">it a voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roareth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he thundereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">of his excellency</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06117" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and he will not stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">them when his voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is heard</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thundereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">marvellously</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with his voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01419">great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he, which we cannot comprehend</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">to the snow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01933" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be thou</w> <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04306">likewise to the small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04306">and to the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of his strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>likewise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and to the shower of rain, and to the showers of rain of his strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 37:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02856" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sealeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of every man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">that all men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">his work</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Then the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01119">into</w> <w lemma="strong:H0695">dens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04585">in their places</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02315">Out of the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">the whirlwind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07135">and cold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04215">out of the north</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>south</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chamber</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>north</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">scattering winds</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 37:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05397">By the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07140">frost</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is given</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07341">and the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04164">is straitened</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07377">Also by watering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02959" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he wearieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">the thick cloud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he scattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">his bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">cloud</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the cloud of his light</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 37:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">And it is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04524">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H08458">by his counsels</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06467">that they may do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">whatsoever he commandeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">them upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He causeth it to come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">whether for correction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">or for his land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">or for mercy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>correction</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a rod</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 37:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">unto this, O Job</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">stand still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">and consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the wondrous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">works of God</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Dost thou know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">when God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">disposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">them, and caused the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">of his cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to shine</w>?

verses.name: Job 37:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Dost thou know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04657">the balancings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">of the clouds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04652">the wondrous works</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">of him which is perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01843">in knowledge</w>?

verses.name: Job 37:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">How thy garments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02525">warm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when he quieteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01864">by the south</w> <transChange type="added">wind</transChange>?

verses.name: Job 37:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Hast thou with him spread out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">the sky</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02389">strong</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">as a molten</w> <w lemma="strong:H07209">looking glass</w>?

verses.name: Job 37:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us what we shall say</w> unto him; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we cannot order</w> <transChange type="added">our speech</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">Shall it be told</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him that I speak</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0376">if a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">speak</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">surely he shall be swallowed up</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:21
verses.text: And now <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0925">not the bright</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w> which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07834">in the clouds</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">but the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cleanseth</w> them.

verses.name: Job 37:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02091">Fair weather</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">out of the north</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0433">with God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">majesty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Fair…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Gold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 37:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Touching</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07706">the Almighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we cannot find him out</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07689">excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and in judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and in plenty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of justice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will not afflict</w>.

verses.name: Job 37:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do therefore fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: he respecteth</w> not any <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 37." eID="gen519" osisID="Job.37"/>

verses.name: Job 38:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">out of the whirlwind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 38:2
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">this that darkeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04405">by words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">without knowledge</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gird up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02504">now thy loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">like a man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will demand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">of thee, and answer</w> thou me.<note type="study"><catchWord>answer…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make me know</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0375">Where</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">wast thou when I laid the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">declare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if thou hast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">knowest understanding</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04461">the measures</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, if thou knowest</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or who hath stretched</w> <w lemma="strong:H06957">the line</w> upon it?

verses.name: Job 38:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0134">Whereupon are the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">thereof fastened</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or who laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">the corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> thereof;<note type="study"><catchWord>foundations</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sockets</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fastened</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made to sink?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">When the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sang</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shouted</w> for joy?

verses.name: Job 38:8
verses.text: Or <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">with doors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01518" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when it brake forth</w>, <transChange type="added">as if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it had issued out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">of the womb</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">the cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">the garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">thereof, and thick darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02854">a swaddlingband</w> for it,

verses.name: Job 38:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And brake up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">for it my decreed</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">and doors</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>brake…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">established my decree upon it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06311 strong:H05704">Hitherto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but no further</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01347">and here shall thy proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be stayed</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the pride of thy waves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Hast thou commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">since thy days</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07837">caused the dayspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">his place</w>;

verses.name: Job 38:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That it might take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">that the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">might be shaken out</w> of it?<note type="study"><catchWord>ends</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">It is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02563">as clay</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02368">the seal</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and they stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">as a garment</w>.

verses.name: Job 38:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">And from the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">their light</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is withholden</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken</w>.

verses.name: Job 38:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05033">into the springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">or hast thou walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02714">in the search</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">of the depth</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">Have the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">been opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee? or hast thou seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">of the shadow of death</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">Hast thou perceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H07338">the breadth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if thou knowest</w> it all.

verses.name: Job 38:19
verses.text: Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwelleth</w>? and <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>, where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">the place</w> thereof,

verses.name: Job 38:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That thou shouldest take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">it to the bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof, and that thou shouldest know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">the paths</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> thereof?<note type="study"><catchWord>to the bound</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">at</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Job 38:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Knowest</w> thou <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">because thou wast then born</w>? or <transChange type="added">because</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of thy days</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Hast thou entered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">into the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">of the snow</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or hast thou seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">the treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">of the hail</w>,

verses.name: Job 38:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Which I have reserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">against the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">against the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">of battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">and war</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0335">By what</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">is the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">parted</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">scattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">the east wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06385" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Who hath divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H08585">a watercourse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07858">for the overflowing of waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">or a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02385">for the lightning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">of thunder</w>;

verses.name: Job 38:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To cause it to rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">no man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>; <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w>, wherein <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w>;

verses.name: Job 38:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07722">the desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04875">and waste</w> <transChange type="added">ground</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04161">and to cause the bud</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">of the tender herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to spring forth</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">Hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">a father</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">or who hath begotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H096">the drops</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">of dew</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0990">Out of whose womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H07140">the ice</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03713">and the hoary frost</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath gendered</w> it?

verses.name: Job 38:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">The waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02244" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">are hid</w> as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H068">a stone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">of the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">is frozen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is taken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Canst thou bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04575">the sweet influences</w> <w lemma="strong:H03598">of Pleiades</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">or loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04189">the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03685">of Orion</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Pleiades</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the seven stars</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Cimah</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Orion</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Cesil?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:32
