verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Canst thou bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04216">Mazzaroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his season</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">or canst thou guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05906">Arcturus</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with his sons</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Mazzaroth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the twelve signs</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>guide</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">guide them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">thou the ordinances</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">canst thou set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04896">the dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thereof in the earth</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Canst thou lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">to the clouds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08229">that abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may cover</w> thee?

verses.name: Job 38:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Canst thou send</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">lightnings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and say</w> unto thee, Here we <transChange type="added">are</transChange>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Here…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Behold us?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who hath put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02910">in the inward parts</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or who hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07907">to the heart</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Who can number</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">in wisdom</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">or who can stay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">the bottles</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>stay</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to lie down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06083">When the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">groweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04165">into hardness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07263">and the clods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">cleave fast together</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>groweth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is turned into mire</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is poured</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">the prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H03833">for the lion</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">or fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the appetite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of the young lions</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>the appetite</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 38:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When they couch</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04585">dens</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in the covert</w> <w lemma="strong:H03926">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H0695">lie in wait</w>?

verses.name: Job 38:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Who provideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06158">for the raven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">his food</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03206">when his young ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H01097">for lack</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">of meat</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 38." eID="gen520" osisID="Job.38"/>

verses.name: Job 39:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">thou the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03277">when the wild goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bring forth</w>? <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">canst thou mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0355">when the hinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">do calve</w>?

verses.name: Job 39:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Canst thou number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03391">the months</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they fulfil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">or knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">thou the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they bring forth</w>?

verses.name: Job 39:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">themselves, they bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03206">their young ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">their sorrows</w>.

verses.name: Job 39:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Their young ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are in good liking</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they grow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">with corn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they go forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and return</w> not unto them.

verses.name: Job 39:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Who hath sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06501">the wild ass</w> <w lemma="strong:H02670">free</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">or who hath loosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">the bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06171">of the wild ass</w>?

verses.name: Job 39:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">Whose house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04420">and the barren</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">land his dwellings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>barren…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">salt places</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 39:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He scorneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08663">he the crying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05065" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the driver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the driver</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the exactor</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 39:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03491">The range</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04829">his pasture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he searcheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03387">every green thing</w>.

verses.name: Job 39:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07214">Will the unicorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, or abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H018">by thy crib</w>?

verses.name: Job 39:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Canst thou bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H07214">the unicorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">with his band</w> <w lemma="strong:H08525">in the furrow</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07702" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">or will he harrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> thee?

verses.name: Job 39:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">him, because his strength</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or wilt thou leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">thy labour</w> to him?

verses.name: Job 39:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Wilt thou believe</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">him, that he will bring home</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">thy seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and gather</w> <transChange type="added">it into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01637">thy barn</w>?

verses.name: Job 39:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Gavest thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07443">the goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05965" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto the peacocks</w>? <w lemma="strong:H084">or wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02624">and feathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05133">unto the ostrich</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>wings and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the feathers of the stork and ostrich</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 39:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Which leaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01000">her eggs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and warmeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">them in dust</w>,

verses.name: Job 39:15

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07188" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">She is hardened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">against her young ones</w>, as though <transChange type="added">they were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">hers: her labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">is in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">without fear</w>;

verses.name: Job 39:18

verses.name: Job 39:19

verses.name: Job 39:20

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He paweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">in the valley</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoiceth</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he goeth on</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05402">the armed men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He paweth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">His feet dig</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the armed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the armour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 39:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He mocketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">at fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02865" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and is not affrighted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither turneth he back</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>.

verses.name: Job 39:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0827">The quiver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07439" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rattleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03851">against him, the glittering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03591">and the shield</w>.

verses.name: Job 39:24

verses.name: Job 39:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H01767">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">Ha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">ha</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07306" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he smelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">the battle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07482">the thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the captains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08643">and the shouting</w>.

verses.name: Job 39:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05322">Doth the hawk</w> <w lemma="strong:H082" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">by thy wisdom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stretch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">her wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">toward the south</w>?

verses.name: Job 39:27

verses.name: Job 39:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">and abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">on the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">upon the crag</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04686">and the strong place</w>.

verses.name: Job 39:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">From thence she seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">the prey</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">her eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>.

verses.name: Job 39:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0667">Her young ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05966" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also suck up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02491">and where the slain</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, there <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01931">she</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 39." eID="gen521" osisID="Job.39"/>

verses.name: Job 40:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Shall he that contendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">with the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03250">instruct</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>? <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that reproveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him answer</w> it.

verses.name: Job 40:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0347">Then Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

I will lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">mine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03926">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Job 40:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Once</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I spoken</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will not answer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08147">yea, twice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but I will proceed no further</w>.

verses.name: Job 40:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">unto Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">out of the whirlwind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 40:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Wilt thou also disannul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my judgment</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wilt thou condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, that thou mayest be righteous</w>?

verses.name: Job 40:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02220">Hast thou an arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">like God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">or canst thou thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with a voice</w> like him?

verses.name: Job 40:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05710" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deck</w> thyself now <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01347">majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01363">and excellency</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and array</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">thyself with glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and beauty</w>.

verses.name: Job 40:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Cast abroad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">the rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thy wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> every one <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01343">proud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and abase</w> him.

verses.name: Job 40:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Look</w> on every one <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01343">proud</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bring him low</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01915" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and tread down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> in their place.

verses.name: Job 40:13

verses.name: Job 40:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then will I also confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">unto thee that thine own right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">can save</w> thee.

verses.name: Job 40:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0930">Behold now behemoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with thee; he eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02682">grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">as an ox</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>behemoth</catchWord>: <transChange type="amplified">probably an extinct animal of some kind</transChange></note>

verses.name: Job 40:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03581">Lo now, his strength</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04975">in his loins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0202">and his force</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08306">in the navel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of his belly</w>.

verses.name: Job 40:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He moveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02180">his tail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">like a cedar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01517">the sinews</w> <w lemma="strong:H06344">of his stones</w> <w lemma="strong:H08276" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">are wrapped together</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">He setteth up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 40:18

verses.name: Job 40:22

verses.name: Job 40:24

verses.name: Job 41:1

verses.name: Job 41:2

verses.name: Job 41:6

verses.name: Job 41:7

verses.name: Job 41:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08431">Behold, the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of him is in vain</w>: shall not <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">be cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04758">even at the sight</w> of him?

verses.name: Job 41:12

verses.name: Job 41:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Who can open</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his face</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08127">his teeth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0367">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">His</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0650 strong:H04043">scales</w> <transChange type="added">are his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01346">pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut up together</w> <transChange type="added">as with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">a close</w> <w lemma="strong:H02368">seal</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>scales</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong pieces of shields</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 41:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is so near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">that no air</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can come</w> between them.

verses.name: Job 41:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">They are joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">one</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">to another</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they stick together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">that they cannot be sundered</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05846">By his neesings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">doth shine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">and his eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06079">like the eyelids</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">of the morning</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Out of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H03940">burning lamps</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03590">sparks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">leap out</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05156">Out of his nostrils</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">smoke</w>, as <transChange type="added">out</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05301" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">of a seething</w> <w lemma="strong:H01731">pot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0100">or caldron</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">His breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">kindleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">coals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03851">and a flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06677">In his neck</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01670">and sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01750" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is turned into joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>is turned into joy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rejoiceth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 41:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04651">The flakes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of his flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are joined together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">they are firm</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">in themselves; they cannot be moved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>flakes</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fallings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 41:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">His heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is as firm</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">as a stone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">yea, as hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06400">as a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">of the nether</w> <transChange type="added">millstone</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 41:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07613">When he raiseth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">himself, the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07667">by reason of breakings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they purify</w> themselves.

verses.name: Job 41:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">The sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of him that layeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">at him cannot hold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02595">the spear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04551">the dart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08302">nor the habergeon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>habergeon</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">breastplate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 41:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He esteemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H08401">as straw</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05154">brass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07539">as rotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">wood</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07198 strong:H01121">The arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cannot make him flee</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07050 strong:H068">slingstones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">with him into stubble</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08455">Darts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07179">as stubble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he laugheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07494">at the shaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03591">of a spear</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02303">Sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">stones</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07502" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">under him: he spreadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">sharp pointed things</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">upon the mire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sharp stones</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Sharp pieces of potsherd</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 41:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04688">He maketh the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07570" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to boil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05518">like a pot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H04841">like a pot of ointment</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05410">He maketh a path</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him; <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would think</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">the deep</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07872">hoary</w>.

verses.name: Job 41:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06083">Upon earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04915">there is not his like</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">who is made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01097">without</w> <w lemma="strong:H02844">fear</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is made without fear</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">behave themselves without fear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 41:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He beholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01364">all high</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">a king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">over all the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07830">of pride</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 41." eID="gen523" osisID="Job.41"/>

verses.name: Job 42:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">Then Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>,

verses.name: Job 42:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou canst do</w> every <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04209">no thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">can be withholden</w> from thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>no thought can be…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">no thought of thine can be hindered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 42:3
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">without knowledge</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">therefore have I uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">not; things too wonderful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for me, which I knew</w> not.

verses.name: Job 42:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I beseech thee, and I will speak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will demand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">of thee, and declare</w> thou unto me.

verses.name: Job 42:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">of thee by the hearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">of the ear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">but now mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">seeth</w> thee.

verses.name: Job 42:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore I abhor</w> <transChange type="added">myself</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">and ashes</w>.

verses.name: Job 42:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/>And it was <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">that after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">had spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">these words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">unto Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0464">to Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08489">the Temanite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">My wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">against thee, and against thy two</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friends</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for ye have not spoken</w> of me <transChange type="added">the thing that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">as my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange>.

verses.name: Job 42:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Therefore take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">unto you now seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">and seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">rams</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">to my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and offer up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">for yourselves a burnt offering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">and my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">for you: for him</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I accept</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">lest I deal</w> with you <transChange type="added">after your</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05039">folly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">in that ye have not spoken</w> of me <transChange type="added">the thing which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">like my servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>him</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his face</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">person</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 42:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0464">So Eliphaz</w> <w lemma="strong:H08489">the Temanite</w> <w lemma="strong:H01085">and Bildad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07747">the Shuhite</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06691">Zophar</w> <w lemma="strong:H05284">the Naamathite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">went</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">according as the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also accepted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347 strong:H06440">Job</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Job</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the face of Job</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 42:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">of Job</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">when he prayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">for his friends</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">also the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H04932">twice as much</w> as he had before.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">added all that had been to Job unto the double</rdg></note>

verses.name: Job 42:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">there unto him all his brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0269">and all his sisters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all they that had been of his acquaintance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with him in his house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they bemoaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and comforted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">him over all the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">had brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">upon him: every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">him a</w> <w lemma="strong:H07192">piece of money</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H05141">an earring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w>.

verses.name: Job 42:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">So the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">the latter end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">of Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">more than his beginning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H0702">for he had fourteen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08337">and six</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01581">camels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06776">yoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">of oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0505">and a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0860">she asses</w>.

verses.name: Job 42:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07658">He had also seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07969">and three</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w>.

verses.name: Job 42:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">of the first</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03224">Jemima</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H08145">of the second</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07103">Kezia</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">and the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07992">of the third</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07163">Keren–happuch</w>.

verses.name: Job 42:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">And in all the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">were no women</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">found</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">as the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">of Job</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and their father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">them inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">their brethren</w>.

verses.name: Job 42:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">After</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">this lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H0347">Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0705">and forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his sons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his sons’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">sons</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0702">four</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Job 42:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0347">So Job</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">died</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02205">old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07649">and full</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 42." eID="gen524" osisID="Job.42"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen482" osisID="Job" type="book"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">not in the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the ungodly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">of sinners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">in the seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the scornful</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ungodly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wicked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02656">But his delight</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08451">and in his law</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth he meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">And he shall be like a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06388">by the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">his fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in his season</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05929">his leaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall not wither</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and whatsoever he doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall prosper</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wither</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fade</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The ungodly</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> not so: but <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04671">like the chaff</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">which the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">driveth away</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">Therefore the ungodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in the judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02400">nor sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">but the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the ungodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 1." eID="gen526" osisID="Ps.1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Why do the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07283" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">rage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">a vain thing</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>rage</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tumultuously assemble</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>imagine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meditate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07336" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">themselves, and the rulers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">take counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04899">and against his anointed</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,

verses.name: Psalms 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-289">Let us break</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">their bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-289">asunder</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">their cords</w> from us.

verses.name: Psalms 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall laugh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have them in derision</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Then shall he speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">unto them in his wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and vex</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">them in his sore displeasure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>vex</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">trouble</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Yet have I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">my king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">upon my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">anointed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">upon Zion, the hill of my holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">the decree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> unto me, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">my Son</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I begotten</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>the decree</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for a decree</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ask</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of me, and I shall give</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0657">and the uttermost parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0272">thy possession</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt break</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">them with a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt dash them in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a potter’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 2:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Be wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">now therefore, O ye kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">be instructed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">with fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07461">with trembling</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Kiss</w> <w lemma="strong:H01248">the Son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he be angry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ye perish</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">when his wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">but a little</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all they that put their trust</w> in him. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 2." eID="gen527" osisID="Ps.2"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H053">Absalom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1"/><w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how are they increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">that trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">me! many</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">they that rise up</w> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">no help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for him in God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">a shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">for me; my glory</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and the lifter up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of mine head</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">about</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">me out of his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hill</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 3:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I laid me down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and slept</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I awaked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sustained</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07233">of ten thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have set</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">against me round about</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 3:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou hast smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all mine enemies</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03895">the cheek bone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">the teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the ungodly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03444">Salvation</w> <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01293">thy blessing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">upon thy people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 3." eID="gen528" osisID="Ps.3"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">on Neginoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2"/><w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me when I call</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of my righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast enlarged</w> me <transChange type="added">when I was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in distress</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">upon me, and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be gracious unto me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">O ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05704">how long</w> <transChange type="added">will ye turn</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">into shame</w>? <transChange type="added">how long</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will ye love</w> <w lemma="strong:H07385">vanity</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">after leasing</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06395" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath set apart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">him that is godly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for himself: the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I call</w> unto him.

verses.name: Psalms 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Stand in awe</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not: commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with your own heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon your bed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be still</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and put your trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 4:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Who will shew</w> us <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lift thou up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thy countenance</w> upon us.

verses.name: Psalms 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast put</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in my heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06256">more than in the time</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01715">their corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">and their wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">increased</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03162">I will both</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lay me down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sleep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0910">only</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">makest me dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in safety</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 4." eID="gen529" osisID="Ps.4"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05155">upon Nehiloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3"/><w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">to my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H01901">my meditation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07773">of my cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">my King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">for unto thee will I pray</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 5:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">My voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I direct</w> <transChange type="added">my prayer</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto thee, and will look up</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 5:4
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">not a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02655">that hath pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">in wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">neither shall evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> with thee.

verses.name: Psalms 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall not stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before thine eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou shalt destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">leasing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">and deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bloody…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">man of bloods and deceit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But as for me, I will come</w> <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercy</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03374">in thy fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">will I worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">toward thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy holy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the temple of thy holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">in thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08324" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of mine enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01870">make thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">straight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before my face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">those which observe me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 5:9
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">no faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07130">their inward</w> part <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01942">very wickedness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01627">their throat</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">an open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">sepulchre</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they flatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">with their tongue</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>faithfulness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">stedfastness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>their mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his mouth</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">the mouth of any of them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>very…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wickednesses</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou them, O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04156">by their own counsels</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cast them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">of their transgressions</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they have rebelled</w> against thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>Destroy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Make them guilty</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from their counsels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But let all those that put their trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in thee rejoice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05769">let them ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shout for joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">because thou defendest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them: let them also that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be joyful</w> in thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>defendest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">coverest over</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">protectest them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wilt bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07522">with favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou compass</w> him as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06793">a shield</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>compass</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">crown</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 5." eID="gen530" osisID="Ps.5"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">on Neginoth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08067">upon Sheminith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">me not in thine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither chasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">me in thy hot displeasure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Sheminith</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the eighth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0536">weak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">me; for my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are vexed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">is also sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">vexed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, how long?

verses.name: Psalms 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">oh save</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">me for thy mercies’</w> sake.

verses.name: Psalms 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04194">For in death</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02143">no remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of thee: in the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">who shall give thee thanks</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 6:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0585">with my groaning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03915">all the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H04296">make I my bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07811" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to swim</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04529" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I water</w> <w lemma="strong:H06210">my couch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">with my tears</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every night</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H06244" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">because of grief</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06275" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it waxeth old</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of all mine enemies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from me, all ye workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">of my weeping</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">my supplication</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 6:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let all mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">vexed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them return</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07281">suddenly</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 6." eID="gen531" osisID="Ps.6"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07692">Shiggaion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he sang</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">concerning the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03568">of Cush</w> <w lemma="strong:H01145 strong:H01121">the Benjamite</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee do I put my trust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me from all them that persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me, and deliver</w> me:<note type="study"><catchWord>words</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">business</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest he tear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">like a lion</w>, rending <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in pieces</w>, while <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to deliver</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not a deliverer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">this; if there be</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in my hands</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I have rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that was at peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">with me; (yea, I have delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">him that without cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is mine enemy</w>:)

verses.name: Psalms 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and take</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, let him tread down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">mine honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">in the dust</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">in thine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">thyself because of the rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of mine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and awake</w> for me <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast commanded</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05712">So shall the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">compass thee about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">for their sakes therefore return</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">thou on high</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">according to my righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08537">and according to mine integrity</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> in me.

verses.name: Psalms 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Oh let the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come to an end</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">but establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the just</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">for the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">trieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03826">the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">and reins</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04043">My defence</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which saveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>My…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">My buckler is upon God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 7:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judgeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">and God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02194" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is angry</w> <transChange type="added">with the wicked</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">every day</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>judgeth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is a righteous judge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If he turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03913" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, he will whet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">his sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath bent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">his bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and made it ready</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath also prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">for him the instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he ordaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">his arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">against the persecutors</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Behold, he travaileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">with iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02029" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hath conceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsehood</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">a pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, and is fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">into the ditch</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he made</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He made a pit</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He hath digged a pit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05999">His mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon his own head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02555">and his violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dealing shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">upon his own pate</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">according to his righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will sing praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">most high</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 7." eID="gen532" osisID="Ps.7"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H01665">upon Gittith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">how excellent</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">who hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">thy glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">above the heavens</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Out of the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">of babes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03243" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sucklings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hast thou ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that thou mightest still</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and the avenger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ordained</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">founded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When I consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thy heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">of thy fingers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">and the stars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">which thou hast ordained</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">What is man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou art mindful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of him? and the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou visitest</w> him?

verses.name: Psalms 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">For thou hast made him a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">lower</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">than the angels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and hast crowned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">him with glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and honour</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou madest him to have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">over the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thy hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast put</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under his feet</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06792">All sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0504">and oxen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">yea, and the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>All…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Flocks and oxen all of them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06833">The fowl</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the air</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01709">and the fish</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>, <transChange type="added">and whatsoever</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passeth through</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 8:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0117">how excellent</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>! <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 8." eID="gen533" osisID="Ps.8"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:1
