verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H04192">upon Muth–labben</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7"/><w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">with my whole heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">all thy marvellous works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">in thee: I will sing praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">O thou most High</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">When mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at thy presence</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thou hast maintained</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">my right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">and my cause</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou satest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">in the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judging</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">right</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>maintained…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made my judgment</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>judging right</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judging in righteousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast rebuked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O thou enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02723">destructions</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">are come to a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">end</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05428" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou hast destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892 strong:H06145" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">cities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02143">their memorial</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">with them</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>O thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The destructions of the enemy are come to a perpetual end: and their cities hast thou destroyed</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall endure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">he hath prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">for judgment</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall minister judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">in uprightness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04869">also will be a refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01790">for the oppressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04869">a refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a refuge</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an high place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">And they that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will put their trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in thee: for thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast not forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that seek</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">his doings</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">When he maketh inquisition</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">for blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he remembereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them: he forgetteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06818">not the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041 strong:H06035" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of the humble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>humble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">afflicted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 9:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">my trouble</w> <transChange type="added">which I suffer</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8789">me, thou that liftest me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">from the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">That I may shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">all thy praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">of the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">in thy salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">The heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are sunk down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">in the pit</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they made</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07568">in the net</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">is their own foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">taken</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is known</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgment</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he executeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05367" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is snared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">in the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of his own hands</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01902">Higgaion</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Higgaion</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Meditation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">into hell</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07913">that forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H034">For the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">shall not alway</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be forgotten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08615">the expectation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035 strong:H06041" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">of the poor</w> shall <transChange type="added">not</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0582">let not man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">prevail</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">let the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be judged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in thy sight</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 9:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172 strong:H04172" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">them in fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> themselves <transChange type="added">to be but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 9." eID="gen534" osisID="Ps.9"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Why standest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">thou afar off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <transChange type="added">why</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hidest</w> thou <transChange type="added">thyself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01346">pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H01814" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let them be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">in the devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have imagined</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The wicked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">For the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">boasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of his heart’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">desire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and blesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the covetous</w>, <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">abhorreth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>heart’s</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul’s</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>blesseth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01363">through the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not seek</w> <transChange type="added">after God</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04209">not in all his thoughts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>God is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all his thoughts are, There is no God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">His ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">are always</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">grievous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04791">far above</w> out of his sight: <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all his enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he puffeth</w> at them.

verses.name: Psalms 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I shall not be moved</w>: for <transChange type="added">I shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755 strong:H01755">never</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in adversity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>never</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">His mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H0423">of cursing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">and deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H08496">and fraud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03956">under his tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05999">mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">and vanity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deceit</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">deceits</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>vanity</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">iniquity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03993">in the lurking places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">of the villages</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04565">in the secret places</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth he murder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">the innocent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are privily set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02489">against the poor</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hide themselves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He lieth in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">secretly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">as a lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05520">in his den</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he lieth in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H02414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he doth catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he draweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">him into his net</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>secretly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the secret places</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01794" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He croucheth</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">humbleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02489 strong:H02489 strong:H02426" morph="strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8675">himself, that the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">may fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">by his strong ones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He breaketh himself</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>by…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">into his strong parts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forgotten</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05331">he will never</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0410">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041 strong:H06035" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">not the humble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>humble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">afflicted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">Wherefore doth the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">contemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou wilt not require</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 10:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for thou beholdest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">and spite</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to requite</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thy hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02489">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">committeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">himself unto thee; thou art the helper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">of the fatherless</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>committeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">leaveth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Break</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">thou the arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the evil</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seek out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">his wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">till</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou find</w> <w lemma="strong:H01077">none</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">King</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of his land</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 10:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035">of the humble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou wilt prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">thou wilt cause thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to hear</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>prepare</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">establish</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01790">and the oppressed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0582">that the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">may no more</w> <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">oppress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppress</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">terrify</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 10." eID="gen535" osisID="Ps.10"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">In the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">put I my trust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">ye to my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Flee</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06833">a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">to your mountain</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 11:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">For, lo, the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bend</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">they make ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">their arrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">upon the string</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01119 strong:H0652" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">that they may privily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">at the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>privily</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in darkness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08356">If the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be destroyed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">what can the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">throne</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06079">his eyelids</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">try</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and him that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hateth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">Upon the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">snares</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01614">and brimstone</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02152">and an horrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">tempest</w>: <transChange type="added">this shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04521">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">of their cup</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an horrible…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a burning tempest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">For the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">his countenance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">the upright</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 11." eID="gen536" osisID="Ps.11"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H08067">upon Sheminith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9"/><w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02623">for the godly man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ceaseth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for the faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06461" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>upon…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">upon the eighth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Help</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Save</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">with his neighbour</w>: <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02513">flattering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with a double</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">do they speak</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a double…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an heart and an heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">all flattering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03956">the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">proud</w> things:<note type="study"><catchWord>proud</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">With our tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will we prevail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08193">our lips</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> our own: who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">lord</w> over us?<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are with us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07701">For the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0603">for the sighing</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now will I arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will set</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03468">in safety</w> <transChange type="added">from him that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">puffeth</w> at him.<note type="study"><catchWord>puffeth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">would ensnare him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0565">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">words</w>: <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">tried</w> <w lemma="strong:H05948">in a furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02212" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">purified</w> <w lemma="strong:H07659">seven times</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">them from this</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>them from</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">him</rdg>, etc: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">every one of them, etc</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02149">when the vilest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120 strong:H01121">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are exalted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the sons of the men</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 12." eID="gen537" osisID="Ps.12"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10"/><w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How long wilt thou forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">how long wilt thou hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> from me?<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How long shall I take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in my soul</w>, <transChange type="added">having</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03015">sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">daily</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">how long shall mine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be exalted</w> over me?

verses.name: Psalms 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Consider</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">lighten</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest I sleep</w> the <transChange type="added">sleep of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Lest mine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have prevailed</w> against him; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">those that trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">when I am moved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I have trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in thy mercy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">in thy salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath dealt bountifully</w> with me. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 13." eID="gen538" osisID="Ps.13"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11"/><w lemma="strong:H05036">The fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They are corrupt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have done abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">works</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">looked down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">if there</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">were any that did understand</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are all gone aside</w>, they are <transChange type="added">all</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H0444" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">become filthy</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">no, not one</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>filthy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stinking</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Have all the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">no knowledge</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">There were they in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they feared a fear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Ye have shamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">because the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">his refuge</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">out of Zion</w>! <w lemma="strong:H03068">when the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bringeth back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be glad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Oh…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Who will give</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 14." eID="gen539" osisID="Ps.14"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv12"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv12"/><w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in thy tabernacle</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hill</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>abide</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sojourn</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">uprightly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in his heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 15:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">backbiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">not with his tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor taketh up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">against his neighbour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>taketh…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">receiveth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">endureth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">In whose eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a vile person</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is contemned</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but he honoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <transChange type="added">He that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sweareth</w> to <transChange type="added">his own</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">hurt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and changeth</w> not.

verses.name: Psalms 15:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">putteth not out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">his money</w> <w lemma="strong:H05392">to usury</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">against the innocent</w>. <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that doeth</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be moved</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 15." eID="gen540" osisID="Ps.15"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv13"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04387">Michtam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv13"/><w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">me, O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for in thee do I put my trust</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Michtam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A golden Psalm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 16:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">O my soul</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">my Lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02896">my goodness</w> <transChange type="added">extendeth</transChange> not to thee;

verses.name: Psalms 16:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">to the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H01992">that</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>, and <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0117">the excellent</w>, in whom <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02656">all my delight</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06094">Their sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be multiplied</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hasten</w> <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0312">another</w> <transChange type="added">god</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05262">their drink offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I not offer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01077">nor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">their names</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">into my lips</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hasten…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">give gifts to another</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 16:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04490">the portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">of mine inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03563">and of my cup</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou maintainest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">my lot</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of my part</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 16:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">The lines</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05273">unto me in pleasant</w> <transChange type="added">places</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H08231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, I have a goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">heritage</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath given me counsel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03629">my reins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">also instruct</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">me in the night seasons</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">always</w> before me: because <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">at my right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I shall not be moved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Therefore my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and my glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiceth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">in hope</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dwell confidently</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou wilt not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">in hell</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither wilt thou suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">thine Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">corruption</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou wilt shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">me the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">in thy presence</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07648">fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of joy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03225">at thy right hand</w> <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05273">pleasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for evermore</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 16." eID="gen541" osisID="Ps.16"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv14"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H08605">A Prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv14"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">the right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">unto my cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto my prayer</w>, <transChange type="added">that goeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03808">not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">out of feigned</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the right</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">justice</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>not…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">without lips of deceit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">Let my sentence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from thy presence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">let thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">the things that are equal</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast proved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast visited</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast tried</w> me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">nothing; I am purposed</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not transgress</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06468">Concerning the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">by the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of thy lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have kept</w> <transChange type="added">me from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H06530">of the destroyer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Hold up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0838">my goings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">in thy paths</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06471">my footsteps</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">slip</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>slip…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be not moved</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee, for thou wilt hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">me, O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> unto me, <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0565">my speech</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06395" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Shew thy marvellous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">lovingkindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">O thou that savest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">by thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them which put their trust</w> <transChange type="added">in thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">from those that rise up</w> <transChange type="added">against them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by thy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">them which trust in thee from those that rise up against thy right hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0380">me as the apple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869 strong:H01323">of the eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">me under the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of thy wings</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">From</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">oppress</w> me, <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my deadly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemies</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">compass me about</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oppress</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">waste</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>my…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my enemies against the soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are inclosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">in their own fat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">with their mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01348">proudly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have now compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0838">us in our steps</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bowing down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the earth</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01825">Like</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">as a lion</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03700" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is greedy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03715">and as it were a young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">lurking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">in secret places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Like…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The likeness of him (that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">of every one of them</rdg>) is as a lion that desireth to ravin</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lurking</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sitting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">disappoint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cast him down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">from the wicked</w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thy sword</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>disappoint…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prevent his face</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>which is</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04962">From men</w> <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thy hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04962">from men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02465">of the world</w>, <transChange type="added">which have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">their portion</w> in <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0990">and whose belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou fillest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06840">with thy hid</w> <transChange type="added">treasure</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are full</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03499">the rest</w> of their <transChange type="added">substance</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05768">to their babes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>which are</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">their children are full</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">As for me, I will behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall be satisfied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08544">with thy likeness</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 17." eID="gen542" osisID="Ps.17"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv15"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">who spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of this song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">him from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of all his enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">of Saul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he said</w>,</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv15"/><w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02391">my strength</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05553">my rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04686">and my fortress</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and my deliverer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in whom I will trust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04043">my buckler</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07161">and the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04869">my high tower</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my strength</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my rock</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">who is worthy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">to be praised</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">so shall I be saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from mine enemies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">The sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H0661" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">me, and the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">of ungodly men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01204" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made me afraid</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ungodly men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">The sorrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">compassed me about</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04170">the snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">prevented</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>sorrows</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cords</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">In my distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">out of his temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07775">and my cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">into his ears</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Then the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shook</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trembled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04146">the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">also of the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01607" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and were shaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he was wroth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">There went up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">a smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">out of his nostrils</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">devoured</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01513">coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were kindled</w> by it.<note type="study"><catchWord>out of his nostrils</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by his</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He bowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also, and came down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06205">and darkness</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under his feet</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he rode</w> <w lemma="strong:H03742">upon a cherub</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and did fly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01675" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, he did fly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">upon the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the wind</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">his secret place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05521">his pavilion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> him <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02824">dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05645">thick clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">of the skies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05051">At the brightness</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05645">before him his thick clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01259">hail</w> <transChange type="added">stones</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01513">and coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also thundered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">and the Highest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01259">hail</w> <transChange type="added">stones</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01513">and coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, he sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">his arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07232" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them; and he shot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">lightnings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and discomfited</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0650">Then the channels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04146">and the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were discovered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">at thy rebuke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05397">at the blast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thy nostrils</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">from above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he took</w> <w lemma="strong:H04871" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, he drew</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">me out of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">me from my strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and from them which hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: for they were too strong</w> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They prevented</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">of my calamity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04937">was my stay</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He brought me forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04800">also into a large place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, because he delighted</w> in me.

verses.name: Psalms 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">me according to my righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01252">according to the cleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath he recompensed</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not wickedly departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from my God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">For all his judgments</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">before me, and I did not put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">his statutes</w> from me.

verses.name: Psalms 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08549">I was also upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">before him, and I kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">myself from mine iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>before</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore hath the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">recompensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">me according to my righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01252">according to the cleanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his eyesight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">before his eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02623">With the merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02616" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself merciful</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08549">with an upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H01399">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself upright</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 18:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">With the pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H01305" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself pure</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06141">and with the froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06617" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">thou wilt shew thyself froward</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shew thyself froward</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">wrestle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For thou wilt save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but wilt bring down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">looks</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For thou wilt light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">my candle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05050" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will enlighten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">my darkness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>candle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lamp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For by thee I have run through</w> <w lemma="strong:H01416">a troop</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and by my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01801" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have I leaped over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07791">a wall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>run…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:30
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0565">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is tried</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">a buckler</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to all those that trust</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>tried</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">refined</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:31
verses.text: For who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01107">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? or who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">a rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H02108">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 18:32
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that girdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">me with strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0355">like hinds’</w> <transChange type="added">feet</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">me upon my high places</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to war</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">so that a bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05154">of steel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">is broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">by mine arms</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast also given</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">me the shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of thy salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">and thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath holden me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06037">and thy gentleness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hath made me great</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy gentleness…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with thy meekness thou hast multiplied me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou hast enlarged</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">my steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H07166">under me, that my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04571" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did not slip</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my feet</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mine ankles</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have pursued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and overtaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them: neither did I turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">till they were consumed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I have wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them that they were not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are fallen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under my feet</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For thou hast girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">me with strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">unto the battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou hast subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">under me those that rose up</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>subdued</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">caused to bow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast also given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06203">me the necks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of mine enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I might destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them that hate</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 18:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They cried</w>, but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to save</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>: <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he answered</w> them not.

verses.name: Psalms 18:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07833" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then did I beat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">them small as the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I did cast them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">as the dirt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in the streets</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">me from the strivings</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">me the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall serve</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 18:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241 strong:H08088">As soon as they hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of me, they shall obey</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">me: the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall submit</w> themselves unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>As soon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">At the hearing of the ear</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>submit…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">yield feigned obedience</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>strangers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of the stranger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05236 strong:H01121">The strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fade away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02727" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04526">out of their close places</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strangers</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sons of the stranger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">liveth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">my rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and let the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be exalted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 18:47
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that avengeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and subdueth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> under me.<note type="study"><catchWord>avengeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">giveth avengements for</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>subdueth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">destroyeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me from mine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">yea, thou liftest me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">above those that rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">against me: thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">me from the violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>violent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">man of violence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore will I give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto thy name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>give…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">confess</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 18:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">deliverance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">giveth he to his king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">to his anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">to David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and to his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">evermore</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 18." eID="gen543" osisID="Ps.18"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv16"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv16"/><w lemma="strong:H08064">The heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07549">and the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">sheweth his</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H04639">handywork</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 19:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0562">speech</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">unto night</w> <w lemma="strong:H02331" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 19:3
