verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0562">no speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">nor language</w>, <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not heard</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">without these their voice is heard</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">without their voice heard</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06957">Their line</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through all the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04405">and their words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">to the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">In them hath he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">a tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">for the sun</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>line</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rule</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">direction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 19:5
verses.text: Which <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02860">as a bridegroom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">coming out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02646">of his chamber</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiceth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">as a strong man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to run</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">a race</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04161">His going forth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08622">and his circuit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07098">unto the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of it: and there is nothing hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H02535">from the heat</w> thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">The law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">perfect</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">converting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">sure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">making wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">the simple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>law</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">doctrine</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>converting</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">restoring</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06490">The statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01249">pure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">enlightening</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enduring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">the judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">true</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">altogether</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>true</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">truth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">More to be desired</w> <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02091">than gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">yea, than much</w> <w lemma="strong:H06337">fine gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweeter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01706">also than honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06688 strong:H05317">and the honeycomb</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the honeycomb</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the dropping of honeycombs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">Moreover by them is thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02094" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">warned</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in keeping</w> of them <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06118">reward</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who can understand</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07691">errors</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thou me from secret</w> <transChange type="added">faults</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02086">also from presumptuous</w> <transChange type="added">sins</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them not have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">over me: then shall I be upright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and I shall be innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">from the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgression</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the great</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">much</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0561">Let the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01902">and the meditation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of my heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">be acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in thy sight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and my redeemer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strength</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rock</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 19." eID="gen544" osisID="Ps.19"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv17"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv17"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">defend</w> thee;<note type="study"><catchWord>defend…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set thee on an high place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">thee help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">from the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">thee out of Zion</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>thee help</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy help</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>strengthen</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">support</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 20:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">all thy offerings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">thy burnt sacrifice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>accept</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turn to ashes</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">thee according to thine own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">all thy counsel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">We will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">in thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w> we will set up <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">banners</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04862">all thy petitions</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Now know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">I that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">saveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">his anointed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">him from his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">with the saving</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">of his right hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his holy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the heaven of his holiness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">by the strength of the salvation of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 20:7
verses.text: Some <transChange type="added">trust</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07393">in chariots</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05483">and some in horses</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but we will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They are brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fallen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but we are risen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8696">and stand upright</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Save</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">let the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">us when</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">we call</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 20." eID="gen545" osisID="Ps.20"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv18"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv18"/><w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">in thy strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03444">and in thy salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">how greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he rejoice</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">him his heart’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">desire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and hast not withholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H0782">the request</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of his lips</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For thou preventest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">him with the blessings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of goodness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou settest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05850">a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06337">of pure gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">on his head</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He asked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w> of thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou gavest</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> him, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0753">length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">His glory</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">in thy salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01935">honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hast thou laid</w> upon him.

verses.name: Psalms 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">him most blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02302" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">him exceeding glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">with thy countenance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made him most…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set him to be blessings</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>made him exceeding…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make him glad with joy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">and through the mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he shall not be moved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all thine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">those that hate</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 21:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">them as a fiery</w> <w lemma="strong:H08574">oven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thine anger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall swallow them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in his wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0784">and the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06529">Their fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt thou destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and their seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from among the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they intended</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against thee: they imagined</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">a mischievous device</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are not able</w> <transChange type="added">to perform</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore shalt thou make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">them turn their back</w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">thou shalt make ready</w> <transChange type="added">thine arrows</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04340">upon thy strings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">against the face</w> of them.<note type="study"><catchWord>shalt thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thou shalt set them as a butt</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>back</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shoulder</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be thou exalted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">in thine own strength</w>: <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">thy power</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 21." eID="gen546" osisID="Ps.21"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv19"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H0365">upon Aijeleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">Shahar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv19"/><w lemma="strong:H0410">My God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">why hast thou forsaken</w> me? <transChange type="added">why art thou so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">from helping</w> me, <transChange type="added">and from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07581">of my roaring</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Aijeleth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the hind of the morning</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>helping…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my salvation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">in the daytime</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou hearest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">not; and in the night season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01747">and am not silent</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>am…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there is no silence to me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:3
verses.text: But thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>, <transChange type="added">O thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that inhabitest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">the praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee: they trusted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou didst deliver</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 22:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">unto thee, and were delivered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee, and were not confounded</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:6
verses.text: But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08438">a worm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">and no man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02781">a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All they that see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me laugh me to scorn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06358" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shoot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">the lip</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,<note type="study"><catchWord>shoot…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">open</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">He trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he would deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him: let him deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, seeing he delighted</w> in him.<note type="study"><catchWord>He trusted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He rolled himself on</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>seeing…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">if he delight in</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:9
verses.text: But thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01518" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">he that took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">me out of the womb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">thou didst make me hope</w> <transChange type="added">when I was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">upon my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07699">breasts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>didst…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">kept me in safety</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">I was cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">upon thee from the womb</w>: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">from my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">belly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">from me; for trouble</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>; for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to help</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">not a helper</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bulls</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">me: strong</w> <transChange type="added">bulls</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w> <w lemma="strong:H03803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have beset me round</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They gaped</w> upon me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">their mouths</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a ravening</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">lion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gaped…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">opened their mouths against me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and all my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">are out of joint</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01749">is like wax</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">it is melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">of my bowels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>out of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sundered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03581">My strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is dried up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02789">like a potsherd</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03956">and my tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04455">to my jaws</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08239" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">me into the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03611">For dogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">me: the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have inclosed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738 strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">me: they pierced</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">and my feet</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I may tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">all my bones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they look</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stare</w> upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 22:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">my garments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">among them, and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">lots</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">upon my vesture</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But be not thou far</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0360">O my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">thee to help</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 22:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">from the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03173">my darling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">of the dog</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my darling</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my only one</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 22:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0738">me from the lion’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">me from the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H07214">of the unicorns</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto my brethren</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I praise</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 22:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03373">Ye that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">him; all ye the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">glorify</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him; and fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">him, all ye the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he hath not despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08262" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">nor abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06039">the affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the afflicted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">neither hath he hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from him; but when he cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, he heard</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08416">My praise</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of thee in the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">my vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">before them that fear</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 22:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06035">The meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be satisfied</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">him: your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0657">All the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H04940">and all the kindreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 22:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04410">For the kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>: and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the governor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the nations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:29
verses.text: All <transChange type="added">they that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01879">fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worship</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all they that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">to the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him: and none can keep alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">A seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">him; it shall be accounted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">to the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">for a generation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 22:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">that shall be born</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath done</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 22." eID="gen547" osisID="Ps.22"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv20"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv20"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">my shepherd</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall not want</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 23:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He maketh me to lie down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">in green</w> <w lemma="strong:H04999">pastures</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he leadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">me beside the still</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>green…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pastures of tender grass</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>still…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">waters of quietness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 23:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">He restoreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he leadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">me in the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">for his name’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Psalms 23:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, though I walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">through the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">of the shadow of death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">no evil</w>: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">with me; thy rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H04938">and thy staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they comfort</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 23:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou preparest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">a table</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me in the presence of mine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou anointest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">with oil</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03563">my cup</w> <w lemma="strong:H07310">runneth over</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>anointest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">makest fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 23:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Surely goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of my life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and I will dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H0753">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for ever</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to length of days</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 23." eID="gen548" osisID="Ps.23"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv21"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv21"/><w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and the fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">thereof; the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that dwell</w> therein.

verses.name: Psalms 24:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he hath founded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">it upon the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">it upon the floods</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 24:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall ascend</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">into the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or who shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">place</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 24:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05355">He that hath clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01249">and a pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath not lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">unto vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">nor sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceitfully</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The clean of hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 24:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of his salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 24:6
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him, that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">O Jacob</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>O Jacob</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">O God of Jacob</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 24:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">your heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">O ye gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and be ye lift up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">ye everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">doors</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the King</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come in</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 24:8
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">this King</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of glory</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05808">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">and mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in battle</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 24:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">your heads</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08179">O ye gates</w>; even lift <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">ye everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">doors</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04428">and the King</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come in</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 24:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Who is this King</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of glory</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of glory</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 24." eID="gen549" osisID="Ps.24"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv22"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv22"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do I lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in thee: let me not be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let not mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">triumph</w> over me.

verses.name: Psalms 25:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Yea, let none that wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on thee be ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which transgress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07387">without cause</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">me thy ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">me thy paths</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">me in thy truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and teach</w> me: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">on thee do I wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07356">thy tender mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and thy lovingkindnesses</w>; for they <transChange type="added">have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever of old</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tender…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bowels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 25:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">not the sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of my youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06588">nor my transgressions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">according to thy mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">thou me for thy goodness’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">sake, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and upright</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore will he teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06035">The meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will he guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06035">and the meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will he teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">All the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto such as keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">and his testimonies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">For thy name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">sake, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pardon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">mine iniquity</w>; for it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">What man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">he that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him shall he teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall choose</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">His soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">at ease</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02233">and his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dwell…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lodge in goodness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 25:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05475">The secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">with them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">him; and he will shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">them his covenant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and his covenant to make them know it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 25:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">toward the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for he shall pluck</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">out of the net</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pluck</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bring forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 25:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee unto me, and have mercy</w> upon me; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03173">desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">and afflicted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06869">The troubles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">are enlarged</w>: <transChange type="added">O</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bring thou me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04691">of my distresses</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">upon mine affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">and my pain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and forgive</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">all my sins</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 25:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they are many</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">me with cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">hatred</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cruel…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hatred of violence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 25:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: let me not be ashamed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I put my trust</w> in thee.

verses.name: Psalms 25:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08537">Let integrity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">and uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">me; for I wait</w> on thee.

verses.name: Psalms 25:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06869">out of all his troubles</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 25." eID="gen550" osisID="Ps.25"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv23"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv23"/><w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">in mine integrity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">also in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04571" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall not slide</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 26:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Examine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and prove</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me; try</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">my reins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">and my heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 26:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">For thy lovingkindness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before mine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and I have walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">in thy truth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 26:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not sat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">with vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04962">persons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will I go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">with dissemblers</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 26:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of evil doers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">with the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 26:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">mine hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05356">in innocency</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">so will I compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thine altar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Psalms 26:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That I may publish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">of thanksgiving</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of all thy wondrous works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 26:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04583">the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thy house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04725">and the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">where thine honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">dwelleth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of the tabernacle of thy honour</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 26:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">with sinners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">nor my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Gather…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Take not away</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>bloody…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of blood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 26:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">In whose hands</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02154">mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and their right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">of bribes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>full…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 26:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But as for me, I will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">in mine integrity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me, and be merciful</w> unto me.

verses.name: Psalms 26:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">My foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">in an even place</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04721">in the congregations</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 26." eID="gen551" osisID="Ps.26"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv24"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv24"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">my light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">and my salvation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom shall I fear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of my life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of whom shall I be afraid</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 27:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">When the wicked</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and my foes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">upon me to eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">my flesh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they stumbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and fell</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>came…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">approached against me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 27:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04264">Though an host</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should encamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">against me, my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not fear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04421">though war</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should rise</w> against me, in this <transChange type="added">will</transChange> I <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">confident</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 27:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">One</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that will I seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">after; that I may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of my life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05278">the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01239" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to enquire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">in his temple</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the beauty</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the delight</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 27:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05520">me in his pavilion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05643">in the secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">of his tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">me; he shall set me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">upon a rock</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 27:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07218">And now shall mine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">above mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: therefore will I offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in his tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">of joy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">yea, I will sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>joy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shouting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 27:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with my voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">also upon me, and answer</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 27:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">When thou saidst</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">ye my face</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto thee, Thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I seek</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>When…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">My heart said unto thee, Let my face seek thy face</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 27:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not thy face</w> <transChange type="added">far</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-290">from me; put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">not thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-290">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in anger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05833">thou hast been my help</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me not, neither forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of my salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 27:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">When my father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">and my mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, then the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will take me up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">gather me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 27:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">me thy way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">me in a plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">path</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08324" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">because of mine enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a plain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a way of plainness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">those which observe me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 27:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">me not over unto the will</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of mine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08267">for false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03307">against me, and such as breathe out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">cruelty</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 27:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">I had fainted</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03884">unless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I had believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 27:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be of good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">I say, on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 27." eID="gen552" osisID="Ps.27"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv25"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv25"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Unto thee will I cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">my rock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not silent</w> to me: lest, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou be silent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">to me, I become</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to me</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 28:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">of my supplications</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">unto thee, when I lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">toward thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01687">oracle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the oracle of thy sanctuary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 28:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Draw me not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">with the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and with the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to their neighbours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">but mischief</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in their hearts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 28:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">them according to their deeds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07455">and according to the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">of their endeavours</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">them after the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of their hands</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">render</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">to them their desert</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 28:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Because they regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06468">not the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">nor the operation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and not build them up</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 28:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">of my supplications</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 28:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and my shield</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">in him, and I am helped</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">therefore my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">greatly rejoiceth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07892">and with my song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I praise</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 28:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">their strength</w>, and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the saving</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">of his anointed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>saving…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strength of salvations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 28:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thine inheritance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">them also, and lift them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>feed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rule</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 28." eID="gen553" osisID="Ps.28"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv26"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv26"/><w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410 strong:H01121">O ye mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">and strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ye mighty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ye sons of the mighty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 29:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">due unto his name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01927">in the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holiness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the glory…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the honour of his name</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in his glorious sanctuary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 29:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">upon the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thundereth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">upon many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 29:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">powerful</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01926">full of majesty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>powerful</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in power</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>full…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in majesty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 29:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">the cedars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">yea, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">the cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 29:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He maketh them also to skip</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">like a calf</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03844">Lebanon</w> <w lemma="strong:H08303">and Sirion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">like a young</w> <w lemma="strong:H07214">unicorn</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 29:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">divideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03852">the flames</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>divideth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cutteth out</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 29:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06946">of Kadesh</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 29:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0355">maketh the hinds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">to calve</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02834" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and discovereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03295">the forests</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01964">and in his temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth every one speak</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to calve</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to be in pain</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>doth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every whit of it uttereth</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 29:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03999">upon the flood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">yea, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">King</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 29:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">with peace</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 29." eID="gen554" osisID="Ps.29"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv27"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w> <transChange type="added">at</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02598">the dedication</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv27"/><w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">I will extol</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01802" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for thou hast lifted me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and hast not made my foes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">to rejoice</w> over me.

verses.name: Psalms 30:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto thee, and thou hast healed</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 30:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast brought up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">from the grave</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast kept me alive</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381 strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8800">that I should not go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">to the pit</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 30:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02623">O ye saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">of his, and give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">at the remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of his holiness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to the memorial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 30:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">For his anger</w> <transChange type="added">endureth but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07281">a moment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07522">in his favour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01065">weeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may endure</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">for a night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07440">but joy</w> <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his anger…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">there is but a moment in his anger</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for a night</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the evening</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>joy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">singing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 30:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07959">And in my prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">I shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be moved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 30:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">by thy favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">thou hast made my mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou didst hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">I was troubled</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">settled strength for my mountain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 30:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I made supplication</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 30:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01215">What profit</w> <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in my blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">to the pit</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06083">Shall the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee? shall it declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thy truth</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 30:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon me: <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">be thou my helper</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 30:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04553">for me my mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04234">into dancing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast put off</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">my sackcloth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">me with gladness</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 30:12
