verses.text: To the end that <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">may sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">praise to thee, and not be silent</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">unto thee for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my glory</catchWord>: that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">my tongue</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">my soul</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 30." eID="gen555" osisID="Ps.30"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv28"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv28"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">In thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I put my trust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H0408">let me never</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">me in thy righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to me; deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">me speedily</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04581">be thou my strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">for an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">of defence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>my…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to me for a rock of strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 31:3
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05553">my rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">and my fortress</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">therefore for thy name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sake lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H05095" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">me, and guide</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 31:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Pull me out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">of the net</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have laid privily</w> for me: for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">my strength</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Into thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in thy mercy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">my trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">in adversities</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 31:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And hast not shut me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04800">in a large room</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I am in trouble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H06244" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">with grief</w>, <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">and my belly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">For my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is spent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03015">with grief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and my years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0585">with sighing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03581">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">because of mine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06244" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are consumed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02781">I was a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among all mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">but especially</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">among my neighbours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06343">and a fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">to mine acquaintance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that did see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">me without</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fled</w> from me.

verses.name: Psalms 31:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">as a dead man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">out of mind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I am like a broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">vessel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a broken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a vessel that perisheth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 31:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H01681">the slander</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04032">fear</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">on every side</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">while they took counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me, they devised</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my life</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But I trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">My times</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in thy hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and from them that persecute</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 31:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Make thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">upon thy servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">me for thy mercies’</w> sake.

verses.name: Psalms 31:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let me not be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">upon thee: let the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them be silent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">in the grave</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>silent…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cut off for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 31:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08267">Let the lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be put to silence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06277">grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">things proudly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">and contemptuously</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">against the righteous</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>grievous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a hard thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 31:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Oh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">how great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02898">thy goodness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">for them that fear</w> thee; <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for them that trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">in thee before the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 31:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">them in the secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thy presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07407">from the pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt keep them secretly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05521">in a pavilion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">from the strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">of tongues</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for he hath shewed me his marvellous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04692">in a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strong</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">fenced</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 31:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H02648" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in my haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01629" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">from before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0403">nevertheless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">of my supplications</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when I cried</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 31:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02623">all ye his saints</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">preserveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the faithful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03499">and plentifully</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">rewardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 31:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be of good courage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all ye that hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 31." eID="gen556" osisID="Ps.31"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv29"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv29"/><w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is he whose</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgression</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">forgiven</w>, <transChange type="added">whose</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02401">sin</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">covered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A Psalm…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Psalm of David giving instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 32:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">imputeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">not iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and in whose spirit</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07423">no guile</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 32:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">When I kept silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waxed old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07581">through my roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> long.

verses.name: Psalms 32:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03119">For day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03955">upon me: my moisture</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02725">into the drought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">of summer</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 32:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I acknowledged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">my sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">unto thee, and mine iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I not hid</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will confess</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgressions</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and thou forgavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of my sin</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 32:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02623">For this shall every one that is godly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">unto thee in a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou mayest be found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07858">surely in the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">they shall not come nigh</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of finding</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 32:7
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">my hiding place</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">me from trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">thou shalt compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07438">me about with songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06405">of deliverance</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 32:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will instruct</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thee with mine eye</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>guide…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">counsel thee, mine eye shall be upon thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 32:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">Be ye not as the horse</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06505">as the mule</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">have no understanding</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05716">whose mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01102" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">must be held</w> <w lemma="strong:H04964">in with bit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07448">and bridle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01077">lest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they come near</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 32:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">sorrows</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">to the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">shall compass</w> him about.

verses.name: Psalms 32:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">ye righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and shout</w> for joy, all <transChange type="added">ye that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 32." eID="gen557" osisID="Ps.32"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">O ye righteous</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05000">is comely</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">for the upright</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">with harp</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">unto him with the psaltery</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06218">an instrument of ten strings</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">unto him a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">play</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">skilfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with a loud noise</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">For the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04639">and all his works</w> <transChange type="added">are done</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">in truth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>goodness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mercy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 33:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">By the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">were the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">made</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06635">and all the host</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of them by the breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05067">together as an heap</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he layeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">the depth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">in storehouses</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Let all the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand in awe</w> of him.

verses.name: Psalms 33:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he spake</w>, and it was <transChange type="added">done</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it stood fast</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06331" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-291">bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06331" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-291">to nought</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-292">he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">the devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-292">of none effect</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bringeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">maketh frustrate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 33:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06098">The counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04284">the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 33:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">whose God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for his own inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he beholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">all the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04349">From the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of his habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07688" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He fashioneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">alike</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he considereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">all their works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">There is no king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of an host</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01368">a mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is not delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">strength</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">An horse</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a vain thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">for safety</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither shall he deliver</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07230">by his great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">strength</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Behold, the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">upon them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him, upon them that hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in his mercy</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 33:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to keep them alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">in famine</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Our soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">waiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05828">our help</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and our shield</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">For our heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in him, because we have trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 33:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Let thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">be upon us, according as we hope</w> in thee. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 33." eID="gen558" osisID="Ps.33"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv30"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">when he changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">his behaviour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H040">Abimelech</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">who drove him away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he departed</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv30"/><w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at all times</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08416">his praise</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in my mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Abimelech</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Achish</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 34:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall make her boast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06035">the humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be glad</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">O magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">with me, and let us exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">me, and delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04035">me from all my fears</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05102" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, and were lightened</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">and their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were not ashamed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were lightened</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">they flowed unto him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 34:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06041">This poor man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">him out of all his troubles</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">The angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">encampeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and delivereth</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 34:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02938" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O taste</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0835">blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">trusteth</w> in him.

verses.name: Psalms 34:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">ye his saints</w>: for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">no want</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">to them that fear</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 34:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03715">The young lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do lack</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and suffer hunger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but they that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not want</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">any good</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto me: I will teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">you the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">What man</w> <transChange type="added">is he that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02655">desireth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <transChange type="added">many</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 34:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">thy tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and thy lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">from speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">guile</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and pursue</w> it.

verses.name: Psalms 34:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">upon the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0241">and his ears</w> <transChange type="added">are open</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07775">unto their cry</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">The face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against them that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">the remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of them from the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The righteous</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heareth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">them out of all their troubles</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto them that are of a broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and saveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01793">such as be of a contrite</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the broken of heart</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of a contrite…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">contrite of spirit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 34:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the afflictions</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">delivereth</w> him out of them all.

verses.name: Psalms 34:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">all his bones</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02007">of them</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is broken</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 34:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">guilty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 34:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">redeemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servants</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and none of them that trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0816" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in him shall be desolate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>desolate</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">guilty</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 34." eID="gen559" osisID="Ps.34"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv31"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv31"/><w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Plead</w> <transChange type="added">my cause</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03401">with them that strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with me: fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against them that fight</w> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">of shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06793">and buckler</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">for mine help</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07324" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">also the spear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and stop</w> <transChange type="added">the way</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">against</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me: say</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto my soul</w>, I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">thy salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and put to shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">after my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let them be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought to confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">my hurt</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04671">Let them be as chaff</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04397">and let the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">chase</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Let their way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">be dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H02519">and slippery</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04397">and let the angel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">persecute</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>dark…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">darkness and slipperiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02600">For without cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">for me their net</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07845">a pit</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H02658" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07722">Let destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808 strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him at unawares</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07568">and let his net</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H07722">himself: into that very destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him fall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">which he knoweth not of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">And my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">in his salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">All my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">like unto thee, which deliverest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02389">from him that is too strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">for him, yea, the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from him that spoileth</w> him?

verses.name: Psalms 35:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02555">False</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witnesses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did rise up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they laid to my charge</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that I knew</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>False…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Witnesses of wrong</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they asked me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07908">the spoiling</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of my soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>spoiling</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">depriving</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">But as for me, when they were sick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03830">my clothing</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I humbled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">with fasting</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08605">and my prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into mine own bosom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>humbled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">afflicted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">I behaved</w> myself as though <transChange type="added">he had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">my friend</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">brother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">heavily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H057">as one that mourneth</w> <transChange type="added">for his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>behaved myself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walked</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>as though…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as a friend, as a brother to me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06761">But in mine adversity</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they rejoiced</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and gathered themselves together</w>: <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05222">the abjects</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">gathered themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">against me, and I knew</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07167" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">not; they did tear</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and ceased</w> not:<note type="study"><catchWord>adversity</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">halting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02611">With hypocritical</w> <w lemma="strong:H03934">mockers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04580">in feasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02786" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">they gnashed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">upon me with their teeth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">how long wilt thou look on</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">rescue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07722">from their destructions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03173">my darling</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">from the lions</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>darling</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">only one</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will give thee thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">thee among much</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>much</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let not them that are mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">wrongfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> over me: <transChange type="added">neither</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07169" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them wink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">me without a cause</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wrongfully</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">falsely</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">For they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">not peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matters</w> against <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07282">quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Yea, they opened their mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">wide</w> against me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">Aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">our eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath seen</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast seen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep not silence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not far</w> from me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thyself, and awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">to my judgment</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07379">unto my cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">and my Lord</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 35:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">according to thy righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them not rejoice</w> over me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them not say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in their hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">Ah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">so would we have it</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them not say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">We have swallowed him up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Ah…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Ah, ah, our soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought to confusion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H08056">that rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">at mine hurt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">with shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">and dishonour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that magnify</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 35:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them shout for joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02655">that favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">my righteous cause</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, let them say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">Let the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be magnified</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02655">which hath pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in the prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of his servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>righteous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 35:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">And my tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of thy righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of thy praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> long. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 35." eID="gen560" osisID="Ps.35"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv32"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">the servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv32"/><w lemma="strong:H06588">The transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w>, <transChange type="added">that there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06343">no fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before his eyes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 36:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For he flattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">himself in his own eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">until his iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be hateful</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>until…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to find his iniquity to hate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 36:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">and deceit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath left off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be wise</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do good</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 36:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon his bed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">himself in a way</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he abhorreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not evil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mischief</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">vanity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 36:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">thy faithfulness</w> <transChange type="added">reacheth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07834">unto the clouds</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 36:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">Thy righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">like the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">deep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou preservest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the mountains of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 36:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03368">How excellent</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy lovingkindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>! <w lemma="strong:H01121">therefore the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put their trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">under the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of thy wings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>excellent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">precious</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 36:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall be abundantly satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">with the fatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thy house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and thou shalt make them drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H05730">of thy pleasures</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abundantly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">watered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 36:9
verses.text: For with thee <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04726">the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0216">in thy light</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall we see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 36:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">thee; and thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">to the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>continue</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">draw out at length</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 36:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">Let not the foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">of pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">against me, and let not the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">remove</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 36:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">There are the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fallen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">they are cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall not be able</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to rise</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 36." eID="gen561" osisID="Ps.36"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv33"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv33"/><w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Fret</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">not thyself because of evildoers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither be thou envious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">of iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04120">For they shall soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H05243" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be cut down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02682">like the grass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05034" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and wither</w> <w lemma="strong:H03418">as the green</w> <w lemma="strong:H01877">herb</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">shalt thou dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0530">and verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou shalt be fed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>verily</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in truth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">stableness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thyself also in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04862">thee the desires</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of thine heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">trust</w> also in him; and he shall bring <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to pass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Commit…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Roll thy way upon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">And he shall bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">as the light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and thy judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">as the noonday</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">and wait patiently</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">for him: fret</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">not thyself because of him who prospereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">because of the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-293">who bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">wicked devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802" type="x-split-293">to pass</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Rest in</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be silent to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">from anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">fret</w> <w lemma="strong:H0389">not thyself in any wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to do evil</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">For evildoers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but those that wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">For yet a little while</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8712">yea, thou shalt diligently consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">his place</w>, and it <transChange type="added">shall</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06035">But the meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06026" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and shall delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">themselves in the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02161" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">plotteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">against the just</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02786" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and gnasheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">upon him with his teeth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>plotteth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">practiseth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall laugh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">at him: for he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">that his day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is coming</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have drawn out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have bent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">their bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">such as be of upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">conversation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>such…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the upright of way</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02719">Their sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">into their own heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07198">and their bows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">A little</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">that a righteous man</w> hath <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01995">than the riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02220">For the arms</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">of the upright</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05159">and their inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall be for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall not be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">and in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07459">of famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall be satisfied</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">But the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">as the fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03733">of lambs</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall consume</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06227">into smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall they consume away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the fat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the preciousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">borroweth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and payeth not again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sheweth mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and giveth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:22
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">such as be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of him shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>; and <transChange type="added">they that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">cursed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of him shall be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04703">The steps</w> of a <transChange type="added">good</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">are ordered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">by the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ordered</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">established</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though he fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">he shall not be utterly cast down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upholdeth</w> <transChange type="added">him with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">I have been young</w>, and <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02204" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">am old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet have I not seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">forsaken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">nor his seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">begging</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:26
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">merciful</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and lendeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02233">and his seed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01293">blessed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ever</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for evermore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forsaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">not his saints</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they are preserved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02233">but the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">therein for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">The mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and his tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">talketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">The law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of his God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0838">none of his steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H04571" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall slide</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>steps</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">watcheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to slay</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 37:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him in his hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">nor condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">him when he is judged</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">on the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and he shall exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee to inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">when the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">are cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">in great power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and spreading</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">himself like a green</w> <w lemma="strong:H0249">bay tree</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a green…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a green tree that groweth in his own soil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 37:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet he passed away</w>, and, lo, he <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">not: yea, I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">him, but he could not be found</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H08535">the perfect</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">the upright</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0319">for the end</w> of <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But the transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0319">the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be cut off</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08668">But the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">their strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 37:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">And the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them: he shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">them from the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and save</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, because they trust</w> in him. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 37." eID="gen562" osisID="Ps.37"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv34"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring to remembrance</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv34"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">me not in thy wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">neither chasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">me in thy hot displeasure</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">For thine arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">stick fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in me, and thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">presseth me sore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04974">no soundness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">of thine anger</w>; neither <transChange type="added">is there any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of my sin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">peace</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">health</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 38:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">For mine iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">mine head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03515">as an heavy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04853">burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are too heavy</w> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02250">My wounds</w> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">stink</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04743" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">of my foolishness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am troubled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> long.<note type="study"><catchWord>troubled</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wried</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 38:7
