verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03689">For my loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07033" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">with a loathsome</w> <transChange type="added">disease</transChange>: and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04974">no soundness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">in my flesh</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06313" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am feeble</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H01794" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">broken</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have roared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05100">by reason of the disquietness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of my heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08378">all my desire</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0585">before thee; and my groaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not hid</w> from thee.

verses.name: Psalms 38:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05503" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">panteth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03581">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">me: as for the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01992">it</w> <w lemma="strong:H0369">also is gone</w> from me.<note type="study"><catchWord>is gone…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is not with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 38:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">My lovers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">and my friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">aloof from</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">my sore</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07138">and my kinsmen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stroke</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>my kinsmen</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">my neighbours</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 38:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">They also that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">after my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05367" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">lay snares</w> <transChange type="added">for me</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">my hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">mischievous things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceits</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> long.

verses.name: Psalms 38:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02795">But I, as a deaf</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">heard</w> not; and <transChange type="added">I was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0483">as a dumb man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">openeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not his mouth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Thus I was as a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not, and in whose mouth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08433">no reproofs</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For in thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">do I hope</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou wilt hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thee do I wait for</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hear</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">answer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 38:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I said</w>, <transChange type="added">Hear me</transChange>, lest <transChange type="added">otherwise</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they should rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">over me: when my foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">slippeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they magnify</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:17
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H06761">to halt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04341">and my sorrow</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> before me.<note type="study"><catchWord>to halt</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for halting</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 38:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For I will declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">mine iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be sorry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">for my sin</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But mine enemies</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">lively</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are strong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">me wrongfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are multiplied</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are lively…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">being living, are strong</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 38:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">They also that render</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07853" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are mine adversaries</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">because I follow</w> <transChange type="added">the thing that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 38:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me not, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not far</w> from me.

verses.name: Psalms 38:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">me, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">my salvation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for my help</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 38." eID="gen563" osisID="Ps.38"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv35"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03038">to Jeduthun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv35"/><w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will take heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">not with my tongue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04269">with a bridle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">while the wicked</w> is before me.<note type="study"><catchWord>my mouth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a bridle</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">muzzle for my mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 39:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I was dumb</w> <w lemma="strong:H01747">with silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I held my peace</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">from good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03511">and my sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was stirred</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stirred</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">troubled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 39:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was hot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01901">me, while I was musing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burned</w>: <transChange type="added"><w lemma="strong:H0227">then</w></transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">I with my tongue</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 39:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make me to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">mine end</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04060">and the measure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of my days</w>, what it <transChange type="added">is</transChange>; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02310">how frail</w> I <transChange type="added">am</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>how…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">what time I have here</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 39:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">my days</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02947">an handbreadth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02465">and mine age</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03605">as nothing before thee: verily every</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">at his best state</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03605">altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">settled</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 39:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Surely every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">in a vain shew</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">surely they are disquieted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">in vain</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06651" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he heapeth up</w> <transChange type="added">riches</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not who shall gather</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>a vain…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an image</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 39:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">And now, Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">what wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H08431">I for? my hope</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> in thee.

verses.name: Psalms 39:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">me from all my transgressions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">me not the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">of the foolish</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 39:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0481" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I was dumb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">not my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou didst</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 39:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-294">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">thy stroke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-294">away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from me: I am consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08409">by the blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>blow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">conflict</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 39:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08433">When thou with rebukes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">dost correct</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">thou makest his beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04529" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to consume away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06211">like a moth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0120">surely every man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that which is to be desired in him to melt away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 39:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07775">unto my cry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hold not thy peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">at my tears</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">a stranger</w> with thee, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08453">a sojourner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">as all my fathers</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 39:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01082" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, that I may recover strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before I go hence</w>, and be no more. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 39." eID="gen564" osisID="Ps.39"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv36"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv36"/><w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">patiently</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, and heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07775">my cry</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I waited…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">In waiting I waited</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 40:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He brought me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07588">also out of an horrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03121">out of the miry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">clay</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">upon a rock</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">established</w> <w lemma="strong:H0838">my goings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a pit of noise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 40:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he hath put</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in my mouth</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 40:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04009">his trust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and respecteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07295">not the proud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07750" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor such as turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">to lies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 40:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thy wonderful</w> works <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04284">and thy thoughts</w> <transChange type="added">which are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order</w> unto thee: <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I would declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and speak</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are more</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">than can be numbered</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they cannot…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">none can order them unto thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 40:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02077">Sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">and offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou didst not desire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0241">mine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou opened</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H02401">and sin offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou not required</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>opened</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">digged</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 40:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I, Lo, I come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04039">in the volume</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">of the book</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w> of me,

verses.name: Psalms 40:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">thy will</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">yea, thy law</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">my heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>within…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the midst of my bowels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 40:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have preached</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lo, I have not refrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">my lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 40:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have not hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">and thy salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have not concealed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and thy truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">from the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">congregation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">not thou thy tender mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">let thy lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and thy truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">preserve</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04557">For innumerable</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evils</w> <w lemma="strong:H0661" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">me about: mine iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">have taken hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon me, so that I am not able</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to look up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are more</w> <w lemma="strong:H08185">than the hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of mine head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">therefore my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>faileth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">forsaketh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be pleased</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me: O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">to help</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">after my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it; let them be driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and put to shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H02655">that wish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me evil</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 40:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be desolate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06118">for a reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">of their shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01889">unto me, Aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">aha</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 40:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Let all those that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in thee: let such as love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">thy salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be magnified</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 40:17
verses.text: But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thinketh</w> upon me: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05833">my help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and my deliverer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">make no tarrying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 40." eID="gen565" osisID="Ps.40"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv37"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv37"/><w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that considereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">him in time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the poor</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the weak</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sick</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in time…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the day of evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 41:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and keep him alive</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">he shall be blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou wilt not deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">him unto the will</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of his enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">do not thou deliver</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 41:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06210">him upon the bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01741">of languishing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou wilt make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">all his bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02483">in his sickness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>make</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turn</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 41:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me: heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have sinned</w> against thee.

verses.name: Psalms 41:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of me, When shall he die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">and his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perish</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 41:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And if he come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w> to itself; <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he telleth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 41:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03907" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">me whisper</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">against me: against me do they devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">my hurt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">evil to me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 41:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01100">An evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">disease</w>, <transChange type="added">say they</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cleaveth fast</w> unto him: and <transChange type="added">now</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he lieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he shall rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no more</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>An…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A thing of Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 41:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07965">Yea, mine own familiar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">friend</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in whom I trusted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of my bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath lifted up</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06119">heel</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the man of my peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lifted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">magnified</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 41:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me, and raise me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I may requite</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 41:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">By this I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou favourest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me, because mine enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">doth not triumph</w> over me.

verses.name: Psalms 41:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And as for me, thou upholdest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">me in mine integrity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and settest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">me before thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 41:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">from everlasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">and to everlasting</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">and Amen</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 41." eID="gen566" osisID="Ps.41"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv38"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv38"/><w lemma="strong:H0354">As the hart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06165" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">panteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">after the water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0650">brooks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06165" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so panteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">after thee, O God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Psalm giving instruction of the sons</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>panteth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">brayeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 42:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thirsteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">for the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when shall I come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 42:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01832">My tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">have been my meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">while they continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">say</w> unto me, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 42:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When I remember</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in me: for I had gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05519">with the multitude</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01718" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">with them to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">of joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">and praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">with a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that kept holyday</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 42:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">Why art thou cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>? and <transChange type="added">why</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">art thou disquieted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">in me? hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou in God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I shall yet praise</w> him <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of his countenance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cast</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bowed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>praise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">give thanks</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>for the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his presence is salvation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 42:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">is cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">within me: therefore will I remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee from the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03383">of Jordan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02769">and of the Hermonites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">from the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04706">Mizar</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the hill…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the little hill</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 42:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08415">Deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">unto deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06794">of thy waterspouts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04867">all thy waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">and thy billows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are gone</w> over me.

verses.name: Psalms 42:8
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will command</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">in the daytime</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and in the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">his song</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> with me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of my life</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 42:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">my rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Why hast thou forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me? why go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">because of the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 42:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07524">with a sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in my bones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me; while they say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> unto me, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>sword</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">killing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 42:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">Why art thou cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and why art thou disquieted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">within me? hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou in God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I shall yet praise</w> him, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the health</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and my God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 42." eID="gen567" osisID="Ps.42"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">my cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623 strong:H03808">against an ungodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">O deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">me from the deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">and unjust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ungodly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">unmerciful</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the deceitful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of deceit and iniquity</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 43:2
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">of my strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">why dost thou cast me off</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">why go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I mourning</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">because of the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 43:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O send out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">thy light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and thy truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let them lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me; let them bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">me unto thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hill</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04908">and to thy tabernacles</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 43:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then will I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">unto the altar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">my exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01524">joy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03658">yea, upon the harp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thee, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my exceeding…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the gladness of my joy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">Why art thou cast down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and why art thou disquieted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">within me? hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for I shall yet praise</w> him, <transChange type="added">who is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the health</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and my God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 43." eID="gen568" osisID="Ps.43"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv39"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv39"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">with our ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have told</w> us, <transChange type="added">what</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06467">work</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou didst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in their days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the times</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 44:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">How</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou didst drive out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with thy hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and plantedst</w> them; <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou didst afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cast them out</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-295">For they got</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">not the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-295">in possession</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by their own sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">neither did their own arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">them: but thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02220">and thine arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thy countenance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hadst a favour</w> unto them.

verses.name: Psalms 44:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Thou art my King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">command</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">deliverances</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">for Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Through thee will we push down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">our enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">through thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will we tread them under</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that rise up</w> against us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I will not trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">in my bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">neither shall my sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">save</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 44:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">But thou hast saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">us from our enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hast put them to shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that hated</w> us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">In God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we boast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">long, and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0637">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast cast off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and put us to shame</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and goest not forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">with our armies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou makest us to turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">from the enemy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they which hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08154" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us spoil</w> for themselves.

verses.name: Psalms 44:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">us like sheep</w> <transChange type="added">appointed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03978">for meat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and hast scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">us among the heathen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>like…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as sheep of meat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 44:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou sellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">for nought</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and dost not increase</w> <transChange type="added">thy wealth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04242">by their price</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">without riches</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 44:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou makest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">us a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">to our neighbours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03933">a scorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07047">and a derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">to them that are round about</w> us.

verses.name: Psalms 44:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou makest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">us a byword</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04493">a shaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">among the people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03639">My confusion</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">before me, and the shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of my face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath covered</w> me,

verses.name: Psalms 44:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">For the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of him that reproacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01442" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and blasphemeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">by reason</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">and avenger</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">All this is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upon us; yet have we not forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08266" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thee, neither have we dealt falsely</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">in thy covenant</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Our heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is not turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0838">neither have our steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">declined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">from thy way</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>steps</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">goings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 44:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01794" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Though thou hast sore broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">us in the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">of dragons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">us with the shadow of death</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If we have forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">god</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 44:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Shall not God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">search this out</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08587">the secrets</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of the heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">Yea, for thy sake are we killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">long; we are counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">as sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02878">for the slaughter</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">why sleepest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">thou, O Lord</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">arise</w>, cast <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Wherefore hidest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thou thy face</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forgettest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">our affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03906">and our oppression</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 44:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">For our soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07743" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is bowed down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">to the dust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0990">our belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 44:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">for our help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">us for thy mercies’</w> sake.<note type="study"><catchWord>for our…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a help for us</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 44." eID="gen569" osisID="Ps.44"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv40"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">upon Shoshannim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03039">of loves</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv40"/><w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07370" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is inditing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of the things which I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">touching the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03956">my tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05842">the pen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04106">of a ready</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">writer</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of instruction</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>is inditing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">boileth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">bubbleth up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 45:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03302" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">Thou art fairer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">than the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03332" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is poured</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">into thy lips</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">therefore God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gird</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">thy sword</w> upon <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03409">thigh</w>, O <transChange type="added">most</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01935">with thy glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and thy majesty</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01926">And in thy majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">prosperously</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06037">and meekness</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03225">and thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thee terrible things</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>ride…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prosper thou, ride thou</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 45:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">Thine arrows</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemies</w>; <transChange type="added">whereby</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> under thee.

verses.name: Psalms 45:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03678">Thy throne</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07626">the sceptre</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of thy kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04334">a right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">sceptre</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou lovest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">therefore God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">thee with the oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">of gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02270">above thy fellows</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">All thy garments</w> <transChange type="added">smell</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04753">of myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0174">and aloes</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07102">cassia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">out of the ivory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">palaces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04482">whereby</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have made thee glad</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Kings’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughters</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">among thy honourable women</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">upon thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">did stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07694">the queen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03800">in gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0211">of Ophir</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and consider</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">also thine own people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 45:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">So shall the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">greatly desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">thy beauty</w>: for he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">thy Lord</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and worship</w> thou him.

verses.name: Psalms 45:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">And the daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w> <transChange type="added">shall be there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04503">with a gift</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06223">the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy favour</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>favour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 45:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">daughter</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03520">all glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06441">within</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03830">her clothing</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04865">of wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">She shall be brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07553">in raiment of needlework</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01330">the virgins</w> <w lemma="strong:H07464">her companions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">that follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">her shall be brought</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 45:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08057">With gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01524">and rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">shall they be brought</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">into the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">palace</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Instead of thy fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">shall be thy children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">whom thou mayest make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 45:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">I will make thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">therefore shall the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 45." eID="gen570" osisID="Ps.45"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv41"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H05961">upon Alamoth</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv41"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">our refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">and strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">a very</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">present</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">in trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore will not we fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">though the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">be removed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">and though the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be carried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>midst…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart of the seas</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof roar</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02560" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be troubled</w>, <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">with the swelling</w> thereof. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">a river</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06388">the streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">whereof shall make glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">of the tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">of her; she shall not be moved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall help</w> her, <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">early</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">when the morning appeareth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">The heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">raged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were moved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he uttered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">melted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with us; the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04869">our refuge</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>our…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an high place for us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04659">the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08047">what desolations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04421">He maketh wars</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">unto the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">the bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-296">and cutteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02595">the spear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-296">in sunder</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05699">the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">in the fire</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Be still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and know</w> that I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 46:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">with us; the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04869">our refuge</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 46." eID="gen571" osisID="Ps.46"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv42"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv42"/><w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O clap</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">your hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">all ye people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shout</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">of triumph</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 47:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">most high</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w>; <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">King</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 47:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He shall subdue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">under us, and the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">under our feet</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 47:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">our inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">for us, the excellency</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he loved</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 47:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is gone up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">with a shout</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of a trumpet</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 47:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing praises</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto our King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing praises</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 47:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing ye praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">with understanding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">every one that hath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 47:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">over the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of his holiness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 47:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05081">The princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are gathered together</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04043">for the shields</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03966">he is greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">exalted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>princes…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">voluntary of the people are gathered unto the people of the God of Abraham</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 47." eID="gen572" osisID="Ps.47"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv43"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04210">Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv43"/><w lemma="strong:H01419">Great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">to be praised</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of his holiness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 48:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03303">Beautiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05131">for situation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04885">the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <transChange type="added">on</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03411">the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H06828">of the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">King</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">in her palaces</w> <w lemma="strong:H04869">for a refuge</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">For, lo, the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">were assembled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they passed by</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08539" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so they marvelled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they were troubled</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02648" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hasted away</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07461">Fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">took hold</w> upon them there, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02427">pain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as of a woman in travail</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou breakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">the ships</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06921">with an east</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">As we have heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so have we seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">it for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">We have thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy lovingkindness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of thy temple</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">According to thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">thy praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07099">unto the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Let mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01323">let the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">because of thy judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 48:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Walk about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and go round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">her: tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">the towers</w> thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 48:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">ye well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02430">her bulwarks</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06448" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">her palaces</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that ye may tell</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">following</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Mark…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Set your heart to</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>consider</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">raise up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 48:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For this God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will be our guide</w> <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04192">unto death</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 48." eID="gen573" osisID="Ps.48"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv44"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv44"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> this, all <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w>, all <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H02465">of the world</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 49:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120 strong:H01121">Both low</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H01121">and high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06223">rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 49:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">My mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H02454">of wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01900">and the meditation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of my heart</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of understanding</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 49:4
