verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">mine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">to a parable</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">my dark saying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">upon the harp</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 49:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wherefore should I fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06120">of my heels</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall compass</w> me about?

verses.name: Psalms 49:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">in their wealth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and boast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">themselves in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">of their riches</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 49:7
verses.text: None <transChange type="added">of them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by any means</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">his brother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">a ransom</w> for him:

verses.name: Psalms 49:8
verses.text: (<w lemma="strong:H06306">For the redemption</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of their soul</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">precious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and it ceaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:)

verses.name: Psalms 49:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That he should still live</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">corruption</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 49:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he seeth</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03162">likewise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">the fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01198">and the brutish person</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">their wealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to others</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 49:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07130">Their inward</w> thought <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">their houses</w> <transChange type="added">shall continue</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">their dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">places to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they call</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0127">lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">after their own names</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 49:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Nevertheless man</w> <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03366">in honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">not: he is like</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">the beasts</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">perish</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 49:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">This their way</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03689">their folly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0310">yet their posterity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">approve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">their sayings</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>approve…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">delight in their mouth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 49:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06629">Like sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08371" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">in the grave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">on them; and the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">over them in the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06736 strong:H06697" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">and their beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">shall consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">in the grave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02073">from their dwelling</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>beauty</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strength</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in the grave from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the grave being an habitation to every one of them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 49:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of the grave</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for he shall receive</w> me. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the grave</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">hell</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 49:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not thou afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">when one</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">is made rich</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">when the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is increased</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 49:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04194">For when he dieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall carry nothing away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not descend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 49:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Though while he lived</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>: and <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee, when thou doest well</w> to thyself.<note type="study"><catchWord>while…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 49:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05331 strong:H03808">they shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The soul shall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 49:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Man</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03366">in honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and understandeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">not, is like</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">the beasts</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01820" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">perish</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 49." eID="gen574" osisID="Ps.49"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv45"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv45"/><w lemma="strong:H0410">The mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">unto the going down</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for Asaph</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 50:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">Out of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04359">the perfection</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">of beauty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath shined</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not keep silence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0784">a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall devour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">him, and it shall be very</w> <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">tempestuous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 50:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05920">from above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and to the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">my saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">together unto me; those that have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">with me by sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">And the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">his righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">judge</w> himself. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">O my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will speak</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will testify</w> against thee: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will not reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">thee for thy sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">or thy burnt offerings</w>, <transChange type="added">to have been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> before me.

verses.name: Psalms 50:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">no bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">out of thy house</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06260">he goats</w> <w lemma="strong:H04356">out of thy folds</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">For every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> mine, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">the cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">upon a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">hills</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">all the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02123">and the wild beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05978">mine</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 50:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I were hungry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I would not tell</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">thee: for the world</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04393">mine, and the fulness</w> thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 50:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Will I eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">of bulls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06260">of goats</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 50:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">thanksgiving</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">thy vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">unto the most High</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 50:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And call</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">upon me in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, and thou shalt glorify</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 50:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">But unto the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">What hast thou to do to declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">my statutes</w>, or <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shouldest take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in thy mouth</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 50:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Seeing thou hatest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and castest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">behind</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 50:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When thou sawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">a thief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then thou consentedst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02506">with him, and hast been partaker</w> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">with adulterers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy portion was with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 50:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and thy tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06775" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">frameth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>givest</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sendest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 50:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou sittest</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">against thy brother</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou</w> <w lemma="strong:H01848">slanderest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">thine own mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:21
verses.text: These <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou done</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and I kept silence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou thoughtest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I was altogether</w> <transChange type="added">such an one</transChange> as thyself: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will reprove</w> thee, and set <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in order</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before thine eyes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">this, ye that forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H0433">God</w>, lest I tear <transChange type="added">you</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02963" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in pieces</w>, and <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to deliver</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 50:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso offereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">glorifieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: and to him that ordereth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">conversation</w> <transChange type="added">aright</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that disposeth his way</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 50." eID="gen575" osisID="Ps.50"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv46"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05416">when Nathan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05030">the prophet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him, after he had gone in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01339">to Bath–sheba</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv46"/><w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon me, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">according to thy lovingkindness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">according unto the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">of thy tender mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgressions</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me throughly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">from mine iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">me from my sin</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For I acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgressions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02403">and my sin</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">ever</w> before me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Against thee, thee only, have I sinned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and done</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mightest be justified</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou speakest</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be clear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou judgest</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">Behold, I was shapen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">in iniquity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02399">and in sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">did my mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03179" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">conceive</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>conceive…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">warm me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, thou desirest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02910">in the inward parts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05640" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and in the hidden</w> <transChange type="added">part</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou shalt make me to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Purge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0231">me with hyssop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I shall be clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03526" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H03835" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me, and I shall be whiter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">than snow</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Make me to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w>; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01794" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may rejoice</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">from my sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and blot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">all mine iniquities</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Create</w> <w lemma="strong:H02889">in me a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and renew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a right</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>right</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">constant</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Cast me not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from thy presence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">not thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> from me.

verses.name: Psalms 51:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">unto me the joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of thy salvation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and uphold</w> me <transChange type="added">with thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05081">free</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy ways</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02400">and sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be converted</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 51:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">me from bloodguiltiness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">of my salvation</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03956">my tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall sing aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of thy righteousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bloodguiltiness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bloods</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 51:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">thou my lips</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">and my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">thy praise</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou desirest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">not sacrifice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">else would I give</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou delightest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">not in burnt offering</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>else…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that I should</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 51:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02077">The sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01794" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and a contrite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou wilt not despise</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Do good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">in thy good pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">unto Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">thou the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 51:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shalt thou be pleased</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">with the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05930">with burnt offering</w> <w lemma="strong:H03632">and whole</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">burnt offering</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then shall they offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">upon thine altar</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 51." eID="gen576" osisID="Ps.51"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv47"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01673">when Doeg</w> <w lemma="strong:H0130">the Edomite</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and told</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto him, David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0288">of Ahimelech</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv47"/><w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">Why boastest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thou thyself in mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">O mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">man? the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 52:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">Thy tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">mischiefs</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03913" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">like a sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H08593">razor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">working</w> <w lemma="strong:H07423">deceitfully</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 52:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou lovest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">more than good</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">rather than to speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 52:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou lovest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01105">all devouring</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>, O <transChange type="added">thou</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>O thou…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and the deceitful tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 52:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall likewise destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">thee for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02846" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall take thee away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05255" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and pluck thee out</w> of <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">dwelling place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and root thee out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">beat thee down</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 52:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall laugh</w> at him:

verses.name: Psalms 52:7
verses.text: Lo, <transChange type="added">this is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04581">his strength</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">of his riches</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">himself in his wickedness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wickedness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">substance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 52:8
verses.text: But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07488">like a green</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">olive tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in the mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 52:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because thou hast done</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">on thy name</w>; for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">before thy saints</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 52." eID="gen577" osisID="Ps.52"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv48"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H04257">upon Mahalath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv48"/><w lemma="strong:H05036">The fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">no God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Corrupt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">are they, and have done abominable</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquity</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 53:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">looked down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">if there were</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that did understand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that did seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 53:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Every one of them is gone back</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03162">they are altogether</w> <w lemma="strong:H0444" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">become filthy</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0259">no, not one</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 53:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Have the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">no knowledge</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 53:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">There were they in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fear</w>, <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06343">no fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">was: for God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02583" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that encampeth</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> thee: thou hast put <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">because God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath despised</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they feared a fear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 53:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">were come</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">out of Zion</w>! <w lemma="strong:H0430">When God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">bringeth back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be glad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Oh that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Who will give salvation</rdg>, etc</note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 53." eID="gen578" osisID="Ps.53"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv49"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">on Neginoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02130">when the Ziphims</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">to Saul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01732">Doth not David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">hide</w> himself with us?</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv49"/><w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">by thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">me by thy strength</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 54:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">to the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 54:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">For strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are risen up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">against me, and oppressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">after my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not set</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> before them. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 54:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Behold, God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine helper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that uphold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 54:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">He shall reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08324" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto mine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cut them off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">in thy truth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">those that observe me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 54:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05071">I will freely</w> <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto thee: I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 54:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For he hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">me out of all trouble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">and mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath seen</w> <transChange type="added">his desire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon mine enemies</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 54." eID="gen579" osisID="Ps.54"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv50"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">on Neginoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv50"/><w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">to my prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H08467">not thyself from my supplication</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, and hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07300" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me: I mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07879">in my complaint</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01949" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and make a noise</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 55:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">Because of the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06125">of the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for they cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">upon me, and in wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H07852" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they hate</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is sore pained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H0367">me: and the terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are fallen</w> upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">Fearfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07461">and trembling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06427">upon me, and horror</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hath overwhelmed</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>overwhelmed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">covered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Oh that</w> <w lemma="strong:H083">I had wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">like a dove</w>! <transChange type="added">for then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">would I fly away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be at rest</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 55:7
verses.text: Lo, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">would I wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">far off</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 55:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I would hasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H04655">my escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">from the windy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05584" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">storm</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05591">tempest</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 55:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Destroy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06385" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">their tongues</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">and strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 55:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03119">Day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">and night</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">they go about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">it upon the walls</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">thereof: mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">also and sorrow</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> of it.

verses.name: Psalms 55:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01942">Wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08496">thereof: deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">and guile</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">not from her streets</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 55:12
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not an enemy</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me; then I could have borne</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>: neither <transChange type="added">was it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he that hated</w> me <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">did magnify</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">against me; then I would have hid</w> myself from him:

verses.name: Psalms 55:13
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">it was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">thou, a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06187">mine equal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0441">my guide</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and mine acquaintance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mine equal</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to my rank</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04985" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">We took sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">unto the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07285">in company</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>We…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Who sweetened counsel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04194">Let death</w> <w lemma="strong:H03451 strong:H05377" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">seize</w> upon them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">quick</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">into hell</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">for wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04033">in their dwellings</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>hell</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the grave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">As for me, I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">and the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall save</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">Evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01242">and morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06672">and at noon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I pray</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cry aloud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 55:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">in peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">from the battle</w> <transChange type="added">that was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">against me: for there were many</w> with me.

verses.name: Psalms 55:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them, even he that abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02487">Because they have no changes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore they fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Because…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">With whom also there be no changes, yet they</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">against such as be at peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">with him: he hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>broken</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">profaned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The words</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were smoother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04260">than butter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07128">but war</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">his words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07401" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">were softer</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">than oil</w>, yet <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06609">they drawn swords</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 55:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03053">thy burden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">and he shall sustain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">thee: he shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be moved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>burden</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">gift</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 55:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But thou, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt bring them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">into the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">of destruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01818">bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">and deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02673" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not live out half</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">their days</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but I will trust</w> in thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>bloody…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of bloods and deceit</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall not half their days</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 55." eID="gen580" osisID="Ps.55"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv51"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H03128">upon Jonath–elem–rechokim</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04387">Michtam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06430">when the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">took</w> <w lemma="strong:H01661">him in Gath</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv51"/><w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto me, O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">for man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would swallow me up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he fighting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">oppresseth</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>Michtam…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A golden Psalm of David</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 56:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08324" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">would daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">swallow</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> up: for <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that fight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">against me, O thou most High</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enemies</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">observers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 56:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">What time</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I am afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will trust</w> in thee.

verses.name: Psalms 56:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">In God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">in God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have put my trust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">what flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can do</w> unto me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they wrest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04284">all their thoughts</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">against me for evil</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 56:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They gather themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06845 strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">they hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">themselves, they mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H06119">my steps</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">when they wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 56:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06405">Shall they escape</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">by iniquity</w>? in <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 56:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou tellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05112">my wanderings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">put</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">thou my tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H04997">into thy bottle</w>: <transChange type="added">are they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05612">not in thy book</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 56:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">When</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cry</w> <transChange type="added">unto thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">then shall mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">this I know</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">In God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I praise</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I praise</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 56:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">In God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I put my trust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">what man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can do</w> unto me.

verses.name: Psalms 56:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05088">Thy vows</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon me, O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will render</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">praises</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 56:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from death</w>: <transChange type="added">wilt</transChange> not <transChange type="added">thou deliver</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01762">from falling</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that I may walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">in the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>? <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 56." eID="gen581" osisID="Ps.56"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv52"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0516" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Al–taschith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04387">Michtam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he fled</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H07586">Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">in the cave</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv52"/><w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto me, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto me: for my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">in thee: yea, in the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of thy wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I make my refuge</w>, until <transChange type="added">these</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01942">calamities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be overpast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Al–taschith</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Destroy not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Michtam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A golden Psalm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 57:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">most high</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01584" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that performeth</w> <transChange type="added">all things</transChange> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 57:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and save</w> me <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that would swallow me up</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall send forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and his truth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he reproacheth him that</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 57:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H03833">lions</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I lie</w> <transChange type="added">even among</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that are set on fire</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08127">whose teeth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02595">spears</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">and arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02299">a sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 57:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be thou exalted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">above the heavens</w>; <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">thy glory</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">above all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 57:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They have prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">a net</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">for my steps</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03721" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is bowed down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07882">a pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">me, into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whereof they are fallen</w> <transChange type="added">themselves</transChange>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 57:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is fixed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is fixed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and give praise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fixed</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prepared</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 57:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">my glory</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">psaltery</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harp</w>: I <transChange type="added">myself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">early</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 57:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">thee, O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">unto thee among the nations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 57:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">For thy mercy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">unto the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0571">and thy truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">unto the clouds</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 57:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be thou exalted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">above the heavens</w>: <transChange type="added">let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">thy glory</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">above all the earth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 57." eID="gen582" osisID="Ps.57"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv53"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0516" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Al–taschith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04387">Michtam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv53"/><w lemma="strong:H0552">Do ye indeed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0482">O congregation</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do ye judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">uprightly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O ye sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Al–taschith…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Destroy not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Michtam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A golden Psalm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 58:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Yea, in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">wickedness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06424" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">ye weigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">the violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of your hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 58:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are estranged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">from the womb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they go astray</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">as soon as they be born</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">speaking</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as soon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 58:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">Their poison</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01823">like</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">the poison</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">of a serpent</w>: <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02795">like the deaf</w> <w lemma="strong:H06620">adder</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0331" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stoppeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">her ear</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>like the poison</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the likeness</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>adder</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">asp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 58:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Which will not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03907" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of charmers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02267 strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">charming</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">never so wisely</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>charming…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">be the charmer never so cunning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 58:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Break</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">their teeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05422" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">break out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04459">the great teeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of the young lions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 58:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Let them melt away</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">as waters</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">run continually</w>: <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he bendeth</w> <transChange type="added">his bow to shoot</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02671">his arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">let them be as cut in pieces</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 58:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07642">As a snail</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08557">melteth</w>, let <transChange type="added">every one of them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pass away</w>: <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05309">the untimely birth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a woman</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they may not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 58:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05518">Before your pots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can feel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0329">the thorns</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08175" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall take them away as with a whirlwind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02416">both living</w>, and in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02740">wrath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>both…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as living as wrath</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 58:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when he seeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">the vengeance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall wash</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 58:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">So that a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall say</w>, Verily <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">a reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">for the righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03426">verily he is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that judgeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a reward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fruit of the</rdg>, etc</note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 58." eID="gen583" osisID="Ps.58"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv54"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0516" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Al–taschith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04387">Michtam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07586">when Saul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">sent</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they watched</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to kill him</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv54"/><w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me from mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">me from them that rise up</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>Al–taschith…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Destroy not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Michtam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A golden Psalm</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>defend…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set me on high</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 59:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me from the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">me from bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For, lo, they lie in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05794">the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are gathered</w> against me; not <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">my transgression</w>, nor <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">my sin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They run</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and prepare</w> themselves without <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">fault</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me, and behold</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>help</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">meet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 59:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Thou therefore, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">to any wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">transgressors</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">at evening</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they make a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">like a dog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">and go round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Behold, they belch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with their mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02719">swords</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in their lips</w>: for who, <transChange type="added">say they</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth hear</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 59:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt laugh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">at them; thou shalt have all the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in derision</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Because of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon thee: for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04869">my defence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>defence</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">high place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 59:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">The God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of my mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall prevent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me: God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall let me see</w> <transChange type="added">my desire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08324" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon mine enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>enemies</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">observers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 59:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">them not, lest my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">them by thy power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and bring them down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">our shield</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">For</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of their mouth</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of their lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let them even be taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01347">in their pride</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0423">and for cursing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03585">and lying</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they speak</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Consume</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">in wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">consume</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, that they <transChange type="added">may</transChange> not <transChange type="added">be</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">in Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">unto the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06153">And at evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them return</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them make a noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">like a dog</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">and go round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:15
