verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05128 strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">Let them wander up and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for meat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and grudge</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if they be not satisfied</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for meat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to eat</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>and grudge…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">if they be not satisfied, then they will stay all night</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 59:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of thy power</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">yea, I will sing aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04869">for thou hast been my defence</w> <w lemma="strong:H04498">and refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of my trouble</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 59:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05797">Unto thee, O my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I sing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">for God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04869">my defence</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of my mercy</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 59." eID="gen584" osisID="Ps.59"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv55"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H07802">upon Shushan–eduth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04387">Michtam</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to teach</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05327" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when he strove</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104 strong:H0763">with Aram–naharaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0760">and with Aram–zobah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03097">when Joab</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">returned</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01516">in the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H04417">of salt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06240 strong:H08147">twelve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousand</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv55"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast cast us off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us, thou hast been displeased</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">O turn thyself to us again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Michtam</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A golden Psalm</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>scattered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 60:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Thou hast made the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to tremble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06480" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">it: heal</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">the breaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof; for it shaketh</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 60:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07186">hard things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast made us to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08653">of astonishment</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 60:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast given</w> <w lemma="strong:H05251">a banner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">to them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8710">thee, that it may be displayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H07189">of the truth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 60:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03039">That thy beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be delivered</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and hear</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 60:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holiness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and mete out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 60:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">mine, and Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">mine; Ephraim</w> also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of mine head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">my lawgiver</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 60:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07366 strong:H05518">my washpot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0123">over Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">my shoe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06429">Philistia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8708">triumph</w> thou because of me.<note type="study"><catchWord>triumph…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">triumph thou over me</rdg> :(by an irony)</note>

verses.name: Psalms 60:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Who will bring</w> me <transChange type="added">into</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04692">the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who will lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">me into Edom</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>strong…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">city of strength?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 60:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Wilt</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not thou, O God</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hadst cast us off</w>? and <transChange type="added">thou</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">didst not go out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">with our armies</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 60:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">us help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">from trouble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07723">for vain</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">the help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>help of man</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">salvation</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 60:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Through God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiantly</w>: for he <transChange type="added">it is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tread down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">our enemies</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 60." eID="gen585" osisID="Ps.60"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv56"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">upon Neginah</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv56"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">my cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto my prayer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07097">From the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto thee, when my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is overwhelmed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">me to the rock</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is higher</w> than I.

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04268">For thou hast been a shelter</w> for me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">tower</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in thy tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in the covert</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of thy wings</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trust</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">make my refuge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For thou, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">my vows</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast given</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03425">the heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">of those that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou wilt prolong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">life</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">his years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">as many</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Thou shalt add days to the days of the king</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">O prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may preserve</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So will I sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">praise unto thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">that I may daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">my vows</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 61." eID="gen586" osisID="Ps.61"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv57"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03038">to Jeduthun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv57"/><w lemma="strong:H05315">Truly my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01747">waiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">upon God</w>: from him <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">my salvation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Truly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Only</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>waiteth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 62:2
verses.text: He only <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">my rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">and my salvation</w>; <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04869">my defence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">I shall not be greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">moved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>defence</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">high place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 62:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02050" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">How long will ye imagine mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">against a man</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">ye shall be slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">all of you: as a bowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07023">wall</w> <transChange type="added">shall ye be</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">a tottering</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">fence</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 62:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They only consult</w> to cast <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07613">from his excellency</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">in lies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but they curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">inwardly</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>inwardly</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in their inward parts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 62:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thou only upon God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08615">for my expectation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> from him.

verses.name: Psalms 62:6
verses.text: He only <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">my rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">and my salvation</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04869">my defence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">I shall not be moved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 62:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">In God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03468">my salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and my glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of my strength</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">my refuge</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 62:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in him at all times</w>; ye <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">him: God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">a refuge</w> for us. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 62:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121 strong:H0120">Surely men</w> of low degree <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">men</w> of high degree <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03577">a lie</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">in the balance</w>, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03162">altogether</w> <transChange type="added">lighter</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">than vanity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>altogether</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">alike</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 62:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">not in oppression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and become not vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01498">in robbery</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02428">if riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">increase</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not your heart</w> <transChange type="added">upon them</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 62:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">once</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08147">twice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">this</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05797">that power</w> <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>power</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Also unto thee, O Lord</w>, <transChange type="added">belongeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for thou renderest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to every man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">according to his work</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 62." eID="gen587" osisID="Ps.62"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv58"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">when he was in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv58"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">early will I seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thee: my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06770" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thirsteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">for thee, my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03642" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">longeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">for thee in a dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05889">and thirsty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01097">where no</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w> is;<note type="study"><catchWord>thirsty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">weary</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>where…</catchWord>: <rdg>without water</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">thy power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and thy glory</w>, so <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">thee in the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Because thy lovingkindness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">than life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall praise</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thus will I bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">thee while I live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w> as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02459">marrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">and fatness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06310">and my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall praise</w> <transChange type="added">thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07445">with joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>marrow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fatness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326">thee upon my bed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">meditate</w> on thee in the <transChange type="added">night</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0821">watches</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05833">Because thou hast been my help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06738">therefore in the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">of thy wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I rejoice</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">followeth hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thee: thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">upholdeth</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: But those <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07722">to destroy</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">into the lower parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719 strong:H03027">by the sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04521">they shall be a portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07776">for foxes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They shall fall…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">They shall make him run out like water by the hands of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">But the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">every one that sweareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">by him shall glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">but the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05534" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be stopped</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 63." eID="gen588" osisID="Ps.63"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv59"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv59"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07879">in my prayer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">from fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 64:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">me from the secret counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the wicked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07285">from the insurrection</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 64:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who whet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">like a sword</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bend</w> <transChange type="added">their bows to shoot</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02671">their arrows</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04751">bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 64:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That they may shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04565">in secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H08535">at the perfect</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do they shoot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">at him, and fear</w> not.

verses.name: Psalms 64:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They encourage</w> themselves <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">an evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">matter</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-297">of laying</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8800" type="x-split-297">privily</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who shall see</w> them?<note type="study"><catchWord>matter</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">speech</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to hide his snares</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 64:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They search out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">iniquities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they accomplish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">a diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02665">search</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07130">both the inward</w> <transChange type="added">thought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of every one</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and the heart</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deep</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">we are consumed by that which they have throughly searched</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a diligent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a search searched</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 64:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall shoot</w> at them <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02671">an arrow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04347">shall they be wounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their wound shall be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 64:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">So they shall make their own tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon themselves: all that see</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">them shall flee away</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 64:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">And all men</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for they shall wisely consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of his doing</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 64:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">in him; and all the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall glory</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 64." eID="gen589" osisID="Ps.64"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv60"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv60"/><w lemma="strong:H08416">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01747">waiteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for thee, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Sion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05088">and unto thee shall the vow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be performed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>waiteth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is silent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 65:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O thou that hearest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">unto thee shall all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 65:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771 strong:H01697">Iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">prevail</w> against me: <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06588">our transgressions</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou shalt purge them away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Iniquities</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Words</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">Matters of iniquities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 65:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is the man whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou choosest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and causest to approach</w> <transChange type="added">unto thee</transChange>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in thy courts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">with the goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thy house</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 65:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">By</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">us, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of our salvation</w>; <transChange type="added">who art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04009">the confidence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07099">of all the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07350">and of them that are afar off</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 65:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03581">Which by his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">setteth fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>; <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">with power</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 65:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Which stilleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07588">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07588">the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">of their waves</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01995">and the tumult</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">of the people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 65:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They also that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07099">in the uttermost parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">at thy tokens</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04161">thou makest the outgoings</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">of the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">and evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to rejoice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rejoice</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 65:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou visitest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07783" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">and waterest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">it: thou greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">enrichest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06388">it with the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thou preparest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">them corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when thou hast so provided</w> for it.<note type="study"><catchWord>and…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">after thou hadst made it to desire rain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 65:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8761" type="x-split-298">Thou waterest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08525">the ridges</w> <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8761" type="x-split-298">thereof abundantly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thou settlest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01418 strong:H01417" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">the furrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">thereof: thou makest it soft</w> <w lemma="strong:H07241">with showers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou blessest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06780">the springing</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>settlest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">causest rain to descend into</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>makest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">dissolvest it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 65:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou crownest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the year</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with thy goodness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04570">and thy paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drop</w> <w lemma="strong:H01880">fatness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 65:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They drop</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04999">the pastures</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01389">and the little hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H01524">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">on every side</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rejoice…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are girded with joy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 65:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03733">The pastures</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">with flocks</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06010">the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also are covered over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">with corn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">they shout for joy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they also sing</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 65." eID="gen590" osisID="Ps.65"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv61"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04210">Psalm</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv61"/><w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make a joyful noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all ye lands</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the earth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sing forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of his name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">his praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glorious</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">How terrible</w> <transChange type="added">art thou in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thy works</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07230">through the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of thy power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">submit</w> themselves unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>submit…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">yield feigned obedience</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">All the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee, and shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto thee; they shall sing</w> <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04659">the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w> <transChange type="added">in his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05949">doing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">toward the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03004">into dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">through the flood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">on foot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there did we rejoice</w> in him.

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">by his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the nations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let not the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311 strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">exalt</w> themselves. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">O bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">ye people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and make the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of his praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to be heard</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 66:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which holdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">our soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">in life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and suffereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">not our feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04132">to be moved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holdeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">putteth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 66:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For thou, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast proved</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">us: thou hast tried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">us, as silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is tried</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou broughtest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">us into the net</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou laidst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04157">affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">upon our loins</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0582">Thou hast caused men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to ride</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">over our heads</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we went</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">through fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">and through water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but thou broughtest us out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07310">into a wealthy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wealthy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moist</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 66:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into thy house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">with burnt offerings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">thee my vows</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 66:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">Which my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have uttered</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06862">when I was in trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>uttered</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">opened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 66:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05930">unto thee burnt sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H04220">of fatlings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07004">with the incense</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">of rams</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01241">bullocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06260">with goats</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fatlings</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">marrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 66:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03373">all ye that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">what he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">unto him with my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07318 strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8785 strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8785">and he was extolled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08478">with</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">my tongue</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in my heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not hear</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>:

verses.name: Psalms 66:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0403">verily</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath heard</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath attended</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">of my prayer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 66:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which hath not turned away</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">nor his mercy</w> from me. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 66." eID="gen591" osisID="Ps.66"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv62"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">on Neginoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv62"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto us, and bless</w> us; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">cause his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to shine</w> upon us; <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>upon</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 67:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">That thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03444">thy saving health</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among all nations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 67:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thee, O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">let all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 67:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03816">O let the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and sing for joy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">righteously</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and govern</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">the nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>govern</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lead</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 67:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thee, O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">let all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 67:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">shall the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">her increase</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our own God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall bless</w> us.

verses.name: Psalms 67:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">us; and all the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fear</w> him. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 67." eID="gen592" osisID="Ps.67"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv63"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv63"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">Let God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be scattered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">let them also that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>before…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from his face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06227">As smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">is driven away</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> drive <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01749">as wax</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">melteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">the fire</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">let the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">But let the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08057">yea, let them exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>exceedingly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rejoice with gladness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">to his name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">extol</w> <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that rideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06160">upon the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">by his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050"><divineName>Jah</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 68:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">A father</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">of the fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01781">and a judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">of the widows</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04583">habitation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03173">the solitary</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in families</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he bringeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">those which are bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03574">with chains</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06707">in a dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in families</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in a house</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou wentest forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when thou didst march</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">through the wilderness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 68:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shook</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also dropped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>: <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">itself</w> <transChange type="added">was moved</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Thou, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">didst send</w> <w lemma="strong:H05071">a plentiful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">rain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">whereby thou didst confirm</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thine inheritance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03811" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">when it was weary</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>send</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shake out</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>confirm</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">confirm it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Thy congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">therein: thou, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hast prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of thy goodness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">for the poor</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0562">the word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of those that published</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>company</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">army</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of armies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H05074" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">apace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05116">and she that tarried</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">at home</w> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>did…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">did flee, did flee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though ye have lien</w> <w lemma="strong:H08240">among the pots</w>, <transChange type="added">yet shall ye be as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03671">the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03123">of a dove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02645" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">with silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H084">and her feathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03422">with yellow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">gold</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07706">When the Almighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> in it, it was <transChange type="added">white</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07949" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">as snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06756">in Salmon</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in it…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for her, she</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01386">an high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hill</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the hill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07520" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Why leap</w> <w lemma="strong:H01386">ye, ye high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hills</w>? <transChange type="added">this is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the hill</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">desireth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell in</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">yea, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will dwell</w> <transChange type="added">in it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07393">The chariots</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07239">twenty thousand</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0505">thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08136">of angels</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> among them, <transChange type="added">as in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05514">Sinai</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <transChange type="added">place</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>even…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">even many thousands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast ascended</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07628">thou hast led captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">captive</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast received</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">for men</w>; yea, <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">also, that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">might dwell</w> <transChange type="added">among them</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for men</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the man</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H06006" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loadeth</w> us <transChange type="added">with benefits</transChange>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of our salvation</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04190">of salvation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03069">and unto <divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w> <transChange type="added">belong</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08444">the issues</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from death</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of his enemies</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08181">the hairy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06936">scalp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">of such an one as goeth on still</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">in his trespasses</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will bring again</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">from Bashan</w>, I will bring <transChange type="added">my people</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">from the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 68:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">That thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may be dipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">in the blood</w> of <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">enemies</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03956">the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03611">of thy dogs</w> in the same.<note type="study"><catchWord>dipped</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">red</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01979">thy goings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01979">the goings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">my King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">went before</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05059" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the players on instruments</w> <transChange type="added">followed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <transChange type="added">them were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05959">the damsels</w> <w lemma="strong:H08608" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">playing with timbrels</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">ye God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04721">in the congregations</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04726">from the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ye that are of the fountain of Israel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:27
verses.text: There <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06810">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">Benjamin</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their ruler</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07277">their council</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02074">of Zebulun</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08269">the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05321">of Naphtali</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and their…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with their company</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Thy God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">thy strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">strengthen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02098">that which</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast wrought</w> for us.

verses.name: Psalms 68:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01964">Because of thy temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">shall kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07862">presents</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 68:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H07070">of spearmen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05712">the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">of the bulls</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05695">with the calves</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <transChange type="added">till every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07511" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">submit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07518">himself with pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0967" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thou the people</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">in war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the company…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the beasts of the reeds</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>scatter…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">he scattereth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02831">Princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03568">Ethiopia</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall soon stretch out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">her hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 68:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">ye kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">O sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto the Lord</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 68:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07392" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">To him that rideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">upon the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heavens</w>, <transChange type="added">which were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lo, he doth send out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>, <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">voice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>send…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Ascribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">ye strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01346">his excellency</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">over Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">and his strength</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07834">in the clouds</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>clouds</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">heavens</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 68:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <transChange type="added">thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">out of thy holy places</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08592">and power</w> unto <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 68." eID="gen593" osisID="Ps.68"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv64"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H07799">upon Shoshannim</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv64"/><w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">for the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> in unto <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">in deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03121">mire</w>, where <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04613">no standing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am come</w> <w lemma="strong:H04615">into deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07641">where the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">overflow</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>deep mire</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the mire of depth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>deep waters</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">depth of waters</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03021" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of my crying</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01627">my throat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is dried</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">while I wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for my God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">me without a cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are more</w> <w lemma="strong:H08185">than the hairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of mine head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">they that would destroy</w> me, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">wrongfully</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are mighty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">then I restored</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I took not away</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">my foolishness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0819">and my sins</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are not hid</w> from thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>sins</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">guiltiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let not them that wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">on thee, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">for my sake: let not those that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thee be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">for my sake, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because for thy sake I have borne</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproach</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03639">shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">my face</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">I am become a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">unto my brethren</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05237">and an alien</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">unto my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07068">For the zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thine house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath eaten me up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02781">and the reproaches</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee are fallen</w> upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When I wept</w>, <transChange type="added">and chastened</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">with fasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">that was to my reproach</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08242">sackcloth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03830">also my garment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04912">and I became a proverb</w> to them.

verses.name: Psalms 69:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that sit in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">speak</w> against me; and I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05058">the song</w> <w lemma="strong:H07941 strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the drunkards</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>drunkards</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">drinkers of strong drink</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08605">But as for me, my prayer</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">an acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">me, in the truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of thy salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02916">me out of the mire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let me not sink</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let me be delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from them that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04615">me, and out of the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07641 strong:H04325">Let not the waterflood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">overflow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">me, neither let the deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">swallow me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0875">and let not the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0332" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shut</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w> upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 69:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">for thy lovingkindness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">unto me according to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">of thy tender mercies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">from thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I am in trouble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">me speedily</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hear…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make haste to hear me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Draw nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto my soul</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">it: deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me because of mine enemies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">my reproach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01322">and my shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03639">and my dishonour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine adversaries</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> all before thee.

verses.name: Psalms 69:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02781">Reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05136" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I am full of heaviness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I looked</w> <transChange type="added">for some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05110" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to take pity</w>, but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">none; and for comforters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I found</w> none.<note type="study"><catchWord>to take…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to lament with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07219">me also gall</w> <w lemma="strong:H01267">for my meat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06772">and in my thirst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02558">they gave me vinegar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07979">Let their table</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">become a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them: and <transChange type="added">that which should have been</transChange> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">welfare</w>, <transChange type="added">let it become</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04170">a trap</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:23
