verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Let their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be darkened</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04975">not; and make their loins</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H04571" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to shake</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">thine indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">upon them, and let thy wrathful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">take hold</w> of them.

verses.name: Psalms 69:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02918">Let their habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">be desolate</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">let none dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in their tents</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>their habitation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their palace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>let none…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">let there not be a dweller</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they persecute</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">whom thou hast smitten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04341">to the grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">of those whom thou hast wounded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>those…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy wounded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Add</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">unto their iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">into thy righteousness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>iniquity unto…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">punishment of iniquity</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Let them be blotted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05612">out of the book</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and not be written</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">with the righteous</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:29
verses.text: But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and sorrowful</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03444">let thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">set me up on high</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">with a song</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and will magnify</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">him with thanksgiving</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:31
verses.text: <transChange type="added">This</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-299">also shall please</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8799" type="x-split-299">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">than an ox</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06499">bullock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07160" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that hath horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06536" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and hoofs</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06035">The humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03824">and your heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>humble</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">meek</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">not his prisoners</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Let the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">him, the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and every thing that moveth</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>moveth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">creepeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 69:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will build</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the cities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that they may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there, and have it in possession</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 69:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">The seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">also of his servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">it: and they that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> therein. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 69." eID="gen594" osisID="Ps.69"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv65"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to bring to remembrance</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv65"/><transChange type="added">Make haste</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me; make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">to help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to help…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to my help</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 70:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">after my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let them be turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">backward</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and put to confusion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02655">that desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">my hurt</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 70:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H06118">for a reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">of their shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">Aha</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01889">aha</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 70:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Let all those that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in thee: and let such as love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">thy salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">Let God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be magnified</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 70:5
verses.text: But I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto me, O God</w>: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05828">my help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and my deliverer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">make no tarrying</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 70." eID="gen595" osisID="Ps.70"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">In thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I put my trust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05769 strong:H0408">let me never</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be put to confusion</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">me in thy righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cause me to escape</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me, and save</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 71:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06697">Be thou my strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04583">habitation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08548">whereunto I may continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">resort</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast given commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> me; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05553">my rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">and my fortress</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Be thou to me for a rock of habitation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 71:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">me, O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03709">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05765" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">of the unrighteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and cruel man</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:5
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">my hope</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04009">my trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">from my youth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">By thee have I been holden up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">from the womb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01491" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou art he that took</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">me out of my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04578">bowels</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08416">my praise</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> of thee.

verses.name: Psalms 71:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04159">I am as a wonder</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">unto many</w>; but thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">my strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04268">refuge</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Let my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be filled</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">thy praise</w> <transChange type="added">and with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08597">thy honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Cast me not off</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02209">of old age</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">me not when my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">faileth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against me; and they that lay wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">take counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>lay…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">watch</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">observe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 71:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath forsaken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">him: persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08610" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take</w> him; for <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">none to deliver</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be not far</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">from me: O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02439 strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8798">make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">for my help</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be confounded</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07853" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that are adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to my soul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them be covered</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">and dishonour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">my hurt</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">But I will hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">and will yet praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thee more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and more</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">My mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">thy righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">thy salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05615">not the numbers</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of thy righteousness</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> of thine only.

verses.name: Psalms 71:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">me from my youth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and hitherto have I declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thy wondrous works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05704">Now also when</w> <w lemma="strong:H02209">I am old</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">and grayheaded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">me not; until I have shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">thy strength</w> unto <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01369">thy power</w> to every one <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is to come</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">unto old age and gray hairs</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>thy strength</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thine arm</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 71:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">Thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">also, O God</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04791">very high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hast done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> like unto thee!

verses.name: Psalms 71:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Thou</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">which hast shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">me great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">and sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">troubles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shalt quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shalt bring me up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">again</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">from the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">my greatness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">me on every side</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will also praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035 strong:H03627" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">thee with the psaltery</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">thy truth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">unto thee will I sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">with the harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06918">O thou Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the psaltery</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the instrument of psaltery</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 71:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">My lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall greatly rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">when I sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto thee; and my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which thou hast redeemed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 71:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">My tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also shall talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">long: for they are confounded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they are brought unto shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">my hurt</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 71." eID="gen596" osisID="Ps.71"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv66"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08010">for Solomon</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv66"/><w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">and thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 72:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">with righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06041">and thy poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">with judgment</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and the little hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">by righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he shall save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the oppressor</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">thee as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">and moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">endure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall come down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">like rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01488">upon the mown</w> <w lemma="strong:H07241">grass: as showers</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02222">water</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">shall the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">flourish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07230">and abundance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">so long as the moon</w> endureth.<note type="study"><catchWord>so long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">till there be no moon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 72:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall have dominion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">also from sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">and from the river</w> <w lemma="strong:H0657">unto the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06728">They that dwell in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him; and his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03897" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall lick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08659">of Tarshish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">and of the isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">presents</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04428">the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w> <w lemma="strong:H05434">and Seba</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall offer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0814">gifts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Yea, all kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall fall down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">before him: all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall serve</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 72:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For he shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">when he crieth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> also, and <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hath no helper</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02347" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the needy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08496">from deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">and violence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">shall their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">be in his sight</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and to him shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of the gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07614">of Sheba</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">prayer also shall be made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">for him continually</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he be praised</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall be given</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">one shall give</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 72:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06451">There shall be an handful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">of corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof shall shake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">like Lebanon</w>: and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall flourish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">like grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">His name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall endure for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05125 strong:H05125" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8735">shall be continued</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">as long as</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w>: and <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">in him: all nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall call him blessed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>endure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his name shall be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall be as a son to continue his father’s name for ever</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 72:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who only doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wondrous things</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">And blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">his glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and let the whole earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be filled</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">his glory</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">and Amen</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 72:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08605">The prayers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03448">of Jesse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">are ended</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 72." eID="gen597" osisID="Ps.72"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv67"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv67"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">Truly God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01249">to such as are of a clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Truly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Yet</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">clean of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">But as for me, my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">were almost</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186 strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">gone</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0838">my steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H0369">had well nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">slipped</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For I was envious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">at the foolish</w>, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">the prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:4
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02784">no bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">in their death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0193">but their strength</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01277">firm</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>firm</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:5
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05999">not in trouble</w> <transChange type="added">as other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">neither are they plagued</w> <w lemma="strong:H05973">like</w> <transChange type="added">other</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the trouble of other men</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>like</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01346">Therefore pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H06059" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">compasseth them about as a chain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">covereth</w> them <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07897">a garment</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Their eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stand out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">with fatness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">than heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04906">could wish</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass the thoughts of the heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04167" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They are corrupt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedly</w> <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06233">oppression</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">loftily</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08371" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They set</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">their mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">against the heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and their tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Therefore his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H01988">hither</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">and waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">of a full</w> <transChange type="added">cup</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04680" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are wrung out</w> to them.

verses.name: Psalms 73:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">How doth God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">know</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03426">and is there</w> <w lemma="strong:H01844">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">in the most High</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 73:12
verses.text: Behold, these <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the ungodly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07961">who prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">in the world</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07685" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they increase</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02428">riches</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Verily I have cleansed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">my heart</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07385">vain</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and washed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05356">in innocency</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For all the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">long have I been plagued</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08433">and chastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">every morning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chastened</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my chastisement was</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If I say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03644">thus</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">behold, I should offend</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of thy children</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">When I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> this, it <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05999">too painful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">for me</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>too…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">labour in mine eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Until I went</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into the sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>; <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">I their end</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Surely thou didst set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02513">them in slippery places</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou castedst them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04876">into destruction</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:19
verses.text: How are they <transChange type="added">brought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08047">into desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07281">as in a moment</w>! <w lemma="strong:H05486" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01091">with terrors</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02472">As a dream</w> when <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">awaketh</w>; <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782">when thou awakest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06754">their image</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03824">Thus my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02556" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">was grieved</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and I was pricked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">in my reins</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01198">So foolish</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I, and ignorant</w>: I was <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0929">a beast</w> before thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>ignorant</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I knew not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>before</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:23
verses.text: Nevertheless I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">with thee: thou hast holden</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">by my right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou shalt guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">me with thy counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and afterward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">receive</w> me <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 73:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Whom have I in heaven</w> <transChange type="added">but thee</transChange>? and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">none upon earth</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I desire</w> beside thee.

verses.name: Psalms 73:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07607">My flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">and my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of my heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">and my portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strength</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rock</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 73:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07369">For, lo, they that are far</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from thee shall perish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all them that go a whoring</w> from thee.

verses.name: Psalms 73:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0589">But</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07132">for me to draw near</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have put</w> <w lemma="strong:H04268">my trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">in the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069"><divineName>God</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">that I may declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">all thy works</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 73." eID="gen598" osisID="Ps.73"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv68"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv68"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, why hast thou cast <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>? <transChange type="added">why</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0639">doth thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06225" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">against the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04830">of thy pasture</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 74:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">thy congregation</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast purchased</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07626">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of thine inheritance</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast redeemed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02022">this mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">wherein thou hast dwelt</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rod</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">tribe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 74:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">thy feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">unto the perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H04876">desolations</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> all <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath done wickedly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">of thy congregations</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">their ensigns</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0226">signs</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">A man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">according as he had lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07134">axes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05442">upon the thick</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But now they break down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06603">the carved work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">thereof at once</w> <w lemma="strong:H03781">with axes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03597">and hammers</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They have cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">into thy sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they have defiled</w> <transChange type="added">by casting down</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the dwelling place</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>They have cast…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">They have sent thy sanctuary unto the fire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 74:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in their hearts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">them together</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have burned up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">all the synagogues</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">break</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 74:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We see</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">not our signs</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05030">no more any prophet</w>: neither <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among us any that knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">how long</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06862">how long shall the adversary</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">reproach</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">blaspheme</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 74:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Why withdrawest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thou thy hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">even thy right hand</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">pluck</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436 strong:H02436" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">thy bosom</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">my King</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">working</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8782">Thou didst divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">by thy strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou brakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">of the dragons</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>divide</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">break</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>dragons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whales</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 74:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07533" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou brakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H03882">of leviathan</w> in pieces, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gavest</w> him <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03978">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">to the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06728">inhabiting the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou didst cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">the fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">and the flood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou driedst up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0386">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">rivers</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>mighty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rivers of strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 74:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">The day</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">thine, the night</w> also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thine: thou hast prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03974">the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">and the sun</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01367">all the borders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">summer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02779">and winter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 74:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> this, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath reproached</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05036">the foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have blasphemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08449">of thy turtledove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">unto the multitude</w> <transChange type="added">of the wicked</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">not the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of thy poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">unto the covenant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04285">for the dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">places of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04999">of the habitations</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of cruelty</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01790">O let not the oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">return</w> <w lemma="strong:H03637" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06041">let the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">thine own cause</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">how the foolish man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">thee daily</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 74:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07588">the tumult</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of those that rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against thee increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>increaseth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">ascendeth</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 74." eID="gen599" osisID="Ps.74"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv69"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0516" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Al–taschith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv69"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">Unto thee, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">do we give thanks</w>, <transChange type="added">unto thee</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">do we give thanks</w>: for <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">is near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thy wondrous works</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">declare</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Al–taschith</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Destroy not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 75:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When I shall receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">uprightly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>receive…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">take a set time</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 75:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thereof are dissolved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I bear up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">the pillars</w> of it. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 75:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto the fools</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Deal not foolishly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">and to the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Lift not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horn</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 75:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Lift not up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">your horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speak</w> <transChange type="added">not with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06277">a stiff</w> <w lemma="strong:H06677">neck</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 75:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022 strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8676 strongMorph:TH8687">For promotion</w> <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04161">neither from the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04628">nor from the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">nor from the south</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>south</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">desert</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 75:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">But God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the judge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he putteth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">one, and setteth up</w> another.

verses.name: Psalms 75:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">For in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03563">a cup</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03196">and the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02560" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is red</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04392">it is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H04538">of mixture</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he poureth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">of the same</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08105">but the dregs</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">thereof, all the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> shall wring <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04680" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">out</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drink</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 75:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">But I will declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">to the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 75:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07161">All the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also will I cut off</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8783">shall be exalted</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 75." eID="gen600" osisID="Ps.75"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv70"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">on Neginoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv70"/><w lemma="strong:H03063">In Judah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">known</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>chief…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">overseer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 76:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08004">In Salem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05520">also is his tabernacle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04585">and his dwelling place</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 76:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">There brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07565">he the arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">of the bow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04043">the shield</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02719">and the sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04421">and the battle</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 76:4
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">more glorious</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0117">excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">than the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">of prey</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 76:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820 strong:H047">The stouthearted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07997" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">are spoiled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05123" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have slept</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">their sleep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0582">and none of the men</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of might</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 76:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01606">At thy rebuke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07393">both the chariot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">and horse</w> <w lemma="strong:H07290" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">are cast into a dead sleep</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 76:7
verses.text: Thou, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> thou, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to be feared</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and who may stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in thy sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0227">when</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">once thou art angry</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 76:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01779">Thou didst cause judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to be heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feared</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and was still</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 76:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">When God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">arose</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">to judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035">all the meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 76:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">Surely the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07611">thee: the remainder</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">of wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou restrain</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 76:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Vow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and pay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">your God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05439">let all that be round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H07862">presents</w> <w lemma="strong:H04172">unto him that ought to be feared</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto him…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to fear</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 76:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01219" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">of princes</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 76." eID="gen601" osisID="Ps.76"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv71"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03038">to Jeduthun</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv71"/><w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with my voice</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with my voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and he gave ear</w> unto me.<note type="study"><catchWord>of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 77:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of my trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">my sore</w> <w lemma="strong:H05064" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06313" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ceased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not: my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">to be comforted</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 77:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was troubled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I complained</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">was overwhelmed</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou holdest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08109">waking</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06470" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am so troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I cannot speak</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have considered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of ancient times</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I call to remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05058">my song</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I commune</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">with mine own heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">and my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">made diligent search</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Will the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he be favourable</w> no more?

verses.name: Psalms 77:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Is his mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0656" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">clean gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>? doth <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0562">promise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755 strong:H01755">for evermore</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>for evermore</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 77:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">Hath God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02589" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to be gracious</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0639">hath he in anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07092" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shut up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">his tender mercies</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And I said</w>, This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">my infirmity</w>: <transChange type="added">but I will remember</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">of the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142 strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">I will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">surely I will remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">thy wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">also of all thy work</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">of thy doings</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Thy way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the sanctuary</w>: who <transChange type="added">is so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a God</w> as <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 77:14
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that doest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">wonders</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">thy strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:15
verses.text: Thou hast with <transChange type="added">thine</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">and Joseph</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">The waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thee, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; they were afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08415">the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also were troubled</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05645">The clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H02229" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07834">the skies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">a sound</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02687">thine arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">also went abroad</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>poured…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">were poured forth with water</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 77:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07482">of thy thunder</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01534">in the heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01300">the lightnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">lightened</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trembled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shook</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Thy way</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07635">and thy path</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06119">and thy footsteps</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are not known</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 77:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou leddest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">like a flock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 77." eID="gen602" osisID="Ps.77"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv72"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv72"/><w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">O my people</w>, <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my law</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">your ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">to the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will open</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">in a parable</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02420">dark sayings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Which we have heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and known</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01">and our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have told</w> us.

verses.name: Psalms 78:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">We will not hide</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">from their children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">shewing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">the praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05807">and his strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and his wonderful works</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath done</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For he established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">a testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">in Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">a law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">in Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">which he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that they should make them known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to their children</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01755">That the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">to come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">might know</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">should be born</w>; <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and declare</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to their children</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they might set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03689">their hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">in God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">his commandments</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">And might not be as their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a stubborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and rebellious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01755">a generation</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-300">set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-300">aright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07307">and whose spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not stedfast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">with God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that prepared not their heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">armed</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07411" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">carrying</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">of battle</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>carrying</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">throwing forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">not the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in his law</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 78:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And forgat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">his works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and his wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">that he had shewed</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 78:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06382">Marvellous things</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">he in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of their fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06814">of Zoan</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and caused them to pass through</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04325">and he made the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05067">as an heap</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03119">In the daytime</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also he led</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">them with a cloud</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and all the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">with a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">of fire</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He clave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, and gave <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">drink</w> as <transChange type="added">out of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">depths</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">also out of the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and caused waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to run down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">like rivers</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:17
