verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And they sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet more</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against him by provoking</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">in the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">And they tempted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by asking</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for their lust</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Yea, they spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">against God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Can</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">furnish</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">a table</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>furnish</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">order</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Behold, he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gushed out</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">and the streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">overflowed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">he give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also? can</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he provide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">for his people</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 78:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Therefore the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and was wroth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0784">so a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H05400" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">against Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">and anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also came up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">against Israel</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 78:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Because they believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">not in God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and trusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">not in his salvation</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Though he had commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">from above</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the doors</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 78:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And had rained down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04478">manna</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">upon them to eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and had given</w> <w lemma="strong:H01715">them of the corn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H047">angels’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06720">them meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07648">to the full</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Man…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Every one did eat the bread of the mighty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06921">He caused an east wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to blow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05797">and by his power</w> <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he brought in</w> <w lemma="strong:H08486">the south wind</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to blow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to go</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04305" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He rained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">also upon them as dust</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and feathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">like as the sand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>feathered…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fowl of wing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:28
verses.text: And he let <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">of their camp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">their habitations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So they did eat</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and were well</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">filled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">them their own desire</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 78:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They were not estranged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">from their lust</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0400">But while their meat</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">yet in their mouths</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 78:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">The wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">came</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon them, and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H04924">the fattest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">of them, and smote down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">the chosen</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>smote…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">made to bow</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>chosen…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">young men</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For all this they sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">still, and believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">not for his wondrous works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Therefore their days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">did he consume</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">in vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and their years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0928">in trouble</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When he slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">them, then they sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him: and they returned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and enquired early</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">after God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">that God</w> <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">their rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">and the high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their redeemer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Nevertheless they did flatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">him with their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and they lied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">unto him with their tongues</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">For their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">was not right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">with him, neither were they stedfast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">in his covenant</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:38
verses.text: But he, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07349">full of compassion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">forgave</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and destroyed</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">not: yea, many a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-301">turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">he his anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687" type="x-split-301">away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and did not stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">all his wrath</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he remembered</w> that they <transChange type="added">were but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01320">flesh</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07307">a wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that passeth away</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and cometh not again</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04100">How</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">oft did they provoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">him in the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06087" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">grieve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">him in the desert</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>provoke</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">rebel against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, they turned back</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and tempted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08428" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and limited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">not his hand</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">them from the enemy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">from affliction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How he had wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">his signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04159">and his wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">in the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H06814">of Zoan</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>wrought</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And had turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H02975">their rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">into blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and their floods</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they could not drink</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">divers sorts of flies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">among them, which devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">them; and frogs</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which destroyed</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 78:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">also their increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H02625">unto the caterpiller</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03018">and their labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">unto the locust</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">their vines</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">with hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08256">and their sycomore trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H02602">with frost</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">killed</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>frost</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">great hailstones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He gave up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01165">their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">also to the hail</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04735">and their flocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H07565">to hot thunderbolts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>gave…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shut up</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>hot…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lightnings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02740">upon them the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05678">wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02195">and indignation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06869">and trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04917">by sending</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">angels</w> <transChange type="added">among them</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06424" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to his anger</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he spared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-302">but gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">their life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-302">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">to the pestilence</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>He made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He weighed a path</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>life…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">beasts to the murrain</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07225">the chief</w> of <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0202">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">But made his own people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">like sheep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and guided</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05739">like a flock</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he led</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">them on safely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that they feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">not: but the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">overwhelmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overwhelmed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">covered</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">them to the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of his sanctuary</w>, <transChange type="added">even to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">this mountain</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had purchased</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">also before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them, and divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">them an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">by line</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">and made the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in their tents</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Yet they tempted</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">not his testimonies</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:57
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">But turned back</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and dealt unfaithfully</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">like their fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">they were turned aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H07423">like a deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07198">bow</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">For they provoked him to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01116">with their high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and moved him to jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06456">with their graven images</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">When God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w> <transChange type="added">this</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">he was wroth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So that he forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07887">of Shiloh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tent</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he placed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">among men</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 78:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">his strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07628">into captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08597">and his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">into the enemy’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-303">He gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-303">over</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">also unto the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">and was wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">with his inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:63
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">The fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">their young men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01330">and their maidens</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were not given to marriage</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>given…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">praised</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Their priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fell</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">by the sword</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0490">and their widows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">made no lamentation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:65
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Then the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03364" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">awaked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03463">as one out of sleep</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">like a mighty man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">that shouteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">by reason of wine</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:66
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">in the hinder parts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he put</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">them to a perpetual</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproach</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:67
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">of Joseph</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">not the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">of Ephraim</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:68
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he loved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 78:69
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he built</w> <w lemma="strong:H04720">his sanctuary</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like high</w> <transChange type="added">palaces</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">like the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>established</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">founded</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:70
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He chose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">also his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and took</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H04356">him from the sheepfolds</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 78:71
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0310">From following</w> <w lemma="strong:H05763" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the ewes great with young</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">him to feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his inheritance</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>following</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">after</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 78:72
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">So he fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">them according to the integrity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of his heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and guided</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">them by the skilfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of his hands</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 78." eID="gen603" osisID="Ps.78"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv73"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv73"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are come</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">into thine inheritance</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06944">thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w> <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have they defiled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H05856">on heaps</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 79:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05038">The dead bodies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they given</w> <transChange type="added">to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03978">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H05775">unto the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">the flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">of thy saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">unto the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 79:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01818">Their blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like water</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>; and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06912" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to bury</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 79:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02781">We are become a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">to our neighbours</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03933">a scorn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07047">and derision</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">to them that are round about</w> us.

verses.name: Psalms 79:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">How long, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">for ever</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07068">shall thy jealousy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like fire</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 79:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">thy wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">upon the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04467">thee, and upon the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that have not called</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 79:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they have devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and laid waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">his dwelling place</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 79:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">not against us former</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquities</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07356">let thy tender mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">speedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">prevent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-304">us: for we are brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-304">low</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>former…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the iniquities of them that were before us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 79:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">us, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of our salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">of thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">us, and purge away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">our sins</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name’s</w> sake.

verses.name: Psalms 79:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">Wherefore should the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>, Where <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">their God</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">let him be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in our sight</w> <transChange type="added">by</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05360">the revenging</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">of the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w> <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>revenging</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">vengeance</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 79:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0603">Let the sighing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">of the prisoner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">thee; according to the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">of thy power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thou those that are appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08546">to die</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thine arm</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>preserve…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">reserve the children of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 79:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">And render</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">unto our neighbours</w> <w lemma="strong:H07659">sevenfold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into their bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">their reproach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">wherewith they have reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">thee, O Lord</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 79:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">So we thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">and sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04830">of thy pasture</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will give thee thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">we will shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">thy praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 79." eID="gen604" osisID="Ps.79"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv74"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H07802">upon Shoshannim–Eduth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv74"/><w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O Shepherd</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05090" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou that leadest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">like a flock</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou that dwellest</w> <transChange type="added">between</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">shine forth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 80:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0669">Ephraim</w> <w lemma="strong:H01144">and Benjamin</w> <w lemma="strong:H04519">and Manasseh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">thy strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03444">save</w> us.<note type="study"><catchWord>come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">come for salvation to us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 80:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn us again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and cause thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to shine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and we shall be saved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 80:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06225" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how long wilt thou be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">against the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">smoke</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 80:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou feedest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them with the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">of tears</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01832">and givest them tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H07991">in great measure</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 80:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou makest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">us a strife</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">unto our neighbours</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and our enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">laugh</w> among themselves.

verses.name: Psalms 80:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn us again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and cause thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to shine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and we shall be saved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 80:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05265" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">a vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">out of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01644" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou hast cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and planted</w> it.

verses.name: Psalms 80:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou preparedst</w> <transChange type="added">room</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H08328">it, and didst cause it to take deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">root</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and it filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 80:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">with the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06057">of it, and the boughs</w> thereof <transChange type="added">were like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">the goodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">cedars</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>goodly…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cedars of God</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 80:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">She sent out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">her boughs</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">unto the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03127">and her branches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">unto the river</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 80:12
verses.text: Why hast thou <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">broken down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01447">her hedges</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">so that all they which pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0717" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do pluck</w> her?

verses.name: Psalms 80:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02386">The boar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">out of the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H03765" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">doth waste</w> <w lemma="strong:H02123">it, and the wild beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doth devour</w> it.

verses.name: Psalms 80:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">we beseech thee, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">look down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">this vine</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 80:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03661 strong:H03657" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And the vineyard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">which thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath planted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">and the branch</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou madest strong</w> for thyself.

verses.name: Psalms 80:16
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">with fire</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03683" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cut down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they perish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">at the rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thy countenance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 80:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Let thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">be upon the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">of thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou madest strong</w> for thyself.

verses.name: Psalms 80:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So will not we go back</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">from thee: quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us, and we will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 80:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn us again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">cause thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to shine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and we shall be saved</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 80." eID="gen605" osisID="Ps.80"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv75"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H01665">upon Gittith</w>, <transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv75"/><w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Sing aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">our strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make a joyful noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of Asaph</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for Asaph</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 81:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H02172">a psalm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">hither the timbrel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05273">the pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">harp</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">with the psaltery</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 81:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Blow up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">the trumpet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02320">in the new moon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03677">in the time appointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02282">on our solemn feast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 81:4
verses.text: For this <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02706">a statute</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">for Israel</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">a law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 81:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">This he ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H03084">in Joseph</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05715">a testimony</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">through the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <transChange type="added">where</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">a language</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I understood</w> not.<note type="study"><catchWord>through</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">against</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 81:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07926">his shoulder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05447">from the burden</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03709">his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">were delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01731">from the pots</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>were…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">passed away</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 81:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou calledst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">in trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee; I answered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">thee in the secret place</w> <w lemma="strong:H07482">of thunder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I proved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">thee at the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04809">of Meribah</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Meribah</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Strife</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 81:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">O my people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will testify</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto thee: O Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou wilt hearken</w> unto me;

verses.name: Psalms 81:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">There shall no strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">god</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">be in thee; neither shalt thou worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">any strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">god</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 81:10
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">which brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thee out of the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">open thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">wide</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will fill</w> it.

verses.name: Psalms 81:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">But my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would not hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to my voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03478">and Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">would</w> none of me.

verses.name: Psalms 81:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">So I gave them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto their own hearts’</w> <w lemma="strong:H08307">lust</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04156">in their own counsels</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to the hardness of their hearts</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">imagination</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 81:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03863">Oh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">that my people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">had hearkened</w> unto me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">had walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in my ways</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 81:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">I should soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have subdued</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">their enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">against their adversaries</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 81:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">The haters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">should have submitted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">themselves unto him: but their time</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">should have endured for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>submitted…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">yielded feigned obedience</rdg>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lied</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 81:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He should have fed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">them also with the finest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of the wheat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01706">and with honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">out of the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">should I have satisfied</w> thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>finest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat of wheat</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 81." eID="gen606" osisID="Ps.81"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv76"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv76"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of the mighty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he judgeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">the gods</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of Asaph</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for Asaph</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 82:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How long will ye judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">unjustly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the persons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 82:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Defend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">and fatherless</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">do justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">to the afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and needy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Defend</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Judge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 82:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">rid</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 82:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not, neither will they understand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">they walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H02825">on in darkness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04144">all the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">are out of course</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>out…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">moved</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 82:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have said</w>, Ye <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>; and all of you <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 82:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0403">But</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">like men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">like one</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">of the princes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 82:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">all nations</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 82." eID="gen607" osisID="Ps.82"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv77"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04210">Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0623">of Asaph</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv77"/><w lemma="strong:H01824">Keep not thou silence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hold not thy peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be not still</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">O God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of Asaph</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for Asaph</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 83:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For, lo, thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make a tumult</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and they that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee have lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They have taken crafty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">against thy hidden ones</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let us cut them off</w> from <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08034">that the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be no more in remembrance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">For they have consulted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with one consent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">confederate</w> against thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>consent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 83:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0168">The tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03459">and the Ishmaelites</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04124">of Moab</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01905">and the Hagarenes</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 83:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01381">Gebal</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05983">and Ammon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06002">and Amalek</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06429">the Philistines</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the inhabitants</w> <w lemma="strong:H06865">of Tyre</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 83:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0804">Assur</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">also is joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">with them: they have holpen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03876">of Lot</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holpen</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">been an arm to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 83:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Do</w> unto them as <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04080">the Midianites</w>; as <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05516">Sisera</w>, as <transChange type="added">to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02985">Jabin</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05158">at the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H07028">of Kison</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 83:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05874">at En–dor</w>: they became <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01828">dung</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">for the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Make</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">their nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06159">like Oreb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02062">and like Zeeb</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05257">yea, all their princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02078">as Zebah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06759">and as Zalmunna</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 83:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04999">Let us take to ourselves the houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in possession</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H01534">them like a wheel</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07179">as the stubble</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">As the fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">a wood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03852">and as the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-305">setteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-305">on fire</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 83:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">them with thy tempest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and make them afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">with thy storm</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">their faces</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">with shame</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that they may seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 83:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and troubled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, let them be put to shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and perish</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 83:18
verses.text: That <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">that thou, whose name</w> alone <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Jehovah</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the most high</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">over all the earth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 83." eID="gen608" osisID="Ps.83"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv78"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H01665">upon Gittith</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv78"/><w lemma="strong:H03039">How amiable</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04908">thy tabernacles</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>for the sons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 84:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03700" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">longeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, even fainteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">for the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">and my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">crieth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">for the living</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 84:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06833">Yea, the sparrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">an house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01866">and the swallow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07064">a nest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for herself, where she may lay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0667">her young</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04196">thine altars</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">my King</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">and my God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 84:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in thy house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they will be still praising</w> thee. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 84:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">whose strength</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thee; in whose heart</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04546">the ways</w> <transChange type="added">of them</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 84:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">through the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H01057 strong:H01056" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">of Baca</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">it a well</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04175">the rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also filleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">the pools</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Baca…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">mulberry trees make him a well</rdg>, etc</note><note type="study"><catchWord>filleth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">covereth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 84:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">from strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">to strength</w>, <transChange type="added">every one of them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appeareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">before God</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strength to…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">company to company</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 84:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 84:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Behold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">our shield</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and look</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">of thine anointed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 84:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in thy courts</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">than a thousand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I had rather</w> <w lemma="strong:H05605" morph="strongMorph:TH8705">be a doorkeeper</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01752" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">than to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">of wickedness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I had…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I would choose rather to sit at the threshold</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 84:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08121">a sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and shield</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will he withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from them that walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">uprightly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 84:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0835">blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that trusteth</w> in thee. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 84." eID="gen609" osisID="Ps.84"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv79"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv79"/><w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast been favourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">unto thy land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast brought back</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for the sons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the sons</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>favourable</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">well pleased</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 85:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast forgiven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">all their sin</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast taken away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">all thy wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast turned</w> <transChange type="added">thyself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02740">from the fierceness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thine anger</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thyself…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thine anger from waxing hot</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 85:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">us, O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of our salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03708">and cause thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">toward us to cease</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0599" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou be angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">with us for ever</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wilt thou draw out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">thine anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 85:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Wilt thou not revive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">us again</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">that thy people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may rejoice</w> in thee?

verses.name: Psalms 85:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">us thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">us thy salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">what God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will speak</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for he will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02623">and to his saints</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but let them not turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03690">to folly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03468">Surely his salvation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">him; that glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in our land</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are met together</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">and peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have kissed</w> <transChange type="added">each other</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0571">Truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall spring out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06664">and righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall look down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Yea, the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall give</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">and our land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H02981">her increase</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 85:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">Righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him; and shall set</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">of his steps</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 85." eID="gen610" osisID="Ps.85"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv80"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H08605">A Prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv80"/><w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bow down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> me: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A Prayer…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Prayer, being a Psalm of David</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 86:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>; for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02623">holy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O thou my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that trusteth</w> in thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">one whom thou favourest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 86:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">unto me, O Lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto thee daily</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>daily</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all the day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 86:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0136">for unto thee, O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do I lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">For thou, Lord</w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05546">and ready to forgive</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">and plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto all them that call</w> upon thee.

verses.name: Psalms 86:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08605">unto my prayer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">of my supplications</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of my trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon thee: for thou wilt answer</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 86:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Among the gods</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">none like unto thee, O Lord</w>; neither <transChange type="added">are there any works</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">like unto thy works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">All nations</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">thee, O Lord</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall glorify</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:10
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and doest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wondrous things</w>: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> alone.

verses.name: Psalms 86:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">me thy way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">in thy truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03161" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">thee, O Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03824">with all my heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will glorify</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for evermore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">For great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">toward me: and thou hast delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">from the lowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">hell</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hell</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">grave</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 86:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02086">the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are risen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">against me, and the assemblies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06184">of violent</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">after my soul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and have not set</w> thee before them.<note type="study"><catchWord>violent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">terrible</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 86:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">But thou, O Lord</w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07349">full of compassion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02587">and gracious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639 strong:H0750">longsuffering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto me, and have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">upon me; give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">thy strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0519">of thine handmaid</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 86:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">me a token</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that they which hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me may see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be ashamed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">because thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast holpen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">me, and comforted</w> me. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 86." eID="gen611" osisID="Ps.86"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv81"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv81"/><w lemma="strong:H03248">His foundation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in the holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">mountains</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for the sons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 87:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">more than all the dwellings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 87:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Glorious things</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">are spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">of thee, O city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 87:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will make mention</w> <w lemma="strong:H07294">of Rahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">and Babylon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H06429">me: behold Philistia</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06865">and Tyre</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03568">with Ethiopia</w>; this <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was born</w> there.

verses.name: Psalms 87:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">And of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it shall be said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">This and that man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was born</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">in her: and the highest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">himself shall establish</w> her.

verses.name: Psalms 87:6
