verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall count</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he writeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> this <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">was born</w> there. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 87:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">As well the singers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as the players</w> on instruments <transChange type="added">shall be there</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H04599">all my springs</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> in thee. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 87." eID="gen612" osisID="Ps.87"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv82"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04210">Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">for the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H07141">of Korah</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to the chief Musician</w> <w lemma="strong:H04257">upon Mahalath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">Leannoth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01968">of Heman</w> <w lemma="strong:H0250">the Ezrahite</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv82"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of my salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w> before thee:<note type="study"><catchWord>for the sons</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the sons</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Psalm of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 88:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08605">Let my prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thee: incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">unto my cry</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 88:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">For my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of troubles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">and my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">draweth nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">unto the grave</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 88:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01397">I am as a man</w> <transChange type="added">that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0353">no strength</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 88:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02670">Free</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">among the dead</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">like the slain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">in the grave</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom thou rememberest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">no more: and they are cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from thy hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">by</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 88:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">me in the lowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">pit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04285">in darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04688">in the deeps</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 88:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">Thy wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lieth hard</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon me, and thou hast afflicted</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04867">with all thy waves</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 88:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-306">Thou hast put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">mine acquaintance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689" type="x-split-306">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">from me; thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">me an abomination</w> unto them: <transChange type="added">I am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">shut up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I cannot come forth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 88:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H01669" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">mourneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">by reason of affliction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07849" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon thee, I have stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">my hands</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 88:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Wilt thou shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">to the dead</w>? <w lemma="strong:H07496">shall the dead</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">arise</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> thee? <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 88:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Shall thy lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06913">in the grave</w>? <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H011">in destruction</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 88:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06382">Shall thy wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be known</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in the dark</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06666">and thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05388">of forgetfulness</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 88:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But unto thee have I cried</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01242">and in the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">shall my prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">prevent</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 88:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">why castest thou off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>? <transChange type="added">why</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hidest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thou thy face</w> from me?

verses.name: Psalms 88:15
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and ready to die</w> from <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05290">youth</w> up: <transChange type="added">while</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0367">thy terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I am distracted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 88:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02740">Thy fierce wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">goeth over</w> <w lemma="strong:H01161">me; thy terrors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">have cut me off</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 88:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They came round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05362" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">me about together</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>daily</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all the day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 88:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Lover</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">and friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hast thou put far</w> from me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">mine acquaintance</w> <w lemma="strong:H04285">into darkness</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 88." eID="gen613" osisID="Ps.88"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv83"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0387">of Ethan</w> <w lemma="strong:H0250">the Ezrahite</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv83"/><w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of the mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">with my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Psalm for Ethan the Ezrahite, to give instruction</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">Mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be built up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0530">thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the very heavens</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">a covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0972">with my chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I have sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 89:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">Thy seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and build up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">thy throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">And the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06382">thy wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0530">thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">also in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the saints</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07834">For who in the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can be compared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">can be likened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>?

verses.name: Psalms 89:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">is greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06206" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to be feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">in the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the saints</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and to be had in reverence</w> of all <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">about</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">of hosts</w>, who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02626">a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> thee?

verses.name: Psalms 89:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou rulest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01348">the raging</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01530">when the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H07721" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thereof arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou stillest</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 89:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-307">Thou hast broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07294">Rahab</w> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-307">in pieces</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02491">as one that is slain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">with thy strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Rahab</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Egypt</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the arm of thy strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">The heavens</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">thine, the earth</w> also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> thine: <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H04393">and the fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thereof, thou hast founded</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>the fulness…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all it containeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06828">The north</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">and the south</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast created</w> <w lemma="strong:H08396">them: Tabor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">and Hermon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01369">Thou hast a mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">is thy hand</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">is thy right hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an arm with might</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">Justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04349">the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of thy throne</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall go</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before thy face</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>habitation</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">establishment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">the joyful sound</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall walk</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">in the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thy countenance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">In thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06666">and in thy righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall they be exalted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:17
verses.text: For thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08597">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of their strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07522">and in thy favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">our horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311 strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">shall be exalted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">our defence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06918">and the Holy One</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">our king</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord</divineName>…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">our shield is of the <divineName>Lord</divineName>, and our king is of the Holy One of Israel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Then thou spakest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02377">in vision</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">to thy holy one</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and saidst</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">help</w> upon <transChange type="added">one that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01368">mighty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have exalted</w> <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">out of the people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">my servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06944">with my holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04886" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I anointed</w> him:

verses.name: Psalms 89:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">With whom my hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be established</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02220">mine arm</w> <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">also shall strengthen</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05378" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not exact</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">upon him; nor the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">of wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">afflict</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03807" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And I will beat down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">his foes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before his face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them that hate</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0530">But my faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and my mercy</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">with him: and in my name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">shall his horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be exalted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">also in the sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and his right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">in the rivers</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall cry</w> unto me, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">my father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06697">and the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of my salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Also I will make</w> him <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01060">firstborn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">higher</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">than the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">My mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for him for evermore</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01285">and my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">shall stand fast</w> with him.

verses.name: Psalms 89:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">His seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also will I make</w> <transChange type="added">to endure</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">and his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">as the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">If his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">my law</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not in my judgments</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 89:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">If they break</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">my statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">not my commandments</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>break</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">profane</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Then will I visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">their transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">with the rod</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">and their iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">with stripes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Nevertheless my lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06331" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I not utterly take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">from him, nor suffer my faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08266" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">to fail</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>will…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">I will not make void from him</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to fail</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01285">My covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I not break</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">nor alter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161">the thing that is gone out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of my lips</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0259">Once</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">have I sworn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">by my holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that I will not lie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">if I lie</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">His seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall endure for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">and his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">as the sun</w> before me.

verses.name: Psalms 89:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">It shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">as the moon</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">in heaven</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But thou hast cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and abhorred</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">thou hast been wroth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">with thine anointed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05010" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast made void</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast profaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H05145">his crown</w> <transChange type="added">by casting it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast broken down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01448">all his hedges</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">his strong holds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04288">to ruin</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">All that pass by</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08155" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">him: he is a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07934">to his neighbours</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou hast set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of his adversaries</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thou hast made all his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to rejoice</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou hast also turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the edge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of his sword</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and hast not made him to stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">in the battle</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02892">Thou hast made his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04048" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-308">and cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H04048" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-308">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>glory</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">brightness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 89:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">The days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05934">of his youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hast thou shortened</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou hast covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0955">him with shame</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">How long, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">wilt thou hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">thyself for ever</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02534">shall thy wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">burn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">like fire</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 89:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H02465">how short</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">my time is: wherefore hast thou made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120 strong:H01121">all men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 89:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">What man</w> <transChange type="added">is he that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">liveth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall not see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w>? <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall he deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of the grave</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:49
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, where <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">thy former</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">lovingkindnesses</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou swarest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">in thy truth</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 89:50
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02781">the reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w>; <transChange type="added">how</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">I do bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in my bosom</w> <transChange type="added">the reproach of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">all the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 89:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Wherewith thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have reproached</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">wherewith they have reproached</w> <w lemma="strong:H06119">the footsteps</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">of thine anointed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 89:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for evermore</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">and Amen</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 89." eID="gen614" osisID="Ps.89"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv84"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H08605">A Prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">of Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv84"/><w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04583">thou hast been our dwelling place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A Prayer…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Prayer, being a Psalm of Moses</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 90:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Before the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were brought forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">or ever thou hadst formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">and the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">even from everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou turnest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01793">to destruction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and sayest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0505">For a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thy sight</w> <transChange type="added">are but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">as</w> <w lemma="strong:H0865">yesterday</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when it is past</w>, and <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0821">a watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>when…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">when he hath passed them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 90:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02229" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou carriest them away as with a flood</w>; they are <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08142">a sleep</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w> <transChange type="added">they are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">like grass</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">groweth up</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>groweth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">is changed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 90:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">In the morning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it flourisheth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and groweth up</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06153">in the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H04135" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">it is cut down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and withereth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For we are consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">by thine anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02534">and by thy wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are we troubled</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">our iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05956" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">before thee, our secret</w> <transChange type="added">sins</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03974">in the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of thy countenance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For all our days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are passed away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">in thy wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we spend</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">our years</w> <w lemma="strong:H01899">as a tale</w> <transChange type="added">that is told</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>passed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">turned away</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>as a…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">as a meditation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 90:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">The days</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">of our years</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07657" type="x-split-309">threescore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07657" type="x-split-309">and ten</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01369">and if by reason of strength</w> <transChange type="added">they be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08084">fourscore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w>, yet <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07296">their strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">and sorrow</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02440">for it is soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01468" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cut off</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and we fly away</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The days…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">As for the days of our years, in them are seventy years</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 90:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of thine anger</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03374">even according to thy fear</w>, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05678">thy wrath</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">So teach</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">our days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that we may apply</w> <transChange type="added">our</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">unto wisdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>apply</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cause to come</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 90:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Return</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">how long? and let it repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thee concerning thy servants</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">O satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">us early</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">with thy mercy</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that we may rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all our days</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Make us glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">according to the days</w> <transChange type="added">wherein</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast afflicted</w> us, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the years</w> <transChange type="added">wherein</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06467">Let thy work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servants</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01926">and thy glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto their children</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 90:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05278">And let the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">be upon us: and establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thou the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">upon us; yea, the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of our hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">establish</w> thou it. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 90." eID="gen615" osisID="Ps.90"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in the secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">place of the most High</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">under the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07706">of the Almighty</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abide</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lodge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 91:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will say</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">He is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">my refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04686">and my fortress</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">in him will I trust</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Surely he shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">thee from the snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03353">of the fowler</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01942">from the noisome</w> <w lemma="strong:H01698">pestilence</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H084">thee with his feathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and under his wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou trust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0571">his truth</w> <transChange type="added">shall be thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06793">shield</w> <w lemma="strong:H05507">and buckler</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt not be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">for the terror</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>; <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02671">for the arrow</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05774" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">flieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">by day</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 91:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01698">for the pestilence</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0652">in darkness</w>; <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06986">for the destruction</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07736" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06672">at noonday</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0505">A thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H06654">at thy side</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07233">and ten thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">at thy right hand</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05066" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall not come nigh</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 91:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Only with thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and see</w> <w lemma="strong:H08011">the reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">my refuge</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05945">the most High</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04583">thy habitation</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 91:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">There shall no evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0579" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">befall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05061">thee, neither shall any plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">thy dwelling</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04397">For he shall give his angels</w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">charge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">over thee, to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee in all thy ways</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall bear thee up</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest thou dash</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">against a stone</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt tread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07826">upon the lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H06620">and adder</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03715">the young lion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08577">and the dragon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07429" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt thou trample under feet</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>adder</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">asp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 91:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02836" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because he hath set his love</w> <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">upon me, therefore will I deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him: I will set him on high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because he hath known</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">my name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 91:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon me, and I will answer</w> him: I <transChange type="added">will be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06869">with him in trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and honour</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 91:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">With long</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him, and shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">him my salvation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">length of days</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 91." eID="gen616" osisID="Ps.91"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv85"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H07676">for the sabbath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv85"/><transChange type="added">It is a</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05945">O most High</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 92:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0530">and thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">every night</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>every…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the nights</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 92:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06218">Upon an instrument of ten strings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">and upon the psaltery</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03658">upon the harp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01902">with a solemn sound</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the harp…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the solemn sound with the harp</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a solemn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Higgaion</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 92:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hast made me glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">through thy work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will triumph</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thy hands</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 92:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">are thy works</w>! <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04284">thy thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">are very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06009" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">deep</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 92:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01198">A brutish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">not; neither doth a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">understand</w> this.

verses.name: Psalms 92:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">When the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">spring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">as the grass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and when all the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">do flourish</w>; <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">that they shall be destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 92:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">art most</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04791">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for evermore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 92:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For, lo, thine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for, lo, thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">shall be scattered</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 92:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07161">But my horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou exalt</w> like <transChange type="added">the horn of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07214">an unicorn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01101" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I shall be anointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">with fresh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 92:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">also shall see</w> <transChange type="added">my desire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07790">on mine enemies</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0241">mine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hear</w> <transChange type="added">my desire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">that rise up</w> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 92:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall flourish</w> <w lemma="strong:H08558">like the palm tree</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07685" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0730">like a cedar</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">in Lebanon</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 92:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08362" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Those that be planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall flourish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 92:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall still bring forth fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07872">in old age</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01879">they shall be fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07488">and flourishing</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>flourishing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">green</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 92:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">upright</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">my rock</w>, and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05766 strong:H05766" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">no unrighteousness</w> in him. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 92." eID="gen617" osisID="Ps.92"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he is clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01348">with majesty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">with strength</w>, <transChange type="added">wherewith</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0247" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">he hath girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">himself: the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also is stablished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it cannot be moved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 93:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03678">Thy throne</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">established</w> <w lemma="strong:H0227">of old</w>: thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">from everlasting</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of old</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from then</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 93:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05104">The floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have lifted up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05104">the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">their voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05104">the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01796">their waves</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 93:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">on high</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0117">mightier</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">than the noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <transChange type="added">than</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0117">the mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04867">waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 93:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05713">Thy testimonies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">are very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">sure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06944">holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04998" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">becometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">thine house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H0753">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for ever</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to length of days</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 93." eID="gen618" osisID="Ps.93"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05360">to whom vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">belongeth; O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05360">to whom vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03313" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">belongeth, shew</w> thyself.<note type="study"><catchWord>God…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">God of revenges</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>shew…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shine forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 94:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thyself, thou judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">render</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">a reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H01343">to the proud</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">how long shall the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">how long shall the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">triumph</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 94:4
verses.text: <transChange type="added">How long</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall they utter</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06277">hard things</w>? <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">boast</w> themselves?

verses.name: Psalms 94:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They break in pieces</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">thine heritage</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">the widow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">and the stranger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07523" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and murder</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yet they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03050">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not see</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">neither shall the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">regard</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Understand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">ye brutish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>: and <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03684">fools</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when will ye be wise</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 94:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that planted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">the ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he not hear</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall he not see</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 94:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that chastiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not he correct</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">he that teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>, <transChange type="added">shall not he know</transChange>?

verses.name: Psalms 94:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">the thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, that they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">vanity</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">whom thou chastenest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03050">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and teachest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">him out of thy law</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 94:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That thou mayest give him rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of adversity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07845">until the pit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">for the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not cast off</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will he forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">But judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">unto righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03477">and all the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">shall follow</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall follow…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall be after it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 94:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who will rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">for me against the evildoers</w>? <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03320" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">who will stand up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">for me against the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 94:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03884">Unless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05833">my help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">had almost</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01745">in silence</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>almost</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">quickly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 94:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">When I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">My foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">slippeth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">held me up</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">In the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H08312">of my thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H08575">me thy comforts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03678">Shall the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">of iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">have fellowship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with thee, which frameth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">by a law</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 94:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01413" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They gather themselves together</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04869">is my defence</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0430">and my God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H04268">of my refuge</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 94:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he shall bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">upon them their own iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall cut them off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in their own wickedness</w>; <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall cut them off</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 94." eID="gen619" osisID="Ps.94"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let us sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">let us make a joyful noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">to the rock</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">of our salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 95:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Let us come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before his presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">with thanksgiving</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and make a joyful noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02158">unto him with psalms</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>come…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prevent his face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 95:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">King</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">above all gods</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 95:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">In his hand</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04278">the deep places</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08443">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">of the hills</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> his also.<note type="study"><catchWord>In…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">In whose</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the strength…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the heights of the hills are his</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 95:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">The sea</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">his, and he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">it: and his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">formed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03006">the dry</w> <transChange type="added">land</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The sea…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Whose the sea is</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 95:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">let us worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03766" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and bow down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us kneel</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">our maker</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 95:7
verses.text: For he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>; and we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04830">of his pasture</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hand</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03117">To day</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if ye will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">his voice</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 95:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Harden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">not your heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04808">as in the provocation</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> as <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04531">of temptation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>provocation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">contention</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 95:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">When your fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">tempted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, proved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me, and saw</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">my work</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 95:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0705">Forty</w> <w lemma="strong:H08141">years</w> <w lemma="strong:H06962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">long was I grieved</w> with <transChange type="added">this</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and said</w>, It <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that do err</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in their heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 95:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Unto whom I sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">in my wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they should not enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04496">into my rest</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">if they enter into my rest</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 95." eID="gen620" osisID="Ps.95"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01319" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">his salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">to day</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among all people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">to be praised</w>: he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to be feared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">above all gods</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">For all the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the nations</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0457">idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01935">Honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and majesty</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">him: strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">and beauty</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04720">in his sanctuary</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04940">O ye kindreds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">and strength</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <transChange type="added">due unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">an offering</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02691">into his courts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>due…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of his name</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 96:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">O worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01927">in the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holiness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">him, all the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">in the glorious sanctuary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 96:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">also shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">that it shall not be moved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">righteously</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 96:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">Let the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03220">let the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and the fulness</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>the fulness…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all it containeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 96:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07704">Let the field</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be joyful</w>, and all that <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">therein: then shall all the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the wood</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">rejoice</w>

verses.name: Psalms 96:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">with righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">with his truth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 96." eID="gen621" osisID="Ps.96"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07227">let the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H0339">of isles</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be glad</w> <transChange type="added">thereof</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>multitude…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">many</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">great isles</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 97:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06051">Clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H06205">and darkness</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">him: righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04349">the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">of his throne</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>habitation</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">establishment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 97:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">A fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and burneth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01300">His lightnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">enlightened</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and trembled</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01749">like wax</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">at the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the whole earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">The heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">his righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">his glory</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">be all they that serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H06459">graven images</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that boast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0457">themselves of idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">worship</w> him, all <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">gods</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heard</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and was glad</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01323">and the daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03063">of Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">because of thy judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05945">high above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou art exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">far above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">all gods</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:10
