verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Ye that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he preserveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the souls</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">of his saints</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them out of the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">Light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is sown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">for the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08057">and gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">for the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 97:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">ye righteous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">at the remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of his holiness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to the memorial</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 97." eID="gen622" osisID="Ps.97"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv86"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv86"/><w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">marvellous things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">his right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06944">and his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath gotten him the victory</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 98:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath made known</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">his salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06666">his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath he openly shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>openly…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">revealed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 98:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">and his truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">toward the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0657">all the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">the salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 98:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make a joyful noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06476" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make a loud noise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and sing</w> praise.

verses.name: Psalms 98:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">with the harp</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03658">with the harp</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06963">and the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02172">of a psalm</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 98:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02689">With trumpets</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">and sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of cornet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make a joyful noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">the King</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 98:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">Let the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roar</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04393">and the fulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">thereof; the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that dwell</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>the fulness…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all it containeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 98:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05104">Let the floods</w> <w lemma="strong:H04222" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">clap</w> <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02022">let the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">be joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>

verses.name: Psalms 98:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for he cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06664">with righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">the world</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">with equity</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 98." eID="gen623" osisID="Ps.98"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">reigneth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05971">let the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07264" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">tremble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he sitteth</w> <transChange type="added">between</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03742">the cherubims</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0776">let the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05120" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be moved</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be moved</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stagger</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 99:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>; and he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">above all the people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 99:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Let them praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and terrible</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 99:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">thou dost establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04339">equity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou executest</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">in Jacob</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 99:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">Exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H01916 strong:H07272">at his footstool</w>; <transChange type="added">for</transChange> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>he is…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">it is holy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 99:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">and Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">among his priests</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08050">and Samuel</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">among them that call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon his name</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they called</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he answered</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 99:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He spake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">unto them in the cloudy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillar</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">his testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">and the ordinance</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he gave</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 99:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou answeredst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0410">thou wast a God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that forgavest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05358" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them, though thou tookest vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">of their inventions</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 99:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8786">Exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">and worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">at his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hill</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 99." eID="gen624" osisID="Ps.99"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv87"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">of praise</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv87"/><w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make a joyful noise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">all ye lands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>praise</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">thanksgiving</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all the earth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 100:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with gladness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before his presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07445">with singing</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 100:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> he <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w>: <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> us, and not we ourselves; <transChange type="added">we are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629">and the sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04830">of his pasture</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and not…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">and his we are</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 100:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">into his gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">with thanksgiving</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02691">into his courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">with praise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">be thankful</w> unto him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 100:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02617">his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0530">and his truth</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">to all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 100." eID="gen625" osisID="Ps.100"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv88"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv88"/><w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I sing</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 101:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will behave myself wisely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">in a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O when wilt thou come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">unto me? I will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">with a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 101:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01100">no wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">before mine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H07750">of them that turn aside</w>; <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not cleave</w> to me.<note type="study"><catchWord>wicked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thing of Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 101:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06141">A froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from me: I will not know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">a wicked</w> <transChange type="added">person</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 101:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05643">Whoso privily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03960 strong:H03960" morph="strongMorph:TH8781 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8764">slandereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him will I cut off</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01362">him that hath an high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">and a proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not I suffer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 101:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">upon the faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they may dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with me: he that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">in a perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall serve</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>in a…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">perfect in the way</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 101:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07423">deceit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">my house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that telleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not tarry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in my sight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall not tarry</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shall not be established</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 101:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01242">I will early</w> <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">all the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the land</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I may cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">all wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doers</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">from the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 101." eID="gen626" osisID="Ps.101"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv89"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H08605">A Prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the afflicted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he is overwhelmed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and poureth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07879">his complaint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv89"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07775">and let my cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> unto thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>of</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 102:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">from me in the day</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">I am in trouble</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">unto me: in the day</w> <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">me speedily</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For my days</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06227">like smoke</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06106">and my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H02787" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are burned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04168">as an hearth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>like…</catchWord>: or, (as some read) <rdg type="alternate">into smoke</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 102:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">My heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">is smitten</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and withered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">like grass</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">so that I forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">my bread</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">By reason of the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0585">of my groaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">my bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">to my skin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>skin</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 102:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am like</w> <w lemma="strong:H06893">a pelican</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">of the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03563">I am like an owl</w> <w lemma="strong:H02723">of the desert</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I watch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06833">and am as a sparrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0909" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">alone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">upon the house top</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">me all the day</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">they that are mad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">against me are sworn</w> against me.

verses.name: Psalms 102:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I have eaten</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">ashes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">like bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04537" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08249">my drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H01065">with weeping</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 102:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Because</w> <w lemma="strong:H02195">of thine indignation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07110">and thy wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for thou hast lifted me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cast me down</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">My days</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">like a shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">that declineth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I am withered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">like grass</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">But thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shalt endure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02143">and thy remembrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou shalt arise</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">upon Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06256">for the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">her, yea, the set time</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is come</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">For thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">in her stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">and favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">the dust</w> thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 102:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01471">So the heathen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">and all the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">thy glory</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">When the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall build up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he shall appear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">in his glory</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He will regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06199">of the destitute</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and not despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">their prayer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">This shall be written</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">for the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0314">to come</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">which shall be created</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For he hath looked down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">from the height</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of his sanctuary</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08064">from heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">did the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 102:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0603">the groaning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0615">of the prisoner</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to loose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">those that are appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08546">to death</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>those…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the children of death</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 102:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">To declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">in Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">and his praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">in Jerusalem</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 102:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">When the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">are gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and the kingdoms</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to serve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He weakened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he shortened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">my days</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>weakened</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">afflicted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 102:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">O my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">take me not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02677">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of my days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08141">thy years</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Of old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou laid the foundation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08064">and the heavens</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thy hands</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall perish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but thou shalt endure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01086" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, all of them shall wax old</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">like a garment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03830">as a vesture</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shalt thou change</w> <w lemma="strong:H02498" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, and they shall be changed</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>endure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">stand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 102:27
verses.text: But thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08141">the same, and thy years</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall have no end</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 102:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">The children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall continue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02233">and their seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 102." eID="gen627" osisID="Ps.102"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv90"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv90"/><w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07130">and all that is within</w> me, <transChange type="added">bless</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576">not all his benefits</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 103:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05545" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who forgiveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">all thine iniquities</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who healeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08463">all thy diseases</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 103:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who redeemeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07845">from destruction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05849" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">who crowneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thee with lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">and tender mercies</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 103:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Who satisfieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05716">thy mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with good</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange>; <transChange type="added">so that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05271">thy youth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">is renewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05404">like the eagle’s</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">executeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for all that are oppressed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He made known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">unto Moses</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05949">his acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07349">merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02587">and gracious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in mercy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>plenteous…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great in mercy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 103:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05331">He will not always</w> <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">chide</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will he keep</w> <transChange type="added">his anger</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath not dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02399">with us after our sins</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">nor rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">us according to our iniquities</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08064">For as the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is high above</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01396" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">is his mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">toward them that fear</w> him.<note type="study"><catchWord>as…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the height of the heaven</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 103:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">As far as</w> <w lemma="strong:H04217">the east</w> <w lemma="strong:H04628">is from the west</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">far hath he removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">our transgressions</w> from us.

verses.name: Psalms 103:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Like as a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">pitieth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07355" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">pitieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">them that fear</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 103:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03336">our frame</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">he remembereth</w> that we <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06083">dust</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0582">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03117">his days</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02682">as grass</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06731">as a flower</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so he flourisheth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">For the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">passeth over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">it, and it is gone; and the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thereof shall know</w> it no more.<note type="study"><catchWord>it is…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it is not</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 103:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">But the mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">from everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">to</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">upon them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">him, and his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 103:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">To such as keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and to those that remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">his commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 103:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hath prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04438">and his kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">ruleth</w> over all.

verses.name: Psalms 103:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04397">ye his angels</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01368">that excel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">in strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hearkening</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of his word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that excel…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">mighty in strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 103:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, all <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06635">his hosts</w>; <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of his, that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">his pleasure</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 103:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">all his works</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in all places</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">of his dominion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 103." eID="gen628" osisID="Ps.103"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">thou art very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">great</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou art clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">with honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and majesty</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who coverest</w> <transChange type="added">thyself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">with light</w> as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08008">a garment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who stretchest out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H03407">like a curtain</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 104:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07136" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Who layeth the beams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">of his chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">in the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07398">his chariot</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">who walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">upon the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of the wind</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 104:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">his angels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirits</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08334" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">his ministers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 104:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04349">the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it should not be removed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703 strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Who…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He hath founded the earth upon her bases</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou coveredst</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">it with the deep</w> as <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03830">a garment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">above the mountains</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04480">At</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">thy rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they fled</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">at the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07482">of thy thunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H02648" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they hasted</w> away.

verses.name: Psalms 104:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">by the mountains</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H01237">by the valleys</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">unto the place</w> <w lemma="strong:H02088">which</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast founded</w> for them.<note type="study"><catchWord>They go up…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">The mountains ascend, the valleys descend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast set</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">a bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they may not pass over</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they turn not again</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He sendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04599">the springs</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">into the valleys</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">among the hills</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Who</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>run</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walk</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They give drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to every beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">of the field</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06501">the wild asses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">quench</w> <w lemma="strong:H06772">their thirst</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>quench</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">break</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05775">By them shall the fowls</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have their habitation</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06963 strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0996">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H06073">the branches</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">give a voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08248" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He watereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H05944">from his chambers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">with the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of thy works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02682">He causeth the grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">for the cattle</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06212">and herb</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">for the service</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he may bring forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the earth</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 104:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03196">And wine</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">maketh glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of man</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w> to make <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H06670" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to shine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">and bread</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">strengtheneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">heart</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>oil…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to make his face shine with oil</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">more than oil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06086">The trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are full</w> <transChange type="added">of sap</transChange>; <w lemma="strong:H0730">the cedars</w> <w lemma="strong:H03844">of Lebanon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which he hath planted</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 104:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06833">Where the birds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07077" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">make their nests</w>: <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02624">the stork</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01265">the fir trees</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">her house</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01364">The high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">hills</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">a refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03277">for the wild goats</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05553">the rocks</w> <w lemma="strong:H08227">for the conies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04150">for seasons</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08121">the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">his going down</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thou makest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">and it is night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02416">wherein all the beasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the forest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07430" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do creep</w> <transChange type="added">forth</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>beasts…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">beasts thereof do trample on the forest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03715">The young lions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">roar</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">after their prey</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">their meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">from God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ariseth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they gather themselves together</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07257" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay them down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04585">in their dens</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">unto his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H05656">and to his labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06153">until the evening</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how manifold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">are thy works</w>! <w lemma="strong:H02451">in wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast thou made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them all: the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">of thy riches</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:25
verses.text: <transChange type="added">So is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">this great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027 strong:H07342">and wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>, wherein <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07431">things creeping</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">innumerable</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06996">both small</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">and great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">beasts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">There go</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">the ships</w>: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03882">that leviathan</w>, <transChange type="added">whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to play</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>made</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">formed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">These wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">all upon thee; that thou mayest give</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0400">their meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in due season</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:28
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03950" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them they gather</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou openest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with good</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thou hidest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they are troubled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0622" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou takest away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">their breath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01478" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and return</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">to their dust</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Thou sendest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">forth thy spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">they are created</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02318" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and thou renewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03519">The glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall endure for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in his works</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>endure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 104:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He looketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">on the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07460" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it trembleth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06225" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they smoke</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">as long as I live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">praise to my God</w> <w lemma="strong:H05750">while I have my being</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07879">My meditation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of him shall be sweet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 104:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02400">Let the sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H08552" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">out of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and let the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">be no more. Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 104." eID="gen629" osisID="Ps.104"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">call</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">upon his name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">his deeds</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto him, sing psalms</w> <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto him: talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">ye of all his wondrous works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">Glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">ye in his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">let the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">and his strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">evermore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his marvellous works</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that he hath done</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04159">his wonders</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and the judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 105:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">O ye seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">of Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H0972">his chosen</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:7
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">his judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in all the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">to a thousand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:9
verses.text: Which <transChange type="added">covenant</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he made</w> <w lemma="strong:H085">with Abraham</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07621">and his oath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03446">unto Isaac</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 105:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And confirmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">the same unto Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">for a law</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">to Israel</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">covenant</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 105:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Unto thee will I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02256">the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of your inheritance</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>lot</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cord</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 105:12
verses.text: When they were <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04962">a few men</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">in number</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04592">yea, very few</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and strangers</w> in it.

verses.name: Psalms 105:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">When they went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">from one nation</w> to another, from <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04467">kingdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">to another</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 105:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He suffered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">no man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do them wrong</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yea, he reproved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w> for their sakes;

verses.name: Psalms 105:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">not mine anointed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05030">and do my prophets</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">no harm</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Moreover he called</w> <w lemma="strong:H07458">for a famine</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the land</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the whole staff</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> them, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03130">Joseph</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04376" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was sold</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for a servant</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 105:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">Whose feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they hurt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03525">with fetters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">he</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">in iron</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>he…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his soul came into iron</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 105:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06256">Until the time</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">that his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">came</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0565">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">tried</w> him.

verses.name: Psalms 105:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and loosed</w> him; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and let him go free</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">him lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and ruler</w> <w lemma="strong:H07075">of all his substance</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">possession</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 105:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">his princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">at his pleasure</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02205">and teach his senators</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also came</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">into Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03290">and Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sojourned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he increased</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made them stronger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">than their enemies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05230" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to deal subtilly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with his servants</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he had chosen</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H0226">his signs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">among them, and wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words of his signs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 105:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and made it dark</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not against his word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">their waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">into blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H01710">their fish</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">Their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-310">brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06854">frogs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08317" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-310">in abundance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02315">in the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of their kings</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and there came</w> <w lemma="strong:H06157">divers sorts of flies</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03654">lice</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">in all their coasts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H01259">them hail</w> <w lemma="strong:H01653">for rain</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03852">flaming</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their land</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">their rain hail</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 105:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">their vines</w> <w lemma="strong:H08384">also and their fig trees</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">the trees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">of their coasts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He spake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0697">and the locusts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">came</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03218">and caterpillers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04557">and that without number</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 105:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And did eat up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">all the herbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and devoured</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">of their ground</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">also all the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in their land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">the chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H0202">of all their strength</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He brought them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">also with silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>: and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not one feeble</w> <transChange type="added">person</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07626">among their tribes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">was glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when they departed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06343">for the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of them fell</w> upon them.

verses.name: Psalms 105:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06051">a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04539">for a covering</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0784">and fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give light</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:40
verses.text: <transChange type="added">The people</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">asked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07958">quails</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">them with the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">the rock</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H02100" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">gushed out</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they ran</w> <w lemma="strong:H06723">in the dry places</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05104">a river</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For he remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">promise</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H085">Abraham</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 105:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he brought forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H08342">with joy</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0972">his chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">with gladness</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>gladness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">singing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 105:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them the lands</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they inherited</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">of the people</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 105:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they might observe</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">his statutes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">his laws</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 105." eID="gen630" osisID="Ps.105"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 106:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04448" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Who can utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">the mighty acts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>? <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">can shew forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">all his praise</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 106:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at all times</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07522">with the favour</w> <transChange type="added">that thou bearest unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">thy people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">O visit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">me with thy salvation</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 106:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That I may see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0972">of thy chosen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I may rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">in the gladness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of thy nation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">that I may glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">with thine inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We have sinned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">with our fathers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">we have committed iniquity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">we have done wickedly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">Our fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">understood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">not thy wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">not the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but provoked</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">at the sea</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05488">at the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Nevertheless he saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">them for his name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">sake, that he might make his mighty power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to be known</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He rebuked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02717" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also, and it was dried up</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so he led</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">them through the depths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04057">as through the wilderness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of him that hated</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the enemy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04325">And the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">their enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0259">there was not one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">of them left</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Then believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">they his words</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they sang</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">his praise</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">They soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">forgat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">his works</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02442" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">they waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">not for his counsel</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>They soon…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">They made haste, they forgat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 106:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">But lusted</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05254" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and tempted</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">in the desert</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lusted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lusted a lust</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 106:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H07596">them their request</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07332">leanness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">into their soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">They envied</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H04264">also in the camp</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">the saint</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and swallowed up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01885">Dathan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the company</w> <w lemma="strong:H048">of Abiram</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">And a fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">in their company</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03852">the flame</w> <w lemma="strong:H03857" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">burned up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05695">a calf</w> <w lemma="strong:H02722">in Horeb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and worshipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04541">the molten image</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04171" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Thus they changed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">their glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08403">into the similitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of an ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">grass</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They forgat</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">their saviour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which had done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great things</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">in Egypt</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 106:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">Wondrous works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02526">of Ham</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">terrible things</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">by the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:23
