verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore he said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that he would destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03884">them, had not</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">Moses</w> <w lemma="strong:H0972">his chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">stood</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06556">him in the breach</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">his wrath</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">lest he should destroy</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, they despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H02532">the pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not his word</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>the pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a land of desire</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 106:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07279" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">But murmured</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in their tents</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hearkened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">not unto the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore he lifted up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">against them, to overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">them in the wilderness</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>to overthrow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to make them fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 106:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">their seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">also among the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">and to scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them in the lands</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>To overthrow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">To make them fall</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 106:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06775" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">They joined</w> <w lemma="strong:H01187">themselves also unto Baal–peor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and ate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of the dead</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:29
verses.text: Thus they provoked <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">with their inventions</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04046">and the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">brake in</w> upon them.

verses.name: Psalms 106:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then stood up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06372">Phinehas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06419" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and executed judgment</w>: and <transChange type="added">so</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04046">the plague</w> <w lemma="strong:H06113" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was stayed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">And that was counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">unto him for righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">evermore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07107" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They angered</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">also at the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04809 strong:H04808" morph="strongMorph:TH8677">of strife</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03415" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so that it went ill</w> <w lemma="strong:H04872">with Moses</w> for their sakes:

verses.name: Psalms 106:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Because they provoked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">his spirit</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0981" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">so that he spake unadvisedly</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">with his lips</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">They did not destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">the nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">concerning whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">commanded</w> them:

verses.name: Psalms 106:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">But were mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and learned</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">their works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they served</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">their idols</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04170">which were a snare</w> unto them.

verses.name: Psalms 106:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, they sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and their daughters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07700">unto devils</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 106:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">the blood</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of their sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H01323">and of their daughters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">whom they sacrificed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06091">unto the idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0776">and the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02610" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">was polluted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">with blood</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02930" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Thus were they defiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">with their own works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and went a whoring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">with their own inventions</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0639">Therefore was the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">kindled</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">against his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">insomuch that he abhorred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">his own inheritance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">them into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them ruled</w> over them.

verses.name: Psalms 106:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Their enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03905" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also oppressed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">them, and they were brought into subjection</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">under their hand</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">times</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">did he deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">them; but they provoked</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098">with their counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04355" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and were brought low</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">for their iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>brought…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">impoverished</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">weakened</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 106:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Nevertheless he regarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">their affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">their cry</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 106:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">for them his covenant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and repented</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">according to the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of his mercies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He made</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">them also to be pitied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">of</w> <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all those that carried them captives</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">us, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and gather</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">us from among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">unto thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">to triumph</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">in thy praise</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 106:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">from everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">to everlasting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05971">and let all the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0543">Amen</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 106." eID="gen631" osisID="Ps.106"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Let the redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w> <transChange type="added">so</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">whom he hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">of the enemy</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 107:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">And gathered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">them out of the lands</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04217">from the east</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04628">and from the west</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06828">from the north</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">and from the south</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>south</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sea</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 107:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They wandered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">in the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03452">in a solitary</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they found</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">no city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">to dwell</w> in.

verses.name: Psalms 107:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07457">Hungry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06771">and thirsty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">fainted</w> in them.

verses.name: Psalms 107:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in their trouble</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he delivered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04691">them out of their distresses</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And he led them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">by the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that they might go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">to a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">of habitation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:8
verses.text: Oh that <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his goodness</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his wonderful works</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 107:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For he satisfieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08264" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the longing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and filleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">the hungry</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with goodness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Such as sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">and in the shadow of death</w>, <transChange type="added">being</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0615">bound</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">in affliction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">and iron</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 107:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04784" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Because they rebelled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">against the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and contemned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05945">of the most High</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 107:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03665" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Therefore he brought down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05999">with labour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they fell down</w>, and <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">none to help</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in their trouble</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he saved</w> <w lemma="strong:H04691">them out of their distresses</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He brought them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06757">and the shadow of death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-311">and brake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04147">their bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05423" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-311">in sunder</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:15
verses.text: Oh that <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his goodness</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his wonderful works</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 107:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For he hath broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H05178">of brass</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-312">and cut</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w> <w lemma="strong:H01438" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-312">in sunder</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0191">Fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">because</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">of their transgression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05771">and because of their iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">are afflicted</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">abhorreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">all manner of meat</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and they draw near</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">unto the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in their trouble</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he saveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04691">them out of their distresses</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and healed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">them, and delivered</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07825">from their destructions</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:21
verses.text: Oh that <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his goodness</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his wonderful works</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 107:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02076" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And let them sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">the sacrifices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">of thanksgiving</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">his works</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">with rejoicing</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>rejoicing</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">singing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 107:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H0591">in ships</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">business</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">in great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 107:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">These see</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and his wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H04688">in the deep</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he commandeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and raiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">the stormy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">which lifteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01530">the waves</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>raiseth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">maketh to stand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 107:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They mount up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">to the heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">again to the depths</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">their soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04127" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">is melted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">because of trouble</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02287" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They reel to and fro</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and stagger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07910">like a drunken man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02451">and are at their wits’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">end</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all their wisdom is swallowed up</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 107:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then they cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">in their trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he bringeth them out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04691">of their distresses</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05591">the storm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01827">a calm</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01530">so that the waves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02814" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereof are still</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then are they glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H08367" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">because they be quiet</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">so he bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">them unto their desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H04231">haven</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:31
verses.text: Oh that <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">would praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his goodness</w>, and <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his wonderful works</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 107:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">Let them exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">him also in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of the people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">him in the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of the elders</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05104">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">into a wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04161 strong:H04325">and the watersprings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06774">into dry ground</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 107:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06529">A fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04420">into barrenness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">for the wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that dwell</w> therein.<note type="study"><catchWord>barrenness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saltiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 107:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">the wilderness</w> <w lemma="strong:H098">into a standing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06723">and dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">ground</w> <w lemma="strong:H04161 strong:H04325">into watersprings</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07457">And there he maketh the hungry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to dwell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">that they may prepare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H04186">for habitation</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 107:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05193" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and plant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03754">vineyards</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which may yield</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of increase</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">He blesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them also, so that they are multiplied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-313">and suffereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">not their cattle</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-313">to decrease</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Again, they are minished</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and brought low</w> <w lemma="strong:H06115">through oppression</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03015">and sorrow</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He poureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">contempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">upon princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and causeth them to wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H08414">in the wilderness</w>, <transChange type="added">where there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">no way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wilderness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">void place</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 107:41
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H034">Yet setteth he the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">on high</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">from affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and maketh</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04940">families</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629">like a flock</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">after</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 107:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03477">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and rejoice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05766">and all iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07092" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall stop</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">her mouth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 107:43
verses.text: Whoso <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will observe</w> these <transChange type="added">things</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">even they shall understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">the lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 107." eID="gen632" osisID="Ps.107"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv91"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04210">Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv91"/><w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is fixed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and give praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">even with my glory</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 108:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05035">psaltery</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harp</w>: I <transChange type="added">myself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will awake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">early</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 108:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">among the people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">unto thee among the nations</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 108:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">For thy mercy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">above the heavens</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0571">and thy truth</w> <transChange type="added">reacheth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07834">unto the clouds</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>clouds</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">skies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 108:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be thou exalted</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08064">above the heavens</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03519">and thy glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">above all the earth</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 108:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03039">That thy beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">may be delivered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">save</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thy right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and answer</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 108:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his holiness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will rejoice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07927">Shechem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04058" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and mete out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06010">the valley</w> <w lemma="strong:H05523">of Succoth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 108:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01568">Gilead</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04519">mine; Manasseh</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0669">mine; Ephraim</w> also <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">of mine head</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">my lawgiver</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 108:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04124">Moab</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05518 strong:H07366">my washpot</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0123">over Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I cast out</w> <w lemma="strong:H05275">my shoe</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06429">over Philistia</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">will I triumph</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 108:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02986" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Who will bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H04013">me into the strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">city</w>? <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who will lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">me into Edom</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 108:11
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Wilt</transChange> not <transChange type="added">thou</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w>, <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast cast us off</w>? <w lemma="strong:H0430">and wilt not thou, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">with our hosts</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 108:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03051" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05833">us help</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">from trouble</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07723">for vain</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">the help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 108:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0430">Through God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we shall do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiantly</w>: for he <transChange type="added">it is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall tread down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">our enemies</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 108." eID="gen633" osisID="Ps.108"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv92"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv92"/><w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Hold not thy peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">O God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of my praise</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 109:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">For the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">and the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">of the deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">against me: they have spoken</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">against me with a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the deceitful</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of deceit</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>are opened</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">have opened themselves</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 109:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They compassed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">me about also with words</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">of hatred</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and fought</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">against me without a cause</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0160">For my love</w> <w lemma="strong:H07853" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are my adversaries</w>: but I <transChange type="added">give myself unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08605">prayer</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they have rewarded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">me evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08135">and hatred</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">for my love</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Set</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">thou a wicked man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07854">over him: and let Satan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">at his right hand</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Satan</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">an adversary</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 109:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8736">When he shall be judged</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him be</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">condemned</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08605">and let his prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02401">become sin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>be condemned</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">go out guilty</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">wicked</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 109:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Let his days</w> <w lemma="strong:H04592">be few</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0312">let another</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06486">his office</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>office</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">charge</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 109:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Let his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">be fatherless</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0802">and his wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">a widow</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Let his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">be continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">vagabonds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and beg</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">let them seek</w> <transChange type="added">their bread</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02723">also out of their desolate places</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05383" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let the extortioner</w> <w lemma="strong:H05367" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">catch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">all that he hath; and let the strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0962" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">his labour</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let there be none to extend</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him: neither let there be any to favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">his fatherless children</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0319">Let his posterity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">be cut off</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">in the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">following</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">let their name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be blotted out</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05771">Let the iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his fathers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02403">and let not the sin</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be blotted out</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Let them be before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that he may cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">the memory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of them from the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because that he remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to shew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but persecuted</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8788">that he might even slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H03512" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">As he loved</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">cursing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so let it come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">unto him: as he delighted</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">not in blessing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so let it be far</w> from him.

verses.name: Psalms 109:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">As he clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07045">himself with cursing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04055">like as with his garment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so let it come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">into his bowels</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">like water</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08081">and like oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">into his bones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>into his bowels</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">within him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 109:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0899">Let it be unto him as the garment</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04206">him, and for a girdle</w> <w lemma="strong:H02296" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">wherewith he is girded</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Let</transChange> this <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06468">the reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H07853" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of mine adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and of them that speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">against my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">But do</w> <w lemma="strong:H03069">thou for me, O <divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">sake: because thy mercy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">deliver</w> thou me.

verses.name: Psalms 109:22
verses.text: For I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06041">poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">and needy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02490" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 109:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H06738">like the shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when it declineth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am tossed up and down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0697">as the locust</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01290">My knees</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are weak</w> <w lemma="strong:H06685">through fasting</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01320">and my flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03584" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">of fatness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02781">I became also a reproach</w> unto them: <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon me they shaked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">their heads</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Help</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O save</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">me according to thy mercy</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 109:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That they may know</w> that this <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thy hand</w>; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hast done</w> it.

verses.name: Psalms 109:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Let them curse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou: when they arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let them be ashamed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">but let thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07853" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Let mine adversaries</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">with shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05844" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let them cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">themselves with their own confusion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04598">as with a mantle</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03966">I will greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">with my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">yea, I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">him among</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">the multitude</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 109:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For he shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">at the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to save</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from those that condemn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>those…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the judges of</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 109." eID="gen634" osisID="Ps.109"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv93"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv93"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05002" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">said</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">unto my Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">thou at my right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272 strong:H01916">thy footstool</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 110:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall send</w> <w lemma="strong:H04294">the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of thy strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">out of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07287" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">thou in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of thine enemies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 110:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05971">Thy people</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05071">willing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">of thy power</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01926">in the beauties</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">of holiness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07358">from the womb</w> <w lemma="strong:H04891">of the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02919">thou hast the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H03208">of thy youth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>from…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">more than the womb of the morning: thou shalt have</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 110:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and will not repent</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03548">a priest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H01700">after the order</w> <w lemma="strong:H04442">of Melchizedek</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 110:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">The Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">at thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall strike</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">through kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">of his wrath</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 110:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall fill</w> <transChange type="added">the places</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01472">with the dead bodies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04272" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he shall wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the heads</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">over many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">countries</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>many</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">great</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 110:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">of the brook</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">therefore shall he lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 110." eID="gen635" osisID="Ps.110"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03824">whole heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05475">in the assembly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w>, and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05712">the congregation</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 111:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">The works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">sought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02656">of all them that have pleasure</w> therein.

verses.name: Psalms 111:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06467">His work</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01935">honourable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">and glorious</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06666">and his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">endureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 111:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">his wonderful works</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">to be remembered</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07349">and full of compassion</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 111:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H02964">meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">unto them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">him: he will ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be mindful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">of his covenant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>meat</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">prey</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 111:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">He hath shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">of his works</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may give</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">them the heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 111:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">The works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of his hands</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">verity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06490">all his commandments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">sure</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 111:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">They stand fast</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>, <transChange type="added">and are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">done</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">in truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">and uprightness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>stand…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">are established</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 111:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06304">redemption</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">unto his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">his covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06918">holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and reverend</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 111:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have all they that do</w> <transChange type="added">his commandments</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08416">his praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">endureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a good…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">good success</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>his commandments</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">them</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 111." eID="gen636" osisID="Ps.111"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">in his commandments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 112:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02233">His seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">shall be mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01755">the generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be blessed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 112:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01952">Wealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">and riches</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in his house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06666">and his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">endureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 112:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03477">Unto the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H02224" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there ariseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">in the darkness</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">gracious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07349">and full of compassion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">and righteous</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 112:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">A good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sheweth favour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and lendeth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">he will guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his affairs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">with discretion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discretion</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judgment</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 112:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">Surely he shall not be moved</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall be in everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">remembrance</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 112:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall not be afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">tidings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is fixed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">trusting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 112:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">His heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">established</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall not be afraid</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until he see</w> <transChange type="added">his desire</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06862">upon his enemies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 112:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">He hath dispersed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">to the poor</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06666">his righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">endureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07161">his horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be exalted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">with honour</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 112:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall see</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03707" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and be grieved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02786" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall gnash</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">with his teeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04549" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and melt away</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08378">the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 112." eID="gen637" osisID="Ps.112"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">O ye servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 113:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">Blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">be the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06258">from this time forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">and for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">evermore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 113:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04217">From the rising</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">of the sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03996">unto the going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the same the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">to be praised</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 113:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">high</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">above all nations</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">above the heavens</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 113:5
verses.text: Who <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">like unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">who dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">on high</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>dwelleth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">exalteth himself to dwell</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 113:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Who humbleth</w> <transChange type="added">himself</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to behold</w> <transChange type="added">the things that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in the earth</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 113:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He raiseth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">out of the dust</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lifteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">the needy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0830">out of the dunghill</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 113:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">That he may set</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05081">with princes</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05081">with the princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 113:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06135">He maketh the barren woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>, <transChange type="added">and to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08056">a joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of children</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to keep…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to dwell in an house</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 113." eID="gen638" osisID="Ps.113"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">When Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">went out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">from a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H03937" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of strange language</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 114:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03063">Judah</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">was his sanctuary</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">his dominion</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 114:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03220">The sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">saw</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and fled</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03383">Jordan</w> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">was driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 114:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">The mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">skipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">like rams</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01389">the little hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H01121">like lambs</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 114:5
verses.text: What <transChange type="added">ailed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03220">thee, O thou sea</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05127" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou fleddest</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03383">thou Jordan</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05437" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou wast driven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 114:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Ye mountains</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07540" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">ye skipped</w> <w lemma="strong:H0352">like rams</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01389">ye little hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06629 strong:H01121">like lambs</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 114:7

verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03050">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">my strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H02176">and song</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03444">and is become my salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06963">The voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">of rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">and salvation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tabernacles</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiantly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03225">The right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07426" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is exalted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03225">the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">valiantly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I shall not die</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03050">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath chastened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">me sore</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but he hath not given me over</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">unto death</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">to me the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will go</w> into them, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Psalms 118:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08179">This gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06662">into which the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall enter</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee: for thou hast heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">me, and art become my salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068">The stone</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the builders</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">refused</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">is become the head</w> <transChange type="added">stone</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06438">of the corner</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">This is the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> doing; it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">marvellous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in our eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName>…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 118:24
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the day</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">we will rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be glad</w> in it.

verses.name: Psalms 118:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Save</w> <w lemma="strong:H0577">now, I beseech</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0577">I beseech</w> <w lemma="strong:H06743" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thee, send now prosperity</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">we have blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">you out of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">which hath shewed us light</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02282">the sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">with cords</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07161">unto the horns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04196">of the altar</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 118:28
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and I will praise</w> thee: <transChange type="added">thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">I will exalt</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 118:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 118." eID="gen643" osisID="Ps.118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv94"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">א ALEPH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv94"/><w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">the undefiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>undefiled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">perfect</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">sincere</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">his testimonies</w>, <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">him with the whole heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They also do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">no iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast commanded</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">diligently</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0305">O that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were directed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shall I not be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto all thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">thee with uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I shall have learned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thy righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judgments of thy righteousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">me not utterly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv95"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ב BETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv95"/><w lemma="strong:H05288">Wherewithal shall a young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">his way</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by taking heed</w> <transChange type="added">thereto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">With my whole heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee: O let me not wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">from thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0565">Thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I might not sin</w> against thee.

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">With my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">all the judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of thy testimonies</w>, as <transChange type="added">much as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05921">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">all riches</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">in thy precepts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">unto thy ways</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">I will delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">myself in thy statutes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv96"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ג GIMEL.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv96"/><w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deal bountifully</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thou mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wondrous things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">out of thy law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Open</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Reveal</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:19
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">not thy commandments</w> from me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01638" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08375">for the longing</w> <transChange type="added">that it hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">unto thy judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at all times</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast rebuked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02086">the proud</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cursed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which do err</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">from thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">from me reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">and contempt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:23
