verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">Princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also did sit</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">speak</w> against me: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05713">Thy testimonies</w> also <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">my delight</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098 strong:H0582">my counsellors</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my counsellors</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of my counsel</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv97"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ד DALETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv97"/><w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">unto the dust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou me according to thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">me: teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make me to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">of thy precepts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall I talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of thy wondrous works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01811" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">melteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08424">for heaviness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou me according unto thy word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>melteth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">droppeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from me the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of lying</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">and grant me thy law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">graciously</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">of truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I laid</w> <transChange type="added">before me</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have stuck</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">unto thy testimonies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">put me not to shame</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will run</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when thou shalt enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv98"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ה HE.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv98"/><w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">of thy statutes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I shall keep</w> it <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06118">the end</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give me understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, I shall observe</w> it with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whole heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make me to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">in the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of thy commandments</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for therein do I delight</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">unto thy testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01215">and not to covetousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:37
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from beholding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thou me in thy way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Turn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Make to pass</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:38
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Stablish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>, who <transChange type="added">is devoted</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03374">to thy fear</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:39
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">my reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I fear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">for thy judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:40
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08373" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have longed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">after thy precepts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">me in thy righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv99"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ו VAU.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv99"/><w lemma="strong:H02617">Let thy mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">also unto me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0565">according to thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:42
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">So shall I have wherewith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that reproacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: for I trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in thy word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>So…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">So shall I answer him that reproveth me in a thing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:43
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have hoped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in thy judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:44
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So shall I keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:45
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And I will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">at liberty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at liberty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at large</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:46
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">of thy testimonies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">also before kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not be ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:47
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">And I will delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">myself in thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have loved</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:48
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03709">My hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also will I lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have loved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv100"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ז ZAIN.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv100"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon which thou hast caused me to hope</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:50
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05165">my comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">in my affliction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0565">for thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath quickened</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:51
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02086">The proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">have had me greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in derision</w>: <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I not declined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">from thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:52
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and have comforted</w> myself.

verses.name: Psalms 119:53
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02152">Horror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">upon me because of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:54
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02706">Thy statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02158">have been my songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">of my pilgrimage</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:55
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:56
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">This I had, because I kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv101"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ח CHETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv101"/><transChange type="added">Thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">my portion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I would keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:58
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy favour</w> with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whole heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">unto me according to thy word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>favour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">face</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:59
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">unto thy testimonies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:60
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I made haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8701">and delayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:61
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02256">The bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have robbed</w> me: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bands</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">companies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:62
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H02676">At midnight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">unto thee because of thy righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:63
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02270">a companion</w> of all <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, and of them that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:64
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv102"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ט TETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv102"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according unto thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:66
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">me good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for I have believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:67
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Before I was afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H07683" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I went astray</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but now have I kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:68
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and doest good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:69
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02086">The proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H02950" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forged</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lie</w> against me: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w> with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whole heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:70
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Their heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02954" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is as fat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">as grease</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8773">I delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:71
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">for me that I have been afflicted</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I might learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:72
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">The law</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H0505">unto me than thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">and silver</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:73
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv103"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">י JOD.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv103"/><w lemma="strong:H03027">Thy hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have made</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">me and fashioned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me: give me understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may learn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:74
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03373">They that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee will be glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when they see</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">me; because I have hoped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:75
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">that thy judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06664">right</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">thou in faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hast afflicted</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>right</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:76
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">be for my comfort</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0565">according to thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to comfort me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:77
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07356">Let thy tender mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, that I may live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">for thy law</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">my delight</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:78
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02086">Let the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ashamed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for they dealt perversely</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">with me without a cause</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">in thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:79
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03373">Let those that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045 strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8802">unto me, and those that have known</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:80
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Let my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">be sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in thy statutes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I be not ashamed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:81
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv104"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">כ CAPH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv104"/><w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fainteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">for thy salvation</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:82
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">for thy word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">saying</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">When wilt thou comfort</w> me?

verses.name: Psalms 119:83
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04997">For I am become like a bottle</w> <w lemma="strong:H07008">in the smoke</w>; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:84
verses.text: How many <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of thy servant</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when wilt thou execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">on them that persecute</w> me?

verses.name: Psalms 119:85
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02086">The proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have digged</w> <w lemma="strong:H07882">pits</w> for me, which <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">not after thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:86
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04687">All thy commandments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithful</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they persecute</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">me wrongfully</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">help</w> thou me.<note type="study"><catchWord>faithful</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">faithfulness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:87
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">They had almost</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">me upon earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">but I forsook</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">not thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:88
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">me after thy lovingkindness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall I keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:89
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv105"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ל LAMED.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv105"/><w lemma="strong:H05769">For ever</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is settled</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in heaven</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:90
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0530">Thy faithfulness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">thou hast established</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and it abideth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>abideth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">standeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:91
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They continue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">according to thine ordinances</w>: for all <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servants</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:92
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03884">Unless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w> <transChange type="added">had been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">my delights</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I should then have perished</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">in mine affliction</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:93
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05769">I will never</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for with them thou hast quickened</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:94
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thine, save</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me; for I have sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:95
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have waited</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for me to destroy</w> me: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">I will consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:96
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have seen</w> <w lemma="strong:H07093">an end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08502">of all perfection</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">exceeding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">broad</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:97
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv106"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">מ MEM.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv106"/><w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">O how love I</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>! it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07881">my meditation</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:98
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04687">Thou through thy commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">hast made me wiser</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">than mine enemies</w>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w> with me.<note type="study"><catchWord>they…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">it is ever with me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:99
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have more understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">than all my teachers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05715">for thy testimonies</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07881">my meditation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:100
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">I understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">more than the ancients</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because I keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:101
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03607" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have refrained</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from every evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I might keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:102
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not departed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">from thy judgments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou hast taught</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:103
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04452" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">How sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">are thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">unto my taste</w>! <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <transChange type="added">sweeter</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01706">than honey</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to my mouth</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>taste</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:104
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06490">Through thy precepts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">I get understanding</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">every false</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">way</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv107"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">נ NUN.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv107"/><w lemma="strong:H01697">Thy word</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05216">a lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">unto my feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0216">and a light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">unto my path</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I have sworn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will perform</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thy righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:107
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I am afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very much</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according unto thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:108
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Accept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05071">I beseech thee, the freewill offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">me thy judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:109
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">in my hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet do I not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:110
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for me: yet I erred</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">not from thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:111
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05715">Thy testimonies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I taken as an heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: for they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08342">the rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of my heart</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:112
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">mine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to perform</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">alway</w>, <transChange type="added">even unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06118">the end</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to perform</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to do</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:113
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv108"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ס SAMECH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv108"/><w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I hate</w> <transChange type="added">vain</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05588">thoughts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">but thy law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I love</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:114
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">my hiding place</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">and my shield</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:115
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">from me, ye evildoers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of my God</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:116
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Uphold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">me according unto thy word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may live</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let me not be ashamed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07664">of my hope</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:117
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hold thou me up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and I shall be safe</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08159" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">unto thy statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:118
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05541" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast trodden down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all them that err</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">from thy statutes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08649">for their deceit</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">falsehood</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:119
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Thou puttest away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">all the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05509">dross</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">therefore I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>puttest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">causest to cease</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:120
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01320">My flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05568" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">trembleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">for fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">of thee; and I am afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of thy judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:121
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv109"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ע AIN.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv109"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">and justice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03240" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me not to mine oppressors</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:122
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Be surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">for thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02086">let not the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">oppress</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:123
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">fail</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">for thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0565">and for the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">of thy righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:124
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">according unto thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:125
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give me understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I may know</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:126
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">time</w> for <transChange type="added">thee</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to work</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they have made void</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:127
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">above gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06337">yea, above fine gold</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:128
verses.text: Therefore I esteem all <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06490">precepts</w> <transChange type="added">concerning</transChange> all <transChange type="added">things to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">right</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">every false</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">way</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv110"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">פ PE.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv110"/><w lemma="strong:H05715">Thy testimonies</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06382">wonderful</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">therefore doth my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">keep</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06608">The entrance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of thy words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">giveth light</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">it giveth understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">unto the simple</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:131
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06473" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I opened</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">my mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07602" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and panted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02968" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I longed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">for thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:132
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Look</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou upon me, and be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">unto me, as thou usest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to do unto those that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>as thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">according to the custom toward those</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:133
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Order</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">my steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">in thy word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0205">and let not any iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H07980" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">have dominion</w> over me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:134
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06233">me from the oppression</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so will I keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:135
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Make thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">to shine</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">upon thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:136
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06388">Rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">run down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">not thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:137
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv111"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">צ TZADDI.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv111"/><w lemma="strong:H06662">Righteous</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03477">and upright</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:138
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05713">Thy testimonies</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">thou hast commanded</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">and very</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">faithful</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>righteous</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">righteousness</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>faithful</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">faithfulness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:139
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07068">My zeal</w> <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath consumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">me, because mine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>consumed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut me off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:140
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0565">Thy word</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H06884" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">pure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05650">therefore thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">loveth</w> it.<note type="study"><catchWord>pure</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">tried</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">refined</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:141
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06810">small</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and despised</w>: <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do not I forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:142
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">Thy righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08451">and thy law</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">the truth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:143
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06862">Trouble</w> <w lemma="strong:H04689">and anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have taken hold</w> on me: <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">my delights</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>taken…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">found me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:144
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">The righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of thy testimonies</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give me understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I shall live</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:145
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv112"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ק KOPH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv112"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I cried</w> with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whole heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:146
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto thee; save</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and I shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and I…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">that I may keep</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:147
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I prevented</w> <w lemma="strong:H05399">the dawning of the morning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07768" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and cried</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I hoped</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:148
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06923" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">prevent</w> the <transChange type="added">night</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0821">watches</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I might meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">in thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:149
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">according unto thy lovingkindness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">me according to thy judgment</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:150
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They draw nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that follow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">after mischief</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they are far</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">from thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:151
verses.text: Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04687">and all thy commandments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:152
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05713">Concerning thy testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have known</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that thou hast founded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">them for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:153
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv113"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ר RESH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv113"/><w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">mine affliction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: for I do not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:154
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Plead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">my cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01350" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">me: quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">me according to thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:155
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03444">Salvation</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">from the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">not thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:156
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Great</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07356">thy tender mercies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">me according to thy judgments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Great</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Many</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:157
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">my persecutors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">and mine enemies</w>; <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I not decline</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">from thy testimonies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:158
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the transgressors</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06962" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">and was grieved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">because they kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">not thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:159
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02617">according to thy lovingkindness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:160
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">Thy word</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">true</w> <transChange type="added">from</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the beginning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06664">and every one of thy righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Thy word…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The beginning of thy word is true</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:161
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv114"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ש SCHIN.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv114"/><w lemma="strong:H08269">Princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have persecuted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">me without a cause</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">but my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">standeth in awe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:162
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">I rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">at thy word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as one that findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">spoil</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:163
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08581" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and abhor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lying</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I love</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:164
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07651">Seven times</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">a day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">do I praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thee because of thy righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:165
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">have they which love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04383">and nothing shall offend</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>nothing…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">they shall have no stumblingblock</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 119:166
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have hoped</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">for thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and done</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:167
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">them exceedingly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:168
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">and thy testimonies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">for all my ways</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> before thee.

verses.name: Psalms 119:169
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv115"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ת TAU.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv115"/><w lemma="strong:H07440">Let my cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give me understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:170
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08467">Let my supplication</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thee: deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">me according to thy word</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:171
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">My lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">praise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">when thou hast taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:172
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">My tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">of thy word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04687">for all thy commandments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:173
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Let thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">help</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me; for I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:174
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08373" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have longed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">for thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H08451">and thy law</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">my delight</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 119:175
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Let my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and it shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thee; and let thy judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05826" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">help</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:176
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have gone astray</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">like a lost</w> <w lemma="strong:H07716">sheep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I do not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 119." eID="gen644" osisID="Ps.119"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv116"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv116"/><w lemma="strong:H06869">In my distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he heard</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 120:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">from lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07423">from a deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 120:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">What shall be given</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto thee? or what shall be done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07423">unto thee, thou false</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>What shall be given…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">What shall the deceitful tongue give unto thee?</rdg> or, <rdg type="alternate">what shall is profit thee?</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>done</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">added</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 120:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">arrows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01513">with coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H07574">of juniper</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Sharp…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">It is as the sharp arrows of the mighty man, with coals of juniper</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 120:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0190">Woe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is me, that I sojourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04902">in Mesech</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">in the tents</w> <w lemma="strong:H06938">of Kedar</w>!

verses.name: Psalms 120:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">hath long</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwelt</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with him that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: I <transChange type="added">am for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but when I speak</w>, they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">for war</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for peace</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a man of peace</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 120." eID="gen645" osisID="Ps.120"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv117"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv117"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">unto the hills</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0370">from whence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">my help</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I will…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Shall I lift up mine eyes to the hills? whence should my help come?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05828">My help</w> <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04132">to be moved</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05123" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee will not slumber</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Behold, he that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05123" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall neither slumber</w> <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor sleep</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thy keeper</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">thy shade</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">upon thy right</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03119">thee by day</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03394">nor the moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thee from all evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">thy soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thy going out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and thy coming in</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">from this time forth, and even for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">evermore</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 121." eID="gen646" osisID="Ps.121"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv118"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv118"/><w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I was glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when they said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me, Let us go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">into the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 122:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">Our feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">within thy gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 122:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">as a city</w> <w lemma="strong:H02266" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">that is compact</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 122:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08033">Whither</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07626">the tribes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05715">unto the testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 122:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For there are set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">thrones</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">the thrones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>are…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">do sit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 122:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Pray</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">for the peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07951" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they shall prosper</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that love</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 122:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02426">be within thy walls</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07962">prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">within thy palaces</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 122:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">For my brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">and companions’</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">sakes, I will now say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">Peace</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> within thee.

verses.name: Psalms 122:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">Because of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">thy good</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 122." eID="gen647" osisID="Ps.122"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv119"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv119"/><w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Unto thee lift I up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">O thou that dwellest</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">in the heavens</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 123:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Behold, as the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">of servants</w> <transChange type="added">look</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of their masters</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05869">as the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08198">of a maiden</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">unto the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01404">of her mistress</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">so our eyes</w> <transChange type="added">wait</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">our God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">until that he have mercy</w> upon us.

verses.name: Psalms 123:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">upon us, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">have mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">upon us: for we are exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">with contempt</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 123:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Our soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">is exceedingly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03933">with the scorning</w> <w lemma="strong:H07600">of those that are at ease</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0937">with the contempt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01349 strong:H01343 strong:H03238" morph="strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8678 strongMorph:TH8802">of the proud</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 123." eID="gen648" osisID="Ps.123"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv120"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv120"/><w lemma="strong:H03884">If</w> <transChange type="added">it had not been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">who was on our side, now may Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">say</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 124:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03884">If</w> <transChange type="added">it had not been</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">who was on our side, when men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">rose up</w> against us:

verses.name: Psalms 124:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0233">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they had swallowed us up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">quick</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0639">when their wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H02734" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">was kindled</w> against us:

verses.name: Psalms 124:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0233">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07857" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had overwhelmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">us, the stream</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">our soul</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 124:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0233">Then</w> <w lemma="strong:H02121">the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">had gone over</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">our soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 124:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who hath not given</w> us <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02964">a prey</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">to their teeth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 124:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">Our soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is escaped</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">as a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">out of the snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the fowlers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06341">the snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is broken</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and we are escaped</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 124:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05828">Our help</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 124." eID="gen649" osisID="Ps.124"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv121"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv121"/><w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">as mount</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">cannot be removed</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 125:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">so the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">from henceforth even for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 125:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07626">For the rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">upon the lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04616">lest</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">their hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">unto iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the wicked</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wickedness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 125:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02895" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Do good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, unto <transChange type="added">those that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>, and to <transChange type="added">them that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03826">in their hearts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 125:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">As for such as turn aside</w> <w lemma="strong:H06128">unto their crooked ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall lead them forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 125." eID="gen650" osisID="Ps.125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv122"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv122"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">When the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">turned again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07870">the captivity</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02492" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">we were like them that dream</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>turned…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">returned the returning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 126:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Then was our mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07814">with laughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03956">and our tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">with singing</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then said</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">they among the heathen</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">great things</w> for them.<note type="study"><catchWord>hath…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hath magnified to do with them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 126:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">hath done</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">great things</w> for us; <transChange type="added">whereof</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08056">we are glad</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 126:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Turn again</w> <w lemma="strong:H07622 strong:H07622" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">our captivity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0650">as the streams</w> <w lemma="strong:H05045">in the south</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 126:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that sow</w> <w lemma="strong:H01832">in tears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reap</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">in joy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>joy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">singing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 126:6
