verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He that goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and weepeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H04901">precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H02233">seed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall doubtless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">again with rejoicing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">bringing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0485">his sheaves</w> <transChange type="added">with him</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>precious…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">seed basket</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 126." eID="gen651" osisID="Ps.126"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv123"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">for Solomon</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv123"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">Except the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">build</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that build</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">it: except the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the watchman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">waketh</w> <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of Solomon</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>that…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that are builders of it in it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 127:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">for you to rise up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07925" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sit up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0309" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">late</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H06089">of sorrows</w>: <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03039">his beloved</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">sleep</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 127:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Lo, children</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the womb</w> <transChange type="added">is his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07939">reward</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 127:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">As arrows</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of a mighty man</w>; so <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of the youth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 127:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01397">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0827">that hath his quiver</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">of them: they shall not be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but they shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">with the enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">in the gate</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">filled his quiver with them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>speak…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">subdue</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">destroy</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 127." eID="gen652" osisID="Ps.127"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv124"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv124"/><w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">every one that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 128:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For thou shalt eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03018">the labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of thine hands</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0835">happy</w> <transChange type="added">shalt</transChange> thou <transChange type="added">be</transChange>, and <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> with thee.

verses.name: Psalms 128:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0802">Thy wife</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06509" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as a fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H01612">vine</w> <w lemma="strong:H03411">by the sides</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of thine house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H02132">like olive</w> <w lemma="strong:H08363">plants</w> <w lemma="strong:H05439">round about</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">thy table</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 128:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">Behold, that thus shall the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">be blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 128:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">thee out of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">the good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 128:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Yea, thou shalt see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">upon Israel</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 128." eID="gen653" osisID="Ps.128"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv125"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv125"/><w lemma="strong:H07227">Many a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">me from my youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03478">may Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">now say</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Many…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Much</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 129:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many a time</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they afflicted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">me from my youth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yet they have not prevailed</w> against me.<note type="study"><catchWord>Many…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Much</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 129:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The plowers</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">plowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01354">upon my back</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">they made long</w> <w lemma="strong:H04618 strong:H04618" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">their furrows</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 129:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07112" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath cut asunder</w> <w lemma="strong:H05688">the cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 129:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let them all be confounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">back</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 129:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02682">Let them be as the grass</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01406">the housetops</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which withereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06927">afore</w> <w lemma="strong:H08025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">it groweth up</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 129:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Wherewith the mower</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">filleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">not his hand</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06014" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">nor he that bindeth sheaves</w> <w lemma="strong:H02683">his bosom</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 129:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Neither do they which go by</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01293">The blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon you: we bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">you in the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 129." eID="gen654" osisID="Ps.129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv126"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv126"/><w lemma="strong:H04615">Out of the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 130:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0136">Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">my voice</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0241">let thine ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H07183">be attentive</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">to the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">of my supplications</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 130:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03050">If thou, <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shouldest mark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquities</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0136">O Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who shall stand</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 130:4
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05547">forgiveness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">with thee, that thou mayest be feared</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 130:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">doth wait</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">and in his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">do I hope</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 130:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <transChange type="added">waiteth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0136">for the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">more than they that watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">for the morning</w>: <transChange type="added">I say</transChange>, <transChange type="added">more than</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that watch</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">for the morning</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I say…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">which watch unto</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 130:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Let Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for with the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>, and with him <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">plenteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06304">redemption</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 130:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06299" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And he shall redeem</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">from all his iniquities</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 130." eID="gen655" osisID="Ps.130"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv127"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv127"/><w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is not haughty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05869">nor mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">lofty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">neither do I exercise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">myself in great matters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">or in things too high</w> for me.<note type="study"><catchWord>exercise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">walk</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>high</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wonderful</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 131:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Surely I have behaved</w> <w lemma="strong:H01826" morph="strongMorph:TH8776">and quieted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">myself</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">as a child that is weaned</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">even as a weaned child</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>myself</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">my soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 131:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Let Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05704">from henceforth and for</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>henceforth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">now</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 131." eID="gen656" osisID="Ps.131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv128"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv128"/><w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06031" morph="strongMorph:TH8793">all his afflictions</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 132:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">How he sware</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05087" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">vowed</w> <w lemma="strong:H046">unto the mighty</w> <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 132:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Surely I will not come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0168">into the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of my house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">nor go up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03326 strong:H06210">into my bed</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 132:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08153">sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to mine eyes</w>, <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08572">slumber</w> <w lemma="strong:H06079">to mine eyelids</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 132:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Until I find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04725">a place</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04908">an habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H046">for the mighty</w> <transChange type="added">God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an habitation</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">habitations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 132:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Lo, we heard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0672">of it at Ephratah</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">we found</w> <w lemma="strong:H07704">it in the fields</w> <w lemma="strong:H03293">of the wood</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We will go</w> <w lemma="strong:H04908">into his tabernacles</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">we will worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272 strong:H01916">at his footstool</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Arise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04496">into thy rest</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0727">thou, and the ark</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of thy strength</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03548">Let thy priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be clothed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">with righteousness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02623">and let thy saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shout for joy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05650">For thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sake turn not away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">of thine anointed</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07650" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">hath sworn</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">unto David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will not turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">from it; Of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of thy body</w> <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will I set</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon thy throne</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>body</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">belly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 132:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">If thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">my covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">and my testimony</w> <w lemma="strong:H02097 strong:H02090" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">that</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I shall teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">them, their children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall also sit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">upon thy throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for evermore</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath desired</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04186">for his habitation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:14
verses.text: This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04496">my rest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">here will I dwell</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have desired</w> it.

verses.name: Psalms 132:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">I will abundantly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">her provision</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">her poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>abundantly</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">surely</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 132:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will also clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03548">her priests</w> <w lemma="strong:H03468">with salvation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02623">and her saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall shout aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H07444" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">for joy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 132:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-315">There will I make</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-315">to bud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have ordained</w> <w lemma="strong:H05216">a lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H04899">for mine anointed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 132:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">His enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H03847" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will I clothe</w> <w lemma="strong:H01322">with shame</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05145">but upon himself shall his crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06692" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">flourish</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 132." eID="gen657" osisID="Ps.132"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv129"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv129"/><w lemma="strong:H02896">Behold, how good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05273">and how pleasant</w> <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0251">for brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">together</w> <w lemma="strong:H03162">in unity</w>!<note type="study"><catchWord>together…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">even together</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 133:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">like the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">ointment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that ran down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">upon the beard</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0175">Aaron’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02206">beard</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that went down</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">to the skirts</w> <w lemma="strong:H04060">of his garments</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 133:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02919">As the dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H02768">of Hermon</w>, <transChange type="added">and as the dew</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that descended</w> <w lemma="strong:H02042">upon the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">for there the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">commanded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">the blessing</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for evermore</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 133." eID="gen658" osisID="Ps.133"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv130"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H07892">A Song</w> <w lemma="strong:H04609">of degrees</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv130"/><w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Behold, bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, all <transChange type="added">ye</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">which by night</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 134:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">your hands</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">the sanctuary</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the sanctuary</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">holiness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 134:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">thee out of Zion</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 134." eID="gen659" osisID="Ps.134"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">ye the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">O ye servants</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Ye that stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02691">in the courts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of our God</w>,

verses.name: Psalms 135:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">for the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto his name</w>; for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05273">pleasant</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03050">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">Jacob</w> unto himself, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05459">for his peculiar treasure</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our Lord</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">above all gods</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Whatsoever the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">pleased</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">he in heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and in earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">in the seas</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08415">and all deep places</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05387">He causeth the vapours</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to ascend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07097">from the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">lightnings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">for the rain</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">out of his treasuries</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Who smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">the firstborn</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">both of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">and beast</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>both…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from man unto beast</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 135:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">sent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0226">tokens</w> <w lemma="strong:H04159">and wonders</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">into the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of thee, O Egypt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06547">upon Pharaoh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and upon all his servants</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">Who smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">nations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">mighty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 135:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05747">and Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04467">and all the kingdoms</w> <w lemma="strong:H03667">of Canaan</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 135:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an heritage</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05159">an heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">Thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02143">thy memorial</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>throughout…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to generation and generation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 135:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01777" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will judge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and he will repent</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">himself concerning his servants</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06091">The idols</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">of the heathen</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">and gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04639">the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">They have mouths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">not; eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">have they, but they see</w> not;

verses.name: Psalms 135:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">They have ears</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but they hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">not; neither is there</w> <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07307">breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">in their mouths</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">They that make</w> them are like unto them: <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">every one that trusteth</w> in them.

verses.name: Psalms 135:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H0175">of Aaron</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 135:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01004">O house</w> <w lemma="strong:H03878">of Levi</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03373">ye that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 135:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">be the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">out of Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">at Jerusalem</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 135." eID="gen660" osisID="Ps.135"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; for <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of gods</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">to the Lord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0113">of lords</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">To him who alone doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wonders</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08394">To him that by wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07554" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">To him that stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">above the waters</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">To him that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">lights</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08121">The sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">to rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">by day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>to rule…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">for the rulings by day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 136:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03394">The moon</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">and stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H04475">to rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">by night</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">To him that smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">Egypt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01060">in their firstborn</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And brought out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">from among</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">them: for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02389">With a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and with a stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02220">arm</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01504" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">To him which divided</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H01506">into parts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">And made Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">to pass through</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of it: for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05287" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">But overthrew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06547">Pharaoh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02428">and his host</w> <w lemma="strong:H05488">in the Red</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">sea</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>overthrew</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">shaked off</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 136:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">To him which led</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">his people</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057">through the wilderness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">To him which smote</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And slew</w> <w lemma="strong:H0117">famous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05511">Sihon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H0567">of the Amorites</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05747">And Og</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w> <w lemma="strong:H01316">of Bashan</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">their land</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">for an heritage</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">an heritage</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Who remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08216">us in our low estate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 136:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06561" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And hath redeemed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06862">us from our enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">to all flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 136:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">O give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heaven</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02617">for his mercy</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 136." eID="gen661" osisID="Ps.136"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05104">By the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">there we sat down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01058" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, we wept</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when we remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">Zion</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 137:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08518" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">We hanged</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">our harps</w> <w lemma="strong:H06155">upon the willows</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> thereof.

verses.name: Psalms 137:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07617" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For there they that carried us away captive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">required</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892 strong:H01697">of us a song</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08437">and they that wasted</w> us <transChange type="added">required of us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">mirth</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> us <transChange type="added">one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07892">of the songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a song</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the words of a song</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>wasted…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">laid us on heaps</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 137:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How shall we sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">in a strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">land</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>strange…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">land of a stranger?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 137:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">thee, O Jerusalem</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">let my right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <transChange type="added">her cunning</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 137:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I do not remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">thee, let my tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cleave</w> <w lemma="strong:H02441">to the roof of my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">if I prefer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">not Jerusalem</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">above my chief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my chief…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the head of my joy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 137:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0123">of Edom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">of Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who said</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Rase</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">rase</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03247">to the foundation</w> thereof.<note type="study"><catchWord>Rase it</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Make bare</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 137:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01323">O daughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0894">of Babylon</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">who art to be destroyed</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0835">happy</w> <transChange type="added">shall he be</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that rewardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01576 strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thee as thou hast served</w> us.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wasted</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>rewardeth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">recompenseth unto thee thy deed which thou didst to us</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 137:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">shall he be</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05310" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">and dasheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05768">thy little ones</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">against the stones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the stones</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the rock</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 137." eID="gen662" osisID="Ps.137"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv131"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv131"/><w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thee with my whole heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0430">before the gods</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I sing praise</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 138:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">I will worship</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">toward thy holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">temple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">for thy lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and for thy truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for thou hast magnified</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">above all thy name</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 138:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">In the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou answeredst</w> me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07292" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">strengthenedst</w> me <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">in my soul</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 138:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">All the kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when they hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 138:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, they shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01419">for great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 138:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">Though the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yet hath he respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H08217">unto the lowly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01364">but the proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04801">afar off</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 138:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Though I walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thou wilt revive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me: thou shalt stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">against the wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall save</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 138:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01584" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will perfect</w> <transChange type="added">that which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">concerneth me: thy mercy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">not the works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine own hands</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 138." eID="gen663" osisID="Ps.138"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv132"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv132"/><w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast searched</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me, and known</w> <transChange type="added">me</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou knowest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">my downsitting</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and mine uprising</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou understandest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07454">my thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">afar off</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou compassest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">my path</w> <w lemma="strong:H07252">and my lying down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05532" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and art acquainted</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">all my ways</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>compassest</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">winnowest</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: For <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04405">not a word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">in my tongue</w>, <transChange type="added">but</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">lo, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou knowest</w> it altogether.

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06696" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast beset</w> <w lemma="strong:H0268">me behind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">and before</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thine hand</w> upon me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Such</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06383 strong:H06383" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">too wonderful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">for me; it is high</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03201" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cannot</w> <transChange type="added">attain</transChange> unto it.

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Whither shall I go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">from thy spirit</w>? <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">or whither shall I flee</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">from thy presence</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05266" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I ascend up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">into heaven</w>, thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03331" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">there: if I make my bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">in hell</w>, behold, thou <transChange type="added">art there</transChange>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I take</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671">the wings</w> <w lemma="strong:H07837">of the morning</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in the uttermost parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">of the sea</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">Even there shall thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">me, and thy right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hold</w> me.

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If I say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02822">Surely the darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07779" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall cover</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">me; even the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">shall be light</w> <w lemma="strong:H01157">about me</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02822">Yea, the darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02821" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">not from thee; but the night</w> <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">as the day</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02825">the darkness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0219">and the light</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> both alike <transChange type="added">to thee</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hideth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">darkeneth not</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the darkness and…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">as is the darkness, so is the light</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For thou hast possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03629">my reins</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou hast covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">me in my mother’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">womb</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">thee; for I am fearfully</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06395" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">wonderfully made</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">marvellous</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thy works</w>; and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">right well</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>right…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">greatly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 139:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06108">My substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03582" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">was not hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">from thee, when I was made</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in secret</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07551" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">curiously wrought</w> <w lemma="strong:H08482">in the lowest parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>substance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">strength</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">body</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 139:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">did see</w> <w lemma="strong:H01564">my substance, yet being unperfect</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05612">and in thy book</w> all <transChange type="added">my members</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were written</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in continuance</w> <w lemma="strong:H03335" morph="strongMorph:TH8795">were fashioned</w>, when <transChange type="added">as yet there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0259">none</w> of them.<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">all of them</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>which…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">what days they should be fashioned</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 139:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03365" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H07454">also are thy thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">unto me, O God</w>! <w lemma="strong:H06105" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">how great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">is the sum</w> of them!

verses.name: Psalms 139:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">If</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I should count</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">them, they are more in number</w> <w lemma="strong:H02344">than the sand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">when I awake</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05750">I am still</w> with thee.

verses.name: Psalms 139:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06991" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Surely thou wilt slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0433">O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">from me therefore, ye bloody</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">men</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">against thee wickedly</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06145">thine enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">take</w> <transChange type="added">thy name</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07723">in vain</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Do not I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">them, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06962" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">thee? and am not I grieved</w> <w lemma="strong:H08618">with those that rise up</w> against thee?

verses.name: Psalms 139:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H08503">them with perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">hatred</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">I count them mine enemies</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 139:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Search</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">me, O God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">my heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">try</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">me, and know</w> <w lemma="strong:H08312">my thoughts</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 139:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">And see</w> if <transChange type="added">there be any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06090">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">in me, and lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">me in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">everlasting</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wicked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">way of pain</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">grief</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 139." eID="gen664" osisID="Ps.139"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv133"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H05329" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">To the chief Musician</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv133"/><w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">from the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">me from the violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>violent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">man of violences</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 140:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Which imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischiefs</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H01481" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are they gathered together</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08150" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They have sharpened</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">their tongues</w> <w lemma="strong:H05175">like a serpent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05919">adders’</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">poison</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">under their lips</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">me from the violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">who have purposed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06471">my goings</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01343">The proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">for me, and cords</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">a net</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570 strong:H03027">by the wayside</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have set</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">gins</w> for me. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">of my supplications</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03069">O <divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05797">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">of my salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05526" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast covered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05402">of battle</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Grant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">not, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03970">the desires</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06329" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">further</w> <w lemma="strong:H02162">not his wicked device</w>; <transChange type="added">lest</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they exalt</w> themselves. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">let them not be exalted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 140:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H04524">of those that compass me about</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05999">let the mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of their own lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cover</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 140:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01513">Let burning coals</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131 strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8735">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">upon them: let them be cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">into the fire</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04113">into deep pits</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that they rise not up again</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956 strong:H0376">Let not an evil speaker</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">the violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04073">to overthrow</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">an evil speaker (Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of tongue</rdg>), a wicked man of violence, be established in the earth: let him be hunted to his overthrow</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 140:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">that the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will maintain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">the cause</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the afflicted</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">the right</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">of the poor</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 140:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">Surely the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">unto thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03477">the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in thy presence</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 140." eID="gen665" osisID="Ps.140"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv134"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv134"/><w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">unto thee: make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">unto me; give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">unto my voice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I cry</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 141:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08605">Let my prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be set forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> thee <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07004">incense</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04864">the lifting up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">of my hands</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06153">the evening</w> <w lemma="strong:H04503">sacrifice</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>set…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">directed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 141:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07896" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Set</w> <w lemma="strong:H08108">a watch</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">before my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of my lips</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 141:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">not my heart</w> to <transChange type="added">any</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thing</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05953" morph="strongMorph:TH8705">to practise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05949">works</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">with men</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and let me not eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04516">of their dainties</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 141:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">Let the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01986" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">smite</w> me; <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">a kindness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and let him reprove</w> me; <transChange type="added">it shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">an excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">oil</w>, <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05106" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not break</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">my head</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08605">for yet my prayer</w> also <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in their calamities</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>me; it shall be a…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 141:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">When their judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H08058" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H05553">in stony</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they shall hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">my words</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they are sweet</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 141:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06106">Our bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are scattered</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">at the grave’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as when one cutteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and cleaveth</w> <transChange type="added">wood</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">upon the earth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 141:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">But mine eyes</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03069">unto thee, O <divineName>God</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0136">the Lord</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in thee is my trust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-316">leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">not my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06168" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-316">destitute</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>leave…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">make not my soul bare</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 141:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341 strong:H03027">me from the snares</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">for me, and the gins</w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 141:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">Let the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04364">into their own nets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03162">whilst that I withal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">escape</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>escape</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">pass over</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 141." eID="gen666" osisID="Ps.141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv135"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04905" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Maschil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08605">A Prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H04631">when he was in the cave</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv135"/><w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">with my voice</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">with my voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">did I make my supplication</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Maschil…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">A Psalm of David, giving instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 142:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I poured out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07879">my complaint</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">him; I shewed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">him my trouble</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 142:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">When my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">was overwhelmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">within me, then thou knewest</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">my path</w>. <w lemma="strong:H0734">In the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I walked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have they privily laid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">a snare</w> for me.

verses.name: Psalms 142:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">I looked</w> on <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">right hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and beheld</w>, but <transChange type="added">there was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">no man that would know</w> <w lemma="strong:H04498">me: refuge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">failed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me; no man cared</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for my soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I looked…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Look on the right hand, and see</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>failed…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">perished from me</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>cared…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sought after</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 142:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02199" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I cried</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I said</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04268">my refuge</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">my portion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of the living</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 142:6
