verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H07440">unto my cry</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-317">for I am brought</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">very</w> <w lemma="strong:H01809" morph="strongMorph:TH8804" type="x-split-317">low</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">me from my persecutors</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for they are stronger</w> than I.

verses.name: Psalms 142:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H04525">out of prison</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">that I may praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03803" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall compass me about</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">for thou shalt deal bountifully</w> with me. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 142." eID="gen667" osisID="Ps.142"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv136"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H04210">A Psalm</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv136"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">my prayer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">give ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">to my supplications</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0530">in thy faithfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">answer</w> me, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06666">in thy righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not into judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440">for in thy sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">shall no man living</w> <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be justified</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For the enemy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath persecuted</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-318">he hath smitten</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">my life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01792" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-318">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">he hath made me to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04285">in darkness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05769">as those that have been long</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">dead</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">Therefore is my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05848" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">overwhelmed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">within me; my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">within</w> <w lemma="strong:H08074" morph="strongMorph:TH8709">me is desolate</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06924">of old</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06467">on all thy works</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">I muse</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">on the work</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thy hands</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I stretch forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto thee: my soul</w> <transChange type="added">thirsteth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05889">after thee, as a thirsty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">land</w>. <w lemma="strong:H05542">Selah</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04118">me speedily</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">faileth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">not thy face</w> <w lemma="strong:H04911" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">from me, lest I be like</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto them that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">for I am become like</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 143:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Cause me to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">thy lovingkindness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">in the morning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for in thee do I trust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">cause me to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02098">wherein</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I should walk</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 143:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">from mine enemies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I flee unto thee to hide</w> me.<note type="study"><catchWord>flee…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hide me with thee</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 143:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">thy will</w>; for thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">my God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07307">thy spirit</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">me into the land</w> <w lemma="strong:H04334">of uprightness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H08034">for thy name’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">sake: for thy righteousness’</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sake bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">out of trouble</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 143:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">And of thy mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06789" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">mine enemies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06887" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all them that afflict</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">my soul</w>: for I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 143." eID="gen668" osisID="Ps.143"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv137"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><transChange type="added">A Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv137"/><w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06697">my strength</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">which teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07128">to war</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0676">my fingers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">to fight</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>strength</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rock</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>to war…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to the war</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 144:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">My goodness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04686">and my fortress</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04869">my high tower</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06403" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and my deliverer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04043">my shield</w>, and <transChange type="added">he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">in whom I trust</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07286" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who subdueth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">my people</w> under me.<note type="study"><catchWord>My goodness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">My mercy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 144:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068"><divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, what <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou takest knowledge</w> of him! <transChange type="added">or</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0582">of man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">that thou makest account</w> of him!

verses.name: Psalms 144:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">Man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01819" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is like</w> <w lemma="strong:H01892">to vanity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03117">his days</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06738">as a shadow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that passeth away</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 144:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">thy heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and come down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">touch</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">the mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06225" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they shall smoke</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 144:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01299" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cast forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01300">lightning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and scatter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">them: shoot out</w> <w lemma="strong:H02671">thine arrows</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02000" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and destroy</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 144:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Send</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">from above</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">rid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">me out of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>hand from</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">hands from</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 144:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">Whose mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and their right hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">a right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of falsehood</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 144:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto thee, O God</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05035">upon a psaltery</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06218">an instrument of ten strings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I sing praises</w> unto thee.

verses.name: Psalms 144:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is he</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08668">salvation</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">unto kings</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">David</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">his servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from the hurtful</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>salvation</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">victory</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 144:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06475" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Rid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">me, and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">me from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H05236">of strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">whose mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03225">and their right hand</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">a right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of falsehood</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 144:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">That our sons</w> <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05195">as plants</w> <w lemma="strong:H01431" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">grown up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">in their youth</w>; <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01323">our daughters</w> <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02106">as corner stones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02404" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">polished</w> <transChange type="added">after</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08403">the similitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01964">of a palace</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>polished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">cut</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 144:13
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04200">our garners</w> <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06329" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">affording</w> <w lemma="strong:H02177 strong:H02177">all manner of store</w>: <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06629">our sheep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0503" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">may bring forth thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07231" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">and ten thousands</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">in our streets</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>all…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">from kind to kind</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 144:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">That</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">our oxen</w> <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05445" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">strong to labour</w>; <transChange type="added">that there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06556">no breaking in</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">nor going out</w>; that <transChange type="added">there be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06682">no complaining</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in our streets</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>strong…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">able to bear burdens</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">loaden with flesh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 144:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03602">that is in such a case</w>: <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0835">happy</w> <transChange type="added">is that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05971">people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0430">whose God</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 144." eID="gen669" osisID="Ps.144"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv138"/><title canonical="true" type="psalm"><w lemma="strong:H01732">David’s</w> <transChange type="added">Psalm</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">of praise</w>.</title><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv138"/><w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">I will extol</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thee, my God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">O king</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">Every day</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee; and I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">Great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03966">and greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">to be praised</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01420">and his greatness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02714">unsearchable</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">and of his greatness there is no search</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 145:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01755">One</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thy works</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to another, and shall declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">thy mighty acts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of the glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">of thy majesty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and of thy wondrous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">works</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>works</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">things</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 145:6
verses.text: And <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05807">of the might</w> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of thy terrible acts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will declare</w> <w lemma="strong:H01420">thy greatness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>declare</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">declare it</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 145:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">They shall abundantly utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H02143">the memory</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of thy great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">goodness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and shall sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of thy righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02587">gracious</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07349">and full of compassion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01419">and of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">mercy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of great…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">great in mercy</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 145:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07356">to all: and his tender mercies</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">over all his works</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04639">All thy works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thee, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H02623">and thy saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall bless</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 145:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">They shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">of the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of thy kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">of thy power</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 145:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">his mighty acts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and the glorious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01926">majesty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">of his kingdom</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04438">Thy kingdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04438">kingdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04475">and thy dominion</w> <transChange type="added">endureth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01755">throughout all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a kingdom of all ages</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 145:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05564" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all that fall</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and raiseth up</w> all <transChange type="added">those that be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03721" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">bowed down</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07663" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">of all wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">upon thee; and thou givest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">them their meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in due season</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wait…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">look unto</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 145:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06605" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Thou openest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">thine hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and satisfiest</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of every living thing</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in all his ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02623">and holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">in all his works</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>holy</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">merciful</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">bountiful</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 145:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto all them that call</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon him, to all that call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">upon him in truth</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will fulfil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">of them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: he also will hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07775">their cry</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will save</w> them.

verses.name: Psalms 145:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">preserveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all them that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">him: but all the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will he destroy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 145:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">My mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H08416">the praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H01320">and let all flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">bless</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">his holy</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">name</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 145." eID="gen670" osisID="Ps.145"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">O my soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 146:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">While I live</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will I praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto my God</w> while I have any being.

verses.name: Psalms 146:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Put not your trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">in princes</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">in the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>, in whom <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">no help</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>help</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">salvation</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 146:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">His breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth forth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he returneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">to his earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03117">in that very day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06250">his thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perish</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 146:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">is he</transChange> that <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">the God</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">of Jacob</w> <w lemma="strong:H05828">for his help</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07664">whose hope</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">his God</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 146:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">heaven</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0776">and earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03220">the sea</w>, and all that therein <transChange type="added">is</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 146:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which executeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">for the oppressed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">food</w> <w lemma="strong:H07457">to the hungry</w>. <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05425" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">looseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the prisoners</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 146:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">openeth</w> <transChange type="added">the eyes of</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05787">the blind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">raiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03721" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">them that are bowed down</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 146:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">preserveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01616">the strangers</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8766">he relieveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03490">the fatherless</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">and widow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">but the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05791" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he turneth upside down</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 146:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall reign</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06726">O Zion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01755">unto all</w> <w lemma="strong:H01755">generations</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 146." eID="gen671" osisID="Ps.146"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto our God</w>; for <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05273">pleasant</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05000">is comely</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doth build up</w> <w lemma="strong:H03389">Jerusalem</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03664" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he gathereth together</w> <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">the outcasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07495" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He healeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">the broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02280" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and bindeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06094">their wounds</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wounds</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">griefs</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 147:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04487" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He telleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04557">the number</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">of the stars</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he calleth</w> them all by <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">names</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">Great</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0113">our Lord</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07227">and of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">power</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08394">his understanding</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04557">infinite</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of his understanding there is no number</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 147:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8767">lifteth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035">the meek</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-319">he casteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08213" morph="strongMorph:TH8688" type="x-split-319">down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">to the ground</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08426">with thanksgiving</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">sing praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">upon the harp</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">unto our God</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 147:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Who covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heaven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05645">with clouds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">who prepareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04306">rain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">for the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02682">who maketh grass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06779" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to grow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02022">upon the mountains</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">to the beast</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">his food</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the young</w> <w lemma="strong:H06158">ravens</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which cry</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He delighteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">not in the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H05483">of the horse</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he taketh not pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07785">in the legs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">taketh pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">in them that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him, in those that hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">in his mercy</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07623" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03389">O Jerusalem</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">thy God</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06726">O Zion</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">For he hath strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H01280">the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of thy gates</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">he hath blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy children</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">within</w> thee.

verses.name: Psalms 147:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w> <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01366">thy borders</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">filleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02459">thee with the finest</w> <w lemma="strong:H02406">of the wheat</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Who maketh thy border peace</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>finest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">fat of wheat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 147:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He sendeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">his commandment</w> <transChange type="added">upon</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">runneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04120">very swiftly</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07950">snow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06785">like wool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he scattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03713">the hoarfrost</w> <w lemma="strong:H0665">like ashes</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07993" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He casteth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07140">his ice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">like morsels</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who can stand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07135">his cold</w>?

verses.name: Psalms 147:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He sendeth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04529" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and melteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">them: he causeth his wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05380" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to blow</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04325">the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">flow</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 147:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He sheweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697 strong:H01697" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">his word</w> <w lemma="strong:H03290">unto Jacob</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02706">his statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and his judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">unto Israel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his word</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his words</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 147:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath not dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">so with any nation</w>: and <transChange type="added">as for his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they have not known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">them. Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 147." eID="gen672" osisID="Ps.147"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">from the heavens</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">him in the heights</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName>. Praise</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg>, etc</note>

verses.name: Psalms 148:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">ye him, all his angels</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06635">ye him, all his hosts</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 148:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08121">ye him, sun</w> <w lemma="strong:H03394">and moon</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03556">him, all ye stars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">of light</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 148:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">him, ye heavens</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">of heavens</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">and ye waters</w> that <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08064">above the heavens</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 148:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Let them praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for he commanded</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01254" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and they were created</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 148:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He hath also stablished</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">them for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">and ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">a decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">which shall not pass</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 148:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08577">ye dragons</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08415">and all deeps</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 148:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0784">Fire</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01259">and hail</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07950">snow</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07008">and vapour</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05591">stormy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">wind</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">fulfilling</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">his word</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 148:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Mountains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01389">and all hills</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06529">fruitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06086">trees</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0730">and all cedars</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 148:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">Beasts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0929">and all cattle</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07431">creeping things</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03671">and flying</w> <w lemma="strong:H06833">fowl</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>flying…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">birds of wing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 148:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">Kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">and all people</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08269">princes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and all judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 148:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0970">Both young men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01330">and maidens</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02205">old men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">and children</w>:

verses.name: Psalms 148:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Let them praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">for his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">alone is excellent</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01935">his glory</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0776">above the earth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">and heaven</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>excellent</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">exalted</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 148:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He also exalteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07161">the horn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of his people</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08416">the praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">of all his saints</w>; <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">a people</w> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">unto him. Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 148." eID="gen673" osisID="Ps.148"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H07891" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Sing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02319">a new</w> <w lemma="strong:H07892">song</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08416">his praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">of saints</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 149:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03478">Let Israel</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">in him that made</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">him: let the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H06726">of Zion</w> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">in their King</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in him…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his Makers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 149:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Let them praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w> <w lemma="strong:H04234">in the dance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02167" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let them sing praises</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">unto him with the timbrel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harp</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">with the pipe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 149:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">taketh pleasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">in his people</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06286" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he will beautify</w> <w lemma="strong:H06035">the meek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03444">with salvation</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 149:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02623">Let the saints</w> <w lemma="strong:H05937" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be joyful</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">in glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">let them sing aloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">upon their beds</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 149:6
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Let</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07319">the high</w> <transChange type="added">praises</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0410">of God</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01627">in their mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06374">and a twoedged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in their hand</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">throat</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 149:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H05360">vengeance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">upon the heathen</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08433">punishments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">upon the people</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 149:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0631" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">their kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02131">with chains</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and their nobles</w> <w lemma="strong:H03525">with fetters</w> <w lemma="strong:H01270">of iron</w>;

verses.name: Psalms 149:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To execute</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">upon them the judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">written</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01926">this honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">have all his saints</w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 149." eID="gen674" osisID="Ps.149"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0410">God</w> <w lemma="strong:H06944">in his sanctuary</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07549">him in the firmament</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">of his power</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Praise ye…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Hallelujah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 150:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01369">him for his mighty acts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">him according to his excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01433">greatness</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 150:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08629">him with the sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07782">of the trumpet</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05035">him with the psaltery</w> <w lemma="strong:H03658">and harp</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>trumpet</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">cornet</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 150:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08596">him with the timbrel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04234">and dance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04482">him with stringed instruments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05748">and organs</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>dance</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">pipe</rdg></note>

verses.name: Psalms 150:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08088">him upon the loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H06767">cymbals</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08643">him upon the high sounding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06767">cymbals</w>.

verses.name: Psalms 150:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05397">Let every thing that hath breath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03050">ye the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 150." eID="gen675" osisID="Ps.150"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen525" osisID="Ps" type="book"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04912">The proverbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <w lemma="strong:H01732">of David</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03478">of Israel</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To know</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">and instruction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to perceive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">of understanding</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">the instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06664">justice</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04339">and equity</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>equity</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">equities</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To give</w> <w lemma="strong:H06195">subtilty</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">to the simple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">to the young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">and discretion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discretion</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">advisement</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and will increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03948">learning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and a man of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall attain</w> <w lemma="strong:H08458">unto wise counsels</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H04912">a proverb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04426">and the interpretation</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01697">the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02420">and their dark sayings</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the interpretation</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">an eloquent speech</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0191">fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">and instruction</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the beginning</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the principal part</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">the instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of thy father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">not the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:9
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03880">an ornament</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">of grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">unto thy head</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06060">and chains</w> <w lemma="strong:H01621">about thy neck</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an adding</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02400">if sinners</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">entice</w> <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thee, consent</w> thou not.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">If they say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">with us, let us lay wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">for blood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us lurk</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">privily for the innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Let us swallow them up</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">alive</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">as the grave</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08549">and whole</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">as those that go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">into the pit</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">We shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">all precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">substance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">we shall fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">our houses</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">with spoil</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H01486">in thy lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0259">us; let us all have one</w> <w lemma="strong:H03599">purse</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not thou in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">with them; refrain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">from their path</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">For their feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">run</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to evil</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and make haste</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02600">Surely in vain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07568">the net</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">is spread</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03671 strong:H01167">of any bird</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in the…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the eyes of every thing that hath a wing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And they lay wait</w> for their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they lurk privily</w> for their <transChange type="added">own</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">lives</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:19
verses.text: So <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of every one that is greedy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">of gain</w>; <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taketh away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">of the owners</w> thereof.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02454">Wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">her voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>Wisdom</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Wisdoms</rdg>, that is, <rdg type="x-meaning">Excellent wisdom</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the chief place</w> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of concourse</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06607">in the openings</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">of the gates</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05892">in the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">her words</w>, <transChange type="added">saying</transChange>,

verses.name: Proverbs 1:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06612">How long, ye simple ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will ye love</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">simplicity</w>? <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and the scorners</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03944">in their scorning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03684">and fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 1:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">you at my reproof</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">behold, I will pour out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">my spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">unto you, I will make known</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w> unto you.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Because I have called</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and ye refused</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have stretched out</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">my hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and no man regarded</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">But ye have set at nought</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">all my counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and would</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">none of my reproof</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I also will laugh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">at your calamity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will mock</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">when your fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 1:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06343">When your fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07584 strong:H07722" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">as desolation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0343">and your destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0857" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05492">as a whirlwind</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06869">when distress</w> <w lemma="strong:H06695">and anguish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh</w> upon you.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shall they call</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">upon me, but I will not answer</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">they shall seek me early</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but they shall not find</w> me:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For that they hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and did not choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 1:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They would</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">none of my counsel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">all my reproof</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Therefore shall they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">of the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of their own way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H04156">with their own devices</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 1:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04878">For the turning away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">of the simple</w> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall slay</w> <w lemma="strong:H07962">them, and the prosperity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall destroy</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>turning…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">ease of the simple</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But whoso hearkeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto me shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07599" morph="strongMorph:TH8768">and shall be quiet</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">from fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 1." eID="gen677" osisID="Prov.1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if thou wilt receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w> with thee;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">So that thou incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">unto wisdom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">apply</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">to understanding</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Yea, if thou criest</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">after knowledge</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">liftest up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">thy voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">for understanding</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>liftest…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">givest thy voice</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">If thou seekest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">her as silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and searchest</w> for her as <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04301">hid treasures</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shalt thou understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and find</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of his mouth</w> <transChange type="added">cometh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">and understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06845 strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">He layeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">sound wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">for the righteous</w>: <transChange type="added">he is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04043">a buckler</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">uprightly</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">He keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and preserveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02623">of his saints</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shalt thou understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04339">and equity</w>; <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">every good</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">path</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:10
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02451">When wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">entereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">into thine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto thy soul</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04209">Discretion</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">thee, understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall keep</w> thee:

verses.name: Proverbs 2:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee from the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the evil</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0376">from the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08419">froward things</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Who leave</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">of uprightness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">of darkness</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08056">Who rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01523" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08419">in the frowardness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the wicked</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">Whose ways</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06141">crooked</w>, and <transChange type="added">they</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03868" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">in their paths</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 2:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">To deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thee from the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05237">from the stranger</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">flattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">with her words</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 2:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Which forsaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">the guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of her youth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and forgetteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01285">the covenant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of her God</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">For her house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07743" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">inclineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">unto death</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04570">and her paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07496">unto the dead</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">None that go</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">unto her return again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">neither take they hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">of the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">That thou mayest walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">of good</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03477">For the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the land</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08549">and the perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03498" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall remain</w> in it.

verses.name: Proverbs 2:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">But the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut off</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">from the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H05255" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be rooted out</w> of it.<note type="study"><catchWord>rooted</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">plucked up</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 2." eID="gen678" osisID="Prov.2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">not my law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03820">but let thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 3:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">For length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and long</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07965">and peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall they add</w> to thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>long…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">years of life</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Let not mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee: bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H01621">them about thy neck</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">them upon the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of thine heart</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 3:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">So shalt thou find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0430">of God</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">and man</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>good…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">good success</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:5
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">with all thine heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08172" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">and lean</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">not unto thine own understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">In all thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">acknowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">him, and he shall direct</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">thy paths</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:7
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02450">Be not wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in thine own eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07500">It shall be health</w> <w lemma="strong:H08270">to thy navel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08250">and marrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">to thy bones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>health</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">medicine</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>marrow</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">watering</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">moistening</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">with thy substance</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07225">and with the firstfruits</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">of all thine increase</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 3:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0618">So shall thy barns</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07647">with plenty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03342">and thy presses</w> <w lemma="strong:H06555" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall burst out</w> <w lemma="strong:H08492">with new wine</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:11
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">not the chastening</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H06973" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither be weary</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">of his correction</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 3:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For whom the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he correcteth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01">even as a father</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">the son</w> <transChange type="added">in whom</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he delighteth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0835">Happy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0120">and the man</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06329" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">getteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">understanding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that getteth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">that draweth out understanding</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05504">For the merchandise</w> of it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H05505">than the merchandise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08393">and the gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">thereof than fine gold</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:15
verses.text: She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">more precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H06443">than rubies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02656">and all the things thou canst desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are not to be compared</w> unto her.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0753">Length</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">of days</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03225">in her right hand</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08040">in her left hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Her ways</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H05278">of pleasantness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05410">and all her paths</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07965">peace</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:18
verses.text: She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w> <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to them that lay hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">upon her: and happy</w> <transChange type="added">is every one</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that retaineth</w> her.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">by wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H03245" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath founded</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08394">by understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8790">hath he established</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>established</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prepared</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:20
