verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01847">By his knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H01234" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are broken up</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07834">and the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H07491" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drop down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02919">the dew</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:21
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03868" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let not them depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from thine eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">sound wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">and discretion</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 3:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02416">So shall they be life</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto thy soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02580">and grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H01621">to thy neck</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shalt thou walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">safely</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H05062" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not stumble</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">When thou liest down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06342" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou shalt not be afraid</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">yea, thou shalt lie down</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08142">and thy sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be sweet</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Be not afraid</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">of sudden</w> <w lemma="strong:H06343">fear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07722">neither of the desolation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when it cometh</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">For the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03689">shall be thy confidence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H03921">from being taken</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:27
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Withhold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">from them to whom it is due</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0410">when it is in the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of thine hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>them…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the owners thereof</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">not unto thy neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and come again</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04279">and to morrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will give</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03426">when thou hast</w> it by thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">not evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">against thy neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">seeing he dwelleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">securely</w> by thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>Devise…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Practise no evil</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:30
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07378" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Strive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">not with a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02600">without cause</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if he have done</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thee no harm</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:31
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H07065" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555 strong:H0376">thou not the oppressor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and choose</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">none of his ways</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the oppressor</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of violence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03868" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">For the froward</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H05475">but his secret</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">with the righteous</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:33
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03994">The curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">but he blesseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">the habitation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Surely he scorneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">the scorners</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">grace</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041 strong:H06035" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">unto the lowly</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 3:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">The wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">glory</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07036">but shame</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">shall be the promotion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall be…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">exalteth the fools</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 3." eID="gen679" osisID="Prov.3"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">ye children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04148">the instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of a father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to know</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For I give</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">you good</w> <w lemma="strong:H03948">doctrine</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">ye not my law</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01">For I was my father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07390">tender</w> <w lemma="strong:H03173">and only</w> <transChange type="added">beloved</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the sight</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of my mother</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">He taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">me also, and said</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">unto me, Let thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">retain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">my words</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and live</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">forget</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">not; neither decline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">from the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her not, and she shall preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thee: love</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">her, and she shall keep</w> thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07225">the principal thing</w>; <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07075">and with all thy getting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">get understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8769">Exalt</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">her, and she shall promote</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">thee: she shall bring thee to honour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">when thou dost embrace</w> her.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">to thine head</w> <w lemma="strong:H03880">an ornament</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">of grace</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05850">a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H04042" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall she deliver</w> to thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>a crown…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">she shall compass thee with a crown of glory</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">O my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">my sayings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08141">and the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be many</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have taught</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thee in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">I have led</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">thee in right</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">paths</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When thou goest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06806">thy steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H03334" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not be straitened</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and when thou runnest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">thou shalt not stumble</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Take fast hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">of instruction</w>; let <transChange type="added">her</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not go</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> her; for she <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">thy life</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:14
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">not into the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">not in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Avoid</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it, pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H07847" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">not by it, turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">from it, and pass away</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">For they sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">not, except they have done mischief</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08142">and their sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01497" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is taken away</w>, unless they cause <transChange type="added">some</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03782 strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">to fall</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For they eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">the bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">of wickedness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">the wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H02555">of violence</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">But the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05051">as the shining</w> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0215" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that shineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">more</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and more unto the perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">day</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0653">as darkness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they know</w> <w lemma="strong:H03782" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not at what they stumble</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">to my words</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">unto my sayings</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03868" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Let them not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">from thine eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">them in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of thine heart</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:22
verses.text: For they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto those that find</w> <w lemma="strong:H04832">them, and health</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">to all their flesh</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>health</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">medicine</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:23
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">thy heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04929">with all diligence</w>; for out of it <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08444">the issues</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">above all keeping</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Put away</w> <w lemma="strong:H06143">from thee a froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03891">and perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">put far</w> from thee.<note type="study"><catchWord>a froward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">frowardness of mouth and perverseness of lips</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">Let thine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">look</w> <w lemma="strong:H05227">right on</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06079">and let thine eyelids</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">look straight</w> before thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 4:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06424" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Ponder</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">of thy feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">and let all thy ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be established</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>let…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">all thy ways shall be ordered aright</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Turn</w> <w lemma="strong:H03225">not to the right hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H08040">nor to the left</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">thy foot</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 4." eID="gen680" osisID="Prov.4"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">unto my wisdom</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">thine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">to my understanding</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 5:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That thou mayest regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">discretion</w>, and <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">thy lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">may keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:3
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08193">For the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">of a strange woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05197" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">drop</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05317">an honeycomb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02441">and her mouth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02509">smoother</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">than oil</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>mouth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">palate</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0319">But her end</w> <w lemma="strong:H04751">is bitter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03939">as wormwood</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02299">sharp</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">as a twoedged</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">sword</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07272">Her feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">to death</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06806">her steps</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">on hell</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06424" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">Lest thou shouldest ponder</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04570">her ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H05128" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">are moveable</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou canst not know</w> <transChange type="added">them</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">me now therefore, O ye children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">not from the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-320">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thy way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8685" type="x-split-320">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07126" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">from her, and come not nigh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of her house</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 5:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lest thou give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01935">thine honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0312">unto others</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and thy years</w> <w lemma="strong:H0394">unto the cruel</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 5:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Lest strangers</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03581">with thy wealth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06089">and thy labours</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of a stranger</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>thy wealth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">thy strength</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05098" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And thou mourn</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">at the last</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01320">when thy flesh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">and thy body</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are consumed</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 5:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">How have I hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">and my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">despised</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">reproof</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 5:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">And have not obeyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">the voice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of my teachers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">nor inclined</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">mine ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">to them that instructed</w> me!

verses.name: Proverbs 5:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04592">I was almost</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in all evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">of the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H05712">and assembly</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:15
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H0953">out of thine own cistern</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05140" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and running waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">out of</w> <w lemma="strong:H0875">thine own well</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04599">Let thy fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H06327" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be dispersed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02351">abroad</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06388">rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’</w> with thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04726">Let thy fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">be blessed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and rejoice</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with the wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H05271">of thy youth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Let her be as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0158">the loving</w> <w lemma="strong:H0365">hind</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">and pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H03280">roe</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01717">let her breasts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">thee at all times</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and be thou ravished</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">always</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">with her love</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>satisfy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">water thee</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>be thou…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">err thou always in her love</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">And why wilt thou, my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">be ravished</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">with a strange woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02263" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and embrace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">the bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of a stranger</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 5:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">For the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05227">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06424" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and he pondereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04570">all his goings</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 5:22
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H05771">His own iniquities</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall take</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">himself, and he shall be holden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02256">with the cords</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">of his sins</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sins</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sin</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He shall die</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">without instruction</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07230">and in the greatness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">of his folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall go astray</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 5." eID="gen681" osisID="Prov.5"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">if thou be surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">for thy friend</w>, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou hast stricken</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">thy hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">with a stranger</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03369" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">Thou art snared</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">with the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">thou art taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">with the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Do</w> <w lemma="strong:H0645">this now</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">and deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thyself, when thou art come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">into the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of thy friend</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">go</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07511" morph="strongMorph:TH8690">humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07292" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thyself, and make sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">thy friend</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>and make…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">so shalt thou prevail with thy friend</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Give</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">not sleep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to thine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08572">nor slumber</w> <w lemma="strong:H06079">to thine eyelids</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8734">Deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H06643">thyself as a roe</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <transChange type="added">of the hunter</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06833">and as a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">from the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03353">of the fowler</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05244">to the ant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06102">thou sluggard</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">consider</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">her ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be wise</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 6:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07101">Which having no guide</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07860" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">overseer</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">or ruler</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Provideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">her meat</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">in the summer</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0103" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03978">her food</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">in the harvest</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">How long wilt thou sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06102">O sluggard</w>? <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when wilt thou arise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">out of thy sleep</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 6:10
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H08572">slumber</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H02264">folding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">of the hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to sleep</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 6:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07389">So shall thy poverty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">as one that travelleth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04270">and thy want</w> <w lemma="strong:H04043">as an armed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:12
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01100">A naughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">person</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0205">a wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06143">with a froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07169" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He winketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with his eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04448" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">with his feet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">with his fingers</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08419">Frowardness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in his heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischief</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">continually</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he soweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04090 strong:H04066" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">discord</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>soweth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">casteth forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0343">Therefore shall his calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">suddenly</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06621">suddenly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07665" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall he be broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H04832">without remedy</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:16
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" subType="x-added" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08337">These six</w> <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">doth the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hate</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07651">yea, seven</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">unto him</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>unto…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of his soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">A proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">look</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08267">a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03027">and hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H08210" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that shed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05355">innocent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">blood</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>A proud…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Haughty eyes</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">An heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">imaginations</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that be swift</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">in running</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">to mischief</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 6:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08267">A false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">and he that soweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04090">discord</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">among brethren</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:20
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">thy father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandment</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">not the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of thy mother</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 6:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">them continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">upon thine heart</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06029" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">tie</w> <w lemma="strong:H01621">them about thy neck</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">When thou goest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it shall lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H07901" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">thee; when thou sleepest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall keep</w> thee; and <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06974" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">thou awakest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall talk</w> with thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04687">For the commandment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05216">a lamp</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08451">and the law</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0216">light</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08433">and reproofs</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">of instruction</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>lamp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">thee from the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02513">from the flattery</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">of the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of a strange woman</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of the…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">of the strange tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Lust</w> <w lemma="strong:H03308">not after her beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">in thine heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither let her take</w> <w lemma="strong:H06079">thee with her eyelids</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01157">For by means of</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a whorish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <transChange type="added">a man is brought</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03603">to a piece</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376 strong:H0802">and the adulteress</w> <w lemma="strong:H06679" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will hunt</w> <w lemma="strong:H03368">for the precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">life</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the adulteress</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the woman of a man</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">a man’s wife</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Can a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02846" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in his bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0899">and his clothes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08313" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not be burned</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 6:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Can one</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01513">upon hot coals</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07272">and his feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H03554" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">not be burned</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 6:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">So he that goeth in</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">to his neighbour’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05060" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whosoever toucheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">her shall not be innocent</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:30
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">do not despise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01590">a thief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">if he steal</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to satisfy</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">when he is hungry</w>;

verses.name: Proverbs 6:31
verses.text: But <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">he be found</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">he shall restore</w> <w lemma="strong:H07659">sevenfold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he shall give</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">all the substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of his house</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:32
verses.text: <transChange type="added">But</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05003" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">whoso committeth adultery</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">with a woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">lacketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">understanding</w>: he <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">doeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">it destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>understanding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05061">A wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">and dishonour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he get</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02781">and his reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H04229" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be wiped away</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07068">For jealousy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02534">the rage</w> <w lemma="strong:H01397">of a man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02550" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">therefore he will not spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05359">of vengeance</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 6:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He will not regard</w> <w lemma="strong:H03724">any ransom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H014" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">neither will he rest content</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">though thou givest many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">gifts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He will…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He will not accept the face of any ransom</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 6." eID="gen682" osisID="Prov.6"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">My son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">my words</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lay up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w> with thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">my commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08451">and my law</w> <w lemma="strong:H0380">as the apple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of thine eye</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07194" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Bind</w> <w lemma="strong:H0676">them upon thy fingers</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03789" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">write</w> <w lemma="strong:H03871">them upon the table</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of thine heart</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">unto wisdom</w>, Thou <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0269">my sister</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and call</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w> <transChange type="added">thy</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04129">kinswoman</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 7:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">That they may keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">thee from the strange</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05237">from the stranger</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">flattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">with her words</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:6
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H02474">For at the window</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of my house</w> <w lemma="strong:H08259" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I looked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0822">through my casement</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">And beheld</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">among the simple ones</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I discerned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">among the youths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05288">a young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">void</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of understanding</w>,<note type="study"><catchWord>the youths</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the sons</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Passing through</w> <w lemma="strong:H07784">the street</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H06434">her corner</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06805" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he went</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">to her house</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05399">In the twilight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06153 strong:H03117">in the evening</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0380">in the black</w> <w lemma="strong:H0653">and dark</w> <w lemma="strong:H03915">night</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>in the evening</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the evening of days</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">And, behold, there met</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">him a woman</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07897">the attire</w> <w lemma="strong:H02181" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of an harlot</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">and subtil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:11
verses.text: (She <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05637" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and stubborn</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07272">her feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">not in her house</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 7:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06471">Now</w> <transChange type="added">is she</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02351">without</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06471">now</w> <w lemma="strong:H07339">in the streets</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and lieth in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H0681">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">every corner</w>.)

verses.name: Proverbs 7:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02388" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">So she caught</w> <w lemma="strong:H05401" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">him, and kissed</w> him, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">with an impudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">face</w> <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">said</w> unto him,<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">she strengthened her face and said</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">I have</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08002">peace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">offerings</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">with me; this day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I payed</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">my vows</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>I have…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Peace offerings are upon me</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Therefore came I forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07125" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">thee, diligently to seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy face</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I have found</w> thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07234" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have decked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06210">my bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04765">with coverings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02405">of tapestry, with carved</w> <transChange type="added">works</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H0330">with fine linen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04714">of Egypt</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have perfumed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04904">my bed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04753">with myrrh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0174">aloes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07076">and cinnamon</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let us take our fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H01730">of love</w> <w lemma="strong:H01242">until the morning</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05965" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">let us solace</w> <w lemma="strong:H0159">ourselves with loves</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">For the goodman</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">not at home</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">he is gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H07350">a long</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">journey</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 7:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He hath taken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06872">a bag</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">of money</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with him</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will come</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">home</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">at the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H03677">appointed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in his hand</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the day…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the new moon</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">With her much</w> <w lemma="strong:H03948">fair speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">she caused him to yield</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02506">with the flattering</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of her lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05080" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">she forced</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> <w lemma="strong:H06597">her straightway</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07794">as an ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">goeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">to the slaughter</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0191">or as a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">to the correction</w> <w lemma="strong:H05914">of the stocks</w>;<note type="study"><catchWord>straightway</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">suddenly</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02671">Till a dart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06398" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">strike</w> <w lemma="strong:H03516">through his liver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06833">as a bird</w> <w lemma="strong:H04116" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">hasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06341">to the snare</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and knoweth</w> not that it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">for his life</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:24
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me now therefore, O ye children</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">and attend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">to the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">Let not thine heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07847" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">decline</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">to her ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">go not astray</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">in her paths</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">For she hath cast down</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H02491">wounded</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06099">yea, many strong</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02026" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">have been slain</w> by her.

verses.name: Proverbs 7:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">Her house</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">to hell</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">going down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">to the chambers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 7." eID="gen683" osisID="Prov.7"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Doth not wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cry</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08394">and understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">put forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06963">her voice</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 8:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">She standeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07218">in the top</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">of high places</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">by the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the places</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">of the paths</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07442" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">She crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">at</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">the gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">at the entry</w> <w lemma="strong:H07176">of the city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03996">at the coming</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">in at the doors</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">Unto you, O men</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I call</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06963">and my voice</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06612">O ye simple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H06195">wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03684">and, ye fools</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">be ye of an understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">for I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05057">of excellent things</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04669">and the opening</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of my lips</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04339">right things</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02441">For my mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">truth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07562">and wickedness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">to my lips</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the abomination of my lips</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0561">All the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of my mouth</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06664">in righteousness</w>; <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06617" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">nothing froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06141">or perverse</w> in them.<note type="study"><catchWord>froward</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">wreathed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:9
verses.text: They <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05228">all plain</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to him that understandeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03477">and right</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that find</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">my instruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03701">and not silver</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">rather than choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">gold</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">For wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H06443">than rubies</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02656">and all the things that may be desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are not to be compared</w> to it.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">I wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06195">with prudence</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and find out</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">of witty inventions</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prudence</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">subtilty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01344">pride</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01347">and arrogancy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">and the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08419">and the froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do I hate</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06098">Counsel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08454">mine, and sound wisdom</w>: I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01369">I have strength</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">By me kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H04427" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">reign</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07336" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8779">decree</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">justice</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08269">By me princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rule</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05081">and nobles</w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08199" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">all the judges</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">me; and those that seek me early</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall find</w> me.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06239">Riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> with me; <transChange type="added">yea</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06276">durable</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">and righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06529">My fruit</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">than gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06337">yea, than fine gold</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08393">and my revenue</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">than choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I lead</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08432">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">of the paths</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>lead</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">walk</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">That I may cause those that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">me to inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">substance</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">and I will fill</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">their treasures</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">possessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07225">me in the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">of his way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H04659">his works</w> of old.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05258" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">I was set up</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">from everlasting</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">from the beginning</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06924">or ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w> was.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:24
verses.text: When <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08415">no depths</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">I was brought forth</w>; when <transChange type="added">there were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04599">no fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">abounding</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">with water</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02022">Before the mountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H02883" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">were settled</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01389">the hills</w> <w lemma="strong:H02342" morph="strongMorph:TH8797">was I brought forth</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 8:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">While as yet he had not made</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02351">nor the fields</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07218">nor the highest part</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">of the dust</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">of the world</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fields</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">open places</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the highest…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the chief part</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">When he prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H08064">the heavens</w>, I <transChange type="added">was</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">there: when he set</w> <w lemma="strong:H02329">a compass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">upon the face</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">of the depth</w>:<note type="study"><catchWord>a compass</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a circle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0553" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">When he established</w> <w lemma="strong:H07834">the clouds</w> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he strengthened</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">the fountains</w> <w lemma="strong:H08415">of the deep</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 8:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07760" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">When he gave</w> <w lemma="strong:H03220">to the sea</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">his decree</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04325">that the waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">should not pass</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his commandment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02710" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when he appointed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04144">the foundations</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 8:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0681">Then I was by him</w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0525">one brought up</w> <transChange type="added">with him</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">and I was daily</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">delight</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">always</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> him;

verses.name: Proverbs 8:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07832" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Rejoicing</w> <w lemma="strong:H08398">in the habitable part</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of his earth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08191">and my delights</w> <transChange type="added">were</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">with the sons</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Now therefore hearken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">unto me, O ye children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0835">for blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are they that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and be wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and refuse</w> it not.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0120">the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08245" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">me, watching</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117 strong:H03117">daily</w> <w lemma="strong:H01817">at my gates</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">waiting</w> <w lemma="strong:H04201">at the posts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">of my doors</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 8:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">For whoso findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672 strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">me findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06329" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and shall obtain</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>obtain</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">bring forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:36
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">But he that sinneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02554" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">against me wrongeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">all they that hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me love</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 8." eID="gen684" osisID="Prov.8"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02454">Wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath builded</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">her house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath hewn out</w> <w lemma="strong:H07651">her seven</w> <w lemma="strong:H05982">pillars</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 9:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02873" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She hath killed</w> <w lemma="strong:H02874">her beasts</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04537" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath mingled</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">her wine</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she hath also furnished</w> <w lemma="strong:H07979">her table</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>her beasts</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">her killing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">She hath sent forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05291">her maidens</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">she crieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01610">upon</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">the highest places</w> <w lemma="strong:H07176">of the city</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:4
verses.text: Whoso <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06612">simple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him turn in</w> hither: <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02638">him that wanteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she saith</w> to him,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Come</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03898" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">of my bread</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08354" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and drink</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">of the wine</w> <transChange type="added">which</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04537" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have mingled</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H06612">the foolish</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and live</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0833" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and go</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">of understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that reproveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a scorner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">getteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">to himself shame</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and he that rebuketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">a wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man getteth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03971">himself a blot</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">not a scorner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lest he hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">thee: rebuke</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">a wise man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will love</w> thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Give</w> <transChange type="added">instruction</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">to a wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and he will be yet wiser</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">a just</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he will increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H03948">in learning</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08462">the beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01847">and the knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06918">of the holy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">For by me thy days</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be multiplied</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08141">and the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of thy life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be increased</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">If thou be wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou shalt be wise</w> for thyself: but <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">thou scornest</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thou alone shalt bear</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:13
verses.text: <milestone marker="¶" type="x-p"/><w lemma="strong:H03687">A foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">clamorous</w>: <transChange type="added">she is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06615">simple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01077">and</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04100">nothing</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 9:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">For she sitteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">at the door</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">of her house</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03678">on a seat</w> <w lemma="strong:H04791">in the high places</w> <w lemma="strong:H07176">of the city</w>,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To call</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870 strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">passengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">who go right</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">on their ways</w>:

verses.name: Proverbs 9:16
verses.text: Whoso <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06612">simple</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">let him turn in</w> hither: and <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02638">him that wanteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">she saith</w> to him,

verses.name: Proverbs 9:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01589" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Stolen</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w> <w lemma="strong:H04985" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">are sweet</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03899">and bread</w> <transChange type="added">eaten</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H05276" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is pleasant</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>eaten…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of secrecies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">But he knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07496">not that the dead</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> there; <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">her guests</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06012">in the depths</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">of hell</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 9." eID="gen685" osisID="Prov.9"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04912">The proverbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H08010">of Solomon</w>. <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">maketh a glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03684">but a foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08424">the heaviness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">of his mother</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0214">Treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">of wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">nothing: but righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-321">will not suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-321">to famish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01920" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he casteth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">the substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the substance…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the wicked for their wickedness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He becometh poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that dealeth</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07423">a slack</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hand</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03027">but the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">of the diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">maketh rich</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0103" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07019">in summer</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07290" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">he that sleepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">in harvest</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that causeth shame</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">Blessings</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02555">but violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02143">The memory</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01293">blessed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08034">but the name</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07537" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall rot</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">The wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">commandments</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">but a prating</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H03832" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a prating…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a fool of lips</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>fall</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be beaten</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">He that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">uprightly</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0983">surely</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06140" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">but he that perverteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be known</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07169" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that winketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with the eye</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">causeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06094">sorrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">but a prating</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H03832" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall fall</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>fall</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be beaten</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">The mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of a righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04726">a well</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02555">but violence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08135">Hatred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05782" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">stirreth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04090">strifes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0160">but love</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">all sins</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">In the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of him that hath understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is found</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07626">but a rod</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01460">for the back</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">of him that is void</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of understanding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of understanding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:14
