verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">Wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">lay up</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">but the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">of the foolish</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07138">near</w> <w lemma="strong:H04288">destruction</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">wealth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">his strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04288">the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07389">their poverty</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06468">The labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">tendeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08393">the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">to sin</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:17
verses.text: He <transChange type="added">is in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">erreth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>erreth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">causeth to err</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">hatred</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and he that uttereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01681">a slander</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03684">a fool</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">In the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">of words</w> <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">there wanteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">not sin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that refraineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">his lips</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">wise</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">The tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">choice</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">silver</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">little worth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">The lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feed</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0191">but fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">die</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">for want</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of wisdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of wisdom</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">The blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it maketh rich</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he addeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06089">no sorrow</w> with it.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:23
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07814">as sport</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">to a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">mischief</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">hath wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04034">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall come</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">upon him: but the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be granted</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05492">As the whirlwind</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">passeth</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> no <transChange type="added">more</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05769">an everlasting</w> <w lemma="strong:H03247">foundation</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02558">As vinegar</w> <w lemma="strong:H08127">to the teeth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06227">and as smoke</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">to the eyes</w>, so <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06102">the sluggard</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that send</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">prolongeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">days</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08141">but the years</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07114" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be shortened</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>prolongeth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">addeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08431">The hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">gladness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08615">but the expectation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04581">strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">to the upright</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04288">but destruction</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">shall never</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be removed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H07931" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall not inhabit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">the earth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">The mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H05107" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">bringeth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08419">but the froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H03772" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be cut out</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 10:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">The lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">know</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">what is acceptable</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">but the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">speaketh</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08419">frowardness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>frowardness</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">frowardnesses</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 10." eID="gen686" osisID="Prov.10"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04820">A false</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">balance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08003">but a just</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">weight</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">his delight</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A false…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Balances of deceit</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>just…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">perfect stone</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:2
verses.text: <transChange type="added">When</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02087">pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">shame</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06800" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">but with the lowly</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08538">The integrity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall guide</w> <w lemma="strong:H05558">them: but the perverseness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07703 strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8804 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">shall destroy</w> them.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01952">Riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H03276" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">profit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">not in the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">of wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06666">but righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">from death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">The righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08549">of the perfect</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall direct</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w> <w lemma="strong:H07564">by his own wickedness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>direct</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">rectify</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">The righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall deliver</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">them: but transgressors</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be taken</w> in <transChange type="added">their own</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01942">naughtiness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">When a wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">dieth</w>, <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">expectation</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08431">and the hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of unjust</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">perisheth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">is delivered out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> in his stead.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02611">An hypocrite</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">destroyeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01847">but through knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">shall the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H02502" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">be delivered</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02898">When it goeth well</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">with the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07151">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H05970" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiceth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">and when the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">perish</w>, <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07440">shouting</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">By the blessing</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H07176">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is exalted</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">but it is overthrown</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">by the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02638">He that is void</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">holdeth his peace</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>void…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">destitute of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07400 strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">A talebearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">revealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">secrets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">but he that is of a faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">concealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the matter</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A talebearer</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">He that walketh, being a talebearer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08458">Where no counsel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H05971">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">but in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of counsellors</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">safety</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">He that is surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451 strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall smart</w> <transChange type="added">for it</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">suretiship</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">is sure</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>smart</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">be sore broken</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>suretiship</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">those that strike hands</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02580">A gracious</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">retaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">honour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06184">and strong</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08551" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">retain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">riches</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">The merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">doeth good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to his own soul</w>: but <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0394">cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">troubleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07607">his own flesh</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">worketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a deceitful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06468">work</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02232" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but to him that soweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0571">a sure</w> <w lemma="strong:H07938">reward</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">As righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">tendeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">so he that pursueth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <transChange type="added">pursueth it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">to his own death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06141">They that are of a froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: but <transChange type="added">such as are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">upright</w> in <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">way</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">his delight</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <transChange type="added">join</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be unpunished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02233">but the seed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">shall be delivered</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">As</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05141">a jewel</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">of gold</w> <w lemma="strong:H02386">in a swine’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">snout</w>, <transChange type="added">so is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03303">a fair</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which is without</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">discretion</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is without</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">departeth from</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08378">The desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">only good</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08615">the expectation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05678">wrath</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H06340" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">that scattereth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and yet increaseth</w>; and <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that withholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">more than is meet</w>, but <transChange type="added">it tendeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">to poverty</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01293">The liberal</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be made fat</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07301" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and he that watereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall be watered</w> also himself.<note type="study"><catchWord>liberal…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">soul of blessing</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04513" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that withholdeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01250">corn</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03816">the people</w> <w lemma="strong:H05344" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall curse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01293">him: but blessing</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07218">upon the head</w> <w lemma="strong:H07666" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">of him that selleth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that diligently seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">procureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">favour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">mischief</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall come</w> unto him.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06239">in his riches</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall fall</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall flourish</w> <w lemma="strong:H05929">as a branch</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that troubleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his own house</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the wind</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0191">and the fool</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">to the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of heart</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 11:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06529">The fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that winneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>winneth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">taketh</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">Behold, the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be recompensed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">much more the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the sinner</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 11." eID="gen687" osisID="Prov.11"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">reproof</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01198">brutish</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">A good</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06329" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">obtaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">of wicked devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will he condemn</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">by wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08328">but the root</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04131" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be moved</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02428">A virtuous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05850">a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to her husband</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">but she that maketh ashamed</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07538">as rottenness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">in his bones</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04284">The thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">right</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08458">the counsels</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0693" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to lie in wait</w> <w lemma="strong:H01818">for blood</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">but the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall deliver</w> them.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">are overthrown</w>, and <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01004">not: but the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05975" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall stand</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be commended</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">according</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">to his wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05753" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">but he that is of a perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">shall be despised</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>of a…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">perverse of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07034" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">despised</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05650">and hath a servant</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">than he that honoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">himself, and lacketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">bread</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">A righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H0929">of his beast</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07356">but the tender mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0394">cruel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>tender…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bowels</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05647" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that tilleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0127">his land</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">but he that followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07386">vain</w> <transChange type="added">persons is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02638">void</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of understanding</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">desireth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04685">the net</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange>: <w lemma="strong:H08328">but the root</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yieldeth</w> <transChange type="added">fruit</transChange>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the net</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the fortress</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">is snared</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">by the transgression</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H03318" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall come out</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">of trouble</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>The wicked…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The snare of the wicked is in the transgression of lips</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">with good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">by the fruit</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01576">and the recompence</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725 strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8686">shall be rendered</w> unto him.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">of a fool</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that hearkeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">unto counsel</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0191">A fool’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">is presently</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">known</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06175">but a prudent</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">shame</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>presently</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in that day</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05046" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">sheweth forth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">righteousness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08267">but a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0981" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04094">like the piercings</w> <w lemma="strong:H02719">of a sword</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03956">but the tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04832">health</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">The lip</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be established</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">for ever</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08267">but a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07280" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but for a moment</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04820">Deceit</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of them that imagine</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but to the counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H07965">of peace</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0205">There shall no evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H0579" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">happen</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">to the just</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">with mischief</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08267">Lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but they that deal</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">truly</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">his delight</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06175">A prudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">concealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">but the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">proclaimeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">foolishness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03027">The hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">of the diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall bear rule</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07423">but the slothful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04522">shall be under tribute</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>slothful</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">deceitful</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01674">Heaviness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07812" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">maketh it stoop</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02896">but a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">word</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">maketh it glad</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08446" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">more excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">than his neighbour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">but the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">seduceth</w> them.<note type="study"><catchWord>excellent</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">abundant</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07423">The slothful</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02760" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">roasteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06718">not that which he took in hunting</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01952">but the substance</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">of a diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03368">precious</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 12:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">In the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>; and <transChange type="added">in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870 strong:H05410">the pathway</w> <transChange type="added">thereof there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04194">no death</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 12." eID="gen688" osisID="Prov.12"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <transChange type="added">heareth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">but a scorner</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">not rebuke</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">by the fruit</w> of <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05315">but the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the transgressors</w> <transChange type="added">shall eat</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02555">violence</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his life</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06589" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that openeth wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">his lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H04288">shall have destruction</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">The soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06102">of the sluggard</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">desireth</w>, and <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">nothing: but the soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">of the diligent</w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be made fat</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">A righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267 strong:H01697">lying</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">but a wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">is loathsome</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and cometh to shame</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">Righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">keepeth</w> <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08537">upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07564">but wickedness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05557" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">overthroweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">the sinner</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the sinner</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sin</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">that maketh himself rich</w>, yet <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> nothing: <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8711">that maketh himself poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03605">yet</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">great</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">riches</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03724">The ransom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">life</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06239">his riches</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01606">not rebuke</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">The light</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">rejoiceth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05216">but the lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01846" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be put out</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02087">Only by pride</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04683">contention</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">but with the well advised</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01952">Wealth</w> <transChange type="added">gotten</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">by vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H04591" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be diminished</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06908" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that gathereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">by labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H07235" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall increase</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>by labour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">with the hand</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08431">Hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H04900" morph="strongMorph:TH8794">deferred</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">maketh the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">sick</w>: but <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08378">the desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">cometh</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be destroyed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03373">but he that feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be rewarded</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>shall be rewarded</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">shall be in peace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08451">The law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04726">a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">from the snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07922">understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02580">favour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01870">but the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of transgressors</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0386">hard</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06175">Every prudent</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">with knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03684">but a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H06566" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">layeth open</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0200">folly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>layeth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">spreadeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">A wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">into mischief</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0529">but a faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06735">ambassador</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04832">health</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a faithful…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an ambassador of faithfulness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07389">Poverty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07036">and shame</w> <transChange type="added">shall be to</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be honoured</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08378">The desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H01961" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">accomplished</w> <w lemma="strong:H06149" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to the soul</w>: but <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">to fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">with wise</w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be wise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but a companion</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H07321" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be destroyed</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroyed</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">broken</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">Evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">pursueth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02400">sinners</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but to the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">shall be repayed</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">A good</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">leaveth an inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">to his children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02428">and the wealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the sinner</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">laid up</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">for the just</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">Much</w> <w lemma="strong:H0400">food</w> <transChange type="added">is in</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05215">the tillage</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326 strong:H07218" morph="strongMorph:TH8802 strongMorph:TH8676">of the poor</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03426">but there is</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05595" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">destroyed</w> <w lemma="strong:H03808">for want</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that spareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07626">his rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">his son</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">him chasteneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07836" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">him betimes</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 13:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">eateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07648">to the satisfying</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of his soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0990">but the belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02637" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall want</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 13." eID="gen689" osisID="Prov.13"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02454">Every wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H01129" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">buildeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">her house</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0200">but the foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H02040" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">plucketh it down</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">with her hands</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">in his uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03373">feareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: but <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03868" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">despiseth</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06310">In the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">of the foolish</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02415">a rod</w> <w lemma="strong:H01346">of pride</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">but the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall preserve</w> them.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0504">Where no oxen</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H018">the crib</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01249">clean</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">but much</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">increase</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">by the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">of the ox</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0529">A faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">will not lie</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08267">but a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will utter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03576" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">lies</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">A scorner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, and <transChange type="added">findeth it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">not: but knowledge</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">easy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">unto him that understandeth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05048">from the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">when thou perceivest</w> not <transChange type="added">in him</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">The wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06175">of the prudent</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0200">but the folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04820">deceit</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0191">Fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">make a mock</w> <w lemma="strong:H0817">at sin</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03477">but among the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">favour</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">knoweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own</w> <w lemma="strong:H04787">bitterness</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">doth not intermeddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">with his joy</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>his own…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the bitterness of his soul</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">The house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be overthrown</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0168">but the tabernacle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <w lemma="strong:H06524" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall flourish</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">which seemeth right</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0319">but the end</w> thereof <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07814">Even in laughter</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03510" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is sorrowful</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0319">and the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">of that mirth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08424">heaviness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05472" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">The backslider</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">with his own ways</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02896">and a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <transChange type="added">shall be satisfied</transChange> from himself.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06612">The simple</w> <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">believeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">every word</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06175">but the prudent</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">looketh well</w> <w lemma="strong:H0838">to his going</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03373">feareth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and departeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03684">but the fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">rageth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and is confident</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07116">soon</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">dealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">foolishly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">and a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04209">of wicked devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is hated</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06612">The simple</w> <w lemma="strong:H05157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">inherit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">folly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06175">but the prudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H03803" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">are crowned</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">with knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">The evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H07817" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">bow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">the good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07563">and the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H08179">at the gates</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is hated</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">even of his own neighbour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06223">but the rich</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">friends</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the rich…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">many are the lovers of the rich</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0936" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sinneth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8781">but he that hath mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041 strong:H06035" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">on the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0835">happy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Do they not err</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>? <w lemma="strong:H02617">but mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to them that devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06089">In all labour</w> <w lemma="strong:H04195">there is profit</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">but the talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of the lips</w> <transChange type="added">tendeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">only to penury</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05850">The crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06239">their riches</w>: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0200">the foolishness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0200">folly</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0571">A true</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">delivereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">souls</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04820">but a deceitful</w> <transChange type="added">witness</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">In the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04009">confidence</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">and his children</w> <w lemma="strong:H04268">shall have a place of refuge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04726">a fountain</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04170">from the snares</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">In the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H05971">of people</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01927">honour</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0657">but in the want</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">of people</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04288">the destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H07333">of the prince</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:29
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to wrath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">understanding</w>: but <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07116">hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">of spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">exalteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">folly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>hasty…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">short of spirit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04832">A sound</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">the life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01320">of the flesh</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07068">but envy</w> <w lemma="strong:H07538">the rottenness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">of the bones</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06231" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that oppresseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">reproacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his Maker</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03513" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">but he that honoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him hath mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H034">on the poor</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01760" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is driven away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">in his wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">but the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H02620" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">hath hope</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">in his death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">resteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of him that hath understanding</w>: but <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07130">in the midst</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is made known</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 14:34
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06666">Righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07311" morph="strongMorph:TH8787">exalteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01471">a nation</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02403">but sin</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">a reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03816">to any people</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>to any…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">to nations</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:35
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">favour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">toward a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05678">but his wrath</w> is <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">him that causeth shame</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 14." eID="gen690" osisID="Prov.14"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07390">A soft</w> <w lemma="strong:H04617">answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">away wrath</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06089">but grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">stir up</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03956">The tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">useth knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">aright</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">but the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">poureth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">foolishness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>poureth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">belcheth</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">bubbleth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05869">The eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04725">in every place</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06822" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">beholding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">the evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">and the good</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04832">A wholesome</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06086">a tree</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05558">but perverseness</w> therein <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07667">a breach</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">in the spirit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A wholesome…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The healing of the tongue</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0191">A fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H05006" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that regardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H06191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">is prudent</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">In the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">much</w> <w lemma="strong:H02633">treasure</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08393">but in the revenues</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">is trouble</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08193">The lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">disperse</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">but the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of the foolish</w> <transChange type="added">doeth</transChange> not so.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02077">The sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H08605">but the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">his delight</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">him that followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">after righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04148">Correction</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">grievous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">unto him that forsaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the way</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Correction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">Instruction</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07585">Hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H011">and destruction</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">before the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03826">how much more then the hearts</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of the children</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of men</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 15:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">A scorner</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">not one that reproveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">him: neither will he go</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">unto the wise</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08056">A merry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">maketh a cheerful</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">countenance</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06094">but by sorrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05218">is broken</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of him that hath understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06440 strong:H06310" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">but the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w> <w lemma="strong:H07462" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">feedeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">on foolishness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03117">All the days</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041">of the afflicted</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02896">but he that is of a merry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08548">a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H04960">feast</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">little</w> <w lemma="strong:H03374">with the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">than great</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H04103">and trouble</w> therewith.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0737">a dinner</w> <w lemma="strong:H03419">of herbs</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">where love</w> <w lemma="strong:H075" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">is, than a stalled</w> <w lemma="strong:H07794">ox</w> <w lemma="strong:H08135">and hatred</w> therewith.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">A wrathful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01624" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">stirreth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">strife</w>: but <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H08252" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">appeaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">strife</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06102">of the slothful</w> <transChange type="added">man is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04881">as an hedge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02312">of thorns</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0734">but the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the righteous</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05549" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">made plain</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>is made…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is raised up as a causey</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">maketh a glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03684">but a foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">his mother</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0200">Folly</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> to <transChange type="added">him that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02638">destitute</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of wisdom</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03474" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">uprightly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destitute…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">void of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05475">Without counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">purposes</w> <w lemma="strong:H06565" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">are disappointed</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07230">but in the multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H03289" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of counsellors</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">they are established</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">hath joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04617">by the answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01697">and a word</w> <transChange type="added">spoken</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06256">in due season</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02896">how good</w> <transChange type="added">is it</transChange>!<note type="study"><catchWord>due…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">his season</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0734">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04605">above</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">to the wise</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that he may depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07585">from hell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04295">beneath</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H05255" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H01343">of the proud</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05324" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">but he will establish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01366">the border</w> <w lemma="strong:H0490">of the widow</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04284">The thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: but <transChange type="added">the words</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02889">of the pure</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05278">pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">words</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasant…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">words of pleasantness</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01214" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that is greedy</w> <w lemma="strong:H01215">of gain</w> <w lemma="strong:H05916" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">troubleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">his own house</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that hateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04979">gifts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall live</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H01897" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">studieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to answer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">but the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">poureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">out evil things</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07350">far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">from the wicked</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">but he heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08605">the prayer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">of the righteous</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03974">The light</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">of the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">rejoiceth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <w lemma="strong:H08052">report</w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-322">maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">the bones</w> <w lemma="strong:H01878" morph="strongMorph:TH8762" type="x-split-322">fat</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0241">The ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">the reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">abideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07130">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">the wise</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 15:32
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06544" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that refuseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03988" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08433">reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">getteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">understanding</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>instruction</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">correction</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>heareth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">obeyeth</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>getteth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">possesseth an heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04148">the instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">honour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06038">humility</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 15." eID="gen691" osisID="Prov.15"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04633">The preparations</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">in man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04617">and the answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">of the tongue</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>preparations</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">disposings</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">All the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02134">clean</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own eyes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">weigheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">the spirits</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H04639">thy works</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04284">and thy thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be established</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Commit</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Roll</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03068">The <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> all <transChange type="added">things</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04617">for himself</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07563">yea, even the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">for the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">of evil</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:5
verses.text: Every one <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01362">proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <transChange type="added">though</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">hand</w> <transChange type="added">join</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in hand</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he shall not be unpunished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unpunished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">held innocent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:6
