verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">By mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05771">iniquity</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">is purged</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03374">and by the fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">men</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">When a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H07521" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">please</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he maketh even his enemies</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to be at peace</w> with him.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04592">a little</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">with righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H07230">than great</w> <w lemma="strong:H08393">revenues</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">without right</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">A man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">deviseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">directeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06806">his steps</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07081">A divine sentence</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04603" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">transgresseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">not in judgment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A divine…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Divination</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04941">A just</w> <w lemma="strong:H06425">weight</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">and balance</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord’s</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H068">all the weights</w> <w lemma="strong:H03599">of the bag</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04639">his work</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>the weights</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">the stones</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:12
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">to kings</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to commit</w> <w lemma="strong:H07562">wickedness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03678">for the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">by righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06664">Righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07522">the delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of kings</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and they love</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02534">The wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of a king</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messengers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02450">but a wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03722" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will pacify</w> it.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0216">In the light</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of the king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">countenance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07522">and his favour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05645">as a cloud</w> <w lemma="strong:H04456">of the latter rain</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">How much better</w> <transChange type="added">is it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">than gold</w>! <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">and to get</w> <w lemma="strong:H0998">understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">rather to be chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H03701">than silver</w>!

verses.name: Proverbs 16:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04546">The highway</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">of the upright</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">from evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">preserveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01347">Pride</w> <transChange type="added">goeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01363">and an haughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03783">a fall</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">it is to be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08217">of an humble</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06041 strong:H06035" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">with the lowly</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">than to divide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07998">the spoil</w> <w lemma="strong:H01343">with the proud</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">He that handleth a matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">wisely</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and whoso trusteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">in the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0835">happy</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> he.<note type="study"><catchWord>handleth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">understandeth a matter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">The wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be called</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">prudent</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04986">and the sweetness</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">increaseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03948">learning</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07922">Understanding</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04726">a wellspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">of life</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">unto him that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">it: but the instruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H0191">of fools</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0200">folly</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">teacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and addeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03948">learning</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">to his lips</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>teacheth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">maketh wise</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05278">Pleasant</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">words</w> <transChange type="added">are as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01706 strong:H06688">an honeycomb</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04966">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">to the soul</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04832">and health</w> <w lemma="strong:H06106">to the bones</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">a way</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">that seemeth right</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">unto</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0319">but the end</w> thereof <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">of death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">He</w> <w lemma="strong:H06001">that laboureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05998" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">laboureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">for himself; for his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0404" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">craveth</w> it of him.<note type="study"><catchWord>He…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The soul of him that</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>craveth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">boweth unto him</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01100">An ungodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03738" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">diggeth up</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">and in his lips</w> <transChange type="added">there is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06867">as a burning</w> <w lemma="strong:H0784">fire</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>An…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A man of Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08419">A froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">soweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">strife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05372">and a whisperer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">separateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0441">chief friends</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>soweth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">sendeth forth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02555">A violent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">enticeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03212" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and leadeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">him into the way</w> <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06095" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He shutteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">his eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to devise</w> <w lemma="strong:H08419">froward things</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07169" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">moving</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">his lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-323">he bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H03615" morph="strongMorph:TH8765" type="x-split-323">to pass</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07872">The hoary head</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05850">a crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H08597">of glory</w>, <transChange type="added">if</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">it be found</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">of righteousness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:32
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0750">slow</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">to anger</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">than the mighty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and he that ruleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">his spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03920" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">than he that taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">a city</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 16:33
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01486">The lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H02904" morph="strongMorph:TH8714">is cast</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">into the lap</w>; <w lemma="strong:H04941">but the whole disposing</w> thereof <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 16." eID="gen692" osisID="Prov.16"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02720">a dry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06595">morsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07962">and quietness</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">therewith, than an house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04392">full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">of sacrifices</w> <transChange type="added">with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07379">strife</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>sacrifices</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">good cheer</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">A wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall have rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">over a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that causeth shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02505" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and shall have part</w> <w lemma="strong:H05159">of the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H08432">among</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">the brethren</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04715">The fining pot</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03701">for silver</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03564">and the furnace</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">for gold</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H0974" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">trieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03826">the hearts</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">A wicked doer</w> <w lemma="strong:H07181" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">giveth heed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">to false</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08267">a liar</w> <w lemma="strong:H0238" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">giveth ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H01942">to a naughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03932" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso mocketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">reproacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">his Maker</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08056">he that is glad</w> <w lemma="strong:H0343">at calamities</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be unpunished</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unpunished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">held innocent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01121">Children’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">children</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05850">the crown</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of old men</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08597">and the glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">of children</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">their fathers</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03499">Excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">speech</w> <w lemma="strong:H05000">becometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">not a fool</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08267">much less do lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">a prince</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Excellent…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A lip of excellency</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>lying…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a lip of lying</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07810">A gift</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02580">a precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H068">stone</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">of him that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H06437" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it: whithersoever it turneth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">it prospereth</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a precious…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a stone of grace</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03680" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that covereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">a transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0160">love</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08138" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">but he that repeateth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">separateth</w> <transChange type="added">very</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0441">friends</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>seeketh</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">procureth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01606">A reproof</w> <w lemma="strong:H05181" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">entereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">more into a wise man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03967">than an hundred</w> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">stripes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">into a fool</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>entereth…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">aweth more a wise man, than to strike a fool an hundred times</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07451">An evil</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H04805">only rebellion</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0394">therefore a cruel</w> <w lemma="strong:H04397">messenger</w> <w lemma="strong:H07971" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">shall be sent</w> against him.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01677">Let a bear</w> <w lemma="strong:H07909">robbed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06298" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">of her whelps meet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0408">rather than</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H0200">in his folly</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">Whoso rewardeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">for good</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H04185 strong:H04185" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">shall not depart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">from his house</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07225">The beginning</w> <w lemma="strong:H04066">of strife</w> <transChange type="added">is as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06362" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">when one letteth out</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05203" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">therefore leave off</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">contention</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01566" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">it be meddled</w> with.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06663" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He that justifieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07561" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and he that condemneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the just</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">even they both</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:16
verses.text: Wherefore <transChange type="added">is there</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04242">a price</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to get</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">wisdom</w>, seeing <transChange type="added">he hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">no heart</w> <transChange type="added">to it</transChange>?

verses.name: Proverbs 17:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07453">A friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at all times</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0251">and a brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is born</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">for adversity</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02638">void</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H08628" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">striketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03709">hands</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">becometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H06161">surety</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">in the presence</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">of his friend</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>understanding</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">transgression</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04683">strife</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">he that exalteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06607">his gate</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06141">He that hath a froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">no good</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02015" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">and he that hath a perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">falleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">into mischief</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>He that hath a froward…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">The froward of heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that begetteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">a fool</w> <transChange type="added">doeth it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08424">to his sorrow</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01">and the father</w> <w lemma="strong:H05036">of a fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H08055" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath no joy</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08056">A merry</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H03190" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">doeth good</w> <transChange type="added">like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01456">a medicine</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05218">but a broken</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H03001" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">drieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01634">the bones</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>like</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">A wicked</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">taketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07810">a gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">out of the bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to pervert</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">the ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">of judgment</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02451">Wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995 strong:H06440" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">before him that hath understanding</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05869">but the eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of a fool</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07097">in the ends</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">of the earth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03684">A foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03708">a grief</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">to his father</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04470">and bitterness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03205" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to her that bare</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">Also to punish</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the just</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>, <transChange type="added">nor</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to strike</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">for equity</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 17:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03045" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that hath</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">spareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">his words</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0376">a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07119 strong:H03368" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">is of an excellent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>an…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">a cool</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0191">Even a fool</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">when he holdeth his peace</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is counted</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">wise</w>: <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0331" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">he that shutteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">his lips</w> <transChange type="added">is esteemed</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a man of understanding</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 17." eID="gen693" osisID="Prov.17"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08378">Through desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">a man, having separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">himself, seeketh</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01566" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">intermeddleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08454">with all wisdom</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Through…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">He that separateth himself seeketh according to his desire, and intermeddleth in every business</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03684">A fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">hath no delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">in understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">but that his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8692">may discover</w> itself.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">When the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">cometh</w>, <transChange type="added">then</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">also contempt</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07036">and with ignominy</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">reproach</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <transChange type="added">are as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">waters</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04726">the wellspring</w> <w lemma="strong:H02451">of wisdom</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05042" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a flowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05158">brook</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:5
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to accept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the person</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to overthrow</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in judgment</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03684">A fool’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">enter</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">into contention</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06310">and his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">calleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04112">for strokes</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03684">A fool’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">mouth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04288">his destruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08193">and his lips</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04170">the snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">of his soul</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01697">The words</w> <w lemma="strong:H05372">of a talebearer</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03859" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">as wounds</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and they go down</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">into the innermost parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the belly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>talebearer</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">whisperer</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>as wounds</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">like as when men are wounded</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>innermost…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">chambers</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07503" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">He also that is slothful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04399">in his work</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">is brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H01167">to him that is a great</w> <w lemma="strong:H07843" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">waster</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08034">The name</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H04026">tower</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06662">the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">runneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">into it, and is safe</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>safe</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">set aloft</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06223">The rich man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">wealth</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">his strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07682" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">and as an high</w> <w lemma="strong:H02346">wall</w> <w lemma="strong:H04906">in his own conceit</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06440">Before</w> <w lemma="strong:H07667">destruction</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01361" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is haughty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06440">and before</w> <w lemma="strong:H03519">honour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06038">humility</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">He that answereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">a matter</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">before he heareth</w> <transChange type="added">it</transChange>, it <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0200">folly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03639">and shame</w> unto him.<note type="study"><catchWord>answereth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">returneth a word</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07307">The spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H03557" morph="strongMorph:TH8770">will sustain</w> <w lemma="strong:H04245">his infirmity</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05218">but a wounded</w> <w lemma="strong:H07307">spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who can bear</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 18:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03820">The heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of the prudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">getteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0241">and the ear</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">seeketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">A man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04976">gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">maketh room</w> <w lemma="strong:H05148" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for him, and bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">him before</w> <w lemma="strong:H01419">great men</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:17
verses.text: <transChange type="added">He that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07223">first</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">in his own cause</w> <transChange type="added">seemeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06662">just</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07453">but his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935 strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">cometh</w> <w lemma="strong:H02713" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">and searcheth</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01486">The lot</w> <w lemma="strong:H04079">causeth contentions</w> <w lemma="strong:H07673" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">to cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and parteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06099">between the mighty</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">A brother</w> <w lemma="strong:H06586" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">offended</w> <transChange type="added">is harder to be won</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05797">than a strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H07151">city</w>: and <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04066 strong:H04079" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">contentions</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01280">like the bars</w> <w lemma="strong:H0759">of a castle</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">belly</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">with the fruit</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of his mouth</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08393">with the increase</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">of his lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall he be filled</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04194">Death</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">and life</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the power</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">of the tongue</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and they that love</w> <w lemma="strong:H0398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it shall eat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06529">the fruit</w> thereof.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:22
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Whoso</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">a wife</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">a good</w> <transChange type="added">thing</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H06329" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and obtaineth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07522">favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">useth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08469">intreaties</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06223">but the rich</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">answereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">roughly</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 18:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0376">A man</w> <transChange type="added">that hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H07489" morph="strongMorph:TH8710">must shew himself friendly</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03426">and there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a friend</w> <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01695">sticketh closer</w> <w lemma="strong:H0251">than a brother</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 18." eID="gen694" osisID="Prov.18"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02896">Better</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">in his integrity</w>, than <transChange type="added">he that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06141">perverse</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">in his lips</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03684">and is a fool</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:2
verses.text: Also, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">the soul</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01847">without knowledge</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">and he that hasteth</w> with <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07272">feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sinneth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0200">The foolishness</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05557" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">perverteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03820">and his heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02196" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">fretteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01952">Wealth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">maketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">friends</w>; <w lemma="strong:H01800">but the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H06504" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is separated</w> <w lemma="strong:H07453">from his neighbour</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08267">A false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be unpunished</w>, and <transChange type="added">he that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04422" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not escape</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>unpunished</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">held innocent</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07227">Many</w> <w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will intreat</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">the favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05081">of the prince</w>: and every man <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07453">a friend</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to him</w> <w lemma="strong:H04976">that giveth gifts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>him…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a man of gifts</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0251">All the brethren</w> <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">of the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H08130" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">do hate</w> <w lemma="strong:H04828">him: how much more do his friends</w> <w lemma="strong:H07368" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">go far</w> <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">from him? he pursueth</w> <transChange type="added">them with</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0561">words</w>, <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> they <transChange type="added">are</transChange> wanting <transChange type="added">to him</transChange>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that getteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">shall find</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>wisdom</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an heart</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08267">A false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05352" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall not be unpunished</w>, and <transChange type="added">he that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06315" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">lies</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08588">Delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H05000">is not seemly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">for a fool</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05650">much less for a servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H04910" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to have rule</w> <w lemma="strong:H08269">over princes</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07922">The discretion</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0748" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">deferreth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">his anger</w>; and <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08597">his glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to pass over</w> <w lemma="strong:H06588">a transgression</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>discretion</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">prudence</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H02197">wrath</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05099">as the roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of a lion</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07522">but his favour</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02919">as dew</w> <w lemma="strong:H06212">upon the grass</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03684">A foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">son</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01942">the calamity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of his father</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04079">and the contentions</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">of a wife</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02956" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">a continual</w> <w lemma="strong:H01812">dropping</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01004">House</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">and riches</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05159">the inheritance</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">of fathers</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and a prudent</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">wife</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">from the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06103">Slothfulness</w> <w lemma="strong:H05307" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">casteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08639">into a deep sleep</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07423">and an idle</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07456" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall suffer hunger</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">the commandment</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0959" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that despiseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall die</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that hath pity</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">upon the poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03867" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">lendeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H01576">and that which he hath given</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">will he pay him again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>that which…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">his deed</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03256" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Chasten</w> <w lemma="strong:H01121">thy son</w> <w lemma="strong:H03426">while there is</w> <w lemma="strong:H08615">hope</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05315">and let not thy soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">spare</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">for his crying</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>for…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to his destruction</rdg>: or, <rdg type="alternate">to cause him to die</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01419">A man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01632">of great</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">wrath</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">shall suffer</w> <w lemma="strong:H06066">punishment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">for if thou deliver</w> <transChange type="added">him</transChange>, <w lemma="strong:H03254" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">yet thou must do it again</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>do</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">add</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">counsel</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06901" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">and receive</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">instruction</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that thou mayest be wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H0319">in thy latter end</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:21
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07227">many</w> <w lemma="strong:H04284">devices</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">in a man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06098">nevertheless the counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that shall stand</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08378">The desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of a man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his kindness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07326" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and a poor man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">than</w> <w lemma="strong:H03577">a liar</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03374">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <transChange type="added">tendeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02416">to life</w>: and <transChange type="added">he that hath it</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03885" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall abide</w> <w lemma="strong:H07649">satisfied</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06485" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">he shall not be visited</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">with evil</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06102">A slothful</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02934" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hideth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">his hand</w> in <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06747">bosom</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-324">and will not so much as bring</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">it to his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686" type="x-split-324">again</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05221" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">Smite</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a scorner</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06612">and the simple</w> <w lemma="strong:H06191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">will beware</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03198" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">and reprove</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">one that hath understanding</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he will understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>will beware</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">will be cunning</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07703" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">He that wasteth</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01">father</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01272" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">chaseth away</w> <transChange type="added">his</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0517">mother</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01121">a son</w> <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">that causeth shame</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02659" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">and bringeth reproach</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02308" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Cease</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01121">my son</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to hear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04148">the instruction</w> <transChange type="added">that causeth</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to err</w> <w lemma="strong:H0561">from the words</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 19:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01100">An ungodly</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">scorneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06310">and the mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">devoureth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">iniquity</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>An…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A witness of Belial</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08201">Judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">are prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">for scorners</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04112">and stripes</w> <w lemma="strong:H01460">for the back</w> <w lemma="strong:H03684">of fools</w>. <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 19." eID="gen695" osisID="Prov.19"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03196">Wine</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a mocker</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07941">strong drink</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01993" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">raging</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and whosoever is deceived</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">thereby is not wise</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0367">The fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">of a king</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05099">as the roaring</w> <w lemma="strong:H03715">of a lion</w>: <transChange type="added">whoso</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">provoketh him to anger</w> <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">sinneth</w> <transChange type="added">against</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his own soul</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:3
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03519">an honour</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">for a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H07674">to cease</w> <w lemma="strong:H07379">from strife</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0191">but every fool</w> <w lemma="strong:H01566" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">will be meddling</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06102">The sluggard</w> <w lemma="strong:H02790" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will not plow</w> <w lemma="strong:H02779">by reason of the cold</w>; <transChange type="added">therefore</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07592 strong:H07592" morph="strongMorph:TH8799 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8804">shall he beg</w> <w lemma="strong:H07105">in harvest</w>, and <transChange type="added">have</transChange> nothing.<note type="study"><catchWord>cold</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">winter</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06098">Counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in the heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w> <transChange type="added">is like</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06013">deep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">water</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0376">but a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H01802" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will draw it out</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07230">Most</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">men</w> <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">will proclaim</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">every one</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">his own goodness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0529">but a faithful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">who can find</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>goodness</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">bounty</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The just</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8693">walketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08537">in his integrity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01121">his children</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0835">blessed</w> <w lemma="strong:H0310">after</w> him.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">A king</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that sitteth in</w> <w lemma="strong:H03678">the throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H01779">of judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">scattereth away</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">all evil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">with his eyes</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:9
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Who can say</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03820">I have made my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">clean</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02891" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I am pure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02403">from my sin</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 20:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H068">Divers weights</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0374 strong:H0374">divers measures</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08147">both</w> of them <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01571">alike</w> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Divers weights</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A stone and a stone</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>divers measures</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an ephah and an ephah</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05288">Even a child</w> <w lemma="strong:H05234" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">is known</w> <w lemma="strong:H04611">by his doings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06467">whether his work</w> <transChange type="added">be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02134">pure</w>, and whether <transChange type="added">it be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">The hearing</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">ear</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the seeing</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">eye</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath made</w> <w lemma="strong:H08147">even both</w> of them.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Love</w> <w lemma="strong:H08142">not sleep</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03423" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">lest thou come to poverty</w>; <w lemma="strong:H06491" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thine eyes</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07646" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">thou shalt be satisfied</w> <w lemma="strong:H03899">with bread</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:14
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">naught</w>, <transChange type="added">it is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">naught</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">saith</w> <w lemma="strong:H07069" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">the buyer</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0235" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">but when he is gone</w> <w lemma="strong:H01984" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">his way, then he boasteth</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:15
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03426">There is</w> <w lemma="strong:H02091">gold</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07230">and a multitude</w> <w lemma="strong:H06443">of rubies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08193">but the lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">of knowledge</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03366">a precious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03627">jewel</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Take</w> <w lemma="strong:H0899">his garment</w> <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that is surety</w> <transChange type="added">for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02114" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">a stranger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02254" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">and take a pledge</w> <w lemma="strong:H05237">of him for a strange woman</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03899">Bread</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of deceit</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06156">sweet</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">to a man</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0310">but afterwards</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">shall be filled</w> <w lemma="strong:H02687">with gravel</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>deceit</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">lying</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">falsehood</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:18
verses.text: <transChange type="added">Every</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04284">purpose</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">is established</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">by counsel</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08458">and with good advice</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">make</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">war</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:19
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that goeth about</w> <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07400">a talebearer</w> <w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">revealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05475">secrets</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06148" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">therefore meddle</w> <w lemma="strong:H06601" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">not with him that flattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08193">with his lips</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>flattereth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">enticeth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:20
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07043" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">Whoso curseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01">his father</w> <w lemma="strong:H0517">or his mother</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05216">his lamp</w> <w lemma="strong:H01846" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall be put out</w> <w lemma="strong:H0380 strong:H0380" morph="strongMorph:TH8676">in obscure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02822">darkness</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>lamp</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">candle</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05159">An inheritance</w> <transChange type="added">may be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0973 strong:H0926" morph="strongMorph:TH8794 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8794">gotten hastily</w> <w lemma="strong:H07223">at the beginning</w>; <w lemma="strong:H0319">but the end</w> <w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8792">thereof shall not be blessed</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Say</w> <w lemma="strong:H07999" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">not thou, I will recompense</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>; <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06960" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">wait on</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03467" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and he shall save</w> thee.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H068 strong:H068">Divers weights</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">an abomination</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">unto the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H04820">and a false</w> <w lemma="strong:H03976">balance</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">not good</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a false…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">balance of deceit</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01397">Man’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H04703">goings</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H0120">how can a man</w> <w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">then understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his own way</w>?

verses.name: Proverbs 20:25
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04170">a snare</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">to the man</w> <transChange type="added">who</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03216" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">devoureth</w> <transChange type="added">that which is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06944">holy</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0310">and after</w> <w lemma="strong:H05088">vows</w> <w lemma="strong:H01239" morph="strongMorph:TH8763">to make enquiry</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">king</w> <w lemma="strong:H02219" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">scattereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0212">the wheel</w> over them.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05397">The spirit</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">of man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05216">the candle</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H02664" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">searching</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">all the inward parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the belly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>candle</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">lamp</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02617">Mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">and truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">preserve</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">the king</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03678">and his throne</w> <w lemma="strong:H05582" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is upholden</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">by mercy</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08597">The glory</w> <w lemma="strong:H0970">of young men</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03581">their strength</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01926">and the beauty</w> <w lemma="strong:H02205">of old men</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07872">the gray head</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 20:30
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02250">The blueness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06482">of a wound</w> <w lemma="strong:H08562">cleanseth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">away evil</w>: so <transChange type="added">do</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04347">stripes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02315">the inward parts</w> <w lemma="strong:H0990">of the belly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>cleanseth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is a purging medicine against</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 20." eID="gen696" osisID="Prov.20"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:1
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04428">The king’s</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03027">in the hand</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06388">the rivers</w> <w lemma="strong:H04325">of water</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he turneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">it whithersoever he will</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:2
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">Every way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of a man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his own eyes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">but the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H08505" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">pondereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03826">the hearts</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:3
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">To do</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">justice</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">and judgment</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">more acceptable</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">to the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w> <w lemma="strong:H02077">than sacrifice</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:4
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07312">An high</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">look</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07342">and a proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">heart</w>, <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05215">the plowing</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>, <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02403">sin</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>An…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Haughtiness of eyes</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>the plowing</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">the light</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:5
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04284">The thoughts</w> <w lemma="strong:H02742">of the diligent</w> <transChange type="added">tend</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04195">only to plenteousness</w>; but of every one <transChange type="added">that is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0213" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">hasty</w> <w lemma="strong:H04270">only to want</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:6
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06467">The getting</w> <w lemma="strong:H0214">of treasures</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">by a lying</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">tongue</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01892">a vanity</w> <w lemma="strong:H05086" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">tossed to and fro of</w> <w lemma="strong:H01245" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">them that seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H04194">death</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:7
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07701">The robbery</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H01641" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall destroy</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">them; because they refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>destroy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">saw them</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternate">dwell with them</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:8
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H01870">The way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">of man</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02019">froward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02054">and strange</w>: but <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02134">the pure</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06467">his work</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">right</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:9
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H06438">in a corner</w> <w lemma="strong:H01406">of the housetop</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04066 strong:H04079" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">than with a brawling</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w> <w lemma="strong:H02267">in a wide</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">house</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>a brawling…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">a woman of contentions</rdg></note><note type="study"><catchWord>a wide…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">an house of society</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:10
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05315">The soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">desireth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07451">evil</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07453">his neighbour</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8717">findeth no favour</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">in his eyes</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>findeth…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">is not favoured</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:11
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">When the scorner</w> <w lemma="strong:H06064" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">is punished</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06612">the simple</w> <w lemma="strong:H02449" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">is made wise</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02450">and when the wise</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">is instructed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03947" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he receiveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">knowledge</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:12
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H06662">The righteous</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8688">wisely considereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w>: <transChange type="added">but God</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05557" morph="strongMorph:TH8764">overthroweth</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">the wicked</w> for <transChange type="added">their</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07451">wickedness</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:13
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0331" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">Whoso stoppeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0241">his ears</w> <w lemma="strong:H02201">at the cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H01800">of the poor</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07121" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">he also shall cry</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">himself, but shall not be heard</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:14
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H04976">A gift</w> <w lemma="strong:H05643">in secret</w> <w lemma="strong:H03711" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">pacifieth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0639">anger</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07810">and a reward</w> <w lemma="strong:H02436">in the bosom</w> <w lemma="strong:H05794">strong</w> <w lemma="strong:H02534">wrath</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:15
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08057">joy</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">to the just</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to do</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgment</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04288">but destruction</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">to the workers</w> <w lemma="strong:H0205">of iniquity</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:16
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0120">The man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08582" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that wandereth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">out of the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H07919" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">of understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H05117" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall remain</w> <w lemma="strong:H06951">in the congregation</w> <w lemma="strong:H07496">of the dead</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:17
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08057">pleasure</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04270">a poor</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">he that loveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03196">wine</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H06238" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">shall not be rich</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>pleasure</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">sport</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:18
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">The wicked</w> <transChange type="added">shall be</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03724">a ransom</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">for the righteous</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0898" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">and the transgressor</w> <w lemma="strong:H03477">for the upright</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:19
verses.text: <transChange type="added">It is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">better</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to dwell</w> <w lemma="strong:H04057 strong:H0776">in the wilderness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04066 strong:H04079" morph="strongMorph:TH8675">than with a contentious</w> <w lemma="strong:H03708">and an angry</w> <w lemma="strong:H0802">woman</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the land of the desert</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:20
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0214">treasure</w> <w lemma="strong:H02530" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">to be desired</w> <w lemma="strong:H08081">and oil</w> <w lemma="strong:H05116">in the dwelling</w> <w lemma="strong:H02450">of the wise</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03684">but a foolish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0120">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H01104" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">spendeth it up</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:21
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07291" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">He that followeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">after righteousness</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">and mercy</w> <w lemma="strong:H04672" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">findeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02416">life</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06666">righteousness</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03519">and honour</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:22
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02450">A wise</w> <transChange type="added">man</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05927" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">scaleth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05892">the city</w> <w lemma="strong:H01368">of the mighty</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03381" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and casteth down</w> <w lemma="strong:H05797">the strength</w> <w lemma="strong:H04009">of the confidence</w> thereof.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:23
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">Whoso keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">his mouth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03956">and his tongue</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">keepeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H05315">his soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H06869">from troubles</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:24
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02086">Proud</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03093">haughty</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8801">scorner</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08034">his name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who dealeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02087">in proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H05678">wrath</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>in proud…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in the wrath of pride</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:25
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H08378">The desire</w> <w lemma="strong:H06102">of the slothful</w> <w lemma="strong:H04191" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">killeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03027">him; for his hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H03985" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">refuse</w> <w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to labour</w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:26
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H0183" morph="strongMorph:TH8694">He coveteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08378">greedily</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">all the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H06662">long: but the righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H05414" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">giveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02820" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and spareth</w> not.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:27
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H02077">The sacrifice</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08441">abomination</w>: how much more, <transChange type="added">when</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">he bringeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H02154">it with a wicked mind</w>?<note type="study"><catchWord>with…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">in wickedness?</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:28
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H03577">A false</w> <w lemma="strong:H05707">witness</w> <w lemma="strong:H06" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">shall perish</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0376">but the man</w> <w lemma="strong:H08085" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that heareth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">speaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H05331">constantly</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>A…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">A witness of lies</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:29
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H07563">A wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H0376">man</w> <w lemma="strong:H05810" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">hardeneth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">his face</w>: but <transChange type="added">as for</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03477">the upright</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03559 strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8686 strongMorph:TH8675 strongMorph:TH8799">he directeth</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">his way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>directeth</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">considereth</rdg></note>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:30
verses.text: <transChange type="added">There is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02451">no wisdom</w> <w lemma="strong:H08394">nor understanding</w> <w lemma="strong:H06098">nor counsel</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">against the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.

verses.name: Proverbs 21:31
verses.text: <w lemma="strong:H05483">The horse</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8716">prepared</w> <w lemma="strong:H03117">against the day</w> <w lemma="strong:H04421">of battle</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08668">but safety</w> <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>safety</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternate">victory</rdg></note> <chapter chapterTitle="CHAPTER 21." eID="gen697" osisID="Prov.21"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:1
